// ── Unit-cost library (ES-03). p50 values are illustrative 2025$ planning rates.
let rid = 0
function rate(assetType: AssetType, workMethod: WorkMethod, categoryId: string, description: string, unit: string, p50: number, extra: { diameterIn?: number; terrain?: Terrain; n?: number } = {}): UnitCostRate {
  rid++
  return { id: `rate-${rid}`, assetType, workMethod, categoryId, description, unit, p50: Math.round(p50), p10: Math.round(p50 * 0.78), p90: Math.round(p50 * 1.34), diameterIn: extra.diameterIn, terrain: extra.terrain, sampleSize: extra.n ?? 4 + ((rid * 7) % 19), basisYear: 2025 }
}
const DIAS = [12, 16, 20, 24, 30, 36]
const pipeCost: Record<number, number> = { 12: 95, 16: 150, 20: 205, 24: 270, 30: 365, 36: 455 }
const terrains: Terrain[] = ['urban', 'suburban', 'rural']
const tf: Record<Terrain, number> = { urban: 1.55, suburban: 1.0, rural: 0.68 }

export const RATES: UnitCostRate[] = (() => {
  const out: UnitCostRate[] = []
  for (const wm of ['replace-open-trench', 'replace-hdd'] as WorkMethod[]) {
    const hdd = wm === 'replace-hdd' ? 1.45 : 1
    for (const d of DIAS) {
      const df = d / 20
      out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-pipe', `Line pipe & fittings, ${d}" API 5L X65`, 'ft', pipeCost[d], { diameterIn: d }))
      for (const t of terrains) out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-contract', `Pipeline installation, ${d}", ${t}`, 'ft', 820 * df * tf[t] * hdd, { diameterIn: d, terrain: t }))
    }
    for (const t of terrains) {
      out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-restore', `Restoration & paving, ${t}`, 'ft', { urban: 340, suburban: 170, rural: 55 }[t], { terrain: t }))
      out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-traffic', `Traffic control, ${t}`, 'ft', { urban: 125, suburban: 48, rural: 9 }[t], { terrain: t }))
      // 2026 table: traffic control priced by region where city requirements differ
      for (const [region, f] of [['West', 1.35], ['East', 1.1]] as const) out.push({ ...rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-traffic', `Traffic control, ${t}`, 'ft', { urban: 125, suburban: 48, rural: 9 }[t] * f, { terrain: t }), region })
      out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-land', `Temporary & permanent land rights, ${t}`, 'ft', { urban: 95, suburban: 60, rural: 30 }[t], { terrain: t }))
    }
    out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-co-labor', 'Company labor (inspection, gas ops, tie-in support)', 'ft', 145))
    out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-eng', 'Engineering, survey & design', 'ft', 128))
    out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-env', 'Environmental review, monitoring & permits', 'ft', 42))
    out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-inspect', 'Weld inspection, X-ray & coating inspection', 'ft', 52))
    out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-test', 'Hydrostatic strength test of new pipe', 'ft', 28))
    out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-valves', 'Mainline valves & tie-in assemblies', 'LS', 1_350_000))
    out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-pmc', 'Project management', 'ft', 62))
    out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-support', 'Project controls, PMO, outreach & closeout support', 'ft', 38))
    out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-permit-fees', 'Permit fees (municipal, environmental, land)', 'ft', 9))
    out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', wm, 'cat-commission', 'Commissioning & functional checkout', 'ft', 6))
  }
  // Hydrotest
  for (const t of terrains) out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', 'hydrotest', 'cat-contract', `Test section setup, fill, test & dewater, ${t}`, 'ft', 165 * tf[t], { terrain: t }))
  out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', 'hydrotest', 'cat-test', 'Test water acquisition, treatment & disposal', 'ft', 38))
  out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', 'hydrotest', 'cat-co-labor', 'Company labor (gas control, blowdown, purge)', 'ft', 62))
  out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', 'hydrotest', 'cat-eng', 'Test plan engineering & segmenting', 'ft', 34))
  out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', 'hydrotest', 'cat-pipe', 'Short-section replacements & test heads', 'ft', 22))
  out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', 'hydrotest', 'cat-env', 'Discharge permit & monitoring', 'ft', 11))
  out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', 'hydrotest', 'cat-restore', 'Excavation restoration', 'ft', 31))
  out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', 'hydrotest', 'cat-pmc', 'Project management & controls', 'ft', 26))
  out.push(rate('transmission-pipeline', 'hydrotest', 'cat-valves', 'Temporary supply (CNG/LNG) and bypass', 'LS', 420_000))
  // Distribution main
  for (const d of [4, 6, 8]) for (const t of terrains) out.push(rate('distribution-main', 'replace-open-trench', 'cat-contract', `Main & service installation, ${d}" PE, ${t}`, 'ft', (210 + d * 18) * tf[t], { diameterIn: d, terrain: t }))
  for (const d of [4, 6, 8]) out.push(rate('distribution-main', 'replace-open-trench', 'cat-pipe', `PE main & service material, ${d}"`, 'ft', 9 + d * 3.2, { diameterIn: d }))
  out.push(rate('distribution-main', 'replace-open-trench', 'cat-restore', 'Paving restoration (municipal standard)', 'ft', 165))
  out.push(rate('distribution-main', 'replace-open-trench', 'cat-traffic', 'Traffic control', 'ft', 42))
  out.push(rate('distribution-main', 'replace-open-trench', 'cat-co-labor', 'Company labor (tie-overs, abandonment)', 'ft', 58))
  out.push(rate('distribution-main', 'replace-open-trench', 'cat-eng', 'Design & mapping', 'ft', 24))
  out.push(rate('distribution-main', 'replace-open-trench', 'cat-pmc', 'Project management', 'ft', 15))
  // Valve automation (per site)
  out.push(rate('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'cat-valves', 'Remote-control valve & actuator package', 'ea', 465_000))
  out.push(rate('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'cat-contract', 'Site construction & installation', 'ea', 640_000))
  out.push(rate('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'cat-equipment', 'SCADA RTU, power & communications', 'ea', 255_000))
  out.push(rate('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'cat-eng', 'Engineering & design', 'ea', 210_000))
  out.push(rate('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'cat-co-labor', 'Company labor & commissioning', 'ea', 140_000))
  out.push(rate('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'cat-env', 'Permits & environmental', 'ea', 45_000))
  out.push(rate('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'cat-land', 'Site easement', 'ea', 60_000))
  out.push(rate('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'cat-pmc', 'Project management', 'ea', 45_000))
  out.push(rate('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'cat-support', 'Project controls & closeout support', 'ea', 25_000))
  out.push(rate('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'cat-commission', 'SCADA point-to-point & functional checkout', 'ea', 38_000))
  // Compressor station modernization (lump sum per station)
  for (const wm of ['compressor-replacement', 'station-rebuild'] as WorkMethod[]) {
    const f = wm === 'station-rebuild' ? 0.55 : 1
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-equipment', 'Electric-drive compressor units & motors', 'LS', 118_000_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-contract', 'Mechanical, civil & building construction', 'LS', 142_000_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-equipment', 'Electrical substation & utility interconnect', 'LS', 46_000_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-eng', 'EPC engineering & design', 'LS', 39_000_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-env', 'Air permits, CEQA & mitigation', 'LS', 14_000_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-co-labor', 'Company labor, commissioning & startup', 'LS', 18_000_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-pmc', 'Owner PM & oversight', 'LS', 10_000_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-support', 'Project controls, PMO, regulatory & closeout support', 'LS', 6_000_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-commission', 'Commissioning & startup support', 'LS', 7_500_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-fabrication', 'Skid & piping spool fabrication', 'LS', 9_000_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-permit-fees', 'Air district & building permit fees', 'LS', 1_200_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
    out.push(rate('compressor-station', wm, 'cat-inspect', 'QA/QC & third-party inspection', 'LS', 7_500_000 * f, { n: 3 }))
  }
  return out
})()

// ── Historical cost table (ES-20): direct $/unit from closed projects, base-year dollars.
// Built from the unit-rate library so the demo's Class 5 quick estimates agree with its parametric estimates.
export function buildHistoricalCosts(rates: UnitCostRate[]): HistoricalCost[] {
  const out: HistoricalCost[] = []
  let k = 0
  const codes = ['PRJ-0871', 'PRJ-0904', 'PRJ-0912', 'PRJ-0933', 'PRJ-0957', 'PRJ-0968', 'PRJ-0981', 'PRJ-0995', 'PRJ-1003', 'PRJ-1011', 'PRJ-1017', 'PRJ-1024']
  const add = (assetType: AssetType, workMethod: WorkMethod, diameterBand: DiameterBand, terrain: Terrain | 'any', unit: HistUnit, rep: { dia: number; terrain: Terrain; len: number; qty: number; sites?: number }) => {
    const proj = { asset: { type: assetType, diameterIn: rep.dia, lengthFt: rep.len }, workMethod, location: { terrain: rep.terrain }, scope: { quantities: [{ label: 'Valve sites', qty: rep.sites ?? 1, unit: 'ea' }] } } as unknown as Project
    const lines = parametricLines(proj, rates)
    if (!lines.length) return
    const byCat: Record<string, number> = {}
    for (const l of lines) byCat[l.categoryId] = (byCat[l.categoryId] || 0) + l.qty * l.unitCost
    const tot = Object.values(byCat).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
    const per = tot / rep.qty
    k++
    const wob = 0.94 + ((k * 37) % 13) / 100 // history is never exactly the library
    const n = 3 + ((k * 7) % 11)
    out.push({
      id: `hc-${k}`, assetType, workMethod, diameterBand, terrain, unit,
      p50: Math.round(per * wob), p10: Math.round(per * wob * (0.7 + (k % 3) * 0.03)), p90: Math.round(per * wob * (1.38 + (k % 4) * 0.06)),
      n, baseYear: k % 3 ? 2025 : 2024,
      mix: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(byCat).map(([c, v]) => [c, +(v / tot).toFixed(4)])),
      sources: codes.filter((_, i) => (i + k) % 3 === 0).slice(0, Math.min(n, 5)),
      updatedAt: '2026-07-15', updatedById: 'u-estl', active: true,
      note: n < 5 ? 'Small sample — confirm with the estimating lead' : undefined,
    })
  }
  const bands: [DiameterBand, number][] = [['10-16', 16], ['20-24', 24], ['26-36', 30]]
  for (const wm of ['replace-open-trench', 'replace-hdd'] as WorkMethod[])
    for (const [b, d] of bands) for (const t of ['urban', 'suburban', 'rural'] as Terrain[]) add('transmission-pipeline', wm, b, t, 'ft', { dia: d, terrain: t, len: 15_000, qty: 15_000 })
  for (const t of ['urban', 'suburban', 'rural'] as Terrain[]) add('transmission-pipeline', 'hydrotest', 'n/a', t, 'ft', { dia: 20, terrain: t, len: 25_000, qty: 25_000 })
  for (const t of ['urban', 'suburban', 'rural'] as Terrain[]) add('distribution-main', 'replace-open-trench', 'le-8', t, 'ft', { dia: 6, terrain: t, len: 8_000, qty: 8_000 })
  add('valve-site', 'valve-automation', 'n/a', 'any', 'site', { dia: 24, terrain: 'suburban', len: 0, qty: 3, sites: 3 })
  add('compressor-station', 'compressor-replacement', 'n/a', 'any', 'hp', { dia: 0, terrain: 'rural', len: 0, qty: 22_000 })
  add('compressor-station', 'station-rebuild', 'n/a', 'any', 'hp', { dia: 0, terrain: 'rural', len: 0, qty: 9_000 })
  k++
  out.push({ id: `hc-${k}`, assetType: 'regulator-station', workMethod: 'station-rebuild', diameterBand: 'n/a', terrain: 'any', unit: 'station', p10: 1_900_000, p50: 2_750_000, p90: 4_100_000, n: 9, baseYear: 2025, mix: { 'cat-equipment': 0.24, 'cat-contract': 0.38, 'cat-eng': 0.12, 'cat-co-labor': 0.1, 'cat-land': 0.04, 'cat-env': 0.03, 'cat-inspect': 0.03, 'cat-pmc': 0.06 }, sources: ['PRJ-0912', 'PRJ-0968', 'PRJ-1011'], updatedAt: '2026-07-15', updatedById: 'u-estl', active: true })
  return out
}

===== FILE: src/core/seed/workflows.ts =====
// Default process catalog (Module 7). Each is a published, versioned WorkflowDef a client edits in the designer.
import type { Assignee, FormField, RecordType, RoleId, WfEdge, WfNode, WorkflowDef } from '../types'

type Step = { id: string; type: WfNode['type']; label: string; a?: Assignee; sla?: number; rule?: 'any' | 'all'; desc?: string; sys?: WfNode['systemAction'] }

const role = (roleId: RoleId): Assignee => ({ kind: 'role', roleId })
const team = (position: Extract<Assignee, { kind: 'team-position' }>['position']): Assignee => ({ kind: 'team-position', position })
const requester: Assignee = { kind: 'requester' }
const doa: Assignee = { kind: 'doa', field: 'amount' }

let eid = 0
const E = (from: string, to: string, extra: Partial<WfEdge> = {}): WfEdge => ({ id: `e${++eid}`, from, to, ...extra })

/** A straight-line process: start → steps → end. Approvals/reviews get a 'return' edge to the first form step. */
function linear(
  id: string, key: string, name: string, recordType: RecordType, ownerRole: RoleId, description: string, purpose: string, fields: FormField[], steps: Step[],
): WorkflowDef {
  const all: Step[] = [{ id: 'start', type: 'start', label: 'Start' }, ...steps, { id: 'end', type: 'end', label: 'Complete' }]
  const nodes: WfNode[] = all.map((s, i) => ({ id: s.id, type: s.type, label: s.label, x: 60 + i * 170, y: 160, assignee: s.a, slaDays: s.sla, rule: s.rule, description: s.desc, systemAction: s.sys }))
  const edges: WfEdge[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < all.length - 1; i++) edges.push(E(all[i].id, all[i + 1].id, { outcome: all[i].type === 'approval' || all[i].type === 'review' ? 'approve' : undefined }))
  const firstForm = steps.find((s) => s.type === 'form')
  if (firstForm) for (const s of steps) if ((s.type === 'approval' || s.type === 'review') && s.id !== firstForm.id) edges.push(E(s.id, firstForm.id, { outcome: 'return', label: 'Return for revision' }))
  return { id, key, name, recordType, version: 1, status: 'published', effective: '2026-01-01', description, purpose, nodes, edges, fields, ownerRole }
}

const money = (key: string, label: string): FormField => ({ key, label, type: 'money', required: true })
const text = (key: string, label: string): FormField => ({ key, label, type: 'textarea', required: true })

/** Phase-2 modules hidden for the pilot (settings.features). */
const NAV_FEATURE: Record<string, keyof AppState['settings']['features']> = { field: 'fieldTailboard', planning: 'portfolioPlanning' }
const CHAT_PATH = 'M4 5h16v11H9l-5 4zM8 9h8M8 12h5'

/** Send workflow reminders and escalations that are due (idempotent). */
function remindIfDue() {
  if (planReminders(getState()).length) mutate((d) => { runReminders(d) }, undefined, { background: true })
}

function PhaseTwo({ name }: { name: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl py-10">
      <Empty title={`${name} is a phase 2 module`} action={<a href="#admin-modules"><Button>Configuration → Modules</Button></a>}>It is turned off for the pilot. An administrator can turn it on in Configuration → Modules.</Empty>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function App() {
  const route = useRoute()
  const features = useStore((s) => s.settings.features)
  const sync = useSync()
  const [unlockOpen, setUnlockOpen] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    const s = startAppSync((m) => toast(m, 'info'))
    void s.start().then(remindIfDue)
    return () => s.stop()
  }, [])
  useUploadGuard()
  const [askOpen, setAskOpen] = useState(false)
  const [navOpen, setNavOpen] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => setNavOpen(false), [route.view, route.id, route.tab])
  const view = (() => {
    switch (route.view) {
      case 'project': return <ProjectView id={route.id!} tab={route.tab} />
      case 'workflow': return <Designer id={route.id} />
      case 'projects': return <Projects />
      case 'new-project': return <NewProject />
      case 'gates': return <Gates />
      case 'estimating': return <Estimating />
      case 'regulatory': return <Regulatory />
      case 'risk': return <RiskPortfolio />
      case 'safety': return <SafetyHome />
      case 'field': return features?.fieldTailboard ? <FieldMode /> : <PhaseTwo name="Field tailboard" />
      case 'inbox': return <Inbox />
      case 'workflows': return <Catalog />
      case 'admin': return <Admin />
      case 'planning': return features?.portfolioPlanning ? <Planning /> : <PhaseTwo name="Portfolio planning" />
      case 'audit': return <Audit />
      case 'forecast': return <ForecastCycle />
      case 'map': return <MapPage />
      case 'actuals': return <Actuals />
      default:
        if (isMessagesView(route.view)) return <Messages view={route.view} />
        if (route.view.startsWith('admin-')) return <Admin id={route.view.slice(6)} />
        return <Portfolio />
    }
  })()
  if (sync.mode === 'connecting') return <Connecting />
  const activeNav = route.view === 'project' ? 'projects' : route.view === 'workflow' ? 'workflows' : route.view === 'new-project' ? 'projects' : isMessagesView(route.view) ? 'messages' : route.view.startsWith('admin-') ? 'admin' : route.view
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full">
      <aside className={cx('fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-40 flex w-[236px] flex-col bg-steel text-steelink transition-transform lg:static lg:translate-x-0', navOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full')} style={{ paddingTop: 'env(safe-area-inset-top)', paddingLeft: 'env(safe-area-inset-left)' }}>
        <Sidebar active={activeNav} />
      </aside>
      {navOpen && <div className="fixed inset-0 z-30 bg-steel/50 lg:hidden" onClick={() => setNavOpen(false)} />}
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
        <TopBar onMenu={() => setNavOpen(true)} onAsk={() => setAskOpen(true)} onUnlock={() => setUnlockOpen(true)} />
        <main id="main" className="min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto" style={{ paddingLeft: 'max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left))', paddingRight: 'max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right))' }}>
          <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1440px] py-5 sm:px-2" style={{ paddingBottom: 'max(40px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))' }}><SyncBanner onUnlock={() => setUnlockOpen(true)} />{view}</div>
        </main>
      </div>
      <AskPanel open={askOpen} onClose={() => setAskOpen(false)} />
      <PasscodeModal open={unlockOpen} onClose={() => setUnlockOpen(false)} />
      <Toaster />
    </div>
  )
}

function Sidebar({ active }: { active: string }) {
  const me = useStore((s) => s.currentUserId)
  const taskCount = useStore((s) => tasksFor(s, me).length)
  const unreadMsgs = useStore((s) => unreadCount(s, me))
  const features = useStore((s) => s.settings.features)
  const org = useStore((s) => s.settings.orgName)
  const asOf = useStore((s) => s.settings.asOf)
  const reset = useStore((s) => s.reset)
  const sync = useSync()
  const sharedView = sync.mode === 'shared' && !sync.canEdit
  return (
    <>
      <a href="#portfolio" className="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 pb-3 pt-4">
        <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-sm bg-marker font-display text-[17px] font-black text-markerink">C</span>
        <span className="flex flex-col leading-tight"><span className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold tracking-tight text-white">Crosswalk</span><span className="text-[11px] text-steelink/70">Capital project delivery</span></span>
      </a>
      <div className="mark-stripe mx-4 mb-3 h-1 rounded-full opacity-80" />
      <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-2 pb-4">
        {NAV.map((g) => (
          <div key={g.group} className="mb-3">
            <div className="px-2 pb-1 pt-2 text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-steelink/50">{g.group}</div>
            {g.items.filter((it) => !NAV_FEATURE[it.id] || features?.[NAV_FEATURE[it.id]]).map((it) => (
              <a key={it.id} href={`#${it.id}`} className={cx('flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium', active === it.id ? 'bg-white/10 text-white' : 'text-steelink/85 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white')}>
                {it.icon === 'chat'
                  ? <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" className={cx('h-4 w-4', active === it.id ? 'text-marker' : 'text-steelink/60')} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden><path d={CHAT_PATH} /></svg>
                  : <Icon name={it.icon} className={cx('h-4 w-4', active === it.id ? 'text-marker' : 'text-steelink/60')} />}
                <span className="flex-1">{it.label}</span>
                {it.id === 'inbox' && taskCount > 0 && <span className="rounded-full bg-marker px-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold tabular-nums text-markerink">{taskCount}</span>}
                {it.id === 'messages' && unreadMsgs > 0 && <span className="rounded-full bg-white/15 px-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold tabular-nums text-white" title={`${unreadMsgs} unread`}>{unreadMsgs}</span>}
              </a>
            ))}
          </div>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <div className="border-t border-white/10 px-4 py-3 text-[11px] text-steelink/60" style={{ paddingBottom: 'max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))' }}>
        <div className="font-semibold text-steelink/80">{org}</div>
        <div>{sync.mode === 'shared' ? 'Shared demo data' : 'Demo data'} · as of {fmtDate(asOf)}</div>
        {!sharedView && <div className="mt-2"><ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel={sync.mode === 'shared' ? 'Reset for everyone' : 'Reset all data'} onConfirm={() => { reset(); toast(sync.mode === 'shared' ? 'Demo data reset for everyone' : 'Demo data reset'); go('#portfolio') }}>Reset demo data</ConfirmButton></div>}
      </div>
    </>
  )
}

function TopBar({ onMenu, onAsk, onUnlock }: { onMenu: () => void; onAsk: () => void; onUnlock: () => void }) {
  const me = useMe()
  const people = useStore((s) => s.people)
  const setUser = useStore((s) => s.setUser)
  const projects = useStore((s) => s.projects)
  const notes = useStore((s) => s.notifications.filter((n) => n.toId === s.currentUserId))
  const update = useStore((s) => s.update)
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [bell, setBell] = useState(false)
  const hits = useMemo(() => (q.length < 2 ? [] : projects.filter((p) => (p.code + ' ' + p.name + ' ' + p.location.city).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())).slice(0, 8)), [q, projects])
  const unread = notes.filter((n) => !n.read).length
  const ai = useAiAvailable()
  return (
    <div className="sticky z-20 flex h-12 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 border-b border-line bg-surface" style={{ top: 'env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)', paddingLeft: 'max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-left))', paddingRight: 'max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-right))' }}>
      <button className="rounded p-1.5 text-muted hover:bg-sunken lg:hidden" onClick={onMenu} aria-label="Open navigation"><Icon name="menu" className="h-5 w-5" /></button>
      <div className="relative min-w-0 flex-1 sm:max-w-sm">
        <Icon name="search" className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-faint" />
        <input id="global-search" className="inp pl-8" placeholder="Find a project by number, name or city" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && hits[0]) { go(projectHref(hits[0].id)); setQ('') } }} />
        {hits.length > 0 && (
          <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-9 z-30 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface py-1 shadow-xl">
            {hits.map((p) => <a key={p.id} href={projectHref(p.id)} onClick={() => setQ('')} className="flex gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] hover:bg-sunken"><span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold">{p.code}</span><span className="truncate">{p.name}</span></a>)}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="ml-auto flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
        <SyncStatusChip onUnlock={onUnlock} />
        {ai && <Button variant="marker" size="sm" onClick={onAsk} icon={<span aria-hidden>✦</span>}>Ask</Button>}
        <div className="relative">
          <button onClick={() => setBell(!bell)} className="relative rounded p-1.5 text-muted hover:bg-sunken" aria-label="Notifications"><Icon name="bell" className="h-5 w-5" />{unread > 0 && <span className="absolute -right-0.5 -top-0.5 rounded-full bg-bad px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">{unread}</span>}</button>
          {bell && (
            <div className="absolute right-0 top-10 z-30 w-80 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface shadow-xl">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-3 py-2"><b className="text-[13px]">Notifications</b><button className="text-xs text-link" onClick={() => update((d) => d.notifications.forEach((n) => { if (n.toId === d.currentUserId) n.read = true }))}>Mark all read</button></div>
              <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
                {notes.length === 0 && <div className="px-3 py-4 text-[13px] text-muted">Nothing new.</div>}
                {notes.slice().reverse().slice(0, 30).map((n) => <a key={n.id} href={n.link.startsWith('#') ? n.link : '#inbox'} onClick={() => setBell(false)} className={cx('block border-b border-line/60 px-3 py-2 text-[13px] hover:bg-sunken', !n.read && 'font-semibold')}>{n.text}<div className="text-[11px] font-normal text-faint">{fmtDateTime(n.at)}</div></a>)}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <UserMenu me={me} />
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded border border-line px-1.5 py-1" title="Act as another person to demo routing and approvals">
          <select id="persona" className="max-w-[96px] bg-transparent text-[12px] font-semibold outline-none sm:max-w-[220px]" value={me.id} onChange={(e) => { setUser(e.target.value); toast(`Now acting as ${people.find((p) => p.id === e.target.value)?.name}`, 'info') }}>
            {people.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name} — {p.title}{p.company ? ` (${p.company})` : ''}</option>)}
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

const isAway = (p: Person | undefined, asOf: string) => !!p?.outOfOffice && asOf >= p.outOfOffice.from && asOf <= p.outOfOffice.to

/** Avatar menu: who you are, your out-of-office status and who you are covering for. */
function UserMenu({ me }: { me: Person }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [ooo, setOoo] = useState(false)
  const asOf = useStore((s) => s.settings.asOf)
  const people = useStore((s) => s.people)
  const away = isAway(me, asOf)
  const oo = me.outOfOffice
  const scheduled = !!oo && oo.to >= asOf && !away
  const covering = people.filter((p) => p.outOfOffice?.delegateId === me.id && isAway(p, asOf))
  useEffect(() => setOpen(false), [me.id])
  const end = () => {
    mutate((d) => { const p = d.people.find((x) => x.id === me.id); if (p) delete p.outOfOffice }, { entity: 'person', entityId: me.id, action: 'delegate-end', summary: 'Ended out-of-office delegation' })
    toast('Out of office ended — steps route to you again')
    setOpen(false)
  }
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <button id="user-menu" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} className="relative flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded p-1 hover:bg-sunken" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={open} aria-label={`Account menu for ${me.name}${away ? ' (out of office)' : ''}`}>
        <Avatar name={me.name} size={24} />
        {away && <span className="hidden rounded-sm bg-warn/15 px-1.5 py-px text-[10.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-warn sm:inline">Out of office</span>}
        {(away || covering.length > 0) && <span className={cx('absolute left-5 top-0.5 h-2 w-2 rounded-full border border-surface', away ? 'bg-warn' : 'bg-info')} />}
      </button>
      {open && (
        <>
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-20" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} />
          <div role="menu" className="absolute right-0 top-10 z-30 w-[300px] max-w-[calc(100vw-24px)] rounded-md border border-line bg-surface shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-line px-3 py-2.5">
              <Avatar name={me.name} size={32} />
              <div className="min-w-0"><div className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold">{me.name}</div><div className="truncate text-[11.5px] text-muted">{me.title}{me.company ? ` · ${me.company}` : ''}</div><div className="truncate text-[11px] text-faint">{me.email}</div></div>
            </div>
            <div className="border-b border-line px-3 py-2.5 text-[12.5px]">
              <div className="eyebrow mb-1">Status</div>
              {away ? <div><Badge tone="warn">Out of office</Badge> <span className="text-muted">until {fmtDate(oo!.to)}</span><div className="mt-1 text-muted">{personName(getState(), oo!.delegateId)} is acting for you on workflow steps.</div></div>
                : scheduled ? <div><Badge tone="info">Scheduled</Badge> <span className="text-muted">away {fmtDate(oo!.from)} – {fmtDate(oo!.to)} · {personName(getState(), oo!.delegateId)} covering</span></div>
                  : <div className="text-muted"><span className="mr-1.5 inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-good" />Available — steps route to you</div>}
              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <Button size="sm" variant={away || scheduled ? 'secondary' : 'primary'} onClick={() => { setOoo(true); setOpen(false) }}>{away || scheduled ? 'Edit out of office' : 'Set out of office…'}</Button>
                {(away || scheduled) && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={end}>End</Button>}
              </div>
            </div>
            {covering.length > 0 && (
              <div className="border-b border-line px-3 py-2.5 text-[12.5px]">
                <div className="eyebrow mb-1">Acting for</div>
                {covering.map((p) => <div key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 py-0.5"><Avatar name={p.name} size={18} /><span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{p.name}</span><span className="text-[11px] text-faint">to {fmtDate(p.outOfOffice!.to)}</span></div>)}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex flex-col py-1 text-[13px]">
              <a href="#inbox" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-sunken">My work</a>
              <a href="#messages" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-sunken">Messages</a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      <OutOfOfficeModal open={ooo} onClose={() => setOoo(false)} me={me} />
    </div>
  )
}

function OutOfOfficeModal({ open, onClose, me }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; me: Person }) {
  const asOf = useStore((s) => s.settings.asOf)
  const people = useStore((s) => s.people)
  const openSteps = useStore((s) => tasksFor(s, me.id).filter((t) => !t.actingFor).length)
  const [from, setFrom] = useState(asOf)
  const [to, setTo] = useState(addDays(asOf, 7))
  const [delegate, setDelegate] = useState('')
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    setFrom(me.outOfOffice?.from ?? asOf); setTo(me.outOfOffice?.to ?? addDays(asOf, 7)); setDelegate(me.outOfOffice?.delegateId ?? '')
  }, [open, me.id]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const candidates = people.filter((p) => p.id !== me.id && (!!me.company === !!p.company))
  const sameRole = candidates.filter((p) => p.roles.some((r) => me.roles.includes(r) && r !== 'admin'))
  const dp = people.find((p) => p.id === delegate)
  const loop = dp?.outOfOffice && dp.outOfOffice.delegateId === me.id && dp.outOfOffice.from <= to && dp.outOfOffice.to >= from
  const dpAway = dp?.outOfOffice && dp.outOfOffice.from <= to && dp.outOfOffice.to >= from
  const bad = !delegate || !from || !to || to < from || !!loop
  const save = () => {
    if (bad) return
    mutate((d) => {
      const p = d.people.find((x) => x.id === me.id)!
      p.outOfOffice = { from, to, delegateId: delegate }
      d.notifications.push({ id: uid('ntf'), at: nowISO(), toId: delegate, text: `${me.name} is out of office ${fmtDate(from)} – ${fmtDate(to)} and named you as delegate. Their workflow steps appear in your My work.`, link: '#inbox', read: false, kind: 'info' })
    }, { entity: 'person', entityId: me.id, action: 'delegate', summary: `Out of office ${from} to ${to}; delegate ${dp?.name}` })
    toast(from <= asOf && to >= asOf ? `Out of office — ${dp?.name} is now acting for you` : `Out of office scheduled from ${fmtDate(from)}`)
    onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="Out of office"
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={bad} onClick={save}>Save</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">While you are away, new workflow steps route to your delegate, and the <b className="text-ink">{openSteps}</b> step{openSteps === 1 ? '' : 's'} already waiting on you show in their My work as “acting for {me.name}”. Every action they take is signed by them and recorded as on your behalf.</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="From"><Input id="ooo-from" type="date" value={from} onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)} /></Field>
          <Field label="To"><Input id="ooo-to" type="date" value={to} min={from} onChange={(e) => setTo(e.target.value)} /></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Delegate" hint={sameRole.length ? 'People who share one of your roles are listed first.' : undefined}>
          <Select id="ooo-delegate" value={delegate} onChange={(e) => setDelegate(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: '— Select —' }, ...sameRole.map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: `${p.name} · ${p.title} (same role)` })), ...candidates.filter((p) => !sameRole.includes(p)).map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: `${p.name} · ${p.title}` }))]} />
        </Field>
        {to < from && <Callout tone="bad">The end date is before the start date.</Callout>}
        {loop && <Callout tone="bad">{dp!.name} has named you as their delegate for overlapping dates. Pick someone else.</Callout>}
        {!loop && dpAway && <Callout tone="warn">{dp!.name} is also out of office for part of this time ({fmtDate(dp!.outOfOffice!.from)} – {fmtDate(dp!.outOfOffice!.to)}).</Callout>}
        {dp && dp.dollarAuthority < me.dollarAuthority && <Callout tone="warn">{dp.name}'s dollar authority is lower than yours. Steps routed by the DOA matrix still go to someone with enough authority.</Callout>}
        <p className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">Email auto-reply in Outlook is set separately until the mail integration is connected.</p>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

// Hand-drawn SVG charts on one scale each. All colors are theme tokens.
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { money } from '@/core/util'

export const SERIES = ['rgb(var(--link))', 'rgb(var(--marker))', 'rgb(var(--good))', 'rgb(var(--bad))', 'rgb(var(--muted))', 'rgb(var(--info))']
const AXIS = 'rgb(var(--line))'
const TEXT = 'rgb(var(--muted))'

function niceTicks(min: number, max: number, n = 4): number[] {
  if (max === min) max = min + 1
  const span = max - min
  const step0 = span / n
  const mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(step0)))
  const step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map((m) => m * mag).find((s) => span / s <= n) ?? mag * 10
  const lo = Math.floor(min / step) * step
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let v = lo; v <= max + step * 0.5; v += step) out.push(Math.round(v * 1e6) / 1e6)
  return out
}

export interface LineSeries { name: string; values: (number | null)[]; color?: string; dashed?: boolean; area?: boolean }

/** Line chart over categorical x labels (months, dates). */
export function LineChart({ labels, series, height = 220, format = money, markers, yMin }: { labels: string[]; series: LineSeries[]; height?: number; format?: (n: number) => string; markers?: { index: number; label: string }[]; yMin?: number }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const W = 720, H = height, L = 64, Rm = 16, T = 14, B = 30
  const vals = series.flatMap((s) => s.values.filter((v): v is number => v != null))
  const max = Math.max(...vals, 0), min = Math.min(yMin ?? 0, ...vals)
  const ticks = niceTicks(min, max)
  const ymin = ticks[0], ymax = ticks[ticks.length - 1]
  const X = (i: number) => L + (labels.length <= 1 ? 0 : (i / (labels.length - 1)) * (W - L - Rm))
  const Y = (v: number) => T + (1 - (v - ymin) / (ymax - ymin || 1)) * (H - T - B)
  const every = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(labels.length / 8))
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} className="w-full" role="img" onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}>
        {ticks.map((t) => <g key={t}><line x1={L} x2={W - Rm} y1={Y(t)} y2={Y(t)} stroke={AXIS} strokeWidth={1} /><text x={L - 8} y={Y(t) + 4} textAnchor="end" fontSize={11} fill={TEXT}>{format(t)}</text></g>)}
        {labels.map((l, i) => i % every === 0 && <text key={i} x={X(i)} y={H - 10} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} fill={TEXT}>{l}</text>)}
        {markers?.map((m) => <g key={m.index}><line x1={X(m.index)} x2={X(m.index)} y1={T} y2={H - B} stroke="rgb(var(--ink))" strokeDasharray="3 3" strokeWidth={1} /><text x={X(m.index) + 4} y={T + 10} fontSize={11} fill="rgb(var(--ink))">{m.label}</text></g>)}
        {series.map((s, si) => {
          const c = s.color ?? SERIES[si % SERIES.length]
          const pts = s.values.map((v, i) => (v == null ? null : [X(i), Y(v)] as const))
          let d = ''
          pts.forEach((p, i) => { if (!p) return; d += (d && pts[i - 1] ? 'L' : 'M') + p[0].toFixed(1) + ' ' + p[1].toFixed(1) })
          const valid = pts.filter(Boolean) as (readonly [number, number])[]
          const area = s.area && valid.length ? `M${valid[0][0]} ${Y(Math.max(ymin, 0))}L` + valid.map((p) => `${p[0]} ${p[1]}`).join('L') + `L${valid[valid.length - 1][0]} ${Y(Math.max(ymin, 0))}Z` : ''
          const last = valid[valid.length - 1]
          return <g key={s.name}>{area && <path d={area} fill={c} opacity={0.1} />}<path d={d} fill="none" stroke={c} strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray={s.dashed ? '5 4' : undefined} strokeLinejoin="round" />{last && <circle cx={last[0]} cy={last[1]} r={3.5} fill={c} />}</g>
        })}
        {labels.map((_, i) => <rect key={i} x={X(i) - (W - L) / labels.length / 2} y={T} width={(W - L) / labels.length} height={H - T - B} fill="transparent" onMouseEnter={() => setHover(i)} />)}
        {hover != null && <line x1={X(hover)} x2={X(hover)} y1={T} y2={H - B} stroke={TEXT} strokeWidth={1} />}
      </svg>
      <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-muted">
        {series.map((s, si) => <span key={s.name} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="inline-block h-0.5 w-4" style={{ background: s.color ?? SERIES[si % SERIES.length], borderTop: s.dashed ? '2px dashed' : undefined }} />{s.name}{hover != null && s.values[hover] != null && <b className="tabular-nums text-ink">{format(s.values[hover] as number)}</b>}</span>)}
        {hover != null && <span className="text-faint">{labels[hover]}</span>}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Vertical bars; multiple series render side by side (grouped) or stacked. */
export function BarChart({ labels, series, height = 220, format = money, stacked, highlight }: { labels: string[]; series: { name: string; values: number[]; color?: string }[]; height?: number; format?: (n: number) => string; stacked?: boolean; highlight?: number }) {
  const W = 720, H = height, L = 64, Rm = 12, T = 12, B = 30
  const totals = labels.map((_, i) => (stacked ? series.reduce((a, s) => a + Math.max(0, s.values[i] || 0), 0) : Math.max(...series.map((s) => s.values[i] || 0))))
  const ticks = niceTicks(0, Math.max(...totals, 1))
  const ymax = ticks[ticks.length - 1]
  const bw = (W - L - Rm) / labels.length
  const Y = (v: number) => T + (1 - v / ymax) * (H - T - B)
  const every = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(labels.length / 10))
  return (
    <div>
      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} className="w-full" role="img">
        {ticks.map((t) => <g key={t}><line x1={L} x2={W - Rm} y1={Y(t)} y2={Y(t)} stroke={AXIS} /><text x={L - 8} y={Y(t) + 4} textAnchor="end" fontSize={11} fill={TEXT}>{format(t)}</text></g>)}
        {labels.map((l, i) => {
          const x0 = L + i * bw
          let acc = 0
          return (
            <g key={i} opacity={highlight == null || highlight === i ? 1 : 0.45}>
              <title>{l + ': ' + series.map((s) => `${s.name} ${format(s.values[i] || 0)}`).join(', ')}</title>
              {series.map((s, si) => {
                const v = Math.max(0, s.values[i] || 0)
                const c = s.color ?? SERIES[si % SERIES.length]
                if (stacked) { const y = Y(acc + v), h = Y(acc) - y; acc += v; return <rect key={si} x={x0 + bw * 0.18} y={y} width={bw * 0.64} height={Math.max(0, h)} fill={c} /> }
                const gw = (bw * 0.7) / series.length
                return <rect key={si} x={x0 + bw * 0.15 + si * gw} y={Y(v)} width={gw - 1} height={Math.max(0, Y(0) - Y(v))} fill={c} rx={1} />
              })}
              {i % every === 0 && <text x={x0 + bw / 2} y={H - 10} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} fill={TEXT}>{l}</text>}
            </g>
          )
        })}
      </svg>
      {series.length > 1 && <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 text-xs text-muted">{series.map((s, si) => <span key={s.name} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm" style={{ background: s.color ?? SERIES[si % SERIES.length] }} />{s.name}</span>)}</div>}
    </div>
  )
}

/** Horizontal bars with labels on the left — for ranked lists. */
export function HBarChart({ rows, format = money, max }: { rows: { label: string; value: number; color?: string; sub?: string }[]; format?: (n: number) => string; max?: number }) {
  const m = max ?? Math.max(...rows.map((r) => Math.abs(r.value)), 1)
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
      {rows.map((r) => (
        <div key={r.label} className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,180px)_1fr_auto] items-center gap-2 text-[12px]">
          <span className="truncate" title={r.label}>{r.label}{r.sub && <span className="ml-1 text-faint">{r.sub}</span>}</span>
          <span className="h-3 rounded-sm bg-sunken"><span className="block h-3 rounded-sm" style={{ width: `${(Math.abs(r.value) / m) * 100}%`, background: r.color ?? SERIES[0] }} /></span>
          <span className="tabular-nums text-muted">{format(r.value)}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

/** Waterfall bridge from one total to another (estimate or baseline bridge). */
export function Waterfall({ start, end, steps, startLabel = 'From', endLabel = 'To', height = 240 }: { start: number; end: number; steps: { label: string; delta: number }[]; startLabel?: string; endLabel?: string; height?: number }) {
  const W = 720, H = height, L = 64, Rm = 12, T = 18, B = 46
  const bars: { label: string; y0: number; y1: number; kind: 'total' | 'up' | 'down' }[] = [{ label: startLabel, y0: 0, y1: start, kind: 'total' }]
  let acc = start
  for (const s of steps) { bars.push({ label: s.label, y0: acc, y1: acc + s.delta, kind: s.delta >= 0 ? 'up' : 'down' }); acc += s.delta }
  bars.push({ label: endLabel, y0: 0, y1: end, kind: 'total' })
  const hi = Math.max(...bars.map((b) => Math.max(b.y0, b.y1)))
  const lo = Math.min(0, ...bars.map((b) => Math.min(b.y0, b.y1)))
  const ticks = niceTicks(lo, hi)
  const ymin = ticks[0], ymax = ticks[ticks.length - 1]
  const Y = (v: number) => T + (1 - (v - ymin) / (ymax - ymin)) * (H - T - B)
  const bw = (W - L - Rm) / bars.length
  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} className="w-full" role="img">
      {ticks.map((t) => <g key={t}><line x1={L} x2={W - Rm} y1={Y(t)} y2={Y(t)} stroke={AXIS} /><text x={L - 8} y={Y(t) + 4} textAnchor="end" fontSize={11} fill={TEXT}>{money(t)}</text></g>)}
      {bars.map((b, i) => {
        const x = L + i * bw + bw * 0.15, w = bw * 0.7
        const top = Y(Math.max(b.y0, b.y1)), h = Math.max(1.5, Math.abs(Y(b.y0) - Y(b.y1)))
        const c = b.kind === 'total' ? 'rgb(var(--ink))' : b.kind === 'up' ? 'rgb(var(--bad))' : 'rgb(var(--good))'
        const delta = b.y1 - b.y0
        return (
          <g key={i}>
            <rect x={x} y={top} width={w} height={h} fill={c} opacity={b.kind === 'total' ? 0.85 : 0.8} rx={1} />
            {i < bars.length - 1 && <line x1={x + w} x2={x + bw} y1={Y(b.y1)} y2={Y(b.y1)} stroke={TEXT} strokeDasharray="2 2" />}
            <text x={x + w / 2} y={top - 4} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10.5} fill="rgb(var(--ink))">{b.kind === 'total' ? money(b.y1) : (delta > 0 ? '+' : '') + money(delta)}</text>
            <text x={x + w / 2} y={H - B + 14} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10.5} fill={TEXT}>{b.label.length > 14 ? b.label.slice(0, 13) + '…' : b.label}</text>
          </g>
        )
      })}
    </svg>
  )
}

export function Sparkline({ values, width = 90, height = 24, color = SERIES[0] }: { values: number[]; width?: number; height?: number; color?: string }) {
  if (values.length < 2) return <svg width={width} height={height} />
  const mx = Math.max(...values), mn = Math.min(...values)
  const X = (i: number) => (i / (values.length - 1)) * (width - 4) + 2
  const Y = (v: number) => height - 3 - ((v - mn) / (mx - mn || 1)) * (height - 6)
  const d = values.map((v, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${X(i).toFixed(1)} ${Y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join('')
  return <svg width={width} height={height} aria-hidden><path d={d} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth={1.5} /><circle cx={X(values.length - 1)} cy={Y(values[values.length - 1])} r={2.5} fill={color} /></svg>
}

/** Histogram with percentile markers (Monte Carlo). */
export function Histogram({ bins, markers, format = money, height = 200 }: { bins: { x: number; n: number }[]; markers?: { x: number; label: string; color?: string }[]; format?: (n: number) => string; height?: number }) {
  const W = 720, H = height, L = 16, Rm = 16, T = 22, B = 28
  if (!bins.length) return null
  const lo = bins[0].x, hi = bins[bins.length - 1].x
  const mx = Math.max(...bins.map((b) => b.n))
  const X = (v: number) => L + ((v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (W - L - Rm)
  const bw = (W - L - Rm) / bins.length
  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} className="w-full" role="img">
      {bins.map((b, i) => { const h = (b.n / mx) * (H - T - B); return <rect key={i} x={L + i * bw} y={H - B - h} width={bw - 1} height={h} fill="rgb(var(--link))" opacity={0.55} /> })}
      <line x1={L} x2={W - Rm} y1={H - B} y2={H - B} stroke={AXIS} />
      {[0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map((f) => <text key={f} x={L + f * (W - L - Rm)} y={H - 10} textAnchor={f === 0 ? 'start' : f === 1 ? 'end' : 'middle'} fontSize={11} fill={TEXT}>{format(lo + f * (hi - lo))}</text>)}
      {markers?.map((m, i) => <g key={m.label}><line x1={X(m.x)} x2={X(m.x)} y1={T - 4} y2={H - B} stroke={m.color ?? 'rgb(var(--ink))'} strokeWidth={1.5} strokeDasharray="4 3" /><text x={X(m.x)} y={T - 8 + (i % 2) * 0} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} fontWeight={600} fill={m.color ?? 'rgb(var(--ink))'}>{m.label}</text></g>)}
    </svg>
  )
}

/** 5×5 likelihood × consequence heat map with counts; click a cell to filter. */
export function RiskMatrix({ cells, onPick, selected }: { cells: Record<string, number>; onPick?: (l: number, c: number) => void; selected?: string }) {
  const tone = (l: number, c: number) => { const s = l * c; return s >= 15 ? 'bg-bad/80 text-white' : s >= 8 ? 'bg-warn/70 text-ink' : 'bg-good/25 text-ink' }
  return (
    <div className="inline-grid grid-cols-[auto_repeat(5,minmax(34px,48px))] gap-1 text-[11px]">
      {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((l) => (
        <React.Fragment key={l}>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end pr-1 text-faint">L{l}</div>
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((c) => {
            const k = `${l}-${c}`, n = cells[k] || 0
            return <button key={k} onClick={() => onPick?.(l, c)} className={`flex h-9 items-center justify-center rounded-sm font-bold tabular-nums ${tone(l, c)} ${selected === k ? 'ring-2 ring-ink' : ''} ${n ? '' : 'opacity-40'}`}>{n || ''}</button>
          })}
        </React.Fragment>
      ))}
      <div />
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((c) => <div key={c} className="text-center text-faint">C{c}</div>)}
    </div>
  )
}

/** Labeled range bar: shows an estimate's low–high band and the point value (AACE ranges). */
export function RangeBar({ low, point, high, scaleMax }: { low: number; point: number; high: number; scaleMax?: number }) {
  const mx = scaleMax ?? high * 1.05
  const pct = (v: number) => `${(v / mx) * 100}%`
  return (
    <div className="relative h-5 w-full">
      <div className="absolute top-2 h-1 w-full rounded bg-sunken" />
      <div className="absolute top-1.5 h-2 rounded bg-info/40" style={{ left: pct(low), width: `calc(${pct(high)} - ${pct(low)})` }} />
      <div className="absolute top-0.5 h-4 w-1 rounded bg-ink" style={{ left: pct(point) }} title={money(point)} />
    </div>
  )
}

// Shared UI kit. Every view builds from these so the product reads as one system.
// Colors come only from tokens (bg-surface, text-muted, border-line, text-good …). Never hard-code hex.
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { AaceClass, RAG } from '@/core/types'
import { cx, initials } from '@/core/util'

// ───────────────────────────── Buttons
type BtnVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'danger' | 'marker'
export function Button({ variant = 'secondary', size = 'md', icon, className, ...rest }: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { variant?: BtnVariant; size?: 'sm' | 'md'; icon?: React.ReactNode }) {
  const base = 'inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded font-semibold transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed whitespace-nowrap'
  const sz = size === 'sm' ? 'h-7 px-2.5 text-xs' : 'h-8 px-3 text-[13px]'
  const v: Record<BtnVariant, string> = {
    primary: 'bg-ink text-surface hover:bg-ink/85',
    secondary: 'bg-surface text-ink border border-line hover:bg-sunken',
    ghost: 'text-muted hover:text-ink hover:bg-sunken',
    danger: 'bg-bad text-white hover:bg-bad/90',
    marker: 'bg-marker text-markerink hover:bg-marker/90',
  }
  return <button type="button" className={cx(base, sz, v[variant], className)} {...rest}>{icon}{rest.children}</button>
}

// ───────────────────────────── Badges & status
export type Tone = 'neutral' | 'good' | 'warn' | 'bad' | 'info' | 'marker' | 'ink'
const toneCls: Record<Tone, string> = {
  neutral: 'bg-sunken text-muted border-line',
  good: 'bg-good/10 text-good border-good/30',
  warn: 'bg-warn/10 text-warn border-warn/30',
  bad: 'bg-bad/10 text-bad border-bad/30',
  info: 'bg-info/10 text-info border-info/30',
  marker: 'bg-marker/20 text-ink border-marker/60',
  ink: 'bg-ink text-surface border-ink',
}
export function Badge({ tone = 'neutral', children, className, title }: { tone?: Tone; children: React.ReactNode; className?: string; title?: string }) {
  return <span title={title} className={cx('inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded border px-1.5 py-px text-[11px] font-semibold leading-4 whitespace-nowrap', toneCls[tone], className)}>{children}</span>
}

/** Map common statuses to tones so every module colors them the same way. */
export function statusTone(status: string): Tone {
  const s = status.toLowerCase()
  if (['approved', 'accepted', 'done', 'closed', 'issued', 'acquired', 'verified', 'complete', 'go', 'met', 'received', 'published', 'green', 'compliant', 'awarded', 'active-ok'].includes(s)) return 'good'
  if (['in-review', 'submitted', 'running', 'mitigating', 'applied', 'negotiating', 'ordered', 'shipped', 'go-with-conditions', 'attached', 'scheduled', 'amber', 'conditional', 'in-progress', 'draft-review'].includes(s)) return 'info'
  if (['required', 'returned', 'recycle', 'hold', 'on-hold', 'expired', 'missing', 'realized', 'overdue', 'red', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'cancel', 'non-compliant', 'open-high'].includes(s)) return 'bad'
  if (['open', 'pending', 'identified', 'not-applied', 'not-started', 'draft', 'rfp', 'requested'].includes(s)) return 'neutral'
  return 'neutral'
}
export const humanize = (s: string) => s.replace(/[-_]/g, ' ').replace(/^\w/, (c) => c.toUpperCase())
export function StatusBadge({ status, label }: { status: string; label?: string }) {

}

  return <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5" title={label ? `${label}: ${rag}` : rag}><span className={cx('inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full', c, rag === 'red' && 'ring-2 ring-bad/25')} />{label && <span className="text-xs text-muted">{label}</span>}</span>

/** AACE estimate class chip: Class 5 is the widest range, Class 1 the tightest. */
export function ClassBadge({ cls, size = 'sm' }: { cls: AaceClass; size?: 'sm' | 'lg' }) {
  const tone = cls >= 5 ? 'border-faint text-muted' : cls === 4 ? 'border-info/60 text-info' : 'border-ink text-ink'
  return <span title={`AACE Class ${cls}`} className={cx('inline-flex items-center rounded-sm border-2 font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums', tone, size === 'lg' ? 'px-2 py-0.5 text-sm' : 'px-1 text-[11px] leading-4')}>C{cls}</span>
}

export function Avatar({ name, size = 22 }: { name: string; size?: number }) {
  let h = 0
  for (const ch of name) h = (h * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) % 360
  return <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full font-semibold text-white" style={{ width: size, height: size, fontSize: size * 0.42, background: `hsl(${h} 32% 42%)` }}>{initials(name)}</span>
}

export function Progress({ value, tone = 'ink', className }: { value: number; tone?: 'ink' | 'good' | 'warn' | 'bad' | 'marker'; className?: string }) {
  const c = { ink: 'bg-ink', good: 'bg-good', warn: 'bg-warn', bad: 'bg-bad', marker: 'bg-marker' }[tone]
  return <div className={cx('h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-sunken', className)} role="progressbar" aria-valuenow={Math.round(value)} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100}><div className={cx('h-full rounded-full', c)} style={{ width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value))}%` }} /></div>
}

/** Stage track: one segment per lifecycle stage, current stage marked. */

      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

export function Tabs<T extends string>({ tabs, value, onChange, className }: { tabs: { id: T; label: React.ReactNode; count?: number }[]; value: T; onChange: (t: T) => void; className?: string }) {

        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Table
export interface Column<T> { key: string; header: React.ReactNode; render: (row: T) => React.ReactNode; num?: boolean; width?: string | number; sort?: (row: T) => number | string; className?: string }
export function Table<T>({ rows, columns, onRowClick, rowKey, empty, maxHeight, dense }: { rows: T[]; columns: Column<T>[]; onRowClick?: (r: T) => void; rowKey: (r: T) => string; empty?: React.ReactNode; maxHeight?: number; dense?: boolean }) {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<{ key: string; dir: 1 | -1 } | null>(null)
  const col = sort && columns.find((c) => c.key === sort.key)
  const sorted = col?.sort ? rows.slice().sort((a, b) => { const x = col.sort!(a), y = col.sort!(b); return (x < y ? -1 : x > y ? 1 : 0) * sort!.dir }) : rows
  if (!rows.length && empty) return <>{empty}</>
  return (
    <div className="scroll-x" style={maxHeight ? { maxHeight, overflowY: 'auto' } : undefined}>
      <table className={cx('tbl', dense && '[&_td]:py-1')}>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            {columns.map((c) => (
              <th key={c.key} className={cx(c.num && 'num', c.sort && 'cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-ink')} style={{ width: c.width }} onClick={() => c.sort && setSort((s) => (s?.key === c.key ? { key: c.key, dir: (s.dir * -1) as 1 | -1 } : { key: c.key, dir: 1 }))}>
                {c.header}{sort?.key === c.key ? (sort.dir === 1 ? ' ▲' : ' ▼') : ''}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {sorted.map((r) => (
            <tr key={rowKey(r)} className={cx(onRowClick && 'clickable')} onClick={onRowClick ? () => onRowClick(r) : undefined}>
              {columns.map((c) => <td key={c.key} className={cx(c.num && 'num', c.className)}>{c.render(r)}</td>)}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Money input that stores whole dollars but shows separators. */
export function MoneyInput({ value, onChange, ...rest }: { value: number; onChange: (v: number) => void } & Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'value' | 'onChange'>) {
  const [txt, setTxt] = useState(value ? value.toLocaleString('en-US') : '')
  useEffect(() => { setTxt(value ? value.toLocaleString('en-US') : '') }, [value])
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[13px] text-faint">$</span>
      <input {...rest} inputMode="numeric" className={cx('inp pl-5 text-right tabular-nums', rest.className)} value={txt}
        onChange={(e) => setTxt(e.target.value)} onBlur={() => { const n = Number(txt.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, '')) || 0; onChange(Math.round(n)); setTxt(n ? Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US') : '') }} />
    </div>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Overlays
export function Modal({ open, onClose, title, children, footer, wide }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; title: React.ReactNode; children: React.ReactNode; footer?: React.ReactNode; wide?: boolean }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const k = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === 'Escape' && onClose()
    window.addEventListener('keydown', k)
    ref.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('input,select,textarea,button')?.focus()
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', k)
  }, [open, onClose])
  if (!open) return null
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-steel/50 p-4 pt-[max(5vh,env(safe-area-inset-top))]" onMouseDown={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
      <div ref={ref} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" className={cx('fadein w-full rounded-md border border-line bg-surface shadow-xl', wide ? 'max-w-4xl' : 'max-w-xl')}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
          <h2 className="font-display text-[17px] font-semibold">{title}</h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded p-1 text-muted hover:bg-sunken hover:text-ink" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div className="max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4">{children}</div>
        {footer && <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2 border-t border-line px-4 py-3">{footer}</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export function Drawer({ open, onClose, title, children, footer, width = 520 }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; title: React.ReactNode; children: React.ReactNode; footer?: React.ReactNode; width?: number }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const k = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === 'Escape' && onClose()
    window.addEventListener('keydown', k)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', k)
  }, [open, onClose])
  if (!open) return null
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-end bg-steel/40" onMouseDown={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
      <aside className="fadein flex h-full w-full flex-col border-l border-line bg-surface shadow-2xl" style={{ maxWidth: width, paddingTop: 'env(safe-area-inset-top)', paddingRight: 'env(safe-area-inset-right)' }}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
          <h2 className="font-display text-[17px] font-semibold">{title}</h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded p-1 text-muted hover:bg-sunken hover:text-ink" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">{children}</div>
        {footer && <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2 border-t border-line px-4 py-3" style={{ paddingBottom: 'max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))' }}>{footer}</div>}
      </aside>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Inline confirm (the artifact viewer blocks window.confirm). */
export function ConfirmButton({ onConfirm, children, confirmLabel = 'Confirm', variant = 'secondary', size = 'md' }: { onConfirm: () => void; children: React.ReactNode; confirmLabel?: string; variant?: BtnVariant; size?: 'sm' | 'md' }) {
  const [ask, setAsk] = useState(false)
  if (!ask) return <Button variant={variant} size={size} onClick={() => setAsk(true)}>{children}</Button>
  return <span className="inline-flex gap-1"><Button variant="danger" size={size} onClick={() => { setAsk(false); onConfirm() }}>{confirmLabel}</Button><Button size={size} variant="ghost" onClick={() => setAsk(false)}>Cancel</Button></span>
}

      ))}
