// Export / import / reset of the full dataset, plus the demo note.
import { useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, strip, useStore, useSync } from '@/core/store'
import { SCHEMA_VERSION } from '@/core/seed'
import { saveFile } from '@/core/download'
import { fmtDate, num } from '@/core/util'
import { go } from '@/core/router'
import { Button, Callout, ConfirmButton, KV, Panel } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { FileButton } from './common'

const REQUIRED: (keyof AppState)[] = ['settings', 'people', 'programs', 'templates', 'projects', 'estimates', 'budgets', 'snapshots', 'workflows', 'workflowDefs', 'audit']

export function validateImport(raw: unknown): { ok: true; state: AppState } | { ok: false; error: string } {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return { ok: false, error: 'The file is not a JSON object.' }
  const s = raw as Partial<AppState>
  if (s.schemaVersion !== SCHEMA_VERSION) return { ok: false, error: `Schema version ${s.schemaVersion ?? 'missing'} does not match this release (v${SCHEMA_VERSION}). Export again from the same release.` }
  const missing = REQUIRED.filter((k) => !(k in s))
  if (missing.length) return { ok: false, error: `Missing sections: ${missing.join(', ')}.` }
  if (!Array.isArray(s.projects) || !Array.isArray(s.audit)) return { ok: false, error: 'Projects and audit must be lists.' }
  return { ok: true, state: s as AppState }
}

export default function DataTab() {
  const s = useStore()
  const reset = useStore((x) => x.reset)
  const sync = useSync()
  const shared = sync.mode === 'shared'
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const counts: [string, number][] = [
    ['Projects', s.projects.length], ['Estimates', s.estimates.length], ['Budget versions', s.budgets.length], ['Snapshots', s.snapshots.length],
    ['Changes', s.changes.length], ['Risks', s.risks.length], ['Safety plans', s.safetyPlans.length], ['Workflow instances', s.workflows.length],
    ['Permits', s.permits.length], ['Records', s.records.length], ['Lessons', s.lessons.length], ['Audit entries', s.audit.length],
  ]
  const exportAll = async () => {
    const state = strip(useStore.getState())
    const r = await saveFile(`crosswalk-${s.settings.orgName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}-${s.settings.asOf}.json`, JSON.stringify(state, null, 1), 'application/json')
    if (r === 'saved') {
      mutate(() => {}, { entity: 'data', entityId: 'export', action: 'export', summary: `Exported full dataset (${num(s.projects.length)} projects, ${num(s.audit.length)} audit entries)` })
      toast('Export saved')
    } else toast(r === 'declined' ? 'Export cancelled' : 'Download is not available here', 'info')
  }
  const importFile = async (f: File) => {
    setErr(null)
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(await f.text())
      const v = validateImport(parsed)
      if (!v.ok) { setErr(v.error); toast('Import rejected', 'bad'); return }
      const keys = Object.keys(v.state) as (keyof AppState)[]
      mutate((d) => { for (const k of keys) (d as any)[k] = (v.state as any)[k] }, { entity: 'data', entityId: 'import', action: 'import', summary: `Imported dataset from ${f.name} (${v.state.projects.length} projects)` })
      toast(`Imported ${v.state.projects.length} projects`)
    } catch {
      setErr('The file could not be read as JSON.')
      toast('Import failed', 'bad')
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_380px]">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <Panel title="Dataset" subtitle={`${s.settings.orgName} · schema v${s.schemaVersion} · demo clock ${fmtDate(s.settings.asOf)}`}>
          <KV cols={4} items={counts.map(([k, v]) => [k, <span className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold tabular-nums">{num(v)}</span>])} />
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Export and import" subtitle="Move a configured tenant between environments, or keep a copy before a demo">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <Button variant="primary" onClick={exportAll}>Export full dataset (JSON)</Button>
              <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Everything: configuration, projects, history, workflows and the audit log.</span>
            </div>
            {shared
              ? <div className="text-[12px] text-muted">Import is off on the shared public demo: it would replace everyone's data with an uploaded file.</div>
              : <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                  <FileButton size="md" label="Import dataset…" accept="application/json,.json" onFile={importFile} />
                  <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Replaces all data. The file must come from schema v{SCHEMA_VERSION}.</span>
                </div>}
            {err && <Callout tone="bad" title="Import rejected">{err}</Callout>}
          </div>
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Reset demo" subtitle="Restore the original Arroyo Valley Gas dataset and history">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            {shared && !sync.canEdit ? <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">Enter the edit passcode to reset the shared data.</span> : <ConfirmButton variant="danger" confirmLabel={shared ? 'Yes, reset for everyone' : 'Yes, reset all data'} onConfirm={() => { reset(); toast(shared ? 'Demo data reset for everyone' : 'Demo data reset'); go('#portfolio') }}>Reset demo data</ConfirmButton>}
            <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{shared ? 'Starts the shared data over for everyone. Earlier edits stay in the database history.' : 'Discards every change made on this page, including configuration edits.'}</span>
          </div>
        </Panel>
      </div>
      <Panel title="About this demo">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-[13px] leading-relaxed">
          <p><b>Arroyo Valley Gas is fictional.</b> Every project, person, dollar figure, proceeding number, permit and record in Crosswalk is illustrative and generated for demonstration. No real utility, regulator filing or individual is represented.</p>
          <p>The dataset is replayed through the same engine the screens use: estimates were approved through workflows, gates decided, baselines snapshotted and changes routed, so every figure traces to a record and an audit entry.</p>
          <p>{shared ? 'Data is kept in a shared database: everyone with the link sees the same projects, and edits (with the passcode) are saved for everyone. The database keeps every change; nothing is overwritten or deleted.' : 'This copy is not connected to the shared database, so changes are not saved.'} Use the persona switcher in the top bar to act as a project manager, sponsor, estimator or contractor and see the same records from their side.</p>
          <p className="text-muted">AI features draft content for a person to accept. They never approve, sign or change a record on their own.</p>
        </div>
      </Panel>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/admin/ForecastLines.tsx =====
// Configuration: forecast line items. Each line rolls up to exactly one WBS function and owns the CBS categories
// whose budget belongs to it (a category belongs to one line). SAP actuals land on lines through the mapping table.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { CostCategory, ForecastLine, WbsFunction } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { CONT_CAT, ESC_CAT } from '@/core/engine/estimates'
import { cx, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, ConfirmButton, Field, Input, Modal, Panel, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'

const SYSTEM = [ESC_CAT, CONT_CAT] // overhead (cat-loaders) is assignable, e.g. to 900 Project Overhead

/** Validation of the line table against cost categories and the WBS function mapping. */
export function lineIssues(lines: ForecastLine[], cats: CostCategory[], fns: WbsFunction[]) {
  const act = lines.filter((l) => l.active)
  const direct = cats.filter((c) => !SYSTEM.includes(c.id))
  const owners = (id: string) => act.filter((l) => l.categoryIds.includes(id))
  const fnOfCat = (id: string) => fns.find((f) => f.categoryIds.includes(id))
  return {
    unassigned: direct.filter((c) => owners(c.id).length === 0),
    multi: direct.filter((c) => owners(c.id).length > 1),
    mismatch: act.flatMap((l) => l.categoryIds.map((c) => ({ l, c, fn: fnOfCat(c) })).filter((x) => x.fn && x.fn.id !== l.functionId)),
    dupCodes: act.filter((l, i) => act.findIndex((x) => x.code.trim() === l.code.trim()) !== i).map((l) => l.code),
    emptyFns: fns.filter((f) => !act.some((l) => l.functionId === f.id)),
  }
}

export default function ForecastLines(_props: { projectId?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const lines = s.settings.forecastLines
  const fns = s.settings.wbsFunctions
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<ForecastLine | null>(null)
  const [showInactive, setShowInactive] = useState(true)
  const issues = lineIssues(lines, s.categories, fns)
  const usage = useMemo(() => {
    const out: Record<string, { forecasts: number; periods: number; txns: number; rules: number }> = {}
    const u = (id: string) => (out[id] ||= { forecasts: 0, periods: 0, txns: 0, rules: 0 })
    for (const f of s.forecasts) for (const [id, row] of Object.entries(f.lineSpread ?? {})) if (Object.values(row).some(Boolean)) u(id).forecasts++
    for (const c of s.costPeriods) for (const [id, v] of Object.entries(c.byLine ?? {})) if (v) u(id).periods++
    for (const t of s.actualTxns) { if (t.lineId) u(t.lineId).txns++; for (const id of Object.keys(t.allocation ?? {})) u(id).txns++ }
    for (const r of s.settings.sapMappings) if (r.lineId) u(r.lineId).rules++
    return out
  }, [s.forecasts, s.costPeriods, s.actualTxns, s.settings.sapMappings])
  const inUse = (id: string) => { const x = usage[id]; return !!x && x.forecasts + x.periods + x.txns + x.rules > 0 }
  const catName = (id: string) => s.categories.find((c) => c.id === id)

  const save = (l: ForecastLine, isNew: boolean) => {
    const moved: string[] = []
    mutate((d) => {
      for (const o of d.settings.forecastLines) if (o.id !== l.id && o.active) {
        const keep = o.categoryIds.filter((c) => !l.categoryIds.includes(c))
        if (keep.length !== o.categoryIds.length) { moved.push(o.code); o.categoryIds = keep }
      }
      const i = d.settings.forecastLines.findIndex((x) => x.id === l.id)
      if (i >= 0) d.settings.forecastLines[i] = l
      else d.settings.forecastLines.push(l)
      d.settings.forecastLines.sort((a, b) => a.code.localeCompare(b.code, undefined, { numeric: true }))
    }, { entity: 'forecast-line', entityId: l.id, action: isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: `${isNew ? 'Added' : 'Updated'} forecast line ${l.code} ${l.name} (WBS ${fns.find((f) => f.id === l.functionId)?.code}; categories ${l.categoryIds.map((c) => catName(c)?.code ?? c).join(', ') || 'none'})${moved.length ? `; categories moved from ${moved.join(', ')}` : ''}` })
    toast(isNew ? `Line ${l.code} added` : `Line ${l.code} saved`)
    setEdit(null)
  }
  const setActive = (l: ForecastLine, active: boolean) => {
    mutate((d) => { const x = d.settings.forecastLines.find((y) => y.id === l.id); if (x) x.active = active }, { entity: 'forecast-line', entityId: l.id, action: active ? 'activate' : 'deactivate', summary: `${active ? 'Reactivated' : 'Deactivated'} forecast line ${l.code} ${l.name}` })
    toast(active ? `${l.code} reactivated` : `${l.code} deactivated — history kept`)
  }
  const remove = (l: ForecastLine) => {
    mutate((d) => { d.settings.forecastLines = d.settings.forecastLines.filter((x) => x.id !== l.id) }, { entity: 'forecast-line', entityId: l.id, action: 'delete', summary: `Deleted unused forecast line ${l.code} ${l.name}` })
    toast(`${l.code} deleted`)
  }
  const add = () => {
    const fn = fns[0]
    const n = lines.filter((l) => l.functionId === fn.id).length
    setEdit({ id: uid('fl'), code: `${fn.code}.${String((n + 1) * 10).padStart(2, '0')}`, name: '', functionId: fn.id, categoryIds: [], active: true })
  }

  const shown = lines.filter((l) => showInactive || l.active)
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Callout tone="info" title="How lines are used">
        Forecasts are entered by line item and roll up to the WBS functions (CBS Level 3 codes 100–999). A line’s budget is the CBS categories it owns (overhead goes to 900 Project Overhead; escalation is allocated pro-rata); SAP actuals reach it through the rules on the <b>SAP mapping</b> tab. A line that has forecasts, actuals or rules can be deactivated but not deleted, so history stays traceable.
      </Callout>
      {(issues.unassigned.length > 0 || issues.multi.length > 0 || issues.mismatch.length > 0 || issues.dupCodes.length > 0 || issues.emptyFns.length > 0) ? (
        <Callout tone="warn" title="Coverage checks">
          <ul className="list-disc pl-4">
            {issues.unassigned.length > 0 && <li>{issues.unassigned.length} cost categor{issues.unassigned.length === 1 ? 'y has' : 'ies have'} no line, so their budget is left out of line totals: {issues.unassigned.map((c) => c.name).join(', ')}</li>}
            {issues.multi.map((c) => <li key={c.id}>{c.name} belongs to more than one active line</li>)}
            {issues.mismatch.map((x, i) => <li key={i}>{x.l.code} owns {catName(x.c)?.name}, which the WBS configuration maps to {x.fn?.code} {x.fn?.name} — budget and actuals will land in different functions</li>)}
            {issues.dupCodes.map((c) => <li key={c}>Duplicate line code {c}</li>)}
            {issues.emptyFns.length > 0 && <li>No active line under {issues.emptyFns.map((f) => `${f.code} ${f.name}`).join(', ')}</li>}
          </ul>
        </Callout>
      ) : <Callout tone="good">Every cost category belongs to exactly one active line, and every line sits under the WBS function its categories map to.</Callout>}

      <Panel title="Forecast line items" subtitle={`${lines.filter((l) => l.active).length} active · ${lines.filter((l) => !l.active).length} inactive · under ${fns.length} WBS functions`} pad={false}
        actions={<>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] text-muted"><input type="checkbox" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" checked={showInactive} onChange={(e) => setShowInactive(e.target.checked)} />Show inactive</label>
          <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={add} icon={<Icon name="plus" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}>Add line</Button>
        </>}>
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Code</th><th>Line item</th><th>Cost categories (budget)</th><th className="num">SAP rules</th><th>In use</th><th>Status</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {fns.map((fn) => {
                const ls = shown.filter((l) => l.functionId === fn.id)
                return [
                  <tr key={fn.id} className="bg-sunken/50"><td colSpan={7} className="py-1.5 font-semibold"><span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">{fn.code}</span> {fn.name}{!ls.length && <span className="ml-2 text-[12px] font-normal text-warn">no lines</span>}</td></tr>,
                  ...ls.map((l) => {
                    const u = usage[l.id]
                    return (
                      <tr key={l.id} className={cx(!l.active && 'text-muted')}>
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold">{l.code}</td>
                        <td className="min-w-[180px]"><div className={cx('font-semibold', !l.active && 'line-through')}>{l.name}</div>{l.note && <div className="text-[11.5px] text-muted">{l.note}</div>}</td>
                        <td className="min-w-[160px]"><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">{l.categoryIds.length ? l.categoryIds.map((c) => <Badge key={c} title={catName(c)?.name}>{catName(c)?.code ?? c} {catName(c)?.name}</Badge>) : <span className="text-[12px] text-faint">none — no budget</span>}</div></td>
                        <td className="num">{u?.rules ? u.rules : <span className="text-warn" title="No SAP rule sends cost here">0</span>}</td>
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px] text-muted">{u ? [u.forecasts && `${u.forecasts} forecasts`, u.periods && `${u.periods} actual periods`, u.txns && `${u.txns} SAP rows`].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—' : '—'}</td>
                        <td>{l.active ? <Badge tone="good">Active</Badge> : <Badge>Inactive</Badge>}</td>
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-right">
                          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit(l)}>Edit</Button>
                          {l.active
                            ? (inUse(l.id) ? <ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Deactivate" onConfirm={() => setActive(l, false)}>Deactivate</ConfirmButton> : <ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Delete line" onConfirm={() => remove(l)}>Delete</ConfirmButton>)
                            : <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setActive(l, true)}>Reactivate</Button>}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )
                  }),
                ]
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </Panel>
      {edit && <LineModal line={edit} isNew={!lines.some((l) => l.id === edit.id)} onClose={() => setEdit(null)} onSave={save} />}
    </div>
  )
}

function LineModal({ line, isNew, onClose, onSave }: { line: ForecastLine; isNew: boolean; onClose: () => void; onSave: (l: ForecastLine, isNew: boolean) => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [l, setL] = useState<ForecastLine>(line)
  const others = s.settings.forecastLines.filter((x) => x.id !== l.id && x.active)
  const ownerOf = (c: string) => others.find((x) => x.categoryIds.includes(c))
  const direct = s.categories.filter((c) => !SYSTEM.includes(c.id))
  const fn = s.settings.wbsFunctions.find((f) => f.id === l.functionId)
  const moves = l.categoryIds.map((c) => ({ c, o: ownerOf(c) })).filter((x) => x.o)
  const dup = others.some((x) => x.code.trim() === l.code.trim())
  const submit = () => {
    if (!l.code.trim() || !l.name.trim()) { toast('A line needs a code and a name', 'bad'); return }
    if (dup) { toast(`Code ${l.code} is already used`, 'bad'); return }
    onSave({ ...l, code: l.code.trim(), name: l.name.trim(), note: l.note?.trim() || undefined }, isNew)
  }
  const toggle = (c: string) => setL({ ...l, categoryIds: l.categoryIds.includes(c) ? l.categoryIds.filter((x) => x !== c) : [...l.categoryIds, c] })
  return (
    <Modal open onClose={onClose} title={isNew ? 'Add forecast line' : `Edit ${line.code} ${line.name}`}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={submit}>{isNew ? 'Add line' : 'Save line'}</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[120px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
          <Field label="Code" hint={dup ? 'Already used' : 'e.g. 06.30'}><Input className="font-mono" value={l.code} onChange={(e) => setL({ ...l, code: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Name"><Input value={l.name} onChange={(e) => setL({ ...l, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. Directional drilling" /></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Rolls up to WBS function"><Select value={l.functionId} onChange={(e) => setL({ ...l, functionId: e.target.value })} options={s.settings.wbsFunctions.map((f) => ({ value: f.id, label: `${f.code} ${f.name}` }))} /></Field>
        <Field label="Cost categories whose budget belongs to this line" hint="A category belongs to one line; choosing one owned by another line moves it here when you save.">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
            {direct.map((c) => {
              const on = l.categoryIds.includes(c.id)
              const o = ownerOf(c.id)
              const fnOf = s.settings.wbsFunctions.find((f) => f.categoryIds.includes(c.id))
              return (
                <button key={c.id} type="button" aria-pressed={on} onClick={() => toggle(c.id)} title={`${c.name}${o ? ` — now on ${o.code}` : ''}${fnOf ? ` · WBS ${fnOf.code}` : ''}`}
                  className={cx('rounded border px-2 py-0.5 text-[12px] font-semibold', on ? 'border-ink bg-ink text-surface' : o ? 'border-dashed border-line bg-surface text-faint hover:text-ink' : 'border-line bg-surface text-muted hover:border-ink/40 hover:text-ink')}>
                  {c.name}{o && !on ? <span className="ml-1 font-mono text-[10.5px]">{o.code}</span> : null}
                </button>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        </Field>
        {moves.length > 0 && <Callout tone="warn">{moves.map((x) => `${s.categories.find((c) => c.id === x.c)?.name} moves from ${x.o!.code}`).join('; ')}.</Callout>}
        {l.categoryIds.some((c) => { const f = s.settings.wbsFunctions.find((x) => x.categoryIds.includes(c)); return f && f.id !== l.functionId }) && <Callout tone="warn">Some of these categories map to a different WBS function than {fn?.code} {fn?.name} in the WBS configuration.</Callout>}
        <Field label="Note"><TextArea rows={2} value={l.note ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setL({ ...l, note: e.target.value })} placeholder="What belongs on this line" /></Field>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/admin/GisSettings.tsx =====
// Configuration → GIS & maps: basemap defaults and the utility's Esri layers (pipe network, facilities).
import { useState } from 'react'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import type { GisSettings as Gis, MapLayer } from '@/core/types'
import { uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, ConfirmButton, Field, Input, Panel, Select, Table, TextArea, Checkbox } from '@/ui/kit'
import { BASEMAPS } from '@/ui/map/GisMap'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'

const KINDS: { value: MapLayer['kind']; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'arcgis-feature', label: 'Esri feature layer (…/FeatureServer/0 or …/MapServer/0)' },
  { value: 'arcgis-mapimage', label: 'Esri map image service (…/MapServer)' },
  { value: 'arcgis-tile', label: 'Esri tiled map service (cached …/MapServer)' },
  { value: 'demo', label: 'Demo network (built in)' },
]

export default function GisSettings() {
  const gis = useStore((s) => s.settings.gis)
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Gis>(() => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(gis)))
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [tests, setTests] = useState<Record<string, { ok: boolean; text: string }>>({})
  const dirty = JSON.stringify(draft) !== JSON.stringify(gis)
  const setLayer = (id: string, patch: Partial<MapLayer>) => setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, layers: d.layers.map((l) => (l.id === id ? { ...l, ...patch } : l)) }))
  const save = () => {
    const bad = draft.layers.find((l) => l.kind !== 'demo' && l.url && !/^https:\/\/.+\/(FeatureServer|MapServer)(\/\d+)?\/?$/i.test(l.url.trim()))
    if (bad) { toast(`"${bad.name}" URL should end in /FeatureServer/0 or /MapServer`, 'bad'); return }
    mutate((d) => { d.settings.gis = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(draft)) }, { entity: 'gis', entityId: 'gis', action: 'update', summary: `GIS settings saved (${draft.layers.length} layers, basemap ${draft.basemap})` })
    toast('GIS settings saved')
  }
  const test = async (l: MapLayer) => {
    setTests((t) => ({ ...t, [l.id]: { ok: true, text: 'Testing…' } }))
    try {
      const u = `${l.url.replace(/\/$/, '')}?f=json${l.token ? `&token=${encodeURIComponent(l.token)}` : ''}`
      const r = await fetch(u)
      const j = await r.json()
      if (j.error) throw new Error(`${j.error.code ?? ''} ${j.error.message ?? 'Service error'}${j.error.code === 499 || j.error.code === 498 ? ' — a token is required or has expired' : ''}`)
      const what = j.geometryType ? `${j.name ?? 'Layer'} · ${String(j.geometryType).replace('esriGeometry', '')} · max ${j.maxRecordCount ?? '?'} per request` : j.layers ? `${j.mapName ?? j.serviceDescription ?? 'Service'} · ${j.layers.length} layers: ${j.layers.slice(0, 6).map((x: any) => `${x.id} ${x.name}`).join(', ')}` : 'Reachable'
      setTests((t) => ({ ...t, [l.id]: { ok: true, text: `Connected — ${what}` } }))
    } catch (e: any) {
      setTests((t) => ({ ...t, [l.id]: { ok: false, text: `${e?.message ?? 'Failed'}. Check the URL, network access from this browser, and CORS on your ArcGIS Server.` } }))
    }
  }
  const add = () => {
    const id = uid('lyr')
    setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, layers: [...d.layers, { id, name: 'New Esri layer', kind: 'arcgis-feature', url: '', color: '#2a7de1', visible: true }] }))
    setEditing(id)
  }
  const ed = draft.layers.find((l) => l.id === editing)
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Callout tone="info" title="Connect your Esri GIS">
        Paste the REST URL of each layer you want under the projects — typically gas transmission and high-pressure distribution mains, valves and stations from ArcGIS Server or ArcGIS Online. Layers draw on the project map and the portfolio map, and project maps can query pipe within 300 m.
        Secured services need a token (kept in this browser only). A production deployment signs in with ArcGIS OAuth instead.
      </Callout>
 <Panel title="Outside map services">
        <Checkbox checked={!!draft.allowExternal} onChange={(v) => setDraft({ ...draft, allowExternal: v })} label="Allow calls to outside map services (Esri basemaps and layers, Google Maps links)" />
        <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-muted">Off for the public demo: the app then makes no network calls except to its own API. Turn on only for internal hosting with approved GIS services.</p>
      </Panel>
      <Panel title="Map defaults" actions={<><Button variant="primary" size="sm" disabled={!dirty} onClick={save}>Save GIS settings</Button>{dirty && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setDraft(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(gis)))}>Discard</Button>}</>}>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
          <Field label="Default basemap"><Select value={draft.basemap} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, basemap: e.target.value as Gis['basemap'] })} options={BASEMAPS.map((b) => ({ value: b.id, label: b.label }))} /></Field>
          <Field label="Center latitude"><Input type="number" step="0.0001" value={draft.center[0]} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, center: [Number(e.target.value), draft.center[1]] })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Center longitude"><Input type="number" step="0.0001" value={draft.center[1]} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, center: [draft.center[0], Number(e.target.value)] })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Zoom (1–19)"><Input type="number" min={1} max={19} value={draft.zoom} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, zoom: Number(e.target.value) })} /></Field>
        </div>
      </Panel>
      <Panel title="Map layers" subtitle="Drawn in this order; checked layers are on by default" pad={false} actions={<Button size="sm" onClick={add}>Add Esri layer</Button>}>
        <Table rowKey={(l) => l.id} rows={draft.layers} onRowClick={(l) => setEditing(l.id)} columns={[
          { key: 'c', header: '', width: 28, render: (l) => <span className="inline-block h-3 w-4 rounded-sm" style={{ background: l.color }} /> },
          { key: 'n', header: 'Layer', render: (l) => <div><div className="font-semibold">{l.name}</div>{l.note && <div className="text-[12px] text-muted">{l.note}</div>}</div> },
          { key: 'k', header: 'Type', render: (l) => <span className="text-[12px]">{KINDS.find((k) => k.value === l.kind)?.label.split(' (')[0]}</span> },
          { key: 'u', header: 'Service URL', render: (l) => l.kind === 'demo' ? <span className="text-muted">built in</span> : l.url ? <span className="break-all font-mono text-[11.5px]">{l.url}</span> : <Badge tone="warn">Not set</Badge> },
          { key: 'v', header: 'On by default', render: (l) => (l.visible ? 'Yes' : 'No') },
          { key: 't', header: 'Connection', render: (l) => tests[l.id] ? <span className={tests[l.id].ok ? 'text-good' : 'text-bad'}>{tests[l.id].text.slice(0, 90)}</span> : l.token ? <Badge>token set</Badge> : '—' },
        ]} />
      </Panel>
      {ed && (
        <Panel title={`Edit layer — ${ed.name}`} actions={<Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>Done</Button>}>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
            <Field label="Name"><Input value={ed.name} onChange={(e) => setLayer(ed.id, { name: e.target.value })} /></Field>
            <Field label="Type"><Select value={ed.kind} onChange={(e) => setLayer(ed.id, { kind: e.target.value as MapLayer['kind'] })} options={KINDS} /></Field>
            {ed.kind !== 'demo' && <Field label="Service URL" className="md:col-span-2" hint="e.g. https://gis.yourutility.com/arcgis/rest/services/Gas/Transmission/FeatureServer/0"><Input className="font-mono text-[12px]" value={ed.url} onChange={(e) => setLayer(ed.id, { url: e.target.value.trim() })} /></Field>}
            <Field label="Line color"><div className="flex items-center gap-2"><input type="color" value={ed.color} onChange={(e) => setLayer(ed.id, { color: e.target.value })} className="h-8 w-12 rounded border border-line" /><Input value={ed.color} onChange={(e) => setLayer(ed.id, { color: e.target.value })} /></div></Field>
            {ed.kind === 'arcgis-feature' && <Field label="Filter (where clause)" hint='Optional, e.g. MAOP_PSIG > 60 AND STATUS = &apos;In Service&apos;'><Input className="font-mono text-[12px]" value={ed.where ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setLayer(ed.id, { where: e.target.value })} /></Field>}
            {ed.kind !== 'demo' && <Field label="Token (secured services)" hint="Stored only in this browser"><Input type="password" value={ed.token ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setLayer(ed.id, { token: e.target.value })} /></Field>}
            {ed.kind === 'arcgis-feature' && <Field label="Show from zoom level" hint="Hide dense layers when zoomed out (e.g. 12)"><Input type="number" min={1} max={19} value={ed.minZoom ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setLayer(ed.id, { minZoom: e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : undefined })} /></Field>}
            <Field label="Note" className="md:col-span-2"><TextArea className="min-h-[48px]" value={ed.note ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setLayer(ed.id, { note: e.target.value })} /></Field>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 md:col-span-2">
              <Checkbox checked={ed.visible} onChange={(v) => setLayer(ed.id, { visible: v })} label="On by default" />
              {ed.kind !== 'demo' && <Button size="sm" disabled={!ed.url || !gis.allowExternal} onClick={() => test(ed)}>Test connection</Button>}
              {tests[ed.id] && <span className={tests[ed.id].ok ? 'text-[12.5px] text-good' : 'text-[12.5px] text-bad'}>{tests[ed.id].text}</span>}
              <span className="ml-auto"><ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Remove layer" onConfirm={() => { setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, layers: d.layers.filter((l) => l.id !== ed.id) })); setEditing(null) }}>Remove</ConfirmButton></span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-3 text-[12px] text-faint">Changes apply when you click Save GIS settings.</p>
        </Panel>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/admin/InfoFields.tsx =====
// Configuration: Project Information sections and fields (PI-*). Edit in place, save once.
// Keys are immutable after create (they identify stored values and revision history).
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { InfoFieldDef } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, ConfirmButton, Field, Input, Modal, Panel, Select, Stat } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { useDraft } from './common'
import { BIND_PATHS, FIELD_TYPES, SYSTEM_KEYS, fieldStats, keyFromLabel, validKey } from '../project/tabs/info/lib'

const move = <T,>(xs: T[], i: number, j: number) => { const a = xs.slice(); const [x] = a.splice(i, 1); a.splice(j, 0, x); return a }

export default function InfoFields() {
  const s = useStore()
  const std = s.templates.find((t) => t.id === 'tpl-standard') ?? s.templates[0]
  const source = useMemo(() => ({ sections: s.settings.infoSections, fields: s.settings.infoFields }), [s.settings.infoSections, s.settings.infoFields])
  const [d, setD, dirty, discard] = useDraft(source)
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [newSection, setNewSection] = useState('')
  const savedKeys = s.settings.infoFields.map((f) => f.key)
  const stats = useMemo(() => Object.fromEntries(d.fields.map((f) => [f.key, fieldStats({ ...s, settings: { ...s.settings, infoFields: d.fields } }, f)])), [s, d.fields])
  const active = s.projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'active')
  const blockedProjects = new Set(Object.values(stats).flatMap((x) => x.blockedCodes))

  const setField = (key: string, patch: Partial<InfoFieldDef>) => setD({ ...d, fields: d.fields.map((f) => (f.key === key ? { ...f, ...patch } : f)) })
  const removeField = (key: string) => setD({ ...d, fields: d.fields.filter((f) => f.key !== key) })
  const moveField = (key: string, dir: -1 | 1) => {
    const f = d.fields.find((x) => x.key === key)!
    const same = d.fields.filter((x) => x.section === f.section)
    const i = same.indexOf(f), j = i + dir
    if (j < 0 || j >= same.length) return
    const a = d.fields.indexOf(f), b = d.fields.indexOf(same[j])
    const fields = d.fields.slice(); fields[a] = same[j]; fields[b] = f
    setD({ ...d, fields })
  }
  const renameSection = (i: number, name: string) => {
    const old = d.sections[i]
    setD({ sections: d.sections.map((x, j) => (j === i ? name : x)), fields: d.fields.map((f) => (f.section === old ? { ...f, section: name } : f)) })
  }

  const problems: string[] = []
  const secNames = d.sections.map((x) => x.trim())
  if (secNames.some((x) => !x)) problems.push('A section has no name')
  if (new Set(secNames).size !== secNames.length) problems.push('Two sections have the same name')
  for (const f of d.fields) {
    if (!f.label.trim()) problems.push(`Field ${f.key} has no label`)
    if (f.type === 'select' && !(f.options ?? []).filter((o) => o.trim()).length) problems.push(`${f.label || f.key}: a choice list needs options`)
  }

  const save = () => {
    if (problems.length) { toast(problems[0], 'bad'); return }
    const before = s.settings.infoFields
    const added = d.fields.filter((f) => !before.some((x) => x.key === f.key)).map((f) => f.label)
    const removed = before.filter((f) => !d.fields.some((x) => x.key === f.key)).map((f) => f.label)
    const edited = d.fields.filter((f) => { const o = before.find((x) => x.key === f.key); return o && JSON.stringify(o) !== JSON.stringify(f) }).map((f) => f.label)
    const secChanged = JSON.stringify(s.settings.infoSections) !== JSON.stringify(d.sections)
    const fields = d.fields.map((f) => ({ ...f, options: f.type === 'select' ? (f.options ?? []).map((o) => o.trim()).filter(Boolean) : undefined, help: f.help?.trim() || undefined }))
    const parts = [secChanged && 'sections updated', added.length && `added ${added.join(', ')}`, edited.length && `edited ${edited.join(', ')}`, removed.length && `removed ${removed.join(', ')}`].filter(Boolean)
    mutate((dr) => { dr.settings.infoSections = d.sections.map((x) => x.trim()); dr.settings.infoFields = fields },
      { entity: 'info-field', entityId: 'project-info', action: 'update', summary: `Project information fields: ${parts.join(' · ') || 'reordered'}` })
    toast('Project information fields saved')
  }

  const stageOptions = [{ value: '', label: 'Not required' }, ...std.stages.map((st) => ({ value: String(st.index), label: `Stage ${st.index + 1} · ${st.name}` }))]
  const bindOptions = (f: InfoFieldDef) => [{ value: '', label: 'Record only' }, ...BIND_PATHS.filter((b) => b.path === f.bind || !d.fields.some((x) => x.bind === b.path && x.key !== f.key)).map((b) => ({ value: b.path, label: `${b.label} (${b.path})` })), ...(f.bind && !BIND_PATHS.some((b) => b.path === f.bind) ? [{ value: f.bind, label: f.bind }] : [])]

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <Stat label="Fields" value={d.fields.length} sub={`${d.sections.length} sections · ${d.fields.filter((f) => f.bind).length} bound to project data`} />
        <Stat label="Required by a stage" value={d.fields.filter((f) => f.requiredAtStage !== undefined && !f.readOnly).length} sub="Empty required fields block the gate" />
        <Stat label="Active projects blocked" value={blockedProjects.size} sub={`of ${active.length} active, at their current stage`} tone={blockedProjects.size ? 'warn' : 'good'} />
        <Stat label="Empty values" value={Object.values(stats).reduce((a, x) => a + x.empty, 0)} sub="Across active projects, all fields" />
      </div>

      <Panel title="Project information fields" subtitle="The controlled data sheet every project carries. Requirements apply by stage number; condensed-template projects use the same stage numbers (stage 3 there is Construct & Close)." pad={false}
        actions={<>
          {dirty && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={discard}>Discard</Button>}
          <Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={save}>Save fields</Button>
        </>}>
        {problems.length > 0 && dirty && <div className="border-b border-line px-4 py-2 text-[12px] font-semibold text-bad">{problems[0]}</div>}
        <div className="flex flex-col">
          {d.sections.map((sec, si) => {
            const fields = d.fields.filter((f) => f.section === sec)
            return (
              <section key={si} className="border-b border-line last:border-0">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 bg-sunken/60 px-4 py-2">
                  <span className="w-5 text-[11px] font-bold text-faint tabular-nums">{si + 1}</span>
                  <Input aria-label="Section name" className="h-8 max-w-xs py-1 font-display font-semibold" value={sec} onChange={(e) => renameSection(si, e.target.value)} />
                  <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{fields.length} field{fields.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
                  <span className="ml-auto flex gap-1">
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={si === 0} aria-label="Move section up" onClick={() => setD({ ...d, sections: move(d.sections, si, si - 1) })}>↑</Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={si === d.sections.length - 1} aria-label="Move section down" onClick={() => setD({ ...d, sections: move(d.sections, si, si + 1) })}>↓</Button>
                    <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setAdding(sec)}>Add field</Button>
                    {!fields.length && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={() => setD({ ...d, sections: d.sections.filter((_, j) => j !== si) })}>Remove</Button>}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {fields.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="scroll-x">
                    <table className="tbl">
                      <thead><tr>
                        <th style={{ width: 64 }}>Order</th><th style={{ minWidth: 220 }}>Label · key</th><th style={{ width: 130 }}>Type</th>
                        <th style={{ minWidth: 200 }}>Required at</th><th style={{ minWidth: 200 }}>Stored on</th><th className="num">Empty</th><th className="num">Blocking</th><th style={{ width: 80 }} />
                      </tr></thead>
                      <tbody>
                        {fields.map((f, fi) => (
                          <FieldRow key={f.key} f={f} first={fi === 0} last={fi === fields.length - 1} isNew={!savedKeys.includes(f.key)}
                            sections={d.sections} stageOptions={stageOptions} bindOptions={bindOptions(f)} stat={stats[f.key]} activeCount={active.length}
                            onChange={(patch) => setField(f.key, patch)} onMove={(dir) => moveField(f.key, dir)} onRemove={() => removeField(f.key)} />
                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                )}
              </section>
            )
          })}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line px-4 py-3">
          <Input aria-label="New section name" className="h-8 max-w-xs py-1" placeholder="New section name" value={newSection} onChange={(e) => setNewSection(e.target.value)} />
          <Button size="sm" disabled={!newSection.trim() || d.sections.includes(newSection.trim())} onClick={() => { setD({ ...d, sections: [...d.sections, newSection.trim()] }); setNewSection('') }}>Add section</Button>
          <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Removing a field hides it from the record; values already stored and their revision history are kept.</span>
        </div>
      </Panel>

      <AddFieldModal section={adding} onClose={() => setAdding(null)} taken={d.fields.map((f) => f.key)}
        stageOptions={stageOptions} bindOptions={bindOptions({ key: '', label: '', section: '', type: 'text' })}
        onAdd={(f) => { setD({ ...d, fields: [...d.fields, f] }); setAdding(null); toast(`Field “${f.label}” added — save to apply`, 'info') }} />
    </div>
  )
}

function FieldRow({ f, first, last, isNew, sections, stageOptions, bindOptions, stat, activeCount, onChange, onMove, onRemove }: {
  f: InfoFieldDef; first: boolean; last: boolean; isNew: boolean; sections: string[]; stageOptions: { value: string; label: string }[]; bindOptions: { value: string; label: string }[]
  stat?: { empty: number; blocked: number; blockedCodes: string[] }; activeCount: number
  onChange: (p: Partial<InfoFieldDef>) => void; onMove: (dir: -1 | 1) => void; onRemove: () => void
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const system = SYSTEM_KEYS.includes(f.key)
  return (
    <>
      <tr className={cx(open && '[&>td]:border-b-0')}>
        <td>
          <span className="inline-flex">
            <button type="button" className="rounded px-1 text-muted hover:bg-sunken hover:text-ink disabled:opacity-30" disabled={first} aria-label="Move up" onClick={() => onMove(-1)}>↑</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded px-1 text-muted hover:bg-sunken hover:text-ink disabled:opacity-30" disabled={last} aria-label="Move down" onClick={() => onMove(1)}>↓</button>
          </span>
        </td>
        <td>
          <Input aria-label="Label" className="h-7 py-0.5" value={f.label} onChange={(e) => onChange({ label: e.target.value })} />
          <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">{f.key}</span>
            {isNew && <Badge tone="marker">New</Badge>}
            {f.readOnly && <Badge>Read-only</Badge>}
            {system && <Badge tone="info">System</Badge>}
          </div>
        </td>
        <td><Select aria-label="Type" className="h-7 py-0.5" disabled={system} value={f.type} onChange={(e) => onChange({ type: e.target.value as InfoFieldDef['type'] })} options={FIELD_TYPES.map((t) => ({ value: t.id, label: t.label }))} /></td>
        <td><Select aria-label="Required at stage" className="h-7 py-0.5" disabled={f.readOnly} value={f.requiredAtStage === undefined ? '' : String(f.requiredAtStage)} onChange={(e) => onChange({ requiredAtStage: e.target.value === '' ? undefined : Number(e.target.value) })} options={stageOptions} /></td>
        <td>{system ? <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Computed from program / team</span>
          : <Select aria-label="Stored on" className="h-7 py-0.5" value={f.bind ?? ''} onChange={(e) => onChange({ bind: e.target.value || undefined })} options={bindOptions} />}</td>
        <td className="num">{f.readOnly ? <span className="text-faint">—</span> : <span className={cx(stat?.empty ? 'text-ink' : 'text-faint')} title={`${stat?.empty ?? 0} of ${activeCount} active projects`}>{stat?.empty ?? 0}</span>}</td>
        <td className="num">{stat?.blocked ? <span className="font-semibold text-bad" title={stat.blockedCodes.join(', ')}>{stat.blocked}</span> : <span className="text-faint">0</span>}</td>
        <td><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>{open ? 'Close' : 'More'}</Button></td>
      </tr>
      {open && (
        <tr>
          <td />
          <td colSpan={7}>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 rounded border border-line bg-sunken/40 p-3 md:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="Section"><Select value={f.section} onChange={(e) => onChange({ section: e.target.value })} options={sections} /></Field>
              <Field label="Help text" hint="Shown under the label while editing and on hover"><Input value={f.help ?? ''} onChange={(e) => onChange({ help: e.target.value })} /></Field>
              {f.type === 'select' && (
                <Field label="Options" hint="One per line" className="md:col-span-2">
                  <textarea className="inp" rows={Math.min(8, (f.options?.length ?? 0) + 1)} value={(f.options ?? []).join('\n')} onChange={(e) => onChange({ options: e.target.value.split('\n') })} />
                </Field>
              )}
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px]">
                <input type="checkbox" className="h-4 w-4" checked={!!f.readOnly} disabled={system} onChange={(e) => onChange({ readOnly: e.target.checked || undefined })} />
                Read-only on the record (shown, never edited there)
              </label>
              {stat && stat.blockedCodes.length > 0 && (
                <div className="text-[12px] text-muted md:col-span-2">
                  Blocking: {stat.blockedCodes.map((c, i) => <span key={c}>{i ? ', ' : ''}<a className="font-mono text-link hover:underline" href={projectHref(c, 'info')}>{c}</a></span>)}
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="md:col-span-2">
                {system ? <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">System fields cannot be removed.</span>
                  : <ConfirmButton size="sm" confirmLabel="Remove field" onConfirm={onRemove}>Remove field</ConfirmButton>}
              </div>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

function AddFieldModal({ section, onClose, taken, onAdd, stageOptions, bindOptions }: {
  section: string | null; onClose: () => void; taken: string[]; onAdd: (f: InfoFieldDef) => void
  stageOptions: { value: string; label: string }[]; bindOptions: { value: string; label: string }[]
}) {
  const [label, setLabel] = useState('')
  const [key, setKey] = useState('')
  const [keyTouched, setKeyTouched] = useState(false)
  const [type, setType] = useState<InfoFieldDef['type']>('text')
  const [options, setOptions] = useState('')
  const [help, setHelp] = useState('')
  const [req, setReq] = useState('')
  const [bind, setBind] = useState('')
  const [readOnly, setReadOnly] = useState(false)
  const k = keyTouched ? key : keyFromLabel(label, taken)
  const err = !label.trim() ? 'Enter a label' : !validKey(k) ? 'Key must start with a letter and use letters and digits only' : taken.includes(k) ? 'That key is already used' : type === 'select' && !options.trim() ? 'Enter at least one option' : ''
  const reset = () => { setLabel(''); setKey(''); setKeyTouched(false); setType('text'); setOptions(''); setHelp(''); setReq(''); setBind(''); setReadOnly(false) }
  const close = () => { reset(); onClose() }
  const add = () => {
    if (err || !section) return
    onAdd({ section, key: k, label: label.trim(), type, options: type === 'select' ? options.split('\n').map((o) => o.trim()).filter(Boolean) : undefined, help: help.trim() || undefined, requiredAtStage: req === '' ? undefined : Number(req), bind: bind || undefined, readOnly: readOnly || undefined })
    reset()
  }
  const pickBind = (path: string) => {
    setBind(path)
    const b = BIND_PATHS.find((x) => x.path === path)
    if (b) { setType(b.type); if (b.options) setOptions(b.options.join('\n')); if (!label.trim()) setLabel(b.label) }
  }
  return (
    <Modal open={section !== null} onClose={close} title={`Add field to ${section ?? ''}`}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={close}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={!!err} onClick={add}>Add field</Button></>}>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Field label="Label"><Input value={label} onChange={(e) => setLabel(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Environmental lead" /></Field>
        <Field label="Key" hint="Permanent once saved"><Input className="font-mono" value={k} onChange={(e) => { setKey(e.target.value); setKeyTouched(true) }} /></Field>
        <Field label="Stored on"><Select value={bind} onChange={(e) => pickBind(e.target.value)} options={bindOptions} /></Field>
        <Field label="Type"><Select value={type} onChange={(e) => setType(e.target.value as InfoFieldDef['type'])} options={FIELD_TYPES.map((t) => ({ value: t.id, label: t.label }))} /></Field>
        {type === 'select' && <Field label="Options" hint="One per line" className="sm:col-span-2"><textarea className="inp" rows={4} value={options} onChange={(e) => setOptions(e.target.value)} /></Field>}
        <Field label="Required at" className="sm:col-span-2"><Select value={req} onChange={(e) => setReq(e.target.value)} options={stageOptions} /></Field>
        <Field label="Help text" className="sm:col-span-2"><Input value={help} onChange={(e) => setHelp(e.target.value)} /></Field>
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] sm:col-span-2"><input type="checkbox" className="h-4 w-4" checked={readOnly} onChange={(e) => setReadOnly(e.target.checked)} />Read-only on the record</label>
      </div>
      {req !== '' && <div className="mt-3"><Callout tone="warn">Projects already at or past this stage with the field empty will show it as a gate blocker as soon as you save.</Callout></div>}
      {err && label && <div className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-bad">{err}</div>}
    </Modal>
  )
}

// Risk library and hazard library CRUD.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { ControlType, HazardItem, RiskLibraryItem, WorkMethod } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, ConfirmButton, Drawer, Field, Input, Panel, Select, SegButtons, Table, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { MultiCheck, WORK_METHODS, humanizeId, useDraft } from './common'

export default function Libraries() {
  const [lib, setLib] = useState<'risk' | 'hazard'>('risk')
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <SegButtons options={[{ id: 'risk', label: 'Risk library' }, { id: 'hazard', label: 'Hazard & control library' }]} value={lib} onChange={setLib} />
      {lib === 'risk' ? <RiskLib /> : <HazardLib />}
    </div>
  )

function RiskLib() {
  const items = useStore((s) => s.riskLibrary)
  const risks = useStore((s) => s.risks)
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<{ it: RiskLibraryItem; isNew: boolean } | null>(null)
  const uses = useMemo(() => { const o: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const r of risks) if (r.libraryId) o[r.libraryId] = (o[r.libraryId] || 0) + 1; return o }, [risks])
  const rows = items.filter((x) => !q || (x.title + x.category + x.cause).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))
  return (
    <Panel title="Risk library" subtitle="Standard risks suggested when a project's work method matches. Typical impact seeds the three-point estimate." pad={false}
      actions={<><Input className="h-7 w-48 py-0.5" placeholder="Filter" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} /><Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setEdit({ isNew: true, it: { id: uid('rl'), title: '', category: 'Technical', cause: '', event: '', effect: '', appliesTo: [], typicalCostPct: 2, typicalDays: 20 } })}>Add risk</Button></>}>
      <Table rows={rows} rowKey={(r) => r.id} onRowClick={(it) => setEdit({ it, isNew: false })} columns={[
        { key: 't', header: 'Risk', sort: (r) => r.title, render: (r) => <div className="min-w-[200px]"><b>{r.title}</b><div className="text-[12px] text-muted">{r.event}</div></div> },
        { key: 'c', header: 'Category', sort: (r) => r.category, render: (r) => <Badge>{r.category}</Badge> },
        { key: 'a', header: 'Applies to', render: (r) => <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{r.appliesTo.map(humanizeId).join(', ')}</span> },
        { key: 'p', header: 'Typical cost', num: true, sort: (r) => r.typicalCostPct, render: (r) => <span className={r.typicalCostPct < 0 ? 'text-good' : ''}>{r.typicalCostPct > 0 ? '+' : ''}{r.typicalCostPct}%</span> },
        { key: 'd', header: 'Typical days', num: true, sort: (r) => r.typicalDays, render: (r) => r.typicalDays },
        { key: 'u', header: 'Used on', num: true, sort: (r) => uses[r.id] || 0, render: (r) => uses[r.id] || '—' },
      ]} />
      <RiskDrawer edit={edit} used={edit ? uses[edit.it.id] || 0 : 0} onClose={() => setEdit(null)} />
    </Panel>
  )
}

function RiskDrawer({ edit, used, onClose }: { edit: { it: RiskLibraryItem; isNew: boolean } | null; used: number; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [it, setIt] = useDraft<RiskLibraryItem | null>(edit?.it ?? null)
  if (!edit || !it) return null
  const save = () => {
    if (!it.title.trim()) { toast('Title is required', 'bad'); return }
    mutate((d) => { const i = d.riskLibrary.findIndex((x) => x.id === it.id); if (i >= 0) d.riskLibrary[i] = it; else d.riskLibrary.push(it) },
      { entity: 'risk-library', entityId: it.id, action: edit.isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: `${edit.isNew ? 'Added' : 'Updated'} library risk "${it.title}"` })
    toast(edit.isNew ? 'Library risk added' : 'Library risk saved'); onClose()
  }
  const remove = () => {
    mutate((d) => { d.riskLibrary = d.riskLibrary.filter((x) => x.id !== it.id) }, { entity: 'risk-library', entityId: it.id, action: 'delete', summary: `Retired library risk "${it.title}"${used ? ` (project risks keep their copy)` : ''}` })
    toast('Library risk retired'); onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} title={edit.isNew ? 'Add library risk' : 'Edit library risk'} width={580}
      footer={<>{!edit.isNew && <ConfirmButton confirmLabel="Retire risk" onConfirm={remove}>Retire</ConfirmButton>}<span className="flex-1" /><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_200px]">
          <Field label="Title"><Input value={it.title} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, title: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Category"><Input value={it.category} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, category: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Cause"><TextArea rows={2} value={it.cause} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, cause: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Event"><TextArea rows={2} value={it.event} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, event: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Effect"><TextArea rows={2} value={it.effect} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, effect: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <Field label="Typical cost impact (% of base)" hint="Negative for opportunities"><Input type="number" step="0.5" value={it.typicalCostPct} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, typicalCostPct: Number(e.target.value) })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Typical schedule impact (days)"><Input type="number" value={it.typicalDays} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, typicalDays: Number(e.target.value) })} /></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Suggest for work methods"><MultiCheck options={WORK_METHODS.map((w) => ({ id: w, label: humanizeId(w) }))} value={it.appliesTo} onChange={(v) => setIt({ ...it, appliesTo: v as WorkMethod[] })} /></Field>
        {used > 0 && <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">Used on {used} project risk{used > 1 ? 's' : ''}. Edits apply to future suggestions; existing project risks are not changed.</p>}
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

function HazardLib() {
  const items = useStore((s) => s.hazards)
  const plans = useStore((s) => s.safetyPlans)
  const [act, setAct] = useState('')

  const activities = Array.from(new Set(items.map((h) => h.activity)))
  const uses = useMemo(() => { const o: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const p of plans) if (p.status !== 'superseded') for (const h of p.hazardIds) o[h] = (o[h] || 0) + 1; return o }, [plans])
  const rows = items.filter((h) => !act || h.activity === act)
  return (
    <Panel title="Hazard & control library" subtitle="Activity → hazard → controls (hierarchy of controls), required permits and OQ tasks. Safety plans pull from this library." pad={false}
      actions={<><Select className="h-7 w-48 py-0.5" value={act} onChange={(e) => setAct(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All activities' }, ...activities]} /><Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setEdit({ isNew: true, it: { id: uid('hz'), activity: act || 'Excavation', hazard: '', controls: [{ type: 'engineering', text: '' }], permits: [], oqTasks: [], effective: useStore.getState().settings.asOf } })}>Add hazard</Button></>}>
      <Table rows={rows} rowKey={(r) => r.id} onRowClick={(it) => setEdit({ it, isNew: false })} columns={[
        { key: 'a', header: 'Activity', sort: (r) => r.activity, render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap font-semibold">{r.activity}</span> },
        { key: 'h', header: 'Hazard', sort: (r) => r.hazard, render: (r) => r.hazard },
        { key: 'c', header: 'Controls', render: (r) => <ul className="min-w-[260px] text-[12px]">{r.controls.map((c, i) => <li key={i}><Badge tone={c.type === 'engineering' ? 'good' : c.type === 'administrative' ? 'info' : 'neutral'}>{c.type === 'ppe' ? 'PPE' : c.type.slice(0, 5)}</Badge> {c.text}</li>)}</ul> },
        { key: 'p', header: 'Permits / OQ', render: (r) => <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{[...r.permits, ...r.oqTasks.map((o) => 'OQ: ' + o)].join(' · ') || '—'}</span> },
        { key: 'u', header: 'Active plans', num: true, sort: (r) => uses[r.id] || 0, render: (r) => uses[r.id] || '—' },

function HazardDrawer({ edit, onClose }: { edit: { it: HazardItem; isNew: boolean } | null; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [it, setIt] = useDraft<HazardItem | null>(edit?.it ?? null)
  if (!edit || !it) return null
  const save = () => {
    if (!it.hazard.trim()) { toast('Hazard is required', 'bad'); return }
    const clean = { ...it, controls: it.controls.filter((c) => c.text.trim()), effective: useStore.getState().settings.asOf }
    mutate((d) => { const i = d.hazards.findIndex((x) => x.id === it.id); if (i >= 0) d.hazards[i] = clean; else d.hazards.push(clean) },
      { entity: 'hazard-library', entityId: it.id, action: edit.isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: `${edit.isNew ? 'Added' : 'Updated'} hazard "${it.activity}: ${it.hazard}" (${clean.controls.length} controls)` })
    toast(edit.isNew ? 'Hazard added' : 'Hazard saved'); onClose()
  }
  const remove = () => {
    mutate((d) => { d.hazards = d.hazards.filter((x) => x.id !== it.id) }, { entity: 'hazard-library', entityId: it.id, action: 'delete', summary: `Retired hazard "${it.activity}: ${it.hazard}"` })
    toast('Hazard retired'); onClose()
  }
  const list = (v: string) => v.split(',').map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean)
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} title={edit.isNew ? 'Add hazard' : 'Edit hazard'} width={600}
      footer={<>{!edit.isNew && <ConfirmButton confirmLabel="Retire hazard" onConfirm={remove}>Retire</ConfirmButton>}<span className="flex-1" /><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save</Button></>}>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Activity"><Input value={it.activity} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, activity: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Hazard"><Input value={it.hazard} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, hazard: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between"><span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">Controls</span><Button size="sm" onClick={() => setIt({ ...it, controls: [...it.controls, { type: 'administrative', text: '' }] })}>Add control</Button></div>
          {it.controls.map((c, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="grid grid-cols-[140px_1fr_auto] gap-2">
              <Select value={c.type} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, controls: it.controls.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, type: e.target.value as ControlType } : x)) })} options={[{ value: 'engineering', label: 'Engineering' }, { value: 'administrative', label: 'Administrative' }, { value: 'ppe', label: 'PPE' }]} />
              <Input value={c.text} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, controls: it.controls.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, text: e.target.value } : x)) })} />
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={() => setIt({ ...it, controls: it.controls.filter((_, j) => j !== i) })}>✕</Button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <Field label="Required permits" hint="Comma-separated"><Input value={it.permits.join(', ')} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, permits: list(e.target.value) })} /></Field>

===== FILE: src/views/admin/Modules.tsx =====
// Configuration → Modules: phase-2 modules that are off for the pilot. Turning one on shows its navigation and panels.
import type { Settings } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { Badge, Callout, Panel } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'

type Key = keyof Settings['features']

const MODULES: { key: Key; name: string; what: string; where: string; needs: string }[] = [
  { key: 'fieldTailboard', name: 'Field tailboard', what: 'Phone-first pre-job briefing for crews: hazards and controls from the approved safety plan, crew sign-in, stop-work reminder, observations and near misses, with an offline queue.', where: 'Adds “Field tailboard” to the navigation and the button on Construction safety.', needs: 'Mobile device management for contractor phones; field connectivity plan.' },
  { key: 'portfolioPlanning', name: 'Portfolio planning', what: 'Multi-year capital plan scenarios: rank candidate projects by risk reduction per dollar against funding envelopes, and compare plans side by side.', where: 'Adds “Portfolio planning” to the navigation.', needs: 'Integrity risk model scores from the DIMP / TIMP systems.' },
  { key: 'opQual', name: 'Operator qualification (an operator-qualification provider)', what: 'Checks every crew member on a safety plan against current operator-qualification records for the covered tasks the plan’s hazards require, and flags expired OQs at the tailboard.', where: 'Adds OQ columns, the crew OQ checks in safety plans, and the expiring-OQ list on Construction safety.', needs: 'the OQ provider (or OpQual) feed of contractor OQ records.' },
]

export default function Modules() {
  const features = useStore((s) => s.settings.features)
  const toggle = (k: Key, on: boolean, name: string) => {
    mutate((d) => { d.settings.features = { ...d.settings.features, [k]: on } }, { entity: 'settings', entityId: 'features', action: 'update', summary: `${name} module turned ${on ? 'on' : 'off'}` })
    toast(`${name} ${on ? 'turned on' : 'turned off'}`)
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Callout tone="info" title="Phase 2 modules are off for the pilot">These modules are built but held back so the pilot stays focused on stage gates, estimating, cost and change control. Turning one on affects every user; data already captured is kept either way.</Callout>
      <Panel pad={false} title="Modules">
        <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
          {MODULES.map((m) => {
            const on = !!features?.[m.key]
            return (
              <li key={m.key} className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-4 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-start">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><b className="text-[14px]">{m.name}</b><Badge tone={on ? 'good' : 'neutral'}>{on ? 'On' : 'Off'}</Badge><Badge>Phase 2</Badge></div>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px]">{m.what}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-muted">{m.where}</p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] text-faint">Before production: {m.needs}</p>
                </div>
                <label className="flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-semibold">
                  <span className="relative inline-flex h-5 w-9 items-center">
                    <input type="checkbox" role="switch" aria-label={`${m.name} module`} className="peer sr-only" checked={on} onChange={(e) => toggle(m.key, e.target.checked, m.name)} />
                    <span className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-line transition peer-checked:bg-good peer-focus-visible:ring-2 peer-focus-visible:ring-link" />
                    <span className="absolute left-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-surface shadow transition peer-checked:translate-x-4" />
                  </span>
                  {on ? 'On' : 'Off'}
                </label>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      </Panel>
    </div>
  )
}
