// People & roles, custom fields (PI-01) and variance thresholds.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { Person, RoleId } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, personName, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { money, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Avatar, Badge, Button, Drawer, Field, Input, MoneyInput, Panel, Select, Table } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { PersonSelect } from '../shared/pickers'
import { MultiCheck, roleName, useDraft } from './common'

export function PeopleTab() {
  const s = useStore()
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [role, setRole] = useState('')
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<{ p: Person; isNew: boolean } | null>(null)
  const rows = s.people.filter((p) => (!q || (p.name + p.title + (p.company ?? '')).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())) && (!role || p.roles.includes(role as RoleId)))
  const holders = useMemo(() => Object.fromEntries(s.roles.map((r) => [r.id, s.people.filter((p) => p.roles.includes(r.id)).length])), [s.roles, s.people])
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Panel title="People" subtitle={`${s.people.length} people · ${s.people.filter((p) => p.company).length} contractor staff. Roles drive workflow routing; dollar authority drives approvals.`} pad={false}
        actions={<>
          <Input className="h-7 w-44 py-0.5" placeholder="Search people" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} />
          <Select className="h-7 w-44 py-0.5" value={role} onChange={(e) => setRole(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All roles' }, ...s.roles.map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: r.name }))]} />
          <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setEdit({ isNew: true, p: { id: uid('u'), name: '', title: '', roles: [], email: '', dollarAuthority: 0 } })}>Add person</Button>
        </>}>
        <Table rows={rows} rowKey={(r) => r.id} onRowClick={(p) => setEdit({ p, isNew: false })} maxHeight={520} columns={[
          { key: 'n', header: 'Name', sort: (r) => r.name, render: (r) => <span className="flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap"><Avatar name={r.name} /><span><b>{r.name}</b><div className="text-[12px] text-muted">{r.email}</div></span></span> },
          { key: 't', header: 'Title', sort: (r) => r.title, render: (r) => <span className="text-[13px]">{r.title}{r.company && <div className="text-[12px] text-muted">{r.company}</div>}</span> },
          { key: 'r', header: 'Roles', render: (r) => <span className="flex min-w-[160px] flex-wrap gap-1">{r.roles.map((x) => <Badge key={x}>{roleName(s.roles, x)}</Badge>)}</span> },
          { key: 'm', header: 'Manager', sort: (r) => personName(s, r.managerId), render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{r.managerId ? personName(s, r.managerId) : '—'}</span> },
          { key: 'd', header: 'Dollar authority', num: true, sort: (r) => r.dollarAuthority, render: (r) => (r.dollarAuthority ? money(r.dollarAuthority) : <span className="text-faint">—</span>) },
          { key: 'o', header: 'Status', render: (r) => (r.outOfOffice && s.settings.asOf >= r.outOfOffice.from && s.settings.asOf <= r.outOfOffice.to ? <Badge tone="warn">Out · delegate {personName(s, r.outOfOffice.delegateId)}</Badge> : <Badge tone="good">Active</Badge>) },
        ]} />
      </Panel>
      <RoleCatalog holders={holders} />
      <Thresholds />
      <PersonDrawer edit={edit} onClose={() => setEdit(null)} />
    </div>
  )
}

function PersonDrawer({ edit, onClose }: { edit: { p: Person; isNew: boolean } | null; onClose: () => void }) {
  const roles = useStore((s) => s.roles)
  const [p, setP] = useDraft<Person | null>(edit?.p ?? null)
  if (!edit || !p) return null
  const save = () => {
    if (!p.name.trim()) { toast('Name is required', 'bad'); return }
    const email = p.email || `${p.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, '.')}@arroyovalleygas.com`
    const prev = edit.p
    const rolesChanged = JSON.stringify(prev.roles) !== JSON.stringify(p.roles)
    mutate((d) => { const n = { ...p, email }; const i = d.people.findIndex((x) => x.id === p.id); if (i >= 0) d.people[i] = n; else d.people.push(n) },
      { entity: 'person', entityId: p.id, action: edit.isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: edit.isNew ? `Added ${p.name} (${p.title}) with roles ${p.roles.join(', ') || 'none'}` : `Updated ${p.name}${rolesChanged ? ` — roles ${prev.roles.join(', ') || 'none'} → ${p.roles.join(', ') || 'none'}` : ''}${prev.dollarAuthority !== p.dollarAuthority ? ` — authority ${money(prev.dollarAuthority)} → ${money(p.dollarAuthority)}` : ''}` })
    toast(edit.isNew ? 'Person added' : 'Person saved'); onClose()
  }
  const oo = p.outOfOffice
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} title={edit.isNew ? 'Add person' : p.name} width={580}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Name"><Input value={p.name} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, name: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Title"><Input value={p.title} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, title: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Email"><Input value={p.email} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, email: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Company" hint="Leave blank for utility employees"><Input value={p.company ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, company: e.target.value || undefined })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Manager"><PersonSelect includeEmpty value={p.managerId} onChange={(id) => setP({ ...p, managerId: id || undefined })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Dollar authority" hint="Maximum this person may approve"><MoneyInput value={p.dollarAuthority} onChange={(v) => setP({ ...p, dollarAuthority: v })} /></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Roles"><MultiCheck options={roles.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, label: r.name }))} value={p.roles} onChange={(v) => setP({ ...p, roles: v as RoleId[] })} /></Field>
        <div className="rounded-md border border-line p-3">
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-semibold"><input type="checkbox" className="h-4 w-4" checked={!!oo} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, outOfOffice: e.target.checked ? { from: useStore.getState().settings.asOf, to: useStore.getState().settings.asOf, delegateId: p.managerId ?? 'u-me' } : undefined })} />Out of office — route approvals to a delegate</label>
          {oo && (
            <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
              <Field label="From"><Input type="date" value={oo.from} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, outOfOffice: { ...oo, from: e.target.value } })} /></Field>
              <Field label="To"><Input type="date" value={oo.to} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, outOfOffice: { ...oo, to: e.target.value } })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Delegate"><PersonSelect value={oo.delegateId} onChange={(id) => setP({ ...p, outOfOffice: { ...oo, delegateId: id } })} /></Field>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

function RoleCatalog({ holders }: { holders: Record<string, number> }) {
  const roles = useStore((s) => s.roles)
  const [rows, setRows, dirty, discard] = useDraft(roles)
  const save = () => {
    const edited = rows.filter((r) => JSON.stringify(r) !== JSON.stringify(roles.find((x) => x.id === r.id))).map((r) => r.name)
    mutate((d) => { d.roles = rows }, { entity: 'role', entityId: 'catalog', action: 'update', summary: `Role catalog updated: ${edited.join(', ')}` })
    toast('Role catalog saved')
  }
  return (
    <Panel title="Role catalog" subtitle="Role identifiers are fixed because workflows and templates route by them; names and descriptions are editable." pad={false}
      actions={<>{dirty && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={discard}>Discard</Button>}<Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={save}>Save roles</Button></>}>
      <div className="scroll-x" style={{ maxHeight: 420, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
        <table className="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 150 }}>ID</th><th style={{ width: 220 }}>Name</th><th>Description</th><th className="num">People</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((r, i) => (
              <tr key={r.id}>
                <td className="font-mono text-[12px] text-muted">{r.id}</td>
                <td><Input className="h-7 py-0.5" value={r.name} onChange={(e) => setRows(rows.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, name: e.target.value } : x)))} /></td>
                <td><Input className="h-7 py-0.5" value={r.description} onChange={(e) => setRows(rows.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, description: e.target.value } : x)))} /></td>
                <td className="num">{holders[r.id] ? holders[r.id] : <span className="text-warn" title="No one holds this role; workflow steps routed to it will be skipped">0</span>}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

function Thresholds() {
  const t = useStore((s) => s.settings.varianceThresholds)
  const [v, setV, dirty, discard] = useDraft(t)
  const save = () => {
    mutate((d) => { d.settings.varianceThresholds = v }, { entity: 'settings', entityId: 'varianceThresholds', action: 'update', summary: `Variance thresholds: EAC ${t.eacPct}% / ${money(t.eacAbs)} → ${v.eacPct}% / ${money(v.eacAbs)}; milestone ${t.milestoneDays} → ${v.milestoneDays} days` })
    toast('Variance thresholds saved')
  }
  return (
    <Panel title="Variance thresholds" subtitle="Crossing either EAC threshold, or slipping a milestone past the day limit versus the Current baseline, requires a variance explanation."
      actions={<>{dirty && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={discard}>Discard</Button>}<Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={save}>Save thresholds</Button></>}>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <Field label="EAC over Current baseline (%)"><Input type="number" step="0.5" value={v.eacPct} onChange={(e) => setV({ ...v, eacPct: Number(e.target.value) })} /></Field>
        <Field label="EAC over Current baseline ($)"><MoneyInput value={v.eacAbs} onChange={(n) => setV({ ...v, eacAbs: n })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Milestone slip (days)"><Input type="number" value={v.milestoneDays} onChange={(e) => setV({ ...v, milestoneDays: Number(e.target.value) })} /></Field>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

export function CustomFields() {
  const s = useStore()
  const [rows, setRows, dirty, discard] = useDraft(s.settings.fieldDefs)
  const filled = (key: string) => s.projects.filter((p) => p.customFields?.[key]).length
  const applicable = (ids: string[]) => s.projects.filter((p) => ids.length === 0 || ids.includes(p.programId))
  const keyErr = (k: string, i: number) => !/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$/.test(k) ? 'Letters and digits only' : rows.findIndex((r) => r.key === k) !== i ? 'Duplicate key' : ''
  const save = () => {
    if (rows.some((r, i) => keyErr(r.key, i))) { toast('Fix field keys first', 'bad'); return }
    mutate((d) => { d.settings.fieldDefs = rows }, { entity: 'settings', entityId: 'fieldDefs', action: 'update', summary: `Custom project fields: ${rows.map((r) => `${r.label} [${r.key}]${r.requiredAtStage !== undefined ? ` required from stage ${r.requiredAtStage + 1}` : ''}`).join('; ')}` })
    toast('Custom fields saved')
  }
  const stageMax = Math.max(...s.templates.map((t) => t.stages.length))
  return (
    <Panel title="Custom project fields" subtitle="Extra fields on the project information record, scoped by program. A required field blocks gate readiness from its stage onward." pad={false}
      actions={<>{dirty && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={discard}>Discard</Button>}<Button size="sm" onClick={() => setRows([...rows, { key: 'newField' + (rows.length + 1), label: 'New field', programIds: [] }])}>Add field</Button><Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={save}>Save fields</Button></>}>
      <div className="scroll-x">
        <table className="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 170 }}>Key</th><th style={{ width: 230 }}>Label</th><th>Programs</th><th style={{ width: 170 }}>Required from</th><th className="num">Filled</th><th /></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((r, i) => {
              const err = keyErr(r.key, i)
              const app = applicable(r.programIds)
              return (
                <tr key={i}>
                  <td><Input className={`h-7 py-0.5 font-mono ${err ? 'border-bad' : ''}`} title={err} value={r.key} onChange={(e) => setRows(rows.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, key: e.target.value } : x)))} />{err && <div className="text-[11px] text-bad">{err}</div>}</td>
                  <td><Input className="h-7 py-0.5" value={r.label} onChange={(e) => setRows(rows.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, label: e.target.value } : x)))} /></td>
                  <td><MultiCheck options={s.programs.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, label: p.code }))} value={r.programIds} onChange={(v) => setRows(rows.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, programIds: v } : x)))} />{r.programIds.length === 0 && <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-faint">All programs</div>}</td>
                  <td><Select className="h-7 py-0.5" value={r.requiredAtStage === undefined ? '' : String(r.requiredAtStage)} onChange={(e) => setRows(rows.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, requiredAtStage: e.target.value === '' ? undefined : Number(e.target.value) } : x)))} options={[{ value: '', label: 'Optional' }, ...Array.from({ length: stageMax }, (_, k) => ({ value: String(k), label: `Stage ${k + 1}` }))]} /></td>
                  <td className="num">{filled(r.key)}/{app.length}</td>
                  <td><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={() => setRows(rows.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}>Remove</Button></td>
                </tr>
              )
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <FieldValues />
    </Panel>
  )
}

/** Fill custom-field values in bulk for the selected field. */
function FieldValues() {
  const s = useStore()
  const [key, setKey] = useState(s.settings.fieldDefs[0]?.key ?? '')
  const def = s.settings.fieldDefs.find((f) => f.key === key)
  const projects = def ? s.projects.filter((p) => def.programIds.length === 0 || def.programIds.includes(p.programId)) : []
  const [vals, setVals, dirty] = useDraft(Object.fromEntries(projects.map((p) => [p.id, p.customFields?.[key] ?? ''])))
  if (!def) return null
  const save = () => {
    const changed = projects.filter((p) => (p.customFields?.[key] ?? '') !== vals[p.id])
    mutate((d) => { for (const p of d.projects) if (p.id in vals) { p.customFields = { ...(p.customFields ?? {}), [key]: vals[p.id] }; if (!vals[p.id]) delete p.customFields[key] } },
      { entity: 'project', entityId: key, action: 'update', summary: `Set ${def.label} on ${changed.length} project${changed.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}: ${changed.slice(0, 6).map((p) => `${p.code}=${vals[p.id] || '(blank)'}`).join(', ')}` })
    toast(`${def.label} saved on ${changed.length} project${changed.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`)
  }
  return (
    <div className="border-t border-line p-4">
      <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2">
        <Field label="Edit values for"><Select className="w-64" value={key} onChange={(e) => setKey(e.target.value)} options={s.settings.fieldDefs.map((f) => ({ value: f.key, label: f.label }))} /></Field>
        <Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={save}>Save values</Button>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-4 gap-y-1.5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
        {projects.map((p) => {
          const missing = def.requiredAtStage !== undefined && p.stageIndex >= def.requiredAtStage && !vals[p.id] && p.status === 'active'
          return (
            <label key={p.id} className="grid grid-cols-[86px_1fr] items-center gap-2 text-[12px]">
              <span className={`font-mono font-semibold ${missing ? 'text-bad' : ''}`} title={missing ? 'Required at this stage' : p.name}>{p.code}</span>
              <Input className="h-7 py-0.5" value={vals[p.id] ?? ''} placeholder={missing ? 'Required' : ''} onChange={(e) => setVals({ ...vals, [p.id]: e.target.value })} />
            </label>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/admin/Programs.tsx =====
// Programs and funding envelopes by year.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { Program, RecoveryMechanism } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { activeBudget } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { money, sum, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Drawer, Field, Input, MoneyInput, Panel, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'
import { useDraft } from './common'

const RECOVERY: RecoveryMechanism[] = ['GRC base', 'Balancing account', 'Memorandum account', 'Customer-funded', 'Advice letter']

export default function Programs() {
  const s = useStore()
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<{ p: Program; isNew: boolean } | null>(null)
  const counts = useMemo(() => Object.fromEntries(s.programs.map((p) => [p.id, s.projects.filter((x) => x.programId === p.id).length])), [s.programs, s.projects])
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Panel title="Programs" subtitle="Each program sets the regulatory driver, recovery path, lifecycle template and approval authority for its projects" pad={false}
        actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setEdit({ isNew: true, p: { id: uid('prg'), code: '', name: '', description: '', regulatoryDriver: '', recovery: 'GRC base', lifecycleTemplateId: s.templates[0]?.id, doaMatrixId: s.doaMatrices[0]?.id } })}>Add program</Button>}>
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Program</th><th>Regulatory driver</th><th>Recovery</th><th>Lifecycle template</th><th>DOA matrix</th><th className="num">Projects</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {s.programs.map((p) => (
                <tr key={p.id} className="clickable" onClick={() => setEdit({ p, isNew: false })}>
                  <td className="min-w-[220px]"><div className="flex items-center gap-2"><ProgramTag programId={p.id} /><b>{p.name}</b></div><div className="text-[12px] text-muted">{p.description}</div></td>
                  <td className="text-[12px]">{p.regulatoryDriver}</td>
                  <td><Badge>{p.recovery}</Badge></td>
                  <td className="text-[12px]">{s.templates.find((t) => t.id === p.lifecycleTemplateId)?.name ?? <span className="text-bad">Missing</span>}</td>
                  <td className="text-[12px]">{(() => { const m = s.doaMatrices.find((x) => x.id === p.doaMatrixId); return m ? `${m.name} v${m.version}` : '—' })()}</td>
                  <td className="num">{counts[p.id]}</td>
                  <td><Button size="sm" variant="ghost">Edit</Button></td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </Panel>
      <FundingGrid />
      <DoaPanel />
      <ProgramDrawer edit={edit} onClose={() => setEdit(null)} />
    </div>
  )
}

function ProgramDrawer({ edit, onClose }: { edit: { p: Program; isNew: boolean } | null; onClose: () => void }) {
  const templates = useStore((s) => s.templates)
  const doas = useStore((s) => s.doaMatrices)
  const projects = useStore((s) => s.projects)
  const [p, setP] = useDraft<Program | null>(edit?.p ?? null)
  if (!edit || !p) return null
  const tplChanged = !edit.isNew && p.lifecycleTemplateId !== edit.p.lifecycleTemplateId
  const affected = projects.filter((x) => x.programId === p.id && x.status === 'active').length
  const save = () => {
    if (!p.code.trim() || !p.name.trim()) { toast('Code and name are required', 'bad'); return }
    mutate((d) => {
      const i = d.programs.findIndex((x) => x.id === p.id)
      if (i >= 0) d.programs[i] = p
      else d.programs.push(p)
    }, { entity: 'program', entityId: p.id, action: edit.isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: edit.isNew ? `Created program ${p.code} · ${p.name}` : `Updated program ${p.code}${tplChanged ? ` — lifecycle template changed to ${templates.find((t) => t.id === p.lifecycleTemplateId)?.name}` : ''}` })
    toast(edit.isNew ? 'Program created' : 'Program saved')
    onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} title={edit.isNew ? 'Add program' : `Edit ${edit.p.code}`} width={560}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>{edit.isNew ? 'Create program' : 'Save program'}</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-[110px_1fr] gap-3">
          <Field label="Code"><Input className="font-mono uppercase" maxLength={6} value={p.code} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, code: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Name"><Input value={p.name} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, name: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Description"><TextArea rows={2} value={p.description} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, description: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Regulatory driver" hint="Statute, rule or order that requires the work"><Input value={p.regulatoryDriver} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, regulatoryDriver: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Recovery mechanism"><Select value={p.recovery} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, recovery: e.target.value as RecoveryMechanism })} options={RECOVERY} /></Field>
        <Field label="Lifecycle template"><Select value={p.lifecycleTemplateId} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, lifecycleTemplateId: e.target.value })} options={templates.map((t) => ({ value: t.id, label: t.name }))} /></Field>
        {tplChanged && affected > 0 && <div className="rounded-md border border-warn/40 bg-warn/5 px-3 py-2 text-[13px]">{affected} active project{affected > 1 ? 's' : ''} will be measured against the new template from their current stage index. Past gate decisions are not changed.</div>}
        <Field label="Delegation of authority matrix"><Select value={p.doaMatrixId} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, doaMatrixId: e.target.value })} options={doas.map((m) => ({ value: m.id, label: `${m.name} v${m.version}` }))} /></Field>
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

function FundingGrid() {
  const programs = useStore((s) => s.programs)
  const funding = useStore((s) => s.funding)
  const budgets = useStore((s) => s.budgets)
  const projects = useStore((s) => s.projects)
  const years = useMemo(() => { const ys = Array.from(new Set(funding.map((f) => f.year))).sort(); return ys.length ? ys : [2026, 2027, 2028] }, [funding])
  const [draft, setDraft, dirty, discard] = useDraft(funding)
  const planned = useMemo(() => {
    const out: Record<string, number> = {}
    for (const p of projects) {
      if (p.status === 'cancelled') continue
      const b = activeBudget({ budgets } as any, p.id)
      for (const [y, v] of Object.entries(b?.byYear ?? {})) out[`${p.programId}|${y}`] = (out[`${p.programId}|${y}`] || 0) + v
    }
    return out
  }, [projects, budgets])
  const cell = (pid: string, y: number) => draft.find((f) => f.programId === pid && f.year === y)
  const setCell = (pid: string, y: number, patch: Partial<{ authorized: number; proceeding: string }>) => setDraft((d) => {
    const i = d.findIndex((f) => f.programId === pid && f.year === y)
    if (i >= 0) return d.map((f, j) => (j === i ? { ...f, ...patch } : f))
    return [...d, { id: uid('fund'), programId: pid, year: y, authorized: 0, proceeding: '', ...patch }]
  })
  const addYear = () => { const y = (years[years.length - 1] ?? 2026) + 1; setDraft((d) => [...d, ...programs.map((p) => ({ id: uid('fund'), programId: p.id, year: y, authorized: 0, proceeding: 'AV-PUC-2026-06 (fictional) (TY2028 GRC, pending)' }))]) }
  const shownYears = Array.from(new Set([...years, ...draft.map((f) => f.year)])).sort()
  const save = () => {
    const changed = draft.filter((f) => { const o = funding.find((x) => x.id === f.id); return !o || o.authorized !== f.authorized || o.proceeding !== f.proceeding })
    mutate((d) => { d.funding = draft }, { entity: 'funding', entityId: 'funding', action: 'update', summary: `Updated ${changed.length} funding envelope${changed.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}: ${changed.slice(0, 6).map((f) => `${programs.find((p) => p.id === f.programId)?.code} ${f.year} ${money(f.authorized)}`).join(', ')}${changed.length > 6 ? '…' : ''}` })
    toast('Funding envelopes saved')
  }
  const [proc, setProc] = useState<{ pid: string; y: number } | null>(null)
  return (
    <Panel title="Authorized funding by program and year" subtitle="Envelope authorized in the rate case or advice letter. Planned = active budgets spread by year; red means over authorization." pad={false}
      actions={<>{dirty && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={discard}>Discard</Button>}<Button size="sm" onClick={addYear}>Add year</Button><Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={save}>Save funding</Button></>}>
      <div className="scroll-x">
        <table className="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th>Program</th>{shownYears.map((y) => <th key={y} className="num">{y}</th>)}<th className="num">Total</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {programs.map((p) => (
              <tr key={p.id}>
                <td className="whitespace-nowrap"><ProgramTag programId={p.id} /> <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{p.name}</span></td>
                {shownYears.map((y) => {
                  const c = cell(p.id, y)
                  const pl = planned[`${p.id}|${y}`] || 0
                  const over = c && pl > c.authorized
                  return (
                    <td key={y} className="min-w-[128px]">
                      <MoneyInput aria-label={`${p.code} ${y} authorized`} className="h-7 py-0.5 text-[12px]" value={c?.authorized ?? 0} onChange={(v) => setCell(p.id, y, { authorized: v })} />
                      <button className="mt-0.5 block w-full truncate text-right text-[11px] tabular-nums" title={`Planned ${money(pl, 'full')} · ${c?.proceeding || 'no proceeding'}`} onClick={() => setProc({ pid: p.id, y })}>
                        <span className={over ? 'font-semibold text-bad' : 'text-faint'}>plan {money(pl)}</span>
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  )
                })}
                <td className="num font-semibold">{money(sum(draft.filter((f) => f.programId === p.id).map((f) => f.authorized)))}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
            <tr>
              <td className="font-semibold">All programs</td>
              {shownYears.map((y) => {
                const a = sum(draft.filter((f) => f.year === y).map((f) => f.authorized))
                const pl = sum(programs.map((p) => planned[`${p.id}|${y}`] || 0))
                return <td key={y} className="num"><b>{money(a)}</b><div className={pl > a ? 'text-[11px] text-bad' : 'text-[11px] text-faint'}>plan {money(pl)}</div></td>
              })}
              <td className="num font-semibold">{money(sum(draft.map((f) => f.authorized)))}</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {proc && (() => {
        const c = cell(proc.pid, proc.y)
        return (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2 border-t border-line px-4 py-3">
            <Field className="min-w-[280px] flex-1" label={`Proceeding for ${programs.find((p) => p.id === proc.pid)?.code} ${proc.y}`}>
              <Input value={c?.proceeding ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setCell(proc.pid, proc.y, { proceeding: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. AV-PUC-2026-06 (fictional) (TY2028 GRC)" />
            </Field>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setProc(null)}>Done</Button>
          </div>
        )
      })()}
      <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-2 text-[12px] text-muted">Click a planned figure to edit the proceeding that authorizes that envelope. Portfolio planning uses these envelopes for its fit-to-funding scenarios.</div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

function DoaPanel() {
  const doas = useStore((s) => s.doaMatrices)
  const roles = useStore((s) => s.roles)
  const m = doas[0]
  const [rows, setRows, dirty, discard] = useDraft(m?.rows ?? [])
  if (!m) return null
  const save = () => {
    const nv = m.version + 1
    mutate((d) => { const x = d.doaMatrices.find((y) => y.id === m.id)!; x.rows = rows; x.version = nv; x.effective = d.settings.asOf }, { entity: 'doa', entityId: m.id, action: 'update', summary: `Published ${m.name} v${nv}: ${rows.map((r) => `≤${money(r.upTo)} ${r.label}`).join(', ')}` })
    toast(`Delegation of authority v${nv} published`)
  }
  return (
    <Panel title="Delegation of authority" subtitle={`${m.name} · v${m.version} effective ${m.effective}. Workflows with a dollar-authority step route to the first row the amount fits under.`} pad={false}
      actions={<>{dirty && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={discard}>Discard</Button>}<Button size="sm" onClick={() => setRows([...rows, { upTo: (rows[rows.length - 1]?.upTo ?? 0) * 2 || 1_000_000, roleId: 'exec', label: 'New tier' }])}>Add tier</Button><Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={save}>Publish new version</Button></>}>
      <div className="scroll-x">
        <table className="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th>Up to</th><th>Approver role</th><th>Label</th><th /></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((r, i) => (
              <tr key={i}>
                <td className="w-[180px]">{r.upTo >= 1e12 ? <span className="text-[13px] text-muted">No limit</span> : <MoneyInput className="h-7 py-0.5" value={r.upTo} onChange={(v) => setRows(rows.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, upTo: v } : x)))} />}</td>
                <td><Select className="h-7 py-0.5" value={r.roleId} onChange={(e) => setRows(rows.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, roleId: e.target.value as typeof r.roleId } : x)))} options={roles.map((x) => ({ value: x.id, label: x.name }))} /></td>
                <td><Input className="h-7 py-0.5" value={r.label} onChange={(e) => setRows(rows.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, label: e.target.value } : x)))} /></td>
                <td className="w-[80px]"><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={() => setRows(rows.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}>Remove</Button></td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/admin/QuickEstimateSettings.tsx =====
// Configuration → Class 5 quick estimate: region factors per district, the default Class 5 contingency,
// how the factor-model method works, and the way to the factor model and historical cost table the estimating team maintains.
import { prefs } from '@/core/data'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { mutate, personName, useMe, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { escalationFactor, loaderPct } from '@/core/engine/quick'
import { publishedModel } from '@/core/engine/factorModel'
import { go, workflowHref } from '@/core/router'
import { cx, fmtDateTime, money, sum } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Field, Input, Panel } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { NumInput } from '@/views/estimating/parts'

const openFactorModel = () => { try { prefs.setRaw('crosswalk:estimating:admin', 'factor'); prefs.setRaw('crosswalk:estimating:tab', 'admin') } catch { /* storage blocked */ } go('#estimating') }
const openHistorical = () => { try { prefs.setRaw('crosswalk:estimating:tab', 'historical') } catch { /* storage blocked */ } go('#estimating') }

export default function QuickEstimateSettings() {
  const s = useStore()
  const me = useMe()
  const qe = s.settings.quickEstimate
  const pub = publishedModel(s)
  const canEdit = me.roles.some((r) => r === 'admin' || r === 'estimating-lead')
  const [factors, setFactors] = useState<Record<string, number>>(() => ({ ...qe.regionFactors }))
  const [cont, setCont] = useState(qe.contingencyPct)
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('')
  useEffect(() => { setFactors({ ...qe.regionFactors }); setCont(qe.contingencyPct) }, [qe])
  const districts = Array.from(new Set([...Object.keys(factors), ...s.projects.map((p) => p.location.district)])).sort()
  const dirty = JSON.stringify(factors) !== JSON.stringify(qe.regionFactors) || cont !== qe.contingencyPct
  const bad = Object.values(factors).some((v) => !(v > 0.5 && v < 2)) || !(cont >= 0 && cont <= 100)
  const lp = sum(loaderPct(s).map((x) => x.pct))
  const y = Number(s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4))
  const reviewers = s.people.filter((p) => p.roles.includes('estimator'))
  const last = [...s.audit].reverse().find((a) => a.entity === 'quick-estimate')
  const save = () => {
    if (!dirty || bad) return
    const ch = [
      ...districts.filter((d) => (factors[d] ?? 1) !== (qe.regionFactors[d] ?? 1)).map((d) => `${d} ×${(qe.regionFactors[d] ?? 1).toFixed(2)} → ×${(factors[d] ?? 1).toFixed(2)}`),
      ...(cont !== qe.contingencyPct ? [`contingency ${qe.contingencyPct}% → ${cont}%`] : []),
    ]
    mutate((d) => { d.settings.quickEstimate.regionFactors = { ...factors }; d.settings.quickEstimate.contingencyPct = cont }, { entity: 'quick-estimate', entityId: 'settings', action: 'update', summary: `Class 5 quick estimate settings: ${ch.join('; ')}` })
    toast('Quick estimate settings saved')
  }
  const addDistrict = () => {
    const n = newName.trim()
    if (!n || factors[n] != null) return
    setFactors({ ...factors, [n]: 1 }); setNewName('')
  }
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
        <Panel pad={false} title="Region factors" subtitle="Multiplier on the historical direct rate for where the work is. 1.00 = system average."
          actions={canEdit && <><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={!dirty} onClick={() => { setFactors({ ...qe.regionFactors }); setCont(qe.contingencyPct) }}>Discard</Button><Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!dirty || bad} onClick={save}>Save settings</Button></>}>
          <div className="scroll-x">
            <table className="tbl">
              <thead><tr><th>District</th><th className="num" style={{ width: 120 }}>Factor</th><th className="num">Projects</th><th className="num">$1M of history becomes</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {districts.map((d) => {
                  const v = factors[d]
                  const n = s.projects.filter((p) => p.location.district === d).length
                  return (
                    <tr key={d}>
                      <td className="font-semibold">{d}{v == null && <Badge className="ml-2" tone="warn">Not set · ×1.00</Badge>}</td>
                      <td className="num">{canEdit ? <NumInput id={`rf-${d}`} ariaLabel={`${d} factor`} className="h-7 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[12px]" value={v ?? 1} onChange={(x) => setFactors({ ...factors, [d]: Math.round(x * 100) / 100 })} /> : `×${(v ?? 1).toFixed(2)}`}</td>
                      <td className="num text-muted">{n}</td>
                      <td className={cx('num', (v ?? 1) > 1 ? 'text-bad' : (v ?? 1) < 1 ? 'text-good' : 'text-muted')}>{money(1e6 * (v ?? 1))}</td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          {canEdit && (
            <form className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2 border-t border-line px-4 py-2.5" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); addDistrict() }}>
              <Field label="Add a district" className="w-48"><Input id="rf-new" value={newName} onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)} placeholder="District name" /></Field>
              <Button size="sm" type="submit" disabled={!newName.trim() || factors[newName.trim()] != null}>Add</Button>
            </form>
          )}
          {bad && <div className="px-4 pb-3"><Callout tone="bad">Factors must be between 0.5 and 2.0 and contingency between 0% and 100%.</Callout></div>}
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Class 5 contingency" subtitle="Applied to direct cost plus loaders on every quick estimate">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
            <Field label="Default contingency %" className="w-36">{canEdit ? <NumInput id="qe-cont" value={cont} min={0} onChange={(v) => setCont(Math.round(v * 10) / 10)} /> : <div className="font-display text-[22px] font-bold tabular-nums">{cont}%</div>}</Field>
            <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[12.5px] text-muted">The estimating standard for Class 5 is 30%. The historical P10–P90 range is shown beside the AACE Class 5 range (−50% / +100%) on every request so reviewers can see when history is thin.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 text-[12px] text-muted">Loaders come from the current loader rates ({loaderPct(s).map((x) => `${x.name} ${x.pct}%`).join(' · ')} = {lp.toFixed(1)}%). Escalation from each row's base year to the spend midpoint uses the escalation table ({Object.entries(s.settings.escalationByYear).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v}%`).join(' · ')}).</div>
          {last && <div className="mt-2 text-[11.5px] text-faint">Last changed {fmtDateTime(last.at)} by {personName(s, last.actorId)}</div>}
          {!canEdit && <div className="mt-2 text-[11.5px] text-faint">Only administrators and the estimating lead change these settings.</div>}
        </Panel>
      </div>
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
        <Panel title="How the quick estimate works">
          <ol className="ml-5 flex list-decimal flex-col gap-2 text-[13px]">
            <li><b>Pick a few values.</b> Asset type, work method, diameter, quantity, region and midpoint year, plus the site drivers: soil, crossings, setting, permit complexity, HCA, class location, traffic, work hours and remoteness. Requests from a project start pre-filled from its record.</li>
            <li><b>Price it on the published factor model{pub ? ` (v${pub.version})` : ''}.</b> Direct = base rate × quantity × size scale × each driver's multiplier × region × escalation (×{escalationFactor(s, 2025, y + 1).toFixed(3)} from 2025 to {y + 1}). Then + loaders ({lp.toFixed(1)}%) and + contingency ({qe.contingencyPct}%). Every driver's dollar effect is itemized, and the drivers' uncertainty gives the P10–P90 range. Drivers are physical, legal or logistical only, never demographic or wealth attributes.</li>
            <li><b>Check it.</b> The rate-table Class 5 and the matching historical row are shown beside it, so reviewers can see when the model and history disagree.</li>
            <li><b>Send to the estimating team.</b> The <a className="font-semibold text-link" href={workflowHref('class5-review')}>Class 5 quick estimate review</a> routes it to any estimator ({reviewers.map((p) => p.name).join(', ') || 'none configured'}). They can adjust it by a percentage and/or price it at P10/P90, with a mandatory reason, then approve or return it.</li>
            <li><b>Approved = estimate of record.</b> It locks, carries its adjustment history, and becomes the planning budget at Gate 1. Maturing to Class 3 starts a new line-item version from it.</li>
          </ol>
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Factor model" subtitle="Weights, multipliers, backtest and versions live in Estimating → Administration">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 text-[13px]">
            <span>Published <b className="tabular-nums">{pub ? `v${pub.version}` : 'none'}</b></span>
            <span><b className="tabular-nums">{s.backtestProjects.length}</b> closed projects in the backtest</span>
            <span><b className="tabular-nums">{s.factorModels.filter((m) => m.status === 'draft' || m.status === 'in-review').length}</b> draft or in review</span>
            <Button size="sm" variant="primary" className="ml-auto" onClick={openFactorModel}>Open factor model</Button>
          </div>
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Historical cost table" subtitle="Maintained by the estimating team in the Estimating module">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 text-[13px]">
            <span><b className="tabular-nums">{s.historicalCosts.filter((h) => h.active).length}</b> active rows</span>
            <span><b className="tabular-nums">{s.historicalCosts.filter((h) => h.active && h.n < 5).length}</b> with fewer than 5 projects</span>
            <span><b className="tabular-nums">{s.estimates.filter((e) => e.method === 'quick').length}</b> quick estimates</span>
            <Button size="sm" variant="primary" className="ml-auto" onClick={openHistorical}>Open historical costs</Button>
          </div>

===== FILE: src/views/admin/SapMappings.tsx =====
// Configuration: the SAP → forecast line mapping table. Rules run in priority order (lowest first) and the first
// match wins: cost-element range, optional WBS-element suffix, optional text/vendor match → a forecast line,
// allocate pro-rata (loader settlements) or exclude (non-project cost). Includes a row tester and coverage checks.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { SapMapping } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { forecastLines, lineById } from '@/core/engine/lines'
import { remap } from '@/core/engine/sap'
import { cx, money, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Checkbox, ConfirmButton, Field, Input, Modal, Panel, SegButtons, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { brokenRules, linesWithoutRule, ruleOverlaps, targetLabel, testRow, unmappedElements } from '../actuals/lib'

export default function SapMappings(_props: { projectId?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const rules = useMemo(() => [...s.settings.sapMappings].sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority), [s.settings.sapMappings])
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<SapMapping | null>(null)
  const overlaps = ruleOverlaps(rules)
  const noRule = linesWithoutRule(s)
  const broken = brokenRules(s)
  const missing = unmappedElements(s)
  const staged = s.actualsImports.filter((x) => x.status === 'staged')
  const hits = useMemo(() => { const out: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const t of s.actualTxns) if (t.ruleId && !t.manual) out[t.ruleId] = (out[t.ruleId] || 0) + 1; return out }, [s.actualTxns])

  const save = (r: SapMapping, isNew: boolean) => {
    mutate((d) => {
      const i = d.settings.sapMappings.findIndex((x) => x.id === r.id)
      if (i >= 0) d.settings.sapMappings[i] = r
      else d.settings.sapMappings.push(r)
    }, { entity: 'sap-mapping', entityId: r.id, action: isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: `${isNew ? 'Added' : 'Updated'} SAP mapping rule P${r.priority}: ${r.costElementFrom}–${r.costElementTo}${r.wbsSuffix ? ` WBS *${r.wbsSuffix}` : ''}${r.textContains ? ` text "${r.textContains}"` : ''} → ${targetLabel(s, r)}` })
    toast(isNew ? `Rule P${r.priority} added` : `Rule P${r.priority} saved`)
    setEdit(null)
  }
  const swap = (i: number, dir: -1 | 1) => {
    const a = rules[i], b = rules[i + dir]
    if (!a || !b) return
    mutate((d) => {
      const x = d.settings.sapMappings.find((y) => y.id === a.id)!, y = d.settings.sapMappings.find((z) => z.id === b.id)!
      const pa = x.priority
      if (pa === y.priority) x.priority = pa + dir
      else { x.priority = y.priority; y.priority = pa }
    }, { entity: 'sap-mapping', entityId: a.id, action: 'reorder', summary: `Moved SAP mapping rule ${a.costElementFrom}–${a.costElementTo} ${dir < 0 ? 'ahead of' : 'after'} ${b.costElementFrom}–${b.costElementTo}` })
  }
  const toggle = (r: SapMapping) => {
    mutate((d) => { const x = d.settings.sapMappings.find((y) => y.id === r.id); if (x) x.active = !x.active }, { entity: 'sap-mapping', entityId: r.id, action: r.active ? 'deactivate' : 'activate', summary: `${r.active ? 'Deactivated' : 'Activated'} SAP mapping rule P${r.priority} ${r.costElementFrom}–${r.costElementTo}` })
    toast(r.active ? `P${r.priority} deactivated` : `P${r.priority} activated`)
  }
  const remove = (r: SapMapping) => {
    mutate((d) => { d.settings.sapMappings = d.settings.sapMappings.filter((x) => x.id !== r.id) }, { entity: 'sap-mapping', entityId: r.id, action: 'delete', summary: `Deleted SAP mapping rule P${r.priority} ${r.costElementFrom}–${r.costElementTo} → ${targetLabel(s, r)}` })
    toast(`P${r.priority} deleted`)
  }
  const newRule = (patch: Partial<SapMapping> = {}) => {
    const maxBelowAlloc = Math.max(0, ...rules.filter((r) => r.target === 'line').map((r) => r.priority))
    setEdit({ id: uid('map'), priority: maxBelowAlloc + 1, costElementFrom: '', costElementTo: '', target: 'line', lineId: forecastLines(s)[0]?.id, note: '', active: true, ...patch })
  }
  const rerunAll = () => {
    mutate((d) => { for (const imp of d.actualsImports.filter((x) => x.status === 'staged')) remap(d, imp.id) }, { entity: 'sap-mapping', entityId: 'remap', action: 'remap', summary: `Re-ran the mapping table over ${staged.length} staged SAP extract(s)` })
    toast(`Mapping re-run on ${staged.length} staged extract${staged.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`)
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.4fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <RowTester />
        <Panel title="Coverage checks" subtitle="What the table misses, and where rules overlap">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-[12.5px]">
            {missing.length > 0 && (
              <Callout tone="bad" title={`${missing.length} cost element${missing.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} in staged extracts match no rule`}>
                <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">{missing.map((m) => <li key={m.costElement} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><span className="font-mono">{m.costElement}</span><span className="text-muted">{m.name} · {m.rows} row{m.rows === 1 ? '' : 's'} · {money(m.amount)}</span><Button size="sm" onClick={() => newRule({ costElementFrom: m.costElement, costElementTo: m.costElement, note: m.name })}>Add rule</Button></li>)}</ul>
              </Callout>
            )}
            {broken.map((r) => <Callout key={r.id} tone="bad">P{r.priority} targets a missing or inactive line — rows it matches stay unmapped.</Callout>)}
            {noRule.length > 0 ? <Callout tone="warn" title="Lines no rule sends cost to">{noRule.map((l) => `${l.code} ${l.name}`).join(', ')}. SAP actuals can still reach them by hand, but not automatically.</Callout> : <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-good"><Icon name="check" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />Every active forecast line has at least one rule.</div>}
            {overlaps.filter((o) => o.kind !== 'refines').map((o, i) => <Callout key={i} tone={o.kind === 'shadowed' ? 'bad' : 'warn'}>{o.text}.</Callout>)}
            {overlaps.filter((o) => o.kind === 'refines').length > 0 && (
              <div><div className="eyebrow mb-1">Intended overlaps</div><ul className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 text-muted">{overlaps.filter((o) => o.kind === 'refines').map((o, i) => <li key={i}><span className="font-mono text-[11.5px] text-ink">P{o.a.priority} / P{o.b.priority}</span> — {o.text}</li>)}</ul></div>
            )}
            {staged.length > 0 && <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line pt-2"><span className="text-muted">{staged.length} staged extract{staged.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} waiting.</span><Button size="sm" onClick={rerunAll}>Re-run mapping on staged</Button><a href="#actuals" className="text-link hover:underline">Open SAP actuals</a></div>}
          </div>
        </Panel>
      </div>

      <Panel title="Mapping rules" subtitle={`${rules.filter((r) => r.active).length} active of ${rules.length} · lowest priority number runs first; the first matching rule wins`} pad={false}
        actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => newRule()} icon={<Icon name="plus" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}>Add rule</Button>}>
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Order</th><th>Cost element</th><th>WBS suffix</th><th>Text contains</th><th>Target</th><th>Note</th><th className="num">Rows matched</th><th>Active</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {rules.map((r, i) => (
                <tr key={r.id} className={cx(!r.active && 'text-faint')}>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap">
                    <span className="mr-1 inline-block w-9 font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold">P{r.priority}</span>
                    <button className="rounded px-1 text-muted hover:bg-sunken hover:text-ink disabled:opacity-30" disabled={i === 0} onClick={() => swap(i, -1)} aria-label="Run earlier">▲</button>
                    <button className="rounded px-1 text-muted hover:bg-sunken hover:text-ink disabled:opacity-30" disabled={i === rules.length - 1} onClick={() => swap(i, 1)} aria-label="Run later">▼</button>
                  </td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[12px]">{r.costElementFrom}{r.costElementTo !== r.costElementFrom && <>–{r.costElementTo}</>}</td>
                  <td className="font-mono text-[12px]">{r.wbsSuffix ? `*${r.wbsSuffix}` : <span className="text-faint">any</span>}</td>
                  <td className="text-[12px]">{r.textContains ? `“${r.textContains}”` : <span className="text-faint">any</span>}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap"><Badge tone={r.target === 'line' ? (lineById(s, r.lineId)?.active ? 'neutral' : 'bad') : r.target === 'allocate' ? 'info' : 'warn'}>{targetLabel(s, r)}</Badge></td>
                  <td className="min-w-[200px] text-[12px] text-muted">{r.note}</td>
                  <td className="num text-muted">{hits[r.id] ?? 0}</td>
                  <td><input type="checkbox" className="h-4 w-4" checked={r.active} onChange={() => toggle(r)} aria-label={`Rule P${r.priority} active`} /></td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-right"><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit(r)}>Edit</Button><ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Delete rule" onConfirm={() => remove(r)}>Delete</ConfirmButton></td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-2 text-[11.5px] text-muted">Changing rules does not touch posted actuals. Staged extracts pick up changes when mapping is re-run; rows resolved by hand are kept.</div>
      </Panel>
      {edit && <RuleModal rule={edit} isNew={!s.settings.sapMappings.some((x) => x.id === edit.id)} onClose={() => setEdit(null)} onSave={save} />}
    </div>
  )
}

function RowTester() {
  const s = useStore()
  const sample = s.projects.find((p) => p.status === 'active' && p.stageIndex >= 2)
  const [ce, setCe] = useState('5100110')
  const [wbs, setWbs] = useState(sample ? `${sample.erpWbs}.02` : '')
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const r = testRow(s, { costElement: ce.trim(), sapWbs: wbs.trim(), text })
  const fn = s.settings.wbsFunctions.find((f) => f.id === r.fnId)
  return (
    <Panel title="Test a row" subtitle="Enter what an SAP line item carries to see which rule catches it">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <Field label="Cost element"><Input className="font-mono" value={ce} onChange={(e) => setCe(e.target.value)} placeholder="5200110" /></Field>
        <Field label="WBS element"><Input className="font-mono" value={wbs} onChange={(e) => setWbs(e.target.value)} placeholder="C.PSE.1001.02" /></Field>
        <Field label="Text or vendor"><Input value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} placeholder="optional" /></Field>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken/40 p-3 text-[12.5px]">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <div><div className="eyebrow">Project</div>{wbs.trim() ? (r.project ? <span><span className="font-mono font-semibold">{r.project.code}</span> <span className="text-muted">{r.project.name}</span></span> : <span className="font-semibold text-bad">No project — row would be an exception</span>) : <span className="text-faint">enter a WBS element</span>}</div>
          <div><div className="eyebrow">Winning rule</div>{r.winner ? <span className="font-mono font-semibold">P{r.winner.priority} · {r.winner.costElementFrom}–{r.winner.costElementTo}{r.winner.wbsSuffix ? ` *${r.winner.wbsSuffix}` : ''}</span> : <span className="font-semibold text-bad">None — unmapped</span>}</div>
          <div><div className="eyebrow">Lands on</div>{r.winner ? <span className="font-semibold">{targetLabel(s, r.winner)}{fn && <span className="font-normal text-muted"> → WBS {fn.code} {fn.name}</span>}</span> : '—'}</div>
        </div>
        {r.all.length > 1 && <div className="mt-2 border-t border-line pt-2 text-[12px] text-muted">Also matches, but runs later: {r.all.slice(1).map((x) => `P${x.priority} (${targetLabel(s, x)})`).join(', ')}</div>}
        {r.winner?.note && <div className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-muted">{r.winner.note}</div>}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

function RuleModal({ rule, isNew, onClose, onSave }: { rule: SapMapping; isNew: boolean; onClose: () => void; onSave: (r: SapMapping, isNew: boolean) => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [r, setR] = useState<SapMapping>(rule)
  const lines = forecastLines(s)
  const clash = s.settings.sapMappings.find((x) => x.id !== r.id && x.priority === r.priority)
  const submit = () => {
    const from = r.costElementFrom.trim(), to = (r.costElementTo.trim() || from)
    if (!/^\d{4,10}$/.test(from) || !/^\d{4,10}$/.test(to)) { toast('Cost elements are numbers, e.g. 5200000', 'bad'); return }
    if (Number(to) < Number(from)) { toast('The range ends before it starts', 'bad'); return }
    if (r.target === 'line' && !r.lineId) { toast('Choose the forecast line', 'bad'); return }
    if (!r.note.trim()) { toast('Add a note — what the rule is for', 'bad'); return }
    onSave({ ...r, costElementFrom: from, costElementTo: to, wbsSuffix: r.wbsSuffix?.trim() || undefined, textContains: r.textContains?.trim() || undefined, lineId: r.target === 'line' ? r.lineId : undefined, note: r.note.trim() }, isNew)
  }
  const affected = useMemo(() => {
    const t = s.actualTxns.filter((x) => s.actualsImports.find((i) => i.id === x.importId)?.status === 'staged' && !x.manual)
    const from = Number(r.costElementFrom), to = Number(r.costElementTo || r.costElementFrom)
    return t.filter((x) => Number(x.costElement) >= from && Number(x.costElement) <= to).length
  }, [s, r.costElementFrom, r.costElementTo])
  return (
    <Modal open onClose={onClose} title={isNew ? 'Add mapping rule' : `Edit rule P${rule.priority}`}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={submit}>{isNew ? 'Add rule' : 'Save rule'}</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <Field label="Priority" hint={clash ? `Same as P${clash.priority} (${clash.costElementFrom}–${clash.costElementTo})` : 'Lower runs first'}><Input type="number" value={r.priority} onChange={(e) => setR({ ...r, priority: Number(e.target.value) })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Cost element from"><Input className="font-mono" value={r.costElementFrom} onChange={(e) => setR({ ...r, costElementFrom: e.target.value })} placeholder="5200000" /></Field>
          <Field label="Cost element to" hint="Inclusive; blank = same as from"><Input className="font-mono" value={r.costElementTo} onChange={(e) => setR({ ...r, costElementTo: e.target.value })} placeholder="5209999" /></Field>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="WBS element ends with" hint="e.g. .02 for the engineering sub-WBS; blank = any"><Input className="font-mono" value={r.wbsSuffix ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setR({ ...r, wbsSuffix: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Text or vendor contains" hint="Case-insensitive; blank = any"><Input value={r.textContains ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setR({ ...r, textContains: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Target">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <SegButtons value={r.target} onChange={(v) => setR({ ...r, target: v })} options={[{ id: 'line', label: 'Forecast line' }, { id: 'allocate', label: 'Allocate pro-rata' }, { id: 'exclude', label: 'Exclude' }]} />
            {r.target === 'line' && <Select aria-label="Forecast line" value={r.lineId ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setR({ ...r, lineId: e.target.value })} options={lines.map((l) => ({ value: l.id, label: `${l.code} ${l.name} (WBS ${s.settings.wbsFunctions.find((f) => f.id === l.functionId)?.code})` }))} />}
            {r.target === 'allocate' && <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">For overhead, benefits and AFUDC settlements: spread over the project-period’s mapped lines in proportion to their direct cost.</span>}
            {r.target === 'exclude' && <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Kept in the import record but never reaches project actuals (balance-sheet transfers, non-project postings).</span>}
          </div>
        </Field>
        <Field label="Note (why this rule exists)"><TextArea rows={2} value={r.note} onChange={(e) => setR({ ...r, note: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <Checkbox checked={r.active} onChange={(v) => setR({ ...r, active: v })} label="Active" />
        {affected > 0 && <Callout tone="info">{affected} row{affected === 1 ? '' : 's'} in staged extracts fall in this range. Re-run mapping after saving to apply the rule to them.</Callout>}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/admin/SpreadProfiles.tsx =====
// Configuration: spread profiles — reusable time-phasing shapes a forecaster can apply to a WBS function.
// Built-in curves (even, S-curve, front, back, bell) plus custom ones: a weight shape resampled to any window,
// with optional black-out calendar months (e.g. a holiday paving moratorium).
import React, { useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, SpreadProfile } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { BUILT_IN_PROFILES, profileWeights } from '@/core/engine/lines'
import { addMonths, cx, monthKey, monthRange, sum, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, ConfirmButton, Field, Input, Modal, Panel, SegButtons, Select } from '@/ui/kit'
import { BarChart } from '@/ui/charts'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { Shape } from '../forecast/Profiles'

const MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

/** Parse "3, 8, 12" into weights (non-negative numbers). Returns null when any entry is not a number. */
export function parseWeights(text: string): number[] | null {
  const parts = text.split(/[\s,;]+/).map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean)
  if (!parts.length) return null
  const out = parts.map(Number)
  return out.every((x) => Number.isFinite(x) && x >= 0) ? out : null
}

/** Weights a profile produces over `months`, as shares (sum 1), using a draft profile that may not be saved yet. */
export function previewShares(s: AppState, prof: SpreadProfile | string, months: string[]): number[] {
  const st = typeof prof === 'string' ? s : { ...s, settings: { ...s.settings, spreadProfiles: [...s.settings.spreadProfiles.filter((x) => x.id !== prof.id), prof] } }
  const w = profileWeights(st, typeof prof === 'string' ? prof : prof.id, months)
  const W = sum(w) || 1
  return w.map((x) => x / W)
}

export default function SpreadProfiles(_props: { projectId?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<SpreadProfile | null>(null)
  const start = monthKey(addMonths(s.settings.asOf, 1))
  const sample = monthRange(start, monthKey(addMonths(start + '-01', 11)))
  const usage = useMemo(() => {
    const out: Record<string, { versions: number; projects: Set<string>; adjusted: number }> = {}
    for (const f of s.forecasts) for (const pr of Object.values(f.profiles ?? {})) {
      const u = (out[pr.profileId] ||= { versions: 0, projects: new Set(), adjusted: 0 })
      u.versions++; u.projects.add(f.projectId); if (pr.adjusted) u.adjusted++
    }
    return out
  }, [s.forecasts])
  const save = (p: SpreadProfile, isNew: boolean) => {
    mutate((d) => {
      const i = d.settings.spreadProfiles.findIndex((x) => x.id === p.id)
      if (i >= 0) d.settings.spreadProfiles[i] = p
      else d.settings.spreadProfiles.push(p)
    }, { entity: 'spread-profile', entityId: p.id, action: isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: `${isNew ? 'Added' : 'Updated'} spread profile “${p.name}”: weights ${p.weights.join(', ')}${p.zeroMonths?.length ? `; no spend in ${p.zeroMonths.map((m) => MONTHS[m - 1]).join(', ')}` : ''}` })
    toast(isNew ? `Profile “${p.name}” added` : `Profile “${p.name}” saved`)
    setEdit(null)
  }
  const remove = (p: SpreadProfile) => {
    mutate((d) => { d.settings.spreadProfiles = d.settings.spreadProfiles.filter((x) => x.id !== p.id) }, { entity: 'spread-profile', entityId: p.id, action: 'delete', summary: `Deleted unused spread profile “${p.name}”` })
    toast(`Profile “${p.name}” deleted`)
  }
  const useText = (id: string) => { const u = usage[id]; return u ? `${u.versions} function${u.versions === 1 ? '' : 's'} on ${u.projects.size} project${u.projects.size === 1 ? '' : 's'}${u.adjusted ? ` · ${u.adjusted} adjusted` : ''}` : 'not used yet' }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Callout tone="info" title="How profiles work">
        On the forecast tab each WBS function gets a profile and a start/end month. Applying it phases the function’s ETC over its line items in that shape; every cell stays editable and a hand edit marks the profile <b>adjusted</b>. Custom weights are stretched or squeezed to the window’s length, and black-out months get no spend (their share moves to the other months).
      </Callout>
      <Panel title="Custom profiles" subtitle={`${s.settings.spreadProfiles.length} defined · shapes shown over a 12-month window from ${MONTHS[Number(start.slice(5)) - 1]} ${start.slice(0, 4)}`} pad={false}
        actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" icon={<Icon name="plus" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} onClick={() => setEdit({ id: uid('prof'), name: '', description: '', weights: [1, 2, 4, 6, 6, 6, 4, 2, 1] })}>New profile</Button>}>
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Shape</th><th>Profile</th><th>Weights</th><th>Black-out months</th><th>Used by</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {s.settings.spreadProfiles.map((p) => (
                <tr key={p.id}>
                  <td><Shape weights={previewShares(s, p, sample)} w={96} h={28} labels={sample} /></td>
                  <td className="min-w-[200px]"><div className="font-semibold">{p.name}</div><div className="text-[12px] text-muted">{p.description}</div></td>
                  <td className="max-w-[220px] font-mono text-[11.5px] text-muted"><div className="truncate" title={p.weights.join(', ')}>{p.weights.join(', ')}</div><div className="text-faint">{p.weights.length} points</div></td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{p.zeroMonths?.length ? p.zeroMonths.map((m) => MONTHS[m - 1]).join(', ') : <span className="text-faint">none</span>}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px] text-muted">{useText(p.id)}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-right">
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit(p)}>Edit</Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit({ ...p, id: uid('prof'), name: `${p.name} (copy)` })}>Copy</Button>
                    {usage[p.id] ? <span className="px-2 text-[11.5px] text-faint" title="Forecast versions reference this profile; edit it instead">in use</span> : <ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Delete profile" onConfirm={() => remove(p)}>Delete</ConfirmButton>}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </Panel>
      <Panel title="Built-in curves" subtitle="Always available; not editable. Copy one to start a custom profile." pad={false}>
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Shape</th><th>Curve</th><th>Used by</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {BUILT_IN_PROFILES.map((b) => (
                <tr key={b.id}>
                  <td><Shape weights={previewShares(s, b.id, sample)} w={96} h={28} labels={sample} /></td>
                  <td><div className="font-semibold">{b.name} <Badge>Built-in</Badge></div><div className="text-[12px] text-muted">{b.description}</div></td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px] text-muted">{useText(b.id)}</td>
                  <td className="text-right"><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit({ id: uid('prof'), name: `${b.name} (custom)`, description: b.description, weights: previewShares(s, b.id, sample).map((x) => Math.round(x * 1000) / 10) })}>Copy to custom</Button></td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </Panel>
      {edit && <ProfileEditor profile={edit} isNew={!s.settings.spreadProfiles.some((x) => x.id === edit.id)} used={!!usage[edit.id]} onClose={() => setEdit(null)} onSave={save} />}
    </div>
  )
}

function ProfileEditor({ profile, isNew, used, onClose, onSave }: { profile: SpreadProfile; isNew: boolean; used: boolean; onClose: () => void; onSave: (p: SpreadProfile, isNew: boolean) => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [p, setP] = useState<SpreadProfile>(profile)
  const [txt, setTxt] = useState(profile.weights.join(', '))
  const [n, setN] = useState('12')
  const [startM, setStartM] = useState(monthKey(addMonths(s.settings.asOf, 1)))
  const setWeights = (w: number[]) => { setP({ ...p, weights: w }); setTxt(w.join(', ')) }
  const onTxt = (t: string) => { setTxt(t); const w = parseWeights(t); if (w) setP({ ...p, weights: w }) }
  const valid = !!parseWeights(txt) && sum(p.weights) > 0
  const months = monthRange(startM, monthKey(addMonths(startM + '-01', Number(n) - 1)))
  const shares = valid ? previewShares(s, p, months) : months.map(() => 0)
  const starts = monthRange(monthKey(addMonths(s.settings.asOf, -2)), monthKey(addMonths(s.settings.asOf, 14)))
  const submit = () => {
    if (!p.name.trim()) { toast('Name the profile', 'bad'); return }
    if (!valid) { toast('Weights must be numbers ≥ 0 with at least one above zero', 'bad'); return }
    if (p.zeroMonths?.length === 12) { toast('At least one month must allow spend', 'bad'); return }
    onSave({ ...p, name: p.name.trim(), description: p.description.trim(), zeroMonths: p.zeroMonths?.length ? [...p.zeroMonths].sort((a, b) => a - b) : undefined }, isNew)
  }
  const toggleMonth = (m: number) => { const z = p.zeroMonths ?? []; setP({ ...p, zeroMonths: z.includes(m) ? z.filter((x) => x !== m) : [...z, m] }) }
  return (
    <Modal open wide onClose={onClose} title={isNew ? 'New spread profile' : `Edit “${profile.name}”`}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={!valid} onClick={submit}>{isNew ? 'Add profile' : 'Save profile'}</Button></>}>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">
          <Field label="Name"><Input value={p.name} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. Pipe delivery in two lots" /></Field>
          <Field label="Description"><Input value={p.description} onChange={(e) => setP({ ...p, description: e.target.value })} placeholder="When to use it" /></Field>
          <Field label="Weights" hint="Comma-separated relative amounts, first month to last. Any number of points; they are stretched to the window.">
            <Input className={cx('font-mono', !parseWeights(txt) && 'border-bad')} value={txt} onChange={(e) => onTxt(e.target.value)} />
          </Field>
          <div>
            <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between"><span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">Shape — click or drag a bar to set it</span>
              <span className="flex gap-1">
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setWeights([...p.weights, p.weights[p.weights.length - 1] ?? 1])}>+ point</Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={p.weights.length <= 1} onClick={() => setWeights(p.weights.slice(0, -1))}>− point</Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={!valid} onClick={() => { const W = sum(p.weights); setWeights(p.weights.map((x) => Math.round((x / W) * 1000) / 10)) }} title="Scale the weights to add up to 100">To 100</Button>
              </span>
            </div>
            <BarEditor weights={p.weights} onChange={setWeights} />
          </div>
          <Field label="Black-out months" hint={p.zeroMonths?.length ? `No spend in ${p.zeroMonths.map((m) => MONTHS[m - 1]).join(', ')}; their share goes to the other months` : 'Calendar months with no spend, e.g. a holiday paving moratorium'}>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-1 sm:grid-cols-12">
              {MONTHS.map((m, i) => { const on = p.zeroMonths?.includes(i + 1); return <button key={m} type="button" aria-pressed={!!on} onClick={() => toggleMonth(i + 1)} className={cx('rounded border py-1 text-[11.5px] font-semibold', on ? 'border-bad/50 bg-bad/10 text-bad' : 'border-line text-muted hover:border-ink/40 hover:text-ink')}>{m}</button> })}
            </div>
          </Field>
          {used && <Callout tone="info">Forecast versions already use this profile. Saving changes how it phases the next time someone applies it; spreads already applied are not changed.</Callout>}
        </div>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="eyebrow">Live preview</span>
            <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Select aria-label="Preview start" className="h-8 w-auto py-1" value={startM} onChange={(e) => setStartM(e.target.value)} options={starts.map((m) => ({ value: m, label: `from ${MONTHS[Number(m.slice(5)) - 1]} ${m.slice(0, 4)}` }))} />
              <SegButtons value={n} onChange={setN} options={['6', '12', '18', '24'].map((x) => ({ id: x, label: `${x} mo` }))} />
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-md border border-line p-2">
            <BarChart labels={months.map((m) => `${MONTHS[Number(m.slice(5)) - 1]} ’${m.slice(2, 4)}`)} series={[{ name: 'Share of the function’s ETC', values: shares.map((x) => Math.round(x * 1000) / 10) }]} height={220} format={(v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}%`} />
          </div>
          <div className="scroll-x">
            <table className="tbl [&_td]:py-0.5 [&_th]:py-1">
              <thead><tr><th>Month</th><th className="num">Share</th><th className="num">Of $1,000,000</th><th className="num">Cumulative</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{(() => { let acc = 0; return months.map((m, i) => { acc += shares[i]; return <tr key={m} className={cx(!shares[i] && 'text-faint')}><td>{MONTHS[Number(m.slice(5)) - 1]} {m.slice(0, 4)}{!shares[i] && p.zeroMonths?.includes(Number(m.slice(5))) ? ' · black-out' : ''}</td><td className="num">{(shares[i] * 100).toFixed(1)}%</td><td className="num">${Math.round(shares[i] * 1_000_000).toLocaleString('en-US')}</td><td className="num text-muted">{(acc * 100).toFixed(0)}%</td></tr> }) })()}</tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

/** Drag-to-set bar editor for a weight shape. */
function BarEditor({ weights, onChange }: { weights: number[]; onChange: (w: number[]) => void }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState(false)
  const top = Math.max(1, ...weights) * 1.25
  const set = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(weights.length - 1, Math.floor(((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * weights.length)))
    const v = Math.max(0, Math.round((1 - (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * top * 10) / 10)
    if (weights[i] === v) return
    onChange(weights.map((x, j) => (j === i ? v : x)))
  }
  return (
    <div ref={ref} role="group" aria-label="Weight bars" className="flex h-28 cursor-crosshair touch-none select-none items-end gap-px rounded border border-line bg-sunken/50 p-1"
      onPointerDown={(e) => { setDrag(true); (e.target as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId); set(e) }} onPointerMove={(e) => drag && set(e)} onPointerUp={() => setDrag(false)} onPointerLeave={() => setDrag(false)}>
      {weights.map((w, i) => <div key={i} title={`Point ${i + 1}: ${w}`} className={cx('flex-1 rounded-sm', w > 0 ? 'bg-link/70' : 'h-[2px] bg-bad/60')} style={w > 0 ? { height: `${(w / top) * 100}%` } : undefined} />)}
    </div>
  )
}
