// Lifecycle template editor (SG-01..03): stages, gates, deliverables and their conditions.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { AaceClass, DeliverableDef, DeliverableKind, LifecycleTemplate, RoleId } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { ensureDeliverables } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { cx, describeCondition, evalCondition, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, ConfirmButton, Drawer, Empty, Field, Input, Panel, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'
import { ConditionEditor, MultiCheck, PERMISSIONS, RoleSelect, clone, roleName, useDraft } from './common'

const KINDS: DeliverableKind[] = ['document', 'estimate', 'risk-register', 'safety-plan', 'schedule', 'checklist', 'permit', 'records']

export default function Templates() {
  const templates = useStore((s) => s.templates)
  const programs = useStore((s) => s.programs)
  const [sel, setSel] = useState(templates[0]?.id)
  const tpl = templates.find((t) => t.id === sel) ?? templates[0]
  const duplicate = () => {
    if (!tpl) return
    const copy: LifecycleTemplate = clone(tpl)
    const suffix = uid('x').slice(-4)
    copy.id = uid('tpl')
    copy.name = `${tpl.name} (copy)`
    copy.stages.forEach((st) => { st.id = `${st.id}-${suffix}`; st.gate.id = `${st.gate.id}-${suffix}`; st.gate.deliverables.forEach((d) => { d.id = `${d.id}-${suffix}` }) })
    mutate((d) => { d.templates.push(copy) }, { entity: 'template', entityId: copy.id, action: 'create', summary: `Duplicated lifecycle template "${tpl.name}" as "${copy.name}"` })
    setSel(copy.id)
    toast('Template duplicated')
  }
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[260px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <div className="eyebrow px-1">Templates</div>
        {templates.map((t) => {
          const using = programs.filter((p) => p.lifecycleTemplateId === t.id)
          return (
            <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setSel(t.id)} className={cx('rounded-md border px-3 py-2.5 text-left', t.id === tpl?.id ? 'border-ink bg-surface shadow-sm' : 'border-line bg-surface hover:border-ink/40')}>
              <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold leading-snug">{t.name}</div>
              <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-muted">
                <span>{t.stages.length} stages · {t.stages.reduce((a, st) => a + st.gate.deliverables.length, 0)} deliverables</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1">{using.length ? using.map((p) => <ProgramTag key={p.id} programId={p.id} />) : <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">Not assigned to a program</span>}</div>
            </button>
          )
        })}
        <Button size="sm" onClick={duplicate}>Duplicate selected template</Button>
        <p className="px-1 text-[11px] text-faint">Duplicate a template to tailor it for a new program, then assign it on the Programs tab.</p>
      </div>
      {tpl ? <TemplateEditor key={tpl.id} tpl={tpl} onDeleted={() => setSel(templates[0]?.id)} /> : <Empty title="No templates" />}
    </div>
  )
}

function TemplateEditor({ tpl, onDeleted }: { tpl: LifecycleTemplate; onDeleted: () => void }) {
  const programs = useStore((s) => s.programs)
  const allProjects = useStore((s) => s.projects)
  const roles = useStore((s) => s.roles)
  const [draft, setDraft, dirty, discard] = useDraft(tpl)
  const [stageIdx, setStageIdx] = useState(0)
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<{ def: DeliverableDef; isNew: boolean } | null>(null)
  const using = programs.filter((p) => p.lifecycleTemplateId === tpl.id)
  const projects = useMemo(() => allProjects.filter((p) => using.some((u) => u.id === p.programId)), [allProjects, using])
  const st = draft.stages[stageIdx] ?? draft.stages[0]
  const atStage = projects.filter((p) => p.stageIndex === stageIdx && p.status === 'active')

  const setStage = (fn: (s: typeof st) => void) => setDraft((d) => { const n = clone(d); fn(n.stages[stageIdx]); return n })
  const moveDel = (i: number, dir: -1 | 1) => setStage((s) => { const a = s.gate.deliverables; const j = i + dir; if (j < 0 || j >= a.length) return; [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]] })
  const removeDel = (i: number) => setStage((s) => { s.gate.deliverables.splice(i, 1) })

  const save = () => {
    const changes = diffTemplate(tpl, draft)
    let created = 0
    mutate((d) => {
      const i = d.templates.findIndex((t) => t.id === tpl.id)
      d.templates[i] = clone(draft)
      const before = d.deliverables.length
      for (const p of d.projects) if (p.status === 'active' && using.some((u) => u.id === p.programId)) ensureDeliverables(d, p)
      created = d.deliverables.length - before
    }, { entity: 'template', entityId: tpl.id, action: 'update', summary: `Updated lifecycle template "${draft.name}": ${changes.join('; ') || 'no field changes'}` })
    toast(created ? `Template saved · ${created} new deliverable${created > 1 ? 's' : ''} assigned to active projects` : 'Template saved')
  }
  const remove = () => {
    mutate((d) => { d.templates = d.templates.filter((t) => t.id !== tpl.id) }, { entity: 'template', entityId: tpl.id, action: 'delete', summary: `Deleted unused lifecycle template "${tpl.name}"` })
    toast('Template deleted')
    onDeleted()
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
      {dirty && (
        <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-md border border-marker bg-marker/10 px-3 py-2">
          <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold">Unsaved changes to this template</span>
          <span className="flex gap-2"><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={discard}>Discard</Button><Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save changes</Button></span>
        </div>
      )}
      <Panel title="Template" subtitle={`${draft.stages.length} stages · used by ${using.length ? using.map((u) => u.code).join(', ') : 'no programs'} · ${projects.length} projects`}
        actions={using.length === 0 ? <ConfirmButton size="sm" confirmLabel="Delete template" onConfirm={remove}>Delete</ConfirmButton> : undefined}>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Template name"><Input value={draft.name} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, name: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Description"><Input value={draft.description} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, description: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        </div>
      </Panel>

      <div className="scroll-x">
        <ol className="flex min-w-max gap-1">
          {draft.stages.map((x, i) => (
            <li key={x.id}>
              <button onClick={() => setStageIdx(i)} className={cx('flex w-[190px] flex-col rounded-md border px-3 py-2 text-left', i === stageIdx ? 'border-marker bg-marker/10' : 'border-line bg-surface hover:border-ink/40')}>
                <span className="eyebrow">Stage {i + 1}</span>
                <span className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold">{x.name}</span>
                <span className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted">{x.gate.name} · {x.gate.deliverables.length} deliverables</span>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <Panel title={`Stage ${stageIdx + 1}`} subtitle={`${atStage.length} active project${atStage.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} in this stage`}>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <Field label="Stage name"><Input value={st.name} onChange={(e) => setStage((s) => { s.name = e.target.value })} /></Field>
            <Field label="Purpose"><TextArea rows={2} value={st.purpose} onChange={(e) => setStage((s) => { s.purpose = e.target.value })} /></Field>
          </div>
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Gate at end of stage" subtitle="Who decides, what the estimate must reach, and what passing unlocks">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <Field label="Gate name"><Input value={st.gate.name} onChange={(e) => setStage((s) => { s.gate.name = e.target.value })} /></Field>
            <Field label="Decision roles"><MultiCheck options={roles.filter((r) => ['sponsor', 'exec', 'gate-board', 'program-manager', 'pmo', 'finance'].includes(r.id) || st.gate.decisionRoles.includes(r.id)).map((r) => ({ id: r.id, label: r.name }))} value={st.gate.decisionRoles} onChange={(v) => setStage((s) => { s.gate.decisionRoles = v as RoleId[] })} /></Field>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="Required estimate class" hint="Approved estimate must reach this class or better">
                <Select value={String(st.gate.requiredEstimateClass ?? '')} onChange={(e) => setStage((s) => { s.gate.requiredEstimateClass = e.target.value ? (Number(e.target.value) as AaceClass) : undefined })}
                  options={[{ value: '', label: 'No estimate requirement' }, ...[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((c) => ({ value: String(c), label: `Class ${c}` }))]} />
              </Field>
              <Field label="Budget event on Go" hint="Converts the approved estimate into a budget">
                <Select value={st.gate.budgetEvent ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setStage((s) => { s.gate.budgetEvent = (e.target.value || undefined) as 'planning' | 'control' | undefined })}
                  options={[{ value: '', label: 'None' }, { value: 'planning', label: 'Planning budget' }, { value: 'control', label: 'Control budget + baselines' }]} />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <Field label="Unlocks when passed"><MultiCheck options={PERMISSIONS} value={st.gate.unlocks} onChange={(v) => setStage((s) => { s.gate.unlocks = v })} /></Field>
          </div>
        </Panel>
      </div>

      <Panel title="Required deliverables" subtitle={`${st.gate.deliverables.length} defined · conditional items apply only to matching projects`} pad={false}
        actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setEditing({ isNew: true, def: { id: uid('d'), name: '', description: '', kind: 'document', ownerRole: 'pm', reviewerRole: 'pmo', acceptance: '' } })}>Add deliverable</Button>}>
        {st.gate.deliverables.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No deliverables">Add the documents and records this gate must see.</Empty></div> : (
          <div className="scroll-x">
            <table className="tbl">
              <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 36 }}>#</th><th>Deliverable</th><th>Kind</th><th>Owner → reviewer</th><th>Applies when</th><th className="num">Projects</th><th style={{ width: 150 }} /></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {st.gate.deliverables.map((d, i) => {
                  const hits = projects.filter((p) => evalCondition(d.condition, p)).length
                  return (
                    <tr key={d.id}>
                      <td className="tabular-nums text-faint">{i + 1}</td>
                      <td className="min-w-[220px]"><button className="text-left font-semibold hover:text-link" onClick={() => setEditing({ def: clone(d), isNew: false })}>{d.name || <span className="text-faint">Untitled</span>}</button><div className="text-[12px] text-muted">{d.acceptance && <>Accept: {d.acceptance}</>}</div></td>
                      <td><Badge>{d.kind}</Badge></td>
                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{roleName(roles, d.ownerRole)} → {roleName(roles, d.reviewerRole)}</td>
                      <td>{d.condition ? <Badge tone="info">{describeCondition(d.condition)}</Badge> : <span className="text-[12px] text-faint">Always</span>}</td>
                      <td className="num">{hits}/{projects.length}</td>
                      <td>
                        <span className="flex justify-end gap-0.5">
                          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label="Move up" disabled={i === 0} onClick={() => moveDel(i, -1)}>↑</Button>
                          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label="Move down" disabled={i === st.gate.deliverables.length - 1} onClick={() => moveDel(i, 1)}>↓</Button>
                          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEditing({ def: clone(d), isNew: false })}>Edit</Button>
                          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={() => removeDel(i)}>Remove</Button>
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-2.5 text-[12px] text-muted">Saving adds newly required deliverables to active projects at their current stage. Existing deliverable records and past gate decisions are never changed.</div>
      </Panel>

      <DeliverableDrawer editing={editing} projects={projects} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} onSave={(def) => {
        setStage((s) => { const i = s.gate.deliverables.findIndex((x) => x.id === def.id); if (i >= 0) s.gate.deliverables[i] = def; else s.gate.deliverables.push(def) })
        setEditing(null)
        toast('Deliverable updated — save the template to publish', 'info')
      }} />
    </div>
  )
}

function DeliverableDrawer({ editing, projects, onClose, onSave }: { editing: { def: DeliverableDef; isNew: boolean } | null; projects: ReturnType<typeof useStore.getState>['projects']; onClose: () => void; onSave: (d: DeliverableDef) => void }) {
  const [d, setD] = useDraft<DeliverableDef | null>(editing?.def ?? null)
  if (!editing || !d) return null
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} title={editing.isNew ? 'Add deliverable' : 'Edit deliverable'} width={600}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={!d.name.trim()} onClick={() => onSave(d)}>{editing.isNew ? 'Add to gate' : 'Apply'}</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <Field label="Name"><Input value={d.name} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. Traffic management plan" /></Field>
        <Field label="Description"><TextArea rows={2} value={d.description} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, description: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <Field label="Kind"><Select value={d.kind} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, kind: e.target.value as DeliverableKind })} options={KINDS} /></Field>
          <Field label="Owner role"><RoleSelect value={d.ownerRole} onChange={(r) => setD({ ...d, ownerRole: r })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Reviewer role"><RoleSelect value={d.reviewerRole} onChange={(r) => setD({ ...d, reviewerRole: r })} /></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Acceptance criteria" hint="Shown to the reviewer when the deliverable is submitted"><TextArea rows={2} value={d.acceptance} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, acceptance: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <ConditionEditor value={d.condition} onChange={(c) => setD({ ...d, condition: c })} projects={projects} />
        {d.ownerRole === d.reviewerRole && <Callout tone="warn">Owner and reviewer are the same role. Separation of duties is stronger when a different role reviews.</Callout>}
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

function diffTemplate(a: LifecycleTemplate, b: LifecycleTemplate): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  if (a.name !== b.name) out.push(`renamed to "${b.name}"`)
  if (a.description !== b.description) out.push('description edited')
  b.stages.forEach((sb, i) => {
    const sa = a.stages[i]
    if (!sa) return
    const parts: string[] = []
    if (sa.name !== sb.name) parts.push('name')
    if (sa.purpose !== sb.purpose) parts.push('purpose')
    if (sa.gate.name !== sb.gate.name) parts.push('gate name')
    if (JSON.stringify(sa.gate.decisionRoles) !== JSON.stringify(sb.gate.decisionRoles)) parts.push(`decision roles → ${sb.gate.decisionRoles.join(', ')}`)
    if (sa.gate.requiredEstimateClass !== sb.gate.requiredEstimateClass) parts.push(`estimate class → ${sb.gate.requiredEstimateClass ? 'Class ' + sb.gate.requiredEstimateClass : 'none'}`)
    if (sa.gate.budgetEvent !== sb.gate.budgetEvent) parts.push(`budget event → ${sb.gate.budgetEvent ?? 'none'}`)
    if (JSON.stringify(sa.gate.unlocks) !== JSON.stringify(sb.gate.unlocks)) parts.push(`unlocks → ${sb.gate.unlocks.join(', ') || 'none'}`)
    const ida = sa.gate.deliverables.map((x) => x.id), idb = sb.gate.deliverables.map((x) => x.id)
    const added = sb.gate.deliverables.filter((x) => !ida.includes(x.id)).map((x) => x.name)
    const removed = sa.gate.deliverables.filter((x) => !idb.includes(x.id)).map((x) => x.name)
    const edited = sb.gate.deliverables.filter((x) => { const o = sa.gate.deliverables.find((y) => y.id === x.id); return o && JSON.stringify(o) !== JSON.stringify(x) }).map((x) => x.name)
    if (added.length) parts.push(`added ${added.join(', ')}`)
    if (removed.length) parts.push(`removed ${removed.join(', ')}`)
    if (edited.length) parts.push(`edited ${edited.join(', ')}`)
    if (!added.length && !removed.length && ida.filter((x) => idb.includes(x)).join() !== idb.filter((x) => ida.includes(x)).join()) parts.push('deliverables reordered')
    if (parts.length) out.push(`Stage ${i + 1} ${sb.name}: ${parts.join(', ')}`)
  })
  return out
}

// Configuration: the WBS functions the forecast is spread against, and which cost categories roll up to each.
// Loaders, escalation and contingency are system categories allocated pro-rata (contingency held separately).
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { WbsFunction } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { CONT_CAT, ESC_CAT } from '@/core/engine/estimates'
import { cx, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, ConfirmButton, Input, Panel, Select } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { useDraft } from './common'

const SYSTEM = [ESC_CAT, CONT_CAT] // overhead (cat-loaders) is assignable, e.g. to 900 Project Overhead
const TIMING: { value: WbsFunction['timing']; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'early', label: 'Early (front-loaded)' },
  { value: 'mid', label: 'Mid (S-curve)' },
  { value: 'late', label: 'Late (back-loaded)' },
  { value: 'flat', label: 'Flat (even)' },
]

/** Validation of a WBS configuration against the cost categories. */
export function wbsIssues(fns: WbsFunction[], cats: { id: string; code: string; name: string }[]) {
  const direct = cats.filter((c) => !SYSTEM.includes(c.id))
  const owners = (id: string) => fns.filter((f) => f.categoryIds.includes(id))
  return {
    unmapped: direct.filter((c) => owners(c.id).length === 0),
    multi: direct.filter((c) => owners(c.id).length > 1),
    dupCodes: fns.filter((f, i) => fns.findIndex((x) => x.code.trim() === f.code.trim()) !== i).map((f) => f.code),
    blank: fns.filter((f) => !f.code.trim() || !f.name.trim()),
  }
}

export default function WbsFunctions(_props: { projectId?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [fns, setFns, dirty, discard] = useDraft(s.settings.wbsFunctions)
  const [mapView, setMapView] = useState<'by-category' | 'by-function'>('by-category')
  const direct = s.categories.filter((c) => !SYSTEM.includes(c.id))
  const system = s.categories.filter((c) => SYSTEM.includes(c.id))
  const issues = wbsIssues(fns, s.categories)
  const used = useMemo(() => {
    const out: Record<string, { forecasts: number; actuals: number }> = {}
    for (const f of s.forecasts) for (const [id, row] of Object.entries(f.spread ?? {})) if (Object.values(row).some(Boolean)) (out[id] ||= { forecasts: 0, actuals: 0 }).forecasts++
    for (const c of s.costPeriods) for (const id of Object.keys(c.byFunction ?? {})) (out[id] ||= { forecasts: 0, actuals: 0 }).actuals++
    return out
  }, [s.forecasts, s.costPeriods])

  const set = (i: number, patch: Partial<WbsFunction>) => setFns(fns.map((f, j) => (j === i ? { ...f, ...patch } : f)))
  const mapCat = (catId: string, fnId: string) => setFns(fns.map((f) => ({ ...f, categoryIds: f.id === fnId ? Array.from(new Set([...f.categoryIds, catId])) : f.categoryIds.filter((x) => x !== catId) })))
  const add = () => {
    const next = String(Math.max(0, ...fns.map((f) => Number(f.code) || 0)) + 1).padStart(2, '0')
    setFns([...fns, { id: uid('wbs'), code: next, name: 'New function', description: '', categoryIds: [], timing: 'mid' }])
  }
  const remove = (i: number) => setFns(fns.filter((_, j) => j !== i))
  const move = (i: number, d: -1 | 1) => { const j = i + d; if (j < 0 || j >= fns.length) return; const n = fns.slice(); [n[i], n[j]] = [n[j], n[i]]; setFns(n) }

  const save = () => {
    if (issues.blank.length) { toast('Every function needs a code and a name', 'bad'); return }
    if (issues.dupCodes.length) { toast(`Duplicate code ${issues.dupCodes[0]}`, 'bad'); return }
    if (issues.multi.length) { toast(`${issues.multi[0].name} is mapped to more than one function`, 'bad'); return }
    const before = s.settings.wbsFunctions
    const added = fns.filter((f) => !before.some((x) => x.id === f.id)).map((f) => `${f.code} ${f.name}`)
    const removed = before.filter((f) => !fns.some((x) => x.id === f.id)).map((f) => `${f.code} ${f.name}`)
    const edited = fns.filter((f) => { const o = before.find((x) => x.id === f.id); return o && JSON.stringify({ ...o, categoryIds: [] }) !== JSON.stringify({ ...f, categoryIds: [] }) }).map((f) => f.code)
    const remapped = direct.filter((c) => before.find((f) => f.categoryIds.includes(c.id))?.id !== fns.find((f) => f.categoryIds.includes(c.id))?.id).map((c) => `${c.code} → ${fns.find((f) => f.categoryIds.includes(c.id))?.code ?? 'unmapped'}`)
    mutate((d) => { d.settings.wbsFunctions = fns.map((f) => ({ ...f, code: f.code.trim(), name: f.name.trim() })) },
      { entity: 'wbs', entityId: 'wbs-functions', action: 'update', summary: `WBS functions updated${added.length ? ` · added ${added.join(', ')}` : ''}${removed.length ? ` · removed ${removed.join(', ')}` : ''}${edited.length ? ` · edited ${edited.join(', ')}` : ''}${remapped.length ? ` · remapped ${remapped.join(', ')}` : ''}${issues.unmapped.length ? ` · ${issues.unmapped.length} categories left unmapped` : ''}` })
    toast(issues.unmapped.length ? `WBS saved — ${issues.unmapped.length} categories still unmapped` : 'WBS functions saved', issues.unmapped.length ? 'bad' : 'good')
  }

  const removedWithHistory = s.settings.wbsFunctions.filter((f) => !fns.some((x) => x.id === f.id) && (used[f.id]?.forecasts || used[f.id]?.actuals))

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Panel title="WBS functions" pad={false}
        subtitle={`The standard work breakdown every project's forecast is spread against (${fns.length} functions). Typical timing sets the curve used when a helper fills a row; people can always type over it.`}
        actions={<>
          {dirty && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={discard}>Discard</Button>}
          <Button size="sm" onClick={add}>Add function</Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={save}>Save WBS</Button>
        </>}>
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 70 }}>Code</th><th style={{ minWidth: 200 }}>Function</th><th style={{ minWidth: 240 }}>Description</th><th style={{ width: 170 }}>Typical timing</th><th>Cost categories</th><th className="num">In use</th><th style={{ width: 120 }} /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {fns.map((f, i) => {
                const u = used[f.id]
                const isNew = !s.settings.wbsFunctions.some((x) => x.id === f.id)
                return (
                  <tr key={f.id}>
                    <td><Input aria-label="Code" className={cx('h-7 py-0.5 font-mono', issues.dupCodes.includes(f.code) && 'border-bad')} value={f.code} onChange={(e) => set(i, { code: e.target.value })} /></td>
                    <td><div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Input aria-label="Name" className={cx('h-7 py-0.5', !f.name.trim() && 'border-bad')} value={f.name} onChange={(e) => set(i, { name: e.target.value })} />{isNew && <Badge tone="info">New</Badge>}</div></td>
                    <td><Input aria-label="Description" className="h-7 py-0.5" value={f.description} onChange={(e) => set(i, { description: e.target.value })} /></td>
                    <td><Select aria-label="Typical timing" className="h-7 py-0.5" value={f.timing} onChange={(e) => set(i, { timing: e.target.value as WbsFunction['timing'] })} options={TIMING} /></td>
                    <td><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">{f.categoryIds.length ? f.categoryIds.map((id) => { const c = s.categories.find((x) => x.id === id); return <Badge key={id} tone="neutral"><span className="font-mono">{c?.code ?? '?'}</span> {c?.name ?? id}</Badge> }) : <span className="text-[12px] text-faint">None mapped</span>}</div></td>
                    <td className="num text-[12px] text-muted">{u ? `${u.forecasts} fcst · ${u.actuals} periods` : '—'}</td>
                    <td>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-0.5">
                        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label="Move up" disabled={i === 0} onClick={() => move(i, -1)}>↑</Button>
                        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label="Move down" disabled={i === fns.length - 1} onClick={() => move(i, 1)}>↓</Button>
                        {u ? <ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Remove" onConfirm={() => remove(i)}>Remove</ConfirmButton> : <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={() => remove(i)}>Remove</Button>}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        {removedWithHistory.length > 0 && (
          <div className="border-t border-line p-3">
            <Callout tone="warn" title="Removing functions with history">
              {removedWithHistory.map((f) => `${f.code} ${f.name}`).join(', ')} {removedWithHistory.length === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} used by existing forecasts or actuals splits. Historic forecasts keep their stored spread (shown as a retired function); new versions and roll-ups by function will no longer include it, and its categories become unmapped until you move them.
            </Callout>
          </div>
        )}
      </Panel>

      <Panel title="Cost category mapping" pad={false}
        subtitle="Every direct cost category rolls up to exactly one function. Budgets and actuals are split to functions through this map."
        actions={<div className="inline-flex rounded border border-line bg-sunken p-0.5">
          {(['by-category', 'by-function'] as const).map((v) => <button key={v} onClick={() => setMapView(v)} className={cx('rounded-sm px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold', mapView === v ? 'bg-surface text-ink shadow-sm' : 'text-muted hover:text-ink')}>{v === 'by-category' ? 'By category' : 'Matrix'}</button>)}
        </div>}>
        {(issues.unmapped.length > 0 || issues.multi.length > 0) && (
          <div className="border-b border-line p-3">
            <Callout tone={issues.multi.length ? 'bad' : 'warn'} title={issues.multi.length ? 'Categories mapped twice' : `${issues.unmapped.length} unmapped categor${issues.unmapped.length === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'}`}>
              {issues.multi.length > 0 && <div>{issues.multi.map((c) => `${c.code} ${c.name}`).join(', ')} — pick one function each.</div>}
              {issues.unmapped.length > 0 && <div>{issues.unmapped.map((c) => `${c.code} ${c.name}`).join(', ')} — budget and actuals in {issues.unmapped.length === 1 ? 'this category' : 'these categories'} are left out of the function split until mapped.</div>}
            </Callout>
          </div>
        )}
        {mapView === 'by-category' ? (
          <div className="scroll-x">
            <table className="tbl">
              <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 80 }}>Code</th><th>Cost category</th><th style={{ width: 140 }}>ERP element</th><th style={{ minWidth: 260 }}>Rolls up to</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {direct.map((c) => {
                  const owners = fns.filter((f) => f.categoryIds.includes(c.id))
                  return (
                    <tr key={c.id}>
                      <td className="font-mono text-[12px]">{c.code}</td>
                      <td>{c.name}</td>
                      <td className="font-mono text-[12px] text-muted">{c.erpCostElement}</td>
                      <td>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Select aria-label={`Function for ${c.name}`} className={cx('h-7 py-0.5', !owners.length && 'border-warn', owners.length > 1 && 'border-bad')} value={owners[0]?.id ?? ''} onChange={(e) => mapCat(c.id, e.target.value)}
                            options={[{ value: '', label: '— Unmapped —' }, ...fns.map((f) => ({ value: f.id, label: `${f.code} ${f.name}` }))]} />
                          {!owners.length && <Badge tone="warn">Unmapped</Badge>}
                          {owners.length > 1 && <Badge tone="bad">{owners.length} functions</Badge>}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                })}
                {system.map((c) => (
                  <tr key={c.id} className="text-muted">
                    <td className="font-mono text-[12px]">{c.code}</td>
                    <td>{c.name} <Badge tone="info">System</Badge></td>
                    <td className="font-mono text-[12px]">{c.erpCostElement}</td>
                    <td className="text-[12px]">{c.id === CONT_CAT ? 'Held separately as “Contingency held” in the forecast' : 'Allocated to every function pro-rata to its direct cost'}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="scroll-x">
            <table className="tbl">
              <thead><tr><th className="sticky left-0 z-[2] bg-sunken">Category</th>{fns.map((f) => <th key={f.id} className="text-center" title={f.name}>{f.code}</th>)}</tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {direct.map((c) => (
                  <tr key={c.id}>
                    <td className="sticky left-0 z-[1] whitespace-nowrap bg-surface"><span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">{c.code}</span> {c.name}</td>
                    {fns.map((f) => {
                      const on = f.categoryIds.includes(c.id)
                      return <td key={f.id} className="text-center"><input type="radio" name={`map-${c.id}`} aria-label={`${c.name} → ${f.name}`} className="h-4 w-4 accent-[rgb(var(--ink))]" checked={on} onChange={() => mapCat(c.id, f.id)} /></td>
                    })}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-2 text-[11.5px] text-muted">{fns.map((f) => `${f.code} ${f.name}`).join(' · ')}</div>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-2 text-[12px] text-muted">Changes apply to budgets, actuals and new forecast versions from now on. Approved and submitted forecasts keep the spread they were approved with.{dirty && <b className="ml-1 text-ink">Unsaved changes.</b>}</div>
      </Panel>
    </div>
  )
}

// Configuration → Workflow notifications: reminder and escalation timing, delivery channels, open escalations.
// The reminder engine (core/engine/notify.ts) runs when Crosswalk opens and from "Send reminders now".
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, personName, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { openEscalations, planReminders, runReminders, workflowNotifySettings } from '@/core/engine/notify'
import { daysBetween, fmtDate, fmtDateTime } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Checkbox, Field, Input, Panel, Stat, Table } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'

/** Send every reminder that is due now; shared by this tab and the Workflows page. */
export function sendRemindersNow() {
  let r: ReturnType<typeof runReminders> | undefined
  mutate((d) => { r = runReminders(d) })
  const n = r!.reminders + r!.overdue + r!.escalations
  toast(n ? `Sent ${r!.reminders + r!.overdue} reminder${r!.reminders + r!.overdue === 1 ? '' : 's'} and ${r!.escalations} escalation${r!.escalations === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : 'Nothing due — every reminder has already been sent', n ? 'good' : 'info')
}

export default function WorkflowSettings() {
  const s = useStore()
  const cur = workflowNotifySettings(s)
  const [rem, setRem] = useState(String(cur.reminderDays))
  const [esc, setEsc] = useState(String(cur.escalateAfterDays))
  const draft = { reminderDays: Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(rem) || 0)), escalateAfterDays: Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(esc) || 0)) }
  const dirty = draft.reminderDays !== cur.reminderDays || draft.escalateAfterDays !== cur.escalateAfterDays
  const preview = useMemo(() => planReminders({ ...s, settings: { ...s.settings, workflow: draft } } as AppState), [s.workflows, s.people, draft.reminderDays, draft.escalateAfterDays]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const count = (k: string) => preview.filter((x) => x.kind === k).length
  const escalations = openEscalations(s)
  const log = s.notifications.filter((n) => n.kind === 'reminder' || n.kind === 'escalation').slice().reverse()
  const save = () => {
    mutate((d) => { d.settings.workflow = { ...draft } }, { entity: 'settings', entityId: 'workflow', action: 'update', summary: `Workflow reminders ${draft.reminderDays} day(s) before due; escalate to manager ${draft.escalateAfterDays ? `${draft.escalateAfterDays} day(s) overdue` : 'off'}` })
    toast('Reminder settings saved')
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Panel title="Reminders and escalation" subtitle="Applies to every workflow step that has an SLA. Each step is reminded and escalated once."
          actions={<>{dirty && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { setRem(String(cur.reminderDays)); setEsc(String(cur.escalateAfterDays)) }}>Discard</Button>}<Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={save}>Save</Button></>}>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="Remind the assignee" hint="Days before the step is due (0 = on the due date). An overdue notice follows the day after it lapses.">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Input id="wf-reminder-days" type="number" min={0} max={30} className="w-24 tabular-nums" value={rem} onChange={(e) => setRem(e.target.value)} /><span className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">days before due</span></div>
              </Field>
              <Field label="Escalate to the assignee's manager" hint="Days overdue before the manager is told (0 = never). Recorded in the workflow history.">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Input id="wf-escalate-days" type="number" min={0} max={60} className="w-24 tabular-nums" value={esc} onChange={(e) => setEsc(e.target.value)} /><span className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">days overdue</span></div>
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken/40 px-3 py-2.5 text-[12.5px]">
              <div className="mb-1 font-semibold">{dirty ? 'With these settings, a run today would send' : `Next run as of ${fmtDate(s.settings.asOf)} will send`}</div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-muted"><span><b className="tabular-nums text-ink">{count('reminder')}</b> due-soon reminders</span><span><b className="tabular-nums text-ink">{count('overdue')}</b> overdue notices</span><span><b className="tabular-nums text-ink">{count('escalation')}</b> escalations</span></div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Button variant="primary" disabled={dirty} onClick={sendRemindersNow}>Send reminders now</Button>
              <span className="text-[12px] text-faint">{dirty ? 'Save first.' : 'Also runs automatically each time Crosswalk opens.'}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Delivery" subtitle="Where reminders, escalations and messages reach people">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <Checkbox checked disabled onChange={() => undefined} label={<span><b>In Crosswalk</b> — My work, the notification bell and Messages</span>} />
            <div>
              <Checkbox checked={false} disabled onChange={() => undefined} label={<span><b>Email via Outlook</b> <Badge>Needs backend integration</Badge></span>} />
              <p className="ml-6 mt-1 text-[12px] text-muted">Email delivery goes through the organization's Exchange Online tenant (Microsoft Graph sendMail from a service mailbox). It is switched on when the backend integration is connected; until then everything is delivered in Crosswalk only.</p>
            </div>
            <Field label="Sender mailbox (set at integration)"><Input disabled placeholder="crosswalk-notifications@arroyovalleygas.com" /></Field>
          </div>
        </Panel>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
        <Stat label="Open escalations" value={escalations.length} tone={escalations.length ? 'bad' : 'good'} sub="steps escalated and still waiting" />
        <Stat label="Reminders sent" value={log.filter((n) => n.kind === 'reminder').length} sub="all time, all people" />
        <Stat label="Escalations sent" value={log.filter((n) => n.kind === 'escalation').length} />
        <Stat label="Steps with an SLA" value={s.workflows.filter((w) => w.status === 'running').reduce((a, w) => a + w.active.filter((x) => x.due).length, 0)} sub="running now" />
      </div>

      <Panel title="Open escalations" subtitle="Escalated steps that are still waiting on the original assignee" pad={false}>
        <Table rows={escalations} rowKey={(e) => `${e.inst.id}:${e.slot.nodeId}:${e.to}`} maxHeight={360}
          empty={<div className="px-4 py-3 text-[13px] text-muted">No open escalations.</div>}
          columns={[
            { key: 'step', header: 'Step', render: (e) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap font-semibold">{e.stepLabel}</span> },
            { key: 'req', header: 'Request', render: (e) => <span className="block min-w-[220px] text-[12.5px]">{e.inst.title}</span> },
            { key: 'with', header: 'Waiting on', render: (e) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12.5px]">{e.slot.assigneeIds.filter((x) => !e.slot.actedIds.includes(x)).map((x) => personName(s, x)).join(', ')}</span> },
            { key: 'late', header: 'Overdue', num: true, sort: (e) => daysBetween(e.slot.due ?? s.settings.asOf, s.settings.asOf), render: (e) => <span className="font-semibold text-bad">{daysBetween(e.slot.due ?? s.settings.asOf, s.settings.asOf)} d</span> },
            { key: 'to', header: 'Escalated to', render: (e) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{personName(s, e.to)}</span> },
            { key: 'at', header: 'On', sort: (e) => e.at, render: (e) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{fmtDate(e.at)}</span> },
          ]} />
      </Panel>

      <Panel title="Reminder log" subtitle="Most recent first" pad={false}>
        <Table rows={log.slice(0, 200)} rowKey={(n) => n.id} maxHeight={360} dense
          empty={<div className="px-4 py-3 text-[13px] text-muted">No reminders sent yet.</div>}
          columns={[
            { key: 'at', header: 'Sent', render: (n) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{fmtDateTime(n.at)}</span> },
            { key: 'k', header: 'Type', render: (n) => <Badge tone={n.kind === 'escalation' ? 'bad' : n.text.startsWith('Overdue') ? 'warn' : 'info'}>{n.kind === 'escalation' ? 'Escalation' : n.text.startsWith('Overdue') ? 'Overdue' : 'Reminder'}</Badge> },

          ]} />
