import { BuildUp, MatchedRow, QuickBadge, QuickHeadline, type BuildUpData } from './parts'
import { QuickRequest } from './QuickForm'
import { BoeText, DriverTable, MonteCarloPanel, RateTableCompare, VerifyTag } from './factorParts'

/** Build-up of a saved quick estimate (from what was stored when it was priced or adjusted). */
function savedBuildUp(s: AppState, e: Estimate): BuildUpData | undefined {
  const q = e.quick
  if (!q) return
  const t = estimateTotals(e)
  const row = s.historicalCosts.find((h) => h.id === q.historicalCostId)
  return { baseRate: q.baseRate, basis: q.basis.toUpperCase(), baseYear: row?.baseYear, qty: q.inputs.qty, unit: q.inputs.unit, district: q.inputs.district, regionFactor: q.regionFactor, escalationFactor: q.escalationFactor, midpointYear: q.inputs.midpointYear, adjustPct: q.adjustment?.pct, direct: t.lines, loaders: t.loaders, loaderPct: sum(e.loaders.map((l) => l.pct)), contingency: t.contingency, contingencyPct: e.contingency.pct, total: t.total }
}

export function QuickEstimateView({ estimate: e, project, onCopy, inbox }: { estimate: Estimate; project: Project; onCopy?: (src: Estimate) => void; inbox?: boolean }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const me = useMe()
  const [revise, setRevise] = useState(false)
  const q = e.quick
  if (!q) return <Callout tone="warn">This estimate has no quick estimate record.</Callout>
  const t = estimateTotals(e)
  const row = s.historicalCosts.find((h) => h.id === q.historicalCostId)
  const match = storedMatch(s, e)
  const b = savedBuildUp(s, e)!
  const wf = s.workflows.find((w) => w.id === e.workflowInstanceId)
  const rv = reviewSlot(s, e)
  const lastReturn = wf && wf.status !== 'running' && wf.status !== 'approved' ? [...wf.history].reverse().find((h) => h.action === 'return' || h.action === 'reject' || h.action === 'recall') : undefined
  const back = returnedToRequester(s, e)
  const revisable = canRevise(s, e) && (!!me.roles.includes('admin') || (back ? back.slot.assigneeIds.includes(me.id) : (wf?.startedById ?? e.createdById) === me.id))
  const adjustable = canAdjust(s, e, me.id)
  const hist = adjustmentHistory(s, e.id)
  const requestPanel = (
    <Panel title="Request" pad>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="rounded border border-line bg-sunken/40 px-3 py-2 text-[13px]"><div className="eyebrow mb-0.5">What it is for</div>{q.requestNote || <span className="text-muted">Not stated</span>}</div>
        <KV cols={2} items={[
          ['Requested by', `${personName(s, wf?.startedById ?? e.createdById)} · ${fmtDate(e.createdAt.slice(0, 10))}`],
          ['Needed by', q.needBy ? <span className={cx(q.needBy < s.settings.asOf && e.status === 'in-review' && 'font-semibold text-bad')}>{fmtDate(q.needBy)}</span> : 'No date'],
          ['Asset · method', `${ASSET_LABEL[q.inputs.assetType]} · ${METHOD_LABEL[q.inputs.workMethod]}`],
          ['Diameter band', isBanded(q.inputs.assetType) ? bandLabel(q.inputs.diameterBand) : 'Not banded'],
          ['Setting · region', `${TERRAIN_LABEL[q.inputs.terrain]} · ${q.inputs.district} (×${q.regionFactor.toFixed(2)})`],
          ['Quantity', `${q.inputs.qty.toLocaleString('en-US')} ${UNIT_LABEL[q.inputs.unit]}`],
          ['Spend midpoint', String(q.inputs.midpointYear)],
          ['Priced at', e.factor ? `Factor model v${e.factor.modelVersion}${q.basis !== 'p50' ? ` · ${q.basis.toUpperCase()}` : ''}` : `${q.basis.toUpperCase()} of history`],
        ]} />
        {e.factor && 'site' in q.inputs && <DriverSummary inputs={q.inputs as FactorInputs} />}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      {!inbox && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1.5">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="font-mono text-[13px] font-semibold text-muted">v{e.version}</span>
              <h2 className="font-display text-[18px] font-bold leading-tight">{e.title}</h2>
              <QuickBadge /><ClassBadge cls={e.cls} size="lg" /><StatusBadge status={e.status} />
              {q.adjustment && <Badge tone="marker">Adjusted {q.adjustment.pct > 0 ? '+' : ''}{q.adjustment.pct}%</Badge>}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-muted">
              <span>Requested by <b className="text-ink">{personName(s, wf?.startedById ?? e.createdById)}</b> · {fmtDate(e.createdAt.slice(0, 10))}</span>
              {e.approvedAt && <span>Approved by <b className="text-ink">{personName(s, e.approvedById)}</b> · {fmtDate(e.approvedAt.slice(0, 10))}</span>}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {revisable && <Button variant="marker" onClick={() => setRevise(true)}>Revise and resubmit</Button>}
            <BoeDownload get={() => getState().estimates.find((x) => x.id === e.id) ?? e} project={project} />
            {onCopy && (e.status === 'approved' || e.status === 'superseded') && <Button onClick={() => onCopy(e)}>New version from this</Button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {!inbox && back && <Callout tone="warn" title="Returned by the estimating team">{back.event?.comment ? <>“{back.event.comment}” — {personName(s, back.event.actorId)}, {fmtDateTime(back.event.at)}. </> : null}{revisable ? 'Revise the inputs and resubmit, or submit it unchanged in the workflow panel below.' : `Waiting on ${back.slot.assigneeIds.map((id) => personName(s, id)).join(', ')} to revise and resubmit.`}</Callout>}
      {!inbox && e.status === 'in-review' && rv && !back && <Callout tone="info" title="With the estimating team">Waiting on {rv.slot.assigneeIds.map((id) => personName(s, id)).join(' or ')}{rv.slot.due ? ` · due ${fmtDate(rv.slot.due)}` : ''}. Any estimator can check the match, adjust with a reason and approve.</Callout>}
      {!inbox && e.status === 'approved' && <Callout tone="good" title="Approved — estimate of record">Approved by {personName(s, e.approvedById)}{q.adjustment ? ` after a ${q.adjustment.pct > 0 ? '+' : ''}${q.adjustment.pct}% adjustment` : ' as requested'}. It becomes the planning budget at the Gate 1 decision. Mature it to Class 3 with a new line-item version.</Callout>}
      {!inbox && e.status === 'draft' && <Callout tone="warn" title={lastReturn?.action === 'recall' ? 'Recalled by the requester' : 'Returned by the estimating team'}>{lastReturn?.comment ? <>“{lastReturn.comment}” — {personName(s, lastReturn.actorId)}, {fmtDateTime(lastReturn.at)}. </> : null}Revise the inputs and resubmit.</Callout>}

      {e.factor ? <FactorDetail s={s} e={e} inbox={inbox} requestPanel={requestPanel} /> : <div className={cx('grid grid-cols-1 gap-3', !inbox && 'xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.1fr)]')}>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">
          {inbox ? <QuickHeadline total={t.total} low={q.range.low} high={q.range.high} perUnit={q.inputs.qty ? t.total / q.inputs.qty : 0} unit={q.inputs.unit} size="md" /> : requestPanel}
          {inbox && <div className="rounded border border-line bg-sunken/40 px-3 py-2 text-[13px]"><div className="eyebrow mb-0.5">What it is for</div>{q.requestNote || <span className="text-muted">Not stated</span>}<div className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] text-muted">{ASSET_LABEL[q.inputs.assetType]} · {METHOD_LABEL[q.inputs.workMethod]}{isBanded(q.inputs.assetType) ? ` · ${bandLabel(q.inputs.diameterBand)}` : ''} · {q.inputs.qty.toLocaleString('en-US')} {UNIT_LABEL[q.inputs.unit]} · {TERRAIN_LABEL[q.inputs.terrain].toLowerCase()} · {q.inputs.district} · {q.inputs.midpointYear} midpoint{q.needBy ? ` · needed by ${fmtDate(q.needBy)}` : ''}</div></div>}
          {inbox && <MatchedRow s={s} row={row} match={match} inputs={q.inputs} />}
        </div>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">
          {!inbox && <Panel title="Estimate" subtitle={`${e.status === 'approved' ? 'As approved' : 'As priced'} from the historical cost table`}>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
              <QuickHeadline total={t.total} low={q.range.low} high={q.range.high} perUnit={q.inputs.qty ? t.total / q.inputs.qty : 0} unit={q.inputs.unit} size="md" />
              <BuildUp b={b} />
            </div>
          </Panel>}
          {!inbox && <MatchedRow s={s} row={row} match={match} inputs={q.inputs} />}
          {inbox && <details className="rounded border border-line px-3 py-2"><summary className="cursor-pointer text-[12.5px] font-semibold">Build-up</summary><div className="mt-2"><BuildUp b={b} /></div></details>}
        </div>
      </div>}

      {adjustable && (e.factor ? <FactorAdjustPanel s={s} e={e} /> : <AdjustPanel s={s} e={e} />)}
      {!adjustable && e.status === 'in-review' && inbox && <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">Only the estimating team can adjust this estimate.</p>}
      {(hist.length > 0 || q.adjustment) && <AdjustmentHistory s={s} e={e} />}
      {!inbox && e.workflowInstanceId && <WorkflowStatus instanceId={e.workflowInstanceId} compact={e.status !== 'in-review'} />}

      {revise && (
        <Modal open wide onClose={() => setRevise(false)} title={`Revise quick estimate v${e.version}`}>
          <QuickRequest reviseId={e.id} onCancel={() => setRevise(false)} onDone={() => setRevise(false)} />
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

/** The site drivers a factor estimate was priced with, as short chips. */
function DriverSummary({ inputs }: { inputs: FactorInputs }) {
  const dv = { ...inputs.site, terrain: inputs.terrain }
  const keys = ['soil', 'crossings', 'permitComplexity', 'classLocation', 'hca', 'traffic', 'workHours', 'remoteness'] as const
  return (
    <div><div className="eyebrow mb-1">Site drivers</div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">{keys.map((k) => { const lv = levelOf(dv, k); const off = lv !== DRIVER_INFO[k].baseline; return <span key={k} className={cx('rounded border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11.5px]', off ? 'border-ink/40 text-ink' : 'border-line text-muted')}>{DRIVER_INFO[k].label}: <b>{k === 'crossings' ? inputs.site.crossings : levelLabel(k, lv)}</b></span> })}</div>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Saved factor-model pricing: headline, itemized drivers, rate-table check, BOE, Monte Carlo. */
function FactorDetail({ s, e, inbox, requestPanel }: { s: AppState; e: Estimate; inbox?: boolean; requestPanel: React.ReactNode }) {
  const q = e.quick!, fx = e.factor!
  const t = estimateTotals(e)
  const [mc, setMc] = useState(false)
  const live = mc ? previewFactorAdjust(s, e, fx.adjustment?.pct ?? 0, q.basis) : undefined
  const headline = <QuickHeadline total={t.total} low={fx.p10} high={fx.p90} perUnit={q.inputs.qty ? t.total / q.inputs.qty : 0} unit={q.inputs.unit} size="md" source="Model" />
  const drivers = <div><div className="eyebrow mb-1">Cost drivers · factor model v{fx.modelVersion}</div><DriverTable items={fx.items} baseline={fx.baseline} direct={t.lines} total={t.total} /></div>
  const build = (
    <table className="tbl [&_td]:py-1"><tbody>
      <tr><td className="text-[12.5px]">Direct cost</td><td className="num text-[12.5px]">{money(t.lines)}</td></tr>
      <tr><td className="text-[12.5px]">+ Sales tax <span className="text-faint">({e.salesTax?.pct ?? 0}%)</span></td><td className="num text-[12.5px]">{money(t.tax)}</td></tr>
      <tr><td className="text-[12.5px]">+ Loaders <span className="text-faint">({sum(e.loaders.map((l) => l.pct)).toFixed(1)}%)</span></td><td className="num text-[12.5px]">{money(t.loaders)}</td></tr>
      <tr><td className="text-[12.5px]">+ Contingency <span className="text-faint">({e.contingency.pct}% Class 5)</span></td><td className="num text-[12.5px]">{money(t.contingency)}</td></tr>
      <tr className="border-t-2 border-ink/60"><td className="font-display text-[13.5px] font-bold">= Total</td><td className="num font-display text-[13.5px] font-bold">{money(t.total)}</td></tr>
    </tbody></table>
  )
  const extras = (
    <>
      <RateTableCompare factor={t.total} rateTable={fx.rateTable} low={fx.p10} high={fx.p90} />
      <BoeText basis={e.basis} />
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-md border border-line p-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2"><span className="eyebrow">Monte Carlo</span><Button size="sm" onClick={() => setMc((v) => !v)}>{mc ? 'Hide' : 'Run Monte Carlo'}</Button></div>
        {mc && live ? <MonteCarloPanel r={live} iterations={s.settings.factorModel.iterations} /> : !mc ? <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">Simulate the total from the model's base-rate uncertainty and each driver off its baseline: histogram, S-curve and tornado.</p> : <p className="text-[12px] text-warn">The model version this estimate was priced on is no longer available.</p>}
      </div>
    </>
  )
  if (inbox) return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      {headline}
      <div className="rounded border border-line bg-sunken/40 px-3 py-2 text-[13px]"><div className="eyebrow mb-0.5">What it is for</div>{q.requestNote || <span className="text-muted">Not stated</span>}<div className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] text-muted">{ASSET_LABEL[q.inputs.assetType]} · {METHOD_LABEL[q.inputs.workMethod]}{isBanded(q.inputs.assetType) ? ` · ${bandLabel(q.inputs.diameterBand)}` : ''} · {q.inputs.qty.toLocaleString('en-US')} {UNIT_LABEL[q.inputs.unit]} · {TERRAIN_LABEL[q.inputs.terrain].toLowerCase()} · {q.inputs.district} · {q.inputs.midpointYear} midpoint{q.needBy ? ` · needed by ${fmtDate(q.needBy)}` : ''}</div>{'site' in q.inputs && <div className="mt-2"><DriverSummary inputs={q.inputs as FactorInputs} /></div>}</div>
      {drivers}
      <RateTableCompare factor={t.total} rateTable={fx.rateTable} low={fx.p10} high={fx.p90} />
      <details className="rounded border border-line px-3 py-2"><summary className="cursor-pointer text-[12.5px] font-semibold">Build-up and basis of estimate</summary><div className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-3">{build}<BoeText basis={e.basis} /></div></details>
    </div>
  )
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.2fr)]">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">{requestPanel}</div>
        <Panel className="min-w-0" title="Estimate" subtitle={`${e.status === 'approved' ? 'As approved' : 'As priced'} with the Class 5 factor model`}>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">{headline}{drivers}{build}</div>
        </Panel>
      </div>
      {extras}
    </div>
  )
}

/** Estimating-team adjustment of a factor estimate: %, optional percentile basis, reason from the override list. */
function FactorAdjustPanel({ s, e }: { s: AppState; e: Estimate }) {
  const me = useMe()
  const q = e.quick!
  const reasons = s.settings.factorModel.overrideReasons
  const [pctAdj, setPct] = useState<number>(q.adjustment?.pct ?? 0)
  const [basis, setBasis] = useState<QuickEstimate['basis']>(q.basis)
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('')
  const [note, setNote] = useState('')
  const before = estimateTotals(e).total
  const r = previewAdjust(s, e, basis, pctAdj)
  const after = r ? Math.round(r.total) : before
  const changed = pctAdj !== (e.factor?.adjustment?.pct ?? q.adjustment?.pct ?? 0) || basis !== q.basis
  const ok = changed && !!reason
  const apply = () => {
    if (!ok) return
    mutate((d) => applyAdjustment(d, e.id, { pct: pctAdj, basis, reason, note: note.trim() || undefined }, me.id))
    toast(`Adjusted: ${money(before)} → ${money(after)}`)
    setReason(''); setNote('')
  }
  return (
    <Panel className="border-marker/70" title="Adjust (estimating team)" subtitle="Scale the model result and/or price it at another percentile of the model range. Pick the override reason; it is kept with the estimate, in its BOE and in the audit trail.">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,280px)]">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">
            <Field label="Priced at"><SegButtons value={basis} onChange={setBasis} options={[{ id: 'p10', label: 'P10' }, { id: 'p50', label: 'P50' }, { id: 'p90', label: 'P90' }]} /></Field>
            <Field label="Adjustment %" className="w-28"><NumInput id="adj-pct" value={pctAdj} onChange={(v) => setPct(Math.max(-90, Math.min(300, Math.round(v * 10) / 10)))} /></Field>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 pb-0.5">{[-10, -5, 0, 5, 10, 15, 25].map((v) => <button key={v} type="button" onClick={() => setPct(v)} className={cx('rounded border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11.5px] tabular-nums', pctAdj === v ? 'border-ink bg-ink text-surface' : 'border-line text-muted hover:text-ink')}>{v > 0 ? '+' : ''}{v}%</button>)}</div>
          </div>
          <Field label="Override reason (required)"><Select id="adj-reason" value={reason} onChange={(ev) => setReason(ev.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'Choose a reason…' }, ...reasons.map((x) => ({ value: x, label: x }))]} /></Field>
          <Field label="Note (optional)" hint="What about this project the drivers do not capture"><TextArea id="adj-note" className="min-h-[52px]" placeholder="e.g. Two HDD crossings under the flood-control channel." value={note} onChange={(ev) => setNote(ev.target.value)} /></Field>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Button variant="primary" disabled={!ok} onClick={apply}>Apply adjustment</Button>
            {!changed && <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Change the % or the percentile to adjust.</span>}
            {changed && !reason && <span className="text-[12px] text-warn">Choose an override reason to apply.</span>}
            <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Then approve or return below.</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken/40 p-3">
          <div className="eyebrow">Before → after</div>
          <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2 font-display tabular-nums">
            <span className="text-[17px] text-muted line-through decoration-faint">{money(before)}</span>
            <span aria-hidden className="text-muted">→</span>
            <span className="text-[22px] font-bold">{money(after)}</span>
          </div>
          <div className={cx('text-[12.5px] font-semibold tabular-nums', after > before ? 'text-bad' : after < before ? 'text-good' : 'text-muted')}>{after === before ? 'No change' : `${moneyDelta(after - before)} (${after > before ? '+' : ''}${pct(after / before - 1, 1)})`}</div>
          {r && <div className="mt-2 text-[11.5px] text-muted">New range {money(r.low)} – {money(r.high)}</div>}
          <div className="mt-2"><VerifyTag>BOE updated — verify</VerifyTag></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

function AdjustPanel({ s, e }: { s: AppState; e: Estimate }) {
  const me = useMe()
  const q = e.quick!
  const [pctAdj, setPct] = useState<number>(q.adjustment?.pct ?? 0)
  const [basis, setBasis] = useState<QuickEstimate['basis']>(q.basis)
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('')
  const before = estimateTotals(e).total
  const r = previewAdjust(s, e, basis, pctAdj)
  const after = r ? Math.round(r.total) : before
  const changed = pctAdj !== (q.adjustment?.pct ?? 0) || basis !== q.basis
  const apply = () => {
    if (!changed || !reason.trim()) return
    mutate((d) => applyAdjustment(d, e.id, { pct: pctAdj, basis, reason: reason.trim() }, me.id))
    toast(`Adjusted: ${money(before)} → ${money(after)}`)
    setReason('')
  }
  return (
    <Panel className="border-marker/70" title="Adjust (estimating team)" subtitle="Scale the historical figure and/or change the percentile it is priced at. A reason is required and is kept with the estimate and in the audit trail.">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,280px)]">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">
            <Field label="Percentile basis"><SegButtons value={basis} onChange={setBasis} options={[{ id: 'p10', label: 'P10' }, { id: 'p50', label: 'P50' }, { id: 'p90', label: 'P90' }]} /></Field>
            <Field label="Adjustment %" className="w-28"><NumInput id="adj-pct" value={pctAdj} onChange={(v) => setPct(Math.max(-90, Math.min(300, Math.round(v * 10) / 10)))} /></Field>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 pb-0.5">{[-10, -5, 0, 5, 10, 15, 25].map((v) => <button key={v} type="button" onClick={() => setPct(v)} className={cx('rounded border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11.5px] tabular-nums', pctAdj === v ? 'border-ink bg-ink text-surface' : 'border-line text-muted hover:text-ink')}>{v > 0 ? '+' : ''}{v}%</button>)}</div>
          </div>
          <Field label="Reason (required)" hint="What about this project is not represented in the historical population?">
            <TextArea id="adj-reason" className="min-h-[60px]" placeholder="e.g. Two HDD crossings under the flood-control channel are not represented in the history." value={reason} onChange={(ev) => setReason(ev.target.value)} />
          </Field>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Button variant="primary" disabled={!changed || !reason.trim()} onClick={apply}>Apply adjustment</Button>
            {!changed && <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Change the % or the basis to adjust.</span>}
            {changed && !reason.trim() && <span className="text-[12px] text-warn">Add a reason to apply.</span>}
            <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Then approve or return below.</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken/40 p-3">
          <div className="eyebrow">Before → after</div>
          <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2 font-display tabular-nums">
            <span className="text-[17px] text-muted line-through decoration-faint">{money(before)}</span>
            <span aria-hidden className="text-muted">→</span>
            <span className="text-[22px] font-bold">{money(after)}</span>
          </div>
          <div className={cx('text-[12.5px] font-semibold tabular-nums', after > before ? 'text-bad' : after < before ? 'text-good' : 'text-muted')}>{after === before ? 'No change' : `${moneyDelta(after - before)} (${after > before ? '+' : ''}${pct(after / before - 1, 1)})`}</div>
          {r && <div className="mt-2 text-[11.5px] text-muted">New range {money(r.low)} – {money(r.high)} · {basis.toUpperCase()} rate ${Math.round(r.baseRate).toLocaleString('en-US')}/{q.inputs.unit}</div>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

function AdjustmentHistory({ s, e }: { s: AppState; e: Estimate }) {
  const hist = adjustmentHistory(s, e.id)
  const q = e.quick!
  const rows = hist.length ? hist : q.adjustment ? [{ at: q.adjustment.at, byId: q.adjustment.byId, pct: q.adjustment.pct, basis: q.basis.toUpperCase(), from: q.adjustment.fromTotal, to: q.adjustment.toTotal, reason: q.adjustment.reason, raw: '' }] : []
  return (
    <Panel pad={false} title="Adjustment history" subtitle="Every estimator adjustment, oldest first">
      <div className="scroll-x">
        <table className="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th>When</th><th>By</th><th className="num">Adjustment</th><th>Basis</th><th className="num">Before → after</th><th>Reason</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((h, k) => (
              <tr key={k}>
                <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{fmtDateTime(h.at)}</td>
                <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12.5px]">{personName(s, h.byId)}</td>
                <td className="num font-semibold">{h.pct != null ? `${h.pct > 0 ? '+' : ''}${h.pct}%` : '—'}</td>
                <td>{h.basis ?? '—'}</td>
                <td className="num whitespace-nowrap text-[12.5px]">{h.from != null && h.to != null ? <>{money(h.from)} → <b>{money(h.to)}</b></> : '—'}</td>
                <td className="min-w-[220px] text-[12.5px]">{h.reason}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

/** Inbox record summary for a quick estimate task (the inbox renders the approve / return controls). */
export function QuickReviewSummary({ estimateId }: { estimateId: string }) {
  const e = useStore((s) => s.estimates.find((x) => x.id === estimateId))
  const p = useStore((s) => s.projects.find((x) => x.id === e?.projectId))
  if (!e || !p) return null
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><QuickBadge /><span className="text-[12px] text-muted">v{e.version} · {e.title}</span><StatusBadge status={e.status} /></div>
      <QuickEstimateView estimate={e} project={p} inbox />
    </div>
  )
}

// ETC / EAC by WBS function (lines nested): the headline of the forecast tab and of the portfolio cycle page.
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, FnProfile, Money } from '@/core/types'
import { cx, money, moneyDelta } from '@/core/util'
import { ProfileChip } from './Profiles'

export interface EtcRow {
  fnId: string; code: string; name: string
  budget: Money; actual: Money; etc: Money; eac: Money; vac: Money
  profile?: FnProfile
  lines: { id: string; code: string; name: string; budget: Money; actual: Money; etc: Money; eac: Money; vac: Money }[]
  note?: React.ReactNode // extra cell content (portfolio: projects over budget)
}

const pctOf = (a: number, b: number) => (b ? (a / b) * 100 : 0)

export function EtcEacTable({ s, rows, contingencyBudget, contingencyHeld, totals, showProfile = true, extraHeader, onProfile, onActual, initiallyOpen }: {
  s: AppState; rows: EtcRow[]; contingencyBudget: Money; contingencyHeld: Money
  totals: { budget: Money; actual: Money; etc: Money; eac: Money; vac: Money }
  showProfile?: boolean; extraHeader?: string
  onProfile?: (fnId: string) => void
  onActual?: (t: { fnId?: string; lineId?: string }) => void
  initiallyOpen?: string[]
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set(initiallyOpen ?? []))
  const toggle = (id: string) => setOpen((o) => { const n = new Set(o); if (n.has(id)) n.delete(id); else n.add(id); return n })
  const all = rows.every((r) => open.has(r.fnId) || r.lines.length < 2)
  const fnBud = rows.reduce((a, r) => a + r.budget, 0)
  const fnEac = rows.reduce((a, r) => a + r.eac, 0)
  const fnAct = rows.reduce((a, r) => a + r.actual, 0)
  const fnEtc = rows.reduce((a, r) => a + r.etc, 0)
  const spent = (a: number, e: number) => {
    const p = pctOf(a, e)
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
        <div className="hidden h-1.5 w-14 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-sunken sm:block"><div className={cx('h-full rounded-full', p > 100 ? 'bg-bad' : 'bg-ink/60')} style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, p))}%` }} /></div>
        <span className="w-10 text-right tabular-nums">{e ? `${Math.round(p)}%` : '—'}</span>
      </div>
    )
  }
  const vacCell = (v: number, b: number) => (
    <span className={cx('tabular-nums', v < 0 ? 'text-bad' : v > 0 ? 'text-good' : 'text-faint')}>{v ? moneyDelta(v) : '–'}{b && v ? <span className="ml-1 text-[10.5px] font-normal text-faint">{pctOf(v, b) > 0 ? '+' : ''}{pctOf(v, b).toFixed(1)}%</span> : null}</span>
  )
  const act = (v: number, t: { fnId?: string; lineId?: string }) => onActual && v
    ? <button className="tabular-nums underline decoration-dotted decoration-faint underline-offset-2 hover:text-link" title="Show the SAP transactions behind this actual" onClick={() => onActual(t)}>{money(v)}</button>
    : <span className="tabular-nums">{v ? money(v) : '–'}</span>
  return (
    <div className="scroll-x">
      <table className="tbl">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th className="sticky left-0 z-[2] bg-sunken">
              <button className="mr-1.5 text-muted hover:text-ink" onClick={() => setOpen(all ? new Set() : new Set(rows.map((r) => r.fnId)))} title={all ? 'Collapse all' : 'Expand all functions to lines'}>{all ? '▾' : '▸'}</button>
              WBS function · line
            </th>
            {showProfile && <th>Profile</th>}
            <th className="num">Budget</th><th className="num">Actual to date</th><th className="num">ETC</th><th className="num">EAC</th>
            <th className="num" title="Variance at completion = budget − EAC">VAC</th><th className="num" title="Actual to date ÷ EAC">% spent</th>
            {extraHeader && <th>{extraHeader}</th>}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((r) => {
            const isOpen = open.has(r.fnId)
            return (
              <React.Fragment key={r.fnId}>
                <tr className="font-semibold">
                  <td className="sticky left-0 z-[1] whitespace-nowrap bg-surface">
                    <button className={cx('mr-1.5 w-3 text-muted hover:text-ink', !r.lines.length && 'invisible')} onClick={() => toggle(r.fnId)} aria-expanded={isOpen} aria-label={`${isOpen ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'} ${r.name}`}>{isOpen ? '▾' : '▸'}</button>
                    <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-normal text-faint">{r.code}</span> {r.name}
                    {r.eac > r.budget && r.eac > 0 && <span className="ml-1.5 inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-bad align-middle" title="EAC exceeds budget" />}
                  </td>
                  {showProfile && <td className="whitespace-nowrap font-normal"><ProfileChip s={s} profile={r.profile} onClick={onProfile && r.lines.length ? () => onProfile(r.fnId) : undefined} /></td>}
                  <td className="num">{r.budget ? money(r.budget) : '–'}</td>
                  <td className="num">{act(r.actual, { fnId: r.fnId })}</td>
                  <td className="num">{r.etc ? money(r.etc) : '–'}</td>
                  <td className={cx('num', r.eac > r.budget && r.eac > 0 && 'text-bad')}>{r.eac ? money(r.eac) : '–'}</td>
                  <td className="num">{vacCell(r.vac, r.budget)}</td>
                  <td className="num font-normal">{spent(r.actual, r.eac)}</td>
                  {extraHeader && <td className="font-normal">{r.note}</td>}
                </tr>
                {isOpen && r.lines.map((l) => (
                  <tr key={l.id} className="text-[12.5px]">
                    <td className="sticky left-0 z-[1] whitespace-nowrap bg-surface pl-9 text-muted"><span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">{l.code}</span> {l.name}</td>
                    {showProfile && <td />}
                    <td className="num text-muted">{l.budget ? money(l.budget) : '–'}</td>
                    <td className="num text-muted">{act(l.actual, { lineId: l.id, fnId: r.fnId })}</td>
                    <td className="num text-muted">{l.etc ? money(l.etc) : '–'}</td>
                    <td className={cx('num', l.eac > l.budget && l.eac > 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-muted')}>{l.eac ? money(l.eac) : '–'}</td>
                    <td className="num">{vacCell(l.vac, l.budget)}</td>
                    <td className="num text-muted">{spent(l.actual, l.eac)}</td>
                    {extraHeader && <td />}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </React.Fragment>
            )
          })}
          <tr className="border-t border-line bg-sunken/50 font-semibold">
            <td className="sticky left-0 z-[1] whitespace-nowrap bg-sunken/50">Functions subtotal</td>
            {showProfile && <td />}
            <td className="num">{money(fnBud)}</td><td className="num">{money(fnAct)}</td><td className="num">{money(fnEtc)}</td><td className="num">{money(fnEac)}</td>
            <td className="num">{vacCell(fnBud - fnEac, fnBud)}</td><td className="num font-normal">{spent(fnAct, fnEac)}</td>
            {extraHeader && <td />}
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td className="sticky left-0 z-[1] whitespace-nowrap bg-surface"><span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">990</span> Contingency held<div className="text-[10.5px] text-faint">In EAC, not spread to a function</div></td>
            {showProfile && <td />}
            <td className="num text-muted">{contingencyBudget ? money(contingencyBudget) : '–'}</td><td className="num text-faint">–</td>
            <td className="num">{contingencyHeld ? money(contingencyHeld) : '–'}</td><td className="num">{contingencyHeld ? money(contingencyHeld) : '–'}</td>
            <td className="num">{vacCell(contingencyBudget - contingencyHeld, 0)}</td><td className="num text-faint">{contingencyBudget ? `${Math.round(pctOf(contingencyHeld, contingencyBudget))}% held` : ''}</td>
            {extraHeader && <td />}
          </tr>
          <tr className="bg-sunken font-bold">
            <td className="sticky left-0 z-[1] bg-sunken uppercase tracking-wide text-[11.5px]">Total</td>
            {showProfile && <td />}
            <td className="num">{money(totals.budget)}</td><td className="num">{money(totals.actual)}</td><td className="num">{money(totals.etc)}</td>
            <td className={cx('num', totals.eac > totals.budget && 'text-bad')}>{money(totals.eac)}</td>
            <td className="num">{vacCell(totals.vac, totals.budget)}</td><td className="num font-normal">{spent(totals.actual, totals.eac)}</td>
            {extraHeader && <td />}
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/forecast/ForecastCycle.tsx =====
// Monthly forecast cycle across the portfolio: where each project's forecast stands this cycle, a
// "Start cycle" action that opens drafts for everyone, ETC / EAC by WBS function across the portfolio, and the
// portfolio roll-up by WBS function × year.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { mutate, personName, useMe, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { actualsThrough } from '@/core/engine/wbs'
import { saveFile, toCSV, htmlDoc } from '@/core/download'
import { cx, fmtDate, fmtMonth, money, moneyDelta, sum } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, ConfirmButton, Empty, Panel, PageHeader, SegButtons, Stat, StatusBadge, Table, type Column } from '@/ui/kit'
import { BarChart, SERIES } from '@/ui/charts'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { ProgramSelect, ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'
import { EtcEacTable } from './EtcEac'
import {
  portfolioEtcEac, portfolioEtcEacCsv, currentCycle, cycleRows, monthLabel, rollup, rollupCell, rollupCsvRows, rollupDetailRows, rollupFnTotal, rollupYearTotal, startCycle,
  type CycleRow, type CycleStatus, type RollupBasis, type SlipMode,
} from './lib'

const STATUS: Record<CycleStatus, { label: string; tone: string }> = {
  approved: { label: 'Approved', tone: 'approved' },
  'in-review': { label: 'In review', tone: 'in-review' },
  draft: { label: 'Draft', tone: 'draft' },
  returned: { label: 'Returned', tone: 'returned' },
  'not-started': { label: 'Not started', tone: 'pending' },
}
const ORDER: CycleStatus[] = ['not-started', 'returned', 'draft', 'in-review', 'approved']

export default function ForecastCycle(_props: { projectId?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const me = useMe()
  const cycle = currentCycle(s)
  const [program, setProgram] = useState('')
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<CycleStatus | ''>('')
  const all = useMemo(() => cycleRows(s, cycle), [s, cycle])
  const rows = all.filter((r) => !program || r.p.programId === program)
  const shown = rows.filter((r) => !filter || r.status === filter)
  const counts = Object.fromEntries(ORDER.map((k) => [k, rows.filter((r) => r.status === k).length])) as Record<CycleStatus, number>
  const notStarted = all.filter((r) => r.status === 'not-started')
  const [slip, setSlip] = useState<SlipMode>('net')
  const canStart = me.roles.some((r) => ['admin', 'pmo', 'project-controls', 'finance'].includes(r))

  const start = () => {
    let res = { codes: [] as string[], moved: 0 }
    mutate((d) => { res = startCycle(d, me.id, slip) }, { entity: 'forecast', entityId: `cycle-${cycle}`, action: 'start-cycle', summary: `Opened the ${monthLabel(cycle)} forecast cycle: draft versions created for ${notStarted.length} projects (${notStarted.map((r) => r.p.code).join(', ')})` })
    toast(`${monthLabel(cycle)} cycle started — ${res.codes.length} drafts created`)
  }

  const eacT = sum(rows.map((r) => r.eac))
  const budT = sum(rows.map((r) => r.budget))
  const deltaT = sum(rows.map((r) => r.delta ?? 0))

  const cols: Column<CycleRow>[] = [
    { key: 'code', header: 'Project', sort: (r) => r.p.code, render: (r) => (
      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2"><ProgramTag programId={r.p.programId} /><a href={projectHref(r.p.id, 'forecast')} className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline">{r.p.code}</a><span className="min-w-0 max-w-[260px] truncate" title={r.p.name}>{r.p.name}</span></div>
    ) },
    { key: 'pm', header: 'PM', sort: (r) => personName(s, r.p.team.pm), render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted">{personName(s, r.p.team.pm)}</span> },
    { key: 'status', header: `${monthLabel(cycle).split(' ')[0]} status`, sort: (r) => ORDER.indexOf(r.status), render: (r) => (
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5"><StatusBadge status={STATUS[r.status].tone} label={STATUS[r.status].label} />{r.version && <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">{fmtDate(r.version.date)}</span>}</div>
    ) },
    { key: 'thru', header: 'Actuals thru', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted">{fmtMonth(actualsThrough(s, r.p.id))}</span> },
    { key: 'budget', header: 'Budget', num: true, sort: (r) => r.budget, render: (r) => money(r.budget) },
    { key: 'eac', header: 'EAC', num: true, sort: (r) => r.eac, render: (r) => <span className={cx('font-semibold', r.eac > r.budget && 'text-bad')}>{money(r.eac)}{!r.version && r.latest && <span className="ml-1 text-[10.5px] font-normal text-faint" title={`Latest version ${r.latest.date}`}>last</span>}</span> },
    { key: 'var', header: 'Budget − EAC', num: true, sort: (r) => r.budget - r.eac, render: (r) => <span className={r.budget - r.eac < 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-muted'}>{moneyDelta(r.budget - r.eac)}</span> },
    { key: 'delta', header: 'vs prior approved', num: true, sort: (r) => r.delta ?? 0, render: (r) => (r.delta === undefined ? <span className="text-faint">—</span> : <span className={r.delta > 0 ? 'text-bad' : r.delta < 0 ? 'text-good' : 'text-faint'}>{r.delta ? moneyDelta(r.delta) : 'no change'}</span>) },
    { key: 'open', header: '', render: (r) => <a href={projectHref(r.p.id, 'forecast')} className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline">{r.status === 'not-started' ? 'Open' : r.status === 'draft' || r.status === 'returned' ? 'Edit spread' : 'View'} →</a> },
  ]

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader eyebrow="Cost control" title="Forecast cycle"
        subtitle={`Every active project re-spreads its estimate to complete across the ${s.settings.wbsFunctions.length} WBS functions each month. Project controls validates, the program manager accepts, and the approved version locks. Cycle month: ${monthLabel(cycle)} (opens after ${fmtMonth(actualsThrough(s, all[0]?.p.id ?? ''))} actuals close).`}
        actions={<>
          <ProgramSelect value={program} onChange={setProgram} />
          {notStarted.length > 0 && canStart && <ConfirmButton variant="marker" confirmLabel={`Create ${notStarted.length} drafts`} onConfirm={start}>Start {monthLabel(cycle).split(' ')[0]} cycle</ConfirmButton>}
        </>} />

      <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6">
        {ORDER.map((k) => <Stat key={k} label={STATUS[k].label} value={counts[k]} tone={k === 'approved' && counts[k] === rows.length ? 'good' : k === 'returned' && counts[k] ? 'bad' : undefined} onClick={() => setFilter(filter === k ? '' : k)} sub={filter === k ? 'Filtered — click to clear' : `of ${rows.length} projects`} />)}
        <Stat label="Portfolio EAC" value={money(eacT)} tone={eacT > budT ? 'bad' : undefined} sub={`budget ${money(budT)} · ${moneyDelta(deltaT)} vs prior`} />
      </div>

      {notStarted.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-4">
          <Callout tone="marker" title={`${notStarted.length} project${notStarted.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} have no ${monthLabel(cycle)} forecast yet`}>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <span>Starting the cycle copies each project’s latest version into a draft with actuals through {fmtMonth(actualsThrough(s, notStarted[0].p.id))}. ETC left in months that have since closed is handled as chosen below; PMs then adjust the spread by hand.</span>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[12px]"><span className="font-semibold">ETC in closed months:</span>
                <SegButtons value={slip} onChange={setSlip} options={[{ id: 'net', label: 'Carry forward unspent' }, { id: 'all', label: 'Carry forward all' }, { id: 'drop', label: 'Drop' }]} />
              </div>
              {!canStart && <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Only PMO, project controls or finance can open the cycle for everyone. PMs can start their own version from the project’s forecast tab.</span>}
            </div>
          </Callout>
        </div>
      )}

      <Panel title={`${monthLabel(cycle)} cycle by project`} subtitle={filter ? `Showing ${STATUS[filter].label.toLowerCase()} only` : `${rows.length} active projects with a budget`} pad={false}
        actions={filter ? <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setFilter('')}>Clear filter</Button> : undefined}>
        <Table rows={shown} rowKey={(r) => r.p.id} columns={cols} dense empty={<div className="p-4"><Empty title="No projects match">Change the program or status filter.</Empty></div>} />
      </Panel>

      <PortfolioEtcEac program={program} />

      <Rollup program={program} />
    </div>
  )
}

function Rollup({ program }: { program: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [basis, setBasis] = useState<RollupBasis>('latest')
  const [view, setView] = useState<'table' | 'chart'>('table')
  const projects = useMemo(() => s.projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'active' && (!program || p.programId === program)), [s.projects, program])
  const r = useMemo(() => rollup(s, projects, basis), [s, projects, basis])
  const prog = s.programs.find((x) => x.id === program)
  const scope = prog ? `${prog.code} ${prog.name}` : 'All programs'
  const nowY = s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4)
  const grand = sum(r.years.map((y) => rollupYearTotal(r, y)))

  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const res = await saveFile(`forecast-rollup-${basis}-${prog?.code ?? 'all'}-${s.settings.asOf}.csv`, toCSV(rollupCsvRows(r)), 'text/csv')
    if (res === 'saved') toast('Roll-up exported for finance')
  }
  const exportDetail = async () => {
    const res = await saveFile(`forecast-detail-${basis}-${prog?.code ?? 'all'}-${s.settings.asOf}.csv`, toCSV(rollupDetailRows(s, r)), 'text/csv')
    if (res === 'saved') toast('Project detail exported')
  }
  const exportHtml = async () => {
    const th = r.years.map((y) => `<th>${y}</th>`).join('')
    const row = (code: string, name: string, vals: number[], total: number, b = false) => `<tr><td>${code}</td><td>${b ? '<b>' + name + '</b>' : name}</td>${vals.map((v) => `<td class="num">${v ? money(v, 'full') : '–'}</td>`).join('')}<td class="num"><b>${money(total, 'full')}</b></td></tr>`
    const body = `<h1>Capital forecast by WBS function</h1><p class="meta">${s.settings.orgName} · ${scope} · ${basis === 'latest' ? 'latest version of each project' : 'latest approved versions'} · ${r.projects.length} projects · as of ${fmtDate(s.settings.asOf)}</p>
<p class="meta">Each cell is recorded ERP actuals (through each version’s actuals month) plus time-phased ETC. Contingency held sits in each project’s final year.</p>
<table><thead><tr><th>Code</th><th>WBS function</th>${th}<th>Total</th></tr></thead><tbody>
${r.fns.map((f) => row(f.code, f.name, r.years.map((y) => rollupCell(r, f.id, y)), rollupFnTotal(r, f.id))).join('\n')}
${row('990', 'Contingency held', r.years.map((y) => r.contingency[y] || 0), sum(Object.values(r.contingency)))}
${row('', 'Total', r.years.map((y) => rollupYearTotal(r, y)), grand, true)}</tbody></table>
<h2>Projects included</h2><table><thead><tr><th>Project</th><th>Version</th><th>Status</th><th>EAC</th></tr></thead><tbody>${r.projects.map(({ p, version }) => `<tr><td>${p.code} ${p.name}</td><td>${version.date}</td><td>${version.status ?? ''}</td><td class="num">${money(version.eac, 'full')}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`
    const res = await saveFile(`forecast-rollup-${prog?.code ?? 'all'}-${s.settings.asOf}.html`, htmlDoc('Capital forecast by WBS function', body), 'text/html')
    if (res === 'saved') toast('Roll-up report saved')
  }

  const chartFns = [...r.fns].sort((a, b) => rollupFnTotal(r, b.id) - rollupFnTotal(r, a.id))
  const top = chartFns.slice(0, 5)
  const rest = chartFns.slice(5)
  const colors = [SERIES[0], SERIES[2], SERIES[5], SERIES[1], SERIES[3]]

  if (!r.projects.length) return <Panel title="Portfolio roll-up" className="mt-4"><Empty title="No forecasts in scope">No active project in {scope} has a {basis === 'approved' ? 'approved ' : ''}forecast version.</Empty></Panel>

  return (
    <Panel className="mt-4" title="Portfolio roll-up by WBS function × year" pad={false}
      subtitle={`${scope} · ${r.projects.length} projects · actuals + time-phased ETC, ${basis === 'latest' ? 'latest version of each project (drafts included)' : 'latest approved versions only'}`}
      actions={<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <SegButtons value={basis} onChange={setBasis} options={[{ id: 'latest', label: 'Latest' }, { id: 'approved', label: 'Approved only' }]} />
        <SegButtons value={view} onChange={setView} options={[{ id: 'table', label: 'Table' }, { id: 'chart', label: 'Chart' }]} />
        <Button size="sm" onClick={exportCsv} icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}>CSV for finance</Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={exportDetail}>Project detail CSV</Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={exportHtml}>Report</Button>
      </div>}>
      {view === 'table' ? (
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th className="sticky left-0 z-[2] bg-sunken">WBS function</th>{r.years.map((y) => <th key={y} className={cx('num', y === nowY && 'text-ink')}>{y}{y < nowY ? ' A' : y === nowY ? ' A+F' : ' F'}</th>)}<th className="num">Total</th><th className="num">Share</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {r.fns.map((f) => {
                const t = rollupFnTotal(r, f.id)
                return (
                  <tr key={f.id}>
                    <td className="sticky left-0 z-[1] whitespace-nowrap bg-surface"><span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">{f.code}</span> <span className={cx(f.retired && 'text-muted line-through')}>{f.name}</span></td>
                    {r.years.map((y) => { const a = r.actual[f.id]?.[y] || 0, v = rollupCell(r, f.id, y); return <td key={y} className="num" title={`Actual ${money(a, 'full')} · forecast ${money(v - a, 'full')}`}>{v ? money(v) : <span className="text-faint">–</span>}</td> })}
                    <td className="num font-semibold">{money(t)}</td>
                    <td className="num text-muted">{grand ? `${((t / grand) * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : '—'}</td>
                  </tr>
                )
              })}
              <tr>
                <td className="sticky left-0 z-[1] bg-surface"><span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">990</span> Contingency held</td>
                {r.years.map((y) => <td key={y} className="num text-muted">{r.contingency[y] ? money(r.contingency[y]) : '–'}</td>)}
                <td className="num font-semibold">{money(sum(Object.values(r.contingency)))}</td>
                <td className="num text-muted">{grand ? `${((sum(Object.values(r.contingency)) / grand) * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : ''}</td>
              </tr>
              <tr className="bg-sunken font-semibold">
                <td className="sticky left-0 z-[1] bg-sunken">Total</td>
                {r.years.map((y) => <td key={y} className="num">{money(rollupYearTotal(r, y))}</td>)}
                <td className="num">{money(grand)}</td><td className="num">100%</td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="p-4">
          <BarChart labels={r.years} stacked height={260} series={[
            ...top.map((f, i) => ({ name: `${f.code} ${f.name}`, values: r.years.map((y) => rollupCell(r, f.id, y)), color: colors[i] })),
            { name: 'Other functions', values: r.years.map((y) => sum(rest.map((f) => rollupCell(r, f.id, y)))), color: 'rgb(var(--muted) / 0.55)' },
            { name: 'Contingency held', values: r.years.map((y) => r.contingency[y] || 0), color: 'rgb(var(--faint) / 0.5)' },
          ]} />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 border-t border-line px-4 py-2 text-[11.5px] text-muted">
        <span><b className="text-ink">A</b> recorded actuals · <b className="text-ink">F</b> forecast ETC · hover a cell for the split</span>
        <span>Loaders and escalation are allocated to functions pro-rata to direct cost</span>
        <span className="ml-auto"><Badge tone="neutral">{r.projects.filter((x) => x.version.status !== 'approved').length} unapproved versions included</Badge></span>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

function PortfolioEtcEac({ program }: { program: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [basis, setBasis] = useState<RollupBasis>('latest')
  const projects = useMemo(() => s.projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'active' && (!program || p.programId === program)), [s.projects, program])
  const r = useMemo(() => portfolioEtcEac(s, projects, basis), [s, projects, basis])
  const prog = s.programs.find((x) => x.id === program)
  const scope = prog ? `${prog.code} ${prog.name}` : 'All programs'
  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const res = await saveFile(`etc-eac-by-function-${basis}-${prog?.code ?? 'all'}-${s.settings.asOf}.csv`, toCSV(portfolioEtcEacCsv(r)), 'text/csv')
    if (res === 'saved') toast('ETC / EAC by function exported')
  }
  if (!r.projects.length) return null
  const worst = [...r.rows].sort((a, b) => a.vac - b.vac)[0]
  return (
    <Panel className="mt-4" pad={false} title="ETC / EAC by WBS function — portfolio"
      subtitle={`${scope} · ${r.projects.length} projects · SAP actuals to each version’s actuals month + ETC by forecast line item, ${basis === 'latest' ? 'latest version of each project' : 'latest approved versions only'}`}
      actions={<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <SegButtons value={basis} onChange={setBasis} options={[{ id: 'latest', label: 'Latest' }, { id: 'approved', label: 'Approved only' }]} />
        <Button size="sm" onClick={exportCsv} icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}>CSV</Button>
      </div>}>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-px border-b border-line bg-line md:grid-cols-4">
        <PFig label="Budget" value={money(r.totals.budget)} sub={`incl. ${money(r.budgetContingency)} contingency`} />
        <PFig label="Actual to date" value={money(r.totals.actual)} sub={r.totals.eac ? `${Math.round((r.totals.actual / r.totals.eac) * 100)}% of EAC spent` : ''} />
        <PFig label="EAC" value={money(r.totals.eac)} tone={r.totals.vac < 0 ? 'bad' : undefined} sub={`ETC ${money(r.totals.etc)} incl. ${money(r.contingencyHeld)} held`} />
        <PFig label="VAC" value={moneyDelta(r.totals.vac)} tone={r.totals.vac < 0 ? 'bad' : 'good'} sub={worst && worst.vac < 0 ? `largest overrun ${worst.code} ${worst.name} ${moneyDelta(worst.vac)}` : 'no function over budget'} />
      </div>
      <EtcEacTable s={s} rows={r.rows.map((x) => ({ ...x, note: x.over.length ? (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">{x.over.slice(0, 4).map((o) => <a key={o.p.id} href={projectHref(o.p.id, 'forecast')} title={`${o.p.name}: ${moneyDelta(o.vac)}`} className="rounded border border-bad/30 bg-bad/10 px-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-bad hover:underline">{o.p.code.replace('PRJ-', '')}</a>)}{x.over.length > 4 && <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">+{x.over.length - 4}</span>}</div>
      ) : <span className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">none</span> }))}
        showProfile={false} extraHeader="Projects over" contingencyBudget={r.budgetContingency} contingencyHeld={r.contingencyHeld} totals={r.totals} />
    </Panel>
  )
}

function PFig({ label, value, sub, tone }: { label: string; value: string; sub?: string; tone?: 'good' | 'bad' }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0 bg-surface px-4 py-2.5">
      <div className="eyebrow truncate">{label}</div>
      <div className={cx('mt-0.5 font-display text-[20px] font-bold leading-tight tabular-nums', tone === 'bad' ? 'text-bad' : tone === 'good' ? 'text-good' : 'text-ink')}>{value}</div>
      {sub && <div className="truncate text-[11.5px] text-muted" title={sub}>{sub}</div>}
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/forecast/Grid.tsx =====
// The time-phased forecast grid: WBS functions (roll-ups) expandable to forecast line items (editable).
// Actual months sit before the forecast months, read-only, and drill to the SAP rows behind them.
// Spreadsheet keys on line cells: arrows move (left/right at the edge of the text), Enter moves down, Esc reverts,
// a tab-separated block pasted from Excel fills right and down across the visible line rows.
import React, { useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, FnProfile, Money } from '@/core/types'
import { cx, sum } from '@/core/util'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { ProfileChip } from './Profiles'
import { applyPaste, gridCols, isBlock, parseClipboard, parseMoney, rowTotal, setCell, setYearTotal, shortMonth, type FnGroup, type GridCol, type Spread } from './lib'

export type Unit = 1 | 1000

export function fmtUnit(v: number, unit: Unit): string {
  if (!v) return '–'
  const x = v / unit
  const neg = x < 0
  const a = Math.abs(x)
  const s = a.toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: unit === 1 ? 0 : a < 100 ? 1 : 0 })
  return neg ? `(${s})` : s
}
const rawUnit = (v: number, unit: Unit) => (v ? String(Math.round((v / unit) * 1000) / 1000) : '')

export interface DrillTarget { lineId?: string; fnId?: string; months: string[]; amount: Money }

export interface LineGridProps {
  s: AppState
  groups: FnGroup[]
  lines: Spread // line × month ETC
  held: Money
  editable: boolean
  budget: Record<string, Money> // by line
  budgetContingency: Money
  actual: Record<string, Money> // by line, through the version's actuals month
  actualMonths: string[] // shown actual months (empty = hidden)
  actualGrid: Spread // line × month actuals
  futureMonths: string[]
  closedThrough: string
  collapsed: Set<string>
  onToggleYear: (y: string) => void
  pastCollapsed: Set<string>
  onTogglePastYear: (y: string) => void
  expanded: Set<string>
  onToggleFn: (fnId: string) => void
  profiles: Record<string, FnProfile>
  unit: Unit
  onChange: (next: Spread, what: string, fnIds: string[]) => void
  onHeld: (v: Money) => void
  onProfile?: (fnId: string) => void
  onLineTools?: (lineId: string) => void
  onDrill?: (t: DrillTarget) => void
}

export function LineGrid(props: LineGridProps) {
  const { s, groups, lines, held, editable, budget, budgetContingency, actual, actualMonths, actualGrid, futureMonths, closedThrough, collapsed, onToggleYear, pastCollapsed, onTogglePastYear, expanded, onToggleFn, profiles, unit, onChange, onHeld, onProfile, onLineTools, onDrill } = props
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const pastCols = useMemo(() => gridCols(actualMonths, pastCollapsed), [actualMonths, pastCollapsed])
  const cols = useMemo(() => gridCols(futureMonths, collapsed), [futureMonths, collapsed])
  const editRows = groups.filter((g) => expanded.has(g.fn.id)).flatMap((g) => g.lines.map((l) => l.id))
  const fnOfLine = (lid: string) => groups.find((g) => g.lines.some((l) => l.id === lid))?.fn.id
  const val = (ids: string[], c: GridCol) => sum(ids.flatMap((id) => c.months.map((m) => lines[id]?.[m] || 0)))
  const pastVal = (ids: string[], c: GridCol) => sum(ids.flatMap((id) => c.months.map((m) => actualGrid[id]?.[m] || 0)))
  const allIds = groups.flatMap((g) => g.lines.map((l) => l.id))

  const focusCell = (r: number, c: number) => {
    const el = ref.current?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(`input[data-r="${r}"][data-c="${c}"]`)
    if (el) { el.focus(); el.select() }
  }
  const commit = (lid: string, ci: number, v: number, label: string) => {
    const col = cols[ci]
    if (!col) return
    if (v === val([lid], col)) return
    onChange(col.kind === 'year' ? setYearTotal(lines, lid, col.months, v) : setCell(lines, lid, col.key, v), `${label} ${col.kind === 'year' ? col.key + ' total' : shortMonth(col.key)}`, [fnOfLine(lid) ?? ''])
  }
  const paste = (r: number, c: number, text: string) => {
    const block = parseClipboard(text)
    const res = applyPaste(lines, editRows, cols.map((x) => x.key), r, c, block, unit, futureMonths)
    const touched = editRows.slice(r, r + block.length).map(fnOfLine).filter(Boolean) as string[]
    onChange(res.spread, `pasted ${res.filled} cells`, [...new Set(touched)])
    toast(res.rejected.length ? `Pasted ${res.filled} cells · ${res.rejected.length} not numbers skipped` : `Pasted ${res.filled} cells`, res.rejected.length ? 'bad' : 'good')
  }

  const colTotals = cols.map((c) => val(allIds, c))
  const pastTotals = pastCols.map((c) => pastVal(allIds, c))
  const budTotal = sum(allIds.map((id) => budget[id] || 0)) + budgetContingency
  const actTotal = sum(allIds.map((id) => actual[id] || 0))
  const etcTotal = sum(allIds.map((id) => rowTotal(lines, id))) + held
  const eacTotal = actTotal + etcTotal

  const yearGroups = (cs: GridCol[]) => {
    const g: { year: string; span: number; collapsed: boolean }[] = []
    for (const c of cs) {
      const y = c.key.slice(0, 4)
      const last = g[g.length - 1]
      if (last && last.year === y) last.span++
      else g.push({ year: y, span: 1, collapsed: c.kind === 'year' })
    }
    return g
  }
  const pastGroups = yearGroups(pastCols)
  const futGroups = yearGroups(cols)
  const stickyTh = 'sticky left-0 z-[3] bg-sunken'
  const numTd = 'whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-1 text-right tabular-nums'
  const sep = 'border-l border-line'
  const boundary = 'border-l-2 border-l-ink/25' // between actual and forecast months
  const pastSep = (c: GridCol, i: number) => (i === 0 ? boundary : c.key.endsWith('-01') || c.kind === 'year' ? sep : '')
  const futSep = (c: GridCol, i: number) => (i === 0 ? (pastCols.length ? boundary : sep) : c.key.endsWith('-01') || c.kind === 'year' ? sep : '')
  let r = -1

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="scroll-x rounded-md border border-line" role="grid" aria-label="Forecast by WBS function and line item, by month">
      <table className="w-max min-w-full border-separate border-spacing-0 text-[12px]">
        <thead className="text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">
          <tr>
            <th rowSpan={2} className={cx(stickyTh, 'min-w-[170px] max-w-[240px] border-b border-r border-line px-2 py-1.5 text-left align-bottom md:min-w-[270px]')}>WBS function · line item</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="border-b border-line bg-sunken px-2 py-1.5 text-right align-bottom">Budget</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="border-b border-line bg-sunken px-2 py-1.5 text-right align-bottom">Actual to date</th>
            {pastGroups.map((g, i) => (
              <th key={'p' + g.year} colSpan={g.span} className={cx('border-b border-line bg-ground px-1 py-1 text-center text-faint', i === 0 ? boundary : sep)}>
                <button className="hover:text-ink" onClick={() => onTogglePastYear(g.year)} title={g.collapsed ? 'Expand months' : 'Collapse to year'}>{g.collapsed ? '▸' : '▾'} {g.year} actual · SAP</button>
              </th>
            ))}
            {futGroups.map((g, i) => (
              <th key={'f' + g.year} colSpan={g.span} className={cx('border-b border-line bg-sunken px-1 py-1 text-center text-ink', i === 0 && pastGroups.length ? boundary : sep)}>
                <button className="hover:text-link" onClick={() => onToggleYear(g.year)} title={g.collapsed ? 'Expand months' : 'Collapse to year'}>{g.collapsed ? '▸' : '▾'} {g.year} forecast</button>
              </th>
            ))}
            <th rowSpan={2} className={cx('border-b border-line bg-sunken px-2 py-1.5 text-right align-bottom', sep)}>ETC</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="border-b border-line bg-sunken px-2 py-1.5 text-right align-bottom">EAC</th>
            <th rowSpan={2} className="border-b border-line bg-sunken px-2 py-1.5 text-right align-bottom" title="Variance at completion = budget − EAC">VAC</th>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            {pastCols.map((c, i) => <th key={'pm' + c.key} className={cx('border-b border-line bg-ground px-2 py-1 text-right font-medium normal-case italic text-faint', pastSep(c, i))}>{c.kind === 'year' ? `${c.key} total` : shortMonth(c.key)}</th>)}
            {cols.map((c, i) => {
              const closed = c.kind === 'month' && c.key <= closedThrough
              return <th key={'fm' + c.key} title={closed ? 'This month has closed in SAP — carry this ETC forward' : undefined} className={cx('border-b border-line px-2 py-1 text-right font-medium normal-case', closed ? 'bg-warn/15 text-warn' : 'bg-sunken text-muted', futSep(c, i))}>{c.kind === 'year' ? `${c.key} total` : shortMonth(c.key)}</th>
            })}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {groups.map((g) => {
            const ids = g.lines.map((l) => l.id)
            const open = expanded.has(g.fn.id)
            const bud = sum(ids.map((id) => budget[id] || 0))
            const act = sum(ids.map((id) => actual[id] || 0))
            const etc = sum(ids.map((id) => rowTotal(lines, id)))
            const eac = act + etc
            const v = bud - eac
            const over = eac > bud && eac > 0
            const prof = profiles[g.fn.id]
            return (
              <React.Fragment key={g.fn.id}>
                <tr className="bg-sunken/40 font-semibold">
                  <td className="sticky left-0 z-[2] border-b border-r border-line bg-sunken px-1.5 py-1">
                    <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5">
                      <button onClick={() => onToggleFn(g.fn.id)} aria-expanded={open} aria-label={`${open ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'} ${g.fn.name}`} className="w-4 shrink-0 text-muted hover:text-ink">{open ? '▾' : '▸'}</button>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">{g.fn.code}</span>
                      <span className={cx('min-w-0 truncate', g.fn.retired && 'text-muted line-through')} title={g.fn.name}>{g.fn.name}</span>
                      {over && <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-bad" title="EAC exceeds budget" />}
                      <span className="ml-auto flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                        <ProfileChip s={s} profile={prof} onClick={editable && onProfile && g.lines.length ? () => onProfile(g.fn.id) : undefined} />
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line')}>{fmtUnit(bud, unit)}</td>
                  <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line')}>{fmtUnit(act, unit)}</td>
                  {pastCols.map((c, i) => { const x = pastVal(ids, c); return <td key={c.key} className={cx('border-b border-line bg-ground p-0', pastSep(c, i))}><ActCell v={x} unit={unit} onClick={onDrill && x ? () => onDrill({ fnId: g.fn.id, months: c.months, amount: x }) : undefined} label={`${g.fn.name} ${c.key}`} /></td> })}
                  {cols.map((c, ci) => { const x = val(ids, c); return <td key={c.key} className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line', futSep(c, ci), c.kind === 'year' && 'bg-sunken/40', x < 0 && 'text-bad')}>{fmtUnit(x, unit)}</td> })}
                  <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line', sep)}>{fmtUnit(etc, unit)}</td>
                  <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line', over && 'text-bad')}>{fmtUnit(eac, unit)}</td>
                  <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line', v < 0 ? 'text-bad' : v > 0 ? 'text-good' : 'text-muted')}>{v ? (v > 0 ? '+' : '') + fmtUnit(v, unit) : '–'}</td>
                </tr>
                {open && g.lines.map((l) => {
                  const ri = editable ? ++r : -1
                  const le = rowTotal(lines, l.id)
                  const la = actual[l.id] || 0
                  const lb = budget[l.id] || 0
                  const lv = lb - la - le
                  return (
                    <tr key={l.id} className="group">
                      <td className="sticky left-0 z-[2] border-b border-r border-line bg-surface py-1 pl-7 pr-1.5 group-hover:bg-sunken">
                        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">{l.code}</span>
                          <span className={cx('min-w-0 truncate', l.inactive && 'text-muted line-through')} title={l.name + (l.inactive ? ' (inactive line)' : '')}>{l.name}</span>
                          {editable && onLineTools && <button aria-label={`Line tools for ${l.name}`} title="Phase, set to remaining or clear this line" onClick={() => onLineTools(l.id)} className="ml-auto shrink-0 rounded border border-line bg-surface px-1.5 text-[10.5px] font-semibold text-muted opacity-70 hover:border-ink/40 hover:text-ink group-hover:opacity-100">Tools</button>}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line text-muted')}>{fmtUnit(lb, unit)}</td>
                      <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line text-muted')}>{fmtUnit(la, unit)}</td>
                      {pastCols.map((c, i) => { const x = pastVal([l.id], c); return <td key={c.key} className={cx('border-b border-line bg-ground p-0', pastSep(c, i))}><ActCell v={x} unit={unit} muted onClick={onDrill && x ? () => onDrill({ lineId: l.id, fnId: g.fn.id, months: c.months, amount: x }) : undefined} label={`${l.name} ${c.key}`} /></td> })}
                      {cols.map((c, ci) => {
                        const x = val([l.id], c)
                        const closed = c.kind === 'month' && c.key <= closedThrough
                        return (
                          <td key={c.key} className={cx('border-b border-line p-0', futSep(c, ci), c.kind === 'year' && 'bg-sunken/30')}>
                            {editable
                              ? <CellInput value={x} unit={unit} r={ri} c={ci} label={`${l.code} ${l.name} ${c.kind === 'year' ? c.key + ' total' : shortMonth(c.key)}`} warn={closed && x !== 0} onCommit={(nv) => commit(l.id, ci, nv, l.code)} onPaste={(t) => paste(ri, ci, t)} onNav={focusCell} maxR={editRows.length - 1} maxC={cols.length - 1} />
                              : <div className={cx(numTd, 'min-w-[76px]', x < 0 && 'bg-bad/10 text-bad', closed && x !== 0 && 'bg-warn/10')}>{fmtUnit(x, unit)}</div>}
                          </td>
                        )
                      })}
                      <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line', sep)}>{fmtUnit(le, unit)}</td>
                      <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line', la + le > lb && la + le > 0 && 'text-bad')}>{fmtUnit(la + le, unit)}</td>
                      <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line', lv < 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-muted')}>{lv ? (lv > 0 ? '+' : '') + fmtUnit(lv, unit) : '–'}</td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                })}
              </React.Fragment>
            )
          })}
          <tr>
            <td className="sticky left-0 z-[2] border-b border-r border-line bg-surface px-2 py-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pl-5"><span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">990</span><span className="font-semibold">Contingency held</span></div>
              <div className="pl-5 text-[10.5px] text-faint">In EAC, not spread to a line</div>
            </td>
            <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line text-muted')}>{fmtUnit(budgetContingency, unit)}</td>
            <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line text-faint')}>–</td>
            {pastCols.map((c, i) => <td key={c.key} className={cx('border-b border-line bg-ground', pastSep(c, i))} />)}
            {cols.map((c, ci) => <td key={c.key} className={cx('border-b border-line', futSep(c, ci))} />)}
            <td className={cx('border-b border-line p-0', sep)}>
              {editable
                ? <CellInput value={held} unit={unit} r={editRows.length} c={-1} label="Contingency held" onCommit={onHeld} onNav={() => undefined} maxR={editRows.length} maxC={0} />
                : <div className={cx(numTd, 'font-semibold')}>{fmtUnit(held, unit)}</div>}
            </td>
            <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line font-semibold')}>{fmtUnit(held, unit)}</td>
            <td className={cx(numTd, 'border-b border-line font-semibold', budgetContingency - held < 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-muted')}>{budgetContingency - held ? (budgetContingency - held > 0 ? '+' : '') + fmtUnit(budgetContingency - held, unit) : '–'}</td>
          </tr>
          <tr className="bg-sunken font-semibold">
            <td className="sticky left-0 z-[2] border-r border-line bg-sunken px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide">Total</td>
            <td className={cx(numTd, 'bg-sunken')}>{fmtUnit(budTotal, unit)}</td>
            <td className={cx(numTd, 'bg-sunken')}>{fmtUnit(actTotal, unit)}</td>
            {pastCols.map((c, i) => <td key={c.key} className={cx('bg-sunken p-0 text-muted', pastSep(c, i))}><ActCell v={pastTotals[i]} unit={unit} label={`All lines ${c.key}`} onClick={onDrill && pastTotals[i] ? () => onDrill({ months: c.months, amount: pastTotals[i] }) : undefined} /></td>)}
            {cols.map((c, i) => <td key={c.key} title={colTotals[i] < 0 ? 'Negative month — check credits or reversals' : undefined} className={cx(numTd, colTotals[i] < 0 ? 'bg-bad/15 text-bad' : 'bg-sunken', futSep(c, i))}>{fmtUnit(colTotals[i], unit)}</td>)}
            <td className={cx(numTd, 'bg-sunken', sep)}>{fmtUnit(etcTotal, unit)}</td>
            <td className={cx(numTd, 'bg-sunken', eacTotal > budTotal && 'text-bad')}>{fmtUnit(eacTotal, unit)}</td>
            <td className={cx(numTd, 'bg-sunken', budTotal - eacTotal < 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{budTotal - eacTotal ? (budTotal - eacTotal > 0 ? '+' : '') + fmtUnit(budTotal - eacTotal, unit) : '–'}</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  )
}

/** A read-only actual cell; clickable when there is something to drill into. */
function ActCell({ v, unit, onClick, muted, label }: { v: number; unit: Unit; onClick?: () => void; muted?: boolean; label: string }) {
  const cls = cx('block w-full min-w-[70px] whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-1 text-right italic tabular-nums', muted ? 'text-muted' : 'text-ink/80', v < 0 && 'text-bad')
  if (!onClick) return <span className={cls}>{fmtUnit(v, unit)}</span>
  return <button onClick={onClick} aria-label={`SAP transactions for ${label}`} title="Show the SAP transactions behind this actual" className={cx(cls, 'underline decoration-dotted decoration-faint underline-offset-2 hover:bg-link/10 hover:text-link')}>{fmtUnit(v, unit)}</button>
}

function CellInput({ value, unit, r, c, label, warn, onCommit, onPaste, onNav, maxR, maxC }: {
  value: number; unit: Unit; r: number; c: number; label: string; warn?: boolean
  onCommit: (v: number) => void; onPaste?: (text: string) => void; onNav: (r: number, c: number) => void; maxR: number; maxC: number
}) {
  const [txt, setTxt] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const done = () => {
    if (txt === null) return
    const v = parseMoney(txt, unit)
    setTxt(null)
    if (v === null) { toast(`"${txt}" is not an amount — try 125000, $1.2M or 450K`, 'bad'); return }
    if (v !== value) onCommit(v)
  }
  const key = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const el = e.currentTarget
    const len = el.value.length
    const all = el.selectionStart === 0 && el.selectionEnd === len
    const go = (dr: number, dc: number) => {
      e.preventDefault()
      const nr = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxR, r + dr)), nc = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxC, c + dc))
      if (nr === r && nc === c) return
      el.blur()
      onNav(nr, nc)
    }
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'Enter': return e.shiftKey ? go(-1, 0) : go(1, 0)
      case 'ArrowDown': return go(1, 0)
      case 'ArrowUp': return go(-1, 0)
      case 'ArrowLeft': if (all || (el.selectionStart === 0 && el.selectionEnd === 0)) go(0, -1); return
      case 'ArrowRight': if (all || (el.selectionStart === len && el.selectionEnd === len)) go(0, 1); return
      case 'Escape': e.preventDefault(); setTxt(rawUnit(value, unit)); setTimeout(() => el.select()); return
    }
  }
  const editing = txt !== null
  return (
    <input
      data-r={r} data-c={c} aria-label={label} inputMode="decimal" spellCheck={false}
      value={editing ? txt! : value ? fmtUnit(value, unit) : ''}
      placeholder="–"
      onFocus={(e) => { setTxt(rawUnit(value, unit)); const t = e.currentTarget; setTimeout(() => t.select()) }}
      onChange={(e) => setTxt(e.target.value)}
      onBlur={done}
      onKeyDown={key}
      onPaste={(e) => { const t = e.clipboardData.getData('text'); if (onPaste && isBlock(t)) { e.preventDefault(); setTxt(null); onPaste(t) } }}
      className={cx('h-7 w-full min-w-[76px] rounded-none border border-transparent bg-transparent px-2 text-right text-[12px] tabular-nums outline-none placeholder:text-faint hover:border-line focus:border-link focus:bg-surface focus:ring-1 focus:ring-link/40',
        value < 0 && !editing && 'bg-bad/10 text-bad', warn && !editing && 'bg-warn/15')}
    />
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/forecast/lib.ts =====
// Pure helpers for the forecast spread grid, the monthly forecast cycle and the WBS roll-ups.
// No React, no store access: everything takes AppState (or a draft of it) so it can be unit-tested.
import type { ActualTxn, AppState, FnProfile, Forecast, Money, Project, WbsFunction } from '@/core/types'
import {
  actualsByFunctionMonth, actualsThrough, budgetByFunction, defaultSpread, eacOf, forecastMonths,
  spreadAmount, spreadByFunction, spreadByMonth, spreadByYear, spreadTotal, type SpreadMethod,
} from '@/core/engine/wbs'
import { activeBudget } from '@/core/engine/position'
import {
  actualsByLineMonth, allProfiles, applyProfile, budgetByLine, defaultLineSpread, etcEacByFunction, functionOfLine, lineById, lineGridOf,
  profileName, profileWeights, rollupGrid, spreadByWeights, syncForecast, type FunctionRow,
} from '@/core/engine/lines'
import { addMonths, monthKey, sum, uid } from '@/core/util'

export type Spread = Record<string, Record<string, Money>>
export type VersionStatus = 'draft' | 'submitted' | 'approved' | 'returned'
export type CycleStatus = 'approved' | 'in-review' | 'draft' | 'returned' | 'not-started'

// ───────────────────────────── Cell entry

/**
 * Parse what a person types (or pastes) into a money cell: `1234`, `$1,234`, `1.2M`, `450k`, `(5,000)`, `-5k`.
 * Blank means zero. Returns null when the text is not a number. `scale` applies to plain numbers only
 * (1000 when the grid shows $K); a K/M/B suffix is always absolute.
 */
export function parseMoney(raw: string, scale = 1): number | null {
  let t = (raw ?? '').trim()
  if (!t || t === '-' || t === '—' || t === '–') return 0
  let neg = false
  if (/^\(.*\)$/.test(t)) { neg = true; t = t.slice(1, -1) }
  t = t.replace(/[$,\s]/g, '').replace(/^[−–]/, '-')
  if (t.startsWith('-')) { neg = !neg; t = t.slice(1) }
  if (t.startsWith('$')) t = t.slice(1)
  const m = /^(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)([kmb])?$/i.exec(t)
  if (!m) return null
  const mult = ({ k: 1e3, m: 1e6, b: 1e9 } as Record<string, number>)[(m[2] ?? '').toLowerCase()] ?? scale
  const v = Math.round(parseFloat(m[1]) * mult)
  return neg ? -v : v
}

/** Whole dollars with separators for an input being edited ('' for zero). */
export const fmtCell = (n: number | undefined) => (n ? Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US') : '')

/** A tab-separated block copied from Excel → rows of cells. Trailing blank line dropped. */
export function parseClipboard(text: string): string[][] {
  const rows = (text ?? '').replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n').split('\n')
  if (rows.length > 1 && rows[rows.length - 1] === '') rows.pop()
  return rows.map((r) => r.split('\t'))
}

/** True when pasted text is a block (more than one cell) rather than a single value. */
export const isBlock = (text: string) => /[\t\n]/.test((text ?? '').replace(/\r?\n$/, ''))

// ───────────────────────────── Spread edits (all return a new spread; zero cells are dropped)

export const cloneSpread = (s?: Spread): Spread => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(s ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => [k, { ...v }]))

export function setCell(spread: Spread, fnId: string, month: string, v: Money): Spread {
  const out = cloneSpread(spread)
  const row = (out[fnId] ||= {})
  if (v) row[month] = Math.round(v)
  else delete row[month]
  return out
}

export const rowTotal = (spread: Spread, fnId: string) => sum(Object.values(spread[fnId] ?? {}))

/**
 * Paste a block at (row r0, column c0). `rows` are function ids; `cols` are the grid's editable columns in
 * order — a month key ('YYYY-MM') or a collapsed year ('YYYY', which sets that year's total across `months`).
 */
export function applyPaste(spread: Spread, rows: string[], cols: string[], r0: number, c0: number, block: string[][], scale = 1, months: string[] = []): { spread: Spread; filled: number; rejected: string[] } {
  let out = cloneSpread(spread)
  let filled = 0
  const rejected: string[] = []
  block.forEach((line, i) => {
    const fn = rows[r0 + i]
    if (!fn) return
    line.forEach((cell, j) => {
      const col = cols[c0 + j]
      if (!col) return
      const v = parseMoney(cell, scale)
      if (v === null) { rejected.push(cell); return }
      out = col.length === 4 ? setYearTotal(out, fn, months.filter((m) => m.startsWith(col)), v) : setCell(out, fn, col, v)
      filled++
    })
  })
  return { spread: out, filled, rejected }
}

/** Set a row's total for one year: keeps the year's monthly shape when it has one, else spreads evenly. */
export function setYearTotal(spread: Spread, fnId: string, yearMonths: string[], v: Money): Spread {
  const row = spread[fnId] ?? {}
  const shape = yearMonths.map((m) => row[m] || 0)
  const vals = shape.some((x) => x > 0) ? distribute(Math.round(v), shape) : distribute(Math.round(v), yearMonths.map(() => 1))
  let out = cloneSpread(spread)
  yearMonths.forEach((m, i) => { out = setCell(out, fnId, m, vals[i]) })
  return out
}

/** Integer split of `total` by weights that sums exactly to total. */
export function distribute(total: Money, weights: number[]): Money[] {
  const W = sum(weights.map((w) => Math.max(0, w)))
  if (!weights.length) return []
  const ws = W > 0 ? weights.map((w) => Math.max(0, w)) : weights.map(() => 1)
  const T = W > 0 ? W : weights.length
  let acc = 0
  return ws.map((w, i) => {
    const v = i === ws.length - 1 ? total - acc : Math.round((total * w) / T)
    acc += v
    return v
