  })
}

/** Spread `amount` from `from` to `to` (inclusive) by a curve. Replaces the whole row. */
export function spreadRow(spread: Spread, fnId: string, months: string[], amount: Money, method: SpreadMethod, from: string, to: string): Spread {
  const range = months.filter((m) => m >= from && m <= to)
  const out = cloneSpread(spread)
  const vals = range.length ? spreadAmount(Math.round(amount), range, method) : {}
  out[fnId] = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(vals).filter(([, v]) => v))
  return out
}

export function clearRow(spread: Spread, fnId: string): Spread {
  const out = cloneSpread(spread)
  out[fnId] = {}
  return out
}

/** Set a row's ETC to `target`: keep the row's shape when it has one, else spread by `method` over `months`. */
export function scaleRow(spread: Spread, fnId: string, months: string[], target: Money, method: SpreadMethod): Spread {
  const row = spread[fnId] ?? {}
  const keys = Object.keys(row).filter((k) => row[k]).sort()
  const out = cloneSpread(spread)
  if (keys.length && rowTotal(spread, fnId) > 0) {
    const vals = distribute(Math.round(target), keys.map((k) => row[k]))
    out[fnId] = Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k, i) => [k, vals[i]]).filter(([, v]) => v))
  } else {
    out[fnId] = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(spreadAmount(Math.round(target), months, method)).filter(([, v]) => v))
  }
  return out
}

export const TIMING_METHOD: Record<WbsFunction['timing'], SpreadMethod> = { early: 'front', mid: 'scurve', late: 'back', flat: 'even' }

/** Budget − actuals by function (never negative). */
export function remainingByFunction(s: AppState, pid: string): Record<string, Money> {
  const bud = budgetByFunction(s, pid).byFn
  const act = actualsByFunction2(s, pid)
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(bud).map((k) => [k, Math.max(0, (bud[k] || 0) - (act[k] || 0))]))
}

// ───────────────────────────── Versions

export const statusOf = (f: Forecast): VersionStatus => f.status ?? (f.locked ? 'approved' : 'draft')
export const isEditable = (f: Forecast) => !f.locked && (statusOf(f) === 'draft' || statusOf(f) === 'returned')

/** Newest first; drafts after a same-day approved version (matches latestForecast). */
export function versionsOf(s: AppState, pid: string): Forecast[] {
  return s.forecasts.filter((f) => f.projectId === pid).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date) || (statusOf(a) === 'draft' ? -1 : 1))
}

const monthBefore = (m: string) => monthKey(addMonths(m + '-01', -1))
const monthAfter = (m: string) => monthKey(addMonths(m + '-01', 1))

/** Last month treated as actuals for a version: its actualsThrough, or the month before its first ETC month. */
export function versionCutoff(s: AppState, f: Forecast): string {
  const months = Object.values(f.spread ?? {}).flatMap((r) => Object.keys(r)).sort()
  const a = f.actualsThrough ?? actualsThrough(s, f.projectId)
  const b = months.length ? monthBefore(months[0]) : a
  return a > b ? a : b
}

/**
 * Actuals by function through a cutoff month. Periods without a recorded split are allocated by budget share in
 * the engine, which can leave a few dollars of rounding; the residual goes to the largest function so the
 * functions always sum to the ERP actual.
 */
export function actualsByFunction2(s: AppState, pid: string, through?: string): Record<string, Money> {
  const m = actualsByFunctionMonth(s, pid)
  const out = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(m).map(([fn, row]) => [fn, sum(Object.entries(row).filter(([k]) => !through || k <= through).map(([, v]) => v))]))
  const truth = sum(s.costPeriods.filter((c) => c.projectId === pid && (!through || c.period <= through)).map((c) => c.actual))
  const resid = truth - sum(Object.values(out))
  if (resid) {
    const big = Object.keys(out).sort((a, b) => out[b] - out[a])[0]
    if (big) out[big] += resid
  }
  return out
}

/** Calendar-year EAC: actuals by year + ETC by year (+ contingency held in the final year). */
export function byYearOf(s: AppState, pid: string, spread: Spread, held: Money): Record<string, Money> {
  const out: Record<string, Money> = {}
  for (const c of s.costPeriods.filter((x) => x.projectId === pid)) out[c.period.slice(0, 4)] = (out[c.period.slice(0, 4)] || 0) + c.actual
  for (const [y, v] of Object.entries(spreadByYear(spread))) out[y] = (out[y] || 0) + v
  const ys = Object.keys(out).sort()
  if (held) { if (ys.length) out[ys[ys.length - 1]] += held; else out[s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4)] = held }
  return out
}

export type SlipMode = 'net' | 'all' | 'drop'

/**
 * Carry a spread forward into a new actuals period. ETC sitting in months that are now closed is
 * re-spread across the row's remaining months (in proportion to what is already there, else evenly).
 * `net`: only the part not already consumed by that function's actuals in those months moves forward.
 * `all`: the whole amount moves forward. `drop`: stale ETC is removed (the actuals replace it).
 */
export function carryForward(s: AppState, p: Project, src: Spread, srcCutoff: string, slip: SlipMode = 'net'): { spread: Spread; moved: Money; movedBy: Record<string, Money> } {
  return carryForwardGrid(s, p, src, srcCutoff, slip, actualsByFunctionMonth(s, p.id))
}
/** Same as carryForward at forecast line level (actuals by line from SAP / the mapping table). */
export function carryForwardLines(s: AppState, p: Project, src: Spread, srcCutoff: string, slip: SlipMode = 'net'): { spread: Spread; moved: Money; movedBy: Record<string, Money> } {
  return carryForwardGrid(s, p, src, srcCutoff, slip, actualsByLineMonth(s, p.id))
}
function carryForwardGrid(s: AppState, p: Project, src: Spread, srcCutoff: string, slip: SlipMode, act: Spread): { spread: Spread; moved: Money; movedBy: Record<string, Money> } {
  const through = actualsThrough(s, p.id)
  const months = forecastMonths(s, p)
  const out: Spread = {}
  const movedBy: Record<string, Money> = {}
  let moved = 0
  for (const [fn, row] of Object.entries(src)) {
    const future: Record<string, Money> = {}
    let stale = 0
    for (const [m, v] of Object.entries(row)) {
      if (m > through) future[m] = v
      else stale += v
    }
    if (slip === 'drop') stale = 0
    if (stale && slip === 'net') {
      const spent = sum(Object.entries(act[fn] ?? {}).filter(([m]) => m > srcCutoff && m <= through).map(([, v]) => v))
      stale = Math.max(0, stale - spent)
    }
    if (stale) {
      const keys = Object.keys(future).filter((k) => future[k] > 0).sort()
      if (keys.length) {
        const add = distribute(stale, keys.map((k) => future[k]))
        keys.forEach((k, i) => { future[k] += add[i] })
      } else {
        const add = spreadAmount(stale, months, 'even')
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(add)) future[k] = (future[k] || 0) + v
      }
      moved += stale
      movedBy[fn] = stale
    }
    out[fn] = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(future).filter(([, v]) => v))
  }
  return { spread: out, moved, movedBy }
}

/**
 * A new draft version copied from `src` (as of today) at forecast-line level, with stale ETC carried forward
 * and each function's profile carried over (window clamped to the open months; marked adjusted when ETC moved).
 * With no source, the draft spreads each line's remaining budget by its function's typical timing.
 */
export function copyVersion(s: AppState, p: Project, src: Forecast | undefined, opts: { byId: string; note?: string; slip?: SlipMode }): { forecast: Forecast; moved: Money } {
  const held = src?.contingencyHeld ?? 0
  const months = forecastMonths(s, p)
  const hasSrc = !!src && (Object.keys(src.lineSpread ?? {}).length > 0 || Object.keys(src.spread ?? {}).length > 0)
  let lines: Spread, moved = 0, profiles: Record<string, FnProfile>
  if (hasSrc) {
    const r = carryForwardLines(s, p, stripZeros(lineGridOf(s, p, src)), versionCutoff(s, src!), opts.slip ?? 'net')
    lines = r.spread
    moved = r.moved
    const movedFns = new Set(Object.keys(r.movedBy).map((l) => functionOfLine(s, l)))
    profiles = carryProfiles(src!.profiles, months, movedFns)
  } else {
    const d = defaultLineSpread(s, p)
    lines = stripZeros(d.lineSpread)
    profiles = d.profiles
  }
  const forecast: Forecast = {
    id: uid('fc'), projectId: p.id, date: s.settings.asOf, eac: 0, byYear: {},
    note: opts.note ?? '', byId: opts.byId, locked: false, spread: {}, lineSpread: lines, profiles, contingencyHeld: held,
    actualsThrough: actualsThrough(s, p.id), status: 'draft',
  }
  syncForecast(s, forecast)
  return { forecast, moved }
}

/** Carry function profiles into a new period: windows start no earlier than the first open month. */
export function carryProfiles(src: Record<string, FnProfile> | undefined, months: string[], adjustedFns: Set<string | undefined> = new Set()): Record<string, FnProfile> {
  const out: Record<string, FnProfile> = {}
  const first = months[0]
  for (const [fn, pr] of Object.entries(src ?? {})) {
    const start = first && pr.start < first ? first : pr.start
    const end = pr.end < start ? start : pr.end
    out[fn] = { ...pr, start, end, adjusted: pr.adjusted || adjustedFns.has(fn) }
  }
  return out
}

/** Drop zero cells (profiles write explicit zeros outside their window). */
export function stripZeros(g?: Spread): Spread {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(g ?? {}).map(([k, row]) => [k, Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(row).filter(([, v]) => v))]))
}

/** Write a spread back to a forecast record (draft of the store) with recomputed EAC and calendar years. */
export function applySpread(d: AppState, f: Forecast, spread: Spread, held: Money, note: string) {
  f.spread = cloneSpread(spread)
  f.contingencyHeld = Math.round(held)
  f.note = note
  f.eac = eacOf(d, f.projectId, spread, held)
  f.byYear = byYearOf(d, f.projectId, spread, held)
}

/** Audit text for a save: which functions' ETC moved and by how much. */
export function diffSummary(fns: { id: string; code: string; name: string }[], before: Spread, after: Spread, heldBefore: Money, heldAfter: Money): string {
  const parts: string[] = []
  let cells = 0
  const ids = Array.from(new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(after)]))
  for (const id of ids) {
    const a = before[id] ?? {}, b = after[id] ?? {}
    for (const m of new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)])) if ((a[m] || 0) !== (b[m] || 0)) cells++
    const d = rowTotal(after, id) - rowTotal(before, id)
    const f = fns.find((x) => x.id === id)
    if (d) parts.push(`${f?.code ?? id} ${f?.name ?? ''} ${signed(d)}`.replace(/\s+/g, ' '))
  }
  if (heldAfter !== heldBefore) parts.push(`contingency held ${signed(heldAfter - heldBefore)}`)
  const etc = spreadTotal(after) - spreadTotal(before) + heldAfter - heldBefore
  if (!parts.length && !cells) return 'No changes to the spread'
  return `${cells} cell${cells === 1 ? '' : 's'} changed; ETC ${signed(etc)}${parts.length ? ' · ' + parts.join(', ') : ' (re-phased only)'}`
}
const signed = (n: number) => (n > 0 ? '+' : n < 0 ? '−' : '') + '$' + Math.abs(Math.round(n)).toLocaleString('en-US')

// ───────────────────────────── Function lists (including functions retired since a version was made)

export interface FnRef { id: string; code: string; name: string; retired: boolean; timing: WbsFunction['timing'] }
export function fnRefs(s: AppState, ...spreads: (Spread | undefined)[]): FnRef[] {
  const out: FnRef[] = s.settings.wbsFunctions.map((f) => ({ id: f.id, code: f.code, name: f.name, retired: false, timing: f.timing }))
  for (const sp of spreads) for (const id of Object.keys(sp ?? {})) {
    if (!out.some((x) => x.id === id) && rowTotal(sp!, id)) out.push({ id, code: id.replace(/^wbs-/, ''), name: 'Retired function', retired: true, timing: 'flat' })
  }
  return out
}

// ───────────────────────────── Compare two versions

export interface CompareRow { id: string; code: string; name: string; etcA: Money; etcB: Money; eacA: Money; eacB: Money; delta: Money }
export function compareVersions(s: AppState, a: Forecast, b: Forecast) {
  const fns = fnRefs(s, a.spread, b.spread)
  const actA = actualsByFunction2(s, a.projectId, versionCutoff(s, a))
  const actB = actualsByFunction2(s, b.projectId, versionCutoff(s, b))
  const ea = spreadByFunction(a.spread), eb = spreadByFunction(b.spread)
  const rows: CompareRow[] = fns.map((f) => {
    const eacA = (actA[f.id] || 0) + (ea[f.id] || 0), eacB = (actB[f.id] || 0) + (eb[f.id] || 0)
    return { id: f.id, code: f.code, name: f.name, etcA: ea[f.id] || 0, etcB: eb[f.id] || 0, eacA, eacB, delta: eacB - eacA }
  })
  const ma = spreadByMonth(a.spread), mb = spreadByMonth(b.spread)
  const months = Array.from(new Set([...Object.keys(ma), ...Object.keys(mb)])).sort().map((m) => ({ month: m, a: ma[m] || 0, b: mb[m] || 0, delta: (mb[m] || 0) - (ma[m] || 0) }))
  const movers = rows.filter((r) => r.delta).sort((x, y) => Math.abs(y.delta) - Math.abs(x.delta)).slice(0, 5)
  return { rows, months, movers, heldA: a.contingencyHeld ?? 0, heldB: b.contingencyHeld ?? 0, eacA: a.eac, eacB: b.eac }
}

// ───────────────────────────── Monthly cycle

/** The cycle opens on this day, after the prior month's actuals close in the ERP. */
export const CYCLE_OPEN_DAY = 21
/** Which monthly cycle a version dated `date` belongs to ('YYYY-MM'). */
export const cycleOf = (date: string) => (Number(date.slice(8, 10)) >= CYCLE_OPEN_DAY ? monthAfter(date.slice(0, 7)) : date.slice(0, 7))
export const currentCycle = (s: AppState) => cycleOf(s.settings.asOf)

export const inCycleScope = (s: AppState, p: Project) => p.status === 'active' && !!activeBudget(s, p.id)

export function cycleVersion(s: AppState, pid: string, cycle: string): Forecast | undefined {
  return versionsOf(s, pid).find((f) => cycleOf(f.date) === cycle)
}
export function cycleStatusOf(f?: Forecast): CycleStatus {
  if (!f) return 'not-started'
  const st = statusOf(f)
  return st === 'submitted' ? 'in-review' : st
}
/** Latest approved version other than `excludeId`. */
export function priorApproved(s: AppState, pid: string, excludeId?: string): Forecast | undefined {
  return versionsOf(s, pid).find((f) => f.id !== excludeId && statusOf(f) === 'approved')
}

export interface CycleRow { p: Project; status: CycleStatus; version?: Forecast; latest?: Forecast; prior?: Forecast; eac: Money; delta?: Money; budget: Money }
export function cycleRows(s: AppState, cycle = currentCycle(s)): CycleRow[] {
  return s.projects.filter((p) => inCycleScope(s, p)).map((p) => {
    const version = cycleVersion(s, p.id, cycle)
    const latest = versionsOf(s, p.id)[0]
    const prior = priorApproved(s, p.id, version?.id)
    const eac = (version ?? latest)?.eac ?? 0
    return { p, status: cycleStatusOf(version), version, latest, prior, eac, delta: prior && version ? version.eac - prior.eac : undefined, budget: budgetByFunction(s, p.id).total }
  })
}

/**
 * Open the cycle: a draft for every in-scope project that has no version this cycle, copied from its
 * latest version (stale ETC carried forward). Mutates `d`; returns the codes it created.
 */
export function startCycle(d: AppState, byId: string, slip: SlipMode = 'net'): { codes: string[]; moved: Money } {
  const cycle = currentCycle(d)
  const codes: string[] = []
  let moved = 0
  for (const p of d.projects.filter((x) => inCycleScope(d, x))) {
    if (cycleVersion(d, p.id, cycle)) continue
    const src = versionsOf(d, p.id)[0]
    const { forecast, moved: mv } = copyVersion(d, p, src, { byId: p.team.pm ?? byId, slip, note: `${monthLabel(cycle)} cycle — opened from ${src ? `the ${src.date} version` : 'remaining budget'}` })
    d.forecasts.push(forecast)
    codes.push(p.code)
    moved += mv
  }
  return { codes, moved }
}
const MONTHS = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December']
export const monthLabel = (k: string) => `${MONTHS[Number(k.slice(5, 7)) - 1]} ${k.slice(0, 4)}`

// ───────────────────────────── Portfolio roll-up (function × calendar year)

export type RollupBasis = 'latest' | 'approved'
export interface Rollup {
  years: string[]
  fns: FnRef[]
  actual: Record<string, Record<string, Money>> // fn → year → actuals
  forecast: Record<string, Record<string, Money>> // fn → year → ETC
  contingency: Record<string, Money> // year → held contingency
  projects: { p: Project; version: Forecast }[]
}
export function versionFor(s: AppState, pid: string, basis: RollupBasis): Forecast | undefined {
  return basis === 'approved' ? priorApproved(s, pid) : versionsOf(s, pid)[0]
}
export function rollup(s: AppState, projects: Project[], basis: RollupBasis = 'latest'): Rollup {
  const picked = projects.map((p) => ({ p, version: versionFor(s, p.id, basis)! })).filter((x) => x.version)
  const fns = fnRefs(s, ...picked.map((x) => x.version.spread))
  const actual: Rollup['actual'] = {}, forecast: Rollup['forecast'] = {}, contingency: Rollup['contingency'] = {}
  const years = new Set<string>()
  const add = (t: Record<string, Record<string, Money>>, fn: string, y: string, v: Money) => { if (!v) return; (t[fn] ||= {})[y] = (t[fn][y] || 0) + v; years.add(y) }
  for (const { p, version } of picked) {
    const cut = versionCutoff(s, version)
    const pys = new Set<string>()
    for (const [fn, row] of Object.entries(actualsByFunctionMonth(s, p.id))) for (const [m, v] of Object.entries(row)) if (m <= cut) { add(actual, fn, m.slice(0, 4), v); pys.add(m.slice(0, 4)) }
    for (const [fn, row] of Object.entries(version.spread ?? {})) for (const [m, v] of Object.entries(row)) { add(forecast, fn, m.slice(0, 4), v); if (v) pys.add(m.slice(0, 4)) }
    const held = version.contingencyHeld ?? 0
    if (held) { const y = [...pys].sort().pop() ?? s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4); contingency[y] = (contingency[y] || 0) + held; years.add(y) }
  }
  return { years: [...years].sort(), fns, actual, forecast, contingency, projects: picked }
}
export const rollupCell = (r: Rollup, fn: string, y: string) => (r.actual[fn]?.[y] || 0) + (r.forecast[fn]?.[y] || 0)
export const rollupFnTotal = (r: Rollup, fn: string) => sum(r.years.map((y) => rollupCell(r, fn, y)))
export const rollupYearTotal = (r: Rollup, y: string) => sum(r.fns.map((f) => rollupCell(r, f.id, y))) + (r.contingency[y] || 0)

/** Finance CSV rows: function × year with actual / forecast split and totals. */
export function rollupCsvRows(r: Rollup): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  const rows: Record<string, unknown>[] = r.fns.map((f) => ({
    'WBS code': f.code, 'WBS function': f.name + (f.retired ? ' (retired)' : ''),
    ...Object.fromEntries(r.years.map((y) => [y, rollupCell(r, f.id, y)])),
    Total: rollupFnTotal(r, f.id),
  }))
  rows.push({ 'WBS code': '990', 'WBS function': 'Contingency held', ...Object.fromEntries(r.years.map((y) => [y, r.contingency[y] || 0])), Total: sum(Object.values(r.contingency)) })
  rows.push({ 'WBS code': 'TOTAL', 'WBS function': 'Total', ...Object.fromEntries(r.years.map((y) => [y, rollupYearTotal(r, y)])), Total: sum(r.years.map((y) => rollupYearTotal(r, y))) })
  return rows
}
/** Long-format detail for finance pivots: project × function × year, actual vs forecast. */
export function rollupDetailRows(s: AppState, r: Rollup): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  const out: Record<string, unknown>[] = []
  for (const { p, version } of r.projects) {
    const cut = versionCutoff(s, version)
    const act = actualsByFunctionMonth(s, p.id)
    const prog = s.programs.find((x) => x.id === p.programId)?.code ?? ''
    for (const f of r.fns) {
      const ys = new Set<string>()
      const a: Record<string, Money> = {}, e: Record<string, Money> = {}
      for (const [m, v] of Object.entries(act[f.id] ?? {})) if (m <= cut) { a[m.slice(0, 4)] = (a[m.slice(0, 4)] || 0) + v; ys.add(m.slice(0, 4)) }
      for (const [m, v] of Object.entries(version.spread?.[f.id] ?? {})) { e[m.slice(0, 4)] = (e[m.slice(0, 4)] || 0) + v; ys.add(m.slice(0, 4)) }
      for (const y of [...ys].sort()) if (a[y] || e[y]) out.push({ Project: p.code, Program: prog, 'Forecast date': version.date, Status: statusOf(version), 'WBS code': f.code, 'WBS function': f.name, Year: y, Actual: a[y] || 0, Forecast: e[y] || 0, Total: (a[y] || 0) + (e[y] || 0) })
    }
    if (version.contingencyHeld) out.push({ Project: p.code, Program: prog, 'Forecast date': version.date, Status: statusOf(version), 'WBS code': '990', 'WBS function': 'Contingency held', Year: '', Actual: 0, Forecast: version.contingencyHeld, Total: version.contingencyHeld })
  }
  return out
}

// ───────────────────────────── Grid export

/** Functions × months CSV for one version (actuals columns for past months optional). */
export function gridCsvRows(s: AppState, p: Project, f: Forecast, months: string[]): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  const fns = fnRefs(s, f.spread)
  const bud = budgetByFunction(s, p.id)
  const act = actualsByFunction2(s, p.id, versionCutoff(s, f))
  const actTotal = sum(Object.values(act))
  const rows: Record<string, unknown>[] = fns.map((fn) => {
    const etc = rowTotal(f.spread ?? {}, fn.id)
    const eac = (act[fn.id] || 0) + etc
    return { 'WBS code': fn.code, 'WBS function': fn.name, Budget: bud.byFn[fn.id] || 0, 'Actual to date': act[fn.id] || 0, ...Object.fromEntries(months.map((m) => [m, f.spread?.[fn.id]?.[m] || 0])), ETC: etc, EAC: eac, Variance: (bud.byFn[fn.id] || 0) - eac }
  })
  const held = f.contingencyHeld ?? 0
  rows.push({ 'WBS code': '990', 'WBS function': 'Contingency held', Budget: bud.contingency, 'Actual to date': 0, ...Object.fromEntries(months.map((m) => [m, 0])), ETC: held, EAC: held, Variance: bud.contingency - held })
  const byM = spreadByMonth(f.spread)
  const etcT = spreadTotal(f.spread) + held
  rows.push({ 'WBS code': 'TOTAL', 'WBS function': 'Total', Budget: bud.total, 'Actual to date': actTotal, ...Object.fromEntries(months.map((m) => [m, byM[m] || 0])), ETC: etcT, EAC: actTotal + etcT, Variance: bud.total - actTotal - etcT })
  return rows
}

/** Same values cell by cell (zero and missing are equal). */
export function sameSpread(a?: Spread, b?: Spread): boolean {
  const A = a ?? {}, B = b ?? {}
  for (const fn of new Set([...Object.keys(A), ...Object.keys(B)])) {
    const x = A[fn] ?? {}, y = B[fn] ?? {}
    for (const m of new Set([...Object.keys(x), ...Object.keys(y)])) if ((x[m] || 0) !== (y[m] || 0)) return false
  }
  return true
}

/** 'Nov ’26' style short month label for charts. */
export const shortMonth = (k: string) => `${['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'][Number(k.slice(5, 7)) - 1]} '${k.slice(2, 4)}`

/** Grid columns: months, with any collapsed year shown as one year-total column. */
export interface GridCol { key: string; kind: 'month' | 'year'; months: string[] }
export function gridCols(months: string[], collapsed: Set<string> | string[]): GridCol[] {
  const c = new Set(collapsed)
  const out: GridCol[] = []
  for (const m of months) {
    const y = m.slice(0, 4)
    if (c.has(y)) {
      const last = out[out.length - 1]
      if (last?.kind === 'year' && last.key === y) last.months.push(m)
      else out.push({ key: y, kind: 'year', months: [m] })
    } else out.push({ key: m, kind: 'month', months: [m] })
  }
  return out
}

// ───────────────────────────── Forecast line items (line × month is what people edit; functions roll up)

export interface LineRef { id: string; code: string; name: string; fnId: string; inactive: boolean }

/** Active lines in WBS order, plus any inactive line that still carries ETC in one of the grids. */
export function lineRefs(s: AppState, ...grids: (Spread | undefined)[]): LineRef[] {
  const order = new Map(s.settings.wbsFunctions.map((f, i) => [f.id, i]))
  const ids = new Set(s.settings.forecastLines.filter((l) => l.active).map((l) => l.id))
  for (const g of grids) for (const [id, row] of Object.entries(g ?? {})) if (sum(Object.values(row))) ids.add(id)
  return [...ids].map((id): LineRef => {
    const l = lineById(s, id)
    return l ? { id, code: l.code, name: l.name, fnId: l.functionId, inactive: !l.active } : { id, code: id, name: 'Removed line', fnId: '', inactive: true }
  }).sort((a, b) => (order.get(a.fnId) ?? 99) - (order.get(b.fnId) ?? 99) || a.code.localeCompare(b.code))
}

export interface FnGroup { fn: FnRef; lines: LineRef[] }
/** Functions with their lines, in WBS order (functions without lines are kept so the table always shows nine). */
export function fnGroups(s: AppState, lines: LineRef[]): FnGroup[] {
  const groups: FnGroup[] = fnRefs(s).map((fn) => ({ fn, lines: lines.filter((l) => l.fnId === fn.id) }))
  const orphans = lines.filter((l) => !groups.some((g) => g.fn.id === l.fnId))
  if (orphans.length) groups.push({ fn: { id: 'fn-orphan', code: '—', name: 'Lines without a function', retired: true, timing: 'flat' }, lines: orphans })
  return groups
}

/** Actuals by line through a cutoff month (exact: line actuals sum to the ERP actual). */
export function lineActuals(s: AppState, pid: string, through?: string): Record<string, Money> {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(actualsByLineMonth(s, pid)).map(([k, row]) => [k, sum(Object.entries(row).filter(([m]) => !through || m <= through).map(([, v]) => v))]))
}

/** ETC/EAC by function (engine) with actuals cut off at a version's actuals month, so older versions read as they were made. */
export function etcEacAt(s: AppState, p: Project, f: Forecast, through?: string) {
  const st = through ? { ...s, costPeriods: s.costPeriods.filter((c) => c.projectId !== p.id || c.period <= through) } : s
  return etcEacByFunction(st, p, f)
}

/** A forecast-shaped object from the editor's working state (for engine calls before saving). */
export const working = (s: AppState, f: Forecast, lines: Spread, held: Money, profiles: Record<string, FnProfile>, note = f.note): Forecast =>
  ({ ...f, lineSpread: lines, spread: linesToSpread(s, lines), contingencyHeld: held, profiles, note, eac: eacOf(s, f.projectId, lines, held) })

/** Spread the edited line grid back into a stored forecast (draft of the store) and re-derive spread, EAC and years. */
export function applyLines(d: AppState, f: Forecast, lines: Spread, held: Money, note: string, profiles: Record<string, FnProfile>) {
  f.lineSpread = stripZeros(lines)
  f.contingencyHeld = Math.round(held)
  f.note = note
  f.profiles = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(profiles))
  syncForecast(d, f)
}

/** The function-level roll-up of a line grid (what `spread` stores). */
export const linesToSpread = (s: AppState, lines: Spread): Spread => stripZeros(rollupGrid(s, lines))

export const fnEtc = (lines: Spread, lineIds: string[]) => sum(lineIds.map((id) => rowTotal(lines, id)))

/** Mark a function's profile as hand-adjusted (no-op when it has no profile or already is). */
export function markAdjusted(profiles: Record<string, FnProfile>, fnId: string | undefined): Record<string, FnProfile> {
  if (!fnId || !profiles[fnId] || profiles[fnId].adjusted) return profiles
  return { ...profiles, [fnId]: { ...profiles[fnId], adjusted: true } }
}

/**
 * Apply a profile to one function: its ETC (`total`, default = current) goes to its lines by each line's current share
 * and is phased by the profile between start and end (engine applyProfile). Returns the new grid and profile entry.
 */
export function applyFnProfile(s: AppState, p: Project, lines: Spread, fnId: string, prof: Pick<FnProfile, 'profileId' | 'start' | 'end'>, total?: Money, at = new Date().toISOString()): { lines: Spread; profile: FnProfile } {
  const g = applyProfile(s, p, { lineSpread: lines }, fnId, prof, total)
  const out = cloneSpread(lines)
  for (const [lid, row] of Object.entries(g)) out[lid] = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(row).filter(([, v]) => v))
  return { lines: out, profile: { profileId: prof.profileId, start: prof.start, end: prof.end, adjusted: false, appliedAt: at } }
}

/** Normalised weights (sum 1) for drawing a profile's shape over `months`. */
export function shapeOf(s: AppState, profileId: string, months: string[]): number[] {
  const w = profileWeights(s, profileId, months)
  const W = sum(w) || 1
  return w.map((x) => x / W)
}
/** Dollar preview of a profile: `total` over the window, whole dollars. */
export const previewSpread = (s: AppState, profileId: string, months: string[], total: Money) => spreadByWeights(Math.round(total), months, profileWeights(s, profileId, months))

export { allProfiles, profileName }

/** Line-level CSV for one version: a subtotal row per function, its lines beneath, contingency held and the total. */
export function lineCsvRows(s: AppState, p: Project, f: Forecast, months: string[]): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  const cut = versionCutoff(s, f)
  const t = etcEacAt(s, p, f, cut)
  const grid = lineGridOf(s, p, f)
  const bud = budgetByLine(s, p.id)
  const rows: Record<string, unknown>[] = []
  const month = (ids: string[]) => Object.fromEntries(months.map((m) => [m, sum(ids.map((id) => grid[id]?.[m] || 0))]))
  for (const r of t.rows) {
    const pr = r.profile ? `${profileName(s, r.profile.profileId)}${r.profile.adjusted ? ' (adjusted)' : ''}` : ''
    rows.push({ 'WBS code': r.code, 'WBS function': r.name, 'Line code': '', 'Line item': `${r.name} — function total`, Profile: pr, Budget: r.budget, 'Actual to date': r.actual, ...month(r.lines.map((l) => l.line.id)), ETC: r.etc, EAC: r.eac, VAC: r.vac })
    for (const l of r.lines) rows.push({ 'WBS code': r.code, 'WBS function': r.name, 'Line code': l.line.code, 'Line item': l.line.name, Profile: '', Budget: l.budget, 'Actual to date': l.actual, ...month([l.line.id]), ETC: l.etc, EAC: l.eac, VAC: l.vac })
  }
  const held = f.contingencyHeld ?? 0
  rows.push({ 'WBS code': '990', 'WBS function': 'Contingency held', 'Line code': '', 'Line item': 'Contingency held', Profile: '', Budget: bud.contingency, 'Actual to date': 0, ...Object.fromEntries(months.map((m) => [m, 0])), ETC: held, EAC: held, VAC: bud.contingency - held })
  rows.push({ 'WBS code': 'TOTAL', 'WBS function': 'Total', 'Line code': '', 'Line item': 'Total', Profile: '', Budget: t.totals.budget, 'Actual to date': t.totals.actual, ...month(Object.keys(grid)), ETC: t.totals.etc + held, EAC: t.totals.eac, VAC: t.totals.vac })
  return rows
}

// ───────────────────────────── Portfolio ETC / EAC by function

export interface PortfolioFnRow {
  fnId: string; code: string; name: string
  budget: Money; actual: Money; etc: Money; eac: Money; vac: Money
  lines: { id: string; code: string; name: string; budget: Money; actual: Money; etc: Money; eac: Money; vac: Money }[]
  over: { p: Project; vac: Money }[] // projects whose EAC exceeds budget in this function, worst first
}
export function portfolioEtcEac(s: AppState, projects: Project[], basis: RollupBasis = 'latest') {
  const picked = projects.map((p) => ({ p, version: versionFor(s, p.id, basis)! })).filter((x) => x.version)
  const map = new Map<string, PortfolioFnRow>()
  for (const fn of s.settings.wbsFunctions) map.set(fn.id, { fnId: fn.id, code: fn.code, name: fn.name, budget: 0, actual: 0, etc: 0, eac: 0, vac: 0, lines: [], over: [] })
  let held = 0, budCont = 0
  for (const { p, version } of picked) {
    const t = etcEacAt(s, p, version, versionCutoff(s, version))
    held += t.contingencyHeld
    budCont += t.totals.budget - sum(t.rows.map((r) => r.budget))
    for (const r of t.rows as FunctionRow[]) {
      const row = map.get(r.fnId)
      if (!row) continue
      row.budget += r.budget; row.actual += r.actual; row.etc += r.etc; row.eac += r.eac; row.vac += r.vac
      if (r.vac < 0 && r.eac > 0) row.over.push({ p, vac: r.vac })
      for (const l of r.lines) {
        let lr = row.lines.find((x) => x.id === l.line.id)
        if (!lr) { lr = { id: l.line.id, code: l.line.code, name: l.line.name, budget: 0, actual: 0, etc: 0, eac: 0, vac: 0 }; row.lines.push(lr) }
        lr.budget += l.budget; lr.actual += l.actual; lr.etc += l.etc; lr.eac += l.eac; lr.vac += l.vac
      }
    }
  }
  const rows = [...map.values()].map((r) => ({ ...r, over: r.over.sort((a, b) => a.vac - b.vac) }))
  const T = (k: 'budget' | 'actual' | 'etc' | 'eac') => sum(rows.map((r) => r[k]))
  const totals = { budget: T('budget') + budCont, actual: T('actual'), etc: T('etc') + held, eac: T('eac') + held, vac: T('budget') + budCont - T('eac') - held }
  return { rows, contingencyHeld: held, budgetContingency: budCont, totals, projects: picked }
}

export function portfolioEtcEacCsv(r: ReturnType<typeof portfolioEtcEac>): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  const out: Record<string, unknown>[] = []
  for (const f of r.rows) {
    out.push({ 'WBS code': f.code, 'WBS function': f.name, 'Line code': '', 'Line item': '', Budget: f.budget, 'Actual to date': f.actual, ETC: f.etc, EAC: f.eac, VAC: f.vac, 'Projects over budget': f.over.length })
    for (const l of f.lines) out.push({ 'WBS code': f.code, 'WBS function': f.name, 'Line code': l.code, 'Line item': l.name, Budget: l.budget, 'Actual to date': l.actual, ETC: l.etc, EAC: l.eac, VAC: l.vac, 'Projects over budget': '' })
  }
  out.push({ 'WBS code': '990', 'WBS function': 'Contingency', 'Line code': '', 'Line item': '', Budget: r.budgetContingency, 'Actual to date': 0, ETC: r.contingencyHeld, EAC: r.contingencyHeld, VAC: r.budgetContingency - r.contingencyHeld, 'Projects over budget': '' })
  out.push({ 'WBS code': 'TOTAL', 'WBS function': 'Total', 'Line code': '', 'Line item': '', Budget: r.totals.budget, 'Actual to date': r.totals.actual, ETC: r.totals.etc, EAC: r.totals.eac, VAC: r.totals.vac, 'Projects over budget': '' })
  return out
}

// ───────────────────────────── SAP drill-down helpers

/** What one SAP transaction contributes to a line (or to all lines of a function): its amount, or its allocated share. */
export function txnShare(s: AppState, t: ActualTxn, o: { lineId?: string; fnId?: string }): Money {
  if (o.lineId) return t.lineId === o.lineId ? t.amount : t.allocation?.[o.lineId] ?? 0
  if (o.fnId) {
    if (t.lineId) return functionOfLine(s, t.lineId) === o.fnId ? t.amount : 0
    return sum(Object.entries(t.allocation ?? {}).filter(([l]) => functionOfLine(s, l) === o.fnId).map(([, v]) => v))
  }
  return t.amount
}

// Curve profiles on the forecast tab: the mini shape preview, the per-function profile chooser and the per-line tools.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, FnProfile, Money, Project } from '@/core/types'
import { cx, fmtMonth, money, monthRange, sum } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, ConfirmButton, Field, Modal, MoneyInput, SegButtons, Select } from '@/ui/kit'
import { allProfiles, previewSpread, profileName, rowTotal, shapeOf, shortMonth, type LineRef, type Spread } from './lib'
import { budgetByLine } from '@/core/engine/lines'
import { lsSet } from '../admin/common'

/** Small bar sketch of a weight shape. Zero bars (black-out months) show as a tick on the baseline. */
export function Shape({ weights, w = 64, h = 18, className, labels }: { weights: number[]; w?: number; h?: number; className?: string; labels?: string[] }) {
  const n = weights.length
  const mx = Math.max(1e-9, ...weights)
  const bw = n ? w / n : w
  return (
    <svg width={w} height={h} viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} className={cx('shrink-0', className)} aria-hidden>
      <line x1={0} x2={w} y1={h - 0.5} y2={h - 0.5} className="stroke-line" strokeWidth={1} />
      {weights.map((x, i) => {
        const bh = x > 0 ? Math.max(1.5, ((h - 2) * x) / mx) : 0
        return x > 0
          ? <rect key={i} x={i * bw + (bw > 3 ? 0.5 : 0)} y={h - 1 - bh} width={Math.max(0.8, bw - (bw > 3 ? 1 : 0.2))} height={bh} rx={bw > 4 ? 1 : 0} className="fill-link/70">{labels && <title>{labels[i]}</title>}</rect>
          : <rect key={i} x={i * bw + bw / 2 - 0.75} y={h - 3} width={1.5} height={2} className="fill-bad/70">{labels && <title>{`${labels[i]} — no spend`}</title>}</rect>
      })}
    </svg>
  )
}

/** Profile chip shown on a function row: name, and an "adjusted" marker once cells were edited after applying. */
export function ProfileChip({ s, profile, onClick, title }: { s: AppState; profile?: FnProfile; onClick?: () => void; title?: string }) {
  const Tag = onClick ? 'button' : 'span'
  if (!profile) return <Tag onClick={onClick} title={title ?? 'No profile applied'} className={cx('inline-flex max-w-[150px] items-center rounded border border-dashed border-line px-1.5 text-[10.5px] font-semibold leading-[18px] text-faint', onClick && 'hover:border-ink/40 hover:text-ink')}>No profile</Tag>
  const name = profileName(s, profile.profileId)
  return (
    <Tag onClick={onClick} title={title ?? `${name} · ${fmtMonth(profile.start)} – ${fmtMonth(profile.end)}${profile.adjusted ? ' · cells edited by hand after applying' : ''}`}
      className={cx('inline-flex min-w-0 max-w-[190px] items-center gap-1 rounded border px-1.5 text-[10.5px] font-semibold leading-[18px]', profile.adjusted ? 'border-warn/50 bg-warn/10 text-ink' : 'border-link/40 bg-link/10 text-ink', onClick && 'hover:border-ink/50')}>
      <span className="truncate">{name}</span>
      {profile.adjusted && <span className="shrink-0 rounded-sm bg-warn/25 px-1 text-[9.5px] uppercase tracking-wide text-warn">adjusted</span>}
    </Tag>
  )
}

type AmountMode = 'current' | 'remaining' | 'custom'

/** Choose a curve profile for one WBS function: profile, window, amount → applyProfile over the function's lines. */
export function ProfileModal({ s, p, fn, lines, grid, months, profile, actual, onApply, onReset, onClose }: {
  s: AppState; p: Project; fn: { id: string; code: string; name: string }; lines: LineRef[]; grid: Spread; months: string[]
  profile?: FnProfile; actual: Record<string, Money>
  onApply: (prof: Pick<FnProfile, 'profileId' | 'start' | 'end'>, total: Money) => void; onReset?: () => void; onClose: () => void
}) {
  const ids = lines.map((l) => l.id)
  const current = sum(ids.map((id) => rowTotal(grid, id)))
  const bud = useMemo(() => budgetByLine(s, p.id).byLine, [s, p.id])
  const remaining = sum(ids.map((id) => Math.max(0, (bud[id] || 0) - (actual[id] || 0))))
  const used = months.filter((m) => ids.some((id) => grid[id]?.[m]))
  const profiles = allProfiles(s)
  const [pid, setPid] = useState(profile?.profileId ?? 'scurve')
  const [start, setStart] = useState(profile && months.includes(profile.start) ? profile.start : used[0] ?? months[0])
  const [end, setEnd] = useState(profile && months.includes(profile.end) ? profile.end : used[used.length - 1] ?? months[months.length - 1])
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<AmountMode>(current ? 'current' : 'remaining')
  const [custom, setCustom] = useState(current || remaining)
  useEffect(() => { if (end < start) setEnd(start) }, [start, end])
  const total = mode === 'current' ? current : mode === 'remaining' ? remaining : custom
  const window = start && end && end >= start ? monthRange(start, end) : []
  const prev = previewSpread(s, pid, window, total)
  const mx = Math.max(1, ...window.map((m) => prev[m] || 0))
  const shares = ids.map((id) => ({ id, v: current ? rowTotal(grid, id) : Math.max(0, (bud[id] || 0) - (actual[id] || 0)) }))
  const sh = sum(shares.map((x) => x.v))
  const sel = profiles.find((x) => x.id === pid)
  const sample = monthRange(months[0], months[Math.min(months.length - 1, 11)])
  return (
    <Modal open wide onClose={onClose} title={`Curve profile · ${fn.code} ${fn.name}`}
      footer={<>
        {onReset && profile && <ConfirmButton size="sm" confirmLabel="Re-apply profile" onConfirm={onReset}>Reset to {profileName(s, profile.profileId)}</ConfirmButton>}
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>
        <Button variant="primary" disabled={!window.length} onClick={() => onApply({ profileId: pid, start, end }, total)}>Apply to {lines.length} line{lines.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</Button>
      </>}>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.15fr)]">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1.5">
          <div className="eyebrow">Profile</div>
          <div role="radiogroup" className="flex max-h-[360px] flex-col gap-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {profiles.map((x) => (
              <button key={x.id} role="radio" aria-checked={pid === x.id} onClick={() => setPid(x.id)}
                className={cx('flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left', pid === x.id ? 'border-ink bg-sunken' : 'border-line hover:border-ink/40')}>
                <Shape weights={shapeOf(s, x.id, sample)} w={56} h={20} />
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold">{x.name}{x.custom && <Badge>Custom</Badge>}{profile?.profileId === x.id && <Badge tone="info">Applied</Badge>}</span>
                  <span className="block truncate text-[11.5px] text-muted" title={x.description}>{x.description}</span>
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <a href="#admin" onClick={() => lsSet('crosswalk:admin-tab', 'profiles')} className="text-[11.5px] text-link hover:underline">Manage custom profiles in Configuration</a>
        </div>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <Field label="Start month"><Select value={start} onChange={(e) => setStart(e.target.value)} options={months.map((m) => ({ value: m, label: fmtMonth(m) }))} /></Field>
            <Field label="End month"><Select value={end} onChange={(e) => setEnd(e.target.value)} options={months.filter((m) => m >= start).map((m) => ({ value: m, label: fmtMonth(m) }))} /></Field>
          </div>
          <Field label="Amount to phase (function ETC)">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              <SegButtons value={mode} onChange={setMode} options={[{ id: 'current', label: `Current ETC ${money(current)}` }, { id: 'remaining', label: `Remaining budget ${money(remaining)}` }, { id: 'custom', label: 'Other' }]} />
              {mode === 'custom' && <MoneyInput value={custom} onChange={setCustom} aria-label="Amount to phase" />}
            </div>
          </Field>
          <div>
            <div className="eyebrow mb-1">Preview · {sel?.name} · {window.length} months · peak {money(mx)}</div>
            <div className="flex h-20 items-end gap-px rounded border border-line bg-sunken/50 p-1" aria-hidden>
              {window.map((m) => <div key={m} title={`${fmtMonth(m)}: ${money(prev[m] || 0, 'full')}`} className={cx('flex-1 rounded-sm', prev[m] ? 'bg-link/70' : 'h-[2px] bg-bad/60')} style={prev[m] ? { height: `${((prev[m] || 0) / mx) * 100}%` } : undefined} />)}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 flex justify-between text-[11px] text-faint"><span>{start && shortMonth(start)}</span><span>{end && shortMonth(end)}</span></div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="eyebrow mb-1">Split to lines {current ? 'by current ETC share' : 'by remaining budget'}</div>
            <table className="tbl [&_td]:py-1">
              <tbody>
                {lines.map((l) => { const x = shares.find((y) => y.id === l.id)!; const f = sh ? x.v / sh : 1 / lines.length; return <tr key={l.id}><td><span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">{l.code}</span> {l.name}</td><td className="num text-muted">{(f * 100).toFixed(1)}%</td><td className="num">{money(total * f)}</td></tr> })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">Applying replaces this function’s ETC in every month: the window gets the curve, months outside it are cleared. Cells stay editable — editing any of them afterwards marks the profile <b>adjusted</b>.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

/** Per-line tools: set ETC to remaining budget, phase an amount by a profile, or clear the line. */
export function LineTools({ s, line, row, months, budget, actual, onApply, onClose }: {
  s: AppState; line: LineRef; row: Record<string, Money>; months: string[]; budget: Money; actual: Money
  onApply: (next: Record<string, Money>, what: string) => void; onClose: () => void
}) {
  const etc = sum(Object.values(row))
  const remaining = Math.max(0, budget - actual)
  const used = months.filter((m) => row[m])
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(etc || remaining)
  const [pid, setPid] = useState('even')
  const [from, setFrom] = useState(used[0] ?? months[0])
  const [to, setTo] = useState(used[used.length - 1] ?? months[months.length - 1])
  useEffect(() => { if (to < from) setTo(from) }, [from, to])
  const win = months.filter((m) => m >= from && m <= to)
  const prev = previewSpread(s, pid, win, amount)
  const mx = Math.max(1, ...win.map((m) => prev[m] || 0))
  const scale = () => {
    if (etc > 0) {
      const keys = Object.keys(row).filter((k) => row[k]).sort()
      const vals = keys.map((k) => row[k])
      const W = sum(vals)
      let acc = 0
      const out: Record<string, Money> = {}
      keys.forEach((k, i) => { const v = i === keys.length - 1 ? remaining - acc : Math.round((remaining * vals[i]) / W); out[k] = v; acc += v })
      return out
    }
    return previewSpread(s, 'even', months, remaining)
  }
  return (
    <Modal open onClose={onClose} title={`Line tools · ${line.code} ${line.name}`}
      footer={<>
        <ConfirmButton size="sm" confirmLabel="Clear line" onConfirm={() => onApply({}, 'cleared')}>Clear line</ConfirmButton>
        <Button size="sm" onClick={() => onApply(scale(), `ETC set to remaining budget ${money(remaining)}`)}>Set ETC to remaining ({money(remaining)})</Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!win.length} onClick={() => onApply(prev, `phased ${money(amount)} ${profileName(s, pid)} ${shortMonth(from)}–${shortMonth(to)}`)}>Apply</Button>
      </>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-[12px]">
          <div><div className="eyebrow">Budget</div><div className="tabular-nums">{money(budget, 'full')}</div></div>
          <div><div className="eyebrow">Actual</div><div className="tabular-nums">{money(actual, 'full')}</div></div>
          <div><div className="eyebrow">Current ETC</div><div className="tabular-nums">{money(etc, 'full')}</div></div>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Amount to phase"><MoneyInput value={amount} onChange={setAmount} /></Field>
          <Field label="Profile"><Select value={pid} onChange={(e) => setPid(e.target.value)} options={allProfiles(s).map((x) => ({ value: x.id, label: x.name }))} /></Field>
          <Field label="Start month"><Select value={from} onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)} options={months.map((m) => ({ value: m, label: fmtMonth(m) }))} /></Field>
          <Field label="End month"><Select value={to} onChange={(e) => setTo(e.target.value)} options={months.filter((m) => m >= from).map((m) => ({ value: m, label: fmtMonth(m) }))} /></Field>
        </div>
        <div className="flex h-14 items-end gap-px rounded border border-line bg-sunken/50 p-1" aria-hidden>
          {win.map((m) => <div key={m} title={`${fmtMonth(m)}: ${money(prev[m] || 0, 'full')}`} className={cx('flex-1 rounded-sm', prev[m] ? 'bg-link/70' : 'h-[2px] bg-bad/60')} style={prev[m] ? { height: `${((prev[m] || 0) / mx) * 100}%` } : undefined} />)}
        </div>
        <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">Line tools change only this line and mark its function’s profile adjusted. To re-shape the whole function use its profile.</p>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/forecast/report.ts =====
// Standalone HTML report for one forecast version: ETC/EAC by function and line item with profiles, monthly spread,
// change from the prior approved version and the review history.
import type { AppState, Forecast, Project } from '@/core/types'
import { budgetByFunction, spreadByMonth } from '@/core/engine/wbs'
import { personName } from '@/core/store'
import { fmtDate, fmtMonth, money, sum } from '@/core/util'
import { htmlDoc } from '@/core/download'
import { lineGridOf } from '@/core/engine/lines'
import { compareVersions, etcEacAt, fnRefs, priorApproved, profileName, statusOf, versionCutoff, type Spread } from './lib'

const esc = (t: string) => t.replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' })[c]!)
const $ = (n: number) => money(n, 'full')
const td = (n: number, bold = false) => `<td class="num">${bold ? '<b>' : ''}${n ? $(n) : '–'}${bold ? '</b>' : ''}</td>`

export function forecastReportHtml(s: AppState, p: Project, f: Forecast): string {
  const spread: Spread = f.spread ?? {}
  const held = f.contingencyHeld ?? 0
  const fns = fnRefs(s, spread)
  const bud = budgetByFunction(s, p.id)
  const cut = versionCutoff(s, f)
  const ee = etcEacAt(s, p, { ...f, lineSpread: f.lineSpread ?? lineGridOf(s, p, f) }, cut)
  const actT = ee.totals.actual
  const etcT = ee.totals.etc + held
  const eac = ee.totals.eac
  const months = Object.keys(spreadByMonth(spread)).sort()
  const years = Array.from(new Set(months.map((m) => m.slice(0, 4)))).sort()
  const yr = (fn: string, y: string) => sum(Object.entries(spread[fn] ?? {}).filter(([m]) => m.startsWith(y)).map(([, v]) => v))
  const prior = priorApproved(s, p.id, f.id)
  const cmp = prior ? compareVersions(s, prior, { ...f, spread, contingencyHeld: held, eac }) : undefined
  const inst = s.workflows.find((w) => w.id === f.workflowInstanceId)

  const grid = lineGridOf(s, p, f)
  const lyr = (lid: string, y: string) => sum(Object.entries(grid[lid] ?? {}).filter(([m]) => m.startsWith(y)).map(([, v]) => v))
  const prof = (fnId: string) => { const x = f.profiles?.[fnId]; return x ? `${esc(profileName(s, x.profileId))}<br><span class="meta">${fmtMonth(x.start)} – ${fmtMonth(x.end)}${x.adjusted ? ' · adjusted' : ''}</span>` : '<span class="meta">—</span>' }
  const pctS = (a: number, e: number) => (e ? `${Math.round((a / e) * 100)}%` : '—')
  const fnTable = `<table><thead><tr><th>Code</th><th>WBS function · line item</th><th>Profile</th><th>Budget</th><th>Actual to date</th>${years.map((y) => `<th>${y} ETC</th>`).join('')}<th>ETC</th><th>EAC</th><th>VAC</th><th>% spent</th></tr></thead><tbody>
${ee.rows.map((r) => `<tr><td><b>${r.code}</b></td><td><b>${esc(r.name)}</b></td><td>${prof(r.fnId)}</td>${td(r.budget, true)}${td(r.actual, true)}${years.map((y) => td(yr(r.fnId, y), true)).join('')}${td(r.etc, true)}${td(r.eac, true)}<td class="num"${r.vac < 0 ? ' style="color:#c02828"' : ''}><b>${$(r.vac)}</b></td><td class="num">${pctS(r.actual, r.eac)}</td></tr>
${r.lines.map((l) => `<tr><td>${l.line.code}</td><td>&nbsp;&nbsp;${esc(l.line.name)}</td><td></td>${td(l.budget)}${td(l.actual)}${years.map((y) => td(lyr(l.line.id, y))).join('')}${td(l.etc)}${td(l.eac)}<td class="num"${l.vac < 0 ? ' style="color:#c02828"' : ''}>${$(l.vac)}</td><td class="num">${pctS(l.actual, l.eac)}</td></tr>`).join('\n')}`).join('\n')}
<tr><td>990</td><td>Contingency held</td><td></td>${td(bud.contingency)}<td class="num">–</td>${years.map(() => '<td></td>').join('')}${td(held)}${td(held)}${td(bud.contingency - held)}<td></td></tr>
<tr><td></td><td><b>Total</b></td><td></td>${td(ee.totals.budget, true)}${td(ee.totals.actual, true)}${years.map((y) => td(sum(fns.map((x) => yr(x.id, y))), true)).join('')}${td(ee.totals.etc + held, true)}${td(ee.totals.eac, true)}<td class="num"><b>${$(ee.totals.vac)}</b></td><td class="num">${pctS(ee.totals.actual, ee.totals.eac)}</td></tr></tbody></table>`

  const chunks: string[][] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < months.length; i += 12) chunks.push(months.slice(i, i + 12))
  const monthTables = chunks.map((ms) => `<table><thead><tr><th>Function</th>${ms.map((m) => `<th>${fmtMonth(m)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>
${fns.filter((x) => ms.some((m) => spread[x.id]?.[m])).map((x) => `<tr><td>${x.code} ${esc(x.name)}</td>${ms.map((m) => td(spread[x.id]?.[m] || 0)).join('')}</tr>`).join('\n')}
<tr><td><b>Total</b></td>${ms.map((m) => td(sum(fns.map((x) => spread[x.id]?.[m] || 0)), true)).join('')}</tr></tbody></table>`).join('')

  const compare = cmp && prior ? `<h2>Change from prior approved (${fmtDate(prior.date)})</h2>
<p class="meta">EAC ${$(prior.eac)} → ${$(eac)} (${eac - prior.eac >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${$(eac - prior.eac)}).${prior.note ? ' Prior basis: ' + esc(prior.note) : ''}</p>
<table><thead><tr><th>Function</th><th>Prior EAC</th><th>This EAC</th><th>Change</th></tr></thead><tbody>
${cmp.rows.filter((r) => r.eacA || r.eacB).map((r) => `<tr><td>${r.code} ${esc(r.name)}</td>${td(r.eacA)}${td(r.eacB)}<td class="num">${r.delta >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${$(r.delta)}</td></tr>`).join('\n')}</tbody></table>` : ''

  const hist = inst ? `<h2>Review</h2><table><thead><tr><th>When</th><th>Who</th><th>Action</th><th>Comment</th></tr></thead><tbody>${inst.history.filter((h) => h.action !== 'system').map((h) => `<tr><td>${h.at.slice(0, 10)}</td><td>${esc(personName(s, h.actorId))}</td><td>${h.action}</td><td>${esc(h.comment ?? '')}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>` : ''

  return htmlDoc(`${p.code} forecast ${f.date}`, `<h1>${esc(p.code)} ${esc(p.name)} — forecast spread</h1>
<p class="meta">${esc(s.settings.orgName)} · Version dated ${fmtDate(f.date)} · ${statusOf(f)} · prepared by ${esc(personName(s, f.byId))} · actuals through ${fmtMonth(cut)}</p>
<table><tbody><tr><th>Budget</th><td class="num">${$(bud.total)}</td><th>Actual to date</th><td class="num">${$(actT)}</td></tr>
<tr><th>ETC (incl. contingency held)</th><td class="num">${$(etcT)}</td><th>EAC</th><td class="num"><b>${$(eac)}</b></td></tr>
<tr><th>Variance (budget − EAC)</th><td class="num">${$(bud.total - eac)}</td><th>Contingency held</th><td class="num">${$(held)}</td></tr></tbody></table>
${f.note ? `<h2>Forecast basis</h2><p>${esc(f.note)}</p>` : ''}
<h2>ETC / EAC by WBS function and line item</h2>${fnTable}
<h2>Monthly spread (ETC)</h2>${monthTables || '<p class="meta">No ETC spread — the project is fully actualized.</p>'}
${compare}${hist}
<p class="meta">EAC = SAP actuals to date (mapped to forecast line items through the SAP mapping table) + time-phased ETC by line item + contingency held. Overhead (AFUDC, allocations) is reported under 900 Project Overhead; escalation is allocated to lines pro-rata to direct cost. Each function is phased by the curve profile shown; “adjusted” means cells were edited by hand after the profile was applied.</p>`)
}

===== FILE: src/views/gates/Gates.tsx =====
// Portfolio gate calendar (SG-11) and gate metrics (SG-12): upcoming reviews, readiness heat map
// across active projects, days per stage by program, recycle rate and waivers granted.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { personName, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { go, projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import type { AppState, GateReview, Project } from '@/core/types'
import { readiness, requiredDefs, templateFor } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { addDays, cx, daysBetween, fmtDate, fmtMonth, groupBy, sum } from '@/core/util'
import { saveFile, toCSV } from '@/core/download'
import { Avatar, Badge, Button, ClassBadge, Empty, Mono, PageHeader, Panel, Progress, SegButtons, Select, Stat } from '@/ui/kit'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'
import { stageDurations } from '../portfolio/lib'
import { ScheduleReviewModal } from './ScheduleReview'

export default function Gates(_props: { projectId?: string; id?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [view, setView] = useState<'list' | 'calendar'>('list')
  const [program, setProgram] = useState('')
  const [sched, setSched] = useState<{ open: boolean; pid?: string }>({ open: false })
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const inProg = (p: Project) => !program || p.programId === program
  const reviews = s.gateReviews.filter((g) => g.status === 'scheduled' && inProg(s.projects.find((p) => p.id === g.projectId)!)).sort((a, b) => a.scheduled.localeCompare(b.scheduled))
  const active = s.projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'active' && inProg(p))
  const unscheduled = active.filter((p) => !s.gateReviews.some((g) => g.projectId === p.id && g.stageIndex === p.stageIndex && g.status === 'scheduled'))
  const readyUnscheduled = unscheduled.filter((p) => readiness(s, p).pct >= 80)
  const decisions = s.gateDecisions.filter((g) => inProg(s.projects.find((p) => p.id === g.projectId)!))
  const last12 = decisions.filter((g) => g.date > addDays(asOf, -365))
  const recycles = last12.filter((g) => g.outcome === 'recycle').length
  const waivers = s.workflows.filter((w) => w.recordType === 'waiver' && w.projectId && inProg(s.projects.find((p) => p.id === w.projectId)!))
  const waiversGranted = waivers.filter((w) => w.status === 'approved')
  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const res = await saveFile(`gate-calendar-${asOf}.csv`, toCSV(reviews.map((g) => {
      const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === g.projectId)!
      const r = readiness(s, p)
      return { Date: g.scheduled, Project: p.code, Name: p.name, Gate: templateFor(s, p).stages[g.stageIndex]?.gate.name, ReadinessPct: r.pct, Blockers: r.blockers.join('; '), Board: g.board.map((b) => personName(s, b)).join('; ') }
    })), 'text/csv')
    if (res === 'saved') toast('Gate calendar exported')
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <PageHeader eyebrow="Stage-gate governance" title="Gate reviews"
        subtitle="Board dates across the portfolio with live readiness, and how long projects take to move through each stage. Readiness counts accepted or waived deliverables against the gate's required list."
        actions={<>
          <Select id="gates-program" value={program} onChange={(e) => setProgram(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All programs' }, ...s.programs.map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: `${p.code} · ${p.name}` }))]} />
          <Button icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-4 w-4" />} onClick={exportCsv}>Export</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" icon={<Icon name="plus" className="h-4 w-4" />} onClick={() => setSched({ open: true })}>Schedule review</Button>
        </>} />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
        <Stat label="Reviews next 60 days" value={reviews.filter((g) => daysBetween(asOf, g.scheduled) <= 60).length} sub={reviews[0] ? `Next ${fmtDate(reviews[0].scheduled)}` : 'None scheduled'} />
        <Stat label="Ready, not scheduled" value={readyUnscheduled.length} sub="Readiness ≥ 80% with no board date" tone={readyUnscheduled.length ? 'warn' : undefined} />
        <Stat label="Recycle rate · 12 mo" value={last12.length ? `${Math.round((recycles / last12.length) * 100)}%` : '—'} sub={`${recycles} of ${last12.length} decisions`} tone={recycles / Math.max(1, last12.length) > 0.15 ? 'bad' : 'good'} />
        <Stat label="Waivers granted" value={waiversGranted.length} sub={`${waivers.filter((w) => w.status === 'running').length} in review · ${waivers.filter((w) => w.status === 'rejected').length} rejected`} />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.25fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Panel title="Upcoming gate reviews" pad={false} actions={<SegButtons value={view} onChange={setView} options={[{ id: 'list', label: 'List' }, { id: 'calendar', label: 'Calendar' }]} />}>
          {reviews.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No gate reviews scheduled" action={<Button onClick={() => setSched({ open: true })}>Schedule review</Button>} /></div>
            : view === 'list' ? <ReviewList s={s} reviews={reviews} onEdit={(pid) => setSched({ open: true, pid })} /> : <ReviewCalendar s={s} reviews={reviews} />}
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Ready but not scheduled" subtitle="Active projects with no board date for their current gate, most ready first" pad={false}>
          {unscheduled.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="Every active project has a board date" /></div> : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-line overflow-y-auto" style={{ maxHeight: 420 }}>
              {unscheduled.map((p) => ({ p, r: readiness(s, p) })).sort((a, b) => b.r.pct - a.r.pct).map(({ p, r }) => (
                <li key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2">
                  <a href={projectHref(p.id, 'lifecycle')} className="min-w-0 flex-1 hover:text-link">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs"><ProgramTag programId={p.programId} /><Mono className="font-semibold">{p.code}</Mono><span className="truncate text-muted">{templateFor(s, p).stages[p.stageIndex]?.gate.name}</span></div>
                    <div className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold">{p.name}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2"><Progress value={r.pct} tone={r.pct >= 80 ? 'good' : r.pct >= 50 ? 'warn' : 'bad'} className="max-w-[120px]" /><span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-muted">{r.pct}%{r.blockers.length ? ` · ${r.blockers[0]}` : ''}</span></div>
                  </a>
                  <Button size="sm" variant={r.pct >= 80 ? 'marker' : 'secondary'} onClick={() => setSched({ open: true, pid: p.id })}>Schedule</Button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Panel>
      </div>

      <Panel title="Readiness heat map" subtitle="Active projects by current gate. Deliverables done/total, estimate class against the gate requirement, and high risks without a response." pad={false}>
        <ReadinessHeat s={s} projects={active} />
      </Panel>

      <GateMetrics s={s} program={program} />
      <ScheduleReviewModal open={sched.open} projectId={sched.pid} onClose={() => setSched({ open: false })} />
    </div>
  )
}

function ReviewList({ s, reviews, onEdit }: { s: AppState; reviews: GateReview[]; onEdit: (pid: string) => void }) {
  const byMonth = groupBy(reviews, (g) => g.scheduled.slice(0, 7))
  return (
    <div className="overflow-y-auto" style={{ maxHeight: 520 }}>
      {Object.entries(byMonth).map(([m, gs]) => (
        <div key={m}>
          <div className="sticky top-0 z-[1] border-b border-line bg-sunken px-4 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">{fmtMonth(m)} · {gs.length} review{gs.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}</div>
          <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
            {gs.map((g) => {
              const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === g.projectId)!
              const r = readiness(s, p)
              const days = daysBetween(s.settings.asOf, g.scheduled)
              const gate = templateFor(s, p).stages[g.stageIndex]?.gate
              const wf = s.workflows.find((w) => w.projectId === p.id && w.defKey === 'gate-review' && w.status === 'running')
              const atRisk = days <= 21 && r.pct < 80
              return (
                <li key={g.id} className="grid grid-cols-[52px_minmax(0,1fr)_auto] items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5">
                  <div className={cx('rounded border text-center leading-tight', days <= 14 ? 'border-marker bg-marker/10' : 'border-line')}>
                    <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase text-faint">{fmtDate(g.scheduled).slice(0, 3)}</div>
                    <div className="font-display text-[19px] font-bold tabular-nums">{Number(g.scheduled.slice(8, 10))}</div>
                  </div>
                  <a href={projectHref(p.id, 'lifecycle')} className="min-w-0 hover:text-link">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs"><ProgramTag programId={p.programId} /><Mono className="font-semibold">{p.code}</Mono><span className="text-muted">{gate?.name}</span>{wf && <Badge tone="info">Packet in review</Badge>}{atRisk && <Badge tone="bad">At risk</Badge>}</div>
                    <div className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold">{p.name}</div>
                    <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <Progress value={r.pct} tone={r.pct >= 80 ? 'good' : r.pct >= 50 ? 'warn' : 'bad'} className="w-[110px]" />
                      <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-muted">{r.pct}% · {r.done}/{r.total}</span>
                      <span className="flex -space-x-1">{g.board.map((b) => <span key={b} title={personName(s, b)} className="rounded-full ring-2 ring-surface"><Avatar name={personName(s, b)} size={18} /></span>)}</span>
                    </div>
                  </a>
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
                    <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-faint">in {days}d</span>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => onEdit(p.id)}>Reschedule</Button>
                  </div>
                </li>
              )
            })}
          </ul>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

function ReviewCalendar({ s, reviews }: { s: AppState; reviews: GateReview[] }) {
  const months = Array.from(new Set([s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 7), ...reviews.map((g) => g.scheduled.slice(0, 7))])).sort().slice(0, 4)
  const [mi, setMi] = useState(0)
  const m = months[Math.min(mi, months.length - 1)]
  const first = new Date(m + '-01T12:00:00Z')
  const startDow = first.getUTCDay()
  const daysIn = new Date(Date.UTC(first.getUTCFullYear(), first.getUTCMonth() + 1, 0)).getUTCDate()
  const cells = Array.from({ length: Math.ceil((startDow + daysIn) / 7) * 7 }, (_, i) => i - startDow + 1)
  const byDay = groupBy(reviews.filter((g) => g.scheduled.startsWith(m)), (g) => String(Number(g.scheduled.slice(8, 10))))
  const today = s.settings.asOf.startsWith(m) ? Number(s.settings.asOf.slice(8, 10)) : -1
  return (
    <div className="p-3">
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={mi === 0} onClick={() => setMi(mi - 1)}>← Prev</Button>
        <span className="font-display text-[15px] font-semibold">{fmtMonth(m)}</span>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={mi >= months.length - 1} onClick={() => setMi(mi + 1)}>Next →</Button>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded border border-line bg-line text-[11px]">
        {['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'].map((d) => <div key={d} className="bg-sunken px-1.5 py-1 font-semibold text-muted">{d}</div>)}
        {cells.map((d, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={cx('min-h-[72px] bg-surface p-1', (d < 1 || d > daysIn) && 'bg-sunken/40')}>
            {d >= 1 && d <= daysIn && <div className={cx('mb-0.5 text-[11px] tabular-nums', d === today ? 'inline-block rounded-full bg-marker px-1.5 font-bold text-markerink' : 'text-faint')}>{d}</div>}
            {(byDay[String(d)] ?? []).map((g) => {
              const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === g.projectId)!
              const r = readiness(s, p)
              return <a key={g.id} href={projectHref(p.id, 'lifecycle')} title={`${p.name} · ${r.pct}% ready`} className={cx('mb-0.5 block truncate rounded-sm border-l-2 bg-sunken px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10.5px] font-semibold hover:bg-line', r.pct >= 80 ? 'border-good' : r.pct >= 50 ? 'border-warn' : 'border-bad')}>{p.code.slice(4)} G{g.stageIndex + 1}</a>
            })}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function ReadinessHeat({ s, projects }: { s: AppState; projects: Project[] }) {
  const rows = projects.map((p) => {
    const r = readiness(s, p)
    const defs = requiredDefs(s, p)
    const dls = s.deliverables.filter((d) => d.projectId === p.id && d.stageIndex === p.stageIndex)
    const review = s.gateReviews.find((g) => g.projectId === p.id && g.stageIndex === p.stageIndex && g.status === 'scheduled')
    return { p, r, defs, dls, review }
  }).sort((a, b) => (a.review?.scheduled ?? '9').localeCompare(b.review?.scheduled ?? '9') || b.r.pct - a.r.pct)
  const maxDefs = Math.max(...rows.map((x) => x.defs.length), 1)
  const cell = (st?: string) => st === 'accepted' ? 'bg-good' : st === 'waived' ? 'bg-good/40' : st === 'submitted' ? 'bg-info/70' : st === 'in-progress' ? 'bg-warn/60' : st === 'returned' ? 'bg-bad' : 'bg-sunken border border-line'
  return (
    <div className="scroll-x" style={{ maxHeight: 560, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
      <table className="tbl">
        <thead><tr><th>Project · gate</th><th>Deliverables</th><th className="num">Done</th><th className="text-center">Estimate</th><th className="num">High risks</th><th className="num">Ready</th><th>Board</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map(({ p, r, defs, dls, review }) => (
            <tr key={p.id} className="clickable" onClick={() => go(projectHref(p.id, 'lifecycle'))}>
              <td className="min-w-[220px]">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><ProgramTag programId={p.programId} /><Mono className="font-semibold">{p.code}</Mono></div>
                <div className="max-w-[280px] truncate text-[12px] text-muted">{templateFor(s, p).stages[p.stageIndex]?.gate.name}</div>
              </td>
              <td>
                <div className="flex gap-0.5" style={{ minWidth: maxDefs * 16 }}>
                  {defs.map((def) => { const d = dls.find((x) => x.defId === def.id); return <span key={def.id} title={`${def.name}: ${d?.status ?? 'not-started'}`} className={cx('h-4 w-3.5 rounded-sm', cell(d?.status))} /> })}
                </div>
              </td>
              <td className="num">{r.done}/{r.total}</td>
              <td className="text-center">
                {r.estimateRequired ? (
                  <span className={cx('inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5', r.estimateOk ? 'bg-good/10' : 'bg-bad/10')} title={`Requires Class ${r.estimateRequired}`}>
                    {r.estimateClass ? <ClassBadge cls={r.estimateClass as 1} /> : <span className="text-[11px] text-bad">none</span>}<span className={cx('text-[11px] font-bold', r.estimateOk ? 'text-good' : 'text-bad')}>{r.estimateOk ? '✓' : `→C${r.estimateRequired}`}</span>
                  </span>
                ) : <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">n/a</span>}
              </td>
              <td className={cx('num font-semibold', r.highRisks ? 'text-bad' : 'text-faint')}>{r.highRisks || '0'}</td>
              <td className="num"><span className={cx('rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-bold tabular-nums', r.ready ? 'bg-good text-white' : r.pct >= 80 ? 'bg-warn/20 text-warn' : r.pct >= 50 ? 'bg-warn/10 text-warn' : 'bg-bad/10 text-bad')}>{r.pct}%</span></td>
              <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{review ? fmtDate(review.scheduled) : <span className="text-faint">Not scheduled</span>}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 border-t border-line px-4 py-2 text-[11px] text-muted">
        {[['bg-good', 'Accepted'], ['bg-good/40', 'Waived'], ['bg-info/70', 'Submitted'], ['bg-warn/60', 'In progress'], ['bg-bad', 'Returned'], ['bg-sunken border border-line', 'Not started']].map(([c, l]) => <span key={l} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className={cx('inline-block h-3 w-2.5 rounded-sm', c)} />{l}</span>)}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function GateMetrics({ s, program }: { s: AppState; program: string }) {
  const durs = useMemo(() => stageDurations(s), [s])
  const programs = s.programs.filter((p) => !program || p.id === program)
  const std = s.templates.find((t) => t.id === 'tpl-standard')!
  const small = s.templates.find((t) => t.id === 'tpl-small')!
  const tplFor = (pid: string) => s.templates.find((t) => t.id === s.programs.find((p) => p.id === pid)?.lifecycleTemplateId) ?? std
  const outcomes = s.gateDecisions.filter((g) => !program || s.projects.find((p) => p.id === g.projectId)?.programId === program)
  const byOutcome = groupBy(outcomes, (g) => g.outcome)
  const withConds = outcomes.filter((g) => g.conditions.length)
  const condActions = s.actions.filter((a) => a.source === 'gate' && withConds.some((g) => g.conditions.includes(a.id)))
  const condOpenLate = condActions.filter((a) => a.status === 'open' && a.due < s.settings.asOf)
  const avg = (xs: number[]) => (xs.length ? Math.round(sum(xs) / xs.length) : undefined)
  const allAvgs = programs.flatMap((pr) => tplFor(pr.id).stages.map((_, i) => avg(durs.filter((d) => d.programId === pr.id && d.stageIndex === i).map((d) => d.days)) ?? 0))
  const maxAvg = Math.max(...allAvgs, 1)
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.6fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
      <Panel title="Average days per stage" subtitle="From stage entry to the Go decision at its gate, across completed stages. Bars share one scale." pad={false}>
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Program</th>{std.stages.map((st, i) => <th key={st.id} className="num" title={st.name}>{i + 1}. {st.name.split(' ')[0]}</th>)}<th className="num">Total</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {programs.map((pr) => {
                const t = tplFor(pr.id)
                const vals = t.stages.map((_, i) => ({ v: avg(durs.filter((d) => d.programId === pr.id && d.stageIndex === i).map((d) => d.days)), n: durs.filter((d) => d.programId === pr.id && d.stageIndex === i).length }))
                const cols = t.id === small.id ? [vals[0], { v: undefined, n: -1 }, vals[1], vals[2], { v: undefined, n: -1 }] : vals
                return (
                  <tr key={pr.id}>
                    <td><span className="flex items-center gap-2"><ProgramTag programId={pr.id} />{t.id === small.id && <span className="text-[10.5px] text-faint">3-stage</span>}</span></td>
                    {cols.map((c, i) => (
                      <td key={i} className="num" style={{ minWidth: 92 }}>
                        {c.n === -1 ? <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">combined</span> : c.v === undefined ? <span className="text-faint">—</span> : (
                          <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-0.5">
                            <span className="font-semibold">{c.v}d <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-faint">n={c.n}</span></span>
                            <span className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-link/70" style={{ width: `${(c.v / maxAvg) * 80}px` }} />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                    <td className="num font-semibold">{sum(vals.map((x) => x.v ?? 0))}d</td>
                  </tr>
                )
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </Panel>
      <Panel title="Gate outcomes" subtitle="All recorded decisions">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {(['go', 'go-with-conditions', 'recycle', 'hold', 'cancel'] as const).map((o) => {
            const n = byOutcome[o]?.length ?? 0
            return (
              <div key={o} className="grid grid-cols-[130px_1fr_40px] items-center gap-2 text-[12px]">
                <span>{({ go: 'Go', 'go-with-conditions': 'Go with conditions', recycle: 'Recycle', hold: 'Hold', cancel: 'Cancel' })[o]}</span>
                <span className="h-3 rounded-sm bg-sunken"><span className={cx('block h-3 rounded-sm', o === 'go' ? 'bg-good/80' : o === 'go-with-conditions' ? 'bg-info/70' : o === 'cancel' ? 'bg-bad/80' : 'bg-warn/80')} style={{ width: `${(n / Math.max(1, outcomes.length)) * 100}%` }} /></span>
                <span className="text-right font-semibold tabular-nums">{n}</span>
              </div>
            )
          })}
          <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-line pt-3 text-[12px]">
            <div><div className="text-faint">Gate conditions issued</div><div className="font-display text-[19px] font-bold tabular-nums">{condActions.length}</div><div className="text-muted">{condActions.filter((a) => a.status === 'done').length} met</div></div>
            <div><div className="text-faint">Conditions overdue</div><div className={cx('font-display text-[19px] font-bold tabular-nums', condOpenLate.length ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{condOpenLate.length}</div><div className="text-muted">open past due date</div></div>
          </div>
          {condOpenLate.length > 0 && (
            <ul className="mt-1 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {condOpenLate.slice(0, 5).map((a) => <li key={a.id}><a href={projectHref(a.projectId, 'lifecycle')} className="block rounded border border-bad/30 px-2 py-1 text-[12px] hover:bg-bad/5"><Mono className="font-semibold">{s.projects.find((p) => p.id === a.projectId)?.code}</Mono> {a.title}<span className="block text-[11px] text-muted">{personName(s, a.ownerId)} · due {fmtDate(a.due)}</span></a></li>)}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      </Panel>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/gates/ScheduleReview.tsx =====
// Schedule (or reschedule) a gate review board date for a project's current gate. Used by the gate
// calendar and the project's lifecycle tab.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { templateFor } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { addDays, fmtDate, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Button, Callout, Checkbox, Field, Input, Modal } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { ProjectSelect } from '../shared/pickers'

export function ScheduleReviewModal({ open, onClose, projectId: fixed }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; projectId?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [pid, setPid] = useState(fixed ?? '')
  const [date, setDate] = useState(addDays(s.settings.asOf, 21))
  const [board, setBoard] = useState<string[]>([])
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === pid)
  const existing = p ? s.gateReviews.find((g) => g.projectId === p.id && g.stageIndex === p.stageIndex && g.status === 'scheduled') : undefined
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const id = fixed ?? pid
    setPid(id)
    const proj = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === id)
    const ex = proj ? s.gateReviews.find((g) => g.projectId === proj.id && g.stageIndex === proj.stageIndex && g.status === 'scheduled') : undefined
    setBoard(ex?.board ?? (proj ? [proj.team.sponsor, 'u-pmo2'].filter(Boolean) as string[] : []))
    if (ex) setDate(ex.scheduled)
  }, [open, fixed, pid]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const eligible = s.people.filter((x) => !x.company && (x.roles.includes('gate-board') || x.roles.includes('sponsor') || x.roles.includes('exec')))
  const gate = p ? templateFor(s, p).stages[p.stageIndex]?.gate : undefined
  const active = s.projects.filter((x) => x.status === 'active')
  const save = () => {
    if (!p || !gate) return
    if (!board.length) { toast('Pick at least one board member', 'bad'); return }
    if (date < s.settings.asOf) { toast('Pick a date from today on', 'bad'); return }
    if (existing) {
      mutate((d) => { const g = d.gateReviews.find((x) => x.id === existing.id)!; g.scheduled = date; g.board = board }, { entity: 'gate-review', entityId: existing.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'reschedule', summary: `${gate.name} review moved ${existing.scheduled} → ${date}` })
      toast(`Gate review moved to ${fmtDate(date)}`)
    } else {
      const id = uid('gr')
      mutate((d) => { d.gateReviews.push({ id, projectId: p.id, stageIndex: p.stageIndex, scheduled: date, board, status: 'scheduled' }) }, { entity: 'gate-review', entityId: id, projectId: p.id, action: 'schedule', summary: `${gate.name} review scheduled for ${date}` })
      toast(`Gate review scheduled for ${fmtDate(date)}`)
    }
    onClose()
  }
  const cancelReview = () => {
    if (!existing || !p) return
