import { functionRows } from '@/core/engine/wbs'
// Record summaries shown next to a workflow task, so an approver can decide without hunting for the record.
import type { AppState, DeliverableDef, WorkflowInstance } from '@/core/types'
import { personName } from '@/core/store'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { estimateTotals } from '@/core/engine/estimates'
import { position } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { readiness, stageName, templateFor } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { categoryName } from '@/core/store'
import { fmtDate, money, moneyDelta } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Callout, ClassBadge, KV, Progress, StatusBadge } from '@/ui/kit'
import { ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'
import { QuickReviewSummary } from '../estimating/quick/QuickView'
import { FactorModelReviewSummary } from '../estimating/admin/FactorModel'
import { commitmentRow } from '@/core/engine/finance'
import { lineById } from '@/core/engine/lines'

export function deliverableDef(s: AppState, defId: string): DeliverableDef | undefined {
  for (const t of s.templates) for (const st of t.stages) { const d = st.gate.deliverables.find((x) => x.id === defId); if (d) return d }
  return undefined
}

/** Which project tab holds the record behind an instance. */
export function recordTab(inst: WorkflowInstance): string {
  switch (inst.recordType) {
    case 'estimate': return 'estimates'
    case 'change': return 'changes'
    case 'safety-plan': return 'safety'
    case 'contingency': return 'risk'
    case 'variance': return 'cost'
    case 'contract': return 'permits'
    case 'closeout': return 'records'
    case 'budget': return 'baselines'
    case 'forecast': return 'forecast'
    case 'commitment-change': return 'finance'
    default: return 'lifecycle'
  }
}

export function recordHref(inst: WorkflowInstance): string | undefined {
  if (inst.projectId) return projectHref(inst.projectId, recordTab(inst))
  if (inst.recordType === 'initiation') return '#planning'
  return undefined
}

export function ProjectLine({ s, projectId }: { s: AppState; projectId?: string }) {
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)
  if (!p) return <div className="text-[12px] text-muted">Portfolio-level request (no project yet)</div>
  const pos = position(s, p.id)
  return (
    <div className="rounded border border-line bg-sunken/50 px-3 py-2">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[12px]"><ProgramTag programId={p.programId} /><a href={projectHref(p.id)} className="font-mono font-semibold text-link">{p.code}</a><span className="min-w-0 truncate font-semibold">{p.name}</span></div>
      <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-muted">
        <span>{stageName(s, p)}</span><span>PM {personName(s, p.team.pm)}</span>
        {pos.currentBudget > 0 && <span>Budget <b className="text-ink tabular-nums">{money(pos.currentBudget)}</b></span>}
        {pos.eac > 0 && <span>EAC <b className={pos.currentBudget && pos.eac > pos.currentBudget ? 'text-bad tabular-nums' : 'text-ink tabular-nums'}>{money(pos.eac)}</b></span>}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export function RecordSummary({ s, inst }: { s: AppState; inst: WorkflowInstance }) {
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === inst.projectId)
  const pos = p ? position(s, p.id) : undefined
  const d = inst.data
  switch (inst.recordType) {
    case 'estimate': {
      const e = s.estimates.find((x) => x.id === inst.recordId)
      if (!e) break
      if (e.method === 'quick') return <QuickReviewSummary estimateId={e.id} />
      const t = estimateTotals(e)
      const prev = s.estimates.filter((x) => x.projectId === e.projectId && x.status === 'approved' && x.id !== e.id).sort((a, b) => b.version - a.version)[0]
      const pt = prev && estimateTotals(prev)
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-end gap-3"><div className="font-display text-[26px] font-bold leading-none tabular-nums">{money(t.total)}</div><ClassBadge cls={e.cls} size="lg" /><span className="text-[12px] text-muted">v{e.version} · {e.method}</span></div>
          <div className="text-[12px] text-muted">Range {money(t.low)} – {money(t.high)} at Class {e.cls}{pt && <> · vs approved Class {prev!.cls} {money(pt.total)} (<b className={t.total > pt.total ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good'}>{moneyDelta(t.total - pt.total)}</b>)</>}</div>
          <KV cols={2} items={[['Base (direct + loaders + escalation)', money(t.base)], ['Contingency', `${money(t.contingency)} (${e.contingency.pct}% ${e.contingency.method})`], ['Lines', String(e.lines.length)], ['Prepared by', personName(s, e.createdById)]]} />
          {e.basis.classJustification && <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted"><b className="text-ink">Class basis:</b> {e.basis.classJustification}</p>}
        </div>
      )
    }
    case 'change': {
      const c = s.changes.find((x) => x.id === inst.recordId)
      if (!c) break
      const remaining = pos?.contingencyRemaining ?? 0
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
            <div><div className="eyebrow">Cost impact</div><div className="font-display text-[24px] font-bold tabular-nums">{moneyDelta(c.costImpact)}</div></div>
            <div><div className="eyebrow">Schedule</div><div className={`font-display text-[24px] font-bold tabular-nums ${c.scheduleImpactDays > 30 ? 'text-warn' : ''}`}>{c.scheduleImpactDays ? `+${c.scheduleImpactDays} d` : '0 d'}</div></div>
            <Badge tone="ink">{c.code}</Badge><StatusBadge status={c.status} />
          </div>
          <KV cols={2} items={[['Root cause', c.rootCause], ['Funded from', c.fundedFrom === 'contingency' ? 'Contingency' : c.fundedFrom === 'new-funding' ? 'New funding' : 'None'], ['Cost category', categoryName(s, c.categoryId)], ['Contingency remaining', <span key="r" className={c.fundedFrom === 'contingency' && c.costImpact > remaining ? 'font-semibold text-bad' : ''}>{money(remaining)}</span>]]} />
          {c.fundedFrom === 'contingency' && c.costImpact > remaining && <Callout tone="bad">This change exceeds remaining contingency by {money(c.costImpact - remaining)}.</Callout>}
          <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">{c.description}{c.scopeImpact && c.scopeImpact !== 'None' ? ` Scope: ${c.scopeImpact}` : ''}</p>
        </div>
      )
    }
    case 'safety-plan': {
      const sp = s.safetyPlans.find((x) => x.id === inst.recordId)
      if (!sp) break
      const expiring = sp.tickets.filter((t) => t.expires < s.settings.asOf).length
      const oqOn = !!s.settings.features?.opQual
      const nonCompliant = sp.crew.filter((c) => c.prequal === 'Non-compliant' || (oqOn && c.oqExpires < s.settings.asOf)).length
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><b className="text-[15px]">Work package {sp.workPackage}</b><Badge>v{sp.version}</Badge><StatusBadge status={sp.status} /></div>
          <KV cols={2} items={[['Contractor', sp.contractor], ['Activities', sp.activities.join(', ')], ['Hazards covered', String(sp.hazardIds.length)], ['Crew', `${sp.crew.length} people`], ['Tickets & permits', `${sp.tickets.length}${expiring ? ` (${expiring} expired)` : ''}`], ['Heat / traffic plan', `${sp.heatPlan ? 'Yes' : 'No'} / ${sp.trafficPlan ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`]]} />
          {(nonCompliant > 0 || expiring > 0) && <Callout tone="warn">{nonCompliant ? `${nonCompliant} crew member(s) with ${oqOn ? 'lapsed OQ or ' : ''}non-compliant prequalification. ` : ''}{expiring ? `${expiring} ticket(s) expired.` : ''}</Callout>}
          <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">Site: {sp.site.address} · Hospital {sp.site.hospital} · Muster {sp.site.musterPoint}</p>
        </div>
      )
    }
    case 'deliverable': {
      const dl = s.deliverables.find((x) => x.id === inst.recordId)
      if (!dl) break
      const def = deliverableDef(s, dl.defId)
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><b className="text-[15px]">{def?.name ?? String(d.deliverable ?? 'Deliverable')}</b><Badge>v{dl.version}</Badge><StatusBadge status={dl.status} /></div>
          {def && <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">{def.description}</p>}
          {def && <Callout tone="info" title="Acceptance criteria">{def.acceptance}</Callout>}
          <KV cols={2} items={[['Owner', personName(s, dl.ownerId)], ['Due', fmtDate(dl.due)], ['Stage', p ? templateFor(s, p).stages[dl.stageIndex]?.name : '—'], ['Evidence', `${dl.evidence.length} file${dl.evidence.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`]]} />
          {dl.evidence.length > 0 && <ul className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 text-[12.5px]">{dl.evidence.map((ev) => <li key={ev.id} className="flex justify-between gap-2"><span className="truncate">{ev.name}</span><span className="shrink-0 text-faint">{ev.sizeKb.toLocaleString()} KB</span></li>)}</ul>}
          {dl.evidence.length === 0 && <Callout tone="warn">No evidence attached. Return it if the criteria need a document.</Callout>}
        </div>
      )
    }
    case 'variance': {
      const v = s.variances.find((x) => x.id === inst.recordId)
      if (!v) break
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3"><div className="font-display text-[22px] font-bold tabular-nums text-bad">{v.metric === 'eac' ? moneyDelta(v.amount) : `+${v.amount} days`}</div><span className="text-[12.5px]">{v.description}</span></div>
          <KV cols={2} items={[['Root cause', v.rootCause ?? '—'], ['Author', personName(s, v.authorId)], ['Budget', money(pos?.currentBudget)], ['Forecast (EAC)', money(pos?.eac)]]} />
          <div className="rounded border border-line px-3 py-2 text-[13px]"><div className="eyebrow mb-1">Explanation</div>{v.narrative || <span className="text-muted">No narrative yet.</span>}</div>
        </div>
      )
    }
    case 'contingency': {
      const c = s.contingencyDraws.find((x) => x.id === inst.recordId)
      if (!c) break
      const risk = s.risks.find((r) => r.id === c.riskId)
      const remaining = pos?.contingencyRemaining ?? 0
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
            <div><div className="eyebrow">Drawdown</div><div className="font-display text-[24px] font-bold tabular-nums">{money(c.amount)}</div></div>
            <div><div className="eyebrow">Contingency left</div><div className="font-display text-[24px] font-bold tabular-nums">{money(remaining)}</div></div>
            <div><div className="eyebrow">After this draw</div><div className={`font-display text-[24px] font-bold tabular-nums ${remaining - c.amount < 0 ? 'text-bad' : ''}`}>{money(remaining - c.amount)}</div></div>
          </div>
          {pos && pos.contingencyOriginal > 0 && <Progress value={((pos.contingencyUsed + c.amount) / pos.contingencyOriginal) * 100} tone={(pos.contingencyUsed + c.amount) / pos.contingencyOriginal > 0.75 ? 'warn' : 'ink'} />}
          <KV cols={2} items={[['Risk realized', risk ? <span key="r"><b>{risk.code}</b> {risk.title}</span> : String(d.risk ?? '—')], ['Risk most-likely cost', risk ? money(risk.cost.ml) : '—']]} />
          <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">{c.reason}</p>
        </div>
      )
    }
    case 'gate': {
      if (!p) break
      const r = readiness(s, p)
      const gate = templateFor(s, p).stages[p.stageIndex]?.gate
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><b className="text-[15px]">{gate?.name}</b>{String(d.recommendation ?? '') && <Badge tone="info">PM recommends: {String(d.recommendation)}</Badge>}</div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><div className="font-display text-[26px] font-bold tabular-nums">{r.pct}%</div><div className="flex-1"><Progress value={r.pct} tone={r.ready ? 'good' : r.pct >= 75 ? 'warn' : 'bad'} /><div className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] text-muted">{r.done} of {r.total} deliverables accepted</div></div></div>
          <KV cols={2} items={[['Estimate', r.estimateRequired ? <span key="e" className={r.estimateOk ? 'text-good' : 'text-bad'}>{r.estimateClass ? `Class ${r.estimateClass}` : 'None approved'} (needs Class {r.estimateRequired})</span> : 'No class requirement'], ['High risks without response', <span key="h" className={r.highRisks ? 'text-bad' : ''}>{r.highRisks}</span>]]} />
          {r.blockers.length ? <Callout tone="warn" title="Blockers">{r.blockers.map((b) => <div key={b}>{b}</div>)}</Callout> : <Callout tone="good">Packet complete — ready for the board.</Callout>}
          {r.missing.length > 0 && <div className="text-[12px] text-muted">Outstanding: {r.missing.map((m) => m.name).join(', ')}</div>}
        </div>
      )
    }
    case 'waiver': {
      const dl = s.deliverables.find((x) => x.id === d.deliverableId)
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><b className="text-[15px]">Exception request</b>{String(d.permission ?? '') && <Badge tone="warn">{String(d.permission)}</Badge>}</div>
          <p className="text-[13px]">{String(d.reason ?? '')}</p>
          {dl && <KV cols={2} items={[['Deliverable affected', deliverableDef(s, dl.defId)?.name ?? '—'], ['Deliverable status', <StatusBadge key="s" status={dl.status} />]]} />}
          <Callout tone="info">Approved exceptions are flagged on every later gate packet and the rate-case evidence package.</Callout>
        </div>
      )
    }
    case 'initiation':
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3"><div><div className="eyebrow">Rough order of magnitude</div><div className="font-display text-[24px] font-bold tabular-nums">{money(Number(d.amount ?? 0))}</div></div></div>
          <div className="rounded border border-line px-3 py-2 text-[13px]"><div className="eyebrow mb-1">Need</div>{String(d.need ?? '')}</div>
          <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">Submitted by {personName(s, inst.startedById)}. Approval creates the project in Initiation with a Class 5 estimate to prepare.</p>
        </div>
      )
    case 'forecast': {
      const f = s.forecasts.find((x) => x.id === inst.recordId)
      if (!f || !p) break
      const prior = s.forecasts.filter((x) => x.projectId === f.projectId && x.status === 'approved' && x.id !== f.id).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)).pop()
      const rows = functionRows(s, p, f)
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-end gap-3"><div className="font-display text-[26px] font-bold leading-none tabular-nums">{money(f.eac)}</div><span className="text-[12px] text-muted">EAC · budget {money(pos?.currentBudget)}{prior && <> · vs prior approved <b className={f.eac > prior.eac ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good'}>{moneyDelta(f.eac - prior.eac)}</b></>}</span></div>
          <table className="tbl"><thead><tr><th>WBS function</th><th className="num">Budget</th><th className="num">ETC</th><th className="num">EAC</th><th className="num">Var.</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{rows.map((r) => <tr key={r.fn.id}><td><span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-faint">{r.fn.code}</span> {r.fn.name}</td><td className="num">{money(r.budget)}</td><td className="num">{money(r.etc)}</td><td className="num">{money(r.eac)}</td><td className={'num ' + (r.variance < 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-muted')}>{moneyDelta(r.variance)}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
          {f.note && <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted"><b className="text-ink">Basis:</b> {f.note}</p>}
        </div>
      )
    }
    case 'commitment-change': return <CommitmentChangeSummary s={s} id={inst.recordId} />
    case 'factor-model': return <FactorModelReviewSummary s={s} id={inst.recordId} />
    case 'contract': {
      const c = s.contracts.find((x) => x.id === inst.recordId)
      return <KV cols={2} items={[['Vendor', c?.vendor ?? String(d.vendor ?? '—')], ['Value', money(c?.value ?? Number(d.amount ?? 0))], ['Type', c?.type ?? '—'], ['Non-standard terms', d.nonStandard ? 'Yes' : 'No']]} />
    }
  }
  const entries = Object.entries(d).filter(([k]) => !k.startsWith('__'))
  return entries.length ? <KV cols={2} items={entries.map(([k, v]) => [k, typeof v === 'number' && k.toLowerCase().includes('amount') ? money(v) : String(v ?? '—')])} /> : <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">No form data.</p>
}


/** RFI / contract change order: what the vendor is asked to do, and the commitment before and after. */
function CommitmentChangeSummary({ s, id }: { s: AppState; id: string }) {
  const x = s.commitmentChanges.find((c) => c.id === id)
  if (!x) return <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Record not found.</p>
  const k = s.contracts.find((c) => c.id === x.contractId)
  const r = k ? commitmentRow(s, k) : undefined
  const ch = s.changes.find((c) => c.id === x.changeId)
  const live = x.status === 'in-review' || x.status === 'draft'
  const after = r ? r.current + (live ? x.amount : 0) : 0
  const io = k ? s.projects.find((p) => p.id === k.projectId)?.finance?.ios.find((i) => i.id === k.ioId) : undefined
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
        <div><div className="eyebrow">Change amount</div><div className={`font-display text-[24px] font-bold tabular-nums ${x.amount > 0 ? 'text-bad' : x.amount < 0 ? 'text-good' : ''}`}>{moneyDelta(x.amount)}</div></div>
        <div><div className="eyebrow">Schedule</div><div className={`font-display text-[24px] font-bold tabular-nums ${x.scheduleImpactDays > 0 ? 'text-warn' : ''}`}>{x.scheduleImpactDays ? `+${x.scheduleImpactDays} d` : '0 d'}</div></div>
        <Badge tone="ink">{x.code}</Badge><StatusBadge status={x.status} />
      </div>
      <div className="rounded border border-line px-3 py-2 text-[13px]"><div className="eyebrow mb-1">RFI / field condition</div><b>{x.rfi}</b><div className="mt-1 text-muted">{x.description}</div></div>
      {k && r && <KV cols={2} items={[
        ['Commitment', <span key="v"><b>{k.vendor}</b> · {k.type}</span>], ['SAP PO', `${k.poNumber ?? '—'}${k.pctOfPo !== undefined ? ` · ${k.pctOfPo}% of ${money(k.poTotal)}` : ''}`],
        ['Current commitment', money(r.current)], [live ? 'If approved' : 'After decision', <b key="a" className="tabular-nums">{money(after)}</b>],
        ['Invoiced', `${money(r.invoiced)} (${r.current ? Math.round((r.invoiced / r.current) * 100) : 0}%)`], ['Other changes in review', money(r.pendingChanges - (x.status === 'in-review' ? x.amount : 0))],
        ['Internal order', io ? `${io.number} · ${io.type === 'capital' ? 'Capital' : 'O&M'}` : 'None'], ['Forecast lines', (k.lineIds ?? []).map((l) => lineById(s, l)?.code).join(', ') || '—'],
      ]} />}
      {k?.scope && <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted"><b className="text-ink">Commitment scope:</b> {k.scope}</p>}
      {ch ? <Callout tone="info">Rolls into project change <b>{ch.code}</b> {ch.title} ({ch.status}).</Callout> : <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">Absorbed within the commitment; no project baseline change linked.</p>}
      {live && r && k && !!k.poTotal && after > (r.poShare ?? Infinity) && <Callout tone="warn">Approval takes this project to {((after / k.poTotal) * 100).toFixed(1)}% of the PO against {k.pctOfPo}% planned. Raise the planned share with supply.</Callout>}
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/map/MapPage.tsx =====
// Portfolio map (#map): every project on Esri basemaps with the utility's pipe layers.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useStore, personName } from '@/core/store'
import type { MapLayer, Project } from '@/core/types'
import { position } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { stageName } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { fmtLatLng, googleMapsUrl, lengthFt, projectPoint, projectsToGeoJSON, projectsToKML } from '@/core/engine/geo'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { money, num, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { saveFile } from '@/core/download'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, HealthDot, Input, PageHeader, Panel, SegButtons } from '@/ui/kit'
import { ProgramSelect, ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'
import { BASEMAPS, GisMap, type Basemap, type LayerStatus } from '@/ui/map/GisMap'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'

export default function MapPage() {
  const s = useStore()
  const gis = s.settings.gis
  const [basemap, setBasemap] = useState<Basemap>(gis.basemap)
  const [vis, setVis] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() => Object.fromEntries(gis.layers.map((l) => [l.id, l.visible])))
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Record<string, LayerStatus>>({})
  const [blocked, setBlocked] = useState(false)
  const [program, setProgram] = useState('')
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'all' | 'active' | 'construction' | 'closed'>('active')
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<string | undefined>()
  const [fitKey, setFitKey] = useState('0')
  const projects = useMemo(() => s.projects.filter((p) => projectPoint(p)).filter((p) => !program || p.programId === program)
    .filter((p) => phase === 'all' || (phase === 'closed' ? p.status === 'closed' : phase === 'construction' ? p.status === 'active' && /construct/i.test(stageName(s, p)) : p.status === 'active' || p.status === 'on-hold'))
    .filter((p) => !q || (p.code + ' ' + p.name + ' ' + p.location.city).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())), [s, program, phase, q])
  const budgets = useMemo(() => Object.fromEntries(s.projects.map((p) => [p.id, position(s, p.id).currentBudget || position(s, p.id).eac])), [s])
  const maxB = Math.max(1, ...Object.values(budgets))
  const layers: MapLayer[] = gis.layers.map((l) => ({ ...l, visible: !!vis[l.id] }))
  const selected = s.projects.find((p) => p.id === sel)
  const exportAll = async (kind: 'geojson' | 'kml') => {
    const r = kind === 'geojson' ? await saveFile('crosswalk-projects.geojson', JSON.stringify(projectsToGeoJSON(s, projects), null, 2), 'application/geo+json') : await saveFile('mainline-projects.kml', projectsToKML(projects, `${s.settings.orgName} capital projects`), 'application/vnd.google-earth.kml+xml')
    if (r === 'saved') toast(`Exported ${projects.length} projects`)
  }
  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader eyebrow="Portfolio" title="Map" subtitle="Project sites and pipeline alignments over Esri basemaps, with the utility's pipe network from GIS. Click a project for details."
        actions={<><Button size="sm" onClick={() => exportAll('geojson')}>Export GeoJSON</Button><Button size="sm" onClick={() => exportAll('kml')}>Export KML</Button><a href="#admin" className="text-[12px] text-link">GIS settings</a></>} />
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <div className="w-56"><ProgramSelect value={program} onChange={setProgram} /></div>
        <SegButtons options={[{ id: 'active', label: 'Active' }, { id: 'construction', label: 'In construction' }, { id: 'closed', label: 'Closed' }, { id: 'all', label: 'All' }]} value={phase} onChange={(v) => { setPhase(v); setFitKey(String(Math.random())) }} />
        <div className="w-60"><Input placeholder="Find project or city" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && projects[0]) setSel(projects[0].id) }} /></div>
        <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{projects.length} projects</span>
      </div>
      {blocked && <div className="mb-3"><Callout tone="warn" title="Basemap imagery is blocked in this view">This browser could not load the Esri tiles (offline, proxy or firewall blocking server.arcgisonline.com). Projects and the demo network still draw. Check network access to Esri and your GIS server, or switch the basemap to None.</Callout></div>}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_320px]">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2">
          {gis.allowExternal ? <SegButtons options={BASEMAPS.map((b) => ({ id: b.id, label: b.label }))} value={basemap} onChange={setBasemap} /> : <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">Outside map services are off (Configuration → GIS & maps). Project geometry and the demo network draw locally.</span>}
          <GisMap external={!!gis.allowExternal} projects={projects} layers={layers} demoNetwork={gis.demoNetwork} basemap={basemap} center={gis.center} zoom={gis.zoom} height="min(72vh, 720px)"
            selectedId={sel} focusId={sel} fitAllKey={fitKey + program} sizeBy={(p) => Math.sqrt((budgets[p.id] || 0) / maxB)} onProjectClick={(p) => setSel(p.id)}
            onLayerStatus={(x) => setStatus((m) => ({ ...m, [x.id]: x }))} onBasemapBlocked={setBlocked} />
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 text-[12px] text-muted">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-good" />On track</span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-warn" />Watch</span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-bad" />At risk</span>
            <span>Marker size = budget · thick lines = project alignments</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
          <Panel title="Layers" pad={false}>
            <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
              {gis.layers.map((l) => (
                <li key={l.id} className="flex items-start gap-2 px-4 py-2.5">
                  <input id={`lyr-${l.id}`} type="checkbox" className="mt-1" checked={!!vis[l.id]} onChange={(e) => setVis({ ...vis, [l.id]: e.target.checked })} />
                  <label htmlFor={`lyr-${l.id}`} className="min-w-0 flex-1 cursor-pointer">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] font-semibold"><span className="inline-block h-2 w-3 shrink-0 rounded-sm" style={{ background: l.color }} /><span className="truncate">{l.name}</span></div>
                    <div className="text-[11.5px] text-muted">{l.kind === 'demo' ? `${gis.demoNetwork.length} fictional lines` : l.url ? l.kind.replace('arcgis-', 'Esri ') : 'No URL set — add one in GIS settings'}</div>
                    {status[l.id]?.state === 'error' && vis[l.id] && <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-bad">{status[l.id].message}</div>}
                    {status[l.id]?.state === 'loading' && vis[l.id] && <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-faint">Loading…</div>}
                  </label>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </Panel>
          {selected ? <SelectedCard p={selected} /> : (
            <Panel title="Projects on the map" pad={false}>
              <ul className="max-h-[420px] divide-y divide-line overflow-y-auto">
                {projects.map((p) => (
                  <li key={p.id}><button onClick={() => setSel(p.id)} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-left hover:bg-sunken"><HealthDot rag={Object.values(p.health).includes('red') ? 'red' : Object.values(p.health).includes('amber') ? 'amber' : 'green'} /><span className="shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[11.5px] font-semibold">{p.code}</span><span className="min-w-0 truncate text-[12.5px]">{p.name}</span></button></li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </Panel>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )

  function SelectedCard({ p }: { p: Project }) {
    const pos = position(s, p.id)
    const pt = projectPoint(p)
    return (
      <Panel title={<span className="flex items-center gap-2"><ProgramTag programId={p.programId} /><span className="font-mono text-[13px]">{p.code}</span></span>} actions={<button className="text-xs text-muted hover:text-ink" onClick={() => { setSel(undefined); setFitKey(String(Math.random())) }}>Close</button>}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-[13px]">
          <div className="font-display text-[16px] font-semibold leading-snug">{p.name}</div>
          <div className="text-muted">{stageName(s, p)} · PM {personName(s, p.team.pm)}</div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">{(['scope', 'schedule', 'cost', 'risk', 'safety'] as const).map((k) => <HealthDot key={k} rag={p.health[k]} label={k[0].toUpperCase() + k.slice(1)} />)}</div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 tabular-nums">
            <div><div className="text-[11px] uppercase text-faint">Budget</div><b>{money(pos.currentBudget)}</b></div>
            <div><div className="text-[11px] uppercase text-faint">EAC</div><b className={cx(pos.eac > pos.currentBudget && pos.currentBudget ? 'text-bad' : '')}>{money(pos.eac)}</b></div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-[12px] text-muted"><span className="font-mono">{fmtLatLng(pt)}</span>{p.location.route?.length ? ` · ${num(lengthFt(p.location.route))} ft alignment` : ''}</div>
          <div className="text-[12px] text-muted">Line {p.asset.lineId}{p.asset.diameterIn ? ` · ${p.asset.diameterIn}"` : ''} · MAOP {p.asset.maopPsig} psig {p.location.hca && <Badge tone="warn">HCA</Badge>}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <a href={projectHref(p.id, 'map')} className="inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded bg-ink px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-surface">Open project map</a>
            <a href={projectHref(p.id)} className="inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded border border-line px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold">Project</a>
            {pt && gis.allowExternal && <a href={googleMapsUrl(pt)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded border border-line px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold">Google Maps ↗</a>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </Panel>
    )
  }
}

===== FILE: src/views/messages/lib.ts =====
// Messaging helpers: channels (project team channels and direct conversations), unread tracking and deep links.
// Deep links use plain hashes the router passes through as the view name:
//   #messages            → the inbox of conversations
//   #messages-1042       → PRJ-1042's team channel (created on first open)
//   #messages-dm-u-pc1   → direct conversation with that person (created on first message)
import type { AppState, Channel, ID, Message } from '@/core/types'
import { nowISO, uid } from '@/core/util'

/** Link to a project's team channel. Accepts 'prj-1042' or 'PRJ-1042'. */
export const messagesHref = (projectIdOrCode?: string) => (projectIdOrCode ? `#messages-${projectIdOrCode.replace(/\D/g, '')}` : '#messages')
/** Link to a direct conversation with a person. */
export const dmHref = (personId: ID) => `#messages-dm-${personId}`

export type MessageTarget = { kind: 'project'; projectId: ID } | { kind: 'direct'; personId: ID } | { kind: 'none' }

/** Parse the router's view name ('messages', 'messages-1042', 'messages-dm-u-pc1'). */
export function parseMessagesView(view: string): MessageTarget {
  const dm = view.match(/^messages-dm-(.+)$/)
  if (dm) return { kind: 'direct', personId: dm[1] }
  const pj = view.match(/^messages-(\d+)$/)
  if (pj) return { kind: 'project', projectId: `prj-${pj[1]}` }
  return { kind: 'none' }
}
export const isMessagesView = (view: string) => view === 'messages' || view.startsWith('messages-')

export const isMember = (c: Channel, me: ID) => c.memberIds.includes(me)
export const channelsFor = (s: Pick<AppState, 'channels'>, me: ID) => s.channels.filter((c) => isMember(c, me))
export const messagesIn = (s: Pick<AppState, 'messages'>, channelId: ID) => s.messages.filter((m) => m.channelId === channelId)
export const isUnread = (m: Message, me: ID) => m.fromId !== me && !m.readBy.includes(me)

export function unreadIn(s: Pick<AppState, 'messages'>, channelId: ID, me: ID): number {
  let n = 0
  for (const m of s.messages) if (m.channelId === channelId && isUnread(m, me)) n++
  return n
}

/** Unread messages across every channel the person belongs to (nav badge). */
export function unreadCount(s: Pick<AppState, 'channels' | 'messages'>, me: ID): number {
  const mine = new Set(channelsFor(s, me).map((c) => c.id))
  let n = 0
  for (const m of s.messages) if (mine.has(m.channelId) && isUnread(m, me)) n++
  return n
}

export const otherMember = (c: Channel, me: ID) => c.memberIds.find((x) => x !== me) ?? me

export function channelTitle(s: Pick<AppState, 'people' | 'projects'>, c: Channel, me: ID): string {
  if (c.kind === 'direct') return s.people.find((p) => p.id === otherMember(c, me))?.name ?? 'Direct message'
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === c.projectId)
  return p ? `${p.code} · ${p.name}` : c.name
}

export const findProjectChannel = (s: Pick<AppState, 'channels'>, projectId: ID) => s.channels.find((c) => c.kind === 'project' && c.projectId === projectId)
export const findDirect = (s: Pick<AppState, 'channels'>, a: ID, b: ID) =>
  s.channels.find((c) => c.kind === 'direct' && c.memberIds.length === 2 && c.memberIds.includes(a) && c.memberIds.includes(b))

/** Project team channel; created with the project team when missing, and `me` joins it on open. */
export function ensureProjectChannel(d: AppState, projectId: ID, me: ID): Channel | undefined {
  const p = d.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)
  if (!p) return
  let c = findProjectChannel(d, projectId)
  if (!c) {
    const members = Array.from(new Set([...(Object.values(p.team).filter(Boolean) as string[]), me]))
    c = { id: uid('ch'), kind: 'project', projectId, memberIds: members, name: `${p.code} team` }
    d.channels.push(c)
  } else if (!c.memberIds.includes(me)) c.memberIds.push(me)
  return c
}

export function ensureDirect(d: AppState, me: ID, other: ID): Channel {
  let c = findDirect(d, me, other)
  if (!c) {
    c = { id: uid('ch'), kind: 'direct', memberIds: [me, other], name: '' }
    d.channels.push(c)
  }
  return c
}

/** Post a message. Direct messages also raise a notification for the recipient. */
export function sendMessage(d: AppState, channelId: ID, fromId: ID, text: string): Message | undefined {
  const c = d.channels.find((x) => x.id === channelId)
  const body = text.trim()
  if (!c || !body) return
  if (!c.memberIds.includes(fromId)) c.memberIds.push(fromId)
  const m: Message = { id: uid('msg'), channelId, fromId, at: nowISO(), text: body, readBy: [fromId] }
  d.messages.push(m)
  const from = d.people.find((p) => p.id === fromId)?.name ?? 'Someone'
  if (c.kind === 'direct') {
    for (const to of c.memberIds.filter((x) => x !== fromId)) d.notifications.push({ id: uid('ntf'), at: m.at, toId: to, text: `${from}: ${body.length > 80 ? body.slice(0, 77) + '…' : body}`, link: dmHref(fromId), read: false, kind: 'message' })
  }
  return m
}

/** Mark every message in a channel read for `me`. Returns how many changed. */
export function markRead(d: AppState, channelId: ID, me: ID): number {
  let n = 0
  for (const m of d.messages) if (m.channelId === channelId && isUnread(m, me)) { m.readBy.push(me); n++ }
  // message notifications for that conversation are read too
  const c = d.channels.find((x) => x.id === channelId)
  if (c?.kind === 'direct') for (const nt of d.notifications) if (nt.toId === me && nt.kind === 'message' && nt.link === dmHref(otherMember(c, me))) nt.read = true
  return n
}

export const lastMessage = (s: Pick<AppState, 'messages'>, channelId: ID): Message | undefined => {
  let last: Message | undefined
  for (const m of s.messages) if (m.channelId === channelId && (!last || m.at > last.at)) last = m
  return last
}

===== FILE: src/views/messages/Messages.tsx =====
// Messages (#messages): project team channels and direct conversations, kept inside Crosswalk next to the records
// they are about. Unread tracking per person (readBy). Deep links: #messages-1042 (project team), #messages-dm-<person>.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, Channel, Message, Person } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, personName, useMe, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { go, projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { cx, fmtDate } from '@/core/util'
import { Avatar, Badge, Button, Empty, Field, Input, Modal, PageHeader, SegButtons, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { ProgramTag } from '@/views/shared/pickers'
import { channelTitle, channelsFor, dmHref, ensureDirect, ensureProjectChannel, findDirect, findProjectChannel, lastMessage, markRead, messagesHref, messagesIn, otherMember, parseMessagesView, sendMessage, unreadCount, unreadIn } from './lib'

const timeOf = (iso: string) => new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })
const dayOf = (iso: string) => iso.slice(0, 10)

function shortWhen(iso: string, asOf: string) {
  const d = dayOf(iso)
  return d === asOf ? timeOf(iso) : fmtDate(d).replace(/, \d{4}$/, '')
}

const hrefFor = (c: Channel, me: string) => (c.kind === 'project' ? messagesHref(c.projectId) : dmHref(otherMember(c, me)))

export default function Messages({ view = 'messages' }: { view?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const me = useMe()
  const target = parseMessagesView(view)
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [newOpen, setNewOpen] = useState(false)
  const mine = useMemo(() => channelsFor(s, me.id).map((c) => ({ c, last: lastMessage(s, c.id), unread: unreadIn(s, c.id, me.id) }))
    .sort((a, b) => (b.last?.at ?? '').localeCompare(a.last?.at ?? '')), [s.channels, s.messages, me.id]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  // Resolve the open conversation from the route.
  const projectChannel = target.kind === 'project' ? findProjectChannel(s, target.projectId) : undefined
  const directChannel = target.kind === 'direct' ? findDirect(s, me.id, target.personId) : undefined
  const selected: Channel | undefined = target.kind === 'project' ? projectChannel : target.kind === 'direct' ? directChannel : mine[0]?.c
  const dmPerson = target.kind === 'direct' ? s.people.find((p) => p.id === target.personId) : undefined
  const targetProject = target.kind === 'project' ? s.projects.find((p) => p.id === target.projectId) : undefined

  // Opening a project's team channel creates it (with the project team) or adds you to it.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (target.kind !== 'project' || !targetProject) return
    const c = findProjectChannel(s, target.projectId)
    if (c && c.memberIds.includes(me.id)) return
    mutate((d) => { ensureProjectChannel(d, target.projectId, me.id) }, c ? undefined : { entity: 'channel', entityId: target.projectId, projectId: target.projectId, action: 'create', summary: `Opened the ${targetProject.code} team channel` })
  }, [target.kind === 'project' ? target.projectId : '', me.id, !!targetProject]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  // Reading a conversation marks it read for you.
  const unreadHere = selected ? unreadIn(s, selected.id, me.id) : 0
  useEffect(() => { if (selected && unreadHere > 0 && selected.memberIds.includes(me.id)) mutate((d) => { markRead(d, selected.id, me.id) }) }, [selected?.id, unreadHere, me.id]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const list = mine.filter(({ c }) => !q || channelTitle(s, c, me.id).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))
  const projects = list.filter((x) => x.c.kind === 'project')
  const directs = list.filter((x) => x.c.kind === 'direct')
  const total = unreadCount(s, me.id)
  const showThread = target.kind !== 'none'
  const threadOpen = !!(selected || dmPerson)

  const row = ({ c, last, unread }: (typeof mine)[number]) => {
    const active = selected?.id === c.id
    const p = c.kind === 'project' ? s.projects.find((x) => x.id === c.projectId) : undefined
    const other = c.kind === 'direct' ? s.people.find((x) => x.id === otherMember(c, me.id)) : undefined
    return (
      <li key={c.id}>
        <a href={hrefFor(c, me.id)} className={cx('flex items-start gap-2.5 border-l-2 px-3 py-2', active ? 'border-marker bg-marker/10' : 'border-transparent hover:bg-sunken/60')}>
          {other ? <Avatar name={other.name} size={28} /> : <span className="mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-sm bg-sunken font-mono text-[10px] font-bold text-muted">#</span>}
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {p && <ProgramTag programId={p.programId} />}
              <span className={cx('min-w-0 truncate text-[13px]', unread ? 'font-bold' : 'font-semibold')}>{p ? p.code : other?.name ?? c.name}</span>
              {last && <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 text-[11px] text-faint">{shortWhen(last.at, s.settings.asOf)}</span>}
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className={cx('min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[12px]', unread ? 'text-ink' : 'text-muted')}>{last ? `${last.fromId === me.id ? 'You' : personName(s, last.fromId).split(' ')[0]}: ${last.text}` : p ? p.name : 'No messages yet'}</span>
              {unread > 0 && <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-marker px-1.5 text-[10.5px] font-bold tabular-nums text-markerink">{unread}</span>}
            </span>
          </span>
        </a>
      </li>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <PageHeader eyebrow="Work" title="Messages"
        subtitle={<>Project team channels and direct conversations, kept with the project record. {total > 0 ? <b className="text-ink">{total} unread.</b> : 'All caught up.'}</>}
        actions={<Button variant="primary" icon={<Icon name="plus" className="h-4 w-4" />} onClick={() => setNewOpen(true)}>New message</Button>} />

      <div className="grid min-h-[560px] grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-line bg-surface lg:grid-cols-[300px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <aside className={cx('min-w-0 flex-col border-line lg:flex lg:border-r', showThread ? 'hidden' : 'flex')}>
          <div className="border-b border-line p-2.5"><Input aria-label="Search conversations" placeholder="Search conversations" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} className="h-8" /></div>
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto lg:max-h-[640px]">
            <div className="eyebrow px-3 pb-1 pt-3">Project channels <span className="font-normal normal-case tracking-normal text-faint">{projects.length}</span></div>
            {projects.length ? <ul>{projects.map(row)}</ul> : <p className="px-3 pb-2 text-[12px] text-muted">Open a project and choose “Message the team”.</p>}
            <div className="eyebrow flex items-center px-3 pb-1 pt-3">Direct messages <span className="ml-1 font-normal normal-case tracking-normal text-faint">{directs.length}</span><button className="ml-auto text-[11.5px] font-semibold normal-case tracking-normal text-link" onClick={() => setNewOpen(true)}>+ New</button></div>
            {directs.length ? <ul>{directs.map(row)}</ul> : <p className="px-3 pb-2 text-[12px] text-muted">No direct conversations yet.</p>}
          </div>
          <p className="border-t border-line px-3 py-2 text-[11px] leading-snug text-faint">Messages are delivered in Crosswalk. Email copies to Outlook need the backend mail integration (Configuration → Workflow notifications).</p>
        </aside>

        <section className={cx('min-w-0 flex-col', showThread ? 'flex' : 'hidden lg:flex')}>
          {threadOpen ? <Thread key={selected?.id ?? dmPerson?.id} s={s} me={me} channel={selected} dmPerson={dmPerson} />
            : target.kind === 'project' && !targetProject ? <div className="p-6"><Empty title="Project not found">That project number does not exist.</Empty></div>
              : <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center p-6"><Empty title="No conversation selected" action={<Button onClick={() => setNewOpen(true)}>Start a conversation</Button>}>Pick a channel on the left, or message anyone in the organization.</Empty></div>}
        </section>
      </div>

      <NewMessage open={newOpen} onClose={() => setNewOpen(false)} s={s} me={me} />
    </div>
  )
}

function Thread({ s, me, channel, dmPerson }: { s: AppState; me: Person; channel?: Channel; dmPerson?: Person }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [showMembers, setShowMembers] = useState(false)
  const [addId, setAddId] = useState('')
  const bottom = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const msgs = channel ? messagesIn(s, channel.id).slice().sort((a, b) => a.at.localeCompare(b.at)) : []
  const project = channel?.kind === 'project' ? s.projects.find((p) => p.id === channel.projectId) : undefined
  const other = channel?.kind === 'direct' ? s.people.find((p) => p.id === otherMember(channel, me.id)) : dmPerson
  const members = channel ? channel.memberIds.map((id) => s.people.find((p) => p.id === id)).filter((p): p is Person => !!p) : other ? [me, other] : [me]
  useEffect(() => { bottom.current?.scrollIntoView?.({ block: 'end' }) }, [msgs.length, channel?.id])

  const send = () => {
    const body = text.trim()
    if (!body) return
    mutate((d) => {
      const c = channel ? d.channels.find((x) => x.id === channel.id)! : ensureDirect(d, me.id, other!.id)
      sendMessage(d, c.id, me.id, body)
    }, { entity: 'message', entityId: channel?.id ?? `dm-${other?.id}`, projectId: project?.id, action: 'send', summary: `Message to ${project ? `${project.code} team` : other?.name}: ${body.length > 60 ? body.slice(0, 57) + '…' : body}` })
    setText('')
  }
  const addMember = () => {
    if (!channel || !addId) return
    mutate((d) => { const c = d.channels.find((x) => x.id === channel.id); if (c && !c.memberIds.includes(addId)) c.memberIds.push(addId) },
      { entity: 'channel', entityId: channel.id, projectId: project?.id, action: 'add-member', summary: `Added ${personName(s, addId)} to ${channel.name || 'conversation'}` })
    toast(`${personName(s, addId)} added to the channel`)
    setAddId('')
  }

  // group consecutive messages from the same person within 10 minutes; date dividers between days
  const blocks: { day?: string; head: boolean; m: Message }[] = msgs.map((m, i) => {
    const prev = msgs[i - 1]
    const newDay = !prev || dayOf(prev.at) !== dayOf(m.at)
    const head = newDay || prev.fromId !== m.fromId || Date.parse(m.at) - Date.parse(prev.at) > 10 * 60e3
    return { day: newDay ? dayOf(m.at) : undefined, head, m }
  })

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-[560px] flex-1 flex-col">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b border-line px-4 py-2.5">
        <a href="#messages" className="rounded p-1 text-muted hover:bg-sunken lg:hidden" aria-label="Back to conversations"><Icon name="arrow" className="h-4 w-4 rotate-180" /></a>
        {other && !project && <Avatar name={other.name} size={28} />}
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <h2 className="truncate font-display text-[15px] font-semibold">{project ? <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><ProgramTag programId={project.programId} /><span className="font-mono">{project.code}</span><span className="truncate">{project.name}</span></span> : other?.name}</h2>
          <div className="truncate text-[11.5px] text-muted">{project ? `Project team · ${members.length} members` : other ? `${other.title}${other.company ? ` · ${other.company}` : ''} · ${other.email}` : ''}</div>
        </div>
        {project && <a href={projectHref(project.id)} className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-link">Open project →</a>}
        {channel && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setShowMembers(!showMembers)}>{showMembers ? 'Hide members' : `Members (${members.length})`}</Button>}
      </header>
      {showMembers && channel && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-b border-line bg-sunken/40 px-4 py-2.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">{members.map((p) => <span key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded border border-line bg-surface px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[12px]"><Avatar name={p.name} size={18} />{p.name}<span className="text-faint">{p.title}</span></span>)}</div>
          {channel.kind === 'project' && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <select aria-label="Add a member" className="inp h-8 w-auto max-w-full" value={addId} onChange={(e) => setAddId(e.target.value)}>
                <option value="">Add someone to this channel…</option>
                {s.people.filter((p) => !channel.memberIds.includes(p.id)).map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name} · {p.title}{p.company ? ` (${p.company})` : ''}</option>)}
              </select>
              <Button size="sm" disabled={!addId} onClick={addMember}>Add</Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3 lg:max-h-[540px]">
        {msgs.length === 0 && <div className="py-10"><Empty title={project ? `Start the ${project.code} team conversation` : `Message ${other?.name ?? ''}`}>{project ? 'Everyone on the project team sees what you post here.' : 'Only the two of you see this conversation.'}</Empty></div>}
        {blocks.map(({ day, head, m }) => (
          <div key={m.id}>
            {day && <div className="my-3 flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-faint"><span className="h-px flex-1 bg-line" />{day === s.settings.asOf ? 'Today' : fmtDate(day)}<span className="h-px flex-1 bg-line" /></div>}
            <div className={cx('group flex gap-2.5 rounded px-1 hover:bg-sunken/40', head ? 'mt-2 pt-1' : 'mt-0')}>
              <div className="w-8 shrink-0">{head && <Avatar name={personName(s, m.fromId)} size={30} />}</div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pb-0.5">
                {head && <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2"><b className="text-[13px]">{m.fromId === me.id ? 'You' : personName(s, m.fromId)}</b><span className="text-[11px] text-faint">{s.people.find((p) => p.id === m.fromId)?.title}</span><span className="text-[11px] text-faint">{timeOf(m.at)}</span></div>}
                <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-[13px] leading-relaxed">{m.text}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        {msgs.length > 0 && (() => {
          const last = msgs[msgs.length - 1]
          const seen = last.readBy.filter((x) => x !== last.fromId).map((x) => (x === me.id ? 'you' : personName(s, x).split(' ')[0]))
          return last.fromId === me.id ? <div className="mt-1 pl-11 text-[11px] text-faint">{seen.length ? `Seen by ${seen.join(', ')}` : 'Delivered'}</div> : null
        })()}
        <div ref={bottom} />
      </div>
      <form className="flex items-end gap-2 border-t border-line p-3" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); send() }}>
        <TextArea id="message-text" aria-label="Message" rows={2} className="min-h-[44px] flex-1 resize-none" placeholder={project ? `Message the ${project.code} team` : `Message ${other?.name ?? ''}`} value={text}
          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); send() } }} />
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={!text.trim()}>Send</Button>
      </form>
    </div>
  )
}

function NewMessage({ open, onClose, s, me }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; s: AppState; me: Person }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'direct' | 'project'>('direct')
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [projectId, setProjectId] = useState('')
  useEffect(() => { if (open) { setQ(''); setProjectId('') } }, [open])
  const people = s.people.filter((p) => p.id !== me.id && (!q || `${p.name} ${p.title} ${p.company ?? ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())))
  const pick = (href: string) => { onClose(); go(href) }
  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="New message"
      footer={mode === 'project' ? <><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={!projectId} onClick={() => pick(messagesHref(projectId))}>Open team channel</Button></> : <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <SegButtons<'direct' | 'project'> value={mode} onChange={setMode} options={[{ id: 'direct', label: 'Direct message' }, { id: 'project', label: 'Project team' }]} />
        {mode === 'direct' ? (
          <>
            <Input autoFocus aria-label="Find a person" placeholder="Find a person by name, title or company" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} />
            <ul className="max-h-[320px] overflow-y-auto rounded border border-line">
              {people.map((p) => {
                const existing = findDirect(s, me.id, p.id)
                return (
                  <li key={p.id} className="border-b border-line/60 last:border-0">
                    <button className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-left hover:bg-sunken/60" onClick={() => pick(dmHref(p.id))}>
                      <Avatar name={p.name} size={26} />
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><span className="block text-[13px] font-semibold">{p.name}</span><span className="block truncate text-[11.5px] text-muted">{p.title}{p.company ? ` · ${p.company}` : ''}</span></span>
                      {existing && <Badge>open</Badge>}
                    </button>
                  </li>
                )
              })}
              {!people.length && <li className="px-3 py-3 text-[13px] text-muted">No one matches.</li>}
            </ul>
          </>
        ) : (
          <Field label="Project" hint="Opens the project's team channel. You are added to it if you are not on the team."><Select value={projectId} onChange={(e) => setProjectId(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: '— Select a project —' }, ...s.projects.filter((p) => p.status !== 'closed').map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: `${p.code} · ${p.name}${findProjectChannel(s, p.id) ? '' : ' (new channel)'}` }))]} /></Field>
        )}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/planning/model.ts =====
// Portfolio planning model (V2): benefit-cost ranking, fit-to-funding scenarios and capacity.
import type { AppState, Driver, ID, Project, Risk } from '@/core/types'
import { activeBudget, position } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { estimateTotals, spreadByYear } from '@/core/engine/estimates'
import { expectedCost, isActive, riskScore } from '@/core/engine/risk'
import { templateFor } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { sum } from '@/core/util'

export interface Weights { driver: Record<Driver, number>; hca: number; dac: number }
export const DEFAULT_WEIGHTS: Weights = {
  driver: { 'Safety / compliance': 1.5, Reliability: 1.2, Environmental: 1.1, Capacity: 1.0, 'Customer / new business': 0.9, Relocation: 0.8 },
  hca: 1.25,
  dac: 1.1,
}

export interface ScenarioItem { include: boolean; defer: number; mandatory?: boolean }
export interface Scenario {
  id: string
  name: string
  createdAt: string
  basis: 'budget' | 'eac'
  weights: Weights
  items: Record<ID, ScenarioItem>
  capacityLimit: number
}

export interface Candidate {
  project: Project
  stageName: string
  /** Committed = control budget in force; scope is authorized and spend is under contract. */
  committed: boolean
  proposed: boolean // no budget yet (estimate only)
  mandatoryDefault: boolean
  costBasis: 'control budget' | 'planning budget' | 'estimate'
  byYear: Record<string, number> // planned spend by year on the chosen basis
  remaining: number // forecast spend not yet incurred
  riskReduced: number // inherent − residual expected cost of active threats
  inherent: number
  residual: number
  constructionWindow?: { start: string; end: string }
}

/** Residual expected cost: scale the inherent expected cost by residual / inherent score. */
export function residualExpected(r: Risk): number {
  const inh = riskScore(r)
  const res = r.residual.likelihood * r.residual.consequence
  return expectedCost(r) * (inh ? res / inh : 1)
}

export function riskReducedFor(s: Pick<AppState, 'risks'>, pid: string): { inherent: number; residual: number; reduced: number } {
  const rs = s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === pid && isActive(r) && r.kind === 'threat')
  const inherent = sum(rs.map(expectedCost))
  const residual = sum(rs.map(residualExpected))
  return { inherent: Math.round(inherent), residual: Math.round(residual), reduced: Math.round(inherent - residual) }
}

const ms = (p: Project, ...names: string[]) => { for (const n of names) { const m = p.milestones.find((x) => x.name === n); if (m) return m.actual ?? m.forecast } return undefined }

export function candidates(s: AppState, basis: 'budget' | 'eac' = 'budget'): Candidate[] {
  const asOfYear = Number(s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4))
  const out: Candidate[] = []
  for (const p of s.projects) {
    if (p.status === 'closed' || p.status === 'cancelled') continue
    const tpl = templateFor(s, p)
    const b = activeBudget(s, p.id)
    const pos = position(s, p.id)
    let byYear: Record<string, number> = {}
    let costBasis: Candidate['costBasis'] = 'estimate'
    if (b) {
      byYear = { ...b.byYear }
      costBasis = b.kind === 'control' ? 'control budget' : 'planning budget'
      if (basis === 'eac' && pos.eac && b.total) {
        // spread the forecast overrun/underrun across the remaining years
        const delta = pos.eac - pos.currentBudget
        const fut = Object.keys(byYear).filter((y) => Number(y) >= asOfYear)
        const futTotal = sum(fut.map((y) => byYear[y]))
        if (fut.length && futTotal > 0) for (const y of fut) byYear[y] = Math.round(byYear[y] + (delta * byYear[y]) / futTotal)
      }
    } else {
      const est = s.estimates.filter((e) => e.projectId === p.id && e.status !== 'rejected' && e.status !== 'superseded').sort((a, c) => a.version - c.version).pop()
      const total = est ? estimateTotals(est).total : 0
      const start = ms(p, 'Business case approved', 'Plan approved') ?? s.settings.asOf
      const end = ms(p, 'In service', 'In service & closed') ?? start
      byYear = total ? spreadByYear(total, start, end) : {}
    }
    const r = riskReducedFor(s, p.id)
    const cs = ms(p, 'Construction start', 'Construction authorized')
    const ce = ms(p, 'In service', 'In service & closed')
    const spentYears = Object.keys(byYear).filter((y) => Number(y) < asOfYear)
    const remaining = Math.max(0, sum(Object.values(byYear)) - Math.max(pos.actualToDate, sum(spentYears.map((y) => byYear[y]))))
    out.push({
      project: p,
      stageName: tpl.stages[p.stageIndex]?.name ?? '—',
      committed: b?.kind === 'control',
      proposed: !b,
      mandatoryDefault: p.driver === 'Safety / compliance',
      costBasis,
      byYear,
      remaining,
      riskReduced: r.reduced,
      inherent: r.inherent,
      residual: r.residual,
      constructionWindow: cs && ce ? { start: cs, end: ce } : undefined,
    })
  }
  return out
}

export interface Ranked extends Candidate { perMillion: number; weight: number; score: number; mandatory: boolean; rank: number }

/** Benefit-cost: risk $ reduced per $M of remaining spend, times driver and consequence weights. Normalized so the best = 100. */
export function rank(cs: Candidate[], sc: Pick<Scenario, 'weights' | 'items'>): Ranked[] {
  const raw = cs.map((c) => {
    const denom = Math.max(c.remaining, 250_000) / 1e6
    const perMillion = c.riskReduced / denom
    const w = (sc.weights.driver[c.project.driver] ?? 1) * (c.project.location.hca ? sc.weights.hca : 1) * (c.project.location.dac ? sc.weights.dac : 1)
    const mandatory = sc.items[c.project.id]?.mandatory ?? c.mandatoryDefault
    return { ...c, perMillion, weight: w, score: perMillion * w, mandatory, rank: 0 }
  })
  const max = Math.max(...raw.map((r) => r.score), 1)
  raw.forEach((r) => { r.score = Math.round((r.score / max) * 1000) / 10 })
  raw.sort((a, b) => Number(b.mandatory) - Number(a.mandatory) || b.score - a.score)
  raw.forEach((r, i) => { r.rank = i + 1 })
  return raw
}

export const itemOf = (sc: Scenario, pid: string): ScenarioItem => sc.items[pid] ?? { include: true, defer: 0 }

/** Shift future-year spend (years after the as-of year) by `defer` years; current and past years are sunk. */
export function shifted(byYear: Record<string, number>, defer: number, asOfYear: number): Record<string, number> {
  if (!defer) return byYear
  const out: Record<string, number> = {}
  for (const [y, v] of Object.entries(byYear)) {
    const n = Number(y)
    const k = String(n > asOfYear ? n + defer : n)
    out[k] = (out[k] || 0) + v
  }
  return out
}

export interface Fit {
  years: number[]
  byProgram: Record<ID, Record<number, { authorized: number; planned: number }>>
  total: Record<number, { authorized: number; planned: number }>
  overYears: number // program-years over authorization
  overAmount: number
  riskFunded: number
  deferred: number
  excluded: number
}

export function fit(s: AppState, cs: Candidate[], sc: Scenario, years: number[]): Fit {
  const asOfYear = Number(s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4))
  const byProgram: Fit['byProgram'] = {}
  const total: Fit['total'] = {}
  for (const y of years) total[y] = { authorized: 0, planned: 0 }
  for (const pr of s.programs) {
    byProgram[pr.id] = {}
    for (const y of years) {
      const a = s.funding.find((f) => f.programId === pr.id && f.year === y)?.authorized ?? 0
      byProgram[pr.id][y] = { authorized: a, planned: 0 }
      total[y].authorized += a
    }
  }
  let riskFunded = 0, deferred = 0, excluded = 0
  for (const c of cs) {
    const it = itemOf(sc, c.project.id)
    if (!it.include) { excluded++; continue }
    if (it.defer) deferred++
    riskFunded += c.riskReduced
    const sh = shifted(c.byYear, it.defer, asOfYear)
    for (const [yk, v] of Object.entries(sh)) {
      const y = Number(yk)
      if (!byProgram[c.project.programId]?.[y]) continue
      byProgram[c.project.programId][y].planned += v
      total[y].planned += v
    }
  }
  let overYears = 0, overAmount = 0
  for (const pid of Object.keys(byProgram)) for (const y of years) {
    const c = byProgram[pid][y]
    if (y >= asOfYear && c.planned > c.authorized) { overYears++; overAmount += c.planned - c.authorized }
  }
  return { years, byProgram, total, overYears, overAmount: Math.round(overAmount), riskFunded, deferred, excluded }
}

/**
 * Suggest a fit: in each program-year over authorization (from next year on), defer the lowest-ranked
 * flexible project (not committed, not mandatory) by one more year, up to `maxDefer`. Deterministic and bounded.
 */
export function suggestFit(s: AppState, cs: Candidate[], sc: Scenario, years: number[], maxDefer = 3): { scenario: Scenario; moves: string[] } {
  const asOfYear = Number(s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4))
  const next: Scenario = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sc))
  const moves: string[] = []
  const ranked = rank(cs, next)
  const stuck = new Set<string>()
  const rejected = new Set<string>()
  for (let guard = 0; guard < 300; guard++) {
    const f = fit(s, cs, next, years)
    let target: { pid: string; y: number } | null = null
    outer: for (const y of years.filter((x) => x > asOfYear)) for (const pr of s.programs) {
      const c = f.byProgram[pr.id][y]
      if (c.planned > c.authorized * 1.0001 && !stuck.has(pr.id + '|' + y)) { target = { pid: pr.id, y }; break outer }
    }
    if (!target) break
    const tg = target
    const pick = [...ranked].reverse().find((r) => {
      const it = itemOf(next, r.project.id)
      if (rejected.has(r.project.id + '|' + tg.y) || r.project.programId !== tg.pid || r.committed || r.mandatory || !it.include || it.defer >= maxDefer) return false
      return (shifted(r.byYear, it.defer, asOfYear)[String(tg.y)] ?? 0) > 0
    })
    if (!pick) { stuck.add(tg.pid + '|' + tg.y); continue }
    const it = itemOf(next, pick.project.id)
    next.items[pick.project.id] = { ...it, defer: it.defer + 1 }
    // keep a deferral only if it lowers total over-authorization (otherwise it just moves the problem)
    if (fit(s, cs, next, years).overAmount >= f.overAmount) { next.items[pick.project.id] = it; rejected.add(pick.project.id + '|' + tg.y); continue }
    moves.push(`${pick.project.code} deferred +${it.defer + 1} yr (score ${pick.score}) to relieve ${s.programs.find((p) => p.id === tg.pid)?.code} ${tg.y}`)
  }
  return { scenario: next, moves }
}

/** Projects in construction per district per year under the scenario (deferral shifts the window). */
export function capacity(cs: Candidate[], sc: Scenario, years: number[], asOfYear: number): { districts: string[]; grid: Record<string, Record<number, string[]>> } {
  const grid: Record<string, Record<number, string[]>> = {}
  for (const c of cs) {
    const it = itemOf(sc, c.project.id)
    if (!it.include || !c.constructionWindow) continue
    const d = c.project.location.district
    grid[d] ||= Object.fromEntries(years.map((y) => [y, []]))
    let y0 = Number(c.constructionWindow.start.slice(0, 4)), y1 = Number(c.constructionWindow.end.slice(0, 4))
    if (it.defer && y0 > asOfYear) { y0 += it.defer; y1 += it.defer } else if (it.defer && y1 > asOfYear) y1 += it.defer
    for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) if (grid[d][y]) grid[d][y].push(c.project.code)
  }
  return { districts: Object.keys(grid).sort(), grid }
}

export function newScenario(name: string, at: string, from?: Scenario): Scenario {
  return { id: 'scn_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9), name, createdAt: at, basis: from?.basis ?? 'budget', weights: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(from?.weights ?? DEFAULT_WEIGHTS)), items: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(from?.items ?? {})), capacityLimit: from?.capacityLimit ?? 3 }
}

// Portfolio planning (V2): rank projects by risk reduced per dollar, fit them into authorized
// funding with deferral/exclusion scenarios, and check construction capacity by district.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { Driver } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { saveFile, toCSV } from '@/core/download'
import { cx, fmtDate, money, moneyDelta, sum } from '@/core/util'
import { BarChart } from '@/ui/charts'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, ConfirmButton, Field, Input, Panel, PageHeader, SegButtons, Select, Stat, Tabs } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'
import { lsGet, lsSet } from '../admin/common'
import { DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, capacity, candidates, fit, itemOf, newScenario, rank, shifted, suggestFit, type Ranked, type Scenario } from './model'

const LS = 'crosswalk:planning:scenarios:v1'
const YEARS_AHEAD = 5

export default function Planning(_props: { projectId?: string; id?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const asOfYear = Number(s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4))
  const years = useMemo(() => Array.from({ length: YEARS_AHEAD }, (_, i) => asOfYear + i), [asOfYear])

  const [scenarios, setScenarios] = useState<Scenario[]>(() => lsGet<Scenario[]>(LS, []))
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string>(() => lsGet<Scenario[]>(LS, [])[0]?.id ?? '')
  const [compareId, setCompareId] = useState<string>('')
  const [program, setProgram] = useState('')
  const [view, setView] = useState<'rank' | 'fund' | 'capacity' | 'compare'>('rank')

  // First visit: seed "as budgeted" and a suggested fit so compare works immediately.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (scenarios.length) return
    const base = newScenario('Current plan (as budgeted)', s.settings.asOf)
    const cs = candidates(s, base.basis)
    const sug = suggestFit(s, cs, { ...newScenario('Fit to authorization', s.settings.asOf, base) }, years)
    const fitSc = { ...sug.scenario, name: 'Fit to authorization (suggested)' }
    setScenarios([base, fitSc]); setActiveId(base.id); setCompareId(fitSc.id)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [])
  useEffect(() => { if (scenarios.length) lsSet(LS, scenarios) }, [scenarios])

  const sc = scenarios.find((x) => x.id === activeId) ?? scenarios[0]
  const cs = useMemo(() => (sc ? candidates(s, sc.basis) : []), [s, sc?.basis])
  const ranked = useMemo(() => (sc ? rank(cs, sc) : []), [cs, sc])
  const f = useMemo(() => (sc ? fit(s, cs, sc, years) : null), [s, cs, sc, years])
  if (!sc || !f) return <PageHeader title="Portfolio planning" subtitle="Preparing scenarios…" />

  const update = (fn: (x: Scenario) => Scenario) => setScenarios((all) => all.map((x) => (x.id === sc.id ? fn(x) : x)))
  const setItem = (pid: string, patch: Partial<{ include: boolean; defer: number; mandatory: boolean }>) => update((x) => ({ ...x, items: { ...x.items, [pid]: { ...itemOf(x, pid), ...patch } } }))
  const audit = (action: string, summary: string) => mutate(() => {}, { entity: 'planning-scenario', entityId: sc.id, action, summary })

  const saveAs = () => {
    const n = newScenario(`${sc.name.replace(/ \(copy.*\)$/, '')} (copy ${scenarios.length + 1})`, s.settings.asOf, sc)
    setScenarios([...scenarios, n]); setCompareId(sc.id); setActiveId(n.id)
    audit('create', `Saved planning scenario "${n.name}" from "${sc.name}"`)
    toast('Scenario saved as a copy')
  }
  const remove = () => {
    const rest = scenarios.filter((x) => x.id !== sc.id)
    const fallback = rest.length ? rest : [newScenario('Current plan (as budgeted)', s.settings.asOf)]
    setScenarios(fallback); setActiveId(fallback[0].id); if (compareId === sc.id) setCompareId('')
    audit('delete', `Deleted planning scenario "${sc.name}"`)
    toast('Scenario deleted')
  }
  const suggest = () => {
    const r = suggestFit(s, cs, sc, years)
    update(() => ({ ...r.scenario, id: sc.id, name: sc.name }))
    audit('update', `Suggested fit on "${sc.name}": ${r.moves.length} deferral${r.moves.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}${r.moves.length ? ' — ' + r.moves.slice(0, 4).join('; ') : ''}`)
    toast(r.moves.length ? `${r.moves.length} deferral${r.moves.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} suggested` : 'Already within authorization where flexible projects allow', r.moves.length ? 'good' : 'info')
  }
  const clearAll = () => { update((x) => ({ ...x, items: {} })); toast('Scenario reset to the budgeted plan', 'info') }
  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const rows = ranked.map((r) => {
      const it = itemOf(sc, r.project.id)
      const sh = shifted(r.byYear, it.include ? it.defer : 0, asOfYear)
      return {
        scenario: sc.name, rank: r.rank, project: r.project.code, name: r.project.name, program: s.programs.find((p) => p.id === r.project.programId)?.code, stage: r.stageName,
        driver: r.project.driver, mandatory: r.mandatory ? 'Y' : 'N', committed: r.committed ? 'Y' : 'N', cost_basis: r.costBasis, remaining_spend: Math.round(r.remaining),
        inherent_risk: r.inherent, residual_risk: r.residual, risk_reduced: r.riskReduced, risk_per_$M: Math.round(r.perMillion), weight: r.weight.toFixed(2), score: r.score,
        included: it.include ? 'Y' : 'N', defer_years: it.defer,
        ...Object.fromEntries(years.map((y) => [`plan_${y}`, it.include ? Math.round(sh[String(y)] ?? 0) : 0])),
      }
    })
    const r = await saveFile(`planning-${sc.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')}-${s.settings.asOf}.csv`, toCSV(rows), 'text/csv')
    if (r === 'saved') { audit('export', `Exported planning scenario "${sc.name}" (${rows.length} projects)`); toast('Scenario CSV saved') } else toast('Download not available here', 'info')
  }

  const progIds = program ? [program] : s.programs.map((p) => p.id)
  const series = years.map((y) => ({ y, a: sum(progIds.map((pid) => f.byProgram[pid]?.[y]?.authorized ?? 0)), p: sum(progIds.map((pid) => f.byProgram[pid]?.[y]?.planned ?? 0)) }))
  const nextYr = series[1] ?? series[0]
  const mandatoryUnfunded = ranked.filter((r) => r.mandatory && !itemOf(sc, r.project.id).include)

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <PageHeader eyebrow="Controls · V2" title="Portfolio planning"
        subtitle="Rank active and proposed projects by risk reduced per dollar, then fit the portfolio into authorized funding by program and year. Scenarios are working drafts: they do not change any project, budget or baseline."
        actions={<><Button onClick={exportCsv}>Export scenario CSV</Button><Button variant="marker" onClick={suggest}>Suggest fit to funding</Button></>} />

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2.5">
        <Field label="Scenario" className="w-64"><Select value={sc.id} onChange={(e) => setActiveId(e.target.value)} options={scenarios.map((x) => ({ value: x.id, label: x.name }))} /></Field>
        <Field label="Name" className="min-w-[200px] flex-1"><Input value={sc.name} onChange={(e) => update((x) => ({ ...x, name: e.target.value }))} /></Field>
        <Field label="Cost basis"><SegButtons options={[{ id: 'budget', label: 'Budget' }, { id: 'eac', label: 'Forecast (EAC)' }]} value={sc.basis} onChange={(b) => update((x) => ({ ...x, basis: b }))} /></Field>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pb-0.5">
          <Button size="sm" onClick={saveAs}>Save as copy</Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={clearAll}>Reset choices</Button>
          <ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Delete scenario" onConfirm={remove}>Delete</ConfirmButton>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <Stat label="Projects in plan" value={`${ranked.length - f.excluded}/${ranked.length}`} sub={`${f.deferred} deferred · ${f.excluded} excluded · ${ranked.filter((r) => r.proposed).length} proposed`} />
        <Stat label={`${nextYr.y} planned vs authorized`} value={moneyDelta(nextYr.p - nextYr.a)} tone={nextYr.p > nextYr.a ? 'bad' : 'good'} sub={`${money(nextYr.p)} planned · ${money(nextYr.a)} authorized${program ? '' : ' (all programs)'}`} />
        <Stat label={`Over authorization ${asOfYear}–${years[years.length - 1]}`} value={money(f.overAmount)} tone={f.overAmount > 0 ? 'bad' : 'good'} sub={`${f.overYears} program-year${f.overYears === 1 ? '' : 's'} over`} />
        <Stat label="Risk reduced (funded)" value={money(f.riskFunded)} sub={`of ${money(sum(ranked.map((r) => r.riskReduced)))} available · expected-cost basis`} />
      </div>

      {mandatoryUnfunded.length > 0 && <Callout tone="bad" title="Mandatory work excluded">{mandatoryUnfunded.map((r) => r.project.code).join(', ')} {mandatoryUnfunded.length === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} flagged safety/compliance mandatory but excluded from this scenario. Excluding mandatory work needs a regulatory deferral basis.</Callout>}

      <Tabs value={view} onChange={setView} tabs={[{ id: 'rank', label: 'Ranking & choices', count: ranked.length }, { id: 'fund', label: 'Fit to funding' }, { id: 'capacity', label: 'Construction capacity' }, { id: 'compare', label: 'Compare scenarios', count: scenarios.length }]} />

      {view === 'rank' && <RankTable ranked={ranked} sc={sc} setItem={setItem} years={years} asOfYear={asOfYear} weights={<Weights sc={sc} update={update} />} />}
      {view === 'fund' && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <Panel title="Authorized vs planned by year" subtitle={`${program ? s.programs.find((p) => p.id === program)?.name : 'All programs'} · ${sc.basis === 'eac' ? 'forecast' : 'budget'} basis with this scenario's deferrals and exclusions`}
            actions={<Select className="h-7 w-56 py-0.5" value={program} onChange={(e) => setProgram(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All programs' }, ...s.programs.map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: `${p.code} · ${p.name}` }))]} />}>
            <BarChart labels={series.map((x) => String(x.y))} series={[{ name: 'Authorized', values: series.map((x) => x.a), color: 'rgb(var(--muted))' }, { name: 'Planned (scenario)', values: series.map((x) => x.p), color: 'rgb(var(--link))' }]} height={240} />
          </Panel>
          <FundingTable f={f} years={years} asOfYear={asOfYear} onPick={setProgram} selected={program} />
        </div>
      )}
      {view === 'capacity' && <Capacity cs={cs} sc={sc} years={years} asOfYear={asOfYear} update={update} />}
      {view === 'compare' && <Compare scenarios={scenarios} a={sc} bId={compareId} setB={setCompareId} years={years} />}
    </div>
  )
}

function RankTable({ ranked, sc, setItem, years, asOfYear, weights }: { ranked: Ranked[]; sc: Scenario; setItem: (pid: string, p: Partial<{ include: boolean; defer: number; mandatory: boolean }>) => void; years: number[]; asOfYear: number; weights: React.ReactNode }) {

  return (

      <Panel title="Benefit-cost ranking" subtitle="Score = risk $ reduced (inherent − residual expected cost of active threats) per $M of remaining spend × driver and consequence weights; best = 100. Mandatory work ranks first." pad={false}
        actions={<SegButtons options={[{ id: 'all', label: 'All' }, { id: 'flex', label: 'Flexible' }, { id: 'mandatory', label: 'Mandatory' }, { id: 'proposed', label: 'Proposed' }]} value={filter} onChange={setFilter} />}>
        <div className="scroll-x" style={{ maxHeight: 640, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th className="num">#</th><th>Project</th><th>Stage</th><th className="num">Remaining</th><th className="num">Risk reduced</th><th className="num">Per $M</th><th style={{ width: 130 }}>Score</th><th>Mandatory</th><th>Include</th><th>Defer</th>{years.slice(1, 4).map((y) => <th key={y} className="num">{y}</th>)}</tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {rows.map((r) => {
                const it = itemOf(sc, r.project.id)
                const sh = shifted(r.byYear, it.defer, asOfYear)
                return (

                    </td>

                    <td><div className="flex items-center gap-2"><span className="h-2 flex-1 rounded-sm bg-sunken"><span className={cx('block h-2 rounded-sm', r.mandatory ? 'bg-ink' : 'bg-link')} style={{ width: `${r.score}%` }} /></span><span className="w-9 text-right text-[12px] tabular-nums">{r.score.toFixed(0)}</span></div></td>
                    <td><input type="checkbox" aria-label="Mandatory" className="h-4 w-4" checked={r.mandatory} onChange={(e) => setItem(r.project.id, { mandatory: e.target.checked })} /></td>

                  </tr>
                )
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

      {weights}
