}

function Weights({ sc, update }: { sc: Scenario; update: (fn: (x: Scenario) => Scenario) => void }) {
  const drivers = Object.keys(DEFAULT_WEIGHTS.driver) as Driver[]
  const set = (patch: Partial<Scenario['weights']>) => update((x) => ({ ...x, weights: { ...x.weights, ...patch } }))
  return (
    <Panel title="Scoring weights" subtitle="Multipliers on risk reduced per $M">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {drivers.map((d) => (
          <label key={d} className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_72px] items-center gap-2 text-[12px]"><span>{d}</span><Input className="h-7 py-0.5 text-right tabular-nums" type="number" step="0.1" min={0} value={sc.weights.driver[d]} onChange={(e) => set({ driver: { ...sc.weights.driver, [d]: Number(e.target.value) } })} /></label>
        ))}
        <div className="my-1 border-t border-line" />
        <label className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_72px] items-center gap-2 text-[12px]"><span>High-consequence area</span><Input className="h-7 py-0.5 text-right tabular-nums" type="number" step="0.05" value={sc.weights.hca} onChange={(e) => set({ hca: Number(e.target.value) })} /></label>
        <label className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_72px] items-center gap-2 text-[12px]"><span>Disadvantaged community</span><Input className="h-7 py-0.5 text-right tabular-nums" type="number" step="0.05" value={sc.weights.dac} onChange={(e) => set({ dac: Number(e.target.value) })} /></label>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => set(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_WEIGHTS)))}>Restore defaults</Button>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-faint">Safety/compliance work is marked mandatory by default. Uncheck mandatory on a project to let the fit defer it.</p>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

function FundingTable({ f, years, asOfYear, onPick, selected }: { f: ReturnType<typeof fit>; years: number[]; asOfYear: number; onPick: (pid: string) => void; selected: string }) {
  const programs = useStore((s) => s.programs)
  return (
    <Panel title="Over / under authorization by program" subtitle="Planned minus authorized. Click a program to chart it." pad={false}>
      <div className="scroll-x">
        <table className="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th>Program</th>{years.map((y) => <th key={y} className="num">{y}</th>)}<th className="num">Net {years[0]}–{years[years.length - 1]}</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {programs.map((p) => {
              const net = sum(years.map((y) => f.byProgram[p.id][y].planned - f.byProgram[p.id][y].authorized))
              return (
                <tr key={p.id} className={cx('clickable', selected === p.id && 'bg-marker/10')} onClick={() => onPick(selected === p.id ? '' : p.id)}>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap"><ProgramTag programId={p.id} /> <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{p.name}</span></td>
                  {years.map((y) => {
                    const c = f.byProgram[p.id][y]
                    const d = c.planned - c.authorized
                    return <td key={y} className="num"><span className={cx('font-semibold', d > 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{moneyDelta(d)}</span><div className="text-[11px] text-faint">{money(c.planned)} / {money(c.authorized)}</div></td>
                  })}
                  <td className={cx('num font-semibold', net > 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{moneyDelta(net)}</td>
                </tr>
              )
            })}
            <tr>
              <td className="font-semibold">Portfolio</td>
              {years.map((y) => { const d = f.total[y].planned - f.total[y].authorized; return <td key={y} className="num"><b className={d > 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good'}>{moneyDelta(d)}</b><div className="text-[11px] text-faint">{money(f.total[y].planned)} / {money(f.total[y].authorized)}</div></td> })}
              <td className="num font-semibold">{moneyDelta(sum(years.map((y) => f.total[y].planned - f.total[y].authorized)))}</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-2 text-[12px] text-muted">Authorized envelopes come from Configuration → Programs & funding. {asOfYear} spend is largely committed; deferral moves only spend after {asOfYear}.</div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

function Capacity({ cs, sc, years, asOfYear, update }: { cs: ReturnType<typeof candidates>; sc: Scenario; years: number[]; asOfYear: number; update: (fn: (x: Scenario) => Scenario) => void }) {
  const cap = useMemo(() => capacity(cs, sc, years, asOfYear), [cs, sc, years, asOfYear])
  const over = cap.districts.flatMap((d) => years.filter((y) => cap.grid[d][y].length > sc.capacityLimit).map((y) => `${d} ${y}`))
  return (
    <Panel title="Projects in construction by district and year" subtitle="Construction window = construction start (or authorization) through in service, shifted by this scenario's deferrals"
      actions={<label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] text-muted">Crew capacity per district <Input className="h-7 w-16 py-0.5 text-right" type="number" min={1} value={sc.capacityLimit} onChange={(e) => update((x) => ({ ...x, capacityLimit: Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)) }))} /></label>}>
      {over.length > 0 && <div className="mb-3"><Callout tone="warn" title="Over crew capacity">{over.join(', ')}. Consider deferring a flexible project or adding a second contractor.</Callout></div>}
      <div className="scroll-x">
        <table className="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th>District</th>{years.map((y) => <th key={y} className="num">{y}</th>)}</tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {cap.districts.map((d) => (
              <tr key={d}>
                <td className="font-semibold">{d}</td>
                {years.map((y) => {
                  const list = cap.grid[d][y]
                  const n = list.length
                  const tone = n > sc.capacityLimit ? 'bg-bad/15 text-bad' : n === sc.capacityLimit ? 'bg-warn/15 text-warn' : n ? 'bg-good/10 text-ink' : 'text-faint'
                  return (
                    <td key={y} className="num align-top">
                      <span className={cx('inline-block min-w-[2rem] rounded px-1.5 text-center font-display text-[16px] font-bold', tone)}>{n}</span>
                      <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-x-1 text-[10.5px]">{list.map((c) => <a key={c} className="font-mono text-link hover:underline" href={projectHref(c)}>{c.slice(4)}</a>)}</div>
                    </td>
                  )
                })}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

function Compare({ scenarios, a, bId, setB, years }: { scenarios: Scenario[]; a: Scenario; bId: string; setB: (id: string) => void; years: number[] }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const b = scenarios.find((x) => x.id === bId && x.id !== a.id) ?? scenarios.find((x) => x.id !== a.id)
  const calc = (x: Scenario) => { const cs = candidates(s, x.basis); return { cs, f: fit(s, cs, x, years), r: rank(cs, x) } }
  const A = useMemo(() => calc(a), [s, a, years])
  const B = useMemo(() => (b ? calc(b) : null), [s, b, years])
  if (!b || !B) return <Panel title="Compare scenarios"><p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Save a copy of this scenario, change it, then compare the two here.</p></Panel>
  const diffs = A.r.map((r) => ({ r, ia: itemOf(a, r.project.id), ib: itemOf(b, r.project.id) })).filter((x) => x.ia.include !== x.ib.include || x.ia.defer !== x.ib.defer)
  const metric = (label: string, va: number, vb: number, fmt = money, lowerBetter = true) => {
    const d = vb - va
    return <tr><td>{label}</td><td className="num">{fmt(va)}</td><td className="num">{fmt(vb)}</td><td className={cx('num font-semibold', d === 0 ? 'text-faint' : (d < 0) === lowerBetter ? 'text-good' : 'text-bad')}>{d === 0 ? '—' : (d > 0 ? '+' : '') + fmt(d)}</td></tr>
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Panel title="Compare scenarios" subtitle="A is the scenario selected above" actions={<Select className="h-7 w-72 py-0.5" value={b.id} onChange={(e) => setB(e.target.value)} options={scenarios.filter((x) => x.id !== a.id).map((x) => ({ value: x.id, label: `B: ${x.name}` }))} />} pad={false}>
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Measure</th><th className="num">A · {a.name}</th><th className="num">B · {b.name}</th><th className="num">B − A</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {metric(`Over authorization ${years[0]}–${years[years.length - 1]}`, A.f.overAmount, B.f.overAmount)}
              {metric('Program-years over', A.f.overYears, B.f.overYears, (n) => String(n))}
              {metric('Risk reduced (funded)', A.f.riskFunded, B.f.riskFunded, money, false)}
              {metric('Projects deferred', A.f.deferred, B.f.deferred, (n) => String(n))}
              {metric('Projects excluded', A.f.excluded, B.f.excluded, (n) => String(n))}
              {years.map((y) => <tr key={y}><td className="text-muted">Planned {y} (authorized {money(A.f.total[y].authorized)})</td><td className="num">{money(A.f.total[y].planned)}</td><td className="num">{money(B.f.total[y].planned)}</td><td className="num">{moneyDelta(B.f.total[y].planned - A.f.total[y].planned)}</td></tr>)}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </Panel>
      <Panel title="Project choices that differ" subtitle={`${diffs.length} project${diffs.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`} pad={false}>
        {diffs.length === 0 ? <p className="p-4 text-[13px] text-muted">Both scenarios make the same include and deferral choices.</p> : (
          <div className="scroll-x">
            <table className="tbl">
              <thead><tr><th>Project</th><th className="num">Score</th><th>A</th><th>B</th><th className="num">Risk reduced</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{diffs.map(({ r, ia, ib }) => {
                const lbl = (i: { include: boolean; defer: number }) => (!i.include ? <Badge tone="bad">Excluded</Badge> : i.defer ? <Badge tone="warn">Defer +{i.defer} yr</Badge> : <Badge tone="good">As planned</Badge>)
                return <tr key={r.project.id}><td><a className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline" href={projectHref(r.project.id)}>{r.project.code}</a> <span className="text-[12px]">{r.project.name}</span></td><td className="num">{r.score.toFixed(0)}</td><td>{lbl(ia)}</td><td>{lbl(ib)}</td><td className="num">{money(r.riskReduced)}</td></tr>
              })}</tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </Panel>
      <p className="text-[12px] text-faint">Scenarios are saved in this browser. Created {fmtDate(a.createdAt)} (A) and {fmtDate(b.createdAt)} (B).</p>
    </div>
  )
}

// Portfolio-level derivations shared by builder A's views (portfolio, projects, gates, overview, lifecycle).
// Pure functions over AppState — every figure traces to records via the engine.
import type { AppState, Estimate, GateReview, Milestone, Project, RAG } from '@/core/types'
import { activeBudget, nextMilestone, position, type Position } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { readiness, templateFor } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { estimateTotals } from '@/core/engine/estimates'
import { addDays, daysBetween, sum } from '@/core/util'
import { personName } from '@/core/store'

/** Normalized phases so the 5-stage and 3-stage templates can be compared on one axis. */
export const PHASES = ['Initiation', 'Option selection', 'Design & procurement', 'Construction', 'Closeout'] as const
export const PHASE_CLS = ['bg-ink/15', 'bg-ink/30', 'bg-ink/55', 'bg-link', 'bg-good/70']
export const PHASE_FILL = ['rgb(var(--ink) / 0.15)', 'rgb(var(--ink) / 0.3)', 'rgb(var(--ink) / 0.55)', 'rgb(var(--link))', 'rgb(var(--good) / 0.7)']

export function phaseOf(s: AppState, p: Project): number {
  const t = templateFor(s, p)
  if (t.stages.length === 3) return [0, 2, 3][p.stageIndex] ?? 3
  return Math.min(p.stageIndex, 4)
}

/** Latest estimate version for a project (any status except rejected). */
export function latestEstimate(s: AppState, pid: string): Estimate | undefined {
  return s.estimates.filter((e) => e.projectId === pid && e.status !== 'rejected').sort((a, b) => a.version - b.version).pop()
}
export function latestApprovedEstimate(s: AppState, pid: string): Estimate | undefined {
  return s.estimates.filter((e) => e.projectId === pid && e.status === 'approved').sort((a, b) => a.version - b.version).pop()
}

/** Overall health roll-up: red if cost is red or two dimensions are red; amber if any red or two ambers. */
export function overallHealth(h: Project['health']): RAG {
  const v = Object.values(h)
  const reds = v.filter((x) => x === 'red').length
  const ambers = v.filter((x) => x === 'amber').length
  if (h.cost === 'red' || reds >= 2) return 'red'
  if (reds >= 1 || ambers >= 2) return 'amber'
  return 'green'
}

export interface ProjectRow {
  p: Project
  programCode: string
  stages: string[]
  stageName: string
  phase: number
  pos: Position
  budget: number
  budgetBasis: 'control' | 'planning' | 'estimate' | 'none'
  eac: number
  variance: number // eac - budget (positive = overrun)
  variancePct: number
  next?: Milestone
  nextSlip: number
  readiness: number
  blockers: string[]
  pmName: string
  overall: RAG
  nextReview?: GateReview
}

export function projectRow(s: AppState, p: Project): ProjectRow {
  const t = templateFor(s, p)
  const pos = position(s, p.id)
  let budget = pos.currentBudget
  let eac = pos.eac
  let basis: ProjectRow['budgetBasis'] = pos.budgetKind ?? 'none'
  if (!budget) {
    const e = latestEstimate(s, p.id)
    if (e) { budget = estimateTotals(e).total; eac = budget; basis = 'estimate' }
  }
  const next = nextMilestone(p)
  const r = p.status === 'active' ? readiness(s, p) : { pct: 100, blockers: [] as string[] }
  const variance = basis === 'estimate' || basis === 'none' ? 0 : eac - budget
  return {
    p,
    programCode: s.programs.find((x) => x.id === p.programId)?.code ?? '—',
    stages: t.stages.map((x) => x.name),
    stageName: t.stages[p.stageIndex]?.name ?? '—',
    phase: phaseOf(s, p),
    pos,
    budget,
    budgetBasis: basis,
    eac,
    variance,
    variancePct: budget ? variance / budget : 0,
    next,
    nextSlip: next ? daysBetween(next.baseline, next.forecast) : 0,
    readiness: r.pct,
    blockers: r.blockers,
    pmName: personName(s, p.team.pm),
    overall: overallHealth(p.health),
    nextReview: s.gateReviews.filter((g) => g.projectId === p.id && g.status === 'scheduled').sort((a, b) => a.scheduled.localeCompare(b.scheduled))[0],
  }
}

/** Find a deliverable definition by id across templates. */
export function defById(s: AppState, defId: string) {
  for (const t of s.templates) for (const st of t.stages) { const d = st.gate.deliverables.find((x) => x.id === defId); if (d) return d }
  return undefined
}

// ───────────────────────────── Funding position (authorized vs budget vs EAC vs actual)
export interface FundingFigures { authorized: number; budget: number; eac: number; actual: number }

/**
 * Year figures: authorized = funding envelopes for the year; budget = active budget's spread for the year;
 * forecast = actuals to date in the year + remaining year budget scaled by the project's EAC/budget ratio;
 * actual = ERP cost periods in the year.
 */
export function yearFigures(s: AppState, projects: Project[], programIds: string[], year: number): FundingFigures {
  const y = String(year)
  const authorized = sum(s.funding.filter((f) => f.year === year && programIds.includes(f.programId)).map((f) => f.authorized))
  let budget = 0, eac = 0, actual = 0
  for (const p of projects) {
    const b = activeBudget(s, p.id)
    const pos = position(s, p.id)
    const by = b?.byYear[y] ?? 0
    const act = sum(s.costPeriods.filter((c) => c.projectId === p.id && c.period.startsWith(y)).map((c) => c.actual))
    const ratio = pos.currentBudget ? pos.eac / pos.currentBudget : 1
    budget += by
    actual += act
    eac += p.status === 'closed' ? act : act + Math.max(0, by - act) * ratio
  }
  return { authorized, budget: Math.round(budget), eac: Math.round(eac), actual: Math.round(actual) }
}

export function allInFigures(s: AppState, projects: Project[], programIds: string[]): FundingFigures {
  const pos = projects.map((p) => position(s, p.id))
  return {
    authorized: sum(s.funding.filter((f) => programIds.includes(f.programId)).map((f) => f.authorized)),
    budget: sum(pos.map((x) => x.currentBudget)),
    eac: sum(pos.map((x) => x.eac)),
    actual: sum(pos.map((x) => x.actualToDate)),
  }
}

// ───────────────────────────── Needs attention
export interface AttentionItem { id: string; projectId: string; code: string; kind: string; label: string; detail: string; severity: 'bad' | 'warn'; href: string; date?: string }

export function needsAttention(s: AppState, projects: Project[]): AttentionItem[] {
  const out: AttentionItem[] = []
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const ids = new Set(projects.map((p) => p.id))
  const code = (pid: string) => s.projects.find((p) => p.id === pid)?.code ?? pid
  const num = (pid: string) => pid.replace(/\D/g, '')
  for (const p of projects) {
    if (p.status !== 'active') continue
    const reds = (Object.keys(p.health) as (keyof Project['health'])[]).filter((k) => p.health[k] === 'red')
    if (reds.length) out.push({ id: 'h-' + p.id, projectId: p.id, code: p.code, kind: 'Red health', label: p.name, detail: `Red on ${reds.join(', ')}`, severity: 'bad', href: `#p-${num(p.id)}` })
    const late = s.deliverables.filter((d) => d.projectId === p.id && d.stageIndex === p.stageIndex && d.due && d.due < asOf && !['accepted', 'waived', 'submitted'].includes(d.status))
    if (late.length) out.push({ id: 'dl-' + p.id, projectId: p.id, code: p.code, kind: 'Overdue deliverables', label: p.name, detail: `${late.length} gate deliverable${late.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} past due (oldest ${daysBetween(late.map((d) => d.due!).sort()[0], asOf)} days)`, severity: 'warn', href: `#p-${num(p.id)}-lifecycle`, date: late.map((d) => d.due!).sort()[0] })
  }
  for (const w of s.workflows) {
    if (w.status !== 'running' || !w.projectId || !ids.has(w.projectId)) continue
    for (const a of w.active) {
      if (!a.due) continue
      const days = daysBetween(asOf, a.due)
      if (days > 3) continue
      const def = s.workflowDefs.find((d) => d.id === w.defId)
      const step = def?.nodes.find((n) => n.id === a.nodeId)?.label ?? 'Step'
      out.push({ id: 'wf-' + w.id + a.nodeId, projectId: w.projectId, code: code(w.projectId), kind: days < 0 ? 'Overdue workflow step' : 'Workflow step due', label: w.title, detail: `${step} · ${a.assigneeIds.map((x) => personName(s, x)).join(', ')} · ${days < 0 ? `${-days} days overdue` : days === 0 ? 'due today' : `due in ${days} day${days > 1 ? 's' : ''}`}`, severity: days < 0 ? 'bad' : 'warn', href: '#inbox', date: a.due })
    }
  }
  for (const pm of s.permits) {
    if (!ids.has(pm.projectId) || pm.status !== 'issued' || !pm.expires) continue
    const days = daysBetween(asOf, pm.expires)
    if (days > 30) continue
    out.push({ id: 'pm-' + pm.id, projectId: pm.projectId, code: code(pm.projectId), kind: days < 0 ? 'Permit expired' : 'Permit expiring', label: `${pm.type} ${pm.number}`, detail: `${pm.agency} · ${days < 0 ? `expired ${-days} days ago` : `expires in ${days} days`}`, severity: days < 7 ? 'bad' : 'warn', href: `#p-${num(pm.projectId)}-permits`, date: pm.expires })
  }
  for (const sp of s.safetyPlans) {
    if (!ids.has(sp.projectId) || sp.status === 'superseded') continue
    const proj = s.projects.find((p) => p.id === sp.projectId)
    if (!proj || proj.status !== 'active') continue
    for (const t of sp.tickets) {
      const days = daysBetween(asOf, t.expires)
      if (days > 7) continue
      out.push({ id: 'tk-' + t.id, projectId: sp.projectId, code: code(sp.projectId), kind: t.type === '811 locate' ? (days < 0 ? '811 ticket expired' : '811 ticket expiring') : days < 0 ? 'Ticket expired' : 'Ticket expiring', label: `${t.type} ${t.number}`, detail: `${sp.workPackage} · ${days < 0 ? `expired ${-days} day${-days > 1 ? 's' : ''} ago — stop excavation until renewed` : days === 0 ? 'expires today' : `expires in ${days} day${days > 1 ? 's' : ''}`}`, severity: days <= 2 ? 'bad' : 'warn', href: `#p-${num(sp.projectId)}-safety`, date: t.expires })
    }
  }
  for (const a of s.actions) {
    if (!ids.has(a.projectId) || a.status !== 'open' || a.due >= asOf) continue
    out.push({ id: 'act-' + a.id, projectId: a.projectId, code: code(a.projectId), kind: 'Overdue gate condition', label: a.title, detail: `${personName(s, a.ownerId)} · due ${a.due}`, severity: 'warn', href: `#p-${num(a.projectId)}-lifecycle`, date: a.due })
  }
  for (const v of s.variances) {
    if (!ids.has(v.projectId) || v.status !== 'required') continue
    out.push({ id: 'var-' + v.id, projectId: v.projectId, code: code(v.projectId), kind: 'Variance explanation due', label: v.description, detail: 'Threshold breached; narrative and root cause required before period close', severity: 'warn', href: `#p-${num(v.projectId)}-baselines` })
  }
  const rank = (x: AttentionItem) => (x.severity === 'bad' ? 0 : 1)
  return out.sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b) || (a.date ?? '9').localeCompare(b.date ?? '9'))
}

// ───────────────────────────── Safety leading indicators
export function safetyIndicators(s: AppState, projects: Project[]) {
  const ids = new Set(projects.map((p) => p.id))
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const from7 = addDays(asOf, -7), from30 = addDays(asOf, -30)
  const tb7 = s.tailboards.filter((t) => ids.has(t.projectId) && t.date > from7 && t.date <= asOf)
  const tbPrior = s.tailboards.filter((t) => ids.has(t.projectId) && t.date > addDays(asOf, -14) && t.date <= from7)
  const sifOpen = s.safetyEvents.filter((e) => ids.has(e.projectId) && e.sifPotential && e.status === 'open')
  const nearMiss30 = s.safetyEvents.filter((e) => ids.has(e.projectId) && e.type === 'near-miss' && e.date > from30)
  const obs30 = s.safetyEvents.filter((e) => ids.has(e.projectId) && e.type === 'observation' && e.date > from30)
  const incidents30 = s.safetyEvents.filter((e) => ids.has(e.projectId) && e.type === 'incident' && e.date > from30)
  const plansInReview = s.safetyPlans.filter((x) => ids.has(x.projectId) && x.status === 'in-review')
  const byProject = projects
    .map((p) => ({ p, tb: tb7.filter((t) => t.projectId === p.id).length, attendees: sum(tb7.filter((t) => t.projectId === p.id).map((t) => t.attendees.length)), sif: sifOpen.filter((e) => e.projectId === p.id).length }))
    .filter((x) => x.tb || x.sif)
  return { tb7, tbPrior, sifOpen, nearMiss30, obs30, incidents30, plansInReview, byProject }
}

/** Days from one go decision to the next, per program and stage (SG-12). */
export function stageDurations(s: AppState) {
  const out: { programId: string; stageIndex: number; days: number; projectId: string }[] = []
  for (const p of s.projects) {
    const ds = s.gateDecisions.filter((g) => g.projectId === p.id && (g.outcome === 'go' || g.outcome === 'go-with-conditions')).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
    let prev = p.dates.initiated
    for (const g of ds) {
      out.push({ programId: p.programId, stageIndex: g.stageIndex, days: daysBetween(prev, g.date), projectId: p.id })
      prev = g.date
    }
  }
  return out
}

// Executive portfolio dashboard (home). Summary first: funding position, stage mix, health, variances,
// contingency, gates, safety leading indicators and a "needs attention" queue. Every row links to its project.

import { saveFile, toCSV } from '@/core/download'
import type { AppState, Project, RAG } from '@/core/types'
import { Badge, Button, HealthDot, PageHeader, Panel, SegButtons, Empty, Progress, Mono } from '@/ui/kit'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'

const DIMS: { key: keyof Project['health']; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'scope', label: 'Scope' }, { key: 'schedule', label: 'Sched' }, { key: 'cost', label: 'Cost' }, { key: 'risk', label: 'Risk' }, { key: 'safety', label: 'Safety' },
]

export default function Portfolio(_props: { projectId?: string; id?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [prog, setProg] = useState<string>('all')
  const year = Number(s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4))
  const programs = s.programs
  const programIds = prog === 'all' ? programs.map((p) => p.id) : [prog]
  const projects = useMemo(() => s.projects.filter((p) => programIds.includes(p.programId)), [s.projects, prog]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const rows = useMemo(() => projects.map((p) => projectRow(s, p)), [s, projects])
  const live = rows.filter((r) => r.p.status === 'active' || r.p.status === 'on-hold')
  const yr = useMemo(() => yearFigures(s, projects, programIds, year), [s, projects]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const all = useMemo(() => allInFigures(s, projects, programIds), [s, projects]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const attention = useMemo(() => needsAttention(s, projects), [s, projects])
  const safety = useMemo(() => safetyIndicators(s, projects), [s, projects])
  const reviews = s.gateReviews.filter((g) => g.status === 'scheduled' && projects.some((p) => p.id === g.projectId) && g.scheduled >= s.settings.asOf).sort((a, b) => a.scheduled.localeCompare(b.scheduled))
  const inConstruction = live.filter((r) => r.phase === 3 && r.p.status === 'active').length
  const overBudget = live.filter((r) => r.variance > 0 && r.budgetBasis === 'control')
  const exposure = sum(live.map((r) => r.pos.riskExposure))
  const contRemaining = sum(live.map((r) => r.pos.contingencyRemaining))

  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const res = await saveFile(`portfolio-${s.settings.asOf}.csv`, toCSV(rows.map((r) => ({
      Project: r.p.code, Name: r.p.name, Program: r.programCode, Stage: r.stageName, Status: r.p.status, PM: r.pmName,
      Budget: r.budget, BudgetBasis: r.budgetBasis, EAC: r.eac, Variance: r.variance, ActualToDate: r.pos.actualToDate, ContingencyRemaining: r.pos.contingencyRemaining, RiskExposure: r.pos.riskExposure,
      Scope: r.p.health.scope, Schedule: r.p.health.schedule, Cost: r.p.health.cost, Risk: r.p.health.risk, Safety: r.p.health.safety, GateReadinessPct: r.readiness,
    }))), 'text/csv')
    if (res === 'saved') toast('Portfolio exported to CSV')
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow={<>{s.settings.orgName} · Capital portfolio · as of {fmtDate(s.settings.asOf)}</>}
        title="Portfolio"
        subtitle="Authorized funding against budgets, forecasts and actuals, with stage-gate position, health and safety leading indicators. Every figure traces to an approved budget, forecast or ERP period."
        actions={<>
          <Button icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-4 w-4" />} onClick={exportCsv}>Export</Button>
          <a href="#projects"><Button variant="primary" icon={<Icon name="list" className="h-4 w-4" />}>Project register</Button></a>
        </>}
      >
        <div className="scroll-x -mx-1 px-1">
          <SegButtons value={prog} onChange={setProg} options={[{ id: 'all', label: 'All programs' }, ...programs.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, label: p.code }))]} />
        </div>
      </PageHeader>

      {/* ── Funding position */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.6fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Panel title="Funding position" subtitle={prog === 'all' ? 'All programs' : programs.find((p) => p.id === prog)?.name}>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
            <FundingBlock title={`${year} plan year`} f={yr} note={`Budget is the ${year} spread of approved budgets; forecast adds remaining-year spend at each project's EAC/budget ratio.`} />
            <FundingBlock title="All-in (life of projects)" f={all} note="Authorized is the sum of funding envelopes 2024–2031 across rate-case cycles; budget, EAC and actuals are project totals." />
          </div>
        </Panel>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <Tile label="Active projects" value={String(rows.filter((r) => r.p.status === 'active').length)} sub={`${inConstruction} in construction · ${rows.filter((r) => r.p.status === 'on-hold').length} on hold`} href="#projects" />
          <Tile label="Forecast over budget" value={String(overBudget.length)} sub={overBudget.length ? `${moneyDelta(sum(overBudget.map((r) => r.variance)))} combined` : 'None above control budget'} tone={overBudget.length ? 'bad' : 'good'} href="#projects" />
          <Tile label="Contingency remaining" value={money(contRemaining)} sub={`vs ${money(exposure)} open risk exposure`} tone={contRemaining < exposure ? 'warn' : undefined} href="#risk" />
          <Tile label="Gate reviews ≤ 60 days" value={String(reviews.filter((g) => daysBetween(s.settings.asOf, g.scheduled) <= 60).length)} sub={reviews[0] ? `Next ${fmtDate(reviews[0].scheduled)}` : 'None scheduled'} href="#gates" />
        </div>

        <Panel title="Projects by stage" subtitle="Count and current budget by lifecycle phase. VAP's three condensed stages map onto the same phases.">
          <StageFunnel s={s} rows={rows.filter((r) => r.p.status !== 'cancelled')} programIds={programIds} />

      {/* ── Health + attention */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.15fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">

        <Panel title={<span className="flex items-center gap-2">Needs attention <Badge tone={attention.length ? 'marker' : 'good'}>{attention.length}</Badge></span>} subtitle="Red health, overdue or due workflow steps, expiring permits and 811 tickets, unexplained variances" pad={false}>
          <AttentionList items={attention} />
        </Panel>
      </div>

      {/* ── Variances, gates, safety */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-3">

            <ul className="divide-y divide-line">

// ───────────────────────────── pieces

function Tile({ label, value, sub, tone, href }: { label: string; value: string; sub?: string; tone?: 'good' | 'warn' | 'bad'; href: string }) {
  const t = tone === 'good' ? 'text-good' : tone === 'warn' ? 'text-warn' : tone === 'bad' ? 'text-bad' : 'text-ink'
  return (
    <a href={href} className="min-w-0 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3 hover:border-ink/40">
      <div className="eyebrow truncate">{label}</div>
      <div className={cx('mt-1 font-display text-[26px] font-bold leading-none tabular-nums', t)}>{value}</div>
      {sub && <div className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-muted">{sub}</div>}
    </a>
  )
}

function FundingBlock({ title, f, note }: { title: string; f: FundingFigures; note: string }) {
  const max = Math.max(f.authorized, f.budget, f.eac, f.actual, 1)
  const items: { k: string; v: number; cls: string; strong?: boolean }[] = [
    { k: 'Authorized', v: f.authorized, cls: 'bg-ink/25' },
    { k: 'Budget', v: f.budget, cls: 'bg-ink/70' },
    { k: 'Forecast (EAC)', v: f.eac, cls: f.eac > f.budget ? 'bg-bad/80' : 'bg-link', strong: true },
    { k: 'Actual', v: f.actual, cls: 'bg-good/80' },
  ]
  const headroom = f.authorized - f.eac
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0">
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 className="eyebrow">{title}</h3>
        <span className={cx('text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums', headroom < 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{headroom < 0 ? `${money(-headroom)} over authorized` : `${money(headroom)} headroom`}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {items.map((it) => (
          <div key={it.k} className="grid grid-cols-[96px_1fr_64px] items-center gap-2 text-[12px]">
            <span className={cx('text-muted', it.strong && 'font-semibold text-ink')}>{it.k}</span>
            <span className="h-3.5 rounded-sm bg-sunken"><span className={cx('block h-3.5 rounded-sm', it.cls)} style={{ width: `${(it.v / max) * 100}%` }} /></span>
            <span className={cx('text-right font-semibold tabular-nums', it.strong && f.eac > f.budget && 'text-bad')}>{money(it.v)}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 border-t border-line pt-2 text-[11px]">
        <div><div className="text-faint">EAC vs budget</div><div className={cx('font-semibold tabular-nums', f.eac > f.budget ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{moneyDelta(f.eac - f.budget)}</div></div>
        <div><div className="text-faint">Spent of budget</div><div className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{f.budget ? pct(f.actual / f.budget) : '—'}</div></div>
        <div><div className="text-faint">Budget of authorized</div><div className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{f.authorized ? pct(f.budget / f.authorized) : '—'}</div></div>
      </div>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-snug text-faint">{note}</p>
    </div>
  )
}

function StageFunnel({ s, rows, programIds }: { s: AppState; rows: ProjectRow[]; programIds: string[] }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'count' | 'dollars'>('count')
  const progs = s.programs.filter((p) => programIds.includes(p.id))
  const val = (r: ProjectRow) => (mode === 'count' ? 1 : r.budget)
  const totals = progs.map((pr) => sum(rows.filter((r) => r.p.programId === pr.id).map(val)))
  const max = Math.max(...totals, 1)
  const phaseTotals = PHASES.map((_, i) => rows.filter((r) => r.phase === i))
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-muted">
          {PHASES.map((ph, i) => <span key={ph} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className={cx('inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm', PHASE_CLS[i])} />{ph}</span>)}
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm border border-dashed border-faint" />Closed</span>
        </div>
        <SegButtons value={mode} onChange={setMode} options={[{ id: 'count', label: 'Count' }, { id: 'dollars', label: 'Budget $' }]} />
      </div>
      {progs.map((pr, pi) => {
        const pr_rows = rows.filter((r) => r.p.programId === pr.id)
        const total = totals[pi]
        return (
          <div key={pr.id} className="grid grid-cols-[48px_1fr_64px] items-center gap-2">
            <ProgramTag programId={pr.id} />
            <div className="flex h-6 overflow-hidden rounded-sm bg-sunken" style={{ width: `${Math.max(8, (total / max) * 100)}%` }}>
              {PHASES.map((ph, i) => {
                const seg = pr_rows.filter((r) => r.phase === i && r.p.status !== 'closed')
                const v = sum(seg.map(val))
                if (!v) return null
                return <span key={ph} title={`${pr.code} · ${ph}: ${seg.length} project(s), ${money(sum(seg.map((r) => r.budget)))}\n${seg.map((r) => r.p.code).join(', ')}`} className={cx('flex items-center justify-center border-r border-surface text-[11px] font-bold', PHASE_CLS[i], i >= 2 ? 'text-white' : 'text-ink')} style={{ width: `${(v / total) * 100}%` }}>{mode === 'count' ? seg.length : ''}</span>
              })}
              {(() => { const seg = pr_rows.filter((r) => r.p.status === 'closed'); const v = sum(seg.map(val)); return v ? <span title={`Closed: ${seg.map((r) => r.p.code).join(', ')}`} className="flex items-center justify-center border border-dashed border-faint text-[11px] text-muted" style={{ width: `${(v / total) * 100}%` }}>{mode === 'count' ? seg.length : ''}</span> : null })()}
            </div>
            <span className="text-right text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums">{mode === 'count' ? pr_rows.length : money(total)}</span>
          </div>
        )
      })}
      <div className="scroll-x mt-1 border-t border-line pt-2">
        <table className="w-full text-[12px]">
          <tbody>
            <tr>{PHASES.map((ph, i) => <td key={ph} className="pr-2 align-top"><div className="text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-faint">{ph}</div><div className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold tabular-nums">{phaseTotals[i].filter((r) => r.p.status !== 'closed').length}</div><div className="tabular-nums text-muted">{money(sum(phaseTotals[i].filter((r) => r.p.status !== 'closed').map((r) => r.budget)))}</div></td>)}</tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function ContingencyByProgram({ s, rows, programIds }: { s: AppState; rows: ProjectRow[]; programIds: string[] }) {
  const data = s.programs.filter((p) => programIds.includes(p.id)).map((pr) => {
    const rs = rows.filter((r) => r.p.programId === pr.id && r.pos.contingencyOriginal > 0)
    const orig = sum(rs.map((r) => r.pos.contingencyOriginal))
    const used = sum(rs.map((r) => r.pos.contingencyUsed))
    const pending = sum(s.contingencyDraws.filter((d) => d.status === 'in-review' && rs.some((r) => r.p.id === d.projectId)).map((d) => d.amount))
    const exp = sum(rs.map((r) => r.pos.riskExposure))
    return { pr, orig, used, rem: orig - used, pending, exp, rs }
  })
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="scroll-x">
        <table className="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th>Program</th><th className="num">Original</th><th className="num">Used</th><th className="num">Pending</th><th className="num">Remaining</th><th style={{ minWidth: 140 }}>Remaining vs exposure</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {data.map((d) => {
              const remPct = d.orig ? d.rem / d.orig : 0
              const covered = d.exp <= 0 ? 1 : d.rem / d.exp
              return (
                <tr key={d.pr.id}>
                  <td><span className="flex items-center gap-2"><ProgramTag programId={d.pr.id} /><span className="hidden text-muted sm:inline">{d.rs.length} budgets</span></span></td>
                  <td className="num">{money(d.orig)}</td>
                  <td className="num">{money(d.used)}</td>
                  <td className="num">{d.pending ? <span className="text-info">{money(d.pending)}</span> : '—'}</td>
                  <td className={cx('num font-semibold', remPct < 0.25 && d.orig ? 'text-warn' : '')}>{money(d.rem)}</td>
                  <td>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Progress value={remPct * 100} tone={remPct < 0.25 ? 'warn' : 'ink'} className="max-w-[110px]" />
                      <span className={cx('text-[11px] tabular-nums', covered < 1 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-muted')} title={`Open risk exposure ${money(d.exp)}`}>{d.exp > 0 ? `${Math.round(covered * 100)}% cover` : '—'}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <p className="text-[11px] text-faint">Cover = contingency remaining ÷ expected value of open threats less opportunities. Below 100% means the register's expected cost exceeds what is left.</p>
    </div>
  )
}

function HealthLegend() {
  return <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-muted"><HealthDot rag="green" /> On track <HealthDot rag="amber" /> Watch <HealthDot rag="red" /> Act</span>
}

function HealthMap({ rows }: { rows: ProjectRow[] }) {
  const score = (r: ProjectRow) => sum(Object.values(r.p.health).map((h: RAG) => (h === 'red' ? 3 : h === 'amber' ? 1 : 0)))
  const sorted = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => score(b) - score(a) || b.budget - a.budget)
  return (
    <div className="scroll-x" style={{ maxHeight: 460, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
      <table className="tbl">
        <thead><tr><th>Project</th>{DIMS.map((d) => <th key={d.key} className="text-center">{d.label}</th>)}<th className="num">EAC</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          {sorted.map((r) => (
            <tr key={r.p.id} className="clickable" onClick={() => go(projectHref(r.p.id))}>
              <td className="min-w-[200px]">
                <a href={projectHref(r.p.id)} className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                  <ProgramTag programId={r.p.programId} />
                  <Mono className="font-semibold">{r.p.code}</Mono>
                  <span className="truncate text-muted" title={r.p.name}>{r.p.name.length > 34 ? r.p.name.slice(0, 33) + '…' : r.p.name}</span>
                  {r.p.status === 'on-hold' && <Badge tone="warn">Hold</Badge>}
                </a>
              </td>
              {DIMS.map((d) => <td key={d.key} className="text-center"><HealthCell rag={r.p.health[d.key]} label={`${r.p.code} ${d.label}`} /></td>)}
              <td className="num">{money(r.eac)}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  )
}

function HealthCell({ rag, label }: { rag: RAG; label: string }) {
  const c = rag === 'green' ? 'bg-good/70' : rag === 'amber' ? 'bg-warn' : 'bg-bad'
  return <span title={`${label}: ${rag}`} className={cx('mx-auto block h-4 w-7 rounded-sm', c, rag === 'green' && 'opacity-40')} />
}

function AttentionList({ items }: { items: ReturnType<typeof needsAttention> }) {
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<string>('all')
  const kinds = Array.from(new Set(items.map((i) => i.kind)))
  const shown = kind === 'all' ? items : items.filter((i) => i.kind === kind)
  if (!items.length) return <div className="p-4"><Empty title="Nothing needs attention">No red health, overdue steps or expiring permits in this view.</Empty></div>
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="scroll-x flex gap-1 border-b border-line px-3 py-2">
        <FilterChip on={kind === 'all'} onClick={() => setKind('all')}>All {items.length}</FilterChip>
        {kinds.map((k) => <FilterChip key={k} on={kind === k} onClick={() => setKind(k)}>{k} {items.filter((i) => i.kind === k).length}</FilterChip>)}
      </div>
      <ul className="divide-y divide-line overflow-y-auto" style={{ maxHeight: 412 }}>
        {shown.map((it) => (
          <li key={it.id}>
            <a href={it.href} className="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-2 hover:bg-sunken/60">
              <span className={cx('mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full', it.severity === 'bad' ? 'bg-bad' : 'bg-warn')} />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 text-[11px]"><span className={cx('font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide', it.severity === 'bad' ? 'text-bad' : 'text-warn')}>{it.kind}</span><Mono className="text-muted">{it.code}</Mono></div>
                <div className="truncate text-[13px] font-semibold">{it.label}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-muted">{it.detail}</div>
              </div>
              <Icon name="arrow" className="mt-2 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-faint" />
            </a>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}

function FilterChip({ on, onClick, children }: { on: boolean; onClick: () => void; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <button onClick={onClick} className={cx('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold', on ? 'border-ink bg-ink text-surface' : 'border-line text-muted hover:text-ink')}>{children}</button>
}

function TopVariances({ rows }: { rows: ProjectRow[] }) {
  const sorted = rows.filter((r) => r.budget > 0).sort((a, b) => b.variance - a.variance).slice(0, 8)
  const max = Math.max(...sorted.map((r) => Math.abs(r.variance)), 1)
  if (!sorted.length) return <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No budgets yet" /></div>
  return (
    <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
      {sorted.map((r) => {
        const over = r.variance > 0
        return (
          <li key={r.p.id}>
            <a href={projectHref(r.p.id, 'cost')} className="block px-4 py-2 hover:bg-sunken/60">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px]">
                <Mono className="font-semibold">{r.p.code}</Mono>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-muted">{r.p.name}</span>
                <span className={cx('font-semibold tabular-nums', over ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{moneyDelta(r.variance)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 grid grid-cols-[1fr_1fr] items-center gap-0">
                <div className="flex justify-end border-r border-line pr-px">{!over && <span className="h-2 rounded-l-sm bg-good/70" style={{ width: `${(Math.abs(r.variance) / max) * 100}%` }} />}</div>
                <div className="flex pl-px">{over && <span className="h-2 rounded-r-sm bg-bad/80" style={{ width: `${(r.variance / max) * 100}%` }} />}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-0.5 flex justify-between text-[11px] tabular-nums text-faint"><span>Budget {money(r.budget)} · EAC {money(r.eac)}</span><span>{r.variancePct ? `${r.variancePct > 0 ? '+' : ''}${(r.variancePct * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : ''}</span></div>
            </a>
          </li>
        )
      })}
    </ul>
  )
}

function SafetyBlock({ s, ind }: { s: AppState; ind: ReturnType<typeof safetyIndicators> }) {
  const delta = ind.tb7.length - ind.tbPrior.length

          <div className="text-[11px] text-muted">{attendees} sign-ins · {delta >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{delta} vs prior week</div>
        </a>
        <a href="#safety" className={cx('rounded-md border px-3 py-2 hover:border-ink/40', ind.sifOpen.length ? 'border-bad/50 bg-bad/5' : 'border-line')}>
          <div className="eyebrow">Open SIF-potential</div>

        </a>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-[12px]">
        <div><div className="text-faint">Observations 30d</div><div className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{ind.obs30.length}</div></div>
        <div><div className="text-faint">Near misses 30d</div><div className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{ind.nearMiss30.length}</div></div>
        <div><div className="text-faint">Plans in review</div><div className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{ind.plansInReview.length}</div></div>
      </div>
      {ind.sifOpen.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          {ind.sifOpen.map((e) => {
            const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === e.projectId)!
            return (
              <li key={e.id}><a href={projectHref(e.projectId, 'safety')} className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded border border-bad/30 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] hover:bg-bad/5">
                <Badge tone="bad">SIF</Badge>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><Mono className="font-semibold">{p.code}</Mono> <span className="text-muted">{fmtDate(e.date)} · {e.type}</span><span className="block">{e.description}</span></span>
              </a></li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
      <div>
        <div className="eyebrow mb-1">Tailboards by site · last 7 days</div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          {ind.byProject.filter((x) => x.tb).sort((a, b) => b.tb - a.tb).map((x) => (
            <a key={x.p.id} href={projectHref(x.p.id, 'safety')} className="grid grid-cols-[70px_1fr_28px] items-center gap-2 text-[12px] hover:text-link">
              <Mono className="font-semibold">{x.p.code}</Mono>
              <span className="flex gap-0.5">{Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => <span key={i} className={cx('h-2.5 flex-1 rounded-sm', i < x.tb ? 'bg-good/70' : 'bg-sunken')} />)}</span>
              <span className="text-right tabular-nums text-muted">{x.tb}/5</span>
            </a>
          ))}
          {!ind.byProject.some((x) => x.tb) && <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">No construction work in the field for this selection.</span>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/portfolio/reports.ts =====
// Generated documents for builder A's module: monthly status report (PI-04) and gate review packet (SG-05).
// Both compose only from records in the store so the printed figures tie to the screen.
import type { AppState, Project } from '@/core/types'
import { personName, categoryName } from '@/core/store'
import { position, nextMilestone } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { readiness, requiredDefs, templateFor, permissions } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { CLASS_RANGES, estimateTotals } from '@/core/engine/estimates'
import { isActive, riskScore, expectedCost } from '@/core/engine/risk'
import { daysBetween, fmtDate, fmtMonth, money, sum, addDays } from '@/core/util'
import { latestApprovedEstimate, latestEstimate, defById } from './lib'

const esc = (v: unknown) => String(v ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
const rag = (r: string) => `<span class="tag" style="border-color:${r === 'red' ? '#c02828' : r === 'amber' ? '#b86e00' : '#1b8048'};color:${r === 'red' ? '#c02828' : r === 'amber' ? '#b86e00' : '#1b8048'}">${r.toUpperCase()}</span>`
const table = (head: string[], rows: (string | number)[][], numCols: number[] = []) =>
  `<table><thead><tr>${head.map((h) => `<th>${esc(h)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.length ? rows.map((r) => `<tr>${r.map((c, i) => `<td${numCols.includes(i) ? ' class="num"' : ''}>${typeof c === 'string' && c.startsWith('<') ? c : esc(c)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('') : `<tr><td colspan="${head.length}" class="meta">None</td></tr>`}</tbody></table>`

/** Data the status report and its AI prompt share. */
export function statusFacts(s: AppState, p: Project) {
  const pos = position(s, p.id)
  const t = templateFor(s, p)
  const month = s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 7)
  const periods = s.costPeriods.filter((c) => c.projectId === p.id).sort((a, b) => a.period.localeCompare(b.period))
  const last = periods[periods.length - 1]
  const cumPV = sum(periods.map((c) => c.planned)), cumEV = sum(periods.map((c) => c.earned)), cumAC = sum(periods.map((c) => c.actual))
  const from = addDays(s.settings.asOf, -31)
  const changes = s.changes.filter((c) => c.projectId === p.id && (c.requestedAt >= from || (c.decidedAt ?? '') >= from))
  const risks = s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === p.id && isActive(r)).sort((a, b) => riskScore(b) - riskScore(a)).slice(0, 5)
  const r = readiness(s, p)
  const events = s.safetyEvents.filter((e) => e.projectId === p.id && e.date >= from)
  const tbs = s.tailboards.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id && x.date >= from)
  const variances = s.variances.filter((v) => v.projectId === p.id && v.status !== 'accepted')
  const review = s.gateReviews.filter((g) => g.projectId === p.id && g.status === 'scheduled').sort((a, b) => a.scheduled.localeCompare(b.scheduled))[0]
  return { pos, t, month, last, cpi: cumAC ? cumEV / cumAC : undefined, spi: cumPV ? cumEV / cumPV : undefined, changes, risks, r, events, tbs, variances, review, next: nextMilestone(p) }
}

export function statusPrompt(s: AppState, p: Project): string {
  const f = statusFacts(s, p)
  const lines = [
    `Project ${p.code} "${p.name}" (${s.programs.find((x) => x.id === p.programId)?.name}). Stage ${p.stageIndex + 1} of ${f.t.stages.length}: ${f.t.stages[p.stageIndex]?.name}. Status ${p.status}.`,
    `Scope: ${p.scope.summary}`,
    `Health: scope ${p.health.scope}, schedule ${p.health.schedule}, cost ${p.health.cost}, risk ${p.health.risk}, safety ${p.health.safety}.`,
    `Budget (${f.pos.budgetKind ?? 'none'}) ${money(f.pos.currentBudget)}; EAC ${money(f.pos.eac)}; actual to date ${money(f.pos.actualToDate)}; contingency remaining ${money(f.pos.contingencyRemaining)} of ${money(f.pos.contingencyOriginal)}; open risk exposure ${money(f.pos.riskExposure)}.`,
    f.cpi ? `CPI ${f.cpi.toFixed(2)}, SPI ${f.spi?.toFixed(2)}. Latest month ${f.last?.period}: actual ${money(f.last?.actual)}, earned ${money(f.last?.earned)}.` : 'No cost periods yet.',
    `Milestones: ${p.milestones.map((m) => `${m.name} baseline ${m.baseline}, forecast ${m.forecast}${m.actual ? `, actual ${m.actual}` : ''}`).join('; ')}.`,
    `Changes in last 30 days: ${f.changes.map((c) => `${c.code} ${c.title} ${money(c.costImpact)} ${c.status}`).join('; ') || 'none'}.`,
    `Top risks: ${f.risks.map((r) => `${r.code} ${r.title} (score ${riskScore(r)}, ${r.status})`).join('; ') || 'none'}.`,
    `Gate readiness ${f.r.pct}%; blockers: ${f.r.blockers.join('; ') || 'none'}. Next gate review ${f.review ? f.review.scheduled : 'not scheduled'}.`,
    `Safety last 30 days: ${f.tbs.length} tailboards, ${f.events.length} events (${f.events.filter((e) => e.sifPotential).length} SIF-potential).`,
    `Open variances: ${f.variances.map((v) => `${v.description} (${v.status})`).join('; ') || 'none'}.`,
    p.lastStatusNote ? `Last month's PM note: ${p.lastStatusNote}` : '',
  ]
  return `You are drafting the project manager's narrative for a gas utility capital project's monthly status report. Use ONLY the facts below; do not invent numbers, names or dates.

${lines.filter(Boolean).join('\n')}

Write 3 short paragraphs of plain text (no headings, no markdown, no bullet characters), 120–180 words total:
1) Progress this period and where the project stands against plan.
2) Cost and schedule position, naming the drivers of any variance and the changes or risks behind them.
3) Look-ahead: next milestone, gate readiness actions, and any decisions needed from the sponsor.
Write in first person plural ("we"), factual and specific, as a PM would for a director audience.`
}

export function statusReportHtml(s: AppState, p: Project, narrative: string): string {
  const f = statusFacts(s, p)
  const prog = s.programs.find((x) => x.id === p.programId)
  const body = `
  <div class="meta">${esc(s.settings.orgName)} · Monthly project status report · ${esc(fmtMonth(f.month))}</div>
  <h1>${esc(p.code)} · ${esc(p.name)}</h1>
  <div class="meta">${esc(prog?.code)} ${esc(prog?.name)} · Stage ${p.stageIndex + 1} of ${f.t.stages.length}: ${esc(f.t.stages[p.stageIndex]?.name)} · PM ${esc(personName(s, p.team.pm))} · Sponsor ${esc(personName(s, p.team.sponsor))} · Prepared ${esc(fmtDate(s.settings.asOf))}</div>
  <h2>Health</h2>
  <p>Scope ${rag(p.health.scope)} &nbsp; Schedule ${rag(p.health.schedule)} &nbsp; Cost ${rag(p.health.cost)} &nbsp; Risk ${rag(p.health.risk)} &nbsp; Safety ${rag(p.health.safety)}</p>
  <h2>Project manager narrative</h2>
  ${narrative.trim() ? narrative.trim().split(/\n\s*\n/).map((x) => `<p>${esc(x)}</p>`).join('') : '<p class="meta">No narrative entered.</p>'}
  <h2>Financial position</h2>
  ${table(['Measure', 'Amount'], [
    [`Current budget (${f.pos.budgetKind ?? 'none'})`, money(f.pos.currentBudget, 'full')], ['Original budget', money(f.pos.originalBudget, 'full')], ['Forecast at completion (EAC)', money(f.pos.eac, 'full')],
    ['Variance (budget − EAC)', money(f.pos.variance, 'full')], ['Actual to date', money(f.pos.actualToDate, 'full')], ['Open commitments', money(f.pos.commitments, 'full')],
    ['Contingency remaining', `${money(f.pos.contingencyRemaining, 'full')} of ${money(f.pos.contingencyOriginal, 'full')}`], ['Open risk exposure (expected value)', money(f.pos.riskExposure, 'full')],
    ...(f.cpi ? [['CPI / SPI (cumulative)', `${f.cpi.toFixed(2)} / ${f.spi?.toFixed(2)}`] as [string, string]] : []),
  ], [1])}
  <h2>Milestones</h2>
  ${table(['Milestone', 'Baseline', 'Forecast', 'Actual', 'Slip (days)'], p.milestones.map((m) => [m.name, m.baseline, m.forecast, m.actual ?? '', daysBetween(m.baseline, m.actual ?? m.forecast)]), [4])}
  <h2>Changes (last 30 days)</h2>
  ${table(['Change', 'Title', 'Root cause', 'Cost', 'Days', 'Status'], f.changes.map((c) => [c.code, c.title, c.rootCause, money(c.costImpact, 'full'), c.scheduleImpactDays, c.status]), [3, 4])}
  <h2>Top risks</h2>
  ${table(['Risk', 'Title', 'Score', 'Expected cost', 'Owner', 'Status'], f.risks.map((r) => [r.code, r.title, riskScore(r), money(Math.round(expectedCost(r)), 'full'), personName(s, r.ownerId), r.status]), [2, 3])}
  <h2>Gate readiness</h2>
  <p>${f.r.pct}% of required deliverables accepted for ${esc(f.t.stages[p.stageIndex]?.gate.name)}. ${f.review ? `Gate review scheduled ${esc(fmtDate(f.review.scheduled))}.` : 'No gate review scheduled.'}</p>
  ${f.r.blockers.length ? `<ul>${f.r.blockers.map((b) => `<li>${esc(b)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>` : ''}
  <h2>Safety (last 30 days)</h2>
  <p>${f.tbs.length} tailboards recorded; ${f.events.length} safety events (${f.events.filter((e) => e.type === 'near-miss').length} near misses, ${f.events.filter((e) => e.sifPotential).length} with SIF potential).</p>
  ${f.variances.length ? `<h2>Open variance explanations</h2>${table(['Variance', 'Status', 'Narrative'], f.variances.map((v) => [v.description, v.status, v.narrative || '—']))}` : ''}
  <p class="meta" style="margin-top:32px">Generated by Crosswalk from project records as of ${esc(fmtDate(s.settings.asOf))}. Figures tie to the approved budget, the latest locked forecast and ERP cost periods.</p>`
  return body
}

/** Gate review packet (SG-05): charter facts, estimate & class, milestones, top 10 risks, changes, deliverable evidence. */
export function gatePacketHtml(s: AppState, p: Project): string {
  const t = templateFor(s, p)
  const st = t.stages[p.stageIndex]
  const r = readiness(s, p)
  const pos = position(s, p.id)
  const est = latestApprovedEstimate(s, p.id)
  const draftEst = latestEstimate(s, p.id)
  const e = est ?? draftEst
  const tot = e ? estimateTotals(e) : undefined
  const defs = requiredDefs(s, p)
  const dls = s.deliverables.filter((d) => d.projectId === p.id && d.stageIndex === p.stageIndex)
  const risks = s.risks.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id && isActive(x)).sort((a, b) => riskScore(b) - riskScore(a)).slice(0, 10)
  const changes = s.changes.filter((c) => c.projectId === p.id)
  const prior = s.gateDecisions.filter((g) => g.projectId === p.id).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
  const prog = s.programs.find((x) => x.id === p.programId)
  const perms = Array.from(permissions(s, p))
  return `
  <div class="meta">${esc(s.settings.orgName)} · Gate review packet · prepared ${esc(fmtDate(s.settings.asOf))}</div>
  <h1>${esc(st?.gate.name)}</h1>
  <h3 style="margin-top:2px">${esc(p.code)} · ${esc(p.name)}</h3>
  <p><b>Readiness ${r.pct}%</b> (${r.done} of ${r.total} deliverables accepted or waived) · Estimate requirement: ${st?.gate.requiredEstimateClass ? `Class ${st.gate.requiredEstimateClass} or better — ${r.estimateOk ? 'met' : 'NOT met'}` : 'none'} · Decision roles: ${esc(st?.gate.decisionRoles.map((x) => s.roles.find((y) => y.id === x)?.name ?? x).join(', '))}</p>
  ${r.blockers.length ? `<p><b>Open blockers:</b></p><ul>${r.blockers.map((b) => `<li>${esc(b)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>` : '<p>No blockers: the project meets all gate criteria.</p>'}
  <h2>1. Charter facts</h2>
  ${table(['Item', 'Value'], [

    ['Permissions in force', perms.join(', ') || 'none'],
  ])}
  <h2>2. Estimate & class</h2>

  ${table(['Measure', 'Amount'], [['Point estimate', money(tot.total, 'full')], [`Expected range (${Math.round(CLASS_RANGES[e.cls].low * 100)}% / +${Math.round(CLASS_RANGES[e.cls].high * 100)}%)`, `${money(tot.low, 'full')} – ${money(tot.high, 'full')}`], ['Base (direct + loaders + escalation)', money(tot.base, 'full')], [`Contingency (${e.contingency.method}, ${e.contingency.pct}%)`, money(tot.contingency, 'full')], ['Current budget', money(pos.currentBudget, 'full')], ['Forecast (EAC)', money(pos.eac, 'full')]], [1])}
  ${table(['Cost category', 'Amount'], Object.entries(tot.byCategory).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([k, v]) => [categoryName(s, k), money(v, 'full')]), [1])}
  <p><b>Basis:</b> ${esc(e.basis.classJustification)} <b>Contingency:</b> ${esc(e.basis.contingencyRationale)}</p>
  ${!est ? '<p><b>Note:</b> no approved estimate; the latest draft is shown.</p>' : ''}` : '<p class="meta">No estimate on file.</p>'}

  <h2>5. Changes</h2>

  ${table(['Deliverable', 'Status', 'Version', 'Owner', 'Reviewer', 'Evidence', 'Acceptance criteria'], defs.map((def) => {
    const d = dls.find((x) => x.defId === def.id)
    return [def.name, d?.status ?? 'not-started', d?.version ?? 0, personName(s, d?.ownerId), personName(s, d?.reviewerId), d?.evidence.map((ev) => `${ev.name} (${ev.sizeKb} KB)`).join('; ') || '—', def.acceptance + (d?.waiverReason ? ` — WAIVED: ${d.waiverReason}` : '')]
  }), [2])}
  <h2>7. Prior gate decisions</h2>
  ${table(['Gate', 'Date', 'Outcome', 'Readiness', 'Decided by', 'Notes'], prior.map((g) => [g.gateName, g.date, g.outcome, `${g.readiness}%`, g.decidedBy.map((x) => personName(s, x)).join(', '), g.notes]), [3])}
  <p class="meta" style="margin-top:32px">Assembled by Crosswalk from live records. Deliverable versions listed here are recorded with the gate decision so the board's basis is reproducible.</p>`
}

// Project workspace frame: header with position + health, then one tab per module.
import { useMemo } from 'react'
import { useStore, personName } from '@/core/store'
import { projectHref, type ProjectTab } from '@/core/router'
import { templateFor } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { position } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { money, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, HealthDot, StageTrack, StatusBadge, Empty } from '@/ui/kit'
import { ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'
import { messagesHref } from '../messages/lib'
import Overview from './tabs/Overview'
import Lifecycle from './tabs/Lifecycle'
import Estimates from './tabs/Estimates'
import Baselines from './tabs/Baselines'
import Cost from './tabs/Cost'
import Changes from './tabs/Changes'
import Risk from './tabs/Risk'
import Safety from './tabs/Safety'
import Permits from './tabs/Permits'
import Records from './tabs/Records'
import Evidence from './tabs/Evidence'
import Activity from './tabs/Activity'
import ProjectInfo from './tabs/ProjectInfo'
import LocationMap from './tabs/LocationMap'
import ForecastSpread from './tabs/ForecastSpread'
import Finance from './tabs/Finance'

const TABS: { id: ProjectTab; label: string; C: (p: { projectId: string }) => JSX.Element }[] = [
  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', C: Overview },
  { id: 'info', label: 'Project info', C: ProjectInfo },
  { id: 'map', label: 'Map', C: LocationMap },
  { id: 'lifecycle', label: 'Lifecycle & gates', C: Lifecycle },
  { id: 'estimates', label: 'Estimates', C: Estimates },
  { id: 'baselines', label: 'Baselines', C: Baselines },
  { id: 'cost', label: 'Cost & EVM', C: Cost },
  { id: 'forecast', label: 'Forecast spread', C: ForecastSpread },
  { id: 'finance', label: 'Finance & commitments', C: Finance },
  { id: 'changes', label: 'Changes', C: Changes },
  { id: 'risk', label: 'Risk', C: Risk },
  { id: 'safety', label: 'Safety', C: Safety },
  { id: 'permits', label: 'Permits & contracts', C: Permits },
  { id: 'records', label: 'Records & closeout', C: Records },
  { id: 'evidence', label: 'Evidence', C: Evidence },
  { id: 'activity', label: 'Activity', C: Activity },
]

export default function ProjectView({ id, tab }: { id: string; tab?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === id)
  const pos = useMemo(() => (p ? position(s, p.id) : undefined), [s, p])
  if (!p || !pos) return <Empty title="Project not found">Check the project number in the link.</Empty>
  const tpl = templateFor(s, p)
  const active = TABS.find((t) => t.id === tab) ?? TABS[0]
  const openTasks = s.workflows.filter((w) => w.projectId === p.id && w.status === 'running').length
  const counts: Partial<Record<ProjectTab, number>> = {
    changes: s.changes.filter((c) => c.projectId === p.id && c.status === 'in-review').length || undefined,
    finance: s.commitmentChanges.filter((c) => c.projectId === p.id && c.status === 'in-review').length || undefined,
    risk: s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === p.id && (r.status === 'open' || r.status === 'mitigating')).length,
    activity: openTasks || undefined,
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <header className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4 px-5 pb-3 pt-4">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted">
              <ProgramTag programId={p.programId} />
              <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-ink">{p.code}</span>
              <span>·</span><span>{p.location.city}, {p.location.district} district</span>
              <span>·</span><span>Tier {p.sizeTier}</span>
              {p.status !== 'active' && <StatusBadge status={p.status} />}
            </div>
            <h1 className="mt-1 font-display text-[24px] font-bold leading-tight">{p.name}</h1>
            <div className="mt-3 max-w-xl">
              <StageTrack stages={tpl.stages.map((x) => x.name)} current={p.stageIndex} status={p.status} />
              <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 text-xs text-muted">
                <span>Stage {p.stageIndex + 1} of {tpl.stages.length}: <b className="text-ink">{tpl.stages[p.stageIndex]?.name}</b></span>
                <span>PM {personName(s, p.team.pm)}</span>
                <span>Sponsor {personName(s, p.team.sponsor)}</span>
                <a href={messagesHref(p.code)} className="font-semibold text-link hover:underline">Message the team</a>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
            <Fig label={pos.budgetKind === 'control' ? 'Control budget' : pos.budgetKind === 'planning' ? 'Planning budget' : 'Budget'} value={money(pos.currentBudget)} />
            <Fig label="Forecast (EAC)" value={money(pos.eac)} tone={pos.currentBudget && pos.eac > pos.currentBudget ? 'bad' : undefined} />
            <Fig label="Actual to date" value={money(pos.actualToDate)} />
            <Fig label="Contingency left" value={money(pos.contingencyRemaining)} tone={pos.contingencyOriginal && pos.contingencyRemaining < pos.contingencyOriginal * 0.25 ? 'warn' : undefined} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 border-t border-line px-5 py-2">
          <HealthDot rag={p.health.scope} label="Scope" /><HealthDot rag={p.health.schedule} label="Schedule" /><HealthDot rag={p.health.cost} label="Cost" /><HealthDot rag={p.health.risk} label="Risk" /><HealthDot rag={p.health.safety} label="Safety" />
          {openTasks > 0 && <Badge tone="marker">{openTasks} workflow{openTasks > 1 ? 's' : ''} in progress</Badge>}
        </div>
        <nav className="scroll-x flex gap-0.5 border-t border-line px-3" role="tablist">
          {TABS.map((t) => (
            <a key={t.id} href={projectHref(p.id, t.id)} role="tab" aria-selected={active.id === t.id}
              className={cx('-mb-px flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 border-b-2 px-2.5 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold', active.id === t.id ? 'border-marker text-ink' : 'border-transparent text-muted hover:text-ink')}>
              {t.label}{counts[t.id] ? <span className="rounded-full bg-sunken px-1.5 text-[11px] tabular-nums text-muted">{counts[t.id]}</span> : null}
            </a>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </header>
      <div className="min-w-0"><active.C projectId={p.id} /></div>
    </div>
  )
}

function Fig({ label, value, tone }: { label: string; value: string; tone?: 'bad' | 'warn' }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0">
      <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-faint">{label}</div>
      <div className={cx('font-display text-[19px] font-bold tabular-nums', tone === 'bad' ? 'text-bad' : tone === 'warn' ? 'text-warn' : '')}>{value}</div>
    </div>
  )
}

// Project activity: the project's workflow instances (running first) and its audit trail as a filterable timeline.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { AuditEntry } from '@/core/types'
import { personName, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { workflowHref } from '@/core/router'
import { saveFile, toCSV } from '@/core/download'
import { cx, fmtDate, fmtDateTime } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Empty, Field, Input, Panel, SegButtons, Select, StatusBadge, type Tone } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { WorkflowStatus } from '../../shared/WorkflowStatus'
import { fmtDur, nowMs, recordTypeLabel } from '../../workflows/lib'

const tone = (a: string): Tone => {
  const x = a.toLowerCase()
  if (['approve', 'accept', 'go', 'verify', 'complete', 'award', 'e-sign', 'publish'].some((k) => x.includes(k))) return 'good'
  if (['reject', 'cancel', 'recall', 'delete'].some((k) => x.includes(k))) return 'bad'
  if (['return', 'recycle', 'hold', 'waive'].some((k) => x.includes(k))) return 'warn'
  if (['start', 'submit', 'create', 'snapshot'].some((k) => x.includes(k))) return 'info'
  return 'neutral'
}

export default function Activity({ projectId }: { projectId: string; id?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)
  const insts = useMemo(() => s.workflows.filter((w) => w.projectId === projectId).sort((a, b) => (a.status === 'running' ? 0 : 1) - (b.status === 'running' ? 0 : 1) || b.startedAt.localeCompare(a.startedAt)), [s.workflows, projectId])
  const [wfFilter, setWfFilter] = useState<'running' | 'all'>('running')
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false)
  const running = insts.filter((w) => w.status === 'running')
  const shownInsts = (wfFilter === 'running' ? running : insts).slice(0, showAll ? 999 : 8)

  const audit = useMemo(() => s.audit.filter((a) => a.projectId === projectId).slice().sort((a, b) => b.at.localeCompare(a.at)), [s.audit, projectId])
  const [entity, setEntity] = useState('')
  const [action, setAction] = useState('')
  const [actor, setActor] = useState('')
  const [from, setFrom] = useState('')
  const [to, setTo] = useState('')
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(60)
  const entities = Array.from(new Set(audit.map((a) => a.entity))).sort()
  const actions = Array.from(new Set(audit.filter((a) => !entity || a.entity === entity).map((a) => a.action))).sort()
  const actors = Array.from(new Set(audit.map((a) => a.actorId)))
  const rows = audit.filter((a) => (!entity || a.entity === entity) && (!action || a.action === action) && (!actor || a.actorId === actor) && (!from || a.at.slice(0, 10) >= from) && (!to || a.at.slice(0, 10) <= to) && (!q || (a.summary + ' ' + personName(s, a.actorId)).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())))
  const byDay = useMemo(() => {
    const out: { day: string; items: AuditEntry[] }[] = []
    for (const a of rows.slice(0, limit)) { const d = a.at.slice(0, 10); const last = out[out.length - 1]; if (last?.day === d) last.items.push(a); else out.push({ day: d, items: [a] }) }
    return out
  }, [rows, limit])
  const filtered = !!(entity || action || actor || from || to || q)

  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const data = rows.map((a) => ({ timestamp: a.at, project: p?.code ?? '', entity: a.entity, entity_id: a.entityId, action: a.action, actor: personName(s, a.actorId), actor_id: a.actorId, summary: a.summary }))
    if (!data.length) { toast('Nothing to export', 'info'); return }
    const r = await saveFile(`${p?.code ?? projectId}-audit-trail.csv`, toCSV(data), 'text/csv')
    toast(r === 'saved' ? `Exported ${data.length} audit entries` : r === 'declined' ? 'Export cancelled' : 'Downloads are not available here', r === 'saved' ? 'good' : 'info')
  }

  const now = nowMs(s)
  const signed = insts.reduce((a, w) => a + w.history.filter((h) => h.signature).length, 0)
  const overdue = running.filter((w) => w.active.some((x) => x.due && x.due < s.settings.asOf)).length

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
        <Fig label="Workflows in progress" value={running.length} tone={running.length ? 'marker' : undefined} />
        <Fig label="Overdue steps" value={overdue} tone={overdue ? 'bad' : undefined} />
        <Fig label="Completed workflows" value={insts.length - running.length} />
        <Fig label="E-signed decisions" value={signed} />
      </div>

      <Panel title="Workflows" subtitle="Every approval on this project, with who acted, when and under which process version."
        actions={<SegButtons value={wfFilter} onChange={setWfFilter} options={[{ id: 'running', label: `Running (${running.length})` }, { id: 'all', label: `All (${insts.length})` }]} />}>
        {shownInsts.length ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {shownInsts.map((w) => (
              <div key={w.id} className="min-w-0">
                <div className="mb-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-[12px] text-muted">
                  <b className="text-[13px] text-ink">{w.title}</b>
                  <span>{recordTypeLabel(w.recordType)}</span>
                  <span>started {fmtDate(w.startedAt.slice(0, 10))} by {personName(s, w.startedById)}</span>
                  <span>{w.status === 'running' ? `${fmtDur((now - Date.parse(w.startedAt)) / 36e5)} in flight` : w.completedAt ? `took ${fmtDur((Date.parse(w.completedAt) - Date.parse(w.startedAt)) / 36e5)}` : ''}</span>
                  <a href={workflowHref(w.defKey)} className="text-link">process v{w.defVersion}</a>
                </div>
                <WorkflowStatus instanceId={w.id} compact />
              </div>
            ))}
            {(wfFilter === 'running' ? running : insts).length > 8 && !showAll && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setShowAll(true)}>Show all {(wfFilter === 'running' ? running : insts).length}</Button>}
          </div>
        ) : <Empty title={wfFilter === 'running' ? 'No workflows in progress' : 'No workflows yet'}>{wfFilter === 'running' && insts.length ? <button className="font-semibold text-link" onClick={() => setWfFilter('all')}>Show the {insts.length} completed</button> : 'Approvals started on this project appear here.'}</Empty>}
      </Panel>

      <Panel title="Audit trail" subtitle={`${audit.length} entries — every change to this project's records, who made it and when.`} pad={false}
        actions={<Button size="sm" icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} onClick={exportCsv}>Export CSV{filtered ? ` (${rows.length})` : ''}</Button>}>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 border-b border-line px-4 py-3 md:grid-cols-6">
          <Field label="Search" className="col-span-2"><Input placeholder="Summary or person" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} /></Field>
          <Field label="Entity"><Select value={entity} onChange={(e) => { setEntity(e.target.value); setAction('') }} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All' }, ...entities]} /></Field>
          <Field label="Action"><Select value={action} onChange={(e) => setAction(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All' }, ...actions]} /></Field>
          <Field label="Actor"><Select value={actor} onChange={(e) => setActor(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'Anyone' }, ...actors.map((a) => ({ value: a, label: personName(s, a) }))]} /></Field>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
            <Field label="From"><Input type="date" value={from} onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)} className="px-1.5" /></Field>
            <Field label="To"><Input type="date" value={to} onChange={(e) => setTo(e.target.value)} className="px-1.5" /></Field>
          </div>
        </div>
        {filtered && <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-line px-4 py-1.5 text-[12px] text-muted">{rows.length} of {audit.length} entries <button className="font-semibold text-link" onClick={() => { setEntity(''); setAction(''); setActor(''); setFrom(''); setTo(''); setQ('') }}>Clear filters</button></div>}
        {byDay.length ? (
          <div className="px-4 py-3">
            {byDay.map((g) => (
              <div key={g.day} className="mb-3 last:mb-0">
                <div className="eyebrow mb-1.5">{fmtDate(g.day)}</div>
                <ol className="relative ml-2 border-l border-line">
                  {g.items.map((a) => (
                    <li key={a.id} className="mb-2 ml-4 last:mb-0">
                      <span className={cx('absolute -left-[5px] mt-1.5 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full border-2 border-surface', { good: 'bg-good', bad: 'bg-bad', warn: 'bg-warn', info: 'bg-info' }[tone(a.action) as 'good'] ?? 'bg-faint')} />
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-[12.5px]">
                        <span className="w-[62px] shrink-0 tabular-nums text-faint">{new Date(a.at).toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })}</span>
                        <Badge tone="neutral">{a.entity}</Badge>
                        <Badge tone={tone(a.action)}>{a.action}</Badge>
                        <b>{personName(s, a.actorId)}</b>
                      </div>
                      <p className="ml-[70px] mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-muted max-sm:ml-0">{a.summary}</p>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ol>
              </div>
            ))}
            {rows.length > limit && <div className="pt-2"><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setLimit(limit + 100)}>Show more ({rows.length - limit} older)</Button></div>}
          </div>
        ) : <div className="p-4"><Empty title={filtered ? 'No entries match' : 'No audit entries yet'}>{filtered ? 'Widen the filters.' : 'Changes to this project will be recorded here.'}</Empty></div>}
        <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-2 text-[11.5px] text-faint">Last entry {audit[0] ? fmtDateTime(audit[0].at) : '—'} · entries cannot be edited or deleted.</div>
      </Panel>
    </div>
  )
}

function Fig({ label, value, tone }: { label: string; value: number; tone?: 'bad' | 'marker' }) {
  return <div className="min-w-0 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2"><div className="eyebrow truncate">{label}</div><div className={cx('mt-0.5 font-display text-[22px] font-bold tabular-nums', tone === 'bad' && 'text-bad')}>{value}{tone === 'marker' && value > 0 && <span className="ml-1.5 inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-marker align-middle" />}</div></div>
}
