      actions={<SegButtons options={[{ id: 'gaps', label: `Uncovered ${cov.gaps.length}` }, { id: 'all', label: `All ${cov.rows.length}` }]} value={only ? 'gaps' : 'all'} onChange={(v) => setOnly(v === 'gaps')} />}>
      {cov.basis === 'none' ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No estimate yet">Line coverage is checked once the project has an estimate.</Empty></div> : (
        <>
          {cov.gaps.length > 0 ? <div className="border-b border-line px-4 py-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-warn">{cov.gaps.length} line{cov.gaps.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} ({money(cov.uncovered)}) not assigned to any commitment — add the PO that buys each one.</div>
            : <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-line px-4 py-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-good"><Icon name="check" className="h-4 w-4" />Every estimate line is covered by a commitment or company labor</div>}
          <Table rows={rows} rowKey={(r) => r.lineId} dense empty={<div className="p-4 text-[13px] text-muted">No uncovered lines.</div>} columns={[
            { key: 'l', header: 'Forecast line', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap"><Mono className="text-faint">{r.code}</Mono> {r.name}</span> },
            { key: 'b', header: 'Budget', num: true, sort: (r) => r.budget, render: (r) => money(r.budget) },
            { key: 'c', header: 'Committed (attributed)', num: true, sort: (r) => r.committed, render: (r) => (r.contractIds.length ? money(r.committed) : '—') },
            { key: 'k', header: 'Commitments', render: (r) => r.contractIds.length ? <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">{r.contractIds.map((id) => { const c = s.contracts.find((x) => x.id === id)!; return <button key={id} onClick={() => onOpen(id)} className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline">{c.vendor}</button> })}</span> : r.status === 'company' ? <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{NON_COMMITMENT_LINES[r.lineId]}</span> : <span className="text-[12px] text-faint">—</span> },
            { key: 's', header: 'Check', render: (r) => <Badge tone={r.status === 'covered' ? 'good' : r.status === 'company' ? 'neutral' : 'warn'}>{r.status === 'covered' ? 'Covered' : r.status === 'company' ? 'Company / direct' : 'Uncovered'}</Badge> },
            { key: 'a', header: '', render: (r) => canEdit && r.status === 'gap' ? <Button size="sm" onClick={() => onCover(r.lineId)}>Add commitment</Button> : null },
          ]} />
        </>
      )}
    </Panel>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Project-wide RFI / CCO log
function CcoLog({ s, p, onOpen }: { s: AppState; p: Project; onOpen: (contractId: string, ccoId: string) => void }) {
  const rows = s.commitmentChanges.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id).sort((a, b) => b.requestedAt.localeCompare(a.requestedAt) || b.code.localeCompare(a.code))
  if (!rows.length) return null
  return (
    <Panel title="RFI / change order log" subtitle="Every change to what a vendor is paid, with its approval status. Approved amounts are in the commitments above." pad={false}>
      <Table rows={rows} rowKey={(x) => x.id} onRowClick={(x) => onOpen(x.contractId, x.id)} dense columns={[
        { key: 'c', header: 'Code', sort: (x) => x.code, render: (x) => <Mono className="font-semibold">{x.code}</Mono> },
        { key: 'v', header: 'Commitment', render: (x) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{s.contracts.find((c) => c.id === x.contractId)?.vendor ?? '—'}</span> },
        { key: 'r', header: 'RFI / field condition', render: (x) => <span className="block min-w-[220px]">{x.rfi}<span className="block text-[11.5px] text-muted">{x.description}</span></span> },
        { key: 'a', header: 'Amount', num: true, sort: (x) => x.amount, render: (x) => <span className={cx('font-semibold', x.amount > 0 ? 'text-bad' : x.amount < 0 ? 'text-good' : '')}>{moneyDelta(x.amount)}</span> },
        { key: 'd', header: 'Days', num: true, render: (x) => (x.scheduleImpactDays ? `+${x.scheduleImpactDays}` : '0') },
        { key: 'ch', header: 'Project change', render: (x) => { const ch = s.changes.find((c) => c.id === x.changeId); return ch ? <a href={projectHref(p.id, 'changes')} onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setFocusChange(ch.id) }} className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline">{ch.code}</a> : <span className="text-faint">—</span> } },
        { key: 'q', header: 'Requested', sort: (x) => x.requestedAt, render: (x) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{fmtDate(x.requestedAt)} · {personName(s, x.requestedById)}</span> },
        { key: 's', header: 'Status', sort: (x) => x.status, render: (x) => <StatusBadge status={x.status} /> },
      ]} />
    </Panel>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/project/tabs/finance/CcoModal.tsx =====
// "New RFI / change order": the single entry point for changing a commitment. Logs the field question and
// its cost against a commitment, optionally ties it to a project change request, and starts the
// 'commitment-change' workflow (PM → construction manager → project controls → approver by dollar authority).
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { commitmentRow, createCommitmentChange, nextCcoCode } from '@/core/engine/finance'
import { latestDef, simulate } from '@/core/engine/workflow'
import { money, moneyDelta, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Button, Callout, Field, Input, KV, Modal, MoneyInput, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'

export interface CcoSeed { contractId?: string; changeId?: string }

export function CcoModal({ projectId, seed, onClose, onCreated }: { projectId: string; seed: CcoSeed | null; onClose: () => void; onCreated?: (ccoId: string, contractId: string) => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const contracts = s.contracts.filter((c) => c.projectId === projectId && c.status !== 'rfp' && c.status !== 'closed')
  const changes = s.changes.filter((c) => c.projectId === projectId && c.status !== 'rejected')
  const blank = { contractId: '', rfi: '', description: '', amount: 0, days: 0, changeId: '' }
  const [f, setF] = useState(blank)
  const open = !!seed
  useEffect(() => {
    if (seed) setF({ ...blank, contractId: seed.contractId ?? contracts[0]?.id ?? '', changeId: seed.changeId ?? '' })
  }, [open, seed?.contractId, seed?.changeId]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const k = s.contracts.find((c) => c.id === f.contractId)
  const row = k ? commitmentRow(s, k) : undefined
  const def = latestDef(s, 'commitment-change')
  const route = useMemo(() => (def && open ? simulate(s, def, { amount: f.amount, scheduleImpactDays: f.days, rfi: f.rfi }, projectId) : []), [s, def, f.amount, f.days, f.rfi, projectId, open])
  if (!seed) return null
  const submit = () => {
    if (!f.contractId) { toast('Pick the commitment this change applies to', 'bad'); return }
    if (!f.rfi.trim() || !f.description.trim()) { toast('Describe the RFI or field condition and the change', 'bad'); return }
    if (!f.amount && !f.days) { toast('Enter the cost or schedule impact', 'bad'); return }
    let id = '', code = ''
    mutate((d) => { const cc = createCommitmentChange(d, projectId, { contractId: f.contractId, rfi: f.rfi, description: f.description, amount: f.amount, scheduleImpactDays: f.days, changeId: f.changeId || undefined }); id = cc.id; code = cc.code })
    toast(`${code} submitted for approval`)
    onCreated?.(id, f.contractId)
    onClose()
  }
  const linked = changes.find((c) => c.id === f.changeId)
  return (
    <Modal open onClose={onClose} wide title={`New RFI / change order · ${nextCcoCode(s, p)}`}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={submit} disabled={!contracts.length}>Submit for approval</Button></>}>
      {!contracts.length ? (
        <Callout tone="warn" title="No live commitment">RFI / change orders are raised against an awarded or active commitment. Add the commitment on the Finance tab first.</Callout>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[3fr_2fr]">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <Field label="Commitment">
              <Select id="cco-contract" value={f.contractId} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, contractId: e.target.value })}
                options={contracts.map((c) => ({ value: c.id, label: `${c.vendor} · ${c.type} · PO ${c.poNumber ?? '—'} · ${money(c.value + c.changeOrders)}` }))} />
            </Field>
            <Field label="RFI / field condition" hint="The question or condition that triggered the change">
              <Input id="cco-rfi" value={f.rfi} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, rfi: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. Unmarked 12-inch water main at Sta 42+10 conflicts with alignment" />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Change to the commitment">
              <TextArea id="cco-desc" value={f.description} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, description: e.target.value })} placeholder="What the vendor will do differently, how it was priced (unit rates, T&M, lump sum) and the evidence attached." />
            </Field>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="Amount" hint="Negative for a credit"><MoneyInput id="cco-amount" value={f.amount} onChange={(v) => setF({ ...f, amount: v })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Schedule impact (days)"><Input id="cco-days" type="number" value={f.days} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, days: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })} /></Field>
            </div>
            <Field label="Project change request (optional)" hint="Link when the RFI is part of a change to the project baseline">
              <Select id="cco-change" value={f.changeId} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, changeId: e.target.value })}
                options={[{ value: '', label: 'Not linked — absorbed within the commitment' }, ...changes.map((c) => ({ value: c.id, label: `${c.code} ${c.title} (${c.status})` }))]} />
            </Field>
            {linked && linked.contractIds && !linked.contractIds.includes(f.contractId) && <Callout tone="info">{linked.code} will list this commitment as affected once the CCO is submitted.</Callout>}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken/40 p-3">
            <div className="eyebrow">Commitment after approval</div>
            {row && <KV cols={1} items={[
              ['Current commitment', <span key="c" className="tabular-nums">{money(row.current, 'full')}</span>],
              ['This change', <b key="t" className={cx('tabular-nums', f.amount > 0 ? 'text-bad' : f.amount < 0 ? 'text-good' : '')}>{moneyDelta(f.amount)}</b>],
              ['In review already', <span key="r" className="tabular-nums">{money(row.pendingChanges)}</span>],
              ['Commitment if approved', <b key="a" className="tabular-nums">{money(row.current + f.amount, 'full')}</b>],
              ['Remaining to invoice', <span key="rm" className="tabular-nums">{money(row.remaining + f.amount, 'full')}</span>],
              ...(row.c.poTotal ? [['Share of PO', <span key="po" className={cx('tabular-nums', row.poShare !== undefined && row.current + f.amount > row.poShare ? 'text-warn font-semibold' : '')}>{(((row.current + f.amount) / row.c.poTotal) * 100).toFixed(1)}% used · {row.c.pctOfPo ?? '—'}% planned</span>] as [string, JSX.Element]] : []),
            ]} />}
            <div className="eyebrow mt-1">Routing (live from the workflow)</div>
            <ol className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-[12.5px]">
              {route.map((r, i) => <li key={i} className="flex gap-2"><span className="w-4 text-right tabular-nums text-faint">{i + 1}</span><span className="min-w-0"><b>{r.node.label}</b><span className="block text-muted">{r.people.map((x) => x.name).join(', ') || 'Unassigned'}</span></span></li>)}
            </ol>
            <p className="text-[11.5px] text-muted">Approval adds the amount to the commitment's approved changes. Nobody edits a commitment value directly.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </Modal>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/project/tabs/finance/CommitmentDetail.tsx =====
// One commitment: PO share, the money waterfall (committed → approved changes → current → invoiced → remaining),
// data-quality flags, and its RFI / change order log with the live workflow for each.
import { useState } from 'react'
import { personName, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import type { CommitmentChange } from '@/core/types'
import { commitmentIssues, commitmentRow } from '@/core/engine/finance'
import { lineById } from '@/core/engine/lines'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { fmtDate, money, moneyDelta, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Drawer, Empty, KV, Mono, Progress, Section, StatusBadge } from '@/ui/kit'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { WorkflowStatus } from '../../../shared/WorkflowStatus'
import { setFocusChange } from '../controls/trace'

export function CommitmentDetail({ contractId, focusCco, onClose, onEdit, onNewCco, canEdit = true }: { contractId: string; focusCco?: string; onClose: () => void; onEdit: () => void; onNewCco: () => void; canEdit?: boolean }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const c = s.contracts.find((x) => x.id === contractId)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(focusCco ?? null)
  if (!c) return null
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === c.projectId)!
  const r = commitmentRow(s, c)
  const issues = commitmentIssues(s, p, c)
  const io = p.finance?.ios.find((x) => x.id === c.ioId)
  const billed = r.current ? r.invoiced / r.current : 0
  const live = c.status !== 'rfp' && c.status !== 'closed'
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} width={680} title={<span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{c.vendor}<Badge>{c.type}</Badge><StatusBadge status={c.status} label={c.status === 'rfp' ? 'RFP' : undefined} /></span>}
      footer={canEdit ? <><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onEdit}>Edit commitment</Button>{live && <Button variant="primary" icon={<Icon name="plus" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} onClick={onNewCco}>New RFI / change order</Button>}</> : undefined}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <KV cols={3} items={[
          ['SAP PO', <Mono key="po">{c.poNumber || '—'}</Mono>], ['PO total (all projects)', money(c.poTotal, 'full')], ['% of PO for this project', c.pctOfPo !== undefined ? `${c.pctOfPo}% · ${money(r.poShare)}` : '—'],
          ['Call-off / contract', <Mono key="n">{c.number || '—'}</Mono>], ['Internal order', io ? <span key="io"><Mono>{io.number}</Mono> · {io.type === 'capital' ? 'Capital' : 'O&M'}</span> : <span className="text-bad">None</span>], ['Awarded', fmtDate(c.awarded)],
        ]} />
        {c.scope && <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken/40 px-3 py-2 text-[13px]"><div className="eyebrow mb-0.5">Scope of work</div>{c.scope}</div>}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-5">
          {([['Committed', r.committed], ['Approved changes', r.approvedChanges], ['Current', r.current], ['Invoiced', r.invoiced], ['Remaining', r.remaining]] as [string, number][]).map(([k, v]) => (
            <div key={k} className="min-w-0 rounded-md border border-line px-2.5 py-1.5">
              <div className="text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-faint">{k}</div>
              <div className={cx('font-display text-[16px] font-bold tabular-nums', k === 'Remaining' && v < 0 && 'text-bad')}>{k === 'Approved changes' ? moneyDelta(v) : money(v)}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div>
          <Progress value={billed * 100} tone={billed > 1 ? 'bad' : 'ink'} />
          <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-2 text-[11.5px] text-muted">
            <span>{(billed * 100).toFixed(0)}% invoiced</span>
            {r.usedPct !== undefined && <span className={r.overShare ? 'font-semibold text-warn' : ''}>Uses {r.usedPct}% of the PO{c.pctOfPo !== undefined ? ` · ${c.pctOfPo}% planned` : ''}{r.overShare ? ' — raise the planned share with supply' : ''}</span>}
            {r.pendingChanges !== 0 && <span>{moneyDelta(r.pendingChanges)} in review</span>}
          </div>
        </div>
        {issues.length > 0 && <Callout tone="warn" title="Fix before the next forecast">{issues.map((x) => <div key={x}>• {x}</div>)}</Callout>}
        <Section title="Forecast lines covered">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">{(c.lineIds ?? []).map((l) => { const line = lineById(s, l); return <span key={l} className="rounded border border-line px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[12px]"><Mono className="text-faint">{line?.code}</Mono> {line?.name ?? l}</span> })}{!c.lineIds?.length && <span className="text-[13px] text-faint">None assigned</span>}</div>
        </Section>
        <Section title={`RFI / change orders (${r.ccos.length})`}>
          {r.ccos.length === 0 ? <Empty title="No RFI / change orders">Every change to what this vendor is paid starts here, so the commitment and the forecast move together.</Empty> : (
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              {r.ccos.map((x) => <CcoItem key={x.id} x={x} open={open === x.id} onToggle={() => setOpen(open === x.id ? null : x.id)} />)}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Section>
        <p className="text-xs text-faint">{p.code} · commitment id <Mono>{c.id}</Mono>. Approved changes are added by the RFI / CCO workflow only.</p>
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

function CcoItem({ x, open, onToggle }: { x: CommitmentChange; open: boolean; onToggle: () => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const ch = s.changes.find((c) => c.id === x.changeId)
  return (
    <li className="rounded-md border border-line">
      <button onClick={onToggle} className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 px-3 py-2 text-left hover:bg-sunken/50">
        <Mono className="font-semibold">{x.code}</Mono>
        <StatusBadge status={x.status} />
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[13px]">{x.rfi}</span>
        <span className={cx('font-semibold tabular-nums', x.amount > 0 ? 'text-bad' : x.amount < 0 ? 'text-good' : '')}>{moneyDelta(x.amount)}</span>
        <span className="text-[12px] tabular-nums text-muted">{x.scheduleImpactDays ? `+${x.scheduleImpactDays}d` : '0d'}</span>
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-line px-3 py-2.5">
          <p className="text-[13px]">{x.description}</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-[12px] text-muted">
            <span>Requested {fmtDate(x.requestedAt)} by {personName(s, x.requestedById)}</span>
            {x.decidedAt && <span>Decided {fmtDate(x.decidedAt)}</span>}
            {ch ? <a href={projectHref(x.projectId, 'changes')} onClick={() => setFocusChange(ch.id)} className="font-semibold text-link hover:underline">Rolls into {ch.code}</a> : <span>Absorbed within the commitment (no project change)</span>}
          </div>
          {x.workflowInstanceId && <WorkflowStatus instanceId={x.workflowInstanceId} compact={x.status !== 'in-review'} />}
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/project/tabs/finance/CommitmentForm.tsx =====
// Add or edit a commitment ("call-off"): the vendor PO the project uses, the share of that PO intended for
// this project, the scope it buys, the forecast lines it covers and the internal order it charges.
// Once awarded, the committed value is fixed; changes go through an RFI / change order.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import type { Contract, Project } from '@/core/types'
import { basisByLine } from '@/core/engine/finance'
import { forecastLines } from '@/core/engine/lines'
import { money, uid, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Button, Callout, Checkbox, Drawer, Field, Input, MoneyInput, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'

const TYPES: Contract['type'][] = ['Construction', 'Engineering', 'Materials', 'Inspection', 'Environmental']

export function CommitmentForm({ p, edit, onClose, onSaved }: { p: Project; edit: { c?: Contract; lineIds?: string[] } | null; onClose: () => void; onSaved?: (id: string) => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [c, setC] = useState<Contract | null>(null)
  const isNew = !edit?.c
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!edit) { setC(null); return }
    if (edit.c) setC(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(edit.c)))
    else {
      const cap = p.finance?.ios.find((io) => io.type === 'capital' && io.status !== 'closed')
      setC({ id: uid('ctr'), projectId: p.id, number: '', vendor: '', type: 'Materials', value: 0, changeOrders: 0, invoiced: 0, status: 'active', awarded: s.settings.asOf, poNumber: '', poTotal: 0, pctOfPo: 100, scope: '', lineIds: edit.lineIds ?? [], ioId: cap?.id })
    }
  }, [edit]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  if (!edit || !c) return null
  const locked = !isNew && edit.c!.status !== 'rfp'
  const basis = basisByLine(s, p.id)
  const ios = p.finance?.ios ?? []
  const others = s.contracts.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id && x.id !== c.id)
  const coveredBy = (lid: string) => others.filter((x) => x.lineIds?.includes(lid)).map((x) => x.vendor || x.number)
  const share = c.poTotal && c.pctOfPo !== undefined ? Math.round((c.poTotal * c.pctOfPo) / 100) : 0
  const setPct = (pct: number) => setC({ ...c, pctOfPo: pct, value: locked ? c.value : c.poTotal ? Math.round((c.poTotal * pct) / 100) : c.value })
  const setPoTotal = (v: number) => setC({ ...c, poTotal: v, value: locked ? c.value : v && c.pctOfPo !== undefined ? Math.round((v * c.pctOfPo) / 100) : c.value })
  const setValue = (v: number) => setC({ ...c, value: v, pctOfPo: c.poTotal ? Math.round((v / c.poTotal) * 1000) / 10 : c.pctOfPo })
  const lines = forecastLines(s).filter((l) => (basis.byLine[l.id] || 0) > 0 || c.lineIds?.includes(l.id))
  const save = () => {
    if (!c.vendor.trim()) { toast('Vendor is required', 'bad'); return }
    if (!c.poNumber?.trim() && c.status !== 'rfp') { toast('Enter the SAP PO number', 'bad'); return }
    if (c.poTotal && (c.pctOfPo === undefined || c.pctOfPo <= 0 || c.pctOfPo > 100)) { toast('% of PO must be between 0 and 100', 'bad'); return }
    if (!c.lineIds?.length) { toast('Assign at least one forecast line', 'bad'); return }
    if (!c.scope?.trim()) { toast('State the scope this commitment buys', 'bad'); return }
    const clean: Contract = { ...c, vendor: c.vendor.trim(), number: c.number.trim() || c.poNumber!.trim(), poNumber: c.poNumber?.trim(), scope: c.scope.trim() }
    const prev = edit.c
    const parts: string[] = []
    if (prev) {
      if (prev.pctOfPo !== clean.pctOfPo) parts.push(`% of PO ${prev.pctOfPo ?? '—'} → ${clean.pctOfPo}`)
      if (prev.poTotal !== clean.poTotal) parts.push(`PO total ${money(prev.poTotal)} → ${money(clean.poTotal)}`)
      if (prev.value !== clean.value) parts.push(`committed ${money(prev.value)} → ${money(clean.value)}`)
      if (prev.invoiced !== clean.invoiced) parts.push(`invoiced ${money(prev.invoiced)} → ${money(clean.invoiced)}`)
      if (prev.ioId !== clean.ioId) parts.push(`IO → ${ios.find((x) => x.id === clean.ioId)?.number ?? 'none'}`)
      if (JSON.stringify(prev.lineIds) !== JSON.stringify(clean.lineIds)) parts.push(`lines ${clean.lineIds!.length}`)
      if (prev.status !== clean.status) parts.push(`status ${prev.status} → ${clean.status}`)
      if (prev.scope !== clean.scope) parts.push('scope')
    }
    mutate((d) => { const i = d.contracts.findIndex((x) => x.id === clean.id); if (i >= 0) d.contracts[i] = clean; else d.contracts.push(clean) },
      { entity: 'contract', entityId: clean.id, projectId: p.id, action: isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: isNew ? `${p.code}: commitment added — ${clean.vendor} PO ${clean.poNumber}, ${clean.pctOfPo}% of ${money(clean.poTotal)} = ${money(clean.value)} for ${clean.lineIds!.length} line(s)` : `${p.code}: commitment ${clean.vendor} PO ${clean.poNumber} ${parts.join('; ') || 'updated'}` })
    toast(isNew ? 'Commitment added' : 'Commitment saved')
    onSaved?.(clean.id)
    onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} width={620} title={isNew ? 'Add commitment' : `Commitment · ${c.vendor}`}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>{isNew ? 'Add commitment' : 'Save commitment'}</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">List each vendor PO the project uses. Blanket POs serve many projects, so record the PO total and the share of it this project intends to use; that share is the project's commitment.</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Vendor"><Input id="cm-vendor" value={c.vendor} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, vendor: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Type"><Select id="cm-type" value={c.type} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, type: e.target.value as Contract['type'] })} options={TYPES} /></Field>
          <Field label="SAP PO number"><Input id="cm-po" className="font-mono" value={c.poNumber ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, poNumber: e.target.value })} placeholder="45xxxxxxxx" /></Field>
          <Field label="Contract / call-off no."><Input id="cm-num" className="font-mono" value={c.number} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, number: e.target.value })} placeholder="Defaults to the PO number" /></Field>
          <Field label="PO total (all projects)" hint="Blanket PO value"><MoneyInput id="cm-pototal" value={c.poTotal ?? 0} onChange={setPoTotal} /></Field>
          <Field label="% of PO for this project" hint={share ? `${money(share, 'full')} of the PO` : undefined}>
            <Input id="cm-pct" type="number" min={0} max={100} step={0.1} className="text-right tabular-nums" value={c.pctOfPo ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setPct(Number(e.target.value))} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Committed for this project" hint={locked ? 'Fixed once awarded — change it with an RFI / change order' : 'PO total × % of PO; edit either'}>
            <MoneyInput id="cm-value" disabled={locked} value={c.value} onChange={setValue} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Invoiced to date" hint="From SAP goods receipts / invoices"><MoneyInput id="cm-inv" value={c.invoiced} onChange={(v) => setC({ ...c, invoiced: v })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Internal order charged">
            <Select id="cm-io" value={c.ioId ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, ioId: e.target.value || undefined })}
              options={[{ value: '', label: ios.length ? '— Select —' : 'No IOs yet' }, ...ios.map((io) => ({ value: io.id, label: `${io.number} · ${io.type === 'capital' ? 'Capital' : 'O&M'} (${io.status})` }))]} />
          </Field>
          <Field label="Status"><Select id="cm-status" value={c.status} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, status: e.target.value as Contract['status'] })} options={[{ value: 'rfp', label: 'RFP / sourcing' }, { value: 'awarded', label: 'Awarded' }, { value: 'active', label: 'Active' }, { value: 'closed', label: 'Closed' }]} /></Field>
        </div>
        {locked && c.changeOrders !== 0 && <Callout tone="info">Approved RFI / change orders: <b className="tabular-nums">{money(c.changeOrders, 'full')}</b> (current commitment {money(c.value + c.changeOrders, 'full')}). Approved changes come only from the RFI / CCO workflow.</Callout>}
        <Field label="Scope of work this commitment buys"><TextArea id="cm-scope" value={c.scope ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, scope: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. Installation, tie-ins and restoration, Sta 0+00 to 48+50" /></Field>
        <div>
          <div className="mb-1 flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">Forecast lines covered</span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">Amounts: {basis.label}</span>
          </div>
          <ul className="flex max-h-[300px] flex-col divide-y divide-line overflow-y-auto rounded-md border border-line">
            {lines.map((l) => {
              const on = !!c.lineIds?.includes(l.id)
              const other = coveredBy(l.id)
              return (
                <li key={l.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5">
                  <Checkbox checked={on} onChange={(v) => setC({ ...c, lineIds: v ? [...(c.lineIds ?? []), l.id] : (c.lineIds ?? []).filter((x) => x !== l.id) })} label={<span><span className="font-mono text-[11.5px] text-faint">{l.code}</span> {l.name}</span>} />
                  <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-[11.5px]">
                    {other.length > 0 ? <span className="text-faint">also {other.join(', ')}</span> : <span className={cx(!on && 'font-semibold text-warn')}>{on ? '' : 'uncovered'}</span>}
                    <span className="w-16 text-right tabular-nums text-muted">{basis.byLine[l.id] ? money(basis.byLine[l.id]) : '—'}</span>
                  </span>
                </li>
              )
            })}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

// Cross-tab focus: another tab sets the commitment (and optionally the RFI / CCO) to open when Finance mounts.
let focus: { contractId: string; ccoId?: string } | null = null
export const setFocusCommitment = (contractId: string, ccoId?: string) => { focus = { contractId, ccoId } }
