// Permits & conditions, land rights, contracts (with award workflow) and long-lead materials (V1.5) + AI-03.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { Contract, LandRight, LongLeadItem, Permit } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { startWorkflow } from '@/core/engine/workflow'
import { permissions } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { askJSON, aiMessage, useAiAvailable } from '@/core/ai'
import { addDays, cx, daysBetween, fmtDate, money, sum, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { AiTag, Badge, Button, Callout, Checkbox, Drawer, Empty, Field, Input, MoneyInput, Panel, Select, Stat, StatusBadge, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { WorkflowStatus } from '../../shared/WorkflowStatus'
import { constructionStart, useDraft } from '../../admin/common'

export default function Permits({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const permits = s.permits.filter((x) => x.projectId === projectId)
  const land = s.landRights.filter((x) => x.projectId === projectId)
  const contracts = s.contracts.filter((x) => x.projectId === projectId)
  const longLead = s.longLead.filter((x) => x.projectId === projectId)
  const cStart = constructionStart(p)
  const started = !!cStart && cStart <= asOf

  const openConds = permits.flatMap((x) => x.conditions.filter((c) => c.status === 'open'))
  const overdueConds = openConds.filter((c) => c.due && c.due < asOf)
  const expiring = permits.filter((x) => x.expires && x.status === 'issued' && daysBetween(asOf, x.expires) <= 60)
  const landLate = land.filter((l) => l.status !== 'acquired' && ((cStart && l.needBy > cStart) || l.needBy < asOf))
  const llLate = longLead.filter((l) => l.status !== 'received' && (l.eta > l.requiredOnSite || (cStart && l.eta > cStart)))

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <Stat label="Permits issued" value={`${permits.filter((x) => x.status === 'issued').length}/${permits.length}`} tone={permits.some((x) => x.status !== 'issued') ? 'warn' : 'good'} sub={expiring.length ? `${expiring.length} expiring within 60 days` : 'None expiring within 60 days'} />
        <Stat label="Open permit conditions" value={openConds.length} tone={overdueConds.length ? 'bad' : undefined} sub={overdueConds.length ? `${overdueConds.length} past due` : 'None past due'} />
        <Stat label="Land rights acquired" value={`${land.filter((l) => l.status === 'acquired').length}/${land.length}`} tone={landLate.length ? 'bad' : undefined} sub={landLate.length ? `${landLate.length} at risk vs schedule` : cStart ? `Construction start ${fmtDate(cStart)}` : 'No construction date'} />
        <Stat label="Contracts committed" value={money(sum(contracts.filter((c) => c.status !== 'rfp').map((c) => c.value + c.changeOrders)))} sub={`${money(sum(contracts.map((c) => c.invoiced)))} invoiced · ${llLate.length} late material item${llLate.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`} tone={llLate.length ? 'warn' : undefined} />
      </div>
      <PermitsPanel projectId={projectId} permits={permits} asOf={asOf} started={started} />
      <LandPanel projectId={projectId} land={land} asOf={asOf} cStart={cStart} />
      <ContractsPanel projectId={projectId} contracts={contracts} canAward={permissions(s, p).has('contract-award')} />
      <LongLeadPanel projectId={projectId} items={longLead} asOf={asOf} cStart={cStart} />
    </div>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Permits
function PermitsPanel({ projectId, permits, asOf, started }: { projectId: string; permits: Permit[]; asOf: string; started: boolean }) {
  const aiOn = useAiAvailable()
  const p = useStore((s) => s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!)
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<{ pm: Permit; isNew: boolean } | null>(null)
  const [extract, setExtract] = useState<Permit | null>(null)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(permits.find((x) => x.conditions.some((c) => c.status === 'open'))?.id ?? null)
  const toggle = (pm: Permit, cid: string) => {
    const c = pm.conditions.find((x) => x.id === cid)!
    const next = c.status === 'open' ? 'met' : 'open'
    mutate((d) => { const x = d.permits.find((y) => y.id === pm.id)!.conditions.find((y) => y.id === cid)!; x.status = next }, { entity: 'permit', entityId: pm.id, projectId, action: next === 'met' ? 'condition-met' : 'condition-reopened', summary: `${pm.type} ${pm.number}: condition "${c.text}" marked ${next}` })
    toast(next === 'met' ? 'Condition marked met' : 'Condition reopened')
  }
  return (
    <Panel title="Permits & conditions" subtitle="Agency permits with expiry tracking. Construction NTP is blocked while any permit is not issued." pad={false}
      actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setEdit({ isNew: true, pm: { id: uid('pmt'), projectId, agency: '', type: '', number: '', status: 'not-applied', conditions: [] } })}>Add permit</Button>}>
      {permits.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No permits recorded">Add the encroachment, discharge, air or CEQA permits this project needs.</Empty></div> : (
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Permit</th><th>Number</th><th>Status</th><th>Applied</th><th>Issued</th><th>Expires</th><th className="num">Conditions</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {permits.map((pm) => {
                const days = pm.expires ? daysBetween(asOf, pm.expires) : undefined
                const oc = pm.conditions.filter((c) => c.status === 'open')
                const isOpen = open === pm.id
                return [
                  <tr key={pm.id} className="clickable" onClick={() => setOpen(isOpen ? null : pm.id)}>
                    <td className="min-w-[200px]"><b>{pm.type}</b><div className="text-[12px] text-muted">{pm.agency}</div></td>
                    <td className="font-mono text-[12px]">{pm.number || '—'}</td>
                    <td><StatusBadge status={pm.status} />{pm.status !== 'issued' && started && <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-bad">Construction underway</div>}</td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{fmtDate(pm.applied)}</td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{fmtDate(pm.issued)}</td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{fmtDate(pm.expires)}{days !== undefined && pm.status === 'issued' && (days < 0 ? <div><Badge tone="bad">Expired {-days}d ago</Badge></div> : days <= 60 ? <div><Badge tone="warn">{days}d left</Badge></div> : null)}</td>
                    <td className="num">{oc.length ? <Badge tone={oc.some((c) => c.due && c.due < asOf) ? 'bad' : 'info'}>{oc.length} open</Badge> : <span className="text-[12px] text-faint">{pm.conditions.length} met</span>}</td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit({ pm, isNew: false })}>Edit</Button><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen(isOpen ? null : pm.id)}>{isOpen ? 'Hide' : 'Conditions'}</Button></td>
                  </tr>,
                  isOpen && (
                    <tr key={pm.id + '-c'}>
                      <td colSpan={8} className="bg-sunken/40">
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 py-1">
                          {pm.conditions.length === 0 && <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">No conditions recorded.</p>}
                          {pm.conditions.map((c) => {
                            const late = c.status === 'open' && c.due && c.due < asOf
                            return (
                              <div key={c.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3 text-[13px]">
                                <Checkbox checked={c.status === 'met'} onChange={() => toggle(pm, c.id)} label={<span className={cx(c.status === 'met' && 'text-muted line-through')}>{c.text}</span>} />
                                <span className={cx('ml-auto whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]', late ? 'font-semibold text-bad' : 'text-muted')}>{c.due ? `Due ${fmtDate(c.due)}${late ? ' · past due' : ''}` : 'No due date'}</span>
                              </div>
                            )
                          })}
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1">
                            <AddCondition pm={pm} projectId={projectId} />
                            {aiOn && <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setExtract(pm)}><AiTag>AI</AiTag> Extract conditions from permit text</Button>}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ),
                ]
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
      <PermitDrawer edit={edit} onClose={() => setEdit(null)} projectCode={p.code} />
      <ExtractDrawer permit={extract} onClose={() => setExtract(null)} projectName={p.name} asOf={asOf} />
    </Panel>
  )
}

function AddCondition({ pm, projectId }: { pm: Permit; projectId: string }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [due, setDue] = useState('')
  const add = () => {
    if (!text.trim()) return
    mutate((d) => { d.permits.find((x) => x.id === pm.id)!.conditions.push({ id: uid('pc'), text: text.trim(), due: due || undefined, status: 'open' }) }, { entity: 'permit', entityId: pm.id, projectId, action: 'condition-added', summary: `${pm.type} ${pm.number}: added condition "${text.trim()}"${due ? ` due ${due}` : ''}` })
    setText(''); setDue(''); toast('Condition added')
  }
  return (
    <form className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-wrap gap-2" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); add() }}>
      <Input className="h-7 min-w-[220px] flex-1 py-0.5" placeholder="New condition" value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} />
      <Input className="h-7 w-[150px] py-0.5" type="date" value={due} onChange={(e) => setDue(e.target.value)} aria-label="Due date" />
      <Button size="sm" type="submit" disabled={!text.trim()}>Add condition</Button>
    </form>
  )
}

function PermitDrawer({ edit, onClose, projectCode }: { edit: { pm: Permit; isNew: boolean } | null; onClose: () => void; projectCode: string }) {
  const [pm, setPm] = useDraft<Permit | null>(edit?.pm ?? null)
  if (!edit || !pm) return null
  const save = () => {
    if (!pm.type.trim() || !pm.agency.trim()) { toast('Agency and permit type are required', 'bad'); return }
    const prev = edit.pm
    const fix: Permit = { ...pm, issued: pm.status === 'issued' ? pm.issued ?? useStore.getState().settings.asOf : pm.issued, applied: pm.status !== 'not-applied' ? pm.applied ?? useStore.getState().settings.asOf : pm.applied }
    mutate((d) => { const i = d.permits.findIndex((x) => x.id === pm.id); if (i >= 0) d.permits[i] = fix; else d.permits.push(fix) },
      { entity: 'permit', entityId: pm.id, projectId: pm.projectId, action: edit.isNew ? 'create' : prev.status !== pm.status ? `status-${pm.status}` : 'update', summary: edit.isNew ? `${projectCode}: added ${pm.type} (${pm.agency})` : `${projectCode}: ${pm.type} ${pm.number}${prev.status !== pm.status ? ` ${prev.status} → ${pm.status}` : ' updated'}${prev.expires !== pm.expires ? `, expires ${pm.expires}` : ''}` })
    toast(edit.isNew ? 'Permit added' : 'Permit saved'); onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} title={edit.isNew ? 'Add permit' : `${pm.type}`} footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save permit</Button></>}>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Field label="Agency"><Input value={pm.agency} onChange={(e) => setPm({ ...pm, agency: e.target.value })} placeholder="City of …" /></Field>
        <Field label="Permit type"><Input value={pm.type} onChange={(e) => setPm({ ...pm, type: e.target.value })} placeholder="Encroachment permit" /></Field>
        <Field label="Permit number"><Input className="font-mono" value={pm.number} onChange={(e) => setPm({ ...pm, number: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Status"><Select value={pm.status} onChange={(e) => setPm({ ...pm, status: e.target.value as Permit['status'] })} options={[{ value: 'not-applied', label: 'Not applied' }, { value: 'applied', label: 'Applied' }, { value: 'issued', label: 'Issued' }, { value: 'expired', label: 'Expired' }]} /></Field>
        <Field label="Applied"><Input type="date" value={pm.applied ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setPm({ ...pm, applied: e.target.value || undefined })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Issued"><Input type="date" value={pm.issued ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setPm({ ...pm, issued: e.target.value || undefined })} /></Field>
        <Field label="Expires"><Input type="date" value={pm.expires ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setPm({ ...pm, expires: e.target.value || undefined })} /></Field>
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

interface Extracted { text: string; due?: string; dueBasis?: string; accept: boolean }

function ExtractDrawer({ permit, onClose, projectName, asOf }: { permit: Permit | null; onClose: () => void; projectName: string; asOf: string }) {
  const ai = useAiAvailable()
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Extracted[]>([])
  const [err, setErr] = useState('')
  if (!permit) return null
  const sample = `CONDITIONS OF APPROVAL — ${permit.type.toUpperCase()} ${permit.number}\n1. Permittee shall notify the City Inspector at least 48 hours prior to commencing work.\n2. No lane closures on arterial streets between 7:00–9:00 AM or 4:00–6:00 PM.\n3. Submit a traffic control plan stamped by a registered engineer no later than 10 working days before start.\n4. All trenches in the roadway shall be plated or backfilled at the end of each work day.\n5. Final paving shall be completed within 30 days of trench backfill and shall extend curb to lane line.\n6. Provide written notice to all fronting residents and businesses 72 hours before work.`
  const run = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setErr(''); setItems([])
    try {
      const prompt = `You extract compliance conditions from a permit issued to a gas utility for a capital project.
Project: ${projectName}. Permit: ${permit.type} ${permit.number} from ${permit.agency}. Today is ${asOf}.
Return JSON exactly: {"conditions":[{"text":"<one obligation, imperative, under 140 chars>","due":"YYYY-MM-DD or null","dueBasis":"<short phrase if the deadline is relative, e.g. '48 h before start', else null>"}]}
Rules: one entry per distinct obligation the utility or its contractor must meet; skip boilerplate definitions and agency obligations; use a calendar date only if the text states one; do not invent conditions.
Already tracked (do not repeat): ${JSON.stringify(permit.conditions.map((c) => c.text))}
PERMIT TEXT:
"""${text.slice(0, 12000)}"""`
      const r = await askJSON<{ conditions: { text: string; due?: string | null; dueBasis?: string | null }[] }>(prompt)
      const list = (r?.conditions ?? []).filter((c) => c && typeof c.text === 'string' && c.text.trim())
      setItems(list.map((c) => ({ text: c.text.trim(), due: c.due && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(c.due) ? c.due : undefined, dueBasis: c.dueBasis ?? undefined, accept: true })))
      if (!list.length) setErr('No conditions found in that text.')
    } catch (e) { setErr(aiMessage(e)) } finally { setBusy(false) }
  }
  const accept = () => {
    const chosen = items.filter((x) => x.accept && x.text.trim())
    mutate((d) => { const pm = d.permits.find((x) => x.id === permit.id)!; for (const c of chosen) pm.conditions.push({ id: uid('pc'), text: c.text, due: c.due, status: 'open' }) },
      { entity: 'permit', entityId: permit.id, projectId: permit.projectId, action: 'conditions-accepted', summary: `${permit.type} ${permit.number}: accepted ${chosen.length} AI-extracted condition${chosen.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} after review` })
    toast(`${chosen.length} condition${chosen.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} added`); setItems([]); setText(''); onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} width={640} title={<span className="flex items-center gap-2">Extract permit conditions <AiTag>AI assist</AiTag></span>}
      footer={items.length ? <><Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setItems([])}>Discard</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={!items.some((x) => x.accept)} onClick={accept}>Accept {items.filter((x) => x.accept).length} condition{items.filter((x) => x.accept).length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</Button></> : undefined}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Paste the conditions-of-approval section of <b className="text-ink">{permit.type} {permit.number}</b>. AI assist drafts a list of obligations; you review each one before it is added to the tracker.</p>
        <TextArea rows={9} value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} placeholder="Paste permit text…" />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button variant="primary" disabled={!text.trim() || busy || ai === false} onClick={run}>{busy ? 'Thinking…' : 'Extract conditions'}</Button>
          {!text && <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setText(sample)}>Use sample permit text</Button>}
        </div>
        {err && <Callout tone="bad">{err}</Callout>}
        {items.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-md border border-info/40 bg-info/5 p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><AiTag /> <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold">{items.length} conditions found — review before accepting</span></div>
            {items.map((c, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr_150px] items-start gap-2">
                <input type="checkbox" className="mt-2 h-4 w-4" checked={c.accept} onChange={(e) => setItems(items.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, accept: e.target.checked } : x)))} aria-label="Accept" />
                <div><Input className="h-8" value={c.text} onChange={(e) => setItems(items.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, text: e.target.value } : x)))} />{c.dueBasis && <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted">Deadline: {c.dueBasis}</div>}</div>
                <Input className="h-8" type="date" value={c.due ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setItems(items.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, due: e.target.value || undefined } : x)))} aria-label="Due" />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Land rights
function LandPanel({ projectId, land, asOf, cStart }: { projectId: string; land: LandRight[]; asOf: string; cStart?: string }) {
  const code = useStore((s) => s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!.code)
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<{ lr: LandRight; isNew: boolean } | null>(null)
  const flag = (l: LandRight) => {
    if (l.status === 'acquired') return null
    if (l.needBy < asOf) return <Badge tone="bad">Need-by passed</Badge>
    if (cStart && l.needBy > cStart) return <Badge tone="bad">After construction start</Badge>
    if (daysBetween(asOf, l.needBy) <= 45) return <Badge tone="warn">{daysBetween(asOf, l.needBy)}d to need-by</Badge>
    return null
  }
  return (
    <Panel title="Land rights" subtitle={cStart ? `Need-by dates are checked against construction start ${fmtDate(cStart)}` : 'Parcels, rights and acquisition status'} pad={false}
      actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setEdit({ isNew: true, lr: { id: uid('lr'), projectId, parcel: '', owner: '', type: 'Temporary right of entry', status: 'identified', needBy: cStart ? addDays(cStart, -30) : asOf, cost: 0 } })}>Add parcel</Button>}>
      {land.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No land rights">This project has no parcels recorded.</Empty></div> : (
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Parcel</th><th>Owner</th><th>Right</th><th>Status</th><th>Need by</th><th>Schedule check</th><th className="num">Cost</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {land.map((l) => (
                <tr key={l.id} className="clickable" onClick={() => setEdit({ lr: l, isNew: false })}>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[12px]">{l.parcel}</td>
                  <td>{l.owner}</td>
                  <td className="text-[12px]">{l.type}</td>
                  <td><StatusBadge status={l.status} /></td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{fmtDate(l.needBy)}</td>
                  <td>{flag(l) ?? <span className="text-[12px] text-faint">{l.status === 'acquired' ? 'Secured' : 'On track'}</span>}</td>
                  <td className="num">{money(l.cost)}</td>
                  <td><Button size="sm" variant="ghost">Edit</Button></td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              <tr><td colSpan={6} className="text-right text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">Total land cost</td><td className="num font-semibold">{money(sum(land.map((l) => l.cost)))}</td><td /></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
      {(() => {
        const [lr, setLr] = [edit?.lr, (v: LandRight) => setEdit(edit ? { ...edit, lr: v } : null)]
        if (!edit || !lr) return null
        const save = () => {
          if (!lr.parcel.trim()) { toast('Parcel is required', 'bad'); return }
          mutate((d) => { const i = d.landRights.findIndex((x) => x.id === lr.id); if (i >= 0) d.landRights[i] = lr; else d.landRights.push(lr) },
            { entity: 'land-right', entityId: lr.id, projectId, action: edit.isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: `${code}: ${edit.isNew ? 'added' : 'updated'} ${lr.type.toLowerCase()} on ${lr.parcel} (${lr.status}, need by ${lr.needBy})` })
          toast(edit.isNew ? 'Parcel added' : 'Land right saved'); setEdit(null)
        }
        return (
          <Drawer open onClose={() => setEdit(null)} title={edit.isNew ? 'Add parcel' : lr.parcel} footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit(null)}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save</Button></>}>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="Parcel (APN)"><Input className="font-mono" value={lr.parcel} onChange={(e) => setLr({ ...lr, parcel: e.target.value })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Owner"><Input value={lr.owner} onChange={(e) => setLr({ ...lr, owner: e.target.value })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Right"><Select value={lr.type} onChange={(e) => setLr({ ...lr, type: e.target.value as LandRight['type'] })} options={['Temporary right of entry', 'Permanent easement', 'Fee purchase', 'License']} /></Field>
              <Field label="Status"><Select value={lr.status} onChange={(e) => setLr({ ...lr, status: e.target.value as LandRight['status'] })} options={['identified', 'negotiating', 'acquired']} /></Field>
              <Field label="Need by" hint={cStart ? `Construction start ${fmtDate(cStart)}` : undefined}><Input type="date" value={lr.needBy} onChange={(e) => setLr({ ...lr, needBy: e.target.value })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Cost"><MoneyInput value={lr.cost} onChange={(v) => setLr({ ...lr, cost: v })} /></Field>
            </div>
          </Drawer>
        )
      })()}
    </Panel>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Contracts
function ContractsPanel({ projectId, contracts, canAward }: { projectId: string; contracts: Contract[]; canAward: boolean }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<{ c: Contract; isNew: boolean } | null>(null)
  const [award, setAward] = useState<Contract | null>(null)
  const [show, setShow] = useState<string | null>(contracts.find((c) => c.workflowInstanceId && s.workflows.find((w) => w.id === c.workflowInstanceId)?.status === 'running')?.id ?? null)
  const running = (c: Contract) => c.workflowInstanceId && s.workflows.find((w) => w.id === c.workflowInstanceId)?.status === 'running'
  return (
    <Panel title="Contracts" subtitle={canAward ? 'Awards route through supply, legal (if non-standard) and the approver with dollar authority' : 'Contract award unlocks when the authorization gate is passed (or an early-start waiver is approved)'} pad={false}
      actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setEdit({ isNew: true, c: { id: uid('ctr'), projectId, number: '', vendor: '', type: 'Construction', value: 0, changeOrders: 0, invoiced: 0, status: 'rfp' } })}>Add contract</Button>}>
      {contracts.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No contracts yet">Contracts appear once engineering or construction is sourced.</Empty></div> : (
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Contract</th><th>Vendor</th><th>Type</th><th>Status</th><th className="num">Value</th><th className="num">Change orders</th><th className="num">Invoiced</th><th style={{ width: 130 }}>Billed</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {contracts.map((c) => {
                const total = c.value + c.changeOrders
                const billed = total ? c.invoiced / total : 0
                return [
                  <tr key={c.id}>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold">{c.number || 'Pending'}{c.awarded && <div className="font-sans text-[11px] font-normal text-faint">Awarded {fmtDate(c.awarded)}</div>}</td>
                    <td>{c.vendor || <span className="text-faint">TBD</span>}</td>
                    <td className="text-[12px]">{c.type}</td>
                    <td><StatusBadge status={running(c) ? 'in-review' : c.status} label={running(c) ? 'Award in review' : c.status === 'rfp' ? 'RFP' : undefined} /></td>
                    <td className="num">{money(c.value)}</td>
                    <td className="num">{c.changeOrders ? <span className={c.changeOrders / Math.max(1, c.value) > 0.1 ? 'text-bad' : ''}>{money(c.changeOrders)}<div className="text-[11px] text-faint">{((c.changeOrders / Math.max(1, c.value)) * 100).toFixed(1)}%</div></span> : '—'}</td>
                    <td className="num">{money(c.invoiced)}</td>
                    <td><div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-sunken"><div className={cx('h-1.5 rounded-full', billed > 1 ? 'bg-bad' : 'bg-ink')} style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, billed * 100)}%` }} /></div><div className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-faint">{(billed * 100).toFixed(0)}%</div></td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap">
                      {c.status === 'rfp' && !running(c) && <Button size="sm" variant={canAward ? 'marker' : 'secondary'} disabled={!canAward} title={canAward ? undefined : 'Pass the authorization gate first'} onClick={() => setAward(c)}>Start award</Button>}
                      {c.workflowInstanceId && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setShow(show === c.id ? null : c.id)}>{show === c.id ? 'Hide' : 'Workflow'}</Button>}
                      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit({ c, isNew: false })}>Edit</Button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>,
                  show === c.id && c.workflowInstanceId && <tr key={c.id + '-wf'}><td colSpan={9} className="bg-sunken/40"><WorkflowStatus instanceId={c.workflowInstanceId} /></td></tr>,
                ]
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
      <ContractDrawer edit={edit} onClose={() => setEdit(null)} code={p.code} />
      <AwardModal c={award} onClose={() => setAward(null)} onStarted={(id) => setShow(id)} code={p.code} />
    </Panel>
  )
}

function ContractDrawer({ edit, onClose, code }: { edit: { c: Contract; isNew: boolean } | null; onClose: () => void; code: string }) {
  const [c, setC] = useDraft<Contract | null>(edit?.c ?? null)
  if (!edit || !c) return null
  const locked = !edit.isNew && edit.c.status !== 'rfp'
  const save = () => {
    if (!c.vendor.trim() && c.status !== 'rfp') { toast('Vendor is required once awarded', 'bad'); return }
    const prev = edit.c
    const parts: string[] = []
    if (prev.changeOrders !== c.changeOrders) parts.push(`change orders ${money(prev.changeOrders)} → ${money(c.changeOrders)}`)
    if (prev.invoiced !== c.invoiced) parts.push(`invoiced ${money(prev.invoiced)} → ${money(c.invoiced)}`)
    if (prev.status !== c.status) parts.push(`status ${prev.status} → ${c.status}`)
    if (prev.value !== c.value) parts.push(`value ${money(prev.value)} → ${money(c.value)}`)
    mutate((d) => { const i = d.contracts.findIndex((x) => x.id === c.id); if (i >= 0) d.contracts[i] = c; else d.contracts.push(c) },
      { entity: 'contract', entityId: c.id, projectId: c.projectId, action: edit.isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: edit.isNew ? `${code}: added ${c.type.toLowerCase()} contract ${c.number || '(RFP)'} ${c.vendor}` : `${code}: contract ${c.number} ${parts.join(', ') || 'updated'}` })
    toast(edit.isNew ? 'Contract added' : 'Contract saved'); onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} title={edit.isNew ? 'Add contract' : `Contract ${c.number || '(RFP)'}`} footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save contract</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Contract number"><Input className="font-mono" value={c.number} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, number: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Vendor"><Input value={c.vendor} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, vendor: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Type"><Select value={c.type} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, type: e.target.value as Contract['type'] })} options={['Construction', 'Engineering', 'Materials', 'Inspection', 'Environmental']} /></Field>
          <Field label="Status" hint={edit.c.status === 'rfp' ? 'Use "Start award" to move an RFP to awarded' : undefined}><Select value={c.status} disabled={edit.c.status === 'rfp' && !edit.isNew} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, status: e.target.value as Contract['status'] })} options={[{ value: 'rfp', label: 'RFP' }, { value: 'awarded', label: 'Awarded' }, { value: 'active', label: 'Active' }, { value: 'closed', label: 'Closed' }]} /></Field>
          <Field label="Contract value" hint={locked ? 'Fixed at award; use change orders' : undefined}><MoneyInput disabled={locked} value={c.value} onChange={(v) => setC({ ...c, value: v })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Approved change orders" hint="Changes come only through RFI / change orders on the Finance tab"><div className="inp bg-sunken tabular-nums">{money(c.changeOrders)}</div></Field>
          <Field label="Invoiced to date"><MoneyInput value={c.invoiced} onChange={(v) => setC({ ...c, invoiced: v })} /></Field>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

function AwardModal({ c, onClose, onStarted, code }: { c: Contract | null; onClose: () => void; onStarted: (id: string) => void; code: string }) {
  const [vendor, setVendor] = useState('')
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(0)
  const [nonStandard, setNonStandard] = useState(false)
  const [num, setNum] = useState('')
  const key = c?.id
  useEffect(() => { if (c) { setVendor(c.vendor); setAmount(c.value); setNonStandard(false); setNum(c.number) } }, [key]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  if (!c) return null
  const start = () => {
    if (!vendor.trim() || !amount) { toast('Vendor and award value are required', 'bad'); return }
    let instId = ''
    mutate((d) => {
      const x = d.contracts.find((y) => y.id === c.id)!
      x.vendor = vendor.trim(); x.value = amount; if (num) x.number = num
      const inst = startWorkflow(d, 'contract-award', { title: `${code} award ${c.type.toLowerCase()} contract to ${vendor.trim()}`, recordType: 'contract', recordId: c.id, projectId: c.projectId, data: { amount, nonStandard, vendor: vendor.trim() } })
      instId = inst?.id ?? ''
    }, { entity: 'contract', entityId: c.id, projectId: c.projectId, action: 'submit-award', summary: `${code}: submitted ${c.type.toLowerCase()} award to ${vendor.trim()} for ${money(amount)}${nonStandard ? ' (non-standard terms — legal review)' : ''}` })
    toast(instId ? 'Award submitted for approval' : 'No published contract-award workflow', instId ? 'good' : 'bad')
    onStarted(c.id); onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} title="Start contract award" footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={start}>Submit for approval</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">The PM confirms the recommendation, supply reviews, legal reviews when terms are non-standard, and the approver is chosen from the delegation-of-authority matrix by award value.</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Recommended vendor"><Input value={vendor} onChange={(e) => setVendor(e.target.value)} /></Field>
          <Field label="Contract number"><Input className="font-mono" value={num} onChange={(e) => setNum(e.target.value)} placeholder="Assigned at award" /></Field>
          <Field label="Award value"><MoneyInput value={amount} onChange={setAmount} /></Field>
        </div>
        <Checkbox checked={nonStandard} onChange={setNonStandard} label="Non-standard terms (limitation of liability, indemnity or payment terms changed) — adds legal review" />
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Long-lead materials
function LongLeadPanel({ projectId, items, asOf, cStart }: { projectId: string; items: LongLeadItem[]; asOf: string; cStart?: string }) {
  const code = useStore((s) => s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!.code)
  const [edit, setEdit] = useState<{ it: LongLeadItem; isNew: boolean } | null>(null)
  const setStatus = (it: LongLeadItem, st: LongLeadItem['status']) => {
    mutate((d) => { const x = d.longLead.find((y) => y.id === it.id)!; x.status = st; if (st === 'received' && x.eta > asOf) x.eta = asOf }, { entity: 'long-lead', entityId: it.id, projectId, action: `status-${st}`, summary: `${code}: ${it.item} marked ${st}` })
    toast(`Marked ${st}`)
  }
  return (
    <Panel title="Long-lead materials" subtitle={cStart ? `ETA vs required-on-site, and against construction start ${fmtDate(cStart)}` : 'Required-on-site vs vendor ETA'} pad={false}
      actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setEdit({ isNew: true, it: { id: uid('ll'), projectId, item: '', qty: '', vendor: '', requiredOnSite: cStart ?? asOf, eta: cStart ?? asOf, status: 'requested' } })}>Add item</Button>}>
      {items.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No long-lead items">Add pipe, valves and major equipment with their need dates.</Empty></div> : (
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Item</th><th>Qty</th><th>Vendor</th><th>Required on site</th><th>ETA</th><th className="num">Float</th><th>Status</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {items.map((it) => {
                const float = daysBetween(it.eta, it.requiredOnSite)
                const afterStart = cStart && it.eta > cStart && it.status !== 'received'
                const late = it.status !== 'received' && float < 0
                return (
                  <tr key={it.id}>
                    <td className="min-w-[180px] font-semibold">{it.item}{afterStart && <div className="text-[11px] font-normal text-bad">ETA after construction start</div>}</td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{it.qty}</td>
                    <td className="text-[12px]">{it.vendor}</td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{fmtDate(it.requiredOnSite)}</td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{fmtDate(it.eta)}</td>
                    <td className="num">{it.status === 'received' ? <span className="text-faint">—</span> : <Badge tone={late ? 'bad' : float < 14 ? 'warn' : 'good'}>{float > 0 ? '+' : ''}{float}d</Badge>}</td>
                    <td><Select className="h-7 w-[120px] py-0.5" value={it.status} onChange={(e) => setStatus(it, e.target.value as LongLeadItem['status'])} options={['requested', 'ordered', 'shipped', 'received']} /></td>
                    <td><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit({ it, isNew: false })}>Edit</Button></td>
                  </tr>
                )
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
      {edit && (() => {
        const it = edit.it
        const setIt = (v: LongLeadItem) => setEdit({ ...edit, it: v })
        const save = () => {
          if (!it.item.trim()) { toast('Item is required', 'bad'); return }
          const prev = edit.it
          mutate((d) => { const i = d.longLead.findIndex((x) => x.id === it.id); if (i >= 0) d.longLead[i] = it; else d.longLead.push(it) },
            { entity: 'long-lead', entityId: it.id, projectId, action: edit.isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: `${code}: ${edit.isNew ? 'added' : 'updated'} long-lead ${it.item} (ETA ${it.eta}, need ${it.requiredOnSite})${!edit.isNew && prev.eta !== it.eta ? ` — ETA moved from ${prev.eta}` : ''}` })
          toast(edit.isNew ? 'Item added' : 'Item saved'); setEdit(null)
        }
        return (
          <Drawer open onClose={() => setEdit(null)} title={edit.isNew ? 'Add long-lead item' : it.item} footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit(null)}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save</Button></>}>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="Item" className="sm:col-span-2"><Input value={it.item} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, item: e.target.value })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Quantity"><Input value={it.qty} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, qty: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. 12,000 ft" /></Field>
              <Field label="Vendor"><Input value={it.vendor} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, vendor: e.target.value })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Required on site"><Input type="date" value={it.requiredOnSite} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, requiredOnSite: e.target.value })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Vendor ETA"><Input type="date" value={it.eta} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, eta: e.target.value })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Status"><Select value={it.status} onChange={(e) => setIt({ ...it, status: e.target.value as LongLeadItem['status'] })} options={['requested', 'ordered', 'shipped', 'received']} /></Field>
            </div>
          </Drawer>
        )
      })()}
    </Panel>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/project/tabs/ProjectInfo.tsx =====
// Project Information record (PI-*): the controlled project data sheet. Every edit is a numbered
// revision with a reason, field-level from → to, and an audit entry; the record can be viewed as it
// stood at any revision and exported as a formal data sheet. Overview stays the summary page.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { getState, mutate, useMe, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import type { AppState, InfoFieldDef, Project } from '@/core/types'
import { infoCompleteness, missingInfo, reviseInfo } from '@/core/engine/info'
import { templateFor } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { deliverableCompleteness } from '@/core/engine/finance'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { htmlDoc, saveFile } from '@/core/download'
import { askJSON, aiMessage, useAiAvailable } from '@/core/ai'
import { cx, fmtDate, fmtDateTime } from '@/core/util'
import { AiTag, Avatar, Badge, Button, Callout, Modal, Panel, Progress, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { FieldInput } from './info/FieldInput'
import { RevisionHistory } from './info/RevisionHistory'
import { CostDrivers } from './info/CostDrivers'
import {
  changedKeys, cleanProposals, currentGateName, currentValues, displayValue, draftPrompt, gateShort, infoCsv, infoSheetHtml,
  infoText, requirement, revisionsFor, sectionsOf, valuesAsOf, type DraftProposal,
} from './info/lib'

export default function ProjectInfo({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  return <ProjectInfoInner key={projectId} projectId={projectId} />
}

const fieldAnchor = (key: string) => `pi-field-${key}`
function jumpTo(key: string) {
  const el = document.getElementById(fieldAnchor(key))
  if (!el) return
  el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' })
  el.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-marker')
  setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-marker'), 1600)
}

function ProjectInfoInner({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const me = useMe()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const tpl = templateFor(s, p)
  const revs = useMemo(() => revisionsFor(s, p.id), [s.infoRevisions, p.id])
  const current = useMemo(() => currentValues(s, p), [s, p])
  const sections = sectionsOf(s)
  const comp = infoCompleteness(s, p)
  const dc = deliverableCompleteness(s, p)
  const missing = missingInfo(s, p)
  const gate = currentGateName(s, p)
  const latest = revs[0]
  const frozen = p.status === 'closed' || p.status === 'cancelled'
  const canEdit = !frozen && (me.roles.includes('admin') || me.roles.includes('pmo') || Object.values(p.team).includes(me.id))

  const [asOfRev, setAsOfRev] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string[]>([]) // section names in edit mode
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})
  const [note, setNote] = useState('')
  const [aiKeys, setAiKeys] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [textOpen, setTextOpen] = useState(false)

  const viewing = asOfRev !== null
  const values = viewing ? valuesAsOf(current, revs, asOfRev!) : current
  const highlight = viewing ? changedKeys(revs.find((r) => r.rev === asOfRev)) : new Set<string>()
  const editable = s.settings.infoFields.filter((f) => !f.readOnly)
  const edits = Object.fromEntries(editable.filter((f) => f.key in draft && (draft[f.key] ?? '') !== (current[f.key] ?? '')).map((f) => [f.key, draft[f.key]]))
  const changedCount = Object.keys(edits).length
  const isEditing = editing.length > 0

  const startEdit = (secs: string[]) => {
    setAsOfRev(null)
    if (!isEditing) { setDraft({ ...current }); setNote(''); setAiKeys([]) }
    setEditing(Array.from(new Set([...editing, ...secs])))
  }
  const cancel = () => { setEditing([]); setDraft({}); setNote(''); setAiKeys([]) }
  const save = () => {
    if (!note.trim()) { toast('Enter a reason for the change', 'bad'); return }
    if (!changedCount) { toast('No changes to save', 'info'); return }
    let ok = false
    mutate((d) => { ok = !!reviseInfo(d, p.id, edits, note.trim()) })
    if (!ok) { toast('No changes to save', 'info'); return }
    const n = revisionsFor(getState(), p.id)[0]?.rev ?? 0
    cancel()
    toast(`Project information revised (rev ${n})`)
  }

  const exportSheet = async () => {
    const rev = asOfRev ?? latest?.rev ?? 0
    const html = htmlDoc(`${p.code} Project Information Sheet Rev ${rev}`, infoSheetHtml(s, p, { values, asOfRev: rev }))
    const r = await saveFile(`${p.code}-project-information-rev${rev}.html`, html, 'text/html')
    toast(r === 'saved' ? `Project information sheet exported (rev ${rev})` : r === 'declined' ? 'Export cancelled' : 'Downloads are not available here', r === 'saved' ? 'good' : 'info')
  }
  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const r = await saveFile(`${p.code}-project-information.csv`, infoCsv(s, p, values), 'text/csv')
    toast(r === 'saved' ? 'Project information CSV exported' : r === 'declined' ? 'Export cancelled' : 'Downloads are not available here', r === 'saved' ? 'good' : 'info')
  }
  const copyText = async () => {
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(infoText(s, p, values)); toast('Project information copied as text') }
    catch { setTextOpen(true) }
  }

  const acceptProposal = (pr: DraftProposal) => {
    const def = s.settings.infoFields.find((f) => f.key === pr.key)
    if (!def) return
    if (!isEditing) setDraft({ ...current, [pr.key]: pr.value })
    else setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, [pr.key]: pr.value }))
    setEditing((e) => Array.from(new Set([...e, def.section])))
    setAsOfRev(null)
    setAiKeys((k) => Array.from(new Set([...k, pr.key])))
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Header s={s} p={p} comp={comp} dc={dc} missing={missing} gate={gate} latest={latest} revCount={revs.length}
        canEdit={canEdit && !viewing} frozen={frozen} isEditing={isEditing}
        onEdit={() => startEdit(sections.map((x) => x.name))} onSheet={exportSheet} onCsv={exportCsv} onCopy={copyText}
        asOfRev={asOfRev} setAsOfRev={(r) => { if (!isEditing) setAsOfRev(r) }} revs={revs.map((r) => ({ rev: r.rev, at: r.at }))} />

      <LinkedRecords s={s} p={p} />

      {viewing && (
        <Callout tone="marker" title={asOfRev === 0 ? 'Viewing the record before revision 1' : `Viewing revision ${asOfRev} of ${latest?.rev ?? 0}`}>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span>{asOfRev === 0 ? 'Values as first recorded, before any tracked revision.' : `The record as it stood after rev ${asOfRev} (${fmtDateTime(revs.find((r) => r.rev === asOfRev)?.at)}). Fields changed in that revision are outlined.`} System fields show current values. Editing is paused while viewing history.</span>
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setAsOfRev(null)}>Back to current</Button>
          </div>
        </Callout>
      )}

      {canEdit && !viewing && <AiDraft s={s} p={p} current={current} onAccept={acceptProposal} draft={isEditing ? draft : current} />}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 2xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,420px)]">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
          {sections.filter((sec) => sec.fields.length).map((sec) => {
            const secEditing = editing.includes(sec.name)
            const secMissing = sec.fields.filter((f) => requirement(f, values[f.key] ?? '', p.stageIndex) === 'blocking').length
            const filled = sec.fields.filter((f) => !f.readOnly && (values[f.key] ?? '').trim()).length
            const total = sec.fields.filter((f) => !f.readOnly).length
            return (
              <Panel key={sec.name} title={sec.name}
                subtitle={<span className="tabular-nums">{filled}/{total} completed{secMissing ? <span className="ml-2 font-semibold text-bad">{secMissing} required empty</span> : null}</span>}
                actions={canEdit && !viewing && !secEditing && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => startEdit([sec.name])}>Edit section</Button>}>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-3.5 md:grid-cols-2">
                  {sec.fields.map((f) => (
                    <FieldRow key={f.key} s={s} p={p} def={f} value={values[f.key] ?? ''} tplStages={tpl.stages.length}
                      editing={secEditing && !f.readOnly} draftValue={draft[f.key] ?? ''} changed={secEditing && (draft[f.key] ?? '') !== (current[f.key] ?? '')}
                      ai={aiKeys.includes(f.key)} highlight={highlight.has(f.key)}
                      onChange={(v) => { setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, [f.key]: v })) }} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </Panel>
            )
          })}
        </div>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
          <CostDrivers p={p} canEdit={canEdit && !viewing} />
          <RevisionHistory s={s} revs={revs} asOfRev={asOfRev} onViewRev={(r) => { if (!isEditing) { setAsOfRev(r === latest?.rev ? null : r); document.getElementById('main')?.scrollTo?.({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }) } }} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {isEditing && (
        <div className="sticky bottom-0 z-20 -mx-1 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface p-3 shadow-lg">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 md:flex-row md:items-end">
            <label className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
              <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">Reason for change <span className="text-bad">*</span></span>
              <TextArea rows={1} value={note} placeholder="e.g. Updated after 60% design review" onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} />
            </label>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-[12px] text-muted tabular-nums">{changedCount} field{changedCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} changed · saves as rev {(latest?.rev ?? 0) + 1}</span>
              <Button variant="ghost" onClick={cancel}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button variant="primary" disabled={!changedCount || !note.trim()} onClick={save}>Save revision</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <Modal open={textOpen} onClose={() => setTextOpen(false)} title="Project information as text" footer={<Button onClick={() => setTextOpen(false)}>Done</Button>}>
        <p className="mb-2 text-[12px] text-muted">The clipboard is blocked in this window. Select the text below and copy it.</p>
        <TextArea readOnly rows={18} className="font-mono text-[12px]" value={infoText(s, p, values)} onFocus={(e) => e.currentTarget.select()} />
      </Modal>
    </div>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Header

function Header(props: {
  s: AppState; p: Project; comp: { filled: number; total: number; pct: number }; dc: ReturnType<typeof deliverableCompleteness>; missing: InfoFieldDef[]; gate?: string
  latest?: { rev: number; at: string; byId: string }; revCount: number; canEdit: boolean; frozen: boolean; isEditing: boolean
  onEdit: () => void; onSheet: () => void; onCsv: () => void; onCopy: () => void
  asOfRev: number | null; setAsOfRev: (r: number | null) => void; revs: { rev: number; at: string }[]
}) {
  const { s, p, comp, dc, missing, gate, latest } = props
  const who = latest ? s.people.find((x) => x.id === latest.byId)?.name ?? latest.byId : ''
  const cur = dc.current
  const tone = cur.pct >= 90 ? 'good' : cur.pct >= 60 ? 'ink' : 'warn'
  return (
    <Panel pad={false}>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 p-4 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.3fr)_auto]">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="eyebrow" title="Accepted or waived deliverables on the stage-gate checklist for the current stage">Deliverable completeness · {gateShort(cur.gate) || cur.gate} checklist</div>
          <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-2">
            <span className="font-display text-[26px] font-bold leading-none tabular-nums">{cur.pct}%</span>
            <span className="text-[12px] text-muted tabular-nums">{cur.done} of {cur.total} deliverables accepted{cur.submitted ? ` · ${cur.submitted} in review` : ''}</span>
          </div>
          <Progress className="mt-2" value={cur.pct} tone={tone} />
          <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-muted tabular-nums">
            <a href={projectHref(p.id, 'lifecycle')} className="hover:text-link">Lifecycle to date {dc.toDate.done}/{dc.toDate.total} ({dc.toDate.pct}%)</a>
            <span title="Project information fields with a value (secondary measure)">Field completeness {comp.pct}% · {comp.filled}/{comp.total}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1.5 text-[12px] text-muted">
            {latest ? <span className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">Rev {latest.rev} · last revised by <Avatar name={who} size={16} /><b className="text-ink">{who}</b> {fmtDateTime(latest.at)}</span> : 'No revisions recorded yet'}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="eyebrow">Required for {templateFor(s, p).stages[p.stageIndex]?.name ?? 'current stage'}</div>
          {props.frozen ? (
            <div className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-muted">Project is {p.status}; the record is frozen as of rev {latest?.rev ?? 0}.</div>
          ) : missing.length ? (
            <>
              <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-bad">
                <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-bad" />
                {missing.length} required field{missing.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} empty — blocks {gateShort(gate)}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                {missing.map((f) => (
                  <button key={f.key} type="button" onClick={() => jumpTo(f.key)} className="rounded border border-bad/40 bg-bad/5 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-bad hover:bg-bad/10">{f.label}</button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-good"><Icon name="check" className="h-4 w-4" />All fields required through this stage are complete{gate ? ` — ready for ${gateShort(gate)}` : ''}</div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 lg:items-end">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 lg:justify-end">
            {props.canEdit && !props.isEditing && <Button variant="primary" onClick={props.onEdit}>Edit</Button>}
            <Button icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-4 w-4" />} onClick={props.onSheet}>Export sheet</Button>
            <Button onClick={props.onCsv}>Export CSV</Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={props.onCopy}>Copy as text</Button>
          </div>
          {props.revs.length > 0 && (
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] text-muted">
              View as of
              <Select aria-label="View as of revision" className="h-8 w-48 py-1 text-[12px]" disabled={props.isEditing} value={props.asOfRev === null ? '' : String(props.asOfRev)}
                onChange={(e) => props.setAsOfRev(e.target.value === '' ? null : Number(e.target.value))}
                options={[{ value: '', label: `Current (rev ${latest?.rev ?? 0})` }, ...props.revs.slice(1).map((r) => ({ value: String(r.rev), label: `Rev ${r.rev} · ${fmtDate(r.at.slice(0, 10))}` })), { value: '0', label: 'Before rev 1' }]} />
            </label>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Linked records

function LinkedRecords({ s, p }: { s: AppState; p: Project }) {
  const permits = s.permits.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id)
  const land = s.landRights.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id)
  const contracts = s.contracts.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id)
  const docs = s.documents.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id)
  const decisions = s.decisions.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id)
  const items: { label: string; value: string; sub: string; href: string }[] = [
    { label: 'Permits', value: String(permits.length), sub: `${permits.filter((x) => x.status === 'issued').length} issued`, href: projectHref(p.id, 'permits') },
    { label: 'Land rights', value: String(land.length), sub: `${land.filter((x) => x.status === 'acquired').length} acquired`, href: projectHref(p.id, 'permits') },
    { label: 'Contracts', value: String(contracts.length), sub: `${contracts.filter((x) => x.status === 'awarded' || x.status === 'active').length} awarded / active`, href: projectHref(p.id, 'permits') },
    { label: 'Documents', value: String(docs.length), sub: docs.length ? `latest ${fmtDate(docs.map((d) => d.updated).sort().pop())}` : 'none filed', href: projectHref(p.id, 'overview') },
    { label: 'Decisions', value: String(decisions.length), sub: decisions.length ? `latest ${fmtDate(decisions.map((d) => d.date).sort().pop())}` : 'none logged', href: projectHref(p.id, 'overview') },
  ]
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Linked records" className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-px overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-line bg-line sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5">
      {items.map((x) => (
        <a key={x.label} href={x.href} className="group flex min-w-0 items-baseline gap-2 bg-surface px-3 py-2 hover:bg-sunken">
          <span className="font-display text-[18px] font-bold tabular-nums">{x.value}</span>
          <span className="min-w-0">
            <span className="block truncate text-[12px] font-semibold group-hover:text-link">{x.label}</span>
            <span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-muted">{x.sub}</span>
          </span>
        </a>
      ))}
    </nav>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── One field

function FieldRow({ s, p, def, value, editing, draftValue, changed, ai, highlight, onChange, tplStages }: {
  s: AppState; p: Project; def: InfoFieldDef; value: string; editing: boolean; draftValue: string; changed: boolean; ai: boolean; highlight: boolean
  onChange: (v: string) => void; tplStages: number
}) {
  const v = editing ? draftValue : value
  const req = requirement(def, v, p.stageIndex)
  const stageName = def.requiredAtStage !== undefined ? templateFor(s, p).stages[def.requiredAtStage]?.name : undefined
  const reqLabel = def.requiredAtStage !== undefined && def.requiredAtStage < tplStages ? `Required at stage ${def.requiredAtStage + 1}` : undefined
  const shown = displayValue(def, value)
  const id = `pi-input-${def.key}`
  return (
    <div id={fieldAnchor(def.key)} className={cx('min-w-0 rounded transition-shadow', def.type === 'textarea' && 'md:col-span-2', highlight && 'outline outline-2 outline-offset-4 outline-marker/70', changed && 'border-l-2 border-link pl-2')}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-1.5 gap-y-0.5">
        <label htmlFor={editing ? id : undefined} className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted" title={!editing ? def.help : undefined}>
          {def.label}{def.help && !editing && <span className="ml-0.5 cursor-help text-faint">ⓘ</span>}
        </label>
        <SourceMark def={def} />
        {reqLabel && req === 'blocking' && <span className="text-[10.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-bad" title={stageName}>{reqLabel}</span>}
        {reqLabel && req === 'later' && <span className="text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-faint" title={stageName}>{reqLabel}</span>}
        {ai && <AiTag>AI proposed</AiTag>}
      </div>
      {editing && def.help && <div className="mb-1 text-[11px] text-faint">{def.help}</div>}
      {editing ? (
        <div className="mt-1"><FieldInput def={def} id={id} value={draftValue} onChange={onChange} /></div>
      ) : (
        <div className={cx('mt-0.5 min-w-0 break-words text-[13.5px]', def.type === 'textarea' && 'whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed')}>
          {shown ? (def.key === 'erpWbs' || def.key === 'scheduleId' || def.key === 'lineId' || def.key === 'workOrder' ? <span className="font-mono text-[12.5px]">{shown}</span> : shown)
            : <span className={cx('italic', req === 'blocking' ? 'text-bad/80' : 'text-faint')}>Not provided</span>}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function SourceMark({ def }: { def: InfoFieldDef }) {
  if (def.readOnly) return <span title="Computed from program and team assignments; change it there" className="rounded-sm border border-line px-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-faint">System</span>
  if (def.bind) return <span title={`Bound to project data (${def.bind}); also used by Overview, gate conditions and reports`} className="rounded-sm border border-info/40 px-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-info">Project data</span>
  return null
}

// ───────────────────────────── AI assist

function AiDraft({ s, p, current, draft, onAccept }: { s: AppState; p: Project; current: Record<string, string>; draft: Record<string, string>; onAccept: (pr: DraftProposal) => void }) {
  const ai = useAiAvailable()
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [err, setErr] = useState('')
  const [props, setProps] = useState<DraftProposal[] | null>(null)
  const [done, setDone] = useState<Record<string, 'accepted' | 'rejected'>>({})
  const empty = s.settings.infoFields.filter((f) => !f.readOnly && !(current[f.key] ?? '').trim() && !(draft[f.key] ?? '').trim())
  if (ai === false) return null
  const run = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setErr(''); setProps(null); setDone({})
    try {
      const raw = await askJSON<unknown>(draftPrompt(s, p, empty))
      setProps(cleanProposals(raw, empty))
    } catch (e) { setErr(aiMessage(e)) } finally { setBusy(false) }
  }
  const label = (k: string) => s.settings.infoFields.find((f) => f.key === k)
  const open = (props ?? []).filter((x) => !done[x.key])
  if (!empty.length && !props) return null
  return (
    <Panel title={<span className="flex items-center gap-2">Draft missing fields <AiTag>AI assist</AiTag></span>}
      subtitle={`${empty.length} empty field${empty.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}. Proposals use only this project's scope, asset, location, risks and permits; nothing is saved until you accept it and save a revision with a reason.`}
      actions={<>
        {props && open.length > 1 && <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { open.forEach(onAccept); setDone((d) => ({ ...d, ...Object.fromEntries(open.map((x) => [x.key, 'accepted' as const])) })) }}>Accept all</Button>}
        <Button size="sm" disabled={busy || !empty.length} onClick={run}>{busy ? 'Thinking…' : props ? 'Draft again' : 'Draft missing fields'}</Button>
      </>}
      pad={!!(props || err)}>
      {err && <div className="text-[13px] text-bad">{err}</div>}
      {props && !props.length && <div className="text-[13px] text-muted">The project facts do not support a confident value for any empty field.</div>}
      {props && props.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-line">
          {props.map((pr) => {
            const def = label(pr.key)
            const st = done[pr.key]
            return (
              <li key={pr.key} className={cx('flex flex-col gap-1 py-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:gap-3', st && 'opacity-60')}>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">{def?.label}<span className="font-normal text-faint">· {def?.section}</span></div>
                  <div className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-[13px]">{def ? displayValue(def, pr.value) : pr.value}</div>
                  {pr.basis && <div className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">Basis: {pr.basis}</div>}
                </div>
                <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1">
                  {st ? <Badge tone={st === 'accepted' ? 'good' : 'neutral'}>{st === 'accepted' ? 'Added to edit form' : 'Rejected'}</Badge> : <>
                    <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { onAccept(pr); setDone((d) => ({ ...d, [pr.key]: 'accepted' })) }}>Accept</Button>
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setDone((d) => ({ ...d, [pr.key]: 'rejected' }))}>Reject</Button>
                  </>}
                </div>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </Panel>
  )
}

// Records completeness (RR-01), closeout checklist + workflow (CO-01), as-built / GIS handoff,
// unitization summary and lessons learned.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, CloseoutItem, Project, RecordItem, RoleId, WorkMethod } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, personName, useMe, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { activeBudget, position } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { ownerForRole, templateFor } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { startWorkflow } from '@/core/engine/workflow'
import { saveFile, toCSV } from '@/core/download'
import { cx, fmtDate, money, num, pct, sum, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, ConfirmButton, Drawer, Empty, Field, Input, KV, Mono, Panel, Progress, Select, StatusBadge, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { WorkflowStatus } from '../../shared/WorkflowStatus'
import { FileButton, MultiCheck, RoleSelect, WORK_METHODS, humanizeId, inServiceDate, roleName } from '../../admin/common'

type RType = RecordItem['type']
const ALL_TYPES: RType[] = ['Weld log', 'NDE report', 'Pressure test chart', 'Material test report', 'As-built drawing', 'Coating inspection', 'MAOP validation']
const STD_CLOSEOUT: [string, RoleId][] = [['In-service date recorded', 'pm'], ['As-builts submitted to GIS', 'engineer'], ['Unitization data to plant accounting', 'project-controls'], ['Open POs and accruals cleared', 'project-controls'], ['Final cost reconciled to ERP', 'finance'], ['Lessons learned captured', 'pm'], ['Records verified complete', 'records'], ['Reasonableness package frozen', 'pmo']]

function defaultMatrix(p: Project): { types: RType[]; segs: string[] } {
  const types: RType[] = p.workMethod === 'hydrotest' ? ['Pressure test chart', 'MAOP validation', 'As-built drawing', 'Weld log'] : p.asset.type === 'valve-site' ? ['Weld log', 'NDE report', 'As-built drawing'] : ['Weld log', 'NDE report', 'Pressure test chart', 'Material test report', 'As-built drawing', 'Coating inspection']
  const segs = p.asset.type === 'compressor-station' ? ['Station piping', 'Unit 1', 'Unit 2'] : p.asset.type === 'valve-site' ? ['Site 1'] : ['Segment A', 'Segment B', 'Segment C']
  return { types, segs }
}

export function recordsCompleteness(s: Pick<AppState, 'records'>, pid: string) {
  const recs = s.records.filter((r) => r.projectId === pid)
  const verified = recs.filter((r) => r.status === 'verified').length
  const attached = recs.filter((r) => r.status === 'attached').length
  const missing = recs.filter((r) => r.status === 'missing').length
  return { recs, total: recs.length, verified, attached, missing, pct: recs.length ? verified / recs.length : 0 }
}

export default function Records({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const rc = recordsCompleteness(s, projectId)
  const items = s.closeout.filter((x) => x.projectId === projectId)
  const coDone = items.filter((x) => x.status !== 'open').length
  const wf = s.workflows.filter((w) => w.projectId === projectId && w.defKey === 'closeout').sort((a, b) => a.startedAt.localeCompare(b.startedAt)).pop()
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <Tile label="Records verified" value={rc.total ? pct(rc.pct) : '—'} tone={!rc.total ? undefined : rc.pct === 1 ? 'good' : rc.missing ? 'bad' : 'warn'} sub={rc.total ? `${rc.verified} verified · ${rc.attached} awaiting verification · ${rc.missing} missing` : 'No records matrix yet'} bar={rc.total ? rc.pct * 100 : undefined} />
        <Tile label="Closeout checklist" value={items.length ? `${coDone}/${items.length}` : '—'} tone={items.length && coDone === items.length ? 'good' : undefined} sub={items.length ? `${items.length - coDone} open item${items.length - coDone === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : 'Not started'} bar={items.length ? (coDone / items.length) * 100 : undefined} />
        <Tile label="Closeout workflow" value={wf ? <StatusBadge status={wf.status} /> : 'Not started'} sub={wf ? `Started ${fmtDate(wf.startedAt.slice(0, 10))}` : 'Starts when records and checklist are complete'} />
        <Tile label="In service" value={fmtDate(p.dates.inService ?? inServiceDate(p))} sub={p.dates.inService ? 'Recorded' : 'Forecast'} />
      </div>
      <RecordsMatrix p={p} />
      <Closeout p={p} items={items} rc={rc} wfId={wf?.id} wfStatus={wf?.status} />
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <Handoff p={p} />
        <Unitization p={p} />
      </div>
      <Lessons p={p} />
    </div>
  )
}

function Tile({ label, value, sub, tone, bar }: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode; sub?: string; tone?: 'good' | 'warn' | 'bad'; bar?: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-3">
      <div className="eyebrow truncate">{label}</div>
      <div className={cx('mt-1 font-display text-[22px] font-bold leading-none tabular-nums', tone === 'good' ? 'text-good' : tone === 'warn' ? 'text-warn' : tone === 'bad' ? 'text-bad' : 'text-ink')}>{value}</div>
      {bar !== undefined && <Progress className="mt-2" value={bar} tone={tone === 'good' ? 'good' : tone === 'bad' ? 'bad' : 'ink'} />}
      {sub && <div className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-muted">{sub}</div>}
    </div>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Records matrix
function RecordsMatrix({ p }: { p: Project }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const me = useMe()
  const setUser = useStore((x) => x.setUser)
  const recs = s.records.filter((r) => r.projectId === p.id)
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [newSeg, setNewSeg] = useState('')
  const [newType, setNewType] = useState<RType | ''>('')
  const segs = Array.from(new Set(recs.map((r) => r.segment)))
  const types = ALL_TYPES.filter((t) => recs.some((r) => r.type === t))
  const canVerify = me.roles.includes('records')
  const cell = (seg: string, t: RType) => recs.find((r) => r.segment === seg && r.type === t)
  const consIdx = templateFor(s, p).stages.findIndex((x) => /construct/i.test(x.name))

  const setup = () => {
    const m = defaultMatrix(p)
    mutate((d) => { for (const seg of m.segs) for (const t of m.types) d.records.push({ id: uid('rec'), projectId: p.id, type: t, segment: seg, status: 'missing' }) },
      { entity: 'records', entityId: p.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'create', summary: `${p.code}: set up records matrix (${m.segs.length} segments × ${m.types.length} record types)` })
    toast('Records matrix created')
  }
  const addSegment = () => {
    const seg = newSeg.trim()
    if (!seg || segs.includes(seg)) return
    const ts = types.length ? types : defaultMatrix(p).types
    mutate((d) => { for (const t of ts) d.records.push({ id: uid('rec'), projectId: p.id, type: t, segment: seg, status: 'missing' }) }, { entity: 'records', entityId: p.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'add-segment', summary: `${p.code}: added segment "${seg}" to records matrix` })
    setNewSeg(''); toast('Segment added')
  }
  const addType = () => {
    if (!newType) return
    mutate((d) => { for (const seg of segs) d.records.push({ id: uid('rec'), projectId: p.id, type: newType, segment: seg, status: 'missing' }) }, { entity: 'records', entityId: p.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'add-type', summary: `${p.code}: required ${newType} for all segments` })
    setNewType(''); toast(`${newType} now required`)
  }
  const verifyAllAttached = () => {
    const n = recs.filter((r) => r.status === 'attached').length
    mutate((d) => { for (const r of d.records) if (r.projectId === p.id && r.status === 'attached') { r.status = 'verified'; r.verifiedById = d.currentUserId } }, { entity: 'records', entityId: p.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'verify', summary: `${p.code}: verified ${n} attached record${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} as traceable, verifiable and complete` })
    toast(`${n} record${n === 1 ? '' : 's'} verified`)
  }
  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const r = await saveFile(`${p.code}-records-matrix.csv`, toCSV(recs.map((r) => ({ project: p.code, segment: r.segment, record_type: r.type, status: r.status, file: r.fileName ?? '', verified_by: r.verifiedById ? personName(s, r.verifiedById) : '' }))), 'text/csv')
    toast(r === 'saved' ? 'Records matrix exported' : 'Download not available here', r === 'saved' ? 'good' : 'info')
  }

  if (!recs.length) {
    return (
      <Panel title="Records completeness" subtitle="Traceable, verifiable and complete records by segment">
        <Empty title="No records matrix yet" action={<Button variant="primary" onClick={setup}>Set up records matrix</Button>}>
          {p.stageIndex < consIdx ? `Records are collected from construction onward (stage ${consIdx + 1}). You can set the matrix up early so field teams know what is required.` : 'Create the matrix of segments and required record types for this asset.'}
        </Empty>
      </Panel>
    )
  }
  const record = recs.find((r) => r.id === sel)
  const attachedN = recs.filter((r) => r.status === 'attached').length
  return (
    <Panel title="Records completeness" subtitle="Each segment needs every required record attached and verified by Records before the project can close" pad={false}
      actions={<>
        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={exportCsv}>Export CSV</Button>
        {canVerify ? <Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={!attachedN} onClick={verifyAllAttached}>Verify {attachedN} attached</Button>
          : <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { setUser('u-rec'); toast('Now acting as Marco Delgado, Records Supervisor', 'info') }} title="Verification needs the Records role">Act as Records to verify</Button>}
      </>}>
      <div className="scroll-x">
        <table className="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th>Segment</th>{types.map((t) => <th key={t} className="text-center">{t}</th>)}<th className="num">Verified</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {segs.map((seg) => {
              const row = recs.filter((r) => r.segment === seg)
              const v = row.filter((r) => r.status === 'verified').length
              return (
                <tr key={seg}>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap font-semibold">{seg}</td>
                  {types.map((t) => {
                    const r = cell(seg, t)
                    if (!r) return <td key={t} className="text-center text-faint">n/a</td>
                    return (
                      <td key={t} className="text-center">
                        <button onClick={() => setSel(r.id)} className={cx('inline-flex min-w-[86px] items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold', r.status === 'verified' ? 'border-good/40 bg-good/10 text-good' : r.status === 'attached' ? 'border-info/40 bg-info/10 text-info' : 'border-bad/40 bg-bad/10 text-bad', sel === r.id && 'ring-2 ring-ink')} title={r.fileName ?? 'No file'}>
                          {r.status === 'verified' ? '✓ Verified' : r.status === 'attached' ? 'Attached' : 'Missing'}
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    )
                  })}
                  <td className="num">{v}/{row.length}</td>
                </tr>
              )
            })}
            <tr>
              <td className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">By type</td>
              {types.map((t) => { const col = recs.filter((r) => r.type === t); const v = col.filter((r) => r.status === 'verified').length; return <td key={t} className="text-center text-[12px] tabular-nums text-muted">{v}/{col.length}</td> })}
              <td className="num font-semibold">{pct(recs.filter((r) => r.status === 'verified').length / recs.length)}</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2 border-t border-line px-4 py-2.5">
        <Input className="h-7 w-44 py-0.5" placeholder="New segment name" value={newSeg} onChange={(e) => setNewSeg(e.target.value)} />
        <Button size="sm" disabled={!newSeg.trim()} onClick={addSegment}>Add segment</Button>
        <span className="mx-2 text-line">|</span>
        <Select className="h-7 w-52 py-0.5" value={newType} onChange={(e) => setNewType(e.target.value as RType)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'Require another record type…' }, ...ALL_TYPES.filter((t) => !types.includes(t))]} />
        <Button size="sm" disabled={!newType} onClick={addType}>Require</Button>
        {!canVerify && <span className="ml-auto text-[12px] text-muted">Attach as any team member; only the Records role can verify.</span>}
      </div>
      <RecordDrawer r={record} p={p} canVerify={canVerify} onClose={() => setSel(null)} />
    </Panel>
  )
}

function RecordDrawer({ r, p, canVerify, onClose }: { r?: RecordItem; p: Project; canVerify: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('')
  if (!r) return null
  const label = `${r.type} · ${r.segment}`
  const attach = (f: File) => {
    mutate((d) => { const x = d.records.find((y) => y.id === r.id)!; x.status = 'attached'; x.fileName = f.name; x.verifiedById = undefined }, { entity: 'record', entityId: r.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'attach', summary: `${p.code}: attached ${f.name} (${Math.max(1, Math.round(f.size / 1024))} KB) as ${label}` })
    toast('Record attached — awaiting verification')
  }
  const verify = () => {
    mutate((d) => { const x = d.records.find((y) => y.id === r.id)!; x.status = 'verified'; x.verifiedById = d.currentUserId }, { entity: 'record', entityId: r.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'verify', summary: `${p.code}: verified ${label} (${r.fileName})` })
    toast('Record verified'); onClose()
  }
  const reject = () => {
    if (!reason.trim()) { toast('Say why the record is rejected', 'bad'); return }
    mutate((d) => { const x = d.records.find((y) => y.id === r.id)!; x.status = 'missing'; x.verifiedById = undefined }, { entity: 'record', entityId: r.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'reject', summary: `${p.code}: rejected ${label} (${r.fileName}) — ${reason.trim()}` })
    setReason(''); toast('Record returned as missing', 'bad'); onClose()
  }
  const hist = s.audit.filter((a) => a.entityId === r.id).slice().reverse()
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} title={label} width={520}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <KV items={[['Status', <StatusBadge status={r.status} />], ['File', r.fileName ? <Mono>{r.fileName}</Mono> : '—'], ['Verified by', r.verifiedById ? personName(s, r.verifiedById) : '—'], ['Segment', r.segment]]} />
        {r.status !== 'verified' && (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-md border border-line p-3">
            <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold">{r.status === 'missing' ? 'Attach the record' : 'Replace the attached file'}</div>
            <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">PDF scans of signed field records, test charts or mill certificates. The file name is kept as evidence; verification is a separate step by Records.</p>
            <FileButton size="md" variant={r.status === 'missing' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'} label={r.status === 'missing' ? 'Choose file…' : 'Replace file…'} onFile={attach} accept=".pdf,.tif,.tiff,.jpg,.png,.xlsx,.csv,.dwg" />
          </div>
        )}
        {r.status === 'attached' && (
          canVerify ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-md border border-marker/60 bg-marker/5 p-3">
              <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold">Records verification</div>
              <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">Confirm the record is traceable (tied to this segment), verifiable (signed, legible, complete) and matches the as-built.</p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><Button variant="primary" onClick={verify}>Verify record</Button></div>
              <Input placeholder="Reason, if rejecting" value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} />
              <div><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={reject}>Reject as incomplete</Button></div>
            </div>
          ) : <Callout tone="info">Awaiting verification by the Records role.</Callout>
        )}
