        {r.status === 'verified' && <Callout tone="good">Verified records are locked. Records can reject and re-open them if a defect is found.</Callout>}
        {r.status === 'verified' && canVerify && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><Input className="flex-1" placeholder="Reason for re-opening" value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} /><Button variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={reject}>Re-open</Button></div>
        )}
        {hist.length > 0 && (
          <div><div className="eyebrow mb-1">History</div><ul className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-[12px]">{hist.map((a) => <li key={a.id}><b>{personName(s, a.actorId)}</b> <span className="text-muted">{a.summary}</span></li>)}</ul></div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Closeout
function Closeout({ p, items, rc, wfId, wfStatus }: { p: Project; items: CloseoutItem[]; rc: ReturnType<typeof recordsCompleteness>; wfId?: string; wfStatus?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [newItem, setNewItem] = useState('')
  const [newRole, setNewRole] = useState<RoleId>('pm')
  const pos = position(s, p.id)
  const openItems = items.filter((x) => x.status === 'open')
  const blocks: string[] = []
  if (!rc.total) blocks.push('No records matrix — records completeness cannot be shown')
  else if (rc.pct < 1) blocks.push(`${rc.total - rc.verified} of ${rc.total} records not verified (${rc.missing} missing, ${rc.attached} awaiting verification)`)
  if (!items.length) blocks.push('Closeout checklist not started')
  else if (openItems.length) blocks.push(`${openItems.length} checklist item${openItems.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} open`)
  if (pos.commitments > 0 && p.status !== 'closed') blocks.push(`${money(pos.commitments)} in open commitments`)
  const running = wfStatus === 'running'
  const approved = wfStatus === 'approved'
  const recordsBlock = blocks.filter((b) => !b.startsWith('$') && !b.includes('commitments'))

  const setStatus = (it: CloseoutItem, st: CloseoutItem['status']) => {
    mutate((d) => { const x = d.closeout.find((y) => y.id === it.id)!; x.status = st; x.done = st === 'done' ? d.settings.asOf : undefined }, { entity: 'closeout', entityId: it.id, projectId: p.id, action: st === 'done' ? 'complete' : st === 'n/a' ? 'not-applicable' : 'reopen', summary: `${p.code}: closeout item "${it.item}" ${st === 'done' ? 'completed' : st === 'n/a' ? 'marked not applicable' : 'reopened'}` })
    toast(st === 'done' ? 'Item completed' : st === 'n/a' ? 'Marked not applicable' : 'Item reopened')
  }
  const create = () => {
    mutate((d) => { for (const [item, role] of STD_CLOSEOUT) d.closeout.push({ id: uid('co'), projectId: p.id, item, ownerRole: role, status: 'open' }) }, { entity: 'closeout', entityId: p.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'create', summary: `${p.code}: started closeout checklist (${STD_CLOSEOUT.length} standard items)` })
    toast('Closeout checklist created')
  }
  const add = () => {
    if (!newItem.trim()) return
    mutate((d) => { d.closeout.push({ id: uid('co'), projectId: p.id, item: newItem.trim(), ownerRole: newRole, status: 'open' }) }, { entity: 'closeout', entityId: p.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'add-item', summary: `${p.code}: added closeout item "${newItem.trim()}" (${newRole})` })
    setNewItem(''); toast('Checklist item added')
  }
  const start = () => {
    let ok = false
    mutate((d) => {
      const inst = startWorkflow(d, 'closeout', { title: `${p.code} project closeout`, recordType: 'closeout', recordId: p.id, projectId: p.id, data: { inService: p.dates.inService ?? inServiceDate(p), recordsVerifiedPct: Math.round(rc.pct * 100), checklistDone: items.length - openItems.length, amount: pos.eac } })
      ok = !!inst
    }, { entity: 'closeout', entityId: p.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'submit', summary: `${p.code}: submitted for closeout (records ${pct(rc.pct)} verified, ${items.length - openItems.length}/${items.length} checklist items complete)` })
    toast(ok ? 'Closeout submitted for approval' : 'No published closeout workflow', ok ? 'good' : 'bad')
  }
  return (
    <Panel title="Closeout" subtitle="PM certifies completion → Records verifies → Plant Accounting accepts unitization → PMO freezes the evidence package" pad={false}
      actions={!items.length ? <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={create}>Start closeout checklist</Button> : !wfId || (!running && !approved) ? <Button size="sm" variant={recordsBlock.length ? 'secondary' : 'marker'} disabled={recordsBlock.length > 0} onClick={start} title={recordsBlock.join('; ')}>{wfStatus ? 'Resubmit closeout' : 'Submit for closeout'}</Button> : undefined}>
      {!approved && blocks.length > 0 && (
        <div className="border-b border-line p-3">
          <Callout tone={recordsBlock.length ? 'bad' : 'warn'} title={recordsBlock.length ? 'Closeout is blocked' : 'Ready to submit, with notes'}>
            <ul className="ml-4 list-disc">{blocks.map((b) => <li key={b}>{b}</li>)}</ul>
          </Callout>
        </div>
      )}
      {approved && <div className="border-b border-line p-3"><Callout tone="good" title="Closeout accepted">PMO accepted closeout. Record the Gate {templateFor(s, p).stages.length} decision in Lifecycle & gates to close the project.</Callout></div>}
      {items.length > 0 && (
        <div className="scroll-x">
          <table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Item</th><th>Owner</th><th>Status</th><th>Completed</th><th style={{ width: 210 }} /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {items.map((it) => (
                <tr key={it.id}>
                  <td className={cx('font-semibold', it.status !== 'open' && 'text-muted')}>{it.item}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{roleName(s.roles, it.ownerRole)}<div className="text-faint">{personName(s, ownerForRole(s, p, it.ownerRole))}</div></td>
                  <td><StatusBadge status={it.status === 'n/a' ? 'cancelled' : it.status} label={it.status === 'n/a' ? 'N/A' : undefined} /></td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{fmtDate(it.done)}</td>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap text-right">
                    {it.status === 'open' ? <><Button size="sm" variant="primary" disabled={running} onClick={() => setStatus(it, 'done')}>Mark done</Button><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={running} onClick={() => setStatus(it, 'n/a')}>N/A</Button></>
                      : <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={running || approved} onClick={() => setStatus(it, 'open')}>Reopen</Button>}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
      {items.length > 0 && !running && !approved && (
        <form className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2 border-t border-line px-4 py-2.5" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); add() }}>
          <Input className="h-7 min-w-[220px] flex-1 py-0.5" placeholder="Add a project-specific closeout item" value={newItem} onChange={(e) => setNewItem(e.target.value)} />
          <div className="w-52"><RoleSelect value={newRole} onChange={setNewRole} /></div>
          <Button size="sm" type="submit" disabled={!newItem.trim()}>Add item</Button>
        </form>
      )}
      {wfId && <div className="border-t border-line p-3"><WorkflowStatus instanceId={wfId} /></div>}
    </Panel>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── As-built / GIS handoff
function Handoff({ p }: { p: Project }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const asb = s.records.filter((r) => r.projectId === p.id && r.type === 'As-built drawing')
  const ready = asb.length > 0 && asb.every((r) => r.status === 'verified')
  const co = s.closeout.find((x) => x.projectId === p.id && /GIS/i.test(x.item))
  const [gis, setGis] = useState('')
  const addGis = () => {
    const id = gis.trim().toUpperCase()
    if (!id || p.gisIds.includes(id)) return
    mutate((d) => { d.projects.find((x) => x.id === p.id)!.gisIds.push(id) }, { entity: 'project', entityId: p.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'gis-link', summary: `${p.code}: linked GIS feature ${id}` })
    setGis(''); toast('GIS feature linked')
  }
  const handoff = () => {
    mutate((d) => {
      const x = d.closeout.find((y) => y.projectId === p.id && /GIS/i.test(y.item))
      if (x) { x.status = 'done'; x.done = d.settings.asOf }
    }, { entity: 'project', entityId: p.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'gis-handoff', summary: `${p.code}: as-builts handed off to GIS for features ${p.gisIds.join(', ')} (${asb.length} verified drawing${asb.length === 1 ? '' : 's'})` })
    toast('As-builts handed off to GIS')
  }
  return (
    <Panel title="As-built & GIS handoff" subtitle="Verified as-builts update the GIS features the project touched">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <KV cols={2} items={[
          ['Asset', `${humanizeId(p.asset.type)} · ${p.asset.lineId}`],
          ['Pipe', p.asset.diameterIn ? `${p.asset.diameterIn}" ${p.asset.material}, MAOP ${num(p.asset.maopPsig)} psig` : p.asset.material],
          ['As-built drawings', asb.length ? `${asb.filter((r) => r.status === 'verified').length}/${asb.length} verified` : 'None required yet'],
          ['GIS handoff', co ? <StatusBadge status={co.status} label={co.status === 'done' ? `Done ${fmtDate(co.done)}` : 'Open'} /> : '—'],
        ]} />
        <div>
          <div className="mb-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">GIS features</div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">{p.gisIds.map((g) => <Badge key={g}><Mono>{g}</Mono></Badge>)}</div>
          <form className="mt-2 flex gap-2" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); addGis() }}>
            <Input className="h-7 w-48 py-0.5 font-mono" placeholder="SEG-…" value={gis} onChange={(e) => setGis(e.target.value)} />
            <Button size="sm" type="submit" disabled={!gis.trim()}>Link feature</Button>
          </form>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button variant={ready && co?.status !== 'done' ? 'marker' : 'secondary'} disabled={!ready || co?.status === 'done'} onClick={handoff}>{co?.status === 'done' ? 'Handed off to GIS' : 'Hand off as-builts to GIS'}</Button>
          {!ready && asb.length > 0 && <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">All as-built drawings must be verified first.</span>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Unitization
function Unitization({ p }: { p: Project }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const b = activeBudget(s, p.id)
  const pos = position(s, p.id)
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    if (!b) return []
    const tot = sum(Object.values(b.byCategory))
    return Object.entries(b.byCategory).filter(([, v]) => v).map(([cid, v]) => {
      const c = s.categories.find((x) => x.id === cid)
      return { cid, code: c?.code ?? '', name: c?.name ?? cid, erp: c?.erpCostElement ?? '', budget: v, share: tot ? v / tot : 0, final: Math.round((tot ? v / tot : 0) * (pos.actualToDate || pos.eac)) }
    }).sort((a, z) => a.code.localeCompare(z.code))
  }, [b, s.categories, pos.actualToDate, pos.eac])
  const primary = p.scope.quantities[0]
  const basis = pos.actualToDate || pos.eac
  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const data = [
      ...p.scope.quantities.map((q) => ({ section: 'Asset unit', project: p.code, wbs: p.erpWbs, item: q.label, qty: q.qty, unit: q.unit, cost_element: '', amount: '' })),
      ...rows.map((r) => ({ section: 'Cost', project: p.code, wbs: p.erpWbs, item: `${r.code} ${r.name}`, qty: '', unit: '', cost_element: r.erp, amount: r.final })),
    ]
    const res = await saveFile(`${p.code}-unitization.csv`, toCSV(data), 'text/csv')
    if (res === 'saved') { mutate(() => {}, { entity: 'project', entityId: p.id, projectId: p.id, action: 'export-unitization', summary: `${p.code}: exported unitization package for plant accounting (${money(basis)} across ${rows.length} cost elements)` }); toast('Unitization package exported') }
    else toast('Download not available here', 'info')
  }
  if (!b) return <Panel title="Unitization summary"><Empty title="No budget yet">Unitization uses the control budget's cost breakdown once one exists.</Empty></Panel>
  return (
    <Panel title="Unitization summary" subtitle={`Asset units and cost by category for plant accounting · WBS ${p.erpWbs} · allocated on ${pos.actualToDate ? 'actual to date' : 'forecast'} ${money(basis)}`} pad={false}
      actions={<Button size="sm" onClick={exportCsv}>Export for plant accounting</Button>}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-2 border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
        {p.scope.quantities.map((q) => <div key={q.label}><div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-faint">{q.label}</div><div className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold tabular-nums">{num(q.qty)} <span className="text-[12px] font-normal text-muted">{q.unit}</span></div></div>)}
        {primary && primary.qty > 0 && <div><div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-faint">Unit cost</div><div className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold tabular-nums">{money(basis / primary.qty)} <span className="text-[12px] font-normal text-muted">/ {primary.unit}</span></div></div>}
      </div>
      <div className="scroll-x" style={{ maxHeight: 340, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
        <table className="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th>Category</th><th>ERP element</th><th className="num">Budget</th><th className="num">Share</th><th className="num">Allocated</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((r) => <tr key={r.cid}><td className="whitespace-nowrap"><Mono className="text-faint">{r.code}</Mono> {r.name}</td><td><Mono>{r.erp}</Mono></td><td className="num">{money(r.budget)}</td><td className="num text-muted">{pct(r.share, 1)}</td><td className="num font-semibold">{money(r.final)}</td></tr>)}
            <tr><td colSpan={2} className="font-semibold">Total (excl. contingency)</td><td className="num font-semibold">{money(sum(rows.map((r) => r.budget)))}</td><td className="num">100%</td><td className="num font-semibold">{money(sum(rows.map((r) => r.final)))}</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Lessons learned
function Lessons({ p }: { p: Project }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const mine = s.lessons.filter((l) => l.projectId === p.id).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))
  const similar = s.lessons.filter((l) => l.projectId !== p.id && l.workMethods.includes(p.workMethod)).slice(0, 4)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [d, setD] = useState({ title: '', category: 'Construction', text: '', workMethods: [p.workMethod] as WorkMethod[] })
  const save = () => {
    if (!d.title.trim() || !d.text.trim()) { toast('Add a title and what happened', 'bad'); return }
    const id = uid('les')
    mutate((x) => { x.lessons.push({ id, projectId: p.id, date: x.settings.asOf, title: d.title.trim(), category: d.category, text: d.text.trim(), workMethods: d.workMethods }) }, { entity: 'lesson', entityId: id, projectId: p.id, action: 'create', summary: `${p.code}: captured lesson "${d.title.trim()}" (${d.category}; ${d.workMethods.join(', ')})` })
    setD({ title: '', category: 'Construction', text: '', workMethods: [p.workMethod] }); setOpen(false); toast('Lesson captured')
  }
  const remove = (id: string, title: string) => {
    mutate((x) => { x.lessons = x.lessons.filter((l) => l.id !== id) }, { entity: 'lesson', entityId: id, projectId: p.id, action: 'delete', summary: `${p.code}: removed lesson "${title}"` })
    toast('Lesson removed')
  }
  return (
    <Panel title="Lessons learned" subtitle="Tagged by work method so estimators and PMs see them on similar projects" pad={false}
      actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Add lesson</Button>}>
      {mine.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No lessons captured yet">Lessons are required for closeout. Capture what you would repeat or avoid.</Empty></div> : (
        <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
          {mine.map((l) => (
            <li key={l.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3">
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><b className="text-[13px]">{l.title}</b><Badge>{l.category}</Badge>{l.workMethods.map((w) => <Badge key={w} tone="info">{humanizeId(w)}</Badge>)}</div>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-muted">{l.text}</p>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[12px] text-faint">{fmtDate(l.date)}</span>
              <ConfirmButton size="sm" variant="ghost" confirmLabel="Remove" onConfirm={() => remove(l.id, l.title)}>Remove</ConfirmButton>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {similar.length > 0 && (
        <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-3">
          <div className="eyebrow mb-1.5">From similar {humanizeId(p.workMethod).toLowerCase()} projects</div>
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-[13px]">{similar.map((l) => <li key={l.id}><b>{l.title}</b> <span className="text-muted">· {s.projects.find((x) => x.id === l.projectId)?.code} · {l.category}</span></li>)}</ul>
        </div>
      )}
      <Drawer open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Capture a lesson" footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save lesson</Button></>}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Field label="Lesson (one line)"><Input value={d.title} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, title: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. Book outage windows at Gate 2" /></Field>
          <Field label="Category"><Select value={d.category} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, category: e.target.value })} options={['Estimating', 'Permitting', 'Scheduling', 'Procurement', 'Construction', 'Safety', 'Records', 'Stakeholder']} /></Field>
          <Field label="What happened and what to do next time"><TextArea rows={5} value={d.text} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, text: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Applies to work methods"><MultiCheck options={WORK_METHODS.map((w) => ({ id: w, label: humanizeId(w) }))} value={d.workMethods} onChange={(v) => setD({ ...d, workMethods: v as WorkMethod[] })} /></Field>
        </div>
      </Drawer>
    </Panel>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/project/tabs/Risk.tsx =====
// Project risk register, quantitative analysis and contingency (RK-01 … RK-11).
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { MonteCarloResult, Risk as RiskT } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, personName, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { expectedCost, isActive, pert, riskScore } from '@/core/engine/risk'
import { position } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { askJSON, aiMessage, useAiAvailable } from '@/core/ai'
import { addDays, fmtDate, fmtMonth, groupBy, money, moneyDelta, pct, sum, uid, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { AiTag, Badge, Button, Callout, Checkbox, Empty, Modal, Panel, SegButtons, Select, Stat, StatusBadge, Table, Input, Mono, type Column } from '@/ui/kit'
import { HBarChart, Histogram, LineChart, RiskMatrix } from '@/ui/charts'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { WorkflowStatus } from '@/views/shared/WorkflowStatus'
import { RiskEditor, ScoreChip } from '@/views/risk/RiskEditor'
import { DrawModal } from '@/views/risk/DrawModal'
import {
  PROB_BY_L, adequacy, budgetBase, burndown, contingencyBasis, delayedDate, exposureSummary, inServiceForecast, latestMonteCarlo, nextRiskCode, residualScore, riskFromLibrary, runMonteCarlo,
} from '@/views/risk/lib'

type View = 'active' | 'all' | 'closed'

export default function Risk({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const risks = s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === projectId)
  const [matrixMode, setMatrixMode] = useState<'inherent' | 'residual'>('inherent')
  const [cell, setCell] = useState<string | undefined>()
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>('active')
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<{ risk: RiskT; isNew?: boolean } | null>(null)
  const [drawFor, setDrawFor] = useState<RiskT | null | undefined>(undefined)
  const [libOpen, setLibOpen] = useState(false)

  const summary = exposureSummary(risks, s.settings.asOf)
  const basis = contingencyBasis(s, projectId)
  const pos = position(s, projectId)

  const shown = risks
    .filter((r) => (view === 'active' ? isActive(r) : view === 'closed' ? !isActive(r) : true))
    .filter((r) => !cell || `${matrixMode === 'inherent' ? r.likelihood : r.residual.likelihood}-${matrixMode === 'inherent' ? r.consequence : r.residual.consequence}` === cell)
    .filter((r) => !q || (r.code + r.title + r.category + r.cause + r.event).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))
    .sort((a, b) => riskScore(b) - riskScore(a) || expectedCost(b) - expectedCost(a))

  const cells: Record<string, number> = {}
  for (const r of risks.filter(isActive)) {
    const k = matrixMode === 'inherent' ? `${r.likelihood}-${r.consequence}` : `${r.residual.likelihood}-${r.residual.consequence}`
    cells[k] = (cells[k] || 0) + 1
  }

  const newRisk = () => setEditing({
    isNew: true,
    risk: {
      id: uid('rsk'), projectId, code: nextRiskCode(s, p), title: '', cause: '', event: '', effect: '', category: 'Third-party / substructures', kind: 'threat', ownerId: p.team.pm ?? s.currentUserId,
      status: 'open', likelihood: 3, consequence: 3, consequenceDim: 'Financial', probability: PROB_BY_L[2], cost: { min: 0, ml: 0, max: 0 }, scheduleDays: { min: 0, ml: 0, max: 0 },
      responses: [], residual: { likelihood: 2, consequence: 3 }, createdAt: s.settings.asOf,
    },
  })

  const cols: Column<RiskT>[] = [
    { key: 'code', header: 'Code', render: (r) => <Mono className="font-semibold">{r.code}</Mono>, sort: (r) => r.code },
    { key: 'title', header: 'Risk', render: (r) => <div className="min-w-[180px] max-w-[300px]"><div className="font-semibold">{r.title}</div><div className="truncate text-xs text-muted" title={r.event}>{r.event}</div></div>, sort: (r) => r.title },
    { key: 'cat', header: 'Category', render: (r) => <span className="text-[12px]">{r.category}</span>, sort: (r) => r.category },
    { key: 'kind', header: 'Kind', render: (r) => <Badge tone={r.kind === 'opportunity' ? 'good' : 'neutral'}>{r.kind === 'opportunity' ? 'Opportunity' : 'Threat'}</Badge>, sort: (r) => r.kind },
    { key: 'owner', header: 'Owner', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{personName(s, r.ownerId)}</span>, sort: (r) => personName(s, r.ownerId) },
    { key: 'score', header: 'L×C', render: (r) => <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><ScoreChip l={r.likelihood} c={r.consequence} /><span className="text-[11px] text-faint">→</span><ScoreChip l={r.residual.likelihood} c={r.residual.consequence} title="Residual" /></span>, sort: (r) => riskScore(r) },
    { key: 'p', header: 'P', num: true, render: (r) => pct(r.probability), sort: (r) => r.probability },
    { key: 'ml', header: 'ML cost', num: true, render: (r) => money(r.cost.ml), sort: (r) => r.cost.ml },
    { key: 'pert', header: 'PERT', num: true, render: (r) => money(pert(r.cost)), sort: (r) => pert(r.cost) },
    { key: 'ev', header: 'Expected', num: true, render: (r) => <span className={r.kind === 'opportunity' ? 'text-good' : ''}>{money(expectedCost(r))}</span>, sort: (r) => expectedCost(r) },
    { key: 'days', header: 'Days', num: true, render: (r) => r.scheduleDays.ml, sort: (r) => r.scheduleDays.ml },
    { key: 'resp', header: 'Responses', render: (r) => { const done = r.responses.filter((x) => x.status === 'done').length; const late = r.responses.some((x) => x.status === 'open' && x.due < s.settings.asOf); return r.responses.length ? <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{done}/{r.responses.length} done{late && <Badge tone="bad" className="ml-1">Overdue</Badge>}</span> : riskScore(r) >= 15 && isActive(r) ? <Badge tone="bad">None — high</Badge> : <span className="text-faint">—</span> }, sort: (r) => r.responses.length },
    { key: 'status', header: 'Status', render: (r) => <StatusBadge status={r.status} />, sort: (r) => r.status },
  ]

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6">
        <Stat label="Active risks" value={summary.active} sub={`${summary.high} high · ${risks.length - summary.active} closed`} />
        <Stat label="High without response" value={summary.highNoResponse} tone={summary.highNoResponse ? 'bad' : 'good'} sub={summary.highNoResponse ? 'Blocks gate readiness' : 'All high risks planned'} />
        <Stat label="Threat exposure" value={money(summary.threat)} sub="Σ probability × PERT" />
        <Stat label="Opportunities" value={money(summary.opportunity)} tone={summary.opportunity ? 'good' : undefined} sub="Expected savings" />
        <Stat label="Net exposure" value={money(summary.net)} sub={`~${summary.scheduleDays} expected days`} />
        <Stat label="Contingency left" value={basis ? money(basis.contingency) : '—'} sub={basis ? basis.source : 'No estimate yet'} tone={basis && summary.net > basis.contingency ? 'warn' : undefined} />
      </div>

      <Panel title="Risk register" subtitle={`${shown.length} of ${risks.length} shown${cell ? ` · cell L${cell.split('-')[0]} × C${cell.split('-')[1]}` : ''}`} pad={false}
        actions={<><Button size="sm" onClick={() => setLibOpen(true)}>Add from library</Button><Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={newRisk}>New risk</Button></>}>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-0 lg:grid-cols-[280px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-b border-line p-4 lg:border-b-0 lg:border-r">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><span className="eyebrow">Heat map</span><SegButtons options={[{ id: 'inherent', label: 'Inherent' }, { id: 'residual', label: 'Residual' }]} value={matrixMode} onChange={(v) => { setMatrixMode(v); setCell(undefined) }} /></div>
            <RiskMatrix cells={cells} selected={cell} onPick={(l, c) => setCell((x) => (x === `${l}-${c}` ? undefined : `${l}-${c}`))} />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-faint">Active risks by likelihood (L) and consequence (C). Click a cell to filter the register; click again to clear.</p>
            {cell && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setCell(undefined)}>Clear cell filter</Button>}
            <ExposureByCategory risks={risks} />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b border-line px-3 py-2">
              <SegButtons options={[{ id: 'active', label: 'Active' }, { id: 'closed', label: 'Closed / realized' }, { id: 'all', label: 'All' }]} value={view} onChange={setView} />
              <Input id="risk-search" className="max-w-[240px]" placeholder="Search risks" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} />
              {summary.overdueResponses > 0 && <Badge tone="bad">{summary.overdueResponses} overdue response{summary.overdueResponses > 1 ? 's' : ''}</Badge>}
            </div>
            <Table rows={shown} columns={cols} rowKey={(r) => r.id} onRowClick={(r) => setEditing({ risk: r })} maxHeight={520}
              empty={<div className="p-4"><Empty title="No risks match">Change the filter, or add risks from the library for {p.workMethod.replace(/-/g, ' ')} work.</Empty></div>} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Panel>

      <Quantitative projectId={projectId} />

      <Contingency projectId={projectId} onRequest={() => setDrawFor(null)} />

      <AiIdentify projectId={projectId} />

      <RiskEditor open={!!editing} risk={editing?.risk ?? null} isNew={editing?.isNew} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} onRequestDraw={pos.budgetKind === 'control' ? (r) => setDrawFor(r) : undefined} />
      <DrawModal open={drawFor !== undefined} projectId={projectId} risk={drawFor} onClose={() => setDrawFor(undefined)} />
      <LibraryModal open={libOpen} onClose={() => setLibOpen(false)} projectId={projectId} />
    </div>
  )
}

function ExposureByCategory({ risks }: { risks: RiskT[] }) {
  const g = groupBy(risks.filter((r) => isActive(r) && r.kind === 'threat'), (r) => r.category)
  const rows = Object.entries(g).map(([k, rs]) => ({ label: k, value: Math.round(sum(rs.map(expectedCost))) })).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value).slice(0, 6)
  if (!rows.length) return null
  return <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><span className="eyebrow">Threat exposure by category</span><HBarChart rows={rows} /></div>
}

// ───────────────────────────── Quantitative analysis (RK-06, RK-07)
function Quantitative({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const saved = latestMonteCarlo(s, projectId)
  const history = s.monteCarlo.filter((m) => m.projectId === projectId).slice().reverse()
  const [iterations, setIterations] = useState(5000)
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<MonteCarloResult | null>(null)
  const [viewId, setViewId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const basis = contingencyBasis(s, projectId)
  const live = useMemo(() => (saved ? null : runMonteCarlo(s, projectId, 3000)), [saved, s.risks, projectId]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const mc = preview ?? history.find((h) => h.id === viewId) ?? saved ?? live
  const isSaved = !!mc && !preview && history.some((h) => h.id === mc.id)
  const ins = inServiceForecast(p)
  if (!basis) return <Panel title="Quantitative analysis"><Empty title="Nothing to simulate yet">Monte Carlo needs a base cost. It runs once the first estimate is drafted.</Empty></Panel>
  const run = () => {
    const r = runMonteCarlo(s, projectId, iterations, Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6))
    if (r) { setPreview(r); setViewId(null); toast(`Simulated ${iterations.toLocaleString()} iterations`, 'info') }
  }
  const save = () => {
    const r = mc
    if (!r) return
    mutate((d) => { d.monteCarlo.push({ ...r, id: uid('mc'), date: d.settings.asOf }) }, { entity: 'monte-carlo', entityId: r.id, projectId, action: 'save', summary: `Saved Monte Carlo (${r.iterations.toLocaleString()} iterations): P50 ${money(r.costP.P50)}, P80 ${money(r.costP.P80)}` })
    setPreview(null); setViewId(null)
    toast('Monte Carlo results saved to the project record')
  }
  const a = mc ? adequacy(basis.contingency, mc) : null
  return (
    <Panel title="Quantitative analysis" subtitle={mc ? `${mc.iterations.toLocaleString()} iterations · base ${money(mc.baseCost)} (${basis.source}, excl. contingency) · ${isSaved ? `saved ${fmtDate(mc.date)}` : 'not saved'}` : undefined}
      actions={<>
        <Select id="mc-iter" className="w-[130px]" value={String(iterations)} onChange={(e) => setIterations(Number(e.target.value))} options={[1000, 5000, 10000, 20000].map((n) => ({ value: String(n), label: `${n.toLocaleString()} runs` }))} />
        <Button size="sm" onClick={run}>Run Monte Carlo</Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant={isSaved ? 'secondary' : 'primary'} disabled={isSaved || !mc} onClick={save}>{isSaved ? 'Saved' : 'Save results'}</Button>
      </>}>
      {mc && a && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_340px]">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            {!isSaved && <div className="mb-2"><Badge tone="marker">{preview ? 'New run — save to keep it on the record' : 'Preview from the current register — not saved'}</Badge></div>}
            <Histogram bins={mc.histogram} markers={[{ x: mc.baseCost, label: 'Base', color: 'rgb(var(--muted))' }, { x: mc.costP.P50, label: 'P50' }, { x: mc.costP.P80, label: 'P80', color: 'rgb(var(--bad))' }]} />
            <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              <table className="tbl">
                <thead><tr><th>Cost</th><th className="num">Total</th><th className="num">Over base</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>{(['P10', 'P50', 'P80', 'P90'] as const).map((k) => <tr key={k}><td className="font-semibold">{k}</td><td className="num">{money(mc.costP[k])}</td><td className="num">{moneyDelta(mc.costP[k] - mc.baseCost)}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
              </table>
              <table className="tbl">
                <thead><tr><th>Schedule</th><th className="num">Risk delay</th><th className="num">In service</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>{(['P10', 'P50', 'P80', 'P90'] as const).map((k) => <tr key={k}><td className="font-semibold">{k}</td><td className="num">{mc.scheduleP[k]} days</td><td className="num">{ins ? fmtDate(delayedDate(ins, mc.scheduleP[k])) : '—'}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className={cx('rounded-md border-2 p-4', a.tone === 'good' ? 'border-good/50 bg-good/5' : a.tone === 'warn' ? 'border-warn/60 bg-warn/5' : 'border-bad/60 bg-bad/5')}>
              <div className="eyebrow">Contingency adequacy</div>
              <div className={cx('mt-1 font-display text-[22px] font-bold', a.tone === 'good' ? 'text-good' : a.tone === 'warn' ? 'text-warn' : 'text-bad')}>{a.label}</div>
              <dl className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto] gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[13px] tabular-nums">
                <dt className="text-muted">Contingency remaining</dt><dd className="text-right font-semibold">{money(a.remaining)}</dd>
                <dt className="text-muted">Needed at P50 (P50 − base)</dt><dd className="text-right">{money(a.need50)}</dd>
                <dt className="text-muted">Needed at P80 (P80 − base)</dt><dd className="text-right">{money(a.need80)}</dd>
                <dt className="border-t border-line pt-1 font-semibold">{a.gap80 >= 0 ? 'Surplus at P80' : 'Shortfall at P80'}</dt><dd className={cx('border-t border-line pt-1 text-right font-bold', a.gap80 >= 0 ? 'text-good' : 'text-bad')}>{money(Math.abs(a.gap80))}</dd>
              </dl>
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted">
                {a.verdict === 'adequate' ? `Remaining contingency covers the P80 outcome with ${money(a.gap80)} to spare (${Math.round(a.coverage * 100)}% of need).`
                  : a.verdict === 'p50-only' ? `Covers the median outcome but not P80. Mitigate top risks or plan a change request for ${money(-a.gap80)}.`
                    : a.verdict === 'short' ? `Below even the P50 requirement. Expect a funding change request; escalate to the sponsor.`
                      : 'No active quantified threats. Review the register before releasing contingency.'}
              </p>
            </div>
            {history.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <div className="eyebrow mb-1">Saved runs</div>
                <table className="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th className="num">Runs</th><th className="num">P50</th><th className="num">P80</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>{history.slice(0, 5).map((h) => <tr key={h.id} className={cx('clickable', mc.id === h.id && 'bg-marker/10')} onClick={() => { setPreview(null); setViewId(h.id) }}><td>{fmtDate(h.date)}</td><td className="num">{h.iterations.toLocaleString()}</td><td className="num">{money(h.costP.P50)}</td><td className="num">{money(h.costP.P80)}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </Panel>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Contingency drawdown & usage over time (RK-08)
function Contingency({ projectId, onRequest }: { projectId: string; onRequest: () => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const pos = position(s, projectId)
  const draws = s.contingencyDraws.filter((d) => d.projectId === projectId).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))
  const fromChanges = s.changes.filter((c) => c.projectId === projectId && c.fundedFrom === 'contingency' && c.status === 'approved')
  const bd = burndown(s, projectId)
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(draws.find((d) => d.status === 'in-review')?.id ?? null)
  const hasBudget = pos.budgetKind === 'control'
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
      <Panel title="Contingency drawdowns" subtitle={hasBudget ? `${money(pos.contingencyOriginal)} original · ${money(pos.contingencyUsed)} used · ${money(pos.contingencyRemaining)} remaining` : 'Contingency is held in the estimate until a control budget is authorized'}
        actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={onRequest} disabled={!hasBudget}>Request drawdown</Button>}>
        {hasBudget && <div className="mb-3"><div className="mb-1 flex justify-between text-xs text-muted"><span>Used {pct(pos.contingencyOriginal ? pos.contingencyUsed / pos.contingencyOriginal : 0)}</span><span>{money(pos.contingencyRemaining)} left</span></div><div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-sunken"><div className="h-full bg-ink" style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (pos.contingencyUsed / Math.max(1, pos.contingencyOriginal)) * 100)}%` }} /></div></div>}
        {draws.length === 0 && fromChanges.length === 0 && <Empty title="No drawdowns">Requests made against a realized risk appear here with their approval routing.</Empty>}
        <div className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-line">
          {draws.map((d) => {
            const r = s.risks.find((x) => x.id === d.riskId)
            return (
              <div key={d.id} className="py-2.5">
                <button className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-left" onClick={() => setOpenId(openId === d.id ? null : d.id)}>
                  <b className="tabular-nums">{money(d.amount, 'full')}</b>
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[13px]">{r ? <><Mono>{r.code}</Mono> {r.title}</> : d.reason}</span>
                  <StatusBadge status={d.status} />
                  <span className="text-xs text-faint">{fmtDate(d.date)}</span>
                </button>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted">{d.reason}</p>
                {openId === d.id && d.workflowInstanceId && <div className="mt-2"><WorkflowStatus instanceId={d.workflowInstanceId} /></div>}
              </div>
            )
          })}
          {fromChanges.map((c) => (
            <div key={c.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 py-2.5 text-[13px]">
              <b className="tabular-nums">{money(c.costImpact, 'full')}</b><span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate"><Mono>{c.code}</Mono> {c.title}</span><Badge>Change funded from contingency</Badge><span className="text-xs text-faint">{fmtDate(c.decidedAt)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Panel>
      <Panel title="Contingency usage over time" subtitle="Contingency remaining each month vs. usage proportional to earned % complete">
        {bd && bd.length > 1 ? (
          <>
            <LineChart labels={bd.map((x) => fmtMonth(x.month).replace(' 20', " '"))} series={[{ name: 'Contingency remaining', values: bd.map((x) => x.remaining), area: true }, { name: 'Proportional to % complete', values: bd.map((x) => x.ideal), dashed: true, color: 'rgb(var(--muted))' }]} />
            {(() => {
              const last = bd[bd.length - 1]
              const ahead = last.remaining >= last.ideal
              return <Callout tone={ahead ? 'good' : 'warn'}>{pct(last.pctComplete)} complete (earned value). Remaining contingency is {money(Math.abs(last.remaining - last.ideal))} {ahead ? 'above' : 'below'} usage proportional to progress{ahead ? ' — spending slower than progress.' : ' — contingency is being consumed faster than work is earned.'}</Callout>
            })()}
          </>
        ) : <Empty title="No contingency usage yet">Contingency usage is tracked once a control budget is authorized and cost periods post.</Empty>}
      </Panel>
    </div>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Library (RK-03)
function LibraryModal({ open, onClose, projectId }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; projectId: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const lib = s.riskLibrary.filter((x) => x.appliesTo.includes(p.workMethod))
  const onReg = new Set(s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === projectId && isActive(r)).map((r) => r.libraryId))
  const [pick, setPick] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({})
  const base = budgetBase(s, projectId)
  const add = () => {
    const items = lib.filter((x) => pick[x.id])
    if (!items.length) return
    mutate((d) => { items.forEach((it, i) => d.risks.push(riskFromLibrary(d, p, it, base, i))) }, { entity: 'risk', entityId: projectId, projectId, action: 'create', summary: `Added ${items.length} risk(s) from library: ${items.map((x) => x.title).join(', ')}` })
    toast(`${items.length} risk${items.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} added from the library`)
    setPick({}); onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} wide title="Add risks from the library"
      footer={<><span className="mr-auto self-center text-xs text-muted">Typical cost is the library % of {money(base)} budget; adjust on the risk after adding.</span><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={!Object.values(pick).some(Boolean)} onClick={add}>Add selected</Button></>}>
      <p className="mb-3 text-[13px] text-muted">Library risks for <b className="text-ink">{p.workMethod.replace(/-/g, ' ')}</b> work, drawn from closed projects.</p>
      <div className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-line">
        {lib.map((it) => {
          const ml = Math.max(5000, Math.round((Math.abs(it.typicalCostPct) / 100) * base / 1000) * 1000)
          const has = onReg.has(it.id)
          return (
            <div key={it.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 py-2.5">
              <Checkbox checked={!!pick[it.id]} disabled={has} onChange={(v) => setPick({ ...pick, [it.id]: v })} label={<span className="sr-only">{it.title}</span>} />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><b className="text-[13px]">{it.title}</b><Badge>{it.category}</Badge>{it.typicalCostPct < 0 && <Badge tone="good">Opportunity</Badge>}{has && <Badge tone="info">On register</Badge>}</div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted">{it.cause} → {it.event} → {it.effect}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="shrink-0 text-right text-xs tabular-nums"><div className="font-semibold">{money(ml)}</div><div className="text-faint">{it.typicalCostPct}% · {it.typicalDays} d</div></div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── AI risk identification (RK-11)
interface AiRisk { title: string; category: string; cause: string; event: string; effect: string; kind: 'threat' | 'opportunity'; likelihood: number; consequence: number; costMostLikely: number; scheduleDays: number; response: string; rationale: string }
function AiIdentify({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const ok = useAiAvailable()
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [items, setItems] = useState<(AiRisk & { key: string })[]>([])
  const [err, setErr] = useState('')
  const base = budgetBase(s, projectId)
  const go = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setErr('')
    const existing = s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === projectId).map((r) => `- ${r.title} (${r.category}, ${r.status})`).join('\n') || '- none'
    const prompt = `You are a utility capital-project risk analyst. Identify NEW risks for this gas utility project (fictional demo data). Do not repeat existing risks.

Project: ${p.code} ${p.name}
Scope: ${p.scope.summary}
In scope: ${p.scope.inScope.join('; ')}
Quantities: ${p.scope.quantities.map((x) => `${x.qty} ${x.unit} ${x.label}`).join('; ')}
Assumptions: ${p.scope.assumptions.join('; ')}
Work method: ${p.workMethod}; asset ${p.asset.type}, ${p.asset.diameterIn}" ${p.asset.material}, vintage ${p.asset.vintage}, MAOP ${p.asset.maopPsig} psig, records ${p.asset.recordsStatus}
Location: ${p.location.city}, ${p.location.county} County, ${p.location.terrain}, class location ${p.location.classLocation}, HCA ${p.location.hca ? 'yes' : 'no'}, disadvantaged community ${p.location.dac ? 'yes' : 'no'}
Contractor: ${p.contractor ?? 'not yet awarded'}
Budget basis: ${money(base, 'full')}
Existing risks:
${existing}

Return JSON exactly: {"risks":[{"title":string (max 8 words),"category":one of "Third-party / substructures","Permitting","Environmental","Material","Operations","Land / right-of-way","Technical","Productivity","Regulatory change","Weather","Records","Market","Safety","Design","Stakeholder","cause":string,"event":string,"effect":string,"kind":"threat"|"opportunity","likelihood":1-5,"consequence":1-5,"costMostLikely":whole US dollars,"scheduleDays":integer,"response":string (one concrete mitigation),"rationale":string (one sentence on why this project specifically)}]}. Give 4 to 6 risks specific to this scope and location.`
    try {
      const r = await askJSON<{ risks: AiRisk[] }>(prompt)
      setItems((r.risks ?? []).map((x) => ({ ...x, key: uid('ai') })))
      if (!r.risks?.length) setErr('No new risks suggested.')
    } catch (e) { setErr(aiMessage(e)) } finally { setBusy(false) }
  }
  const accept = (x: AiRisk & { key: string }) => {
    const L = Math.min(5, Math.max(1, Math.round(x.likelihood))) as RiskT['likelihood']
    const C = Math.min(5, Math.max(1, Math.round(x.consequence))) as RiskT['consequence']
    const ml = Math.max(1000, Math.round(Number(x.costMostLikely) || 0))
    const days = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(x.scheduleDays) || 0))
    mutate((d) => {
      d.risks.push({
        id: uid('rsk'), projectId, code: nextRiskCode(d, p), title: x.title, cause: x.cause, event: x.event, effect: x.effect, category: x.category, kind: x.kind === 'opportunity' ? 'opportunity' : 'threat',
        ownerId: p.team.pm ?? d.currentUserId, status: 'open', likelihood: L, consequence: C, consequenceDim: x.category === 'Environmental' ? 'Environmental' : x.category === 'Safety' ? 'Safety' : days > 40 ? 'Schedule' : 'Financial',
        probability: PROB_BY_L[L - 1], cost: { min: Math.round(ml * 0.4), ml, max: Math.round(ml * 2.2) }, scheduleDays: { min: Math.round(days * 0.4), ml: days, max: days * 2 },
        responses: x.response ? [{ id: uid('rr'), action: x.response, ownerId: p.team.pm ?? d.currentUserId, due: addDays(d.settings.asOf, 30), status: 'open', cost: 0 }] : [],
        residual: { likelihood: Math.max(1, L - 1) as RiskT['likelihood'], consequence: C }, createdAt: d.settings.asOf,
      })
    }, { entity: 'risk', entityId: projectId, projectId, action: 'create', summary: `Accepted AI-suggested risk: ${x.title}` })
    setItems(items.filter((i) => i.key !== x.key))
    toast('Risk added to register')
  }
  if (!ok) return null
  return (
    <Panel title={<span className="flex items-center gap-2">Identify missing risks <AiTag>AI assist</AiTag></span>} subtitle="AI assist reads scope, location, work method and the current register, then suggests what is missing. Nothing is added until you accept it."
      actions={<Button size="sm" onClick={go} disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Thinking…' : items.length ? 'Suggest again' : 'Suggest risks'}</Button>}>
      {err && <Callout tone="warn">{err}</Callout>}
      {busy && <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Thinking… reviewing {s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === projectId).length} existing risks against the scope.</p>}
      {!busy && items.length === 0 && !err && <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">No suggestions yet.</p>}
      <div className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-line">
        {items.map((x) => (
          <div key={x.key} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 py-3 md:flex-row md:items-start">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><AiTag /><b className="text-[13px]">{x.title}</b><Badge>{x.category}</Badge>{x.kind === 'opportunity' && <Badge tone="good">Opportunity</Badge>}<ScoreChip l={x.likelihood} c={x.consequence} /><span className="text-xs tabular-nums text-muted">ML {money(x.costMostLikely)} · {x.scheduleDays} d</span></div>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[13px]">{x.cause} → <b>{x.event}</b> → {x.effect}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted">Response: {x.response}</p>
              <p className="text-xs italic text-faint">{x.rationale}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1.5"><Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => accept(x)}>Accept</Button><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setItems(items.filter((i) => i.key !== x.key))}>Dismiss</Button></div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/project/tabs/Safety.tsx =====
// Project safety: job-specific safety plans by work package, NTP gate, tailboards and safety events (SF-*).
import { useState } from 'react'
import type { SafetyPlan } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { startWorkflow } from '@/core/engine/workflow'
import { ntpBlockers } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { saveFile } from '@/core/download'
import { fmtDate, groupBy, uid, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Empty, Field, Input, Modal, Panel, StatusBadge, Table, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { WorkflowStatus } from '@/views/shared/WorkflowStatus'
import { EventModal, EventsTable } from '@/views/safety/Events'
import { PlanEditor } from '@/views/safety/PlanEditor'
import { blankPlan, indicators, jsspHtml, levelTone, opQualOn, oqCoverage, oqLevel, planHazards, planIssues, ticketLevel } from '@/views/safety/lib'
import { submitFirstForm } from '@/views/risk/wf'

export default function Safety({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const plans = s.safetyPlans.filter((x) => x.projectId === projectId)
  const byWp = groupBy(plans, (x) => x.workPackage)
  const wps = Object.keys(byWp).sort()
  const current = (wp: string) => { const vs = byWp[wp].slice().sort((a, b) => b.version - a.version); return vs.find((x) => x.status === 'approved') ?? vs[0] }
  const [selId, setSelId] = useState<string | undefined>(() => (wps[0] ? current(wps[0]).id : undefined))
  const sel = plans.find((x) => x.id === selId) ?? (wps[0] ? current(wps[0]) : undefined)
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<SafetyPlan | null>(null)
  const [newWp, setNewWp] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [eventOpen, setEventOpen] = useState(false)
  const blockers = ntpBlockers(s, p)
  const ind = indicators(s, [projectId], 30)
  const tailboards = s.tailboards.filter((t) => t.projectId === projectId).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))
  const events = s.safetyEvents.filter((e) => e.projectId === projectId).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))
  const inConstruction = s.budgets.some((b) => b.projectId === projectId && b.kind === 'control')

  const createPlan = () => {
    const wp = (newWp ?? '').trim()
    if (!wp) { toast('Name the work package.', 'bad'); return }
    if (byWp[wp]) { toast('That work package already has a plan.', 'bad'); return }
    const plan = blankPlan(s, projectId, wp)
    mutate((d) => { d.safetyPlans.push(plan) }, { entity: 'safety-plan', entityId: plan.id, projectId, action: 'create', summary: `Started JSSP for ${wp}` })
    setNewWp(null); setSelId(plan.id); setEditing(plan)
    toast('Safety plan started')
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className={cx('flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-md border-2 px-4 py-3 md:flex-row md:items-center', blockers.length ? 'border-bad/60 bg-bad/5' : 'border-good/60 bg-good/5')}>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="eyebrow">Construction notice to proceed</div>
          <div className={cx('font-display text-[20px] font-bold', blockers.length ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{blockers.length ? 'NTP blocked' : 'Clear for NTP'}</div>
          {blockers.length ? <ul className="mt-0.5 text-[13px]">{blockers.map((b) => <li key={b}>• {b}</li>)}</ul> : <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Authorization gate passed, an approved job-specific safety plan is on file and all permits are issued.</p>}
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-center">
          <div><div className="font-display text-[22px] font-bold tabular-nums">{ind.tailboardRate == null ? '—' : `${Math.round(ind.tailboardRate * 100)}%`}</div><div className="text-[11px] uppercase text-faint">Tailboards, 2 wks</div></div>
          <div><div className={cx('font-display text-[22px] font-bold tabular-nums', ind.lapsed ? 'text-bad' : '')}>{ind.lapsed}</div><div className="text-[11px] uppercase text-faint">Lapsed tickets</div></div>
          <div><div className={cx('font-display text-[22px] font-bold tabular-nums', ind.sif ? 'text-bad' : '')}>{ind.sif}</div><div className="text-[11px] uppercase text-faint">Open SIF-potential</div></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[300px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Panel title="Safety plans" subtitle="One job-specific plan per work package" pad={false} actions={<Button size="sm" onClick={() => setNewWp(p.asset.type === 'valve-site' ? `WP${wps.length + 1} Sites` : `WP${wps.length + 1} Segment ${String.fromCharCode(65 + wps.length)}`)}>New plan</Button>}>
          {wps.length === 0 && <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No safety plans">{inConstruction ? 'Construction cannot start without an approved plan.' : 'Plans are prepared by the contractor during design & procurement.'}</Empty></div>}
          <div className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-line">
            {wps.map((wp) => (
              <div key={wp} className="px-3 py-2.5">
                <div className="mb-1.5 text-[13px] font-semibold">{wp}</div>
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                  {byWp[wp].slice().sort((a, b) => b.version - a.version).map((v) => {
                    const issues = planIssues(s, v).filter((i) => i.level === 'bad').length
                    return (
                      <button key={v.id} onClick={() => setSelId(v.id)} className={cx('flex items-center gap-2 rounded border px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-[13px]', sel?.id === v.id ? 'border-ink bg-ink/5' : 'border-transparent hover:bg-sunken')}>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold">v{v.version}</span>
                        <StatusBadge status={v.status} />
                        <span className="text-xs text-faint">{fmtDate(v.approvedAt ?? v.createdAt)}</span>
                        {v.status !== 'superseded' && issues > 0 && <Badge tone="bad" className="ml-auto">{issues} issue{issues > 1 ? 's' : ''}</Badge>}
                      </button>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </Panel>
        {sel ? <PlanDetail plan={sel} onEdit={() => setEditing(sel)} onSelect={setSelId} /> : <Panel title="Plan"><Empty title="Select or start a plan" /></Panel>}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <Panel title="Tailboards" subtitle={`${tailboards.length} recorded · ${ind.tailboardsHeld} of ${ind.tailboardsExpected} working days in the last two weeks`} pad={false} actions={<a href="#field"><Button size="sm">Open field tailboard</Button></a>}>
          <Table rows={tailboards} rowKey={(t) => t.id} maxHeight={360} dense empty={<div className="p-4"><Empty title="No tailboards yet">Crews record the pre-job briefing from the field tailboard app.</Empty></div>}
            columns={[
              { key: 'date', header: 'Date', render: (t) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{fmtDate(t.date)}</span>, sort: (t) => t.date },
              { key: 'leader', header: 'Leader', render: (t) => t.leader },
              { key: 'n', header: 'Crew', num: true, render: (t) => t.attendees.length },
              { key: 'hz', header: 'Hazards discussed', render: (t) => <span className="text-[12px]">{t.hazardsDiscussed.map((id) => s.hazards.find((h) => h.id === id)?.hazard).filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || '—'}</span> },
              { key: 'flags', header: '', render: (t) => <span className="flex gap-1">{t.stopWorkReminder && <Badge tone="good">SWA</Badge>}{t.offlineCaptured && <Badge tone="info">Offline</Badge>}</span> },
            ]} />
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Safety events" subtitle={`${ind.observations} observations · ${ind.nearMisses} near misses · ${ind.incidents} incidents in 30 days`} pad={false} actions={<Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setEventOpen(true)}>Log event</Button>}>
          <EventsTable events={events} />
        </Panel>
      </div>

      <PlanEditor open={!!editing} plan={editing} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} />
      <EventModal open={eventOpen} onClose={() => setEventOpen(false)} projectId={projectId} planId={sel?.id} contractor={sel?.contractor ?? p.contractor} />
      <Modal open={newWp !== null} onClose={() => setNewWp(null)} title="New job-specific safety plan" footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setNewWp(null)}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={createPlan}>Start plan</Button></>}>
        <Field label="Work package" hint="Each work package gets its own plan and version history."><Input id="new-wp" value={newWp ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setNewWp(e.target.value)} /></Field>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  )
}

function PlanDetail({ plan, onEdit, onSelect }: { plan: SafetyPlan; onEdit: () => void; onSelect: (id: string) => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === plan.projectId)!
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const hz = planHazards(s, plan)
  const issues = planIssues(s, plan)
  const bad = issues.filter((i) => i.level === 'bad')
  const oqOn = opQualOn(s)
  const cov = oqOn ? oqCoverage(s, plan, asOf) : []
  const newer = s.safetyPlans.find((x) => x.projectId === plan.projectId && x.workPackage === plan.workPackage && x.version > plan.version && x.status !== 'superseded')
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [changeOpen, setChangeOpen] = useState(false)
  const [changeNote, setChangeNote] = useState('')

  const submit = () => {
    mutate((d) => {
      const inst = startWorkflow(d, 'safety-plan', { title: `${p.code} JSSP ${plan.workPackage} v${plan.version}`, recordType: 'safety-plan', recordId: plan.id, projectId: plan.projectId, data: { workPackage: plan.workPackage, version: plan.version, openIssues: bad.length } })
      submitFirstForm(d, inst?.id, bad.length ? `Submitted with ${bad.length} open item(s) for reviewer attention` : 'Plan prepared; all pre-mobilization checks pass')
    }, { entity: 'safety-plan', entityId: plan.id, projectId: plan.projectId, action: 'submit', summary: `Submitted JSSP ${plan.workPackage} v${plan.version} for approval` })
    setSubmitting(false)
    toast('Safety plan submitted for approval')
  }
  const fieldChange = () => {
    if (!changeNote.trim()) { toast('Describe the field change.', 'bad'); return }
    const id = uid('jssp')
    mutate((d) => {
      const src = d.safetyPlans.find((x) => x.id === plan.id)!
      const max = Math.max(...d.safetyPlans.filter((x) => x.projectId === plan.projectId && x.workPackage === plan.workPackage).map((x) => x.version))
      const copy: SafetyPlan = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(src))
      d.safetyPlans.push({ ...copy, id, version: max + 1, status: 'draft', createdAt: d.settings.asOf, approvedAt: undefined, workflowInstanceId: undefined, extraControls: [...copy.extraControls] })
    }, { entity: 'safety-plan', entityId: id, projectId: plan.projectId, action: 'field-change', summary: `Field change to JSSP ${plan.workPackage}: v${plan.version} → new draft. ${changeNote.trim()}` })
    setChangeOpen(false); setChangeNote('')
    onSelect(id)
    toast(`Version ${plan.version + 1} draft created; v${plan.version} stays in force until it is approved`)
  }
  const download = async () => {
    const r = await saveFile(`JSSP_${p.code}_${plan.workPackage.replace(/\W+/g, '_')}_v${plan.version}.html`, jsspHtml(s, plan), 'text/html')
    toast(r === 'saved' ? 'Safety plan downloaded' : r === 'declined' ? 'Download cancelled' : 'Download not available here', r === 'saved' ? 'good' : 'info')
  }

  return (
    <Panel title={<span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{plan.workPackage} <Badge tone="ink">v{plan.version}</Badge><StatusBadge status={plan.status} /></span>}
      subtitle={`${plan.contractor} · ${plan.activities.length} activities · ${hz.length} hazards · ${plan.crew.length} crew · library ${plan.libraryVersion}`}
      actions={<>
        <Button size="sm" onClick={download}>Download plan</Button>
        {plan.status === 'draft' && <Button size="sm" onClick={onEdit}>Edit plan</Button>}
        {plan.status === 'draft' && (submitting ? <span className="inline-flex gap-1"><Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={submit}>Confirm submit</Button><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setSubmitting(false)}>Cancel</Button></span> : <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => setSubmitting(true)} disabled={!plan.hazardIds.length}>Submit for approval</Button>)}
        {plan.status === 'approved' && !newer && <Button size="sm" variant="marker" onClick={() => setChangeOpen(true)}>Field change</Button>}
      </>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {newer && plan.status === 'approved' && <Callout tone="info" title={`Field change in progress: v${newer.version} ${newer.status.replace('-', ' ')}`}>This version stays in force until v{newer.version} is approved. <button className="font-semibold text-link" onClick={() => onSelect(newer.id)}>Open v{newer.version}</button></Callout>}
        {plan.status === 'superseded' && <Callout tone="warn">Superseded by a later approved version. Kept for the record.</Callout>}
        {submitting && bad.length > 0 && <Callout tone="bad" title={`${bad.length} blocking item(s)`}>The reviewer will see these. Fix them first if you can.</Callout>}
        {plan.workflowInstanceId && <WorkflowStatus instanceId={plan.workflowInstanceId} compact={plan.status === 'approved' || plan.status === 'superseded'} />}

        {issues.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-md border border-line">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-2"><span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">Pre-mobilization check</span>{bad.length > 0 && <Badge tone="bad">{bad.length} blocking</Badge>}{issues.length - bad.length > 0 && <Badge tone="warn">{issues.length - bad.length} warning</Badge>}</div>
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1 px-3 py-2 text-[13px]">{issues.map((x, i) => <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2"><span className={cx('mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full', x.level === 'bad' ? 'bg-bad' : 'bg-warn')} />{x.text}</li>)}</ul>
          </div>
        ) : <Callout tone="good">All pre-mobilization checks pass: tickets current, permits listed, every covered task has a qualified crew member.</Callout>}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <div className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Tickets & permits</div>
            {plan.tickets.length === 0 ? <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">None listed.</p> : (
              <table className="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Type</th><th>Number</th><th>Expires</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>{plan.tickets.map((t) => { const st = ticketLevel(t.expires, asOf); return <tr key={t.id}><td>{t.type}</td><td className="font-mono text-[12px]">{t.number || '—'}</td><td className="whitespace-nowrap">{fmtDate(t.expires)}</td><td><Badge tone={levelTone(st.level)}>{st.label}</Badge></td></tr> })}</tbody></table>
            )}
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Emergency</div>
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-[110px_1fr] gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[13px]">
              <dt className="text-muted">Site</dt><dd>{plan.site.address || '—'}</dd>
              <dt className="text-muted">Hospital</dt><dd><b>{plan.site.hospital || '—'}</b><div className="text-xs text-muted">{plan.site.hospitalRoute}</div></dd>
              <dt className="text-muted">Muster point</dt><dd>{plan.site.musterPoint || '—'}</dd>
              <dt className="text-muted">Contacts</dt><dd>{plan.site.contacts.map((c) => <div key={c.name + c.role}>{c.name} <span className="text-muted">· {c.role} · {c.phone}</span></div>)}</dd>
              <dt className="text-muted">Plans</dt><dd className="flex gap-1">{plan.heatPlan && <Badge tone="warn">Heat plan</Badge>}{plan.trafficPlan && <Badge tone="info">Traffic plan</Badge>}{!plan.heatPlan && !plan.trafficPlan && '—'}</dd>
            </dl>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <div className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Hazards & controls</div>
          <div className="scroll-x"><table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Activity</th><th>Hazard</th><th className="num">Eng.</th><th className="num">Admin</th><th className="num">PPE</th><th className="num">Site</th><th>{oqOn ? 'Permits / OQ' : 'Permits'}</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{hz.map((h) => (
              <tr key={h.id}>
                <td className="text-[12px] text-muted">{h.activity}</td>
                <td className="font-semibold">{h.hazard}</td>
                <td className="num">{h.controls.filter((c) => c.type === 'engineering').length}</td>
                <td className="num">{h.controls.filter((c) => c.type === 'administrative').length}</td>
                <td className="num">{h.controls.filter((c) => c.type === 'ppe').length}</td>
                <td className="num">{plan.extraControls.filter((x) => x.hazardId === h.id).length || '—'}</td>
                <td className="text-[12px]">{[...h.permits, ...(oqOn ? h.oqTasks.map((x) => `OQ ${x}`) : [])].join(' · ') || '—'}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}</tbody>
          </table></div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <div className="mb-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><span className="eyebrow">Crew</span>{cov.map((c) => <Badge key={c.task} tone={c.valid.length ? 'good' : 'bad'}>{c.task} {c.valid.length ? `✓ ${c.valid.length}` : '✗'}</Badge>)}</div>
          <div className="scroll-x"><table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Role</th><th>Company</th>{oqOn && <><th>OQ tasks</th><th>OQ</th></>}<th>Prequal</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{plan.crew.map((c) => { const oq = oqLevel(c.oqExpires, asOf); return (
              <tr key={c.id}><td className="font-semibold">{c.name}</td><td>{c.role}</td><td className="text-[12px]">{c.company}</td>{oqOn && <><td className="text-[12px]">{c.oqTasks.join(', ') || '—'}</td><td><Badge tone={levelTone(oq.level)}>{oq.label}</Badge></td></>}<td><StatusBadge status={c.prequal.toLowerCase()} label={c.prequal} /></td></tr>) })}</tbody>
          </table></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <Modal open={changeOpen} onClose={() => setChangeOpen(false)} title={`Field change to ${plan.workPackage}`} footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setChangeOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={fieldChange}>Create v{plan.version + 1} draft</Button></>}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Callout tone="info">Approved plans are never edited. A field change creates version {plan.version + 1} as a draft; v{plan.version} stays in force until the new version is approved.</Callout>
          <Field label="What changed in the field"><TextArea id="fc-note" value={changeNote} onChange={(e) => setChangeNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Night work added on Mission Rd; new crew from sub-contractor; confined space vault found at station 42+10" /></Field>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </Panel>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/projects/NewProject.tsx =====
// Project initiation wizard (#new-project): Need & driver → Asset & location → Team → Review.
// Creates a stage-0 project on the program's lifecycle template, its gate deliverables, an optional
// draft Class 5 rate-table estimate, and starts the project-initiation workflow.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { mutate, useMe, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { go, projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import type { AssetType, Driver, Estimate, Milestone, Project, TeamPosition, Terrain, WorkMethod } from '@/core/types'
import { ensureDeliverables, ownerForRole, requiredDefs } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { CLASS_RANGES, MATURITY_ITEMS, computeClass, estimateTotals, parametricLines } from '@/core/engine/estimates'
import { basisYearOf, contingencyForClass, currentLoaders, escalationPctFor, pricingFor, salesTaxFor, scopeQuantities, spendMidpoint } from '@/core/engine/estimatingAdmin'
import { actOnWorkflow, startWorkflow } from '@/core/engine/workflow'
import { addDays, cx, money, nowISO, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Checkbox, ClassBadge, Field, Input, KV, Mono, PageHeader, Panel, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { RangeBar } from '@/ui/charts'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { PersonSelect, ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'

const DRIVERS: Driver[] = ['Safety / compliance', 'Reliability', 'Capacity', 'Customer / new business', 'Relocation', 'Environmental']
const ASSETS: { id: AssetType; label: string; methods: WorkMethod[] }[] = [
  { id: 'transmission-pipeline', label: 'Transmission pipeline', methods: ['replace-open-trench', 'replace-hdd', 'hydrotest'] },
  { id: 'distribution-main', label: 'Distribution main', methods: ['replace-open-trench'] },
  { id: 'valve-site', label: 'Valve site', methods: ['valve-automation'] },
  { id: 'compressor-station', label: 'Compressor station', methods: ['compressor-replacement', 'station-rebuild'] },
]
const METHOD_LABEL: Record<WorkMethod, string> = {
  'replace-open-trench': 'Replace — open trench', 'replace-hdd': 'Replace — HDD', hydrotest: 'Hydrostatic test', abandon: 'Abandon', 'valve-automation': 'Valve automation',
  'station-rebuild': 'Station rebuild', 'compressor-replacement': 'Compressor replacement', 'inline-inspection': 'In-line inspection',
}
const DISTRICTS: Record<string, { box: [number, number, number, number]; county: string; cities: string[] }> = {
  West: { box: [90, 300, 330, 540], county: 'Coastline County', cities: ['Mesa Verde', 'Old Mission', 'Bellport', 'Cresthaven'] },
  East: { box: [360, 260, 620, 500], county: 'Arroyo County', cities: ['San Lucero', 'Rancho Alto', 'Las Piedras', 'Sycamore Flats', 'Westgate', 'Las Lomas'] },
  South: { box: [650, 220, 930, 520], county: 'Sierra Mesa County', cities: ['Palo Duro', 'Ironwood', 'Laguna Ciega', 'Del Arroyo'] },
  North: { box: [260, 50, 720, 210], county: 'Arroyo County', cities: ['Vista Linda', 'Cielo Grande', 'Juniper Ridge', 'Fairhollow'] },
}
const POSITIONS: { pos: TeamPosition; label: string; role: Parameters<typeof PersonSelect>[0]['role'] }[] = [
  { pos: 'sponsor', label: 'Sponsor (director)', role: 'sponsor' },
  { pos: 'pm', label: 'Project manager', role: 'pm' },
  { pos: 'engineer', label: 'Project engineer', role: 'engineer' },
  { pos: 'estimator', label: 'Estimator', role: 'estimator' },
  { pos: 'projectControls', label: 'Project controls', role: 'project-controls' },
  { pos: 'scheduler', label: 'Scheduler', role: 'scheduler' },
  { pos: 'constructionManager', label: 'Construction manager', role: 'construction-manager' },
  { pos: 'safety', label: 'Safety advisor', role: 'safety-advisor' },
  { pos: 'environmental', label: 'Environmental', role: 'environmental' },
  { pos: 'land', label: 'Land agent', role: 'land' },
]
const STEPS = ['Need & driver', 'Asset & location', 'Team', 'Review & create'] as const

interface Form {
  name: string; programId: string; driver: Driver; need: string; citation: string; proceeding: string; custom: Record<string, string>
  asset: AssetType; method: WorkMethod; lineId: string; diameterIn: number; lengthFt: number; sites: number; maopPsig: number; material: string; vintage: number; recordsStatus: Project['asset']['recordsStatus']
  district: string; city: string; terrain: Terrain; classLocation: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4; hca: boolean; dac: boolean; x: number; y: number
  team: Partial<Record<TeamPosition, string>>
  buildEstimate: boolean; startWorkflow: boolean
}

export default function NewProject(_props: { projectId?: string; id?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const me = useMe()
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0)
  const [f, setF] = useState<Form>(() => {
    const prog = s.programs[0]
    return {
      name: '', programId: prog.id, driver: 'Safety / compliance', need: '', citation: prog.regulatoryDriver, proceeding: 'PSE balancing account (AV-PUC-2022-05 (fictional) review)', custom: {},
      asset: 'transmission-pipeline', method: 'replace-open-trench', lineId: '', diameterIn: 16, lengthFt: 8000, sites: 1, maopPsig: 720, material: 'Steel, Grade B', vintage: 1958, recordsStatus: 'gaps',
      district: 'East', city: 'San Lucero', terrain: 'suburban', classLocation: 2, hca: true, dac: false, x: 490, y: 380,
      team: { sponsor: 'u-dir1', pm: 'u-pm1', engineer: 'u-eng1', estimator: 'u-est1', projectControls: 'u-pc1', scheduler: 'u-sch', constructionManager: 'u-cm1', safety: 'u-saf1', environmental: 'u-env', land: 'u-land' },
      buildEstimate: true, startWorkflow: true,
    }
  })
  const set = <K extends keyof Form>(k: K, v: Form[K]) => setF((x) => ({ ...x, [k]: v }))
  const program = s.programs.find((p) => p.id === f.programId)!
  const tpl = s.templates.find((t) => t.id === program.lifecycleTemplateId)!
  const fieldDefs = s.settings.fieldDefs.filter((d) => d.programIds.includes(f.programId))
  const nextNum = Math.max(...s.projects.map((p) => Number(p.code.replace(/\D/g, '')))) + 1
  const code = `PRJ-${nextNum}`

  const setProgram = (id: string) => {
    const pr = s.programs.find((p) => p.id === id)!
    setF((x) => {
      const asset: AssetType = pr.code === 'VAP' ? 'valve-site' : pr.code === 'CSM' ? 'compressor-station' : pr.code === 'DRP' ? 'distribution-main' : 'transmission-pipeline'
      const methods = ASSETS.find((a) => a.id === asset)!.methods
      const sponsor = pr.code === 'CSM' ? 'u-dir2' : 'u-dir1'
      return {
        ...x, programId: id, citation: pr.regulatoryDriver, asset, method: methods.includes(x.method) ? x.method : methods[0],
        driver: pr.code === 'CSM' ? 'Environmental' : pr.code === 'DRP' ? 'Reliability' : 'Safety / compliance',
        proceeding: pr.code === 'PSE' ? 'PSE balancing account (AV-PUC-2022-05 (fictional) review)' : pr.code === 'CSM' ? 'Tier 2 advice letter on in-service' : 'TY2028 GRC (AV-PUC-2026-06 (fictional))',
        diameterIn: asset === 'distribution-main' ? 6 : asset === 'compressor-station' ? 0 : x.diameterIn || 16,
        maopPsig: asset === 'distribution-main' ? 60 : asset === 'compressor-station' ? 1000 : x.maopPsig,
        material: asset === 'distribution-main' ? 'Pre-1940 cast iron / bare steel' : asset === 'compressor-station' ? 'Gas turbine-driven reciprocating units' : 'Steel, Grade B',
        team: { ...x.team, sponsor, engineer: asset === 'compressor-station' ? 'u-eng2' : 'u-eng1', constructionManager: asset === 'compressor-station' ? 'u-cm2' : 'u-cm1' },
      }
    })
  }

  // Draft project object (used for preview estimate and creation)
  const draft = useMemo<Project>(() => buildProject(f, code, s.settings.asOf, tpl.stages.length === 3), [f, code, s.settings.asOf, tpl.stages.length])
  const lines = useMemo(() => parametricLines(draft, s.rates, pricingFor(s, draft), scopeQuantities(s, draft)), [draft, s.rates, s.settings])
  const estPreview = useMemo(() => {
    const maturity = Object.fromEntries((s.settings.estimating.maturityItems ?? MATURITY_ITEMS).map((m) => [m.key, m.key === 'need-defined']))
    const year = Number(s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4))
    void year
    const cls = computeClass(maturity, s.settings.estimating.maturityItems)
    const e = { lines, loaders: currentLoaders(s), escalationPct: escalationPctFor(s, basisYearOf(s, lines), spendMidpoint(s, draft)), contingency: { method: 'deterministic' as const, pct: contingencyForClass(s, cls) }, cls, salesTax: salesTaxFor(s, draft), region: draft.location.district, rateTableVersion: s.settings.estimating.rateTableVersion }
    return { ...e, maturity, totals: estimateTotals(e) }
  }, [lines, s.settings])
  const defs = requiredDefs(s, draft, 0)

  const problems: string[][] = [
    [!f.name.trim() && 'Give the project a name', f.need.trim().length < 20 && 'Describe the need in at least a sentence', !f.citation.trim() && 'Add the regulatory citation or driver reference', ...fieldDefs.filter((d) => d.requiredAtStage === 0 && !f.custom[d.key]?.trim()).map((d) => `${d.label} is required at initiation`)].filter(Boolean) as string[],
    [!f.lineId.trim() && f.asset !== 'compressor-station' && 'Enter the line or facility ID', f.asset !== 'compressor-station' && f.asset !== 'valve-site' && f.lengthFt <= 0 && 'Length must be greater than zero', !f.city.trim() && 'Enter the city'].filter(Boolean) as string[],
    [!f.team.sponsor && 'Name a sponsor', !f.team.pm && 'Name a project manager'].filter(Boolean) as string[],
    [],
  ]
  const canNext = problems[step].length === 0

  const create = () => {
    const pid = `prj-${nextNum}`
    let instTitle = ''
    mutate((d) => {
      const p: Project = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(draft))
      const rom = f.buildEstimate ? estPreview.totals.total : 0
      p.sizeTier = rom > 50_000_000 ? 'L' : rom > 5_000_000 || !rom ? 'M' : 'S'
      d.projects.push(p)
      ensureDeliverables(d, p)
      // charter deliverable starts in progress with the wizard output as its first draft
      const charter = d.deliverables.find((x) => x.projectId === pid && /charter/.test(x.defId))
      if (charter) { charter.status = 'in-progress'; charter.version = 1; charter.evidence = [{ id: uid('evd'), name: `${code}_Charter_draft.pdf`, sizeKb: 184, uploadedAt: nowISO(), byId: d.currentUserId }]; charter.updatedAt = nowISO() }
      if (f.buildEstimate && estPreview.lines.length) {
        const e: Estimate = {
          id: uid('est'), projectId: pid, version: 1, title: 'Class 5 rate-table estimate', cls: estPreview.cls, status: 'draft', method: 'parametric', createdAt: nowISO(), createdById: d.currentUserId,
          lines: estPreview.lines.map((l) => ({ ...l, id: uid('ln') })), maturity: estPreview.maturity, loaders: estPreview.loaders, escalationPct: estPreview.escalationPct, contingency: estPreview.contingency, salesTax: estPreview.salesTax, region: estPreview.region, rateTableVersion: estPreview.rateTableVersion,
          basis: {
            scopeBasis: p.scope.summary,
            assumptions: ['Quantities from GIS centerline length', 'Library P50 rates for matching asset, method, diameter and terrain', 'No land acquisition beyond temporary rights'],
            exclusions: ['Customer-side work', 'Unknown contamination', 'Escalation beyond the planned in-service year'],
            contingencyRationale: 'Deterministic 30% for Class 5 per estimating standard.',
            classJustification: 'Definition 0–2%: need, asset and length known; no design.',
          },
        }
        d.estimates.push(e)
