        d.audit.push({ id: uid('aud'), at: nowISO(), actorId: d.currentUserId, entity: 'estimate', entityId: e.id, projectId: pid, action: 'create', summary: `Draft Class ${e.cls} rate-table estimate ${money(estPreview.totals.total)} created from initiation` })
      }
      if (f.startWorkflow) {
        const inst = startWorkflow(d, 'project-initiation', { title: `${code} ${p.name}`, recordType: 'initiation', recordId: pid, projectId: pid, data: { need: f.need, amount: estPreview.totals.total, program: program.code, driver: f.driver } })
        if (inst) {
          instTitle = inst.title
          const slot = inst.active[0]
          if (slot && slot.assigneeIds.includes(d.currentUserId)) actOnWorkflow(d, inst.id, slot.nodeId, d.currentUserId, 'submit', 'Submitted from the initiation wizard')
        }
      }
    }, { entity: 'project', entityId: pid, projectId: pid, action: 'create', summary: `Initiated ${code} ${draft.name} (${program.code}, ${tpl.stages[0].name})` })
    toast(instTitle ? `${code} created and sent for program screening` : `${code} created`)
    go(projectHref(pid))
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <PageHeader eyebrow={<a href="#projects" className="hover:underline">Projects</a>} title="Initiate a project"
        subtitle="Capture the need, the asset and the team. Crosswalk creates the project at Stage 1 on the program's lifecycle template, opens its gate deliverables, drafts a Class 5 rate-table estimate from the unit-cost library, and routes the request for program screening." />
      <ol className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
        {STEPS.map((label, i) => (
          <li key={label}>
            <button disabled={i > step && problems.slice(0, i).some((p) => p.length)} onClick={() => setStep(i)} className={cx('flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-3 py-2 text-left text-[13px] font-semibold disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50', i === step ? 'border-ink bg-surface' : 'border-line bg-surface/60 text-muted hover:text-ink')}>
              <span className={cx('flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px]', i < step ? 'bg-good text-white' : i === step ? 'bg-marker text-markerink' : 'bg-sunken text-muted')}>{i < step ? '✓' : i + 1}</span>
              <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_320px]">
        <Panel title={STEPS[step]}>
          {step === 0 && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
              <Field label="Project name" className="md:col-span-2" hint="Line or facility, work type and place, e.g. “Line AV-15 Replacement — Old Mission Blvd”"><Input id="np-name" value={f.name} onChange={(e) => set('name', e.target.value)} placeholder="Line AV-27 Replacement — Arroyo Seco Crossing" /></Field>
              <Field label="Program"><Select id="np-program" value={f.programId} onChange={(e) => setProgram(e.target.value)} options={s.programs.map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: `${p.code} · ${p.name}` }))} /></Field>
              <Field label="Driver"><Select id="np-driver" value={f.driver} onChange={(e) => set('driver', e.target.value as Driver)} options={DRIVERS} /></Field>
              <Field label="Need statement" className="md:col-span-2" hint="What condition or requirement makes this work necessary? This becomes the charter need and the initiation request."><TextArea id="np-need" className="min-h-[90px]" value={f.need} onChange={(e) => set('need', e.target.value)} placeholder="Records review found no pressure test record for 1.6 miles of Line AV-27 in a Class 3 location; PU Code §958 requires test or replacement." /></Field>
              <Field label="Regulatory citation"><Input id="np-cite" value={f.citation} onChange={(e) => set('citation', e.target.value)} /></Field>
              <Field label="Funding proceeding"><Input id="np-proc" value={f.proceeding} onChange={(e) => set('proceeding', e.target.value)} /></Field>
              <div className="md:col-span-2"><KV cols={3} items={[['Recovery mechanism', program.recovery], ['Lifecycle template', tpl.name], ['DOA matrix', s.doaMatrices.find((m) => m.id === program.doaMatrixId)?.name ?? '—']]} /></div>
              {fieldDefs.map((d) => (
                <Field key={d.key} label={<span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">{d.label}{d.requiredAtStage !== undefined && <Badge tone={d.requiredAtStage === 0 ? 'bad' : 'neutral'}>Required by stage {d.requiredAtStage + 1}</Badge>}</span>}>
                  <Input id={`np-cf-${d.key}`} value={f.custom[d.key] ?? ''} onChange={(e) => set('custom', { ...f.custom, [d.key]: e.target.value })} />
                </Field>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          {step === 1 && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
                <Field label="Asset type"><Select id="np-asset" value={f.asset} onChange={(e) => { const a = e.target.value as AssetType; set('asset', a); set('method', ASSETS.find((x) => x.id === a)!.methods[0]) }} options={ASSETS.map((a) => ({ value: a.id, label: a.label }))} /></Field>
                <Field label="Work method"><Select id="np-method" value={f.method} onChange={(e) => set('method', e.target.value as WorkMethod)} options={ASSETS.find((a) => a.id === f.asset)!.methods.map((m) => ({ value: m, label: METHOD_LABEL[m] }))} /></Field>
                <Field label={f.asset === 'compressor-station' ? 'Facility ID' : 'Line ID'}><Input id="np-line" value={f.lineId} onChange={(e) => set('lineId', e.target.value)} placeholder={f.asset === 'compressor-station' ? 'STA-LAS' : '7100'} /></Field>
                {f.asset !== 'compressor-station' && <Field label="Diameter (in)"><Input id="np-dia" type="number" value={f.diameterIn} onChange={(e) => set('diameterIn', Number(e.target.value))} /></Field>}
                {f.asset !== 'compressor-station' && f.asset !== 'valve-site' && <Field label="Length (ft)" hint={`${(f.lengthFt / 5280).toFixed(2)} miles`}><Input id="np-len" type="number" value={f.lengthFt} onChange={(e) => set('lengthFt', Number(e.target.value))} /></Field>}
                {f.asset === 'valve-site' && <Field label="Valve sites"><Input id="np-sites" type="number" min={1} value={f.sites} onChange={(e) => set('sites', Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)))} /></Field>}
                <Field label="MAOP (psig)"><Input id="np-maop" type="number" value={f.maopPsig} onChange={(e) => set('maopPsig', Number(e.target.value))} /></Field>
                <Field label="Material"><Input id="np-mat" value={f.material} onChange={(e) => set('material', e.target.value)} /></Field>
                <Field label="Vintage"><Input id="np-vin" type="number" value={f.vintage} onChange={(e) => set('vintage', Number(e.target.value))} /></Field>
                <Field label="Records status"><Select id="np-rec" value={f.recordsStatus} onChange={(e) => set('recordsStatus', e.target.value as Form['recordsStatus'])} options={[{ value: 'complete', label: 'Complete (TVC)' }, { value: 'gaps', label: 'Gaps identified' }, { value: 'unknown', label: 'Unknown' }]} /></Field>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.1fr)]">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <Field label="District"><Select id="np-district" value={f.district} onChange={(e) => { const dn = e.target.value; const b = DISTRICTS[dn].box; setF((x) => ({ ...x, district: dn, city: DISTRICTS[dn].cities[0], x: Math.round((b[0] + b[2]) / 2), y: Math.round((b[1] + b[3]) / 2) })) }} options={Object.keys(DISTRICTS)} /></Field>
                  <Field label="City"><Input id="np-city" list="np-cities" value={f.city} onChange={(e) => set('city', e.target.value)} /><datalist id="np-cities">{DISTRICTS[f.district].cities.map((c) => <option key={c} value={c} />)}</datalist></Field>
                  <Field label="Terrain"><Select id="np-terrain" value={f.terrain} onChange={(e) => { const t = e.target.value as Terrain; setF((x) => ({ ...x, terrain: t, classLocation: t === 'urban' ? 3 : t === 'suburban' ? 2 : 1 })) }} options={['urban', 'suburban', 'rural']} /></Field>
                  <Field label="Class location"><Select id="np-class" value={String(f.classLocation)} onChange={(e) => set('classLocation', Number(e.target.value) as Form['classLocation'])} options={['1', '2', '3', '4'].map((c) => ({ value: c, label: `Class ${c}` }))} /></Field>
                  <div className="col-span-2 flex flex-col gap-2">
                    <Checkbox checked={f.hca} onChange={(v) => set('hca', v)} label="In a high consequence area (HCA)" />
                    <Checkbox checked={f.dac} onChange={(v) => set('dac', v)} label="Serves a disadvantaged community (DAC)" />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="mb-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">Map location <span className="font-normal text-faint">— click to place the pin</span></div>
                  <PlacePin x={f.x} y={f.y} onPlace={(x, y) => { const dn = Object.entries(DISTRICTS).find(([, v]) => x >= v.box[0] - 20 && x <= v.box[2] + 20 && y >= v.box[1] - 20 && y <= v.box[3] + 20)?.[0]; setF((s0) => ({ ...s0, x, y, district: dn ?? s0.district })) }} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {step === 2 && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
              <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Team positions drive workflow routing (for example, the controls review on a change request goes to the project's controls analyst) and deliverable ownership.</p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                {POSITIONS.map((x) => <Field key={x.pos} label={x.label}><PersonSelect id={`np-team-${x.pos}`} role={x.role} includeEmpty value={f.team[x.pos]} onChange={(v) => set('team', { ...f.team, [x.pos]: v || undefined })} /></Field>)}
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Stage 1 deliverables and owners</div>
                <div className="scroll-x"><table className="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Deliverable</th><th>Owner</th><th>Reviewer</th></tr></thead><tbody>
                  {defs.map((d) => <tr key={d.id}><td>{d.name}</td><td>{s.people.find((p) => p.id === ownerForRole(s, { ...draft }, d.ownerRole))?.name ?? '—'}</td><td className="text-muted">{s.people.find((p) => p.id === ownerForRole(s, { ...draft }, d.reviewerRole))?.name ?? '—'}</td></tr>)}
                </tbody></table></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {step === 3 && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              <div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted"><ProgramTag programId={f.programId} /><Mono className="font-semibold text-ink">{code}</Mono><span>{f.city}, {f.district} district</span></div>
                <h3 className="mt-1 font-display text-[19px] font-bold">{f.name || 'Untitled project'}</h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[13px]">{draft.scope.summary}</p>
              </div>
              <KV cols={3} items={[
                ['Driver', f.driver], ['Citation', f.citation], ['Proceeding', f.proceeding],
                ['Asset', `${ASSETS.find((a) => a.id === f.asset)!.label} · ${METHOD_LABEL[f.method]}`], ['Line / facility', f.lineId || '—'], ['MAOP', `${f.maopPsig} psig`],
                ['Location', `Class ${f.classLocation} · ${f.terrain}${f.hca ? ' · HCA' : ''}${f.dac ? ' · DAC' : ''}`], ['Sponsor', s.people.find((p) => p.id === f.team.sponsor)?.name], ['Project manager', s.people.find((p) => p.id === f.team.pm)?.name],
              ]} />
              <div className="rounded-md border border-line">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-line px-3 py-2">
                  <Checkbox checked={f.buildEstimate} onChange={(v) => set('buildEstimate', v)} label={<span className="font-semibold">Build a draft Class 5 rate-table estimate</span>} />
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><ClassBadge cls={estPreview.cls} /><span className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold tabular-nums">{money(estPreview.totals.total)}</span></span>
                </div>
                {f.buildEstimate && (
                  <div className="px-3 py-2">
                    {lines.length === 0 ? <Callout tone="warn">No library rates match this asset and work method. The estimator will build the estimate by hand.</Callout> : (
                      <>
                        <RangeBar low={estPreview.totals.low} point={estPreview.totals.total} high={estPreview.totals.high} />
                        <div className="mt-1 flex justify-between text-[11px] tabular-nums text-muted"><span>Low {money(estPreview.totals.low)} ({Math.round(CLASS_RANGES[estPreview.cls].low * 100)}%)</span><span>High {money(estPreview.totals.high)} (+{Math.round(CLASS_RANGES[estPreview.cls].high * 100)}%)</span></div>
                        <div className="scroll-x mt-2"><table className="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Library line</th><th className="num">Qty</th><th className="num">Unit P50</th><th className="num">Total</th></tr></thead><tbody>
                          {lines.map((l) => <tr key={l.id}><td>{l.description}</td><td className="num">{l.qty.toLocaleString()} {l.unit}</td><td className="num">{money(l.unitCost, 'full')}</td><td className="num">{money(Math.round(l.qty * l.unitCost))}</td></tr>)}
                          <tr><td className="text-muted">Loaders {estPreview.loaders.map((x) => x.pct).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0).toFixed(1)}% · escalation {estPreview.escalationPct}% · contingency 30%</td><td /><td /><td className="num">{money(estPreview.totals.loaders + estPreview.totals.escalation + estPreview.totals.contingency)}</td></tr>
                        </tbody></table></div>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              <Checkbox checked={f.startWorkflow} onChange={(v) => set('startWorkflow', v)} label={<span><b>Submit for program screening</b> — starts the Project initiation request workflow (program screening → portfolio planning → sponsor approval).</span>} />
              <Callout tone="info">The project opens at <b>{tpl.stages[0].name}</b> with {defs.length} gate deliverables. Its charter is marked in progress with this record as the first draft. Created by {me.name}; every field is recorded in the audit log.</Callout>
            </div>
          )}
          {problems[step].length > 0 && <div className="mt-4"><Callout tone="warn" title="Before you continue">{problems[step].map((p) => <div key={p}>• {p}</div>)}</Callout></div>}
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-2 border-t border-line pt-3">
            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => (step === 0 ? go('#projects') : setStep(step - 1))}>{step === 0 ? 'Cancel' : 'Back'}</Button>
            {step < 3 ? <Button variant="primary" disabled={!canNext} onClick={() => setStep(step + 1)}>Continue</Button> : <Button variant="primary" disabled={problems.some((p) => p.length)} onClick={create}>Create {code}</Button>}
          </div>
        </Panel>

        <aside className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Panel title="What happens next">
            <ol className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 text-[13px]">
              {tpl.stages.map((st, i) => (
                <li key={st.id} className="flex gap-2">
                  <span className={cx('mt-0.5 flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold', i === 0 ? 'bg-marker text-markerink' : 'bg-sunken text-muted')}>{i + 1}</span>
                  <span className="min-w-0"><b>{st.name}</b><span className="block text-xs text-muted">{st.gate.name}{st.gate.requiredEstimateClass ? ` · needs Class ${st.gate.requiredEstimateClass}` : ''}{st.gate.budgetEvent ? ` · sets ${st.gate.budgetEvent} budget` : ''}</span></span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>
          </Panel>
          <Panel title="Planned milestones">
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-[13px]">
              {draft.milestones.map((m) => <li key={m.id} className="flex justify-between gap-2"><span className="truncate">{m.name}</span><span className="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-muted">{m.baseline}</span></li>)}
            </ul>
            <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-faint">Indicative dates from typical stage durations; the scheduler sets the baseline at option selection.</p>
          </Panel>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function PlacePin({ x, y, onPlace }: { x: number; y: number; onPlace: (x: number, y: number) => void }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 1000 600" className="w-full cursor-crosshair rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken/40" onClick={(e) => {
      const r = (e.currentTarget as SVGSVGElement).getBoundingClientRect()
      onPlace(Math.round(((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * 1000), Math.round(((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * 600))
    }}>
      {Object.entries(DISTRICTS).map(([n, v]) => (
        <g key={n}>
          <rect x={v.box[0] - 20} y={v.box[1] - 20} width={v.box[2] - v.box[0] + 40} height={v.box[3] - v.box[1] + 40} rx={40} fill="rgb(var(--surface))" stroke="rgb(var(--line))" strokeWidth={2} />
          <text x={(v.box[0] + v.box[2]) / 2} y={v.box[1] + 4} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={22} fontWeight={700} fill="rgb(var(--faint))" letterSpacing="0.12em">{n.toUpperCase()}</text>
        </g>
      ))}
      <path d="M30 420 C 140 410, 220 395, 300 375 S 470 352, 560 320 S 760 268, 980 250" fill="none" stroke="rgb(var(--steel))" strokeOpacity={0.3} strokeWidth={5} />
      <g transform={`translate(${x} ${y})`}><circle r={18} fill="rgb(var(--marker))" fillOpacity={0.35} stroke="rgb(var(--marker))" strokeWidth={3} /><circle r={5} fill="rgb(var(--ink))" /></g>
    </svg>
  )
}

function buildProject(f: Form, code: string, asOf: string, small: boolean): Project {
  const isStation = f.asset === 'compressor-station', isValve = f.asset === 'valve-site'
  const miles = +(f.lengthFt / 5280).toFixed(1)
  const lengthFt = isStation || isValve ? 0 : f.lengthFt
  const quantities = isValve
    ? [{ label: 'Valve sites automated', qty: f.sites, unit: 'ea' }]
    : isStation
      ? [{ label: 'Compressor units', qty: f.method === 'compressor-replacement' ? 4 : 2, unit: 'ea' }, { label: 'Station capacity', qty: f.method === 'compressor-replacement' ? 22000 : 9000, unit: 'hp' }]
      : f.method === 'hydrotest'
        ? [{ label: 'Pipe tested', qty: lengthFt, unit: 'ft' }, { label: 'Test sections', qty: Math.max(2, Math.round(lengthFt / 4200)), unit: 'ea' }]
        : [{ label: 'Pipe installed', qty: lengthFt, unit: 'ft' }, { label: 'Tie-ins', qty: 2, unit: 'ea' }]
  const summary = isValve
    ? `Install remote-control valves with SCADA at ${f.sites} mainline valve site(s) on Line ${f.lineId || '—'} to meet automatic shutoff requirements.`
    : isStation
      ? `${f.method === 'station-rebuild' ? 'Rebuild' : 'Replace compression at'} ${f.city} station with electric-drive units, new substation and controls; decommission legacy units.`
      : f.method === 'hydrotest'
        ? `Pressure test ${miles} miles of ${f.diameterIn}-inch Line ${f.lineId || '—'} to establish MAOP records; replace short sections that cannot be tested.`
        : `Replace ${miles} miles of ${f.diameterIn}-inch ${f.asset === 'distribution-main' ? 'distribution main' : `Line ${f.lineId || '—'}`} through ${f.city} by ${f.method === 'replace-hdd' ? 'horizontal directional drill' : 'open trench'}; abandon existing pipe in place.`
  const durs = small ? [150, 240, 300] : [160, 240, 320, isStation ? 720 : 300, 150]
  const names = small ? ['Plan approved', 'Construction authorized', 'In service & closed'] : ['Business case approved', 'Option selected', 'Construction authorized', 'In service', 'Closeout complete']
  let acc = asOf
  const milestones: Milestone[] = names.map((name, i) => { acc = addDays(acc, durs[i]); return { id: uid('ms'), name, baseline: acc, forecast: acc } })
  if (!small) { const auth = milestones[2].baseline; milestones.splice(3, 0, { id: uid('ms'), name: 'Construction start', baseline: addDays(auth, 30), forecast: addDays(auth, 30) }) }
  const n = code.slice(4)
  const progCode = f.programId.slice(4).toUpperCase()
  return {
    id: `prj-${n}`, code, info: { problemStatement: f.need ?? '' }, name: f.name.trim() || 'Untitled project', programId: f.programId, sizeTier: 'M', driver: f.driver, regulatoryCitation: f.citation, fundingProceeding: f.proceeding,
    location: { district: f.district, city: f.city, county: DISTRICTS[f.district].county, x: f.x, y: f.y, classLocation: f.classLocation, hca: f.hca, dac: f.dac, terrain: f.terrain },
    asset: { type: f.asset, lineId: f.lineId || (isStation ? 'STA-' + f.city.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase() : 'DIST'), diameterIn: isStation ? 0 : f.diameterIn, lengthFt, maopPsig: f.maopPsig, material: f.material, vintage: f.vintage, recordsStatus: f.recordsStatus },
    workMethod: f.method, team: { ...f.team }, stageIndex: 0, status: 'active',
    health: { scope: 'green', schedule: 'green', cost: 'green', risk: 'green', safety: 'green' },
    scope: {
      summary,
      inScope: isStation ? ['Compressor units and motors', 'Substation and interconnect', 'Station piping and controls', 'Demolition of legacy units', 'Air permit compliance']
        : isValve ? ['Valve and actuator installation', 'SCADA RTU and communications', 'Site civil work', 'Commissioning with gas control']
          : ['Engineering, survey and design', 'Land rights and permits', 'Construction and inspection', 'Tie-ins and gas handling', 'Restoration'],
      outOfScope: ['Customer meter work', 'Unrelated leak repairs'],
      quantities,
      assumptions: ['Outage windows available October–April', 'Work hours 7 AM–6 PM weekdays in residential areas'],
    },
    milestones, dates: { initiated: asOf }, erpWbs: `C.${progCode}.${n}`, scheduleId: `P6-${n}`, gisIds: isStation ? [`FAC-${n}`] : [`SEG-${f.lineId || 'NEW'}-001`],
    permitsNeeded: { ceqa: isStation || f.terrain === 'rural', encroachment: !isStation, hydrotestDischarge: f.method === 'hydrotest' },
    customFields: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(f.custom).filter(([, v]) => v.trim())),
    lastStatusNote: 'Initiated; need submitted for program screening.',
  }
}

===== FILE: src/views/projects/Projects.tsx =====
// Project register: filterable/sortable table with quick filters, CSV export and a territory map toggle.
import { prefs } from '@/core/data'
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useMe, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { go, projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { daysBetween, fmtDate, money, moneyDelta, cx, sum } from '@/core/util'
import { saveFile, toCSV } from '@/core/download'
import { Badge, Button, HealthDot, Input, Mono, PageHeader, Panel, Progress, SegButtons, Select, StageTrack, StatusBadge, Table, Empty, type Column } from '@/ui/kit'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'
import { PHASES, projectRow, type ProjectRow } from '../portfolio/lib'
import { TerritoryMap } from './TerritoryMap'

type Quick = 'all' | 'mine' | 'over' | 'gate60' | 'construction' | 'red'
const QUICK: { id: Quick; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'all', label: 'All' },
  { id: 'mine', label: 'My projects' },
  { id: 'over', label: 'Over budget' },
  { id: 'gate60', label: 'Gate due ≤ 60d' },
  { id: 'construction', label: 'Construction' },
  { id: 'red', label: 'Red health' },
]

const VIEW_KEY = 'crosswalk:projects:view'
function loadPref(): { view: 'table' | 'map'; quick: Quick } {
  try { const v = JSON.parse(prefs.getRaw(VIEW_KEY) || '{}'); return { view: v.view === 'map' ? 'map' : 'table', quick: QUICK.some((q) => q.id === v.quick) ? v.quick : 'all' } } catch { return { view: 'table', quick: 'all' } }
}
function savePref(v: { view: string; quick: string }) { try { prefs.setRaw(VIEW_KEY, JSON.stringify(v)) } catch { /* storage blocked */ } }

export default function Projects(_props: { projectId?: string; id?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const me = useMe()
  const pref = useMemo(loadPref, [])
  const [view, setViewRaw] = useState<'table' | 'map'>(pref.view)
  const [quick, setQuickRaw] = useState<Quick>(pref.quick)
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [program, setProgram] = useState('')
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState('')
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('open')
  const [pm, setPm] = useState('')
  const setView = (v: 'table' | 'map') => { setViewRaw(v); savePref({ view: v, quick }) }
  const setQuick = (v: Quick) => { setQuickRaw(v); savePref({ view, quick: v }) }

  const all = useMemo(() => s.projects.map((p) => projectRow(s, p)), [s])
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const isMine = (r: ProjectRow) => Object.values(r.p.team).includes(me.id)
  const rows = all.filter((r) => {
    if (quick === 'mine' && !isMine(r)) return false
    if (quick === 'over' && !(r.variance > 0)) return false
    if (quick === 'gate60' && !(r.nextReview && daysBetween(asOf, r.nextReview.scheduled) <= 60)) return false
    if (quick === 'construction' && r.phase !== 3) return false
    if (quick === 'red' && r.overall !== 'red') return false
    if (program && r.p.programId !== program) return false
    if (phase !== '' && String(r.phase) !== phase) return false
    if (status === 'open' && !(r.p.status === 'active' || r.p.status === 'on-hold')) return false
    if (status !== 'open' && status !== '' && r.p.status !== status) return false
    if (pm && r.p.team.pm !== pm) return false
    if (q.trim()) {
      const hay = `${r.p.code} ${r.p.name} ${r.p.location.city} ${r.p.location.district} ${r.pmName} ${r.p.asset.lineId}`.toLowerCase()
      if (!hay.includes(q.toLowerCase())) return false
    }
    return true
  })
  const mineCount = all.filter(isMine).length
  const pms = s.people.filter((p) => p.roles.includes('pm'))

  const columns: Column<ProjectRow>[] = [
    { key: 'code', header: 'Project', sort: (r) => r.p.code, render: (r) => (
      <a href={projectHref(r.p.id)} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} className="flex min-w-[240px] max-w-[360px] flex-col">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><ProgramTag programId={r.p.programId} /><Mono className="font-semibold">{r.p.code}</Mono>{r.p.status !== 'active' && <StatusBadge status={r.p.status} />}</span>
        <span className="truncate font-semibold text-ink" title={r.p.name}>{r.p.name}</span>
        <span className="text-[11px] text-faint">{r.p.location.city} · {r.p.location.district} · Tier {r.p.sizeTier}</span>
      </a>
    ) },
    { key: 'stage', header: 'Stage', sort: (r) => r.phase * 10 + r.p.stageIndex, render: (r) => (
      <div className="w-[150px]"><StageTrack stages={r.stages} current={r.p.stageIndex} status={r.p.status} /><div className="mt-1 truncate text-[11px] text-muted" title={r.stageName}>{r.p.stageIndex + 1}/{r.stages.length} · {r.stageName}</div></div>
    ) },
    { key: 'health', header: 'Health', sort: (r) => ({ red: 0, amber: 1, green: 2 })[r.overall], render: (r) => (
      <span className="flex gap-1" title={`Scope ${r.p.health.scope} · Schedule ${r.p.health.schedule} · Cost ${r.p.health.cost} · Risk ${r.p.health.risk} · Safety ${r.p.health.safety}`}>
        {(['scope', 'schedule', 'cost', 'risk', 'safety'] as const).map((k) => <HealthDot key={k} rag={r.p.health[k]} />)}
      </span>
    ) },
    { key: 'pm', header: 'PM', sort: (r) => r.pmName, render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{r.pmName}</span> },
    { key: 'budget', header: 'Budget', num: true, sort: (r) => r.budget, render: (r) => <span title={r.budgetBasis === 'estimate' ? 'No budget yet — latest estimate shown' : `${r.budgetBasis} budget`}>{money(r.budget)}{r.budgetBasis === 'estimate' && <span className="ml-1 text-[10px] text-faint">est</span>}{r.budgetBasis === 'planning' && <span className="ml-1 text-[10px] text-faint">plan</span>}</span> },
    { key: 'eac', header: 'EAC', num: true, sort: (r) => r.eac, render: (r) => money(r.eac) },
    { key: 'var', header: 'Variance', num: true, sort: (r) => r.variance, render: (r) => r.budgetBasis === 'estimate' || r.budgetBasis === 'none' ? <span className="text-faint">—</span> : <span className={cx('font-semibold', r.variance > 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{moneyDelta(r.variance)}</span> },
    { key: 'next', header: 'Next milestone', sort: (r) => r.next?.forecast ?? '9', render: (r) => r.next ? (
      <div className="min-w-[150px]"><div className="truncate text-[13px]">{r.next.name}</div><div className="text-[11px] text-muted">{fmtDate(r.next.forecast)}{r.nextSlip > 0 && <span className={cx('ml-1 font-semibold', r.nextSlip > 30 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-warn')}>+{r.nextSlip}d</span>}</div></div>
    ) : <span className="text-faint">—</span> },
    { key: 'ready', header: 'Gate readiness', sort: (r) => r.readiness, render: (r) => r.p.status === 'active' ? (
      <div className="w-[120px]" title={r.blockers.join('\n') || 'Ready for gate'}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]"><span className="tabular-nums font-semibold">{r.readiness}%</span>{r.nextReview && <span className="text-faint">{fmtDate(r.nextReview.scheduled).replace(/, \d{4}/, '')}</span>}</div>
        <Progress value={r.readiness} tone={r.readiness >= 80 ? 'good' : r.readiness >= 50 ? 'warn' : 'bad'} />
      </div>
    ) : <span className="text-faint">—</span> },
  ]

  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const res = await saveFile(`project-register-${asOf}.csv`, toCSV(rows.map((r) => ({
      Project: r.p.code, Name: r.p.name, Program: r.programCode, District: r.p.location.district, City: r.p.location.city, Stage: `${r.p.stageIndex + 1}/${r.stages.length} ${r.stageName}`, Status: r.p.status,
      PM: r.pmName, Sponsor: s.people.find((x) => x.id === r.p.team.sponsor)?.name ?? '', Budget: r.budget, BudgetBasis: r.budgetBasis, EAC: r.eac, Variance: r.variance, ActualToDate: r.pos.actualToDate,
      ContingencyRemaining: r.pos.contingencyRemaining, Health: r.overall, Scope: r.p.health.scope, Schedule: r.p.health.schedule, Cost: r.p.health.cost, Risk: r.p.health.risk, Safety: r.p.health.safety,
      NextMilestone: r.next?.name ?? '', NextMilestoneForecast: r.next?.forecast ?? '', SlipDays: r.nextSlip, GateReadinessPct: r.readiness, NextGateReview: r.nextReview?.scheduled ?? '', ErpWbs: r.p.erpWbs,
    }))), 'text/csv')
    if (res === 'saved') toast(`Exported ${rows.length} projects`)
    else if (res === 'unavailable') toast('Download is not available here', 'bad')
  }

  const totBudget = sum(rows.map((r) => r.budget)), totEac = sum(rows.map((r) => r.eac))
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow="Capital delivery"
        title="Project register"
        subtitle={`${all.filter((r) => r.p.status === 'active').length} active projects across ${s.programs.length} programs. Budget shows the control budget once authorized, else the planning budget or latest estimate.`}
        actions={<>
          <SegButtons value={view} onChange={setView} options={[{ id: 'table', label: 'Table' }, { id: 'map', label: 'Map' }]} />
          <Button icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-4 w-4" />} onClick={exportCsv}>Export CSV</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" icon={<Icon name="plus" className="h-4 w-4" />} onClick={() => go('#new-project')}>New project</Button>
        </>}
      />
      <Panel pad={false}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 border-b border-line px-3 py-2.5">
          <div className="scroll-x flex gap-1">
            {QUICK.map((x) => {
              const n = x.id === 'mine' ? mineCount : undefined
              return <button key={x.id} onClick={() => setQuick(x.id)} className={cx('shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold', quick === x.id ? 'border-ink bg-ink text-surface' : 'border-line text-muted hover:text-ink')}>{x.label}{n !== undefined && <span className="ml-1 opacity-70">{n}</span>}</button>
            })}
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,2fr)_repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))]">
            <div className="relative col-span-2 md:col-span-1">
              <Icon name="search" className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-faint" />
              <Input id="proj-search" className="pl-8" placeholder="Search number, name, city, PM, line" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <Select id="proj-program" value={program} onChange={(e) => setProgram(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All programs' }, ...s.programs.map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: `${p.code} · ${p.name}` }))]} />
            <Select id="proj-phase" value={phase} onChange={(e) => setPhase(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All phases' }, ...PHASES.map((p, i) => ({ value: String(i), label: p }))]} />
            <Select id="proj-status" value={status} onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: 'open', label: 'Active & on hold' }, { value: '', label: 'All statuses' }, { value: 'active', label: 'Active' }, { value: 'on-hold', label: 'On hold' }, { value: 'closed', label: 'Closed' }, { value: 'cancelled', label: 'Cancelled' }]} />
            <Select id="proj-pm" value={pm} onChange={(e) => setPm(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All PMs' }, ...pms.map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: p.name }))]} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-muted">
            <span><b className="tabular-nums text-ink">{rows.length}</b> projects</span>
            <span>Budget <b className="tabular-nums text-ink">{money(totBudget)}</b></span>
            <span>EAC <b className={cx('tabular-nums', totEac > totBudget ? 'text-bad' : 'text-ink')}>{money(totEac)}</b></span>
            <span>Actual <b className="tabular-nums text-ink">{money(sum(rows.map((r) => r.pos.actualToDate)))}</b></span>
            {(q || program || phase || pm || status !== 'open' || quick !== 'all') && <button className="font-semibold text-link hover:underline" onClick={() => { setQ(''); setProgram(''); setPhase(''); setPm(''); setStatus('open'); setQuick('all') }}>Clear filters</button>}
            {quick === 'mine' && mineCount === 0 && <Badge tone="info">You are not on any project team. Switch persona to a PM to see theirs.</Badge>}
          </div>
        </div>
        {view === 'table' ? (
          <Table rows={rows} columns={columns} rowKey={(r) => r.p.id} onRowClick={(r) => go(projectHref(r.p.id))} maxHeight={680}
            empty={<div className="p-4"><Empty title="No projects match">Change the filters or clear them.</Empty></div>} />
        ) : (
          <div className="p-3">{rows.length ? <TerritoryMap rows={rows} /> : <Empty title="No projects match">Change the filters or clear them.</Empty>}</div>
        )}
      </Panel>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/projects/TerritoryMap.tsx =====
// Schematic territory map: districts as soft regions, fictional transmission lines, project pins
// colored by overall health and sized by budget. Hover shows a card; click opens the project.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { projectHref, go } from '@/core/router'
import { money, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, HealthDot, Mono, StageTrack } from '@/ui/kit'
import type { ProjectRow } from '../portfolio/lib'

const W = 1000, H = 600

const DISTRICTS: { name: string; d: string; label: [number, number] }[] = [
  { name: 'North', d: 'M240 40 C 340 18, 520 22, 640 34 C 720 42, 760 90, 742 150 C 728 205, 650 228, 540 222 C 430 218, 320 230, 262 200 C 214 174, 196 70, 240 40 Z', label: [490, 62] },
  { name: 'West', d: 'M70 300 C 120 262, 250 270, 330 292 C 372 304, 358 400, 350 470 C 342 540, 290 572, 190 566 C 110 560, 60 520, 52 450 C 46 390, 40 330, 70 300 Z', label: [150, 290] },
  { name: 'East', d: 'M350 262 C 430 240, 560 244, 628 262 C 660 272, 652 380, 640 450 C 630 510, 560 522, 470 516 C 400 512, 360 494, 356 440 C 352 380, 320 280, 350 262 Z', label: [490, 538] },
  { name: 'South', d: 'M648 222 C 720 200, 880 196, 940 226 C 970 244, 962 380, 950 460 C 940 520, 880 540, 790 536 C 712 532, 660 516, 652 450 C 646 380, 620 236, 648 222 Z', label: [800, 214] },
]

// Fictional transmission backbone (schematic): main trunks with line ids.
const LINES: { id: string; d: string; major?: boolean }[] = [
  { id: 'L-1185', d: 'M30 420 C 140 410, 220 395, 300 375 S 470 352, 560 320 S 760 268, 980 250', major: true },
  { id: 'L-2003', d: 'M560 320 C 650 300, 760 300, 905 262', major: true },
  { id: 'L-4000', d: 'M300 375 C 360 420, 430 440, 520 446 S 700 470, 820 452' },
  { id: 'L-85', d: 'M330 70 C 360 120, 420 150, 470 200 S 520 280, 560 320' },
  { id: 'L-5000', d: 'M820 452 C 860 480, 900 500, 975 512' },
  { id: 'L-1004', d: 'M60 520 C 110 500, 160 470, 220 420' },
  { id: 'L-2000', d: 'M560 60 C 580 120, 590 170, 575 220' },
]

const healthFill = { green: 'rgb(var(--good))', amber: 'rgb(var(--warn))', red: 'rgb(var(--bad))' } as const

export function TerritoryMap({ rows }: { rows: ProjectRow[] }) {
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const maxB = Math.max(...rows.map((r) => r.budget), 1)
  const radius = (b: number) => 6 + Math.sqrt(Math.max(b, 0) / maxB) * 22
  const sel = rows.find((r) => r.p.id === (pinned ?? hover))
  // a few stations along the lines for context
  const stations = useMemo(() => rows.filter((r) => r.p.asset.type === 'compressor-station'), [rows])
  const ordered = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => b.budget - a.budget)
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} className="w-full rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken/40" role="img" aria-label="Service territory map" onClick={() => setPinned(null)}>
        <defs>
          <pattern id="tm-grid" width="40" height="40" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M40 0H0V40" fill="none" stroke="rgb(var(--line))" strokeWidth="0.6" opacity="0.6" /></pattern>
        </defs>
        <rect width={W} height={H} fill="url(#tm-grid)" />
        {/* coastline */}
        <path d="M0 330 C 30 360, 20 420, 40 470 S 30 560, 60 600 L0 600 Z" fill="rgb(var(--info))" opacity="0.12" />
        <text x={14} y={590} fontSize={11} fill="rgb(var(--faint))" fontStyle="italic">Pacific</text>
        {DISTRICTS.map((d) => (
          <g key={d.name}>
            <path d={d.d} fill="rgb(var(--surface))" stroke="rgb(var(--line))" strokeWidth={1.5} opacity={0.9} />
            <text x={d.label[0]} y={d.label[1]} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={12} fontWeight={700} letterSpacing="0.14em" fill="rgb(var(--faint))">{d.name.toUpperCase()}</text>
          </g>
        ))}
        {LINES.map((l) => (
          <g key={l.id}>
            <path d={l.d} fill="none" stroke="rgb(var(--steel))" strokeOpacity={0.35} strokeWidth={l.major ? 3.5 : 2} strokeLinecap="round" />
            <path d={l.d} fill="none" stroke="rgb(var(--marker))" strokeOpacity={0.55} strokeWidth={l.major ? 1.2 : 0.8} strokeDasharray="6 6" />
          </g>
        ))}
        {[['L-1185', 36, 412], ['L-2003', 880, 256], ['L-4000', 430, 450], ['L-85', 336, 92], ['L-5000', 930, 500]].map(([id, x, y]) => (
          <text key={id as string} x={x as number} y={(y as number) - 6} fontSize={10} fontFamily="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" fill="rgb(var(--muted))">{id}</text>
        ))}
        {stations.map((r) => <rect key={'st' + r.p.id} x={r.p.location.x - 4} y={r.p.location.y - 4} width={8} height={8} fill="rgb(var(--steel))" opacity={0.25} transform={`rotate(45 ${r.p.location.x} ${r.p.location.y})`} />)}
        {ordered.map((r) => {
          const rr = radius(r.budget)
          const active = r.p.id === (pinned ?? hover)
          const closed = r.p.status === 'closed'
          return (
            <g key={r.p.id} transform={`translate(${r.p.location.x} ${r.p.location.y})`} className="cursor-pointer"
              onMouseEnter={() => setHover(r.p.id)} onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); if (pinned === r.p.id) go(projectHref(r.p.id)); else setPinned(r.p.id) }}>
              <circle r={rr} fill={closed ? 'rgb(var(--faint))' : healthFill[r.overall]} fillOpacity={closed ? 0.25 : 0.32} stroke={closed ? 'rgb(var(--faint))' : healthFill[r.overall]} strokeWidth={active ? 3 : 1.5} strokeDasharray={r.p.status === 'on-hold' ? '3 2' : undefined} />
              <circle r={2.5} fill={closed ? 'rgb(var(--faint))' : healthFill[r.overall]} />
              {(rr > 14 || active) && <text y={-rr - 4} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10.5} fontWeight={600} fontFamily="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" fill="rgb(var(--ink))">{r.p.code.slice(4)}</text>}
            </g>
          )
        })}
      </svg>
      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-muted">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><HealthDot rag="green" /> On track</span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><HealthDot rag="amber" /> Watch</span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><HealthDot rag="red" /> Act</span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full border border-dashed border-faint" /> On hold</span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-faint/40" /> Closed</span>
        <span>Pin size = current budget · Tap a pin to pin its card, tap again to open</span>
      </div>
      {sel && (
        <div className={cx('fadein absolute right-2 top-2 w-[min(320px,calc(100%-16px))] rounded-md border border-line bg-surface p-3 shadow-xl')}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted">
            <Mono className="font-semibold text-ink">{sel.p.code}</Mono>
            <span>{sel.programCode}</span><span>·</span><span>{sel.p.location.city}</span>
            {sel.p.status !== 'active' && <Badge tone={sel.p.status === 'closed' ? 'neutral' : 'warn'}>{sel.p.status}</Badge>}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-0.5 font-display text-[15px] font-semibold leading-snug">{sel.p.name}</div>
          <div className="mt-2"><StageTrack stages={sel.stages} current={sel.p.stageIndex} status={sel.p.status} /><div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted">{sel.stageName}</div></div>
          <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-[12px]">
            <div><div className="text-faint">Budget</div><div className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{money(sel.budget)}</div></div>
            <div><div className="text-faint">EAC</div><div className={cx('font-semibold tabular-nums', sel.variance > 0 && 'text-bad')}>{money(sel.eac)}</div></div>
            <div><div className="text-faint">Readiness</div><div className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{sel.readiness}%</div></div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {(['scope', 'schedule', 'cost', 'risk', 'safety'] as const).map((k) => <HealthDot key={k} rag={sel.p.health[k]} label={k[0].toUpperCase() + k.slice(1)} />)}
          </div>
          <a href={projectHref(sel.p.id)} className="mt-2 inline-block text-[13px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline">Open project →</a>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/regulatory/Regulatory.tsx =====
// Rate case & evidence (#regulatory): authorized vs recorded vs forecast (BL-08), reasonableness-review
// readiness across projects, large-project annual report, program evidence package, regulatory snapshots (RC-02).
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { mutate, useStore, personName } from '@/core/store'
import type { AppState } from '@/core/types'
import { activeBudget, position, snapshotsFor, takeSnapshot } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { stageName } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { saveFile, toCSV } from '@/core/download'
import { go, projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { fmtDate, money, moneyDelta, sum, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Checkbox, Field, Input, Modal, PageHeader, Panel, Progress, SegButtons, Stat, StatusBadge, Table, Mono } from '@/ui/kit'
import { BarChart } from '@/ui/charts'
import { ProgramSelect, ProgramTag } from '../shared/pickers'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { assessEvidence, forecastByYear, actualsByYear, programYears } from '../project/tabs/controls/trace'
import { evidenceRows, programBinderHtml } from '../project/tabs/controls/binder'

const LARGE = 50_000_000
const CPCN = 75_000_000

export default function Regulatory() {
  const s = useStore()
  const [programId, setProgramId] = useState('')
  const [snapOpen, setSnapOpen] = useState(false)
  const year = Number(s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4))
  const years = useMemo(() => programYears(s, programId || undefined), [s, programId])
  const projects = s.projects.filter((p) => (!programId || p.programId === programId) && p.status !== 'cancelled')
  const assessed = useMemo(() => projects.filter((p) => s.budgets.some((b) => b.projectId === p.id)).map((p) => ({ p, a: assessEvidence(s, p.id), pos: position(s, p.id) })), [s, programId]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const cur = years.find((y) => y.year === year)
  const ready = assessed.filter((x) => x.a.score >= 90).length
  const avg = assessed.length ? Math.round(sum(assessed.map((x) => x.a.score * Math.max(1, x.pos.currentBudget))) / sum(assessed.map((x) => Math.max(1, x.pos.currentBudget)))) : 0
  const prog = s.programs.find((x) => x.id === programId)
  const regSnaps = s.snapshots.filter((x) => x.type === 'regulatory' && projects.some((p) => p.id === x.projectId)).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))

  const downloadProgram = async (kind: 'html' | 'csv') => {
    if (!prog) return
    const pids = assessed.map((x) => x.p.id)
    const r = kind === 'html'
      ? await saveFile(`${prog.code}-program-evidence-package-${s.settings.asOf}.html`, programBinderHtml(s, prog.id, pids), 'text/html')
      : await saveFile(`${prog.code}-program-evidence-extract-${s.settings.asOf}.csv`, toCSV(pids.flatMap((id) => evidenceRows(s, id))), 'text/csv')
    if (r === 'saved') { mutate(() => {}, { entity: 'evidence', entityId: prog.id, action: 'export', summary: `Downloaded ${prog.code} program evidence ${kind === 'html' ? 'binder' : 'CSV'} (${pids.length} projects)` }); toast(kind === 'html' ? 'Program binder saved' : 'Program CSV saved') }
    else if (r === 'unavailable') toast('Download is not available here', 'bad')
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <PageHeader eyebrow="Controls" title="Rate case & evidence" subtitle="Authorized funding against recorded and forecast cost, and how ready each project is for a reasonableness review. Every figure is computed from budgets, ERP cost periods, signed forecasts and approved decisions."
        actions={<>
          <div className="w-[260px]"><ProgramSelect value={programId} onChange={setProgramId} /></div>
          <Button onClick={() => setSnapOpen(true)} icon={<Icon name="plus" className="h-4 w-4" />}>Regulatory snapshot</Button>
        </>} />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-5">
        <Stat label={`Authorized ${year}`} value={money(cur?.authorized)} sub={cur?.proceeding || '—'} />
        <Stat label={`Recorded ${year} to date`} value={money(cur?.recorded)} sub={cur?.authorized ? `${((cur.recorded / cur.authorized) * 100).toFixed(0)}% of authorized` : undefined} />
        <Stat label={`Forecast ${year}`} value={money(cur?.forecast)} tone={cur && cur.forecast > cur.authorized ? 'bad' : 'good'} sub={cur ? `${moneyDelta(cur.forecast - cur.authorized)} vs authorized` : undefined} />
        <Stat label="Review readiness" value={`${avg}%`} tone={avg >= 90 ? 'good' : avg >= 75 ? 'warn' : 'bad'} sub={`Dollar-weighted · ${ready} of ${assessed.length} projects ≥ 90%`} />
        <Stat label="Large projects" value={assessed.filter((x) => Math.max(x.pos.currentBudget, x.pos.eac) >= LARGE).length} sub={`≥ ${money(LARGE)} · ${assessed.filter((x) => Math.max(x.pos.currentBudget, x.pos.eac) > CPCN).length} over CPCN threshold`} />
      </div>

      <FundingPanel s={s} years={years} programId={programId} year={year} />
      <ReadinessPanel assessed={assessed} s={s} />
      <LargeProjectsPanel s={s} assessed={assessed} year={year} />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <Panel title="Program evidence package" subtitle="One binder covering every budgeted project in the program — cover, estimates, baselines, change approval chains, variances, contingency, safety, records and gates.">
          {prog ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
              <div className="text-[13px]"><ProgramTag programId={prog.id} /> <b>{prog.name}</b> · {prog.regulatoryDriver} · recovery via {prog.recovery}</div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-[13px]">
                <MiniFig k="Projects" v={String(assessed.length)} />
                <MiniFig k="Gaps to close" v={String(sum(assessed.map((x) => x.a.gaps.length)))} />
                <MiniFig k="Recorded" v={money(sum(assessed.map((x) => x.pos.actualToDate)))} />
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><Button variant="primary" onClick={() => downloadProgram('html')} icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-4 w-4" />}>Download HTML binder</Button><Button onClick={() => downloadProgram('csv')} icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-4 w-4" />}>CSV extract</Button></div>
            </div>
          ) : <Callout tone="info">Choose a program above to assemble its evidence package.<div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">{s.programs.map((p) => <Button key={p.id} size="sm" onClick={() => setProgramId(p.id)}>{p.code}</Button>)}</div></Callout>}
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Regulatory snapshots" subtitle="Positions frozen for a filing or data request" pad={false}>
          <Table rows={regSnaps} rowKey={(x) => x.id} dense maxHeight={260} empty={<p className="p-4 text-[13px] text-muted">No regulatory snapshots yet. Take one to freeze every active project's position for a proceeding.</p>} columns={[
            { key: 'd', header: 'Date', render: (x) => fmtDate(x.date) },
            { key: 'p', header: 'Project', render: (x) => <a className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline" href={projectHref(x.projectId, 'baselines')}>{s.projects.find((p) => p.id === x.projectId)?.code}</a> },
            { key: 'g', header: 'Proceeding', render: (x) => <span className="text-[12.5px]">{x.proceeding}</span> },
            { key: 'b', header: 'Budget', num: true, render: (x) => money(x.budget.total) },
            { key: 'e', header: 'EAC', num: true, render: (x) => money(x.budget.eac) },
            { key: 'by', header: 'By', render: (x) => <span className="text-xs text-muted">{personName(s, x.createdById)}</span> },
          ]} />
        </Panel>
      </div>
      <RegSnapshotModal open={snapOpen} onClose={() => setSnapOpen(false)} initialProgram={programId} />
    </div>
  )
}

function MiniFig({ k, v }: { k: string; v: string }) {
  return <div className="rounded-md border border-line px-2.5 py-2"><div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-faint">{k}</div><div className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold tabular-nums">{v}</div></div>
}

// ───────────────────────────── BL-08
function FundingPanel({ s, years, programId, year }: { s: AppState; years: ReturnType<typeof programYears>; programId: string; year: number }) {
  const [view, setView] = useState<'years' | 'programs'>('years')
  const shown = years.filter((y) => y.authorized || y.recorded || y.forecast)
  const progRows = s.programs.map((pr) => { const y = programYears(s, pr.id).find((x) => x.year === year); return { pr, y } })
  return (
    <Panel title="Authorized vs recorded vs forecast" subtitle={view === 'years' ? `By year${programId ? '' : ', all programs'} · recorded = ERP actuals; forecast = actuals for past years plus the signed EAC spread for the rest` : `By program for ${year}`}
      actions={<SegButtons options={[{ id: 'years', label: 'By year' }, { id: 'programs', label: `By program ${year}` }]} value={view} onChange={setView} />}>
      {view === 'years' ? (
        <>
          <BarChart labels={shown.map((y) => String(y.year))} highlight={shown.findIndex((y) => y.year === year)} series={[
            { name: 'Authorized', values: shown.map((y) => y.authorized), color: 'rgb(var(--ink))' },
            { name: 'Planned (budgets)', values: shown.map((y) => y.planned), color: 'rgb(var(--muted))' },
            { name: 'Recorded', values: shown.map((y) => y.recorded), color: 'rgb(var(--link))' },
            { name: 'Forecast', values: shown.map((y) => y.forecast), color: 'rgb(var(--marker))' },
          ]} />
          <div className="mt-3">
            <Table rows={shown} rowKey={(y) => String(y.year)} dense columns={[
              { key: 'y', header: 'Year', render: (y) => <b className={y.year === year ? 'text-ink' : ''}>{y.year}{y.year === year && <span className="ml-1 text-xs font-normal text-muted">(current)</span>}</b> },
              { key: 'pr', header: 'Proceeding', render: (y) => <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{y.proceeding || '—'}</span> },
              { key: 'a', header: 'Authorized', num: true, render: (y) => money(y.authorized) },
              { key: 'p', header: 'Planned', num: true, render: (y) => money(y.planned) },
              { key: 'r', header: 'Recorded', num: true, render: (y) => money(y.recorded) },
              { key: 'f', header: 'Forecast', num: true, render: (y) => money(y.forecast) },
              { key: 'v', header: 'Forecast − authorized', num: true, render: (y) => <span className={cx('font-semibold', y.forecast > y.authorized ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{moneyDelta(y.forecast - y.authorized)}</span> },
              { key: 'vp', header: '%', num: true, render: (y) => (y.authorized ? `${(((y.forecast - y.authorized) / y.authorized) * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : '—') },
            ]} />
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <BarChart labels={progRows.map((x) => x.pr.code)} series={[
            { name: 'Authorized', values: progRows.map((x) => x.y?.authorized ?? 0), color: 'rgb(var(--ink))' },
            { name: 'Recorded', values: progRows.map((x) => x.y?.recorded ?? 0), color: 'rgb(var(--link))' },
            { name: 'Forecast', values: progRows.map((x) => x.y?.forecast ?? 0), color: 'rgb(var(--marker))' },
          ]} />
          <div className="mt-3">
            <Table rows={progRows} rowKey={(x) => x.pr.id} dense columns={[
              { key: 'p', header: 'Program', render: (x) => <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><ProgramTag programId={x.pr.id} />{x.pr.name}</span> },
              { key: 'm', header: 'Recovery', render: (x) => <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{x.pr.recovery}</span> },
              { key: 'a', header: 'Authorized', num: true, render: (x) => money(x.y?.authorized) },
              { key: 'r', header: 'Recorded', num: true, render: (x) => money(x.y?.recorded) },
              { key: 'f', header: 'Forecast', num: true, render: (x) => money(x.y?.forecast) },
              { key: 'v', header: 'Variance', num: true, render: (x) => { const v = (x.y?.forecast ?? 0) - (x.y?.authorized ?? 0); return <span className={cx('font-semibold', v > 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{moneyDelta(v)}</span> } },
            ]} />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </Panel>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Readiness across projects (AI-06 style, deterministic)
function ReadinessPanel({ s, assessed }: { s: AppState; assessed: { p: AppState['projects'][number]; a: ReturnType<typeof assessEvidence>; pos: ReturnType<typeof position> }[] }) {
  const rows = [...assessed].sort((x, y) => x.a.score - y.a.score || y.pos.currentBudget - x.pos.currentBudget)
  const allGaps = assessed.flatMap((x) => x.a.gaps)
  const themes = Object.entries(allGaps.reduce<Record<string, number>>((a, g) => { a[g.area] = (a[g.area] || 0) + 1; return a }, {})).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
  return (
    <Panel title="Reasonableness-review readiness" subtitle="Deterministic checks over each project's records: approvals, signatures, baselines, variances, contingency, records, safety and gates. Lowest first." pad={false}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 border-b border-line px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-muted">
        <span className="font-semibold text-ink">{allGaps.length} gaps across {assessed.length} projects:</span>
        {themes.map(([k, v]) => <Badge key={k}>{k} {v}</Badge>)}
      </div>
      <Table rows={rows} rowKey={(x) => x.p.id} maxHeight={480} onRowClick={(x) => go(projectHref(x.p.id, 'evidence'))} columns={[
        { key: 'p', header: 'Project', render: (x) => <span className="block min-w-[200px]"><span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><ProgramTag programId={x.p.programId} /><Mono className="font-semibold">{x.p.code}</Mono></span><span className="block text-[12.5px]">{x.p.name}</span></span>, sort: (x) => x.p.code },
        { key: 'st', header: 'Stage', render: (x) => <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{stageName(s, x.p)}{x.p.status !== 'active' && <> · <StatusBadge status={x.p.status} /></>}</span> },
        { key: 'b', header: 'Budget', num: true, render: (x) => money(x.pos.currentBudget), sort: (x) => x.pos.currentBudget },
        { key: 'sc', header: 'Score', render: (x) => <span className="flex min-w-[110px] items-center gap-2"><span className={cx('w-9 text-right font-bold tabular-nums', x.a.score >= 90 ? 'text-good' : x.a.score >= 75 ? 'text-warn' : 'text-bad')}>{x.a.score}%</span><Progress className="w-16" value={x.a.score} tone={x.a.score >= 90 ? 'good' : x.a.score >= 75 ? 'warn' : 'bad'} /></span>, sort: (x) => x.a.score },
        { key: 'g', header: 'Top gaps', render: (x) => x.a.gaps.length ? <ul className="min-w-[260px] text-[12.5px]">{x.a.gaps.slice(0, 2).map((g) => <li key={g.id} className={g.severity === 'major' ? 'text-ink' : 'text-muted'}>{g.gap}</li>)}{x.a.gaps.length > 2 && <li className="text-faint">+{x.a.gaps.length - 2} more</li>}</ul> : <span className="text-[12.5px] text-good">Ready</span> },
      ]} />
    </Panel>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Large-project report (GO 177-style)
function LargeProjectsPanel({ s, assessed, year }: { s: AppState; assessed: { p: AppState['projects'][number]; a: ReturnType<typeof assessEvidence>; pos: ReturnType<typeof position> }[]; year: number }) {
  const rows = assessed.filter((x) => Math.max(x.pos.currentBudget, x.pos.eac) >= LARGE).map((x) => {

    const fy = forecastByYear(s, p.id)

    return {
      x, p, authorized, original: x.pos.originalBudget, recordedYear: act[String(year)] ?? 0, recordedCum: x.pos.actualToDate, forecastYear: fy[String(year)] ?? 0, eac: x.pos.eac,
      cpcn: Math.max(authorized, x.pos.eac) > CPCN, ins, budgetKind: activeBudget(s, p.id)?.kind,
      explanation: latestVar?.narrative || (approvedChanges.length ? `${approvedChanges.length} approved change(s): ${approvedChanges.map((c) => c.code).join(', ')}` : 'Within authorization'),
    }
  }).sort((a, b) => b.authorized - a.authorized)
  const csv = async () => {

'', cpcn_required: r.cpcn ? 'Y' : 'N', original_authorized: r.original, current_authorized: r.authorized, [`recorded_${year}`]: r.recordedYear, recorded_cumulative: r.recordedCum, [`forecast_${year}`]: r.forecastYear, eac: r.eac, variance: r.eac - r.authorized, variance_pct: r.authorized ? +(((r.eac - r.authorized) / r.authorized) * 100).toFixed(1) : '', in_service_baseline: r.ins?.baseline ?? '', in_service_forecast: r.ins?.actual ?? r.ins?.forecast ?? '', evidence_score: r.x.a.score, explanation: r.explanation }))), 'text/csv')
    if (r === 'saved') { mutate(() => {}, { entity: 'report', entityId: `large-${year}`, action: 'export', summary: `Downloaded ${year} large-project report (${rows.length} projects)` }); toast('Report saved') }

// ───────────────────────────── RC-02 regulatory snapshot
function RegSnapshotModal({ open, onClose, initialProgram }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; initialProgram: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [programId, setProgramId] = useState(initialProgram || s.programs[0]?.id)
  const progFunding = s.funding.filter((f) => f.programId === programId)
  const proceedings = Array.from(new Set(progFunding.map((f) => f.proceeding))).reverse()
  const [proceeding, setProceeding] = useState('')
  const [label, setLabel] = useState('')
  const [excluded, setExcluded] = useState<string[]>([])
  const proc = proceeding || proceedings[0] || ''
  const eligible = s.projects.filter((p) => p.programId === programId && p.status === 'active' && s.budgets.some((b) => b.projectId === p.id))
  const chosen = eligible.filter((p) => !excluded.includes(p.id))
  const submit = () => {
    if (!proc.trim()) { toast('Name the proceeding.', 'bad'); return }
    if (!chosen.length) { toast('Select at least one project.', 'bad'); return }
    const prog = s.programs.find((x) => x.id === programId)!
    const lab = label.trim() || `Regulatory snapshot — ${proc.trim()}`
    mutate((d) => { for (const p of chosen) takeSnapshot(d, p.id, 'regulatory', lab, { proceeding: proc.trim() }) }, { entity: 'snapshot', entityId: prog.id, action: 'create', summary: `Took ${proc.trim()} regulatory snapshot for ${chosen.length} ${prog.code} projects` })
    toast(`Froze ${chosen.length} project positions`)
    setExcluded([]); setLabel(''); onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="Take regulatory snapshot" wide footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={submit}>Freeze {chosen.length} project{chosen.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Freezes scope, schedule, budget by category, EAC, actuals and contingency for every active budgeted project in the program, tagged with the proceeding. Snapshots are immutable and appear on each project's baseline timeline.</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Program"><ProgramSelect includeAll={false} value={programId} onChange={(v) => { setProgramId(v); setProceeding(''); setExcluded([]) }} /></Field>
          <Field label="Proceeding">
            <Input list="reg-proceedings" value={proc} onChange={(e) => setProceeding(e.target.value)} />
            <datalist id="reg-proceedings">{proceedings.map((x) => <option key={x} value={x} />)}</datalist>
          </Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Label (optional)"><Input value={label} onChange={(e) => setLabel(e.target.value)} placeholder={`Regulatory snapshot — ${proc}`} /></Field>
        <div className="rounded-md border border-line">
          <div className="border-b border-line bg-sunken/50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-muted">{eligible.length} eligible projects</div>
          <div className="flex max-h-[260px] flex-col gap-1.5 overflow-y-auto p-3">
            {eligible.map((p) => { const pos = position(s, p.id); const last = snapshotsFor(s, p.id).filter((x) => x.type === 'regulatory').pop(); return <Checkbox key={p.id} checked={!excluded.includes(p.id)} onChange={(v) => setExcluded(v ? excluded.filter((x) => x !== p.id) : [...excluded, p.id])} label={<span><Mono className="font-semibold">{p.code}</Mono> {p.name} <span className="text-muted">· {money(pos.currentBudget)} · EAC {money(pos.eac)}{last ? ` · last regulatory ${fmtDate(last.date)}` : ''}</span></span>} /> })}
            {!eligible.length && <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">No active budgeted projects in this program.</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/risk/DrawModal.tsx =====
// Contingency drawdown request (RK-08): draws are made only against a named risk and routed by dollar authority.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { Risk } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { startWorkflow, doaRoleFor } from '@/core/engine/workflow'
import { position } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { isActive, pert } from '@/core/engine/risk'
import { money, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Button, Callout, Checkbox, Field, Modal, MoneyInput, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { submitFirstForm } from './wf'

export function DrawModal({ projectId, risk, open, onClose }: { projectId: string; risk?: Risk | null; open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const risks = s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === projectId && r.kind === 'threat' && (isActive(r) || r.status === 'realized'))
  const [riskId, setRiskId] = useState(risk?.id ?? risks[0]?.id ?? '')
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(0)
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('')
  const [realize, setRealize] = useState(true)
  const r = s.risks.find((x) => x.id === riskId)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const rr = risk ?? risks[0]
    setRiskId(rr?.id ?? '')
    setAmount(rr ? Math.round(pert(rr.cost) / 1000) * 1000 : 0)
    setReason(rr ? `${rr.event}. ` : '')
    setRealize(true)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open, risk?.id])
  const pos = position(s, projectId)
  const role = doaRoleFor(s, { projectId }, amount)
  const roleName = s.roles.find((x) => x.id === role)?.name
  const over = amount > pos.contingencyRemaining
  const submit = () => {
    if (!r) { toast('Pick the risk this draw is for.', 'bad'); return }
    if (amount <= 0) { toast('Enter the amount to draw.', 'bad'); return }
    if (!reason.trim()) { toast('Explain what happened.', 'bad'); return }
    const id = uid('cd')
    mutate((d) => {
      d.contingencyDraws.push({ id, projectId, riskId: r.id, amount, date: d.settings.asOf, reason: reason.trim(), status: 'in-review' })
      if (realize) { const x = d.risks.find((y) => y.id === r.id); if (x && isActive(x)) { x.status = 'realized'; x.closedAt = d.settings.asOf } }
      const inst = startWorkflow(d, 'contingency-drawdown', { title: `${p.code} contingency for ${r.title}`, recordType: 'contingency', recordId: id, projectId, data: { amount, risk: `${r.code} ${r.title}`, reason: reason.trim() } })
      submitFirstForm(d, inst?.id, 'Request submitted from the risk register')
    }, { entity: 'contingency', entityId: id, projectId, action: 'request', summary: `Requested ${money(amount, 'full')} contingency against ${r.code} ${r.title}` })
    toast('Contingency request submitted for approval')
    onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="Request contingency drawdown"
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={submit}>Submit for approval</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <Field label="Risk realized" hint="Contingency is drawn only against an identified risk.">
          <Select id="draw-risk" value={riskId} onChange={(e) => { setRiskId(e.target.value); const x = s.risks.find((y) => y.id === e.target.value); if (x) setAmount(Math.round(pert(x.cost) / 1000) * 1000) }} options={risks.length ? risks.map((x) => ({ value: x.id, label: `${x.code} · ${x.title} (ML ${money(x.cost.ml)})` })) : [{ value: '', label: 'No threats on the register' }]} />
        </Field>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Amount" hint={r ? `Risk range ${money(r.cost.min)} – ${money(r.cost.max)}` : undefined}><MoneyInput value={amount} onChange={setAmount} /></Field>
          <Field label="Contingency remaining"><div className={over ? 'pt-1.5 font-semibold tabular-nums text-bad' : 'pt-1.5 font-semibold tabular-nums'}>{money(pos.contingencyRemaining, 'full')}{over ? ' — request exceeds remaining' : ''}</div></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="What happened"><TextArea id="draw-reason" value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} placeholder="Field condition, date found, evidence (photos, contractor quote, daily report)" /></Field>
        <Checkbox checked={realize} onChange={setRealize} label="Mark this risk realized (removes it from active exposure)" />
        <Callout tone="info">Routes to project controls for verification, then to <b>{roleName ?? 'the approver'}</b> under the dollar-authority matrix for {money(amount)}. Remaining contingency drops only when the draw is approved.</Callout>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/risk/lib.ts =====
// Risk & contingency helpers (RK-*). Pure functions over AppState so they can be unit-tested.
import type { AppState, MonteCarloResult, Project, Risk, RiskLibraryItem } from '@/core/types'
import { activeBudget, position } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { estimateTotals } from '@/core/engine/estimates'
import { expectedCost, isActive, monteCarlo, riskBand, riskScore } from '@/core/engine/risk'
import { addDays, daysBetween, monthRange, sum, uid } from '@/core/util'

export const RISK_CATEGORIES = [
  'Third-party / substructures', 'Permitting', 'Environmental', 'Material', 'Operations', 'Land / right-of-way', 'Technical',
  'Productivity', 'Regulatory change', 'Weather', 'Records', 'Market', 'Safety', 'Design', 'Stakeholder',
]
export const CONSEQUENCE_DIMS = ['Safety', 'Reliability', 'Environmental', 'Financial', 'Schedule', 'Reputational'] as const
export const PROB_BY_L = [0.05, 0.15, 0.35, 0.6, 0.85]

export const bandTone = (score: number): 'bad' | 'warn' | 'good' => {
  const b = riskBand(score)
  return b === 'high' ? 'bad' : b === 'medium' ? 'warn' : 'good'
}
export const residualScore = (r: Risk) => r.residual.likelihood * r.residual.consequence

/** Where the project's contingency number comes from: the budget in force, else the latest live estimate. */
export interface ContingencyBasis { base: number; contingency: number; original: number; source: string }
export function contingencyBasis(s: AppState, pid: string): ContingencyBasis | null {
  const pos = position(s, pid)
  if (pos.budgetKind) return { base: pos.baseBudget, contingency: pos.contingencyRemaining, original: pos.contingencyOriginal, source: pos.budgetKind === 'control' ? 'Control budget' : 'Planning budget' }
  const est = s.estimates.filter((e) => e.projectId === pid && e.status !== 'rejected' && e.status !== 'superseded').sort((a, b) => b.version - a.version)[0]
  if (!est) return null
  const t = estimateTotals(est)
  return { base: t.base, contingency: t.contingency, original: t.contingency, source: `Class ${est.cls} estimate v${est.version} (${est.status.replace('-', ' ')})` }
}

/** In-service milestone forecast (the date schedule risk pushes out). */
export function inServiceForecast(p: Project): string | undefined {
  const m = p.milestones.find((x) => /in service/i.test(x.name))
  return m && !m.actual ? m.forecast : undefined
}

/**
 * Run the engine Monte Carlo for a project. Base cost = budget (or estimate) excluding contingency;
 * schedule percentiles are risk-driven delay in days (base 0), applied to the in-service forecast.
 */
export function runMonteCarlo(s: AppState, pid: string, iterations = 5000, seed = 7): MonteCarloResult | null {
  const basis = contingencyBasis(s, pid)
  if (!basis) return null
  return monteCarlo(pid, s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === pid), basis.base, 0, s.settings.asOf, iterations, seed)
}
export const latestMonteCarlo = (s: AppState, pid: string) => s.monteCarlo.filter((m) => m.projectId === pid).slice(-1)[0]

export type Verdict = 'adequate' | 'p50-only' | 'short' | 'no-risk'
export interface Adequacy { remaining: number; need50: number; need80: number; gap80: number; verdict: Verdict; coverage: number; label: string; tone: 'good' | 'warn' | 'bad' }
/** Contingency adequacy (RK-06): contingency remaining vs the P80 − base requirement from Monte Carlo. */
export function adequacy(remaining: number, mc: Pick<MonteCarloResult, 'costP' | 'baseCost'>): Adequacy {
  const need50 = Math.max(0, mc.costP.P50 - mc.baseCost)
  const need80 = Math.max(0, mc.costP.P80 - mc.baseCost)
  const gap80 = remaining - need80
  const coverage = need80 ? remaining / need80 : remaining > 0 ? 9.99 : 1
  if (need80 === 0) return { remaining, need50, need80, gap80, coverage, verdict: 'no-risk', label: 'No quantified risk to cover', tone: 'good' }
  if (remaining >= need80) return { remaining, need50, need80, gap80, coverage, verdict: 'adequate', label: 'Adequate at P80', tone: 'good' }
  if (remaining >= need50) return { remaining, need50, need80, gap80, coverage, verdict: 'p50-only', label: 'Covers P50 only', tone: 'warn' }
  return { remaining, need50, need80, gap80, coverage, verdict: 'short', label: 'Short of P50', tone: 'bad' }
}

/** Contingency burn-down (RK-08): remaining contingency each month vs a draw-down proportional to % complete. */
export interface BurnPoint { month: string; remaining: number; ideal: number; pctComplete: number }
export function burndown(s: AppState, pid: string): BurnPoint[] | null {
  const b = activeBudget(s, pid)
  if (!b || b.kind !== 'control') return null
  const pos = position(s, pid)
  const start = b.createdAt.slice(0, 7)
  const end = s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 7)
  if (start > end) return null
  const periods = s.costPeriods.filter((c) => c.projectId === pid)
  const snaps = s.snapshots.filter((x) => x.projectId === pid && x.date >= b.createdAt).sort((a, c) => a.date.localeCompare(c.date))
  const bac = Math.max(1, pos.baseBudget)
  let cumEv = sum(periods.filter((p) => p.period < start).map((p) => p.earned))
  return monthRange(start, end).map((m) => {
    cumEv += sum(periods.filter((p) => p.period === m).map((p) => p.earned))
    const pct = Math.min(1, cumEv / bac)
    const snap = [...snaps].reverse().find((x) => x.date.slice(0, 7) <= m)
    const remaining = m === end ? pos.contingencyRemaining : snap?.budget.contingencyRemaining ?? pos.contingencyOriginal
    return { month: m, remaining, ideal: Math.round(pos.contingencyOriginal * (1 - pct)), pctComplete: pct }
  })
}

export function nextRiskCode(s: AppState, p: Project, offset = 0): string {
  const nums = s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === p.id).map((r) => Number(r.code.split('-').pop()) || 0)
  return `R-${p.code.slice(4)}-${String(Math.max(0, ...nums) + 1 + offset).padStart(2, '0')}`
}

/** Seed a register entry from the risk library, typical cost taken as a % of the project budget (RK-03). */
export function riskFromLibrary(s: AppState, p: Project, item: RiskLibraryItem, budgetBase: number, offset = 0): Risk {
  const ml = Math.max(5000, Math.round((Math.abs(item.typicalCostPct) / 100) * budgetBase / 1000) * 1000)
  return {
    id: uid('rsk'), projectId: p.id, code: nextRiskCode(s, p, offset), title: item.title, cause: item.cause, event: item.event, effect: item.effect, category: item.category,
    kind: item.typicalCostPct < 0 ? 'opportunity' : 'threat', ownerId: p.team.pm ?? s.currentUserId, status: 'open', likelihood: 3, consequence: 3,
    consequenceDim: item.category === 'Environmental' ? 'Environmental' : item.typicalDays > 40 ? 'Schedule' : 'Financial',
    probability: PROB_BY_L[2], cost: { min: Math.round(ml * 0.4), ml, max: Math.round(ml * 2.2) },
    scheduleDays: { min: Math.round(item.typicalDays * 0.4), ml: item.typicalDays, max: Math.round(item.typicalDays * 2) },
    responses: [], residual: { likelihood: 2, consequence: 3 }, libraryId: item.id, createdAt: s.settings.asOf,
  }
}

/** Budget figure library percentages apply to. */
export function budgetBase(s: AppState, pid: string): number {
  const pos = position(s, pid)
  if (pos.currentBudget) return pos.currentBudget
  return contingencyBasis(s, pid)?.base ?? 0
}

/** When a realized risk happened: its close date, else its contingency draw, else creation. */
export function realizedDate(s: AppState, r: Risk): string {
  return r.closedAt ?? s.contingencyDraws.filter((d) => d.riskId === r.id).map((d) => d.date).sort().pop() ?? r.createdAt
}

export interface LessonRow { id: string; projectId: string; date: string; title: string; category: string; text: string; workMethods: string[]; source: string }
/** Lessons library (RK-10): published lessons plus closed risks that carry a lesson. */
export function lessonsLibrary(s: AppState): LessonRow[] {
  const rows: LessonRow[] = s.lessons.map((l) => ({ id: l.id, projectId: l.projectId, date: l.date, title: l.title, category: l.category, text: l.text, workMethods: l.workMethods, source: 'Lessons register' }))
  for (const r of s.risks) {
    if (!r.lesson) continue
    const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === r.projectId)
    rows.push({ id: r.id, projectId: r.projectId, date: r.closedAt ?? r.createdAt, title: r.title, category: r.category, text: r.lesson, workMethods: p ? [p.workMethod] : [], source: `Closed risk ${r.code}` })
  }
  return rows.sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))
}

export function exposureSummary(risks: Risk[], asOf: string) {
  const act = risks.filter(isActive)
  const threats = act.filter((r) => r.kind === 'threat')
  const opps = act.filter((r) => r.kind === 'opportunity')
  return {
    active: act.length,
    high: act.filter((r) => riskScore(r) >= 15).length,
    highNoResponse: act.filter((r) => riskScore(r) >= 15 && r.responses.length === 0).length,
    threat: Math.round(sum(threats.map(expectedCost))),
    opportunity: Math.round(-sum(opps.map(expectedCost))),
    net: Math.round(sum(act.map(expectedCost))),
    overdueResponses: act.flatMap((r) => r.responses).filter((x) => x.status === 'open' && x.due < asOf).length,
    scheduleDays: Math.round(sum(threats.map((r) => r.probability * r.scheduleDays.ml))),
  }
}

/** Schedule date for a percentile delay on the in-service forecast. */
export const delayedDate = (forecast: string | undefined, days: number) => (forecast ? addDays(forecast, Math.max(0, days)) : undefined)
export const daysLate = (a?: string, b?: string) => (a && b ? daysBetween(a, b) : 0)
