// Risk editor drawer (RK-02, RK-04, RK-05, RK-10): cause → event → effect, scoring, 3-point estimates,
// responses, residual rating, and closing with a lesson learned.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { ConsequenceDim, Risk, RiskResponse } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { CONSEQUENCE_LABELS, LIKELIHOOD_LABELS, expectedCost, pert, riskScore } from '@/core/engine/risk'
import { addDays, money, uid, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Checkbox, Drawer, Field, Input, MoneyInput, Section, Select, SegButtons, TextArea, humanize } from '@/ui/kit'
import { PersonSelect } from '@/views/shared/pickers'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { CONSEQUENCE_DIMS, PROB_BY_L, RISK_CATEGORIES, bandTone } from './lib'

type LC = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5
const lcOpts = (labels: string[]) => labels.map((l, i) => ({ value: String(i + 1), label: `${i + 1} · ${l}` }))

export function ScoreChip({ l, c, title }: { l: number; c: number; title?: string }) {
  const sc = l * c
  const t = bandTone(sc)
  return <span title={title ?? `L${l} × C${c}`} className={cx('inline-flex h-6 min-w-[30px] items-center justify-center rounded-sm px-1 font-mono text-[12px] font-bold tabular-nums', t === 'bad' ? 'bg-bad text-white' : t === 'warn' ? 'bg-warn/80 text-ink' : 'bg-good/25 text-ink')}>{sc}</span>
}

export function RiskEditor({ risk, open, onClose, onRequestDraw, isNew }: { risk: Risk | null; open: boolean; onClose: () => void; onRequestDraw?: (r: Risk) => void; isNew?: boolean }) {
  const [r, setR] = useState<Risk | null>(risk)
  const [closing, setClosing] = useState<null | 'closed' | 'realized'>(null)
  const asOf = useStore((s) => s.settings.asOf)
  const project = useStore((s) => s.projects.find((p) => p.id === risk?.projectId))
  useEffect(() => { setR(risk ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(risk)) : null); setClosing(null) }, [risk, open])
  if (!r) return null
  const set = <K extends keyof Risk>(k: K, v: Risk[K]) => setR({ ...r, [k]: v })
  const setResp = (id: string, patch: Partial<RiskResponse>) => set('responses', r.responses.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, ...patch } : x)))
  const closedState = r.status === 'closed' || r.status === 'realized'
  const valid = r.title.trim() && r.event.trim() && r.cost.min <= r.cost.ml && r.cost.ml <= r.cost.max && r.scheduleDays.min <= r.scheduleDays.ml && r.scheduleDays.ml <= r.scheduleDays.max

  const save = (next: Risk = r, msg = isNew ? 'Risk added to register' : 'Risk updated') => {
    if (!next.title.trim() || !next.event.trim()) { toast('Give the risk a title and an event statement.', 'bad'); return }
    if (!(next.cost.min <= next.cost.ml && next.cost.ml <= next.cost.max)) { toast('Cost range must be min ≤ most likely ≤ max.', 'bad'); return }
    if (!(next.scheduleDays.min <= next.scheduleDays.ml && next.scheduleDays.ml <= next.scheduleDays.max)) { toast('Schedule range must be min ≤ most likely ≤ max.', 'bad'); return }
    mutate((d) => {
      const i = d.risks.findIndex((x) => x.id === next.id)
      if (i >= 0) d.risks[i] = next
      else d.risks.push(next)
    }, { entity: 'risk', entityId: next.id, projectId: next.projectId, action: isNew ? 'create' : next.status === 'closed' || next.status === 'realized' ? next.status : 'update', summary: `${next.code} ${next.title}${isNew ? ' added' : ` — ${next.status}`} (L${next.likelihood}×C${next.consequence}, ML ${money(next.cost.ml)})` })
    toast(msg)
    onClose()
  }
  const finish = () => {
    if (!closing) return
    if (!r.lesson?.trim()) { toast('Write the lesson learned before closing.', 'bad'); return }
    save({ ...r, status: closing, closedAt: asOf }, closing === 'closed' ? 'Risk closed; lesson added to the library' : 'Risk marked realized; lesson added to the library')
  }

  return (
    <Drawer open={open} onClose={onClose} width={720}
      title={<span className="flex items-center gap-2"><span className="font-mono text-[14px]">{r.code}</span>{isNew ? 'New risk' : 'Risk'}</span>}
      footer={closing ? (
        <><Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setClosing(null)}>Back</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={finish}>{closing === 'closed' ? 'Close risk' : 'Mark realized'}</Button></>
      ) : (
        <>
          {!isNew && !closedState && onRequestDraw && r.kind === 'threat' && project && <Button onClick={() => { onClose(); onRequestDraw(r) }}>Request contingency</Button>}
          {!isNew && !closedState && <Button onClick={() => { setClosing('realized'); set('lesson', r.lesson ?? '') }}>Mark realized…</Button>}
          {!isNew && !closedState && <Button onClick={() => setClosing('closed')}>Close with lesson…</Button>}
          {closedState && <Button onClick={() => save({ ...r, status: 'open', closedAt: undefined }, 'Risk reopened')}>Reopen</Button>}
          <Button variant="primary" disabled={!valid} onClick={() => save()}>{isNew ? 'Add to register' : 'Save changes'}</Button>
        </>
      )}>
      {closing ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Callout tone="info" title={closing === 'closed' ? 'Close this risk' : 'This risk happened'}>
            {closing === 'closed' ? 'Closed risks leave active exposure and the Monte Carlo. ' : 'A realized risk leaves active exposure; request a contingency draw if it costs money. '}
            The lesson goes to the lessons library and is shown when similar work is planned.
          </Callout>
          <Field label="Lesson learned" hint="What should the next project doing this work method do differently?">
            <TextArea id="risk-lesson" className="min-h-[120px]" value={r.lesson ?? ''} onChange={(e) => set('lesson', e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Pothole every foreign crossing before the Class 3 estimate; two of five crossings were off-record by more than 3 ft." />
          </Field>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
          {closedState && <Callout tone={r.status === 'realized' ? 'bad' : 'good'} title={`${humanize(r.status)} ${r.closedAt ? 'on ' + r.closedAt : ''}`}>{r.lesson ? <>Lesson: {r.lesson}</> : 'No lesson recorded.'}</Callout>}
          <Section title="Statement">
            <Field label="Title"><Input id="risk-title" value={r.title} onChange={(e) => set('title', e.target.value)} /></Field>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
              <Field label="Cause (because of…)"><TextArea value={r.cause} onChange={(e) => set('cause', e.target.value)} /></Field>
              <Field label="Event (…this may happen)"><TextArea value={r.event} onChange={(e) => set('event', e.target.value)} /></Field>
              <Field label="Effect (…resulting in)"><TextArea value={r.effect} onChange={(e) => set('effect', e.target.value)} /></Field>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4">
              <Field label="Kind"><SegButtons options={[{ id: 'threat', label: 'Threat' }, { id: 'opportunity', label: 'Opportunity' }]} value={r.kind} onChange={(v) => set('kind', v)} /></Field>
              <Field label="Category"><Select value={r.category} onChange={(e) => set('category', e.target.value)} options={Array.from(new Set([r.category, ...RISK_CATEGORIES])).filter(Boolean)} /></Field>
              <Field label="Owner"><PersonSelect value={r.ownerId} onChange={(v) => set('ownerId', v)} /></Field>
              <Field label="Status"><Select value={r.status} onChange={(e) => set('status', e.target.value as Risk['status'])} options={closedState ? [r.status] : ['open', 'mitigating']} disabled={closedState} /></Field>
            </div>
          </Section>

          <Section title="Inherent rating">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4">
              <Field label="Likelihood"><Select value={String(r.likelihood)} onChange={(e) => { const l = Number(e.target.value) as LC; setR({ ...r, likelihood: l, probability: PROB_BY_L[l - 1] }) }} options={lcOpts(LIKELIHOOD_LABELS)} /></Field>
              <Field label="Consequence"><Select value={String(r.consequence)} onChange={(e) => set('consequence', Number(e.target.value) as LC)} options={lcOpts(CONSEQUENCE_LABELS)} /></Field>
              <Field label="Consequence dimension"><Select value={r.consequenceDim} onChange={(e) => set('consequenceDim', e.target.value as ConsequenceDim)} options={[...CONSEQUENCE_DIMS]} /></Field>
              <Field label="Probability (quantitative)" hint="Defaults from likelihood"><div className="relative"><Input type="number" min={0} max={100} className="pr-7 text-right tabular-nums" value={Math.round(r.probability * 100)} onChange={(e) => set('probability', Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(e.target.value) || 0)) / 100)} /><span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[13px] text-faint">%</span></div></Field>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[13px]"><span className="text-muted">Score</span><ScoreChip l={r.likelihood} c={r.consequence} /><span className="text-muted">PERT cost</span><b className="tabular-nums">{money(pert(r.cost))}</b><span className="text-muted">Expected value</span><b className={cx('tabular-nums', r.kind === 'opportunity' && 'text-good')}>{money(expectedCost(r))}</b></div>
          </Section>

          <Section title="Three-point estimate">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <Field label="Cost min"><MoneyInput value={r.cost.min} onChange={(v) => set('cost', { ...r.cost, min: v })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Most likely"><MoneyInput value={r.cost.ml} onChange={(v) => set('cost', { ...r.cost, ml: v })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Cost max"><MoneyInput value={r.cost.max} onChange={(v) => set('cost', { ...r.cost, max: v })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Days min"><Input type="number" className="text-right tabular-nums" value={r.scheduleDays.min} onChange={(e) => set('scheduleDays', { ...r.scheduleDays, min: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Days most likely"><Input type="number" className="text-right tabular-nums" value={r.scheduleDays.ml} onChange={(e) => set('scheduleDays', { ...r.scheduleDays, ml: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })} /></Field>
              <Field label="Days max"><Input type="number" className="text-right tabular-nums" value={r.scheduleDays.max} onChange={(e) => set('scheduleDays', { ...r.scheduleDays, max: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })} /></Field>
            </div>
            {!valid && <p className="text-xs text-bad">Ranges must run min ≤ most likely ≤ max, and the risk needs a title and event.</p>}
          </Section>

          <Section title={`Responses (${r.responses.length})`} actions={<Button size="sm" onClick={() => set('responses', [...r.responses, { id: uid('rr'), action: '', ownerId: r.ownerId, due: addDays(asOf, 30), status: 'open', cost: 0 }])}>Add response</Button>}>
            {r.responses.length === 0 && <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">No response plan yet.{riskScore(r) >= 15 && <b className="text-bad"> High risks without a response block the next gate.</b>}</p>}
            {r.responses.map((x) => (
              <div key={x.id} className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 rounded-md border border-line p-2.5 md:grid-cols-[1fr_170px]">

'done' : 'open' })} label="Done" />{x.status === 'open' && x.due < asOf && <Badge tone="bad">Overdue</Badge>}<button className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted hover:text-bad" onClick={() => set('responses', r.responses.filter((y) => y.id !== x.id))}>Remove</button></div></Field>

// Portfolio risk view (RK-12) and lessons learned library (RK-10).
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { Risk } from '@/core/types'
import { personName, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { projectHref, go } from '@/core/router'
import { expectedCost, isActive, riskScore } from '@/core/engine/risk'
import { addDays, fmtDate, groupBy, money, sum, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Callout, Empty, Input, Mono, PageHeader, Panel, SegButtons, Select, Stat, StatusBadge, Table, type Column } from '@/ui/kit'
import { HBarChart, RiskMatrix } from '@/ui/charts'
import { ProgramTag } from '@/views/shared/pickers'
import { ScoreChip } from './RiskEditor'
import { adequacy, contingencyBasis, latestMonteCarlo, lessonsLibrary, realizedDate, runMonteCarlo } from './lib'

export default function RiskPortfolio(_props: { projectId?: string; id?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [program, setProgram] = useState('')
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'inherent' | 'residual'>('inherent')
  const [cell, setCell] = useState<string | undefined>()
  const live = s.projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'active' || p.status === 'on-hold')
  const projects = live.filter((p) => !program || p.programId === program)
  const pids = new Set(projects.map((p) => p.id))
  const risks = s.risks.filter((r) => pids.has(r.projectId))
  const active = risks.filter(isActive)
  const proj = (id: string) => s.projects.find((p) => p.id === id)!

  const cells: Record<string, number> = {}
  for (const r of active) { const k = mode === 'inherent' ? `${r.likelihood}-${r.consequence}` : `${r.residual.likelihood}-${r.residual.consequence}`; cells[k] = (cells[k] || 0) + 1 }
  const inCell = (r: Risk) => !cell || (mode === 'inherent' ? `${r.likelihood}-${r.consequence}` : `${r.residual.likelihood}-${r.residual.consequence}`) === cell

  const top = active.filter((r) => r.kind === 'threat' && inCell(r)).sort((a, b) => riskScore(b) - riskScore(a) || expectedCost(b) - expectedCost(a)).slice(0, 15)

  // Per-project adequacy (uses saved Monte Carlo when present, otherwise expected value as P50 proxy)
  const perProject = useMemo(() => projects.map((p) => {
    const pr = s.risks.filter((r) => r.projectId === p.id)
    const exp = Math.round(sum(pr.filter(isActive).map(expectedCost)))
    const basis = contingencyBasis(s, p.id)
    const saved = latestMonteCarlo(s, p.id)
    const mc = saved ?? (basis ? runMonteCarlo(s, p.id, 2000) ?? undefined : undefined)
    const a = basis && mc ? adequacy(basis.contingency, mc) : null
    return { p, exp, cont: basis?.contingency ?? 0, a, mc, saved: !!saved }
  }), [s.risks, s.monteCarlo, s.budgets, s.contingencyDraws, s.changes, s.estimates, program]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const byProgram = s.programs.filter((pg) => !program || pg.id === program).map((pg) => {
    const rows = perProject.filter((x) => x.p.programId === pg.id)
    const exposure = sum(rows.map((x) => x.exp))
    const cont = sum(rows.map((x) => x.cont))
    const short = rows.filter((x) => x.a?.verdict === 'p50-only').length
    const uncovered = rows.filter((x) => x.a?.verdict === 'short' || (!x.a && x.exp > x.cont)).length
    return { pg, n: rows.length, exposure, cont, ratio: cont ? exposure / cont : 0, short, uncovered, highs: s.risks.filter((r) => rows.some((x) => x.p.id === r.projectId) && isActive(r) && riskScore(r) >= 15).length }
  })

  const byCat = Object.entries(groupBy(active.filter((r) => r.kind === 'threat'), (r) => r.category)).map(([k, rs]) => ({ label: k, value: Math.round(sum(rs.map(expectedCost))), sub: `${rs.length}` })).sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
  const totalExp = sum(byCat.map((x) => x.value))
  const topCatShare = byCat[0] ? byCat[0].value / Math.max(1, totalExp) : 0

  const since = addDays(s.settings.asOf, -90)
  const realized = risks.filter((r) => r.status === 'realized' && realizedDate(s, r) >= since).sort((a, b) => realizedDate(s, b).localeCompare(realizedDate(s, a)))
  const drawsFor = (r: Risk) => s.contingencyDraws.filter((d) => d.riskId === r.id)

  const totals = { exposure: sum(perProject.map((x) => x.exp)), cont: sum(perProject.map((x) => x.cont)) }
  const highNoResp = active.filter((r) => riskScore(r) >= 15 && r.responses.length === 0).length

  const topCols: Column<Risk>[] = [
    { key: 'proj', header: 'Project', render: (r) => <a className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline" href={projectHref(r.projectId, 'risk')} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>{proj(r.projectId).code}</a>, sort: (r) => proj(r.projectId).code },
    { key: 'code', header: 'Risk', render: (r) => <div className="min-w-[200px]"><div className="font-semibold"><Mono className="mr-1 text-muted">{r.code}</Mono>{r.title}</div><div className="text-xs text-muted">{proj(r.projectId).name}</div></div>, sort: (r) => r.title },
    { key: 'cat', header: 'Category', render: (r) => <span className="text-[12px]">{r.category}</span>, sort: (r) => r.category },
    { key: 'score', header: 'L×C', render: (r) => <ScoreChip l={r.likelihood} c={r.consequence} />, sort: (r) => riskScore(r) },
    { key: 'ev', header: 'Expected', num: true, render: (r) => money(expectedCost(r)), sort: (r) => expectedCost(r) },
    { key: 'ml', header: 'ML cost', num: true, render: (r) => money(r.cost.ml), sort: (r) => r.cost.ml },
    { key: 'owner', header: 'Owner', render: (r) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{personName(s, r.ownerId)}</span> },
    { key: 'resp', header: 'Response', render: (r) => (r.responses.length ? <span className="text-[12px]">{r.responses.filter((x) => x.status === 'done').length}/{r.responses.length} done</span> : <Badge tone="bad">None</Badge>) },
  ]

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader eyebrow="Controls" title="Portfolio risk" subtitle="Every active risk across live projects, how much contingency stands behind it, and what we learned from the ones that happened."
        actions={<Select id="risk-program" className="w-[260px]" value={program} onChange={(e) => { setProgram(e.target.value); setCell(undefined) }} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All programs' }, ...s.programs.map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: `${p.code} · ${p.name}` }))]} />} />

      <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6">
        <Stat label="Active risks" value={active.length} sub={`${projects.length} live projects`} />
        <Stat label="High (≥15)" value={active.filter((r) => riskScore(r) >= 15).length} tone="bad" sub={`${highNoResp} without a response`} />
        <Stat label="Expected exposure" value={money(totals.exposure)} sub="Net of opportunities" />
        <Stat label="Contingency held" value={money(totals.cont)} sub={`${totals.cont ? Math.round((totals.exposure / totals.cont) * 100) : 0}% of it at risk`} />
        <Stat label="Realized, 90 days" value={realized.length} sub={money(sum(realized.flatMap(drawsFor).map((d) => d.amount))) + ' drawn'} tone={realized.length ? 'warn' : undefined} />
        <Stat label="Lessons on file" value={lessonsLibrary(s).length} sub="Searchable below" />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[300px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Panel title="Heat map" actions={<SegButtons options={[{ id: 'inherent', label: 'Inherent' }, { id: 'residual', label: 'Residual' }]} value={mode} onChange={(v) => { setMode(v); setCell(undefined) }} />}>
          <RiskMatrix cells={cells} selected={cell} onPick={(l, c) => setCell((x) => (x === `${l}-${c}` ? undefined : `${l}-${c}`))} />
          <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-faint">{cell ? `Filtering top risks to L${cell[0]} × C${cell[2]}. Click again to clear.` : 'Click a cell to filter the top-risk list.'}</p>
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Top 15 threats" subtitle="Ranked by score, then expected cost. Click to open the project register." pad={false}>
          <Table rows={top} columns={topCols} rowKey={(r) => r.id} onRowClick={(r) => go(projectHref(r.projectId, 'risk'))} maxHeight={460} empty={<div className="p-4"><Empty title="No risks in this cell" /></div>} />
        </Panel>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <Panel title="Exposure and contingency by program" pad={false}>
          <div className="scroll-x">
            <table className="tbl">
              <thead><tr><th>Program</th><th className="num">Projects</th><th className="num">High risks</th><th className="num">Exposure</th><th className="num">Contingency</th><th className="num">Exposure ÷ cont.</th><th>Adequacy</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {byProgram.map((x) => (
                  <tr key={x.pg.id}>
                    <td><span className="flex items-center gap-2"><ProgramTag programId={x.pg.id} /><span className="text-[12px]">{x.pg.name}</span></span></td>
                    <td className="num">{x.n}</td>
                    <td className="num">{x.highs}</td>
                    <td className="num">{money(x.exposure)}</td>
                    <td className="num">{money(x.cont)}</td>
                    <td className={cx('num font-semibold', x.ratio > 1 ? 'text-bad' : x.ratio > 0.7 ? 'text-warn' : 'text-good')}>{x.cont ? `${Math.round(x.ratio * 100)}%` : '—'}</td>
                    <td>{x.uncovered ? <Badge tone="bad">{x.uncovered} short of P50</Badge> : null}{x.short ? <Badge tone="warn" className="ml-1">{x.short} below P80</Badge> : null}{!x.uncovered && !x.short && x.n ? <Badge tone="good">Covered at P80</Badge> : null}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <div className="border-t border-line p-4">
            <div className="eyebrow mb-2">Expected exposure by program</div>
            <HBarChart rows={byProgram.filter((x) => x.n).map((x) => ({ label: x.pg.code + ' · ' + x.pg.name, value: x.exposure, color: x.ratio > 1 ? 'rgb(var(--bad))' : x.ratio > 0.7 ? 'rgb(var(--warn))' : undefined }))} />
          </div>
        </Panel>

        <Panel title="Concentration by category" subtitle="Where threat exposure clusters across the portfolio">
          {byCat.length ? <HBarChart rows={byCat.slice(0, 10)} /> : <Empty title="No active threats" />}
          {topCatShare > 0.25 && <div className="mt-3"><Callout tone="warn" title="Concentration">{byCat[0].label} carries {Math.round(topCatShare * 100)}% of portfolio threat exposure across {byCat[0].sub} risks. A program-level response (standard practice, master agreement, or early action) is likely cheaper than project-by-project mitigation.</Callout></div>}
        </Panel>
      </div>

      <Panel className="mt-4" title="Contingency adequacy by project" subtitle="Contingency remaining vs the P80 requirement. Uses each project's saved Monte Carlo run, or a live run from the current register." pad={false}>
        <AdequacyTable rows={perProject} />
      </Panel>

      <Panel className="mt-4" title="Risks realized in the last 90 days" subtitle={`Since ${fmtDate(since)}`} pad={false}>
        {realized.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="Nothing realized in 90 days" /></div> : (
          <div className="scroll-x"><table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Project</th><th>Risk</th><th>Category</th><th className="num">ML</th><th className="num">Drawn</th><th>Draw status</th><th>Lesson</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{realized.map((r) => { const ds = drawsFor(r); return (
              <tr key={r.id}>
                <td className="whitespace-nowrap">{fmtDate(realizedDate(s, r))}</td>
                <td><a className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline" href={projectHref(r.projectId, 'risk')}>{proj(r.projectId).code}</a></td>
                <td><Mono className="mr-1 text-muted">{r.code}</Mono>{r.title}</td>
                <td className="text-[12px]">{r.category}</td>
                <td className="num">{money(r.cost.ml)}</td>
                <td className="num">{ds.length ? money(sum(ds.map((d) => d.amount))) : '—'}</td>
                <td>{ds.map((d) => <StatusBadge key={d.id} status={d.status} />)}</td>
                <td className="max-w-[280px] text-[12px] text-muted">{r.lesson ?? <span className="text-faint">Not yet captured</span>}</td>
              </tr>) })}</tbody>
          </table></div>
        )}
      </Panel>

      <LessonsLibrary />
    </div>
  )
}

function AdequacyTable({ rows }: { rows: { p: { id: string; code: string; name: string; programId: string }; exp: number; cont: number; a: ReturnType<typeof adequacy> | null; mc?: { date: string; iterations: number }; saved: boolean }[] }) {
  const sorted = rows.filter((r) => r.cont || r.exp).slice().sort((a, b) => (a.a ? a.a.gap80 : a.cont - a.exp) - (b.a ? b.a.gap80 : b.cont - b.exp))
  return (
    <div className="scroll-x" style={{ maxHeight: 420, overflowY: 'auto' }}><table className="tbl">
      <thead><tr><th>Project</th><th className="num">Exposure</th><th className="num">Contingency left</th><th className="num">P80 need</th><th className="num">Surplus / gap</th><th>Verdict</th><th>Analysis</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>{sorted.map(({ p, exp, cont, a, mc, saved }) => (
        <tr key={p.id}>
          <td><a href={projectHref(p.id, 'risk')} className="flex items-center gap-2 hover:underline"><ProgramTag programId={p.programId} /><span className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold">{p.code}</span><span className="truncate text-[12px] text-muted">{p.name}</span></a></td>
          <td className="num">{money(exp)}</td>
          <td className="num">{money(cont)}</td>
          <td className="num">{a ? money(a.need80) : '—'}</td>
          <td className={cx('num font-semibold', (a ? a.gap80 : cont - exp) < 0 ? 'text-bad' : 'text-good')}>{money(a ? a.gap80 : cont - exp)}</td>
          <td>{a ? <Badge tone={a.tone}>{a.label}</Badge> : exp > cont ? <Badge tone="bad">Exposure exceeds contingency</Badge> : <Badge>Not simulated</Badge>}</td>
          <td className="text-[12px] text-muted">{mc ? (saved ? `Saved run ${fmtDate(mc.date)}` : `Live run, ${mc.iterations.toLocaleString()} iterations`) : 'Expected value only'}</td>
        </tr>
      ))}</tbody>
    </table></div>
  )
}

function LessonsLibrary() {
  const s = useStore()
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [cat, setCat] = useState('')
  const [wm, setWm] = useState('')
  const all = lessonsLibrary(s)
  const cats = Array.from(new Set(all.map((l) => l.category))).sort()
  const methods = Array.from(new Set(all.flatMap((l) => l.workMethods))).sort()
  const rows = all.filter((l) => (!cat || l.category === cat) && (!wm || l.workMethods.includes(wm)) && (!q || (l.title + ' ' + l.text + ' ' + l.category).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())))
  const proj = (id: string) => s.projects.find((p) => p.id === id)
  return (
    <Panel className="mt-4" title="Lessons learned library" subtitle="Published lessons and closed risks that carry a lesson. Shown to teams planning similar work." pad={false}
      actions={<>
        <Input id="lesson-q" className="w-[200px]" placeholder="Search lessons" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} />
        <Select id="lesson-cat" className="w-[160px]" value={cat} onChange={(e) => setCat(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All categories' }, ...cats]} />
        <Select id="lesson-wm" className="w-[190px]" value={wm} onChange={(e) => setWm(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All work methods' }, ...methods.map((m) => ({ value: m, label: m.replace(/-/g, ' ') }))]} />
      </>}>
      {rows.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="No lessons match">Try a broader search.</Empty></div> : (
        <div className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-line" style={{ maxHeight: 480, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
          {rows.map((l) => {
            const p = proj(l.projectId)
            return (
              <div key={l.id} className="px-4 py-3">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <b className="text-[13px]">{l.title}</b><Badge>{l.category}</Badge>
                  {l.workMethods.map((m) => <Badge key={m} tone="info">{m.replace(/-/g, ' ')}</Badge>)}
                  <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-faint">{fmtDate(l.date)}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-muted">{l.text}</p>
                <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-faint">{l.source} · {p ? <a className="text-link hover:underline" href={projectHref(p.id, 'risk')}>{p.code} {p.name}</a> : '—'}</div>
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </Panel>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/risk/wf.ts =====
// Small workflow helpers shared by the risk and safety modules.
import type { AppState } from '@/core/types'
import { actOnWorkflow } from '@/core/engine/workflow'

/**
 * The person who fills in and submits a record has completed the process's first "form" step.
 * If the current user is an assignee on that step (or an administrator), record their submit.
 */
export function submitFirstForm(d: AppState, instId: string | undefined, comment: string) {
  if (!instId) return
  const inst = d.workflows.find((w) => w.id === instId)
  const slot = inst?.active[0]
  if (!inst || !slot) return
  const def = d.workflowDefs.find((x) => x.id === inst.defId)
  const node = def?.nodes.find((n) => n.id === slot.nodeId)
  if (node?.type !== 'form') return
  const me = d.people.find((p) => p.id === d.currentUserId)
  if (slot.assigneeIds.includes(d.currentUserId) || me?.roles.includes('admin')) {
    try { actOnWorkflow(d, inst.id, slot.nodeId, d.currentUserId, 'submit', comment) } catch { /* leave at the form step */ }
  }
}

===== FILE: src/views/safety/Events.tsx =====
// Safety event log and entry form (SF-09), shared by the project tab, Safety home and field mode.
import { useState } from 'react'
import type { SafetyEvent } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { addDays, fmtDate, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Checkbox, Empty, Field, Input, Modal, SegButtons, StatusBadge, Table, TextArea, type Column } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'

/** Record a safety event; SIF-potential and incidents notify the safety advisor and create a PM corrective action. */
export function logEvent(e: Omit<SafetyEvent, 'id'>): string {
  const id = uid('se')
  mutate((d) => {
    d.safetyEvents.push({ ...e, id })
    if (e.sifPotential || e.type === 'incident') {
      const p = d.projects.find((x) => x.id === e.projectId)
      if (p) {
        p.health.safety = e.type === 'incident' && e.sifPotential ? 'red' : 'amber'
        if (p.team.safety) d.notifications.push({ id: uid('ntf'), at: new Date().toISOString(), toId: p.team.safety, text: `${p.code}: ${e.type}${e.sifPotential ? ' with SIF potential' : ''} — ${e.description}`, link: `#p-${p.id.replace(/\D/g, '')}-safety`, read: false })
        if (p.team.pm && e.status === 'open') d.actions.push({ id: uid('act'), projectId: e.projectId, title: `Corrective action: ${e.description.slice(0, 60)}`, ownerId: p.team.pm, due: addDays(d.settings.asOf, 7), status: 'open', source: 'safety', sourceId: id })
      }
    }
  }, { entity: 'safety-event', entityId: id, projectId: e.projectId, action: 'create', summary: `Logged ${e.type}${e.sifPotential ? ' (SIF potential)' : ''}: ${e.description}` })
  return id
}

export function EventsTable({ events, showProject }: { events: SafetyEvent[]; showProject?: boolean }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const close = (e: SafetyEvent) => mutate((d) => { const x = d.safetyEvents.find((y) => y.id === e.id); if (x) x.status = 'closed' }, { entity: 'safety-event', entityId: e.id, projectId: e.projectId, action: 'close', summary: `Closed ${e.type}: ${e.description}` })
  const cols: Column<SafetyEvent>[] = [
    { key: 'date', header: 'Date', render: (e) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{fmtDate(e.date)}</span>, sort: (e) => e.date },
    ...(showProject ? [{ key: 'p', header: 'Project', render: (e: SafetyEvent) => <a className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline" href={`#p-${e.projectId.replace(/\D/g, '')}-safety`}>{s.projects.find((p) => p.id === e.projectId)?.code}</a> }] : []),
    { key: 'type', header: 'Type', render: (e) => <Badge tone={e.type === 'incident' ? 'bad' : e.type === 'near-miss' ? 'warn' : 'neutral'}>{e.type === 'near-miss' ? 'Near miss' : e.type === 'incident' ? 'Incident' : 'Observation'}</Badge>, sort: (e) => e.type },
    { key: 'desc', header: 'What happened', render: (e) => <div className="min-w-[200px]"><div>{e.description}</div><div className="text-xs text-muted">{e.correctiveAction}</div></div> },
    { key: 'sif', header: 'SIF', render: (e) => (e.sifPotential ? <Badge tone="bad">SIF potential</Badge> : <span className="text-faint">—</span>), sort: (e) => (e.sifPotential ? 1 : 0) },
    { key: 'st', header: 'Status', render: (e) => (e.status === 'open' ? <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><StatusBadge status="open" /><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { close(e); toast('Event closed') }}>Close</Button></span> : <StatusBadge status="closed" />), sort: (e) => e.status },
  ]
  return <Table rows={events} columns={cols} rowKey={(e) => e.id} maxHeight={360} dense empty={<div className="p-4"><Empty title="No events logged">Observations, near misses and incidents appear here.</Empty></div>} />
}

export function EventModal({ open, onClose, projectId, planId, contractor }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; projectId: string; planId?: string; contractor?: string }) {
  const asOf = useStore((s) => s.settings.asOf)
  const [type, setType] = useState<SafetyEvent['type']>('observation')
  const [date, setDate] = useState(asOf)
  const [desc, setDesc] = useState('')
  const [ca, setCa] = useState('')
  const [sif, setSif] = useState(false)
  const [closed, setClosed] = useState(false)
  const save = () => {
    if (!desc.trim()) { toast('Describe what happened.', 'bad'); return }
    logEvent({ projectId, planId, date, type, description: desc.trim(), sifPotential: sif, correctiveAction: ca.trim() || 'Corrective action to be assigned', status: closed ? 'closed' : 'open', contractor })
    toast(sif ? 'Event logged; safety advisor notified' : 'Event logged')
    setDesc(''); setCa(''); setSif(false); setClosed(false); setType('observation'); setDate(asOf)
    onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="Log safety event" footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Log event</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_160px]">
          <Field label="Type"><SegButtons options={[{ id: 'observation', label: 'Observation' }, { id: 'near-miss', label: 'Near miss' }, { id: 'incident', label: 'Incident' }]} value={type} onChange={setType} /></Field>
          <Field label="Date"><Input type="date" value={date} max={asOf} onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)} /></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="What happened"><TextArea id="ev-desc" value={desc} onChange={(e) => setDesc(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Excavator swing radius not barricaded near sidewalk" /></Field>
        <Field label="Corrective action"><TextArea value={ca} onChange={(e) => setCa(e.target.value)} placeholder="What was done, or what must be done and by whom" /></Field>
        <Checkbox checked={sif} onChange={setSif} label={<span><b>Serious injury or fatality (SIF) potential</b><span className="block text-xs text-muted">Could this have resulted in a life-altering injury or fatality? SIF-potential events notify the safety advisor and create a corrective action for the PM.</span></span>} />
        <Checkbox checked={closed} onChange={setClosed} label="Corrected on site — close now" />
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/safety/FieldMode.tsx =====
// Field tailboard (SF-05): phone-first pre-job briefing for the crew, with an offline queue,
// plus a quick observation / near-miss report. Built for gloves and sunlight: big targets, high contrast.
import { prefs } from '@/core/data'
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { SafetyEvent, Tailboard } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { fmtDate, uid, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { logEvent } from './Events'
import { opQualOn, oqLevel, planHazards, ticketLevel } from './lib'

const QKEY = 'crosswalk:field-queue:v1'
const PKEY = 'crosswalk:field-plan:v1'
interface Queued { tailboards: Tailboard[]; events: Omit<SafetyEvent, 'id'>[] }
const readQueue = (): Queued => { try { const r = prefs.getRaw(QKEY); if (r) return JSON.parse(r) } catch { /* storage blocked */ } return { tailboards: [], events: [] } }
const writeQueue = (q: Queued) => { try { prefs.setRaw(QKEY, JSON.stringify(q)) } catch { /* in-memory only */ } }
const readPlan = () => { try { return prefs.getRaw(PKEY) ?? '' } catch { return '' } }
const writePlan = (id: string) => { try { prefs.setRaw(PKEY, id) } catch { /* ignore */ } }

const CTRL = { engineering: 'ENG', administrative: 'ADMIN', ppe: 'PPE' } as const

export default function FieldMode(_props: { projectId?: string; id?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const me = s.people.find((p) => p.id === s.currentUserId)
  const plans = s.safetyPlans.filter((x) => x.status === 'approved' && s.projects.find((p) => p.id === x.projectId)?.status === 'active')
    .sort((a, b) => (s.projects.find((p) => p.id === a.projectId)!.code).localeCompare(s.projects.find((p) => p.id === b.projectId)!.code))
  const defaultPlan = () => {
    const saved = readPlan()
    if (plans.some((x) => x.id === saved)) return saved
    const mine = me?.company ? plans.find((x) => x.contractor === me.company) : undefined
    return (mine ?? plans[0])?.id ?? ''
  }
  const [planId, setPlanId] = useState(defaultPlan)
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'tailboard' | 'report'>('tailboard')
  const [offline, setOffline] = useState(false)
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState<Queued>(readQueue)
  const plan = plans.find((x) => x.id === planId)
  const p = plan ? s.projects.find((x) => x.id === plan.projectId) : undefined
  useEffect(() => { if (planId) writePlan(planId) }, [planId])
  const pushQueue = (q: Queued) => { setQueue(q); writeQueue(q) }
  const queued = queue.tailboards.length + queue.events.length

  const sync = () => {
    if (offline) { toast('Go back online to sync.', 'bad'); return }
    if (!queued) { toast('Nothing to sync', 'info'); return }
    const q = queue
    mutate((d) => { for (const t of q.tailboards) if (!d.tailboards.some((x) => x.id === t.id)) d.tailboards.push(t) }, { entity: 'tailboard', entityId: q.tailboards[0]?.id ?? 'sync', projectId: q.tailboards[0]?.projectId, action: 'sync', summary: `Synced ${q.tailboards.length} tailboard(s) captured offline` })
    for (const e of q.events) logEvent(e)
    pushQueue({ tailboards: [], events: [] })
    toast(`Synced ${q.tailboards.length} tailboard${q.tailboards.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}${q.events.length ? ` and ${q.events.length} report${q.events.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ''}`)
  }

  return (
    <div className="-mx-4 -my-5 min-h-full bg-ground sm:mx-0 sm:my-0">
      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[480px] flex-col gap-3 pb-10 sm:rounded-lg sm:border-2 sm:border-ink/20">
        {/* Status bar */}
        <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center gap-2 bg-steel px-4 py-3 text-steelink sm:rounded-t-lg">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-marker">Field · {fmtDate(asOf)}</div>
            <div className="truncate font-display text-[18px] font-bold text-white">{p ? `${p.code} · ${plan!.workPackage}` : 'Tailboard'}</div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => { setOffline(!offline); toast(offline ? 'Back online' : 'Offline: tailboards will queue on this device', 'info') }}
            className={cx('flex h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border-2 px-3 text-[13px] font-bold', offline ? 'border-warn bg-warn text-ink' : 'border-good/70 text-white')} aria-pressed={offline}>
            <span className={cx('h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full', offline ? 'bg-ink' : 'bg-good')} />{offline ? 'Offline' : 'Online'}
          </button>
        </div>

        {queued > 0 && (
          <div className="mx-3 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md border-2 border-warn bg-warn/10 px-3 py-2.5">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[14px] font-semibold">{queue.tailboards.length} tailboard{queue.tailboards.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}{queue.events.length ? ` · ${queue.events.length} report${queue.events.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ''} waiting to sync</div>
            <button onClick={sync} disabled={offline} className="h-11 rounded-md bg-ink px-4 text-[14px] font-bold text-surface disabled:opacity-40">Sync now</button>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="px-3">
          <label className="mb-1 block text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted" htmlFor="field-plan">Job & safety plan</label>
          <select id="field-plan" value={planId} onChange={(e) => setPlanId(e.target.value)} className="h-12 w-full rounded-md border-2 border-ink/30 bg-surface px-3 text-[15px] font-semibold text-ink">
            {plans.map((x) => { const pp = s.projects.find((y) => y.id === x.projectId)!; return <option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{pp.code} · {x.workPackage} v{x.version} — {pp.location.city}</option> })}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="mx-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-md bg-sunken p-1">
          {(['tailboard', 'report'] as const).map((m) => (
            <button key={m} onClick={() => setMode(m)} className={cx('h-12 rounded text-[15px] font-bold', mode === m ? 'bg-ink text-surface' : 'text-muted')}>{m === 'tailboard' ? 'Tailboard' : 'Report observation'}</button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {!plan || !p ? (
          <div className="mx-3 rounded-md border-2 border-dashed border-line p-6 text-center text-[14px] text-muted">No approved safety plans for active jobs. Work cannot start without one.</div>
        ) : mode === 'tailboard' ? (
          <TailboardForm key={plan.id} planId={plan.id} offline={offline} onQueue={(t) => pushQueue({ ...queue, tailboards: [...queue.tailboards, t] })} queuedToday={queue.tailboards.filter((t) => t.planId === plan.id && t.date === asOf).length} />
        ) : (
          <ReportForm key={plan.id + 'r'} planId={plan.id} offline={offline} onQueue={(e) => pushQueue({ ...queue, events: [...queue.events, e] })} onDone={() => setMode('tailboard')} />
        )}

        {p && <a href={projectHref(p.id, 'safety')} className="mx-3 mt-2 text-center text-[13px] font-semibold text-link">Open full project safety record</a>}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function TailboardForm({ planId, offline, onQueue, queuedToday }: { planId: string; offline: boolean; onQueue: (t: Tailboard) => void; queuedToday: number }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const plan = s.safetyPlans.find((x) => x.id === planId)!
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === plan.projectId)!
  const hazards = planHazards(s, plan)
  const foreman = plan.crew.find((c) => /foreman/i.test(c.role)) ?? plan.crew[0]
  const [leader, setLeader] = useState(foreman?.name ?? '')
  const [covered, setCovered] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(hazards[0]?.id ?? null)
  const [present, setPresent] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(foreman ? [foreman.name] : []))
  const [visitors, setVisitors] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [visitor, setVisitor] = useState('')
  const [swa, setSwa] = useState(false)
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('')
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<string[]>([])
  const today = s.tailboards.filter((t) => t.planId === planId && t.date === asOf)
  const tickets = plan.tickets.map((t) => ({ t, st: ticketLevel(t.expires, asOf) })).filter((x) => x.st.level !== 'ok')
  const expired = tickets.filter((x) => x.st.level === 'bad')
  const extraFor = (id: string) => plan.extraControls.filter((x) => x.hazardId === id)
  const toggle = (set: Set<string>, v: string, f: (x: Set<string>) => void) => { const n = new Set(set); if (n.has(v)) n.delete(v); else n.add(v); f(n) }
  const attendees = [...plan.crew.map((c) => c.name).filter((n) => present.has(n)), ...visitors.map((v) => `${v} (visitor)`)]
  const missing = [!leader && 'leader', covered.size === 0 && 'hazards', attendees.length === 0 && 'crew sign-in', !swa && 'stop-work reminder'].filter(Boolean) as string[]
  const oqIssues = useMemo(() => !opQualOn(s) ? [] : plan.crew.filter((c) => present.has(c.name) && c.oqTasks.length && oqLevel(c.oqExpires, asOf).level === 'bad'), [plan, present, asOf])

  const submit = () => {
    if (missing.length) { toast(`Still needed: ${missing.join(', ')}`, 'bad'); return }
    const t: Tailboard = {
      id: uid('tb'), planId, projectId: plan.projectId, date: asOf, leader, attendees, hazardsDiscussed: Array.from(covered),
      notes: [notes.trim(), photos.length ? `Photos: ${photos.join(', ')}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join('\n'), stopWorkReminder: swa, offlineCaptured: offline || undefined,
    }
    if (offline) { onQueue(t); toast('Saved on this device. Sync when you have signal.', 'info') }
    else {
      mutate((d) => { d.tailboards.push(t) }, { entity: 'tailboard', entityId: t.id, projectId: t.projectId, action: 'create', summary: `Tailboard ${p.code} ${plan.workPackage}: ${attendees.length} signed in, ${covered.size} hazards, led by ${leader}` })
      toast('Tailboard submitted')
    }
    setCovered(new Set()); setPresent(new Set(foreman ? [foreman.name] : [])); setVisitors([]); setSwa(false); setNotes(''); setPhotos([])
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 px-3">
      {(today.length > 0 || queuedToday > 0) && <div className="rounded-md border-2 border-good bg-good/10 px-3 py-2.5 text-[14px] font-semibold">Today: {today.length + queuedToday} tailboard{today.length + queuedToday > 1 ? 's' : ''} recorded{today[0] ? `, led by ${today[0].leader}` : ''}. Add another for a new crew or a change in conditions.</div>}

      {expired.length > 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-md border-2 border-bad bg-bad px-3 py-3 text-white">
          <div className="text-[16px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide">Do not dig</div>
          {expired.map(({ t, st }) => <div key={t.id} className="text-[14px] font-semibold">{t.type} {t.number}: {st.label.toLowerCase()}</div>)}
        </div>
      )}
      {tickets.filter((x) => x.st.level === 'warn').map(({ t, st }) => <div key={t.id} className="rounded-md border-2 border-warn bg-warn/10 px-3 py-2 text-[14px] font-semibold">{t.type} {t.number}: {st.label.toLowerCase()} — renew now</div>)}

      <Card title="Emergency">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 text-[15px]">
          <div><span className="text-[12px] font-bold uppercase text-muted">Hospital</span><div className="font-bold">{plan.site.hospital}</div><div className="text-[13px] text-muted">{plan.site.hospitalRoute}</div></div>
          <div><span className="text-[12px] font-bold uppercase text-muted">Muster point</span><div className="font-bold">{plan.site.musterPoint}</div></div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">{plan.site.contacts.map((c) => <a key={c.name + c.role} href={`tel:${c.phone.replace(/\D/g, '')}`} className="flex h-11 items-center rounded-md border-2 border-ink/30 px-3 text-[13px] font-bold">{c.role}: {c.phone}</a>)}</div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">{plan.heatPlan && <span className="rounded bg-warn/20 px-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-warn">HEAT PLAN IN EFFECT</span>}{plan.trafficPlan && <span className="rounded bg-info/15 px-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-info">TRAFFIC PLAN</span>}</div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Led by">
        <select value={leader} onChange={(e) => setLeader(e.target.value)} className="h-12 w-full rounded-md border-2 border-ink/30 bg-surface px-3 text-[15px] font-semibold">
          {plan.crew.map((c) => <option key={c.id} value={c.name}>{c.name} — {c.role}</option>)}
        </select>
      </Card>

      <Card title={`Today's hazards · ${covered.size}/${hazards.length} covered`} action={<button onClick={() => setCovered(covered.size === hazards.length ? new Set() : new Set(hazards.map((h) => h.id)))} className="h-9 rounded border-2 border-ink/30 px-3 text-[12px] font-bold">{covered.size === hazards.length ? 'Clear' : 'All covered'}</button>}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {hazards.map((h) => {
            const on = covered.has(h.id)
            const expanded = open === h.id
            return (
              <div key={h.id} className={cx('overflow-hidden rounded-md border-2', on ? 'border-good' : 'border-line')}>
                <div className="flex items-stretch">
                  <button className="min-w-0 flex-1 px-3 py-2.5 text-left" onClick={() => setOpen(expanded ? null : h.id)} aria-expanded={expanded}>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">{h.activity}</div>
                    <div className="text-[16px] font-bold leading-tight">{h.hazard}</div>
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={() => { toggle(covered, h.id, setCovered); if (!on) { const next = hazards.find((x) => x.id !== h.id && !covered.has(x.id)); setOpen(next?.id ?? null) } }}
                    className={cx('flex w-[84px] shrink-0 flex-col items-center justify-center text-[12px] font-black uppercase', on ? 'bg-good text-white' : 'bg-sunken text-muted')} aria-pressed={on}>
                    <span className="text-[22px] leading-none">{on ? '✓' : '○'}</span>{on ? 'Covered' : 'Tap'}
                  </button>
                </div>
                {expanded && (
                  <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 border-t border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2.5 text-[14px]">
                    {h.controls.map((c, i) => <li key={i} className="flex gap-2"><span className="w-[52px] shrink-0 pt-0.5 text-[10px] font-black text-faint">{CTRL[c.type]}</span><span>{c.text}</span></li>)}
                    {extraFor(h.id).map((x, i) => <li key={'x' + i} className="flex gap-2"><span className="w-[52px] shrink-0 pt-0.5 text-[10px] font-black text-ink">SITE</span><span className="font-semibold">{x.text}</span></li>)}
                    {h.permits.length > 0 && <li className="text-[12px] text-muted">Permit: {h.permits.join(', ')}</li>}
                  </ul>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title={`Crew sign-in · ${attendees.length}`}>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {plan.crew.map((c) => {
            const on = present.has(c.name)
            const oq = oqLevel(c.oqExpires, asOf)
            return (
              <button key={c.id} onClick={() => toggle(present, c.name, setPresent)} aria-pressed={on}
                className={cx('flex min-h-[60px] flex-col items-start justify-center rounded-md border-2 px-3 py-2 text-left', on ? 'border-ink bg-ink text-surface' : 'border-line bg-surface')}>
                <span className="text-[15px] font-bold leading-tight">{on ? '✓ ' : ''}{c.name}</span>
                <span className={cx('text-[11px] font-semibold', on ? 'text-surface/75' : 'text-muted')}>{c.role}{opQualOn(s) && c.oqTasks.length && oq.level === 'bad' ? ' · OQ EXPIRED' : ''}</span>
              </button>
            )
          })}
          {visitors.map((v) => <button key={v} onClick={() => setVisitors(visitors.filter((x) => x !== v))} className="flex min-h-[60px] flex-col items-start justify-center rounded-md border-2 border-info bg-info/10 px-3 py-2 text-left"><span className="text-[15px] font-bold">✓ {v}</span><span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted">Visitor · tap to remove</span></button>)}
        </div>
        {oqIssues.length > 0 && <div className="mt-2 rounded-md border-2 border-bad bg-bad/10 px-3 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-bad">{oqIssues.map((c) => c.name).join(', ')}: operator qualification expired — may not perform covered tasks ({oqIssues.flatMap((c) => c.oqTasks).join(', ')}).</div>}
        <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">
          <input value={visitor} onChange={(e) => setVisitor(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && visitor.trim()) { setVisitors([...visitors, visitor.trim()]); setVisitor('') } }} placeholder="Visitor name & company" className="h-12 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border-2 border-ink/30 bg-surface px-3 text-[15px]" />
          <button onClick={() => { if (visitor.trim()) { setVisitors([...visitors, visitor.trim()]); setVisitor('') } }} className="h-12 shrink-0 rounded-md border-2 border-ink px-4 text-[14px] font-bold">Add</button>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <button onClick={() => setSwa(!swa)} aria-pressed={swa} className={cx('flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md border-[3px] px-4 py-4 text-left', swa ? 'border-good bg-good/10' : 'border-bad bg-bad/5')}>
        <span className={cx('flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-[22px] font-black', swa ? 'bg-good text-white' : 'border-2 border-bad text-bad')}>{swa ? '✓' : '!'}</span>
        <span><span className="block text-[16px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide">Stop-work authority</span><span className="block text-[13px] text-muted">Everyone can stop the job when something changes or a hazard isn't controlled. No blame. Tap when the crew has heard it.</span></span>
      </button>

      <Card title="Notes & photos">
        <textarea value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="Conditions, changes from yesterday, weather, who is new on site" className="min-h-[90px] w-full rounded-md border-2 border-ink/30 bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-[15px]" />
        <label className="mt-2 flex h-12 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-md border-2 border-dashed border-ink/40 text-[14px] font-bold">
          <input type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment" multiple className="sr-only" onChange={(e) => { const names = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []).map((f) => f.name); if (names.length) { setPhotos([...photos, ...names]); toast(`${names.length} photo${names.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} attached`, 'info') } e.target.value = '' }} />
          Take or attach photo
        </label>
        {photos.length > 0 && <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">{photos.map((n, i) => <button key={i} onClick={() => setPhotos(photos.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} className="rounded border border-line bg-sunken px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[11px]">{n} ✕</button>)}</div>}
      </Card>

      <button onClick={submit} className={cx('h-16 rounded-md text-[18px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide shadow-sm', missing.length ? 'bg-sunken text-muted' : 'bg-marker text-markerink')}>
        {offline ? 'Save tailboard offline' : 'Submit tailboard'}
      </button>
      {missing.length > 0 && <p className="-mt-1 text-center text-[13px] text-muted">Still needed: {missing.join(' · ')}</p>}
    </div>
  )
}

function ReportForm({ planId, offline, onQueue, onDone }: { planId: string; offline: boolean; onQueue: (e: Omit<SafetyEvent, 'id'>) => void; onDone: () => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const plan = s.safetyPlans.find((x) => x.id === planId)!
  const [type, setType] = useState<SafetyEvent['type']>('observation')
  const [desc, setDesc] = useState('')
  const [sif, setSif] = useState<boolean | null>(null)
  const [fixed, setFixed] = useState(false)
  const [ca, setCa] = useState('')
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<string[]>([])
  const submit = () => {
    if (!desc.trim()) { toast('Say what you saw.', 'bad'); return }
    if (sif === null) { toast('Answer the SIF question.', 'bad'); return }
    const e: Omit<SafetyEvent, 'id'> = {
      projectId: plan.projectId, planId, date: s.settings.asOf, type, description: desc.trim() + (photos.length ? ` [photos: ${photos.join(', ')}]` : ''), sifPotential: sif,
      correctiveAction: ca.trim() || (fixed ? 'Corrected on site' : 'Reported from field; corrective action to be assigned'), status: fixed ? 'closed' : 'open', contractor: plan.contractor,
    }
    if (offline) { onQueue(e); toast('Report saved on this device', 'info') }
    else { logEvent(e); toast(sif ? 'Reported. Safety advisor notified.' : 'Report submitted') }
    setDesc(''); setSif(null); setFixed(false); setCa(''); setPhotos([])
    onDone()
  }
  const T: { id: SafetyEvent['type']; label: string; cls: string }[] = [
    { id: 'observation', label: 'Observation', cls: 'border-ink bg-ink text-surface' },
    { id: 'near-miss', label: 'Near miss', cls: 'border-warn bg-warn text-ink' },
    { id: 'incident', label: 'Incident', cls: 'border-bad bg-bad text-white' },
  ]
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 px-3">
      <Card title="What kind?">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">{T.map((t) => <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setType(t.id)} aria-pressed={type === t.id} className={cx('h-14 rounded-md border-2 text-[14px] font-bold', type === t.id ? t.cls : 'border-line bg-surface')}>{t.label}</button>)}</div>
        {type === 'incident' && <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-bad">Injury or damage: call 911 first if anyone is hurt, then your supervisor and Gas Control.</p>}
      </Card>
      <Card title="What did you see?">
        <textarea value={desc} onChange={(e) => setDesc(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Spoil pile right at trench edge on the east side" className="min-h-[100px] w-full rounded-md border-2 border-ink/30 bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-[15px]" />
        <label className="mt-2 flex h-12 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-md border-2 border-dashed border-ink/40 text-[14px] font-bold">
          <input type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment" multiple className="sr-only" onChange={(e) => { const names = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []).map((f) => f.name); if (names.length) setPhotos([...photos, ...names]); e.target.value = '' }} />
          {photos.length ? `${photos.length} photo${photos.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} attached — add more` : 'Take or attach photo'}
        </label>
      </Card>
      <Card title="Could this have killed or seriously hurt someone?">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <button onClick={() => setSif(true)} aria-pressed={sif === true} className={cx('h-14 rounded-md border-2 text-[16px] font-black', sif === true ? 'border-bad bg-bad text-white' : 'border-line bg-surface')}>Yes</button>
          <button onClick={() => setSif(false)} aria-pressed={sif === false} className={cx('h-14 rounded-md border-2 text-[16px] font-black', sif === false ? 'border-ink bg-ink text-surface' : 'border-line bg-surface')}>No</button>
        </div>
      </Card>
      <Card title="Fixed?">
        <button onClick={() => setFixed(!fixed)} aria-pressed={fixed} className={cx('flex h-14 w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-md border-2 px-3 text-left text-[15px] font-bold', fixed ? 'border-good bg-good/10' : 'border-line bg-surface')}><span className={cx('flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded text-[18px]', fixed ? 'bg-good text-white' : 'border-2 border-line')}>{fixed ? '✓' : ''}</span>Corrected on site</button>
        <textarea value={ca} onChange={(e) => setCa(e.target.value)} placeholder="What was done (or needs to be done)" className="mt-2 min-h-[64px] w-full rounded-md border-2 border-ink/30 bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-[15px]" />
      </Card>
      <button onClick={submit} className="h-16 rounded-md bg-marker text-[18px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-markerink shadow-sm">{offline ? 'Save report offline' : 'Send report'}</button>
    </div>
  )
}

function Card({ title, action, children }: { title: string; action?: React.ReactNode; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="rounded-md border-2 border-line bg-surface p-3">
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><h2 className="text-[13px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-ink">{title}</h2>{action}</div>
      {children}
    </section>
  )
}

// Safety helpers (SF-*): ticket expiry, OQ coverage, leading indicators, printable JSSP.
import type { AppState, HazardItem, SafetyPlan } from '@/core/types'
import { addDays, daysBetween, fmtDate, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { htmlDoc } from '@/core/download'

export type Level = 'ok' | 'warn' | 'bad'
export const levelTone = (l: Level) => (l === 'bad' ? 'bad' : l === 'warn' ? 'warn' : 'good') as 'bad' | 'warn' | 'good'

/** Ticket status (SF-04): expired = bad, expiring within 3 days = warn. */
export function ticketLevel(expires: string, asOf: string): { level: Level; days: number; label: string } {
  const days = daysBetween(asOf, expires)
  if (days < 0) return { level: 'bad', days, label: `Expired ${-days} day${days === -1 ? '' : 's'} ago` }
  if (days === 0) return { level: 'warn', days, label: 'Expires today' }
  if (days <= 3) return { level: 'warn', days, label: `Expires in ${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'}` }
  return { level: 'ok', days, label: `${days} days left` }
}

/** Crew member OQ status (SF-06). */
export function oqLevel(expires: string, asOf: string): { level: Level; label: string } {
  const d = daysBetween(asOf, expires)
  if (d < 0) return { level: 'bad', label: `OQ expired ${fmtDate(expires)}` }
  if (d <= 30) return { level: 'warn', label: `OQ expires ${fmtDate(expires)}` }
  return { level: 'ok', label: `OQ valid to ${fmtDate(expires)}` }
}

/** Operator-qualification records (an operator-qualification provider feed) are a phase-2 module, off for the pilot. */
export const opQualOn = (s: Pick<AppState, 'settings'>) => !!s.settings.features?.opQual

export const planHazards = (s: Pick<AppState, 'hazards'>, plan: Pick<SafetyPlan, 'hazardIds'>): HazardItem[] => plan.hazardIds.map((id) => s.hazards.find((h) => h.id === id)).filter((h): h is HazardItem => !!h)

/**
 * Operator-qualification coverage (SF-06): for each hazard that involves covered tasks, at least one crew
 * member must hold a current OQ for one of those tasks (e.g. Hot tapping OR Tapping & stopping).
 */
export function oqCoverage(s: Pick<AppState, 'hazards'>, plan: SafetyPlan, asOf: string) {
  const groups = new Map<string, string[]>()
  for (const h of planHazards(s, plan)) if (h.oqTasks.length) groups.set(h.oqTasks.join(' / '), h.oqTasks)
  return Array.from(groups.entries()).map(([task, tasks]) => {
    const holders = plan.crew.filter((c) => c.oqTasks.some((t) => tasks.includes(t)))
    const valid = holders.filter((c) => c.oqExpires >= asOf)
    return { task, tasks, holders, valid, level: (valid.length ? 'ok' : 'bad') as Level }
  })
}

export const requiredPermits = (s: Pick<AppState, 'hazards'>, plan: Pick<SafetyPlan, 'hazardIds'>) => Array.from(new Set(planHazards(s, plan).flatMap((h) => h.permits)))

/** Pre-mobilization checks a reviewer looks at before approving the plan. */
export function planIssues(s: AppState, plan: SafetyPlan): { level: Level; text: string }[] {
  const out: { level: Level; text: string }[] = []
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  for (const t of plan.tickets) {
    const st = ticketLevel(t.expires, asOf)
    if (st.level !== 'ok') out.push({ level: st.level, text: `${t.type} ${t.number}: ${st.label.toLowerCase()}` })
  }
  const have = new Set(plan.tickets.map((t) => t.type as string))
  for (const p of requiredPermits(s, plan)) {
    const covered = have.has(p) || (p === 'Excavation permit' && have.has('Encroachment permit')) || (p === 'Discharge permit' && s.permits.some((x) => x.projectId === plan.projectId && /discharge/i.test(x.type) && x.status === 'issued'))
    if (!covered) out.push({ level: p === '811 locate' ? 'bad' : 'warn', text: `${p} required by the hazards but not listed in tickets & permits` })
  }
  const oqOn = opQualOn(s)
  if (oqOn) for (const c of oqCoverage(s, plan, asOf)) if (!c.valid.length) out.push({ level: 'bad', text: `No crew member with a current OQ for “${c.task}”` })
  for (const c of plan.crew) {
    const oq = oqLevel(c.oqExpires, asOf)
    if (oqOn && oq.level === 'bad' && c.oqTasks.length) out.push({ level: 'bad', text: `${c.name}: ${oq.label} — may not perform ${c.oqTasks.join(', ')}` })
    if (c.prequal === 'Non-compliant') out.push({ level: 'bad', text: `${c.company} prequalification non-compliant (${c.name})` })
  }
  const prequal = Array.from(new Set(plan.crew.filter((c) => c.prequal === 'Conditional').map((c) => c.company)))
  for (const co of prequal) out.push({ level: 'warn', text: `${co}: ISNetworld-style prequalification is Conditional` })
  if (!plan.site.hospital || !plan.site.musterPoint) out.push({ level: 'bad', text: 'Emergency information incomplete (hospital or muster point)' })
  if (planHazards(s, plan).some((h) => h.activity === 'Traffic control') && !plan.trafficPlan) out.push({ level: 'warn', text: 'Traffic control activity without a traffic plan flag' })
  return out
}

export function workingDays(from: string, to: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, 1)) { const w = new Date(d + 'T12:00:00Z').getUTCDay(); if (w !== 0 && w !== 6) out.push(d) }
  return out
}

/** Leading indicators (SF-10) for a set of projects over the last `days` calendar days. */
export function indicators(s: AppState, projectIds: string[], days = 30, contractor?: string) {
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const from = addDays(asOf, -days)
  const ids = new Set(projectIds)
  const plans = s.safetyPlans.filter((p) => ids.has(p.projectId) && p.status === 'approved' && (!contractor || p.contractor === contractor))
  // a project is "working" from its first tailboard in the window (or plan approval) until yesterday
  const recent = workingDays(addDays(asOf, -14), addDays(asOf, -1))
  let expected = 0, held = 0
  for (const pl of plans) {
    const tbs = s.tailboards.filter((t) => t.planId === pl.id || (t.projectId === pl.projectId && !plans.some((x) => x.id === t.planId)))
    const days0 = recent.filter((d) => !pl.approvedAt || d >= pl.approvedAt)
    expected += days0.length
    held += days0.filter((d) => tbs.some((t) => t.date === d)).length
  }
  const events = s.safetyEvents.filter((e) => ids.has(e.projectId) && (!contractor || e.contractor === contractor))
  const win = events.filter((e) => e.date >= from)
  const tickets = plans.flatMap((p) => p.tickets)
  const lapsed = tickets.filter((t) => t.expires < asOf).length
  const expiring = tickets.filter((t) => t.expires >= asOf && daysBetween(asOf, t.expires) <= 3).length
  const wd = Math.max(1, workingDays(from, addDays(asOf, -1)).length)
  return {
    plans: plans.length,
    tailboardRate: expected ? held / expected : null,
    tailboardsHeld: held, tailboardsExpected: expected,
    observations: win.filter((e) => e.type === 'observation').length,
    nearMisses: win.filter((e) => e.type === 'near-miss').length,
    incidents: win.filter((e) => e.type === 'incident').length,
    obsPerWeek: (win.filter((e) => e.type !== 'incident').length / wd) * 5 / Math.max(1, plans.length),
    lapsed, expiring,
    openEvents: events.filter((e) => e.status === 'open').length,
    sif: events.filter((e) => e.sifPotential && e.status === 'open').length,
    sifAll: win.filter((e) => e.sifPotential).length,
  }
}

export function blankPlan(s: AppState, projectId: string, workPackage: string): SafetyPlan {
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId)!
  const cm = s.people.find((x) => x.id === p.team.constructionManager)
  const contractor = p.contractor ?? 'Contractor to be awarded'
  const cs = s.people.find((x) => x.company === contractor)
  return {
    id: uid('jssp'), projectId, workPackage, version: 1, status: 'draft', contractor, activities: [], hazardIds: [], extraControls: [],
    site: { address: '', hospital: `${p.location.city} Regional Medical Center`, hospitalRoute: '', musterPoint: '', contacts: [cm ? { name: cm.name, role: 'Construction Manager', phone: '(555) 201-4410' } : null, cs ? { name: cs.name, role: 'Contractor Safety', phone: '(555) 388-1902' } : null, { name: 'Gas Control', role: '24-hour', phone: '(555) 600-0100' }].filter((x): x is { name: string; role: string; phone: string } => !!x) },
    tickets: [], crew: [], heatPlan: true, trafficPlan: p.permitsNeeded.encroachment, createdAt: s.settings.asOf, libraryVersion: '2026.1',
  }
}

const esc = (t: string) => t.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')

/** Printable job-specific safety plan (SF-*). */

  const hz = planHazards(s, plan)
  const byAct: Record<string, HazardItem[]> = {}
  for (const h of hz) (byAct[h.activity] ||= []).push(h)
  const wf = s.workflows.find((w) => w.id === plan.workflowInstanceId)
  const sigs = wf ? wf.history.filter((h) => h.action === 'approve' || h.action === 'submit') : []
  const name = (id: string) => s.people.find((x) => x.id === id)?.name ?? id
  const cov = oqCoverage(s, plan, asOf)
  const oqOn = opQualOn(s)
  const body = `
  <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;border-bottom:4px solid #141b24;padding-bottom:8px">

    <div style="text-align:right"><div><b>Version ${plan.version}</b> · <span class="tag">${plan.status.toUpperCase()}</span></div><div class="meta">Hazard library ${esc(plan.libraryVersion)}<br/>Prepared ${fmtDate(plan.createdAt)}${plan.approvedAt ? `<br/>Approved ${fmtDate(plan.approvedAt)}` : ''}</div></div>
  </div>
  <h2>1. Project and contractor</h2>

  <tr><th>Contractor</th><td>${esc(plan.contractor)}</td><th>Location</th><td>${esc(plan.site.address || p.location.city)}</td></tr>
  <tr><th>Scope</th><td colspan="3">${esc(p.scope.summary)}</td></tr>
