'Heat illness prevention plan' : ''}${plan.heatPlan && plan.trafficPlan ? '; ' : ''}${plan.trafficPlan ? 'Traffic control plan' : ''}${!plan.heatPlan && !plan.trafficPlan ? 'None' : ''}</td></tr></table>
  <h2>2. Emergency information</h2>
  <table><tr><th style="width:22%">Nearest hospital</th><td>${esc(plan.site.hospital)}</td></tr><tr><th>Route</th><td>${esc(plan.site.hospitalRoute)}</td></tr><tr><th>Muster point</th><td>${esc(plan.site.musterPoint)}</td></tr><tr><th>Emergency</th><td><b>Call 911</b>, then Gas Control. Any person may stop work.</td></tr></table>
  <table><tr><th>Contact</th><th>Role</th><th>Phone</th></tr>${plan.site.contacts.map((c) => `<tr><td>${esc(c.name)}</td><td>${esc(c.role)}</td><td>${esc(c.phone)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>
  <h2>3. Activities, hazards and controls</h2>
  <p class="meta">Controls are listed in hierarchy order: engineering, administrative, then PPE. Site-specific controls are added below each hazard.</p>
  ${Object.entries(byAct).map(([act, hs]) => `<h3>${esc(act)}</h3><table><tr><th style="width:26%">Hazard</th><th>Controls</th><th style="width:18%">${oqOn ? 'Permits / OQ' : 'Permits'}</th></tr>${hs.map((h) => {
    const extra = plan.extraControls.filter((x) => x.hazardId === h.id)
    const order = { engineering: 0, administrative: 1, ppe: 2 } as Record<string, number>
    return `<tr><td><b>${esc(h.hazard)}</b></td><td>${h.controls.slice().sort((a, b) => order[a.type] - order[b.type]).map((c) => `<div><span class="tag">${c.type === 'ppe' ? 'PPE' : c.type.toUpperCase()}</span> ${esc(c.text)}</div>`).join('')}${extra.map((x) => `<div><span class="tag">SITE-SPECIFIC</span> ${esc(x.text)}</div>`).join('')}</td><td>${[...h.permits, ...(oqOn ? h.oqTasks.map((o) => 'OQ: ' + o) : [])].map(esc).join('<br/>') || '—'}</td></tr>`
  }).join('')}</table>`).join('')}
  <h2>4. Tickets and permits</h2>
  <table><tr><th>Type</th><th>Number</th><th>Expires</th><th>Status as of ${fmtDate(asOf)}</th></tr>${plan.tickets.map((t) => `<tr><td>${esc(t.type)}</td><td>${esc(t.number)}</td><td>${fmtDate(t.expires)}</td><td>${ticketLevel(t.expires, asOf).label}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="4">None listed</td></tr>'}</table>
  ${oqOn ? `<h2>5. Crew, operator qualification and prequalification</h2>
  <table><tr><th>Name</th><th>Company</th><th>Role</th><th>OQ tasks</th><th>OQ expires</th><th>Prequal</th></tr>${plan.crew.map((c) => `<tr><td>${esc(c.name)}</td><td>${esc(c.company)}</td><td>${esc(c.role)}</td><td>${c.oqTasks.map(esc).join(', ') || '—'}</td><td>${fmtDate(c.oqExpires)}${c.oqExpires < asOf ? ' (EXPIRED)' : ''}</td><td>${c.prequal}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>
  <table><tr><th>Covered task required by hazards</th><th>Qualified crew</th></tr>${cov.map((c) => `<tr><td>${esc(c.task)}</td><td>${c.valid.map((x) => esc(x.name)).join(', ') || '<b>NONE — task may not be performed</b>'}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="2">No covered tasks</td></tr>'}</table>` : `<h2>5. Crew and prequalification</h2>
  <table><tr><th>Name</th><th>Company</th><th>Role</th><th>Prequal</th></tr>${plan.crew.map((c) => `<tr><td>${esc(c.name)}</td><td>${esc(c.company)}</td><td>${esc(c.role)}</td><td>${c.prequal}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="4">No crew listed</td></tr>'}</table>`}
  <h2>6. Stop-work authority</h2>
  <p>Every person on this job has the authority and the obligation to stop work when conditions change or a hazard is not controlled. No one will be disciplined for stopping work in good faith. Work resumes only after the hazard is controlled and the crew is re-briefed at a tailboard.</p>
  <h2>7. Review and approval</h2>
  <table><tr><th>Step</th><th>Name</th><th>Action</th><th>Date</th></tr>${sigs.map((h) => `<tr><td>${esc(s.workflowDefs.find((d) => d.id === wf!.defId)?.nodes.find((n) => n.id === h.nodeId)?.label ?? '')}</td><td>${esc(name(h.actorId))}</td><td>${h.action === 'approve' ? 'Approved (e-signed)' : 'Submitted'}</td><td>${h.at.slice(0, 10)}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="4">Not yet routed for approval</td></tr>'}</table>
  <p class="meta" style="margin-top:24px">Generated by Crosswalk on ${fmtDate(asOf)}. Keep a copy at the job site. Fictional demo data.</p>`
  return htmlDoc(`JSSP ${p.code} ${plan.workPackage} v${plan.version}`, body)
}

===== FILE: src/views/safety/PlanEditor.tsx =====
// Job-specific safety plan builder (SF-01 … SF-07, SF-11): activities → hazards & controls from the library,
// site-specific controls, permits/tickets, emergency info, crew OQ and prequalification.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { SafetyPlan, TicketType } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { askJSON, aiMessage, useAiAvailable } from '@/core/ai'
import { addDays, uid, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { AiTag, Badge, Button, Callout, Checkbox, Drawer, Field, Input, Select, Tabs, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { levelTone, opQualOn, oqCoverage, oqLevel, planHazards, planIssues, requiredPermits, ticketLevel } from './lib'

const TICKET_TYPES: TicketType[] = ['811 locate', 'Excavation permit', 'Encroachment permit', 'Hot work permit', 'Confined space permit', 'Lift plan']
const CTRL_LABEL = { engineering: 'Engineering', administrative: 'Admin', ppe: 'PPE' } as const

type Tab = 'hazards' | 'site' | 'tickets' | 'crew'

export function PlanEditor({ plan, open, onClose }: { plan: SafetyPlan | null; open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [d, setD] = useState<SafetyPlan | null>(plan)
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('hazards')
  const [newCtl, setNewCtl] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})
  const [ai, setAi] = useState<{ key: string; hazardId: string; text: string; why: string }[]>([])
  const [aiBusy, setAiBusy] = useState(false)
  const aiOk = useAiAvailable()
  useEffect(() => { setD(plan ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(plan)) : null); setTab('hazards'); setAi([]); setNewCtl({}) }, [plan, open])
  if (!d) return null
  const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.id === d.projectId)!
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const oqOn = opQualOn(s)
  const activities = Array.from(new Set(s.hazards.map((h) => h.activity)))
  const allOq = Array.from(new Set(s.hazards.flatMap((h) => h.oqTasks)))
  const hz = planHazards(s, d)
  const set = <K extends keyof SafetyPlan>(k: K, v: SafetyPlan[K]) => setD({ ...d, [k]: v })
  const toggleAct = (a: string, on: boolean) => {
    const acts = on ? [...d.activities, a] : d.activities.filter((x) => x !== a)
    const ids = s.hazards.filter((h) => acts.includes(h.activity)).map((h) => h.id)
    setD({ ...d, activities: acts, hazardIds: ids, extraControls: d.extraControls.filter((x) => ids.includes(x.hazardId)) })
  }
  const addCtl = (hazardId: string, text: string) => { if (!text.trim()) return; setD((x) => x && ({ ...x, extraControls: [...x.extraControls, { hazardId, text: text.trim() }] })); setNewCtl((m) => ({ ...m, [hazardId]: '' })) }
  const issues = planIssues(s, d)
  const save = () => {
    mutate((dr) => { const i = dr.safetyPlans.findIndex((x) => x.id === d.id); if (i >= 0) dr.safetyPlans[i] = d; else dr.safetyPlans.push(d) },
      { entity: 'safety-plan', entityId: d.id, projectId: d.projectId, action: 'update', summary: `Saved JSSP ${d.workPackage} v${d.version} draft (${d.activities.length} activities, ${d.hazardIds.length} hazards, ${d.crew.length} crew)` })
    toast('Safety plan draft saved')
    onClose()
  }
  const draft = async () => {
    setAiBusy(true)
    const prompt = `You are a gas utility construction safety advisor reviewing a contractor's job-specific safety plan (fictional demo data). Propose ADDITIONAL site-specific controls that the standard hazard library does not already cover.

Project: ${p.code} ${p.name}
Scope: ${p.scope.summary}
Location: ${d.site.address || p.location.city}; ${p.location.terrain}; class location ${p.location.classLocation}; HCA ${p.location.hca ? 'yes' : 'no'}; assumptions: ${p.scope.assumptions.join('; ')}
Asset: ${p.asset.diameterIn}" ${p.asset.material}, MAOP ${p.asset.maopPsig} psig, vintage ${p.asset.vintage}
Contractor: ${d.contractor}; crew of ${d.crew.length}
Activities: ${d.activities.join(', ')}
Hazards with existing library controls:
${hz.map((h) => `- [${h.id}] ${h.activity} / ${h.hazard}: ${h.controls.map((c) => c.text).join('; ')}`).join('\n')}
Already-added site-specific controls: ${d.extraControls.map((x) => x.text).join('; ') || 'none'}

Return JSON exactly: {"controls":[{"hazardId": one of the ids in brackets above, "text": one concrete, verifiable control a foreman can check (max 25 words), "why": one short sentence tying it to this site}]}. Give 4 to 7 controls. Do not repeat existing controls.`
    try {
      const r = await askJSON<{ controls: { hazardId: string; text: string; why: string }[] }>(prompt)
      const ok = (r.controls ?? []).filter((c) => d.hazardIds.includes(c.hazardId) && c.text)
      setAi(ok.map((c) => ({ ...c, key: uid('aic') })))
      if (!ok.length) toast('No new controls proposed', 'info')
    } catch (e) { toast(aiMessage(e), 'bad') } finally { setAiBusy(false) }
  }
  const counts = { hazards: d.hazardIds.length, tickets: d.tickets.length, crew: d.crew.length }
  return (
    <Drawer open={open} onClose={onClose} width={860}
      title={<span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">JSSP · {d.workPackage} <Badge tone="ink">v{d.version}</Badge><Badge>Draft</Badge></span>}
      footer={<><span className="mr-auto self-center text-xs text-muted">{issues.filter((i) => i.level === 'bad').length} blocking item(s) · {issues.filter((i) => i.level === 'warn').length} warning(s)</span><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save draft</Button></>}>
      <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <Field label="Work package"><Input value={d.workPackage} onChange={(e) => set('workPackage', e.target.value)} /></Field>
        <Field label="Contractor"><Input value={d.contractor} onChange={(e) => set('contractor', e.target.value)} /></Field>
        <div className="flex flex-col justify-end gap-1.5 pb-1">
          <Checkbox checked={d.heatPlan} onChange={(v) => set('heatPlan', v)} label="Heat illness prevention plan" />
          <Checkbox checked={d.trafficPlan} onChange={(v) => set('trafficPlan', v)} label="Traffic control plan" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <Tabs className="mb-4" value={tab} onChange={setTab} tabs={[{ id: 'hazards', label: 'Activities & hazards', count: counts.hazards }, { id: 'site', label: 'Site & emergency' }, { id: 'tickets', label: 'Tickets & permits', count: counts.tickets }, { id: 'crew', label: oqOn ? 'Crew & OQ' : 'Crew', count: counts.crew }]} />

      {tab === 'hazards' && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="eyebrow mb-2">Work activities</div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1.5 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3">
              {activities.map((a) => <label key={a} className={cx('flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded border px-2.5 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold', d.activities.includes(a) ? 'border-ink bg-ink/5' : 'border-line')}><input type="checkbox" className="h-4 w-4" checked={d.activities.includes(a)} onChange={(e) => toggleAct(a, e.target.checked)} />{a}</label>)}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="eyebrow">Required permits from hazards</span>
            {requiredPermits(s, d).map((x) => <Badge key={x} tone={d.tickets.some((t) => t.type === x) ? 'good' : 'warn'}>{x}{d.tickets.some((t) => t.type === x) ? '' : ' — not listed'}</Badge>)}
            {!requiredPermits(s, d).length && <span className="text-xs text-faint">None</span>}
          </div>
          {aiOk !== false && (
            <div className="rounded-md border border-info/40 bg-info/5 p-3">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><AiTag>AI assist</AiTag><span className="text-[13px] font-semibold">Site-specific controls</span><span className="text-xs text-muted">AI assist reads scope, location and activities and proposes controls beyond the library. You accept each one.</span><Button size="sm" className="ml-auto" disabled={aiBusy || !d.hazardIds.length || aiOk === null} onClick={draft}>{aiBusy ? 'Thinking…' : ai.length ? 'Propose again' : 'Propose controls'}</Button></div>
              {ai.length > 0 && <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col divide-y divide-info/20">{ai.map((c) => { const h = s.hazards.find((x) => x.id === c.hazardId); return (
                <div key={c.key} className="flex flex-col gap-1 py-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-start">
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5"><AiTag /><span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted">{h?.activity} · {h?.hazard}</span></div><div className="text-[13px]">{c.text}</div><div className="text-xs italic text-faint">{c.why}</div></div>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1"><Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => { addCtl(c.hazardId, c.text); setAi(ai.filter((x) => x.key !== c.key)); toast('Control added to the plan') }}>Accept</Button><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setAi(ai.filter((x) => x.key !== c.key))}>Dismiss</Button></div>
                </div>) })}</div>}
            </div>
          )}
          {hz.length === 0 && <Callout tone="warn">Choose the work activities. Hazards, controls, permits and OQ requirements come from the hazard library (version {d.libraryVersion}).</Callout>}
          {hz.map((h) => (
            <div key={h.id} className="rounded-md border border-line">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-2"><span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">{h.activity}</span><b className="text-[13px]">{h.hazard}</b>{h.permits.map((x) => <Badge key={x} tone="info">{x}</Badge>)}{oqOn && h.oqTasks.map((x) => <Badge key={x}>OQ: {x}</Badge>)}</div>
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1 px-3 py-2 text-[13px]">
                {h.controls.map((c, i) => <li key={i} className="flex gap-2"><span className="w-[84px] shrink-0 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-faint">{CTRL_LABEL[c.type]}</span>{c.text}</li>)}
                {d.extraControls.map((x, i) => ({ x, i })).filter(({ x }) => x.hazardId === h.id).map(({ x, i }) => <li key={'x' + i} className="flex gap-2"><span className="w-[84px] shrink-0 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase text-ink">Site</span><span className="flex-1">{x.text}</span><button className="text-xs text-muted hover:text-bad" onClick={() => set('extraControls', d.extraControls.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}>Remove</button></li>)}
              </ul>
              <div className="flex gap-2 border-t border-line/60 px-3 py-2"><Input placeholder="Add a site-specific control" value={newCtl[h.id] ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setNewCtl({ ...newCtl, [h.id]: e.target.value })} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') addCtl(h.id, newCtl[h.id] ?? '') }} /><Button size="sm" onClick={() => addCtl(h.id, newCtl[h.id] ?? '')}>Add</Button></div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'site' && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Field label="Site address / limits of work"><Input value={d.site.address} onChange={(e) => set('site', { ...d.site, address: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
            <Field label="Nearest hospital"><Input value={d.site.hospital} onChange={(e) => set('site', { ...d.site, hospital: e.target.value })} /></Field>
            <Field label="Muster point"><Input value={d.site.musterPoint} onChange={(e) => set('site', { ...d.site, musterPoint: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          </div>
          <Field label="Route to hospital"><TextArea value={d.site.hospitalRoute} onChange={(e) => set('site', { ...d.site, hospitalRoute: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <div className="eyebrow mt-2">Emergency contacts</div>
          {d.site.contacts.map((c, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_1fr_auto] gap-2">
              <Input value={c.name} placeholder="Name" onChange={(e) => set('site', { ...d.site, contacts: d.site.contacts.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, name: e.target.value } : x)) })} />
              <Input value={c.role} placeholder="Role" onChange={(e) => set('site', { ...d.site, contacts: d.site.contacts.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, role: e.target.value } : x)) })} />
              <Input value={c.phone} placeholder="Phone" onChange={(e) => set('site', { ...d.site, contacts: d.site.contacts.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, phone: e.target.value } : x)) })} />
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => set('site', { ...d.site, contacts: d.site.contacts.filter((_, j) => j !== i) })}>Remove</Button>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div><Button size="sm" onClick={() => set('site', { ...d.site, contacts: [...d.site.contacts, { name: '', role: '', phone: '' }] })}>Add contact</Button></div>
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'tickets' && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">811 locate tickets, permits and lift plans with their expiry. Expired tickets block work; tickets within 3 days of expiry are flagged.</p>
          {d.tickets.map((t, i) => { const st = ticketLevel(t.expires, asOf); return (
            <div key={t.id} className={cx('grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 rounded-md border p-2 sm:grid-cols-[180px_1fr_150px_auto] sm:items-end', st.level === 'bad' ? 'border-bad/60 bg-bad/5' : st.level === 'warn' ? 'border-warn/60 bg-warn/5' : 'border-line')}>
              <Field label="Type"><Select value={t.type} onChange={(e) => set('tickets', d.tickets.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, type: e.target.value as TicketType } : x)))} options={TICKET_TYPES} /></Field>
              <Field label="Number"><Input value={t.number} onChange={(e) => set('tickets', d.tickets.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, number: e.target.value } : x)))} /></Field>
              <Field label="Expires"><Input type="date" value={t.expires} onChange={(e) => set('tickets', d.tickets.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, expires: e.target.value } : x)))} /></Field>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-1"><Badge tone={levelTone(st.level)}>{st.label}</Badge><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => set('tickets', d.tickets.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}>Remove</Button></div>
            </div>) })}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => set('tickets', [...d.tickets, { id: uid('tk'), type: '811 locate', number: '', expires: addDays(asOf, 28) }])}>Add ticket</Button>
            {requiredPermits(s, d).filter((x) => TICKET_TYPES.includes(x as TicketType) && !d.tickets.some((t) => t.type === x)).map((x) => <Button key={x} size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => set('tickets', [...d.tickets, { id: uid('tk'), type: x as TicketType, number: '', expires: addDays(asOf, 14) }])}>+ {x}</Button>)}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'crew' && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {!oqOn && <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-dashed border-line px-3 py-2 text-[12px] text-muted"><Badge>Phase 2</Badge>Operator-qualification checks (an operator-qualification provider feed) are not part of the pilot; crew and prequalification are still checked.</div>}
          {oqOn && <div className="rounded-md border border-line">
            <div className="border-b border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">Covered tasks required by this plan's hazards</div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 p-3">
              {oqCoverage(s, d, asOf).map((c) => <Badge key={c.task} tone={c.valid.length ? 'good' : 'bad'}>{c.task}: {c.valid.length ? `${c.valid.length} qualified` : 'no current OQ'}</Badge>)}
              {!oqCoverage(s, d, asOf).length && <span className="text-xs text-faint">No covered tasks for these activities.</span>}
            </div>
          </div>}
          {d.crew.map((c, i) => { const oq = oqLevel(c.oqExpires, asOf); const upd = (patch: Partial<SafetyPlan['crew'][number]>) => set('crew', d.crew.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, ...patch } : x))); return (
            <div key={c.id} className="rounded-md border border-line p-2.5">
              <div className={cx('grid grid-cols-2 gap-2', oqOn ? 'md:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_1fr_150px_150px]' : 'md:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_1fr_150px]')}>
                <Field label="Name"><Input value={c.name} onChange={(e) => upd({ name: e.target.value })} /></Field>
                <Field label="Company"><Input value={c.company} onChange={(e) => upd({ company: e.target.value })} /></Field>
                <Field label="Role"><Input value={c.role} onChange={(e) => upd({ role: e.target.value })} /></Field>
                {oqOn && <Field label="OQ expires"><Input type="date" value={c.oqExpires} onChange={(e) => upd({ oqExpires: e.target.value })} className={oq.level === 'bad' ? 'border-bad' : ''} /></Field>}
                <Field label="Prequal (ISNetworld)"><Select value={c.prequal} onChange={(e) => upd({ prequal: e.target.value as SafetyPlan['crew'][number]['prequal'] })} options={['Compliant', 'Conditional', 'Non-compliant']} /></Field>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
                {oqOn && <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase text-faint">OQ tasks</span>}
                {oqOn && allOq.map((t) => <Checkbox key={t} checked={c.oqTasks.includes(t)} onChange={(v) => upd({ oqTasks: v ? [...c.oqTasks, t] : c.oqTasks.filter((x) => x !== t) })} label={<span className="text-[12px]">{t}</span>} />)}
                {oqOn && <Badge tone={levelTone(oq.level)}>{oq.label}</Badge>}
                <button className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted hover:text-bad" onClick={() => set('crew', d.crew.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}>Remove</button>
              </div>
            </div>) })}
          <div><Button size="sm" onClick={() => set('crew', [...d.crew, { id: uid('crw'), name: '', company: d.contractor, role: 'Laborer', oqTasks: [], oqExpires: addDays(asOf, 365), prequal: 'Compliant' }])}>Add crew member</Button></div>
        </div>
      )}

      {issues.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-5 rounded-md border border-line">
          <div className="border-b border-line bg-sunken px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted">Pre-mobilization check</div>
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1 p-3 text-[13px]">{issues.map((x, i) => <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2"><span className={cx('mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full', x.level === 'bad' ? 'bg-bad' : 'bg-warn')} />{x.text}</li>)}</ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </Drawer>
  )
}

// Safety home (SF-10): leading indicators by contractor and project, approvals, expiring tickets, hazard library.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { ControlType, HazardItem } from '@/core/types'
import { mutate, personName, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { daysBetween, fmtDate, uid, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Drawer, Empty, Field, Input, PageHeader, Panel, Select, Stat, Table, TextArea, type Column } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { WorkflowStatus } from '@/views/shared/WorkflowStatus'
import { ProgramTag } from '@/views/shared/pickers'
import { EventsTable } from './Events'
import { indicators, levelTone, opQualOn, planIssues, ticketLevel } from './lib'

const pctTxt = (n: number | null) => (n == null ? '—' : `${Math.round(n * 100)}%`)
const rateTone = (n: number | null) => (n == null ? '' : n >= 0.95 ? 'text-good' : n >= 0.8 ? 'text-warn' : 'text-bad')

export default function SafetyHome(_props: { projectId?: string; id?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const asOf = s.settings.asOf
  const oqOn = opQualOn(s)
  const fieldOn = !!s.settings.features?.fieldTailboard
  const [hazard, setHazard] = useState<HazardItem | null>(null)
  const [openWf, setOpenWf] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [hzQ, setHzQ] = useState('')
  const [evFilter, setEvFilter] = useState<'open' | 'sif' | 'all'>('open')

  const working = s.projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'active' && s.safetyPlans.some((x) => x.projectId === p.id && x.status === 'approved'))
  const withPlans = s.projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'active' && s.safetyPlans.some((x) => x.projectId === p.id))
  const all = indicators(s, working.map((p) => p.id), 30)
  const contractors = Array.from(new Set(s.safetyPlans.filter((x) => x.status === 'approved').map((x) => x.contractor))).sort()
  const byContractor = contractors.map((c) => ({ c, ...indicators(s, working.map((p) => p.id), 30, c), projects: working.filter((p) => s.safetyPlans.some((x) => x.projectId === p.id && x.contractor === c && x.status === 'approved')).length }))

  const awaiting = s.safetyPlans.filter((x) => x.status === 'in-review')
  const drafts = s.safetyPlans.filter((x) => x.status === 'draft')
  const live = s.safetyPlans.filter((x) => x.status === 'approved' || x.status === 'in-review')
  const tickets = live.flatMap((pl) => pl.tickets.map((t) => ({ t, pl, st: ticketLevel(t.expires, asOf) }))).filter((x) => x.st.days <= 7).sort((a, b) => a.st.days - b.st.days)
  const crewOq = live.flatMap((pl) => pl.crew.filter((c) => c.oqTasks.length && daysBetween(asOf, c.oqExpires) <= 30).map((c) => ({ c, pl })))
  const proj = (id: string) => s.projects.find((p) => p.id === id)!
  const events = s.safetyEvents.filter((e) => (evFilter === 'open' ? e.status === 'open' : evFilter === 'sif' ? e.sifPotential : true)).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))

  const projCols: Column<(typeof working)[number]>[] = [
    { key: 'p', header: 'Project', render: (p) => <a href={projectHref(p.id, 'safety')} className="flex items-center gap-2 hover:underline"><ProgramTag programId={p.programId} /><span className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold">{p.code}</span><span className="max-w-[220px] truncate text-[12px] text-muted">{p.name}</span></a>, sort: (p) => p.code },
    { key: 'c', header: 'Contractor', render: (p) => <span className="text-[12px]">{s.safetyPlans.find((x) => x.projectId === p.id && x.status === 'approved')?.contractor}</span> },
    { key: 'tb', header: 'Tailboards', num: true, render: (p) => { const i = indicators(s, [p.id]); return <span className={cx('font-semibold', rateTone(i.tailboardRate))}>{pctTxt(i.tailboardRate)}</span> }, sort: (p) => indicators(s, [p.id]).tailboardRate ?? 0 },
    { key: 'obs', header: 'Obs. 30d', num: true, render: (p) => indicators(s, [p.id]).observations + indicators(s, [p.id]).nearMisses },
    { key: 'lapse', header: 'Lapsed', num: true, render: (p) => { const n = indicators(s, [p.id]).lapsed; return <span className={n ? 'font-bold text-bad' : ''}>{n}</span> }, sort: (p) => indicators(s, [p.id]).lapsed },
    { key: 'exp', header: '≤3 days', num: true, render: (p) => { const n = indicators(s, [p.id]).expiring; return <span className={n ? 'font-bold text-warn' : ''}>{n}</span> } },
    { key: 'open', header: 'Open events', num: true, render: (p) => indicators(s, [p.id]).openEvents },
    { key: 'sif', header: 'SIF open', num: true, render: (p) => { const n = indicators(s, [p.id]).sif; return n ? <Badge tone="bad">{n}</Badge> : <span className="text-faint">0</span> }, sort: (p) => indicators(s, [p.id]).sif },
  ]

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader eyebrow="Controls" title="Construction safety" subtitle="Leading indicators across every crew working under an approved job-specific safety plan."
        actions={fieldOn ? <a href="#field"><Button variant="marker">Open field tailboard</Button></a> : undefined} />

      <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6">
        <Stat label="Crews working" value={working.length} sub={`${working.filter((p) => s.tailboards.some((t) => t.projectId === p.id && t.date === asOf)).length} of ${working.length} briefed today`} />
        <Stat label="Tailboard completion" value={pctTxt(all.tailboardRate)} sub={`${all.tailboardsHeld} of ${all.tailboardsExpected} working days, 2 wks`} tone={all.tailboardRate == null ? undefined : all.tailboardRate >= 0.95 ? 'good' : all.tailboardRate >= 0.8 ? 'warn' : 'bad'} />
        <Stat label="Observations, 30 days" value={all.observations + all.nearMisses} sub={`${all.nearMisses} near misses · ${all.obsPerWeek.toFixed(1)}/crew/wk`} />
        <Stat label="Lapsed tickets" value={all.lapsed} tone={all.lapsed ? 'bad' : 'good'} sub={`${all.expiring} expiring in ≤3 days`} />
        <Stat label="Open SIF-potential" value={all.sif} tone={all.sif ? 'bad' : 'good'} sub={`${all.openEvents} open events total`} />
        <Stat label="Plans awaiting approval" value={awaiting.length} tone={awaiting.length ? 'warn' : undefined} sub={`${drafts.length} drafts in preparation`} />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <Panel title="Leading indicators by contractor" subtitle="Last 30 days; tailboards over the last two weeks" pad={false}>
          <div className="scroll-x"><table className="tbl">
            <thead><tr><th>Contractor</th><th className="num">Projects</th><th className="num">Tailboards</th><th className="num">Obs. / near miss</th><th className="num">Lapsed tickets</th><th className="num">Open events</th><th className="num">SIF open</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{byContractor.map((x) => (
              <tr key={x.c}>
                <td className="font-semibold">{x.c}</td>
                <td className="num">{x.projects}</td>
                <td className={cx('num font-semibold', rateTone(x.tailboardRate))}>{pctTxt(x.tailboardRate)}</td>
                <td className="num">{x.observations} / {x.nearMisses}</td>
                <td className={cx('num', x.lapsed > 0 && 'font-bold text-bad')}>{x.lapsed}</td>
                <td className="num">{x.openEvents}</td>
                <td className="num">{x.sif ? <Badge tone="bad">{x.sif}</Badge> : '0'}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}</tbody>
          </table></div>
          <p className="border-t border-line px-4 py-2 text-[11px] text-faint">Tailboard completion = working days with a recorded tailboard ÷ working days since plan approval. Targets: ≥95% tailboards, zero lapsed tickets.</p>
        </Panel>

        <Panel title="Plans awaiting approval" subtitle={`${awaiting.length} in review · ${drafts.length} drafts`} pad={false}>
          {awaiting.length === 0 && <div className="p-4"><Empty title="Nothing waiting">Submitted job-specific safety plans appear here.</Empty></div>}
          <div className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-line">
            {awaiting.map((pl) => {
              const p = proj(pl.projectId)
              const issues = planIssues(s, pl)
              const bad = issues.filter((i) => i.level === 'bad').length
              const wf = s.workflows.find((w) => w.id === pl.workflowInstanceId)
              return (
                <div key={pl.id} className="px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <a className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline" href={projectHref(p.id, 'safety')}>{p.code}</a>
                    <b className="text-[13px]">{pl.workPackage} v{pl.version}</b>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted">{pl.contractor}</span>
                    {bad ? <Badge tone="bad">{bad} blocking</Badge> : <Badge tone="good">Checks pass</Badge>}
                    {wf?.active[0] && <span className="text-xs text-muted">At {s.workflowDefs.find((d) => d.id === wf.defId)?.nodes.find((n) => n.id === wf.active[0].nodeId)?.label} · {wf.active[0].assigneeIds.map((id) => personName(s, id)).join(', ')}</span>}
                    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="ml-auto" onClick={() => setOpenWf(openWf === pl.id ? null : pl.id)}>{openWf === pl.id ? 'Hide' : 'Review'}</Button>
                  </div>
                  {openWf === pl.id && (
                    <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-2">
                      {issues.length > 0 && <ul className="text-[13px]">{issues.map((x, i) => <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2"><span className={cx('mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full', x.level === 'bad' ? 'bg-bad' : 'bg-warn')} />{x.text}</li>)}</ul>}
                      <WorkflowStatus instanceId={pl.workflowInstanceId} />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        </Panel>
      </div>

      <Panel className="mt-4" title="Leading indicators by project" pad={false}>
        <Table rows={working} columns={projCols} rowKey={(p) => p.id} empty={<div className="p-4"><Empty title="No crews working" /></div>} />
      </Panel>

      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <Panel title="Expiring tickets & permits" subtitle="Expired or expiring within 7 days on live plans" pad={false}>
          {tickets.length === 0 ? <div className="p-4"><Empty title="All tickets current" /></div> : (
            <div className="scroll-x"><table className="tbl">
              <thead><tr><th>Project</th><th>Ticket</th><th>Number</th><th>Expires</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{tickets.map(({ t, pl, st }) => (
                <tr key={t.id} className={st.level === 'bad' ? 'bg-bad/5' : ''}>
                  <td><a className="font-mono text-[12px] font-semibold text-link hover:underline" href={projectHref(pl.projectId, 'safety')}>{proj(pl.projectId).code}</a> <span className="text-xs text-muted">{pl.workPackage}</span></td>
                  <td>{t.type}</td><td className="font-mono text-[12px]">{t.number}</td><td className="whitespace-nowrap">{fmtDate(t.expires)}</td>
                  <td><Badge tone={st.level === 'ok' ? 'neutral' : levelTone(st.level)}>{st.label}</Badge></td>
                </tr>
              ))}</tbody>
            </table></div>
          )}
          {!oqOn && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-line px-4 py-2.5 text-[12px] text-muted"><Badge>Phase 2</Badge>Operator-qualification tracking (an operator-qualification provider feed) is not part of the pilot. Turn it on in Configuration → Modules.</div>
          )}
          {oqOn && crewOq.length > 0 && (
            <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-3">
              <div className="eyebrow mb-1.5">Operator qualifications expiring or expired</div>
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-[13px]">{crewOq.slice(0, 10).map(({ c, pl }) => <li key={c.id + pl.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><b>{c.name}</b><span className="text-xs text-muted">{c.role} · {c.company} · {proj(pl.projectId).code}</span><Badge tone={c.oqExpires < asOf ? 'bad' : 'warn'}>{c.oqExpires < asOf ? 'Expired' : 'Expires'} {fmtDate(c.oqExpires)}</Badge></li>)}</ul>
            </div>
          )}
        </Panel>

        <Panel title="Safety events" pad={false} actions={<Select id="ev-filter" className="w-[170px]" value={evFilter} onChange={(e) => setEvFilter(e.target.value as typeof evFilter)} options={[{ value: 'open', label: 'Open events' }, { value: 'sif', label: 'SIF potential' }, { value: 'all', label: 'All events' }]} />}>
          <EventsTable events={events} showProject />
        </Panel>
      </div>

      <Panel className="mt-4" title="Hazard library" subtitle={`${s.hazards.length} hazards by activity. Plans assemble controls from here; edits take effect for plans prepared after the effective date.`} pad={false}
        actions={<><Input id="hz-q" className="w-[220px]" placeholder="Search hazards" value={hzQ} onChange={(e) => setHzQ(e.target.value)} /><Button size="sm" onClick={() => setHazard({ id: uid('hz'), activity: '', hazard: '', controls: [{ type: 'administrative', text: '' }], permits: [], oqTasks: [], effective: asOf })}>New hazard</Button></>}>
        <Table rows={s.hazards.filter((h) => !hzQ || (h.activity + h.hazard + h.controls.map((c) => c.text).join(' ')).toLowerCase().includes(hzQ.toLowerCase()))} rowKey={(h) => h.id} onRowClick={(h) => setHazard(h)} maxHeight={480}
          columns={[
            { key: 'a', header: 'Activity', render: (h) => <span className="font-semibold">{h.activity}</span>, sort: (h) => h.activity },
            { key: 'h', header: 'Hazard', render: (h) => h.hazard, sort: (h) => h.hazard },
            { key: 'c', header: 'Controls', render: (h) => <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">{(['engineering', 'administrative', 'ppe'] as const).map((t) => { const n = h.controls.filter((c) => c.type === t).length; return n ? <Badge key={t} tone={t === 'engineering' ? 'good' : t === 'ppe' ? 'warn' : 'info'}>{n} {t === 'ppe' ? 'PPE' : t === 'engineering' ? 'eng.' : 'admin'}</Badge> : null })}</span> },
            { key: 'p', header: 'Permits', render: (h) => <span className="text-[12px]">{h.permits.join(', ') || '—'}</span> },
            ...(oqOn ? [{ key: 'o', header: 'OQ tasks', render: (h: HazardItem) => <span className="text-[12px]">{h.oqTasks.join(', ') || '—'}</span> }] : []),
            { key: 'u', header: 'In plans', num: true, render: (h) => s.safetyPlans.filter((x) => x.status !== 'superseded' && x.hazardIds.includes(h.id)).length },
            { key: 'e', header: 'Effective', render: (h) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{fmtDate(h.effective)}</span>, sort: (h) => h.effective },
          ]} />
      </Panel>

      <HazardDrawer hazard={hazard} onClose={() => setHazard(null)} />
    </div>
  )
}

function HazardDrawer({ hazard, onClose }: { hazard: HazardItem | null; onClose: () => void }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [h, setH] = useState<HazardItem | null>(null)
  const [permits, setPermits] = useState('')
  const [oq, setOq] = useState('')
  useEffect(() => {
    setH(hazard ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(hazard)) : null)
    setPermits(hazard?.permits.join(', ') ?? '')
    setOq(hazard?.oqTasks.join(', ') ?? '')
  }, [hazard])
  if (!hazard || !h) return null
  const isNew = !s.hazards.some((x) => x.id === h.id)
  const used = s.safetyPlans.filter((x) => x.status !== 'superseded' && x.hazardIds.includes(h.id))
  const save = () => {
    if (!h.activity.trim() || !h.hazard.trim()) { toast('Activity and hazard are required.', 'bad'); return }
    const next: HazardItem = { ...h, controls: h.controls.filter((c) => c.text.trim()), permits: permits.split(',').map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean), oqTasks: oq.split(',').map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean) }
    if (!next.controls.length) { toast('Add at least one control.', 'bad'); return }
    mutate((d) => { const i = d.hazards.findIndex((x) => x.id === next.id); if (i >= 0) d.hazards[i] = next; else d.hazards.push(next) },
      { entity: 'hazard', entityId: next.id, action: isNew ? 'create' : 'update', summary: `${isNew ? 'Added' : 'Updated'} hazard library: ${next.activity} / ${next.hazard} (effective ${next.effective})` })
    toast(isNew ? 'Hazard added to library' : 'Hazard library updated')
    onClose()
  }
  return (
    <Drawer open onClose={onClose} width={640} title={isNew ? 'New hazard' : `${h.activity} · ${h.hazard}`}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>{isNew ? 'Add hazard' : 'Save changes'}</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        {!isNew && used.length > 0 && <Callout tone="info">Used by {used.length} live plan{used.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}. Approved plans keep the controls they were approved with; new and revised plans pick up this change from the effective date.</Callout>}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_150px]">
          <Field label="Activity"><Input value={h.activity} onChange={(e) => setH({ ...h, activity: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Hazard"><Input value={h.hazard} onChange={(e) => setH({ ...h, hazard: e.target.value })} /></Field>
          <Field label="Effective date"><Input type="date" value={h.effective} onChange={(e) => setH({ ...h, effective: e.target.value })} /></Field>
        </div>
        <div className="eyebrow mt-1">Controls (hierarchy: engineering → administrative → PPE)</div>
        {h.controls.map((c, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="grid grid-cols-[140px_1fr_auto] gap-2">
            <Select value={c.type} onChange={(e) => setH({ ...h, controls: h.controls.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, type: e.target.value as ControlType } : x)) })} options={[{ value: 'engineering', label: 'Engineering' }, { value: 'administrative', label: 'Administrative' }, { value: 'ppe', label: 'PPE' }]} />
            <TextArea className="min-h-[36px]" value={c.text} onChange={(e) => setH({ ...h, controls: h.controls.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, text: e.target.value } : x)) })} />
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setH({ ...h, controls: h.controls.filter((_, j) => j !== i) })}>Remove</Button>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div><Button size="sm" onClick={() => setH({ ...h, controls: [...h.controls, { type: 'administrative', text: '' }] })}>Add control</Button></div>
        <Field label="Required permits" hint="Comma-separated, e.g. Hot work permit, Excavation permit"><Input value={permits} onChange={(e) => setPermits(e.target.value)} /></Field>
        {opQualOn(s) && <Field label="Covered tasks (operator qualification)" hint="Comma-separated; crews are checked against these"><Input value={oq} onChange={(e) => setOq(e.target.value)} /></Field>}
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/shared/AskPanel.tsx =====
// "Ask the portfolio" (AI-01): the organization's AI assist answers from project records through read-only page tools.
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { getState, personName } from '@/core/store'
import { ask, aiMessage, useAiAvailable } from '@/core/ai'
import { position } from '@/core/engine/position'
import { readiness, stageName } from '@/core/engine/gates'
import { isActive, riskScore } from '@/core/engine/risk'
import { money } from '@/core/util'
import { AiTag, Button, Drawer, TextArea, Callout } from '@/ui/kit'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'

const RULES = `You are the portfolio assistant inside Crosswalk, a capital-project platform for a gas utility (Arroyo Valley Gas; all data is a fictional demo).
Answer ONLY from the tool results. Call tools as needed. Cite project codes like PRJ-1042. Use $M with one decimal for money. Keep answers short: a direct answer first, then up to 6 bullets. If the data cannot answer, say what is missing.`

function tools() {
  const s = getState()
  const row = (p: (typeof s.projects)[number]) => {
    const pos = position(s, p.id)
    return { code: p.code, name: p.name, program: s.programs.find((x) => x.id === p.programId)?.code, stage: stageName(s, p), status: p.status, pm: personName(s, p.team.pm), budget: money(pos.currentBudget), eac: money(pos.eac), actual: money(pos.actualToDate), contingencyLeft: money(pos.contingencyRemaining), riskExposure: money(pos.riskExposure), health: p.health }
  }
  return [
    {
      name: 'list_projects', description: 'List projects with stage, budget, forecast (EAC), actuals, contingency, risk exposure and RAG health. Optional filters: program code (PSE, TIM, DRP, CSM, VAP), status, health dimension "cost"|"schedule"|"risk" equal to "red"|"amber".',
      inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: { program: { type: 'string' }, status: { type: 'string' }, healthDim: { type: 'string' }, healthIs: { type: 'string' } } },
      execute: (i: Record<string, unknown>) => s.projects.filter((p) => (!i.program || s.programs.find((x) => x.id === p.programId)?.code === String(i.program).toUpperCase()) && (!i.status || p.status === i.status) && (!i.healthDim || (p.health as any)[String(i.healthDim)] === i.healthIs)).map(row),
    },
    {
      name: 'get_project', description: 'Full detail for one project by code (e.g. PRJ-1042): scope, milestones, gate readiness, top risks, changes, variances, safety summary.',
      inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: { code: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['code'] },
      execute: (i: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        const p = s.projects.find((x) => x.code.toLowerCase() === String(i.code).toLowerCase())
        if (!p) throw new Error('No project with that code')
        const r = readiness(s, p)
        return {
          ...row(p), scope: p.scope.summary, milestones: p.milestones.map((m) => ({ name: m.name, baseline: m.baseline, forecast: m.forecast, actual: m.actual })),
          gateReadiness: { pct: r.pct, blockers: r.blockers },
          topRisks: s.risks.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id && isActive(x)).sort((a, b) => riskScore(b) - riskScore(a)).slice(0, 6).map((x) => ({ code: x.code, title: x.title, score: riskScore(x), ml: money(x.cost.ml), status: x.status })),
          changes: s.changes.filter((c) => c.projectId === p.id).map((c) => ({ code: c.code, title: c.title, cost: money(c.costImpact), status: c.status, rootCause: c.rootCause })),
          variances: s.variances.filter((v) => v.projectId === p.id).map((v) => ({ description: v.description, status: v.status, narrative: v.narrative })),
          safety: { plans: s.safetyPlans.filter((x) => x.projectId === p.id).map((x) => `${x.workPackage} v${x.version} ${x.status}`), openEvents: s.safetyEvents.filter((e) => e.projectId === p.id && e.status === 'open').length },
        }
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'portfolio_totals', description: 'Totals by program: count of projects, budget, EAC, actual to date, and authorized funding for the current year.',
      execute: () => s.programs.map((pr) => {
        const ps = s.projects.filter((p) => p.programId === pr.id)
        const pos = ps.map((p) => position(s, p.id))
        return { program: pr.code, name: pr.name, projects: ps.length, budget: money(pos.reduce((a, x) => a + x.currentBudget, 0)), eac: money(pos.reduce((a, x) => a + x.eac, 0)), actual: money(pos.reduce((a, x) => a + x.actualToDate, 0)), authorized2026: money(s.funding.find((f) => f.programId === pr.id && f.year === 2026)?.authorized ?? 0) }
      }),
    },
  ]
}

const SUGGESTIONS = ['Which projects are forecast over budget, and why?', 'What is blocking gate readiness on the PSE program?', 'Summarize contingency remaining by program.', 'Which construction projects have open safety items?']

export function AskPanel({ open, onClose }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const ok = useAiAvailable()
  const [turns, setTurns] = useState<{ role: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string }[]>([])
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('')
  const ctl = useRef<AbortController | null>(null)
  const send = async (text: string) => {
    if (!text.trim() || busy) return
    const next = [...turns, { role: 'user' as const, content: text }]
    setTurns(next); setQ(''); setBusy(true); setDraft('Thinking…')
    ctl.current = new AbortController()
    try {
      const answer = await ask([{ role: 'user', content: RULES }, { role: 'assistant', content: 'Understood.' }, ...next], { onText: setDraft, signal: ctl.current.signal, tools: tools(), cache: false })
      setTurns([...next, { role: 'assistant', content: answer }])
    } catch (e) {
      setTurns([...next, { role: 'assistant', content: aiMessage(e) }])
    } finally { setBusy(false); setDraft('') }
  }
  const linkify = (t: string) => t.split(/(PRJ-\d{4})/g).map((part, i) => (/^PRJ-\d{4}$/.test(part) ? <a key={i} className="font-mono font-semibold text-link underline-offset-2 hover:underline" href={projectHref(part)} onClick={onClose}>{part}</a> : <span key={i}>{part}</span>))
  return (
    <Drawer open={open} onClose={onClose} title={<span className="flex items-center gap-2">Ask the portfolio <AiTag>AI assist</AiTag></span>} width={560}
      footer={<form className="flex w-full gap-2" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); send(q) }}><TextArea id="ask-q" className="min-h-[40px] flex-1" placeholder="Ask about budgets, gates, risks, safety…" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); send(q) } }} />{busy ? <Button onClick={() => ctl.current?.abort()}>Stop</Button> : <Button variant="primary" type="submit">Ask</Button>}</form>}>
      {!turns.length && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">The assistant reads the live project records through read-only tools and answers with project codes you can click.</p>
          {SUGGESTIONS.map((x) => <button key={x} onClick={() => send(x)} className="rounded-md border border-line px-3 py-2 text-left text-[13px] hover:border-ink/40 hover:bg-sunken">{x}</button>)}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        {turns.map((t, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={t.role === 'user' ? 'self-end rounded-md bg-ink px-3 py-2 text-[13px] text-surface' : 'whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken/50 px-3 py-2 text-[13px]'}>{t.role === 'assistant' ? linkify(t.content) : t.content}</div>
        ))}
        {busy && <div className="whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-md border border-line bg-sunken/50 px-3 py-2 text-[13px] text-muted">{linkify(draft)}</div>}
      </div>
    </Drawer>
  )
}

// Shared-data UI: the connection banner, the saved/saving indicator, the passcode prompt, and the
// public-demo guard that turns off file uploads (AGENT_RULES §8: no uploads of real files).
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useSync } from '@/core/store'
import { appSync } from '@/core/syncClient'
import { cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Button, Input, Modal } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'

/** True when uploads and pasted files must be refused: the data is shared on a public server. */
export const useUploadsLocked = () => useSync().mode === 'shared'

export function Connecting() {
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center bg-ground">
      <div className="text-center">
        <div className="mx-auto mb-3 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-sm bg-marker font-display text-[20px] font-black text-markerink">C</div>
        <div className="text-[14px] font-semibold">Loading the shared data…</div>

export function SyncBanner({ onUnlock }: { onUnlock: () => void }) {
  const s = useSync()
  if (s.mode === 'offline') {
    return (
      <div className="mb-4 rounded-md border border-warn/40 bg-warn/10 px-3 py-2 text-[13px]">
        <b>Not connected to the shared database.</b> You can explore everything, but changes on this page are not saved anywhere.
      </div>
    )
  }
  if (s.mode !== 'shared' || s.canEdit) return null
  return (
    <div className={cx('mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-3 py-2 text-[13px]', s.unsaved ? 'border-warn/40 bg-warn/10' : 'border-line bg-surface')}>
      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <b>{s.unsaved ? 'Your changes on this page are not saved.' : 'View only.'}</b>{' '}
        {s.editable ? 'Everyone sees the same shared data. Enter the edit passcode to make changes that are saved for everyone.' : 'Editing is turned off on this server.'}
      </span>
      {s.unsaved && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { void appSync.current?.discardLocal(); toast('Showing the shared data again', 'info') }}>Discard my changes</Button>}
      {s.editable && <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={onUnlock}>Enter passcode</Button>}
    </div>
  )
}

/** Top-bar status: Saved / Saving… / error, plus lock and unlock. */
export function SyncStatusChip({ onUnlock }: { onUnlock: () => void }) {
  const s = useSync()
  if (s.mode === 'offline') return <span className="hidden rounded border border-warn/50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-warn sm:inline" title="Changes are not saved">Not saved</span>
  if (s.mode !== 'shared') return null
  if (!s.canEdit) return s.editable ? <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onUnlock} title="Enter the edit passcode">View only · Edit</Button> : null
  const label = s.error ? s.error : s.saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Saved'
  return (
    <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
      <span className={cx('hidden items-center gap-1 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11.5px] font-semibold sm:inline-flex', s.error ? 'text-bad' : 'text-muted')} title={s.lastSavedAt ? `Last saved ${new Date(s.lastSavedAt).toLocaleTimeString()}` : 'All changes are saved to the shared database'}>
        <span className={cx('h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full', s.error ? 'bg-bad' : s.saving ? 'bg-warn' : 'bg-good')} />{label}
      </span>
      <button className="rounded px-1 text-[11px] text-faint hover:text-ink" title="Stop editing on this browser (forget the passcode)" onClick={() => { appSync.current?.lock(); toast('Editing locked on this browser', 'info') }}>Lock</button>
    </span>
  )
}

export function PasscodeModal({ open, onClose }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
  useEffect(() => { if (open) { setCode(''); setErr(null) } }, [open])
  const submit = async () => {
    if (!code.trim() || !appSync.current) return
    setBusy(true); setErr(null)
    const ok = await appSync.current.unlock(code.trim())
    setBusy(false)
    if (ok) { toast('Editing on. Your changes are saved for everyone.'); onClose() } else setErr('That passcode is not right.')
  }
  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="Enter the edit passcode"
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={busy || !code.trim()} onClick={() => void submit()}>{busy ? 'Checking…' : 'Start editing'}</Button></>}>
      <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void submit() }} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Edits are saved to the shared database and everyone with the link sees them. Any changes you made on this page in view-only mode are discarded.</p>
        <Input autoFocus type="password" autoComplete="current-password" aria-label="Edit passcode" placeholder="Passcode" value={code} onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)} />
        {err && <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-bad">{err}</div>}
        <div className="rounded-md border border-warn/40 bg-warn/5 px-3 py-2 text-[12.5px]"><b>Fictional data only.</b> This is a public demo. Never enter real company project data, costs, people or files.</div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  )
}

/** While the data is shared, refuse file pickers and dropped files anywhere in the app. */
export function useUploadGuard() {
  const locked = useUploadsLocked()
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!locked) return
    const msg = 'File uploads are off on the shared public demo (fictional data only).'
    const onClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null
      const input = t?.closest?.('input[type="file"]') ?? (t instanceof HTMLLabelElement ? (t.control as HTMLElement | null) : t?.closest?.('label')?.querySelector?.('input[type="file"]'))
      if (input && (input as HTMLInputElement).type === 'file') { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); toast(msg, 'info') }
    }
    const onDrop = (e: DragEvent) => { if (e.dataTransfer?.files?.length) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); toast(msg, 'info') } }
    const onDragOver = (e: DragEvent) => { if (e.dataTransfer?.types?.includes('Files')) e.preventDefault() }
    document.addEventListener('click', onClick, true)
    document.addEventListener('drop', onDrop, true)
    document.addEventListener('dragover', onDragOver, true)
    return () => { document.removeEventListener('click', onClick, true); document.removeEventListener('drop', onDrop, true); document.removeEventListener('dragover', onDragOver, true) }
  }, [locked])
}

===== FILE: src/views/shared/WorkflowStatus.tsx =====
// Shows where a record sits in its workflow and lets the current user act on it.
// Drop it next to any record that has a workflowInstanceId:  <WorkflowStatus instanceId={x.workflowInstanceId} />
import { useState } from 'react'
import { mutate, personName, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { actOnWorkflow, recallWorkflow, type Decision } from '@/core/engine/workflow'
import { fmtDateTime, cx } from '@/core/util'
import { Avatar, Badge, Button, StatusBadge, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'

export function WorkflowStatus({ instanceId, compact }: { instanceId?: string; compact?: boolean }) {
  const inst = useStore((s) => s.workflows.find((w) => w.id === instanceId))
  const def = useStore((s) => s.workflowDefs.find((d) => d.id === inst?.defId))
  const me = useStore((s) => s.currentUserId)
  const people = useStore((s) => s.people)
  const [comment, setComment] = useState('')
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(!compact)
  if (!inst || !def) return null
  const nodeLabel = (id: string) => def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === id)?.label ?? 'Step'
  const mine = inst.active.find((a) => a.assigneeIds.includes(me) && !a.actedIds.includes(me))
  const isAdmin = people.find((p) => p.id === me)?.roles.includes('admin')
  const act = (decision: Decision) => {
    const slot = mine ?? inst.active[0]
    if (!slot) return
    if ((decision === 'reject' || decision === 'return') && !comment.trim()) { toast('Add a comment explaining why.', 'bad'); return }
    try {
      mutate((d) => actOnWorkflow(d, inst.id, slot.nodeId, me, decision, comment || undefined))
      toast(decision === 'approve' ? 'Approved and signed' : decision === 'submit' ? 'Submitted' : decision === 'return' ? 'Returned for revision' : 'Rejected', decision === 'reject' ? 'bad' : 'good')
      setComment('')
    } catch (e: any) { toast(e.message, 'bad') }
  }
  const step = mine ? def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === mine.nodeId) : undefined
  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
      <button onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-left">
        <span className="eyebrow">Workflow</span>
        <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold">{def.name}</span>
        <span className="text-xs text-faint">v{inst.defVersion}</span>
        <StatusBadge status={inst.status} />
        {inst.active.map((a) => <Badge key={a.nodeId} tone="marker">At: {nodeLabel(a.nodeId)} · {a.assigneeIds.map((id) => personName({ people }, id)).join(', ')}</Badge>)}
        <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted">{open ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} history</span>
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="border-t border-line px-3 py-3">
          <ol className="relative ml-2 border-l border-line">
            {inst.history.filter((h) => h.action !== 'system' || h.comment).map((h) => (
              <li key={h.id} className="mb-2.5 ml-4">
                <span className={cx('absolute -left-[5px] mt-1.5 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full border-2 border-surface', h.action === 'approve' || h.action === 'complete' ? 'bg-good' : h.action === 'reject' ? 'bg-bad' : h.action === 'return' ? 'bg-warn' : 'bg-faint')} />
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 text-[13px]">
                  {h.actorId !== 'system' && <Avatar name={personName({ people }, h.actorId)} size={18} />}
                  <b>{personName({ people }, h.actorId)}</b>
                  <span className="text-muted">{h.action === 'complete' ? `completed — ${h.comment}` : h.action}{h.nodeId && h.action !== 'complete' ? ` · ${nodeLabel(h.nodeId)}` : ''}</span>
                  {h.signature && <Badge tone="good" title={`Signature ${h.signature.hash}`}>e-signed</Badge>}
                  <span className="text-xs text-faint">{fmtDateTime(h.at)}</span>
                </div>
                {h.comment && h.action !== 'complete' && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-muted">“{h.comment}”</p>}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
          {inst.status === 'running' && (mine || isAdmin) && (
            <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-md border border-marker/60 bg-marker/5 p-3">
              <div className="text-[13px] font-semibold">{mine ? `Your step: ${step?.label}` : `Act as administrator on: ${nodeLabel(inst.active[0]?.nodeId ?? '')}`}</div>
              {step?.description && <p className="text-xs text-muted">{step.description}</p>}
              <TextArea id={`wf-comment-${inst.id}`} placeholder="Comment (required to return or reject)" value={comment} onChange={(e) => setComment(e.target.value)} className="min-h-[56px]" />
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {step?.type === 'form' ? <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => act('submit')}>Submit</Button> : <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => act('approve')}>Approve & sign</Button>}
                <Button onClick={() => act('return')}>Return for revision</Button>
                {step?.type !== 'form' && <Button variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={() => act('reject')}>Reject</Button>}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {inst.status === 'running' && inst.startedById === me && (
            <div className="mt-2"><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => { mutate((d) => recallWorkflow(d, inst.id, me)); toast('Recalled') }}>Recall</Button></div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/workflows/canvas.tsx =====
// SVG process canvas: typed node shapes, routed edges with arrowheads, drag-to-move and drag-to-connect.
// All colors are theme tokens so the diagram follows light/dark mode.
import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, WfEdge, WfNode, WfNodeType, WorkflowDef } from '@/core/types'
import { describeCondition } from '@/core/util'
import { describeAssignee, edgeOutcomeLabel, laneFor, nodeTypeLabel } from './lib'

export const tok = (n: string, a?: number) => (a == null ? `rgb(var(--${n}))` : `rgb(var(--${n}) / ${a})`)

export const TYPE_COLOR: Record<WfNodeType, string> = {
  start: 'good', end: 'ink', form: 'link', review: 'info', approval: 'marker', condition: 'warn',
  'parallel-split': 'ink', 'parallel-join': 'ink', notify: 'info', system: 'muted',
}

export function nodeSize(t: WfNodeType): { w: number; h: number } {
  switch (t) {
    case 'start': case 'end': return { w: 36, h: 36 }
    case 'condition': return { w: 70, h: 70 }
    case 'parallel-split': case 'parallel-join': return { w: 12, h: 72 }
    case 'notify': case 'system': return { w: 140, h: 48 }
    default: return { w: 150, h: 66 }
  }
}

export function wrap(text: string, max: number, lines = 2): string[] {
  const words = text.split(/\s+/)
  const out: string[] = []
  let cur = ''
  for (const w of words) {
    if ((cur + ' ' + w).trim().length > max && cur) { out.push(cur); cur = w } else cur = (cur + ' ' + w).trim()
  }
  if (cur) out.push(cur)
  if (out.length > lines) { const keep = out.slice(0, lines); keep[lines - 1] = keep[lines - 1].slice(0, max - 1) + '…'; return keep }
  return out.map((l) => (l.length > max + 2 ? l.slice(0, max) + '…' : l))
}
const trunc = (t: string, n: number) => (t.length > n ? t.slice(0, n - 1) + '…' : t)

export interface EdgeGeom { d: string; mid: { x: number; y: number }; back: boolean }
export function edgeGeom(def: WorkflowDef, e: WfEdge): EdgeGeom | null {
  const S = def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.from), T = def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.to)
  if (!S || !T) return null
  return geomBetween(S, T, e.outcome === 'return' || e.outcome === 'reject')
}
export function geomBetween(S: Pick<WfNode, 'x' | 'y' | 'type'>, T: Pick<WfNode, 'x' | 'y' | 'type'>, isReturn: boolean): EdgeGeom {
  const s = nodeSize(S.type), t = nodeSize(T.type)
  const dx = T.x - S.x, dy = T.y - S.y
  let p0: [number, number], p1: [number, number], p2: [number, number], p3: [number, number]
  const back = isReturn || dx < -10
  if (back) {
    const depth = 46 + Math.abs(dx) * 0.12 + Math.max(0, Math.abs(dy) * 0.2)
    const base = Math.max(S.y + s.h / 2, T.y + t.h / 2)
    p0 = [S.x - 8, S.y + s.h / 2]
    p3 = [T.x + 8, T.y + t.h / 2]
    p1 = [p0[0], base + depth]
    p2 = [p3[0], base + depth]
  } else if (dx > (s.w + t.w) / 2 * 0.7) {
    p0 = [S.x + s.w / 2, S.y]
    p3 = [T.x - t.w / 2, T.y]
    const c = Math.max(28, (p3[0] - p0[0]) * 0.45)
    p1 = [p0[0] + c, p0[1]]
    p2 = [p3[0] - c, p3[1]]
  } else {
    const down = dy >= 0
    p0 = [S.x, S.y + (down ? s.h / 2 : -s.h / 2)]
    p3 = [T.x, T.y + (down ? -t.h / 2 : t.h / 2)]
    const c = Math.max(24, Math.abs(p3[1] - p0[1]) * 0.45) * (down ? 1 : -1)
    p1 = [p0[0], p0[1] + c]
    p2 = [p3[0], p3[1] - c]
  }
  const mid = { x: 0.125 * p0[0] + 0.375 * p1[0] + 0.375 * p2[0] + 0.125 * p3[0], y: 0.125 * p0[1] + 0.375 * p1[1] + 0.375 * p2[1] + 0.125 * p3[1] }
  const f = (p: [number, number]) => `${p[0].toFixed(1)} ${p[1].toFixed(1)}`
  return { d: `M${f(p0)} C${f(p1)} ${f(p2)} ${f(p3)}`, mid, back }
}

export function canvasExtent(def: WorkflowDef, pad = 140) {
  let w = 860, h = 400
  for (const n of def.nodes) { const z = nodeSize(n.type); w = Math.max(w, n.x + z.w / 2 + pad); h = Math.max(h, n.y + z.h / 2 + pad) }
  return { w, h }
}

const edgeColor = (e: WfEdge) => (e.outcome === 'return' ? 'warn' : e.outcome === 'reject' ? 'bad' : 'faint')

export function ArrowDefs({ prefix = 'wf' }: { prefix?: string }) {
  return (
    <defs>
      {['faint', 'warn', 'bad', 'link', 'ink'].map((c) => (
        <marker key={c} id={`${prefix}-arrow-${c}`} viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
          <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill={tok(c)} />
        </marker>
      ))}
      <pattern id={`${prefix}-grid`} width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><circle cx="1" cy="1" r="1" fill={tok('line')} /></pattern>
    </defs>
  )
}

export type Sel = { kind: 'node' | 'edge'; id: string } | null

export interface CanvasProps {
  s: AppState
  def: WorkflowDef
  selected?: Sel
  onSelect?: (sel: Sel) => void
  onMoveNode?: (id: string, x: number, y: number) => void
  onMoveEnd?: () => void
  onConnect?: (from: string, to: string) => void
  readOnly?: boolean
  highlight?: Set<string> // node ids on a traced path
  issues?: Set<string> // node ids with validation errors
  active?: Set<string> // node ids where an instance sits now
  done?: Set<string> // node ids already completed in an instance
  connectMode?: boolean
  zoom?: number
}

export function Canvas({ s, def, selected, onSelect, onMoveNode, onMoveEnd, onConnect, readOnly, highlight, issues, active, done, connectMode, zoom = 1 }: CanvasProps) {
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const drag = useRef<{ id: string; ox: number; oy: number; moved: boolean; sx: number; sy: number } | null>(null)
  const [link, setLink] = useState<{ from: string; x: number; y: number } | null>(null)
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [hoverNode, setHoverNode] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const { w, h } = canvasExtent(def)

  const toSvg = (clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
    const svg = svgRef.current!
    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint()
    pt.x = clientX; pt.y = clientY
    const m = svg.getScreenCTM()
    return m ? pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse()) : { x: clientX, y: clientY }
  }
  const nodeAt = (x: number, y: number) => def.nodes.find((n) => { const z = nodeSize(n.type); const pw = Math.max(z.w, 40) / 2 + 6, ph = Math.max(z.h, 40) / 2 + 6; return Math.abs(n.x - x) <= pw && Math.abs(n.y - y) <= ph })

  const onNodeDown = (e: React.PointerEvent, n: WfNode) => {
    e.stopPropagation()
    if (connectMode && !readOnly) {
      if (!pending) { setPending(n.id); onSelect?.({ kind: 'node', id: n.id }) } else if (pending !== n.id) { onConnect?.(pending, n.id); setPending(null) }
      return
    }
    onSelect?.({ kind: 'node', id: n.id })
    if (readOnly) return
    const p = toSvg(e.clientX, e.clientY)
    drag.current = { id: n.id, ox: p.x - n.x, oy: p.y - n.y, moved: false, sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY }
    svgRef.current?.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
  }
  const onHandleDown = (e: React.PointerEvent, n: WfNode) => {
    e.stopPropagation()
    if (readOnly) return
    const p = toSvg(e.clientX, e.clientY)
    setLink({ from: n.id, x: p.x, y: p.y })
    svgRef.current?.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
  }
  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (drag.current) {
      const d = drag.current
      if (!d.moved && Math.abs(e.clientX - d.sx) + Math.abs(e.clientY - d.sy) < 3) return
      d.moved = true
      const p = toSvg(e.clientX, e.clientY)
      const snap = (v: number) => Math.round(v / 10) * 10
      onMoveNode?.(d.id, Math.max(40, snap(p.x - d.ox)), Math.max(50, snap(p.y - d.oy)))
    } else if (link) {
      const p = toSvg(e.clientX, e.clientY)
      setLink({ ...link, x: p.x, y: p.y })
      setHoverNode(nodeAt(p.x, p.y)?.id ?? null)
    }
  }
  const onUp = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (drag.current?.moved) onMoveEnd?.()
    drag.current = null
    if (link) {
      const p = toSvg(e.clientX, e.clientY)
      const t = nodeAt(p.x, p.y)
      if (t && t.id !== link.from) onConnect?.(link.from, t.id)
      setLink(null)
      setHoverNode(null)
    }
    try { svgRef.current?.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId) } catch { /* not captured */ }
  }

  const dim = (id: string) => (highlight && !highlight.has(id) ? 0.28 : 1)
  const edgeOn = (e: WfEdge) => !highlight || (highlight.has(e.from) && highlight.has(e.to) && e.outcome !== 'return' && e.outcome !== 'reject')
  const linkFrom = link && def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === link.from)

  return (
    <svg ref={svgRef} width={w * zoom} height={h * zoom} viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${h}`} role="img" aria-label={`Process diagram: ${def.name}`}
      className={readOnly ? '' : connectMode ? 'cursor-crosshair' : ''} style={{ touchAction: 'none', userSelect: 'none', display: 'block' }}
      onPointerMove={onMove} onPointerUp={onUp} onPointerDown={() => { if (!readOnly) { onSelect?.(null); setPending(null) } }}>
      <ArrowDefs />
      <rect x={0} y={0} width={w} height={h} fill={`url(#wf-grid)`} />
      {/* edges */}
      {def.edges.map((e) => {
        const g = edgeGeom(def, e)
        if (!g) return null
        const sel = selected?.kind === 'edge' && selected.id === e.id
        const c = sel ? 'link' : highlight && edgeOn(e) ? 'ink' : edgeColor(e)
        const label = e.label || e.condition || e.outcome === 'return' || e.outcome === 'reject' ? edgeOutcomeLabel(e) : ''
        const on = edgeOn(e)
        return (
          <g key={e.id} opacity={on ? 1 : 0.22} onPointerDown={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); onSelect?.({ kind: 'edge', id: e.id }) }} style={{ cursor: readOnly ? 'default' : 'pointer' }}>
            <path d={g.d} fill="none" stroke="transparent" strokeWidth={14} />
            <path d={g.d} fill="none" stroke={tok(c)} strokeWidth={sel ? 2.5 : highlight && on ? 2.2 : 1.6} strokeDasharray={g.back || e.outcome === 'return' || e.outcome === 'reject' ? '6 4' : undefined} markerEnd={`url(#wf-arrow-${c})`} />
            {label && (
              <g transform={`translate(${g.mid.x},${g.mid.y})`}>
                <rect x={-(Math.min(label.length, 26) * 3.1 + 7)} y={-9} width={Math.min(label.length, 26) * 6.2 + 14} height={18} rx={9} fill={tok('surface')} stroke={tok(sel ? 'link' : e.outcome === 'return' ? 'warn' : e.outcome === 'reject' ? 'bad' : 'line')} />
                <text textAnchor="middle" y={3.5} fontSize={10.5} fontWeight={600} fill={tok(e.outcome === 'return' ? 'warn' : e.outcome === 'reject' ? 'bad' : 'muted')}>{trunc(label, 26)}</text>
              </g>
            )}
          </g>
        )
      })}
      {/* in-progress connection */}
      {link && linkFrom && <path d={`M${linkFrom.x + nodeSize(linkFrom.type).w / 2} ${linkFrom.y} L${link.x} ${link.y}`} stroke={tok('link')} strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray="4 3" markerEnd="url(#wf-arrow-link)" fill="none" />}
      {/* nodes */}
      {def.nodes.map((n) => (
        <g key={n.id} opacity={dim(n.id)} transform={`translate(${n.x},${n.y})`} onPointerDown={(e) => onNodeDown(e, n)} style={{ cursor: readOnly ? 'pointer' : connectMode ? 'crosshair' : 'grab' }}>
          <NodeShape s={s} def={def} n={n} selected={selected?.kind === 'node' && selected.id === n.id} issue={issues?.has(n.id)} pending={pending === n.id} target={hoverNode === n.id} active={active?.has(n.id)} done={done?.has(n.id)} />
          {!readOnly && selected?.kind === 'node' && selected.id === n.id && n.type !== 'end' && (
            <g transform={`translate(${nodeSize(n.type).w / 2 + 12},0)`} onPointerDown={(e) => onHandleDown(e, n)} style={{ cursor: 'crosshair' }}>
              <title>Drag to another step to connect</title>
              <circle r={8} fill={tok('link')} stroke={tok('surface')} strokeWidth={2} />
              <path d="M-3 0 H3 M0 -3 V3" stroke={tok('surface')} strokeWidth={1.6} />
            </g>
          )}
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  )
}

export function NodeShape({ s, def, n, selected, issue, pending, target, active, done }: { s: AppState; def: WorkflowDef; n: WfNode; selected?: boolean; issue?: boolean; pending?: boolean; target?: boolean; active?: boolean; done?: boolean }) {
  const z = nodeSize(n.type)
  const col = TYPE_COLOR[n.type]
  const ring = selected || pending || target ? tok('link') : issue ? tok('bad') : active ? tok('marker') : tok('line')
  const rw = selected || pending || target || issue || active ? 2.2 : 1.2
  const label = (y: number, max: number, lines = 2) => wrap(n.label, max, lines).map((l, i) => <text key={i} x={0} y={y + i * 13} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={11} fontWeight={600} fill={tok('ink')}>{l}</text>)
  const status = active ? <circle cx={z.w / 2 - 2} cy={-z.h / 2 + 2} r={6} fill={tok('marker')} stroke={tok('surface')} strokeWidth={2} /> : done ? <g transform={`translate(${z.w / 2 - 2},${-z.h / 2 + 2})`}><circle r={7} fill={tok('good')} stroke={tok('surface')} strokeWidth={2} /><path d="M-3 0 L-1 2.5 L3 -2.5" stroke={tok('surface')} strokeWidth={1.6} fill="none" /></g> : null
  const issueDot = issue ? <g transform={`translate(${-z.w / 2 + 2},${-z.h / 2 + 2})`}><circle r={7} fill={tok('bad')} /><text y={3.5} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={10} fontWeight={700} fill={tok('surface')}>!</text></g> : null
  switch (n.type) {
    case 'start':
    case 'end':
      return (
        <g>
          <circle r={18} fill={n.type === 'start' ? tok('good', 0.14) : tok('surface')} stroke={selected ? ring : n.type === 'start' ? tok('good') : tok('ink')} strokeWidth={n.type === 'end' ? 3 : rw + 0.6} />
          {n.type === 'end' && <circle r={11} fill={tok('ink')} />}
          {n.type === 'start' && <path d="M-4 -6 L6 0 L-4 6 z" fill={tok('good')} />}
          {label(34, 16, 1)}
          {issueDot}
        </g>
      )
    case 'condition':
      return (
        <g>
          <polygon points={`0,${-z.h / 2} ${z.w / 2},0 0,${z.h / 2} ${-z.w / 2},0`} fill={tok('warn', 0.1)} stroke={selected || pending || target ? ring : issue ? tok('bad') : tok('warn')} strokeWidth={rw + 0.3} />
          <text y={5} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={15} fontWeight={700} fill={tok('warn')}>?</text>
          {label(z.h / 2 + 14, 24)}
          {issueDot}
        </g>
      )
    case 'parallel-split':
    case 'parallel-join':
      return (
        <g>
          <rect x={-z.w / 2} y={-z.h / 2} width={z.w} height={z.h} rx={2} fill={tok('ink')} stroke={selected || pending || target ? ring : 'none'} strokeWidth={3} />
          {label(z.h / 2 + 14, 18)}
          {issueDot}
        </g>
      )
    case 'notify':
    case 'system': {
      const sub = n.type === 'system' ? 'SYSTEM' : `NOTIFY · ${describeAssignee(s, n.assignee, def.fields)}`
      return (
        <g>
          <rect x={-z.w / 2} y={-z.h / 2} width={z.w} height={z.h} rx={z.h / 2} fill={n.type === 'system' ? tok('sunken') : tok('info', 0.08)} stroke={ring} strokeWidth={rw} strokeDasharray={n.type === 'system' ? '4 3' : undefined} />
          <text x={0} y={-8} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={700} letterSpacing={0.6} fill={tok('faint')}>{trunc(sub, 26)}</text>
          {wrap(n.label, 22, 2).map((l, i, arr) => <text key={i} x={0} y={arr.length > 1 ? 6 + i * 12 : 10} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={arr.length > 1 ? 10.5 : 11} fontWeight={600} fill={tok('ink')}>{l}</text>)}
          {status}{issueDot}
        </g>
      )
    }
    default: {
      const lane = laneFor(s, def, n)
      const lines = wrap(n.label, 22)
      return (
        <g>
          <rect x={-z.w / 2} y={-z.h / 2} width={z.w} height={z.h} rx={5} fill={tok('surface')} stroke={ring} strokeWidth={rw} />
          <rect x={-z.w / 2} y={-z.h / 2} width={4} height={z.h} rx={2} fill={tok(col)} />
          <text x={-z.w / 2 + 11} y={-z.h / 2 + 13} fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={700} letterSpacing={0.6} fill={tok(n.type === 'approval' ? 'warn' : col)}>{nodeTypeLabel(n.type).toUpperCase()}{n.rule === 'all' ? ' · ALL' : ''}</text>
          {n.slaDays ? <text x={z.w / 2 - 8} y={-z.h / 2 + 13} textAnchor="end" fontSize={9} fontWeight={600} fill={tok('muted')}>{n.slaDays}d SLA</text> : null}
          {lines.map((l, i) => <text key={i} x={-z.w / 2 + 11} y={-z.h / 2 + 29 + i * 13} fontSize={11.5} fontWeight={600} fill={tok('ink')}>{l}</text>)}
          <text x={-z.w / 2 + 11} y={z.h / 2 - 7} fontSize={10} fill={tok(n.assignee ? 'muted' : 'bad')}>{trunc(n.assignee ? lane : 'No assignee', 25)}</text>
          {n.type === 'approval' && <path d={`M${z.w / 2 - 16} ${z.h / 2 - 16} l3 3 l6 -6`} stroke={tok('warn')} strokeWidth={1.6} fill="none" />}
          {status}{issueDot}
        </g>
      )
    }
  }
}

export const conditionText = (e: WfEdge) => (e.condition ? describeCondition(e.condition) : 'Default (no rule matched)')
