// Process catalog (WF-01, WF-03, WF-12): every business process with its approvers and routing, the DOA matrix, and process analytics.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, DoaMatrix, RecordType, RoleId, WorkflowDef } from '@/core/types'
import { getState, mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { go, workflowHref } from '@/core/router'
import { saveFile, toCSV } from '@/core/download'
import { doaRoleFor } from '@/core/engine/workflow'
import { cx, fmtDate, fmtDateTime, money, pct } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Empty, Field, Input, Modal, MoneyInput, PageHeader, Panel, SegButtons, Select, Stat, Table, Tabs, TextArea, Mono } from '@/ui/kit'
import { BarChart, HBarChart, SERIES } from '@/ui/charts'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { RECORD_TYPES, blankDef, describeAssignee, draftOf, fmtDur, isHuman, monthlyVolume, processStats, recordTypeLabel, slugify, tasksForAll, versionsOf, type ProcessStat } from './lib'
import { manualHtml } from './sop'
import { planReminders } from '@/core/engine/notify'
import { sendRemindersNow } from '@/views/admin/WorkflowSettings'

type Tab = 'catalog' | 'doa' | 'analytics'

export default function Catalog(_props: { projectId?: string; id?: string }) {
  const s = useStore()
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('catalog')
  const [newOpen, setNewOpen] = useState(false)
  const keys = useMemo(() => Array.from(new Set(s.workflowDefs.map((d) => d.key))), [s.workflowDefs])
  const stats = useMemo(() => Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k) => [k, processStats(s, k)])) as Record<string, ProcessStat>, [s.workflows, s.workflowDefs, keys]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const current = (k: string) => { const v = versionsOf(s, k); return v.find((d) => d.status === 'published') ?? v[0] }
  const published = keys.map(current).filter((d) => d.status === 'published')
  const running = s.workflows.filter((w) => w.status === 'running')
  const overdue = running.reduce((a, w) => a + w.active.filter((x) => x.due && x.due < s.settings.asOf).length, 0)
  const year = s.workflows.filter((w) => w.completedAt && w.completedAt.slice(0, 10) >= `${Number(s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 4)) - 1}${s.settings.asOf.slice(4)}`)
  const allCycles = Object.values(stats).flatMap((x) => x.cycles)
  const pendingNotices = useMemo(() => planReminders(s).length, [s.workflows, s.settings.workflow]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const manual = async () => {
    const r = await saveFile(`process-manual-${s.settings.asOf}.html`, manualHtml(getState(), published), 'text/html')
    toast(r === 'saved' ? `Process manual downloaded — ${published.length} SOPs` : r === 'declined' ? 'Download cancelled' : 'Downloads are not available here', r === 'saved' ? 'good' : 'info')
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <PageHeader eyebrow="Configure" title="Workflows"
        subtitle="Every business process documented with its approvers, routing rules and approval authority. Edit a process to change how work routes — the SOP regenerates from the same definition."
        actions={<><Button icon={<Icon name="bell" className="h-4 w-4" />} onClick={sendRemindersNow} title={`Reminders ${s.settings.workflow.reminderDays} day(s) before due; escalation to the manager ${s.settings.workflow.escalateAfterDays ? `${s.settings.workflow.escalateAfterDays} day(s) overdue` : 'off'}`}>Send reminders now{pendingNotices > 0 && <span className="rounded-full bg-marker px-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold tabular-nums text-markerink">{pendingNotices}</span>}</Button><Button icon={<Icon name="doc" className="h-4 w-4" />} onClick={manual}>Download process manual</Button><Button variant="primary" icon={<Icon name="plus" className="h-4 w-4" />} onClick={() => setNewOpen(true)}>New process</Button></>} />
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-5">
        <Stat label="Published processes" value={published.length} sub={`${keys.length - published.length ? `${keys.length - published.length} in draft · ` : ''}${s.workflowDefs.filter((d) => d.status === 'retired').length} retired versions`} />
        <Stat label="Requests in flight" value={running.length} sub={`${new Set(running.map((w) => w.projectId).filter(Boolean)).size} projects`} />
        <Stat label="Completed (12 mo)" value={year.length} sub={`${year.filter((w) => w.status === 'approved').length} approved`} />
        <Stat label="Median cycle time" value={fmtDur(allCycles.length ? allCycles.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(allCycles.length / 2)] : undefined)} sub="start to completion" />
        <Stat label="Overdue steps" value={overdue} tone={overdue ? 'bad' : 'good'} sub={<>past their SLA · <a href="#admin-notify" className="text-link">reminder rules</a></>} />
      </div>
      <Tabs<Tab> value={tab} onChange={setTab} tabs={[{ id: 'catalog', label: 'Process catalog', count: keys.length }, { id: 'doa', label: 'Delegation of authority' }, { id: 'analytics', label: 'Process analytics' }]} />
      {tab === 'catalog' && <CatalogTable s={s} keys={keys} stats={stats} current={current} />}
      {tab === 'doa' && <DoaEditor s={s} />}
      {tab === 'analytics' && <Analytics s={s} keys={keys} stats={stats} />}
      <NewProcessModal open={newOpen} onClose={() => setNewOpen(false)} s={s} keys={keys} current={current} />
    </div>
  )
}

function approversSummary(s: AppState, d: WorkflowDef): string {
  const out: string[] = []
  for (const n of d.nodes.filter((x) => x.type === 'approval')) { const t = describeAssignee(s, n.assignee, d.fields); if (!out.includes(t)) out.push(t) }
  return out.join(' → ') || '—'
}

function CatalogTable({ s, keys, stats, current }: { s: AppState; keys: string[]; stats: Record<string, ProcessStat>; current: (k: string) => WorkflowDef }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [rt, setRt] = useState('')
  const rows = keys.map(current).filter((d) => (!rt || d.recordType === rt) && (!q || (d.name + ' ' + d.key + ' ' + d.description).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())))
  return (
    <Panel pad={false} title="Process catalog" subtitle="Click a process to open the designer, test its routing or read its SOP."
      actions={<div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><Input aria-label="Search processes" placeholder="Search processes" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} className="h-7 w-[200px] py-0.5" /><Select aria-label="Record type" className="h-7 w-auto py-0.5" value={rt} onChange={(e) => setRt(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'All record types' }, ...RECORD_TYPES.filter((r) => keys.some((k) => current(k).recordType === r.id)).map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: r.label }))]} /></div>}>
      <Table rowKey={(d) => d.key} rows={rows} onRowClick={(d) => go(workflowHref(d.key))} empty={<div className="p-4"><Empty title="No processes match">Clear the search or filter.</Empty></div>} columns={[
        { key: 'name', header: 'Process', sort: (d) => d.name, render: (d) => <div className="min-w-[220px] max-w-[340px]"><a href={workflowHref(d.key)} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} className="font-semibold text-ink hover:text-link">{d.name}</a><div className="line-clamp-2 text-[12px] text-muted">{d.description}</div></div> },
        { key: 'key', header: 'Key', render: (d) => <Mono className="text-muted">{d.key}</Mono> },
        { key: 'rt', header: 'Record', sort: (d) => d.recordType, render: (d) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12.5px]">{recordTypeLabel(d.recordType)}</span> },
        { key: 'v', header: 'Version', render: (d) => { const dr = draftOf(s, d.key); return <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap"><b>v{d.version}</b><Badge tone={d.status === 'published' ? 'good' : d.status === 'draft' ? 'info' : 'neutral'}>{d.status}</Badge>{dr && dr.id !== d.id && <Badge tone="info">draft v{dr.version}</Badge>}</div> } },
        { key: 'eff', header: 'Effective', sort: (d) => d.effective, render: (d) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{fmtDate(d.effective)}</span> },
        { key: 'own', header: 'Owner', render: (d) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12.5px]">{s.roles.find((r) => r.id === d.ownerRole)?.name}</span> },
        { key: 'steps', header: 'Steps', num: true, sort: (d) => d.nodes.filter((n) => isHuman(n.type)).length, render: (d) => <span title={`${d.nodes.length} nodes in total`}>{d.nodes.filter((n) => isHuman(n.type)).length}</span> },
        { key: 'appr', header: 'Approvers', render: (d) => <span className="block min-w-[160px] max-w-[240px] text-[12px]">{approversSummary(s, d)}{d.nodes.some((n) => n.type === 'condition') && <span className="ml-1 text-faint">· conditional routing</span>}</span> },
        { key: 'run', header: 'Running', num: true, sort: (d) => stats[d.key]?.running ?? 0, render: (d) => (stats[d.key]?.running ? <Badge tone="marker">{stats[d.key].running}</Badge> : <span className="text-faint">0</span>) },
        { key: 'cyc', header: 'Avg cycle', num: true, sort: (d) => stats[d.key]?.avgCycleH ?? -1, render: (d) => <span title={stats[d.key]?.completed ? `${stats[d.key].completed} completed` : 'No completed instances'}>{fmtDur(stats[d.key]?.avgCycleH)}</span> },
      ]} />
    </Panel>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── New process
function NewProcessModal({ open, onClose, s, keys, current }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; s: AppState; keys: string[]; current: (k: string) => WorkflowDef }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [key, setKey] = useState('')
  const [keyTouched, setKeyTouched] = useState(false)
  const [from, setFrom] = useState<string>('')
  const [rt, setRt] = useState<RecordType>('change')
  const [owner, setOwner] = useState<RoleId>('pmo')
  const k = keyTouched ? key : slugify(name)
  const clash = keys.includes(k)
  const create = () => {
    if (!name.trim() || !k || clash) return
    const src = from ? current(from) : undefined
    const def: WorkflowDef = src
      ? { ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(src)), id: `wfd-${k}`, key: k, name: name.trim(), version: 1, status: 'draft', effective: s.settings.asOf }
      : blankDef(k, name.trim(), rt, owner, s.settings.asOf)
    if (!src) { def.description = `Routes ${recordTypeLabel(rt).toLowerCase()} records for review and approval.`; def.purpose = '' }
    mutate((d) => { d.workflowDefs.push(def) }, { entity: 'workflow-def', entityId: k, action: 'create', summary: `Created process ${def.name} (${k}) as draft v1${src ? ` from ${src.name}` : ''}` })
    toast(`Draft process created — design it, then publish`)
    onClose()
    setName(''); setKey(''); setKeyTouched(false); setFrom('')
    go(workflowHref(k))
  }
  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title="New process" footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={!name.trim() || !k || clash} onClick={create}>Create draft</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <Field label="Process name"><Input id="new-wf-name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Emergency work authorization" /></Field>
        <Field label="Process key" hint={clash ? <span className="text-bad">That key is already used.</span> : 'Stable identifier modules use to start this process. Lowercase and hyphens.'}>
          <Input className="font-mono" value={k} onChange={(e) => { setKeyTouched(true); setKey(slugify(e.target.value)) }} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Start from">
          <Select value={from} onChange={(e) => setFrom(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: 'Blank process (request → manager review → dollar-authority approval)' }, ...keys.map((x) => ({ value: x, label: `Duplicate: ${current(x).name} v${current(x).version}` }))]} />
        </Field>
        {!from && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <Field label="Record type"><Select value={rt} onChange={(e) => setRt(e.target.value as RecordType)} options={RECORD_TYPES.map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: r.label }))} /></Field>
            <Field label="Process owner"><Select value={owner} onChange={(e) => setOwner(e.target.value as RoleId)} options={s.roles.map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: r.name }))} /></Field>
          </div>
        )}
        <Callout>New processes start as a draft. Nothing routes on them until you publish v1.</Callout>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Delegation of authority (WF-03)
function DoaEditor({ s }: { s: AppState }) {
  const [mid, setMid] = useState(s.doaMatrices[0]?.id)
  const m = s.doaMatrices.find((x) => x.id === mid) ?? s.doaMatrices[0]
  const me = s.people.find((p) => p.id === s.currentUserId)!
  const canEdit = me.roles.includes('finance') || me.roles.includes('admin')
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<DoaMatrix['rows'] | null>(null)
  const [effective, setEffective] = useState(s.settings.asOf)
  const [note, setNote] = useState('')
  const [newOpen, setNewOpen] = useState(false)
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('')
  if (!m) return <Empty title="No DOA matrix">Create one to route approvals by dollar amount.</Empty>
  const work = rows ?? m.rows
  const sorted = work.slice().sort((a, b) => a.upTo - b.upTo)
  const dirty = !!rows && JSON.stringify(rows) !== JSON.stringify(m.rows)
  const programs = s.programs.filter((p) => p.doaMatrixId === m.id)
  const history = s.audit.filter((a) => a.entity === 'doa' && a.entityId === m.id).slice().reverse()
  const doaProcesses = Array.from(new Set(s.workflowDefs.filter((d) => d.status === 'published' && d.nodes.some((n) => n.assignee?.kind === 'doa')).map((d) => d.name)))
  // impact on in-flight requests that will reach (or sit at) a DOA step
  const impact = s.workflows.filter((w) => w.status === 'running').map((w) => {
    const def = s.workflowDefs.find((d) => d.id === w.defId)
    const doaNode = def?.nodes.find((n) => n.assignee?.kind === 'doa')
    if (!doaNode || doaNode.assignee?.kind !== 'doa') return null
    const amt = Math.abs(Number(w.data[doaNode.assignee.field] ?? 0))
    const before = doaRoleFor(s, w, amt)
    const after = (sorted.find((r) => amt <= r.upTo) ?? sorted[sorted.length - 1])?.roleId
    const at = w.active.some((a) => a.nodeId === doaNode.id)
    return { w, amt, before, after, at }
  }).filter(Boolean) as { w: (typeof s.workflows)[number]; amt: number; before?: RoleId; after?: RoleId; at: boolean }[]
  const changed = impact.filter((x) => x.before !== x.after)
  const set = (i: number, patch: Partial<DoaMatrix['rows'][number]>) => setRows(sorted.map((r, j) => (j === i ? { ...r, ...patch } : r)))
  const issues: string[] = []
  if (!sorted.length) issues.push('Add at least one tier.')
  if (sorted.length && sorted[sorted.length - 1].upTo < 1e12) issues.push('The last tier should have no upper limit so every amount has an approver.')
  if (new Set(sorted.map((r) => r.upTo)).size !== sorted.length) issues.push('Two tiers have the same limit.')
  const publish = () => {
    const nv = m.version + 1
    const summary = `Published ${m.name} v${nv} effective ${effective}: ${sorted.map((r) => `${r.upTo >= 1e12 ? 'above' : '≤' + money(r.upTo)} ${r.label}`).join(', ')}${note.trim() ? ` — ${note.trim()}` : ''}`
    mutate((d) => { const x = d.doaMatrices.find((y) => y.id === m.id)!; x.rows = sorted; x.version = nv; x.effective = effective }, { entity: 'doa', entityId: m.id, action: 'publish', summary })
    setRows(null); setNote('')
    toast(`${m.name} v${nv} published — new dollar-authority steps route on it`)
  }
  const createMatrix = () => {
    const id = `doa-${slugify(newName) || 'matrix'}`
    if (s.doaMatrices.some((x) => x.id === id)) { toast('A matrix with that name exists', 'bad'); return }
    mutate((d) => { d.doaMatrices.push({ id, name: newName.trim(), version: 1, effective: d.settings.asOf, rows: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m.rows)) }) }, { entity: 'doa', entityId: id, action: 'create', summary: `Created ${newName.trim()} v1 from ${m.name} v${m.version}` })
    setMid(id); setNewOpen(false); setNewName('')
    toast('Matrix created — assign it to programs in Configuration')
  }
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_380px]">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
        <Panel title={<span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{s.doaMatrices.length > 1 ? <Select aria-label="Matrix" className="h-7 w-auto py-0.5" value={m.id} onChange={(e) => { setMid(e.target.value); setRows(null) }} options={s.doaMatrices.map((x) => ({ value: x.id, label: x.name }))} /> : m.name}<Badge tone="good">v{m.version}</Badge><span className="text-[12px] font-normal text-muted">effective {fmtDate(m.effective)}</span></span>}
          subtitle={`Owned by Capital Finance. Used by ${programs.length ? programs.map((p) => p.code).join(', ') : 'no programs'}. A dollar-authority step routes to the first tier whose limit covers the amount.`}
          actions={canEdit ? <><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setNewOpen(true)}>New matrix</Button><Button size="sm" onClick={() => setRows([...sorted.slice(0, -1), { upTo: Math.max(1000, (sorted[sorted.length - 2]?.upTo ?? 0) * 2), roleId: 'exec', label: 'New tier' }, ...sorted.slice(-1)])}>Add tier</Button></> : undefined} pad={false}>
          {!canEdit && <div className="px-4 pt-3"><Callout tone="info">Only Capital Finance or an administrator can change approval authority. You are viewing the matrix in force.</Callout></div>}
          <div className="scroll-x">
            <table className="tbl">
              <thead><tr><th className="num">From</th><th className="num">Up to</th><th>Approver role</th><th>Label</th><th>People holding the role</th><th /></tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {sorted.map((r, i) => {
                  const holders = s.people.filter((p) => p.roles.includes(r.roleId) && !p.company)
                  const last = i === sorted.length - 1
                  return (
                    <tr key={i}>
                      <td className="num text-muted">{i === 0 ? '$0' : money(sorted[i - 1].upTo + 1)}</td>
                      <td className="num w-[170px]">{last && r.upTo >= 1e12 ? <span className="text-muted">No limit</span> : canEdit ? <MoneyInput aria-label="Up to" className="h-7 py-0.5" value={r.upTo} onChange={(v) => set(i, { upTo: v })} /> : money(r.upTo, 'full')}</td>
                      <td className="min-w-[170px]">{canEdit ? <Select aria-label="Role" className="h-7 py-0.5" value={r.roleId} onChange={(e) => set(i, { roleId: e.target.value as RoleId })} options={s.roles.map((x) => ({ value: x.id, label: x.name }))} /> : s.roles.find((x) => x.id === r.roleId)?.name}</td>
                      <td className="min-w-[150px]">{canEdit ? <Input aria-label="Label" className="h-7 py-0.5" value={r.label} onChange={(e) => set(i, { label: e.target.value })} /> : r.label}</td>
                      <td className="text-[12px] text-muted">{holders.length ? holders.map((p) => p.name).join(', ') : <span className="text-bad">Nobody holds this role</span>}</td>
                      <td>{canEdit && !last && <button className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-bad hover:underline" onClick={() => setRows(sorted.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}>Remove</button>}</td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <DoaBand rows={sorted} />
        </Panel>
        {dirty && (
          <Panel title={`Publish v${m.version + 1}`} subtitle="Publishing replaces the matrix in force from its effective date. Steps already assigned keep their approver; new dollar-authority steps route on the new tiers.">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
              {issues.map((x) => <Callout key={x} tone="bad">{x}</Callout>)}
              {changed.length > 0 ? (
                <Callout tone="warn" title={`${changed.length} in-flight request${changed.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} would route to a different tier`}>
                  <ul className="mt-1 list-disc pl-4">{changed.slice(0, 6).map((x) => <li key={x.w.id}>{x.w.title} ({money(x.amt)}): {s.roles.find((r) => r.id === x.before)?.name} → {s.roles.find((r) => r.id === x.after)?.name}{x.at ? ' — already at the approval step, keeps its current approver' : ''}</li>)}</ul>
                </Callout>
              ) : <Callout tone="good">No in-flight request changes tier.</Callout>}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[180px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
                <Field label="Effective date"><Input type="date" value={effective} onChange={(e) => setEffective(e.target.value)} /></Field>
                <Field label="Reason for change"><TextArea className="min-h-[38px]" value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Board resolution 2026-14 raised director authority" /></Field>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2"><Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setRows(null)}>Discard</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={!!issues.length} onClick={publish}>Publish v{m.version + 1}</Button></div>
            </div>
          </Panel>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <Panel title="Where it applies">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-[13px]">
            <div><div className="eyebrow mb-1">Programs</div><div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">{programs.map((p) => <Badge key={p.id} tone="ink">{p.code}</Badge>)}{!programs.length && <span className="text-muted">None</span>}</div></div>
            <div><div className="eyebrow mb-1">Processes with a dollar-authority step</div><ul className="list-disc pl-4 text-[12.5px]">{doaProcesses.map((n) => <li key={n}>{n}</li>)}</ul></div>
            <div><div className="eyebrow mb-1">In flight</div><span className="text-[12.5px]">{impact.length} running request{impact.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} route through dollar authority ({impact.filter((x) => x.at).length} at the approval step now).</span></div>
          </div>
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Revision history" pad={false}>
          {history.length ? (
            <ol className="divide-y divide-line">{history.map((h) => <li key={h.id} className="px-4 py-2 text-[12.5px]"><div className="font-semibold">{h.summary.split(':')[0]}</div><div className="text-muted">{h.summary.split(':').slice(1).join(':')}</div><div className="text-[11px] text-faint">{fmtDateTime(h.at)} · {s.people.find((p) => p.id === h.actorId)?.name}</div></li>)}</ol>
          ) : <div className="px-4 py-3 text-[12.5px] text-muted">v{m.version} effective {fmtDate(m.effective)} was migrated into Crosswalk; no changes since.</div>}
        </Panel>
      </div>
      <Modal open={newOpen} onClose={() => setNewOpen(false)} title="New DOA matrix" footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setNewOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={!newName.trim()} onClick={createMatrix}>Create</Button></>}>
        <Field label="Name" hint={`Starts as a copy of ${m.name} v${m.version}.`}><Input value={newName} onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Emergency work authority" /></Field>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Log-scale band showing how authority steps up by amount. */
function DoaBand({ rows }: { rows: DoaMatrix['rows'] }) {
  if (!rows.length) return null
  const lo = Math.log10(10_000), hi = Math.log10(200_000_000)
  const x = (v: number) => ((Math.log10(Math.max(10_000, Math.min(v, 200_000_000))) - lo) / (hi - lo)) * 100
  let prev = 0
  return (
    <div className="border-t border-line px-4 py-3">
      <div className="relative h-7 overflow-hidden rounded bg-sunken">
        {rows.map((r, i) => { const a = x(prev || 10_000), b = x(r.upTo); prev = r.upTo; return <div key={i} className="absolute top-0 flex h-7 items-center overflow-hidden border-r-2 border-surface px-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white" style={{ left: `${a}%`, width: `${Math.max(0, b - a)}%`, background: SERIES[i % SERIES.length] }} title={r.label}><span className="truncate">{r.label}</span></div> })}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 flex justify-between text-[10.5px] text-faint tabular-nums">{[10_000, 100_000, 1_000_000, 10_000_000, 100_000_000].map((v) => <span key={v}>{money(v)}</span>)}</div>
    </div>
  )
}

// ───────────────────────────── Analytics (WF-12)
function Analytics({ s, keys, stats }: { s: AppState; keys: string[]; stats: Record<string, ProcessStat> }) {
  const withData = keys.filter((k) => stats[k].total > 0)
  const [pick, setPick] = useState(withData.slice().sort((a, b) => stats[b].total - stats[a].total)[0] ?? keys[0])
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState<'avg' | 'p90'>('avg')
  const st = stats[pick]
  const vol = useMemo(() => monthlyVolume(s, 12), [s.workflows]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const load = useMemo(() => tasksForAll(s), [s.workflows]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const exportCsv = async () => {
    const rows = keys.flatMap((k) => stats[k].steps.map((x) => ({ process: stats[k].name, key: k, step: x.label, decisions: x.n, avg_hours: x.avgH.toFixed(2), max_hours: x.maxH.toFixed(2), sla_days: x.slaDays ?? '', sla_breaches: x.breaches, returns: x.returns, waiting_now: x.runningNow })))
    const r = await saveFile(`process-analytics-${s.settings.asOf}.csv`, toCSV(rows), 'text/csv')
    toast(r === 'saved' ? 'Analytics exported' : 'Download cancelled', r === 'saved' ? 'good' : 'info')
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <Panel title="Cycle time by process" subtitle="Start to completion, completed instances" actions={<SegButtons value={unit} onChange={setUnit} options={[{ id: 'avg', label: 'Average' }, { id: 'p90', label: 'P90' }]} />}>
          {withData.some((k) => stats[k].completed) ? (
            <HBarChart format={(n) => fmtDur(n)} rows={withData.filter((k) => stats[k].completed).sort((a, b) => ((unit === 'avg' ? stats[b].avgCycleH : stats[b].p90CycleH) ?? 0) - ((unit === 'avg' ? stats[a].avgCycleH : stats[a].p90CycleH) ?? 0)).map((k) => ({ label: stats[k].name, value: (unit === 'avg' ? stats[k].avgCycleH : stats[k].p90CycleH) ?? 0, sub: `n=${stats[k].completed}`, color: k === pick ? SERIES[1] : SERIES[0] }))} />
          ) : <Empty title="No completed instances yet" />}
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Volume" subtitle="Requests started and completed per month">
          <BarChart labels={vol.labels.map((k) => ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'][Number(k.slice(5)) - 1])} series={[{ name: 'Started', values: vol.started }, { name: 'Completed', values: vol.completed, color: SERIES[2] }]} format={(n) => String(Math.round(n))} height={200} />
        </Panel>
      </div>
      <Panel title="Process health" pad={false} actions={<Button size="sm" icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} onClick={exportCsv}>Export CSV</Button>}>
        <Table rowKey={(k) => k} rows={keys} onRowClick={(k) => setPick(k)} columns={[
          { key: 'n', header: 'Process', sort: (k) => stats[k].name, render: (k) => <span className={cx('font-semibold', k === pick && 'text-link')}>{stats[k].name}</span> },
          { key: 't', header: 'Instances', num: true, sort: (k) => stats[k].total, render: (k) => stats[k].total },
          { key: 'r', header: 'Running', num: true, sort: (k) => stats[k].running, render: (k) => stats[k].running },
          { key: 'a', header: 'Approved', num: true, render: (k) => stats[k].approved },
          { key: 'rj', header: 'Rejected / returned', num: true, render: (k) => stats[k].rejected + stats[k].returnedOut },
          { key: 'c', header: 'Avg cycle', num: true, sort: (k) => stats[k].avgCycleH ?? -1, render: (k) => fmtDur(stats[k].avgCycleH) },
          { key: 'rr', header: 'Return rate', num: true, sort: (k) => stats[k].returnRate, render: (k) => <span className={stats[k].returnRate > 0.2 ? 'text-warn font-semibold' : ''}>{pct(stats[k].returnRate)}</span> },
          { key: 'sla', header: 'SLA breaches', num: true, sort: (k) => stats[k].slaBreaches + stats[k].overdueNow, render: (k) => (stats[k].slaBreaches + stats[k].overdueNow ? <Badge tone="bad">{stats[k].slaBreaches + stats[k].overdueNow}</Badge> : <span className="text-good">0</span>) },
          { key: 'b', header: 'Bottleneck step', render: (k) => <span className="text-[12px]">{stats[k].bottleneck ? `${stats[k].bottleneck!.label} (${fmtDur(stats[k].bottleneck!.avgH)})` : '—'}</span> },
        ]} />
      </Panel>
      {st && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_360px]">
          <Panel title={`Step timing — ${st.name}`} subtitle="Elapsed time from a step being entered to the assignee's decision, across every instance" actions={<a className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-link" href={workflowHref(pick)}>Open in designer →</a>}>
            {st.steps.length ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                {st.bottleneck && <Callout tone="marker" title={`Bottleneck: ${st.bottleneck.label}`}>Averages {fmtDur(st.bottleneck.avgH)} per decision across {st.bottleneck.n} decisions{st.bottleneck.slaDays ? ` against a ${st.bottleneck.slaDays}-day SLA` : ''}. {st.bottleneck.runningNow ? `${st.bottleneck.runningNow} waiting there now.` : ''}</Callout>}
                <HBarChart format={(n) => fmtDur(n)} rows={st.steps.filter((x) => x.n).map((x) => ({ label: x.label, value: x.avgH, sub: `n=${x.n}`, color: x.nodeId === st.bottleneck?.nodeId ? SERIES[1] : SERIES[0] }))} />
                <div className="scroll-x">
                  <table className="tbl">
                    <thead><tr><th>Step</th><th className="num">Decisions</th><th className="num">Average</th><th className="num">Longest</th><th className="num">SLA</th><th className="num">Breaches</th><th className="num">Returns</th><th className="num">Waiting now</th><th className="num">Oldest wait</th></tr></thead>
                    <tbody>{st.steps.map((x) => <tr key={x.nodeId}><td>{x.label}</td><td className="num">{x.n}</td><td className="num">{fmtDur(x.avgH)}</td><td className="num">{fmtDur(x.maxH)}</td><td className="num">{x.slaDays ? `${x.slaDays} d` : '—'}</td><td className="num">{x.breaches || <span className="text-good">0</span>}</td><td className="num">{x.returns}</td><td className="num">{x.runningNow ? <Badge tone="marker">{x.runningNow}</Badge> : '0'}</td><td className="num">{x.runningNow ? fmtDur(x.oldestRunningH) : '—'}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : <Empty title="No history yet">Step timing appears once requests run through this process.</Empty>}
          </Panel>
          <Panel title="Who is holding work" subtitle="Open steps by assignee, all processes" pad={false}>
            {load.length ? (
              <ol className="divide-y divide-line">
                {load.slice(0, 12).map((x) => (
                  <li key={x.person.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-[13px]">
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><b>{x.person.name}</b><span className="block truncate text-[11.5px] text-muted">{x.person.title}</span></span>
                    {x.overdue > 0 && <Badge tone="bad">{x.overdue} overdue</Badge>}
                    <span className="w-8 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums">{x.count}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ol>
            ) : <div className="p-4 text-[13px] text-muted">No open steps.</div>}
          </Panel>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/workflows/Designer.tsx =====
// Workflow designer (WF-01..09, WF-11): visual process editor with versioning, test mode and generated SOP.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, WfEdge, WfNode, WfNodeType, WorkflowDef } from '@/core/types'
import { getState, mutate, useStore } from '@/core/store'
import { saveFile } from '@/core/download'
import { cx, fmtDate, uid } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Callout, Empty, Field, Input, Modal, PageHeader, Panel, Select, Tabs, TextArea, Mono } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons'
import { Canvas, TYPE_COLOR, canvasExtent, tok, type Sel } from './canvas'
import { AssigneeEditor, Checklist, ConditionEditor, FieldsEditor, ProcessSettings, type Preview } from './editors'
import { NODE_TYPES, SYSTEM_ACTIONS, blockingErrors, defaultTestProject, defaultValues, diffDefs, draftOf, isHuman, nodeTypeLabel, recordTypeLabel, validate, versionsOf, type Check } from './lib'
import { sopHtml } from './sop'
import { TestMode } from './TestMode'
import { SopView } from './SopView'
import { VersionsPanel } from './Versions'
import { useNarrow } from './hooks'

type Mode = 'design' | 'test' | 'sop' | 'versions'
type SideTab = 'selection' | 'process' | 'fields' | 'checks'

const clone = <T,>(x: T): T => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x))

export default function Designer({ id }: { projectId?: string; id?: string }) {
  const key = id ?? ''
  const s = useStore()
  const narrow = useNarrow(900)
  const versions = useMemo(() => versionsOf(s, key), [s.workflowDefs, key])
  const published = versions.find((d) => d.status === 'published')
  const storedDraft = draftOf(s, key)
  const [viewId, setViewId] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined)
  const baseDef = (viewId && versions.find((v) => v.id === viewId)) || storedDraft || published || versions[0]
  const editable = !!baseDef && (baseDef.status === 'draft' || (baseDef.id === published?.id && !storedDraft))
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>('design')
  useEffect(() => { if (narrow && mode === 'design') setMode('sop') }, [narrow, mode])

  // local working copy + undo history
  const [work, setWork] = useState<WorkflowDef | undefined>(() => (baseDef ? clone(baseDef) : undefined))
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false)
  const undo = useRef<WorkflowDef[]>([])
  const redo = useRef<WorkflowDef[]>([])
  const baseKey = baseDef ? baseDef.id + ':' + baseDef.version + ':' + baseDef.status : ''
  useEffect(() => { if (baseDef) { setWork(clone(baseDef)); setDirty(false); undo.current = []; redo.current = [] } }, [baseKey]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const [sel, setSel] = useState<Sel>(null)
  const [side, setSide] = useState<SideTab>('process')
  const [connect, setConnect] = useState(false)
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1)
  const viewport = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const fit = useCallback(() => {
    const el = viewport.current
    if (!el || !work) return
    const { w } = canvasExtent(work)
    setZoom(Math.max(0.5, Math.min(1, +((el.clientWidth - 8) / w).toFixed(2))))
  }, [work])
  const fitted = useRef('')
  useEffect(() => { if (mode === 'design' && work && fitted.current !== work.key) { fitted.current = work.key; requestAnimationFrame(fit) } }, [mode, work, fit])
  const [publishOpen, setPublishOpen] = useState(false)
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<Preview>(() => ({ projectId: defaultTestProject(s), requesterId: s.currentUserId, data: baseDef ? defaultValues(baseDef) : {} }))
  useEffect(() => { if (baseDef) setPreview((p) => ({ ...p, data: { ...defaultValues(baseDef), ...p.data } })) }, [baseDef?.id]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const change = useCallback((fn: (d: WorkflowDef) => void, opts: { record?: boolean } = {}) => {
    setWork((w) => {
      if (!w) return w
      if (opts.record !== false) { undo.current.push(clone(w)); if (undo.current.length > 80) undo.current.shift(); redo.current = [] }
      const n = clone(w)
      fn(n)
      return n
    })
    setDirty(true)
  }, [])
  const doUndo = () => { const prev = undo.current.pop(); if (prev && work) { redo.current.push(clone(work)); setWork(prev); setDirty(true) } }
  const doRedo = () => { const nx = redo.current.pop(); if (nx && work) { undo.current.push(clone(work)); setWork(nx); setDirty(true) } }

  const checks = useMemo(() => (work ? validate(work) : []), [work])
  const errors = blockingErrors(checks)
  const issueNodes = useMemo(() => new Set(checks.filter((c) => !c.ok && c.level === 'error').flatMap((c) => c.nodeIds ?? [])), [checks])

  const readOnly = !editable || narrow
  const liveAt = useMemo(() => new Set(s.workflows.filter((w) => w.defId === work?.id && w.status === 'running').flatMap((w) => w.active.map((a) => a.nodeId))), [s.workflows, work?.id])
  const selNode = sel?.kind === 'node' ? work?.nodes.find((n) => n.id === sel.id) : undefined
  const selEdge = sel?.kind === 'edge' ? work?.edges.find((e) => e.id === sel.id) : undefined
  useEffect(() => { if (sel) setSide('selection') }, [sel])

  // ── Mutations on the working copy
  const addNode = (type: WfNodeType) => {
    if (!work || readOnly) return
    const nid = uid('n').slice(0, 10)
    const label = { form: 'New form step', review: 'New review', approval: 'New approval', condition: 'New decision', 'parallel-split': 'Split', 'parallel-join': 'Join', notify: 'Notify', system: 'System action', start: 'Start', end: 'Complete' }[type]
    change((d) => {
      const from = selNode && selNode.type !== 'end' ? selNode : undefined
      let x = 120, y = 200
      if (from) { x = from.x + 170; y = from.y } else { const maxX = Math.max(0, ...d.nodes.map((n) => n.x)); x = maxX + 170; y = d.nodes.length ? d.nodes[d.nodes.length - 1].y : 200 }
      const node: WfNode = { id: nid, type, label, x, y, ...(isHuman(type) ? { slaDays: 3, assignee: type === 'form' ? { kind: 'requester' } : { kind: 'role', roleId: 'pmo' }, rule: 'any' } : {}), ...(type === 'system' ? { systemAction: 'none' } : {}), ...(type === 'notify' ? { assignee: { kind: 'requester' } } : {}) } as WfNode
      if (from) {
        const fwd = d.edges.filter((e) => e.from === from.id && e.outcome !== 'return' && e.outcome !== 'reject')
        if (fwd.length === 1 && from.type !== 'condition' && from.type !== 'parallel-split') {
          for (const n of d.nodes) if (n.x > from.x + 20) n.x += 170
          const oldTo = fwd[0].to
          fwd[0].to = nid
          d.edges.push({ id: uid('e'), from: nid, to: oldTo, ...(isHuman(type) && type !== 'form' ? { outcome: 'approve' } : {}) })
        } else {
          while (d.nodes.some((n) => Math.abs(n.x - x) < 60 && Math.abs(n.y - y) < 60)) y += 100
          d.edges.push({ id: uid('e'), from: from.id, to: nid, ...(isHuman(from.type) && from.type !== 'form' ? { outcome: 'approve' } : {}), ...(from.type === 'condition' ? { label: 'Yes', condition: { field: d.fields[0]?.key ?? 'amount', op: 'gt', value: 0 } } : {}) })
        }
      }
      d.nodes.push(node)
    })
    setSel({ kind: 'node', id: nid })
    toast(`${nodeTypeLabel(type)} added${selNode ? ` after “${selNode.label}”` : ''}`, 'info')
  }
  const moving = useRef(false)
  const moveNode = (nid: string, x: number, y: number) => {
    if (readOnly) return
    const first = !moving.current
    moving.current = true
    change((d) => { const n = d.nodes.find((q) => q.id === nid); if (n) { n.x = x; n.y = y } }, { record: first })
  }
  const connectNodes = (from: string, to: string) => {
    if (!work || readOnly) return
    if (work.edges.some((e) => e.from === from && e.to === to)) { toast('Those steps are already connected', 'info'); return }
    const a = work.nodes.find((n) => n.id === from)!, b = work.nodes.find((n) => n.id === to)!
    if (b.type === 'start') { toast('Nothing can flow into Start', 'bad'); return }
    const eid = uid('e')
    change((d) => {
      const back = b.x < a.x - 10
      const e: WfEdge = { id: eid, from, to }
      if (isHuman(a.type) && a.type !== 'form') { e.outcome = back ? 'return' : 'approve'; if (back) e.label = 'Return' }
      if (a.type === 'condition') { const hasDefault = d.edges.some((x) => x.from === from && !x.condition); if (hasDefault) { e.condition = { field: d.fields.find((f) => f.type === 'money' || f.type === 'number')?.key ?? d.fields[0]?.key ?? 'amount', op: 'gt', value: 0 }; e.label = 'Yes' } else e.label = 'No' }
      d.edges.push(e)
    })
    setSel({ kind: 'edge', id: eid })
    toast(`Connected “${a.label}” → “${b.label}”`, 'info')
  }
  const deleteSel = () => {
    if (!work || readOnly || !sel) return
    if (sel.kind === 'edge') { change((d) => { d.edges = d.edges.filter((e) => e.id !== sel.id) }); setSel(null); toast('Connection removed', 'info'); return }
    const n = work.nodes.find((x) => x.id === sel.id)
    if (!n) return
    change((d) => {
      const ins = d.edges.filter((e) => e.to === n.id && e.outcome !== 'return' && e.outcome !== 'reject')
      const outs = d.edges.filter((e) => e.from === n.id && e.outcome !== 'return' && e.outcome !== 'reject')
      d.edges = d.edges.filter((e) => e.from !== n.id && e.to !== n.id)
      if (ins.length === 1 && outs.length === 1 && ins[0].from !== outs[0].to) d.edges.push({ ...ins[0], id: uid('e'), to: outs[0].to })
      d.nodes = d.nodes.filter((x) => x.id !== n.id)
    })
    setSel(null)
    toast(`Removed “${n.label}”`, 'info')
  }
  const patchNode = (patch: Partial<WfNode>) => selNode && change((d) => { const n = d.nodes.find((x) => x.id === selNode.id); if (n) Object.assign(n, patch); for (const k of Object.keys(patch) as (keyof WfNode)[]) if (patch[k] === undefined && n) delete n[k] })
  const patchEdge = (patch: Partial<WfEdge>) => selEdge && change((d) => { const e = d.edges.find((x) => x.id === selEdge.id); if (e) Object.assign(e, patch); for (const k of Object.keys(patch) as (keyof WfEdge)[]) if (patch[k] === undefined && e) delete e[k] })

  // keyboard: delete, undo/redo, escape
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== 'design') return
    const k = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement
      if (t && (t.tagName === 'INPUT' || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || t.tagName === 'SELECT' || t.isContentEditable)) return
      if ((e.key === 'Delete' || e.key === 'Backspace') && sel) { e.preventDefault(); deleteSel() }
      else if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'z') { e.preventDefault(); e.shiftKey ? doRedo() : doUndo() }
      else if (e.key === 'Escape') { setSel(null); setConnect(false) }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', k)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', k)
  })

  // ── Persistence (WF-08): published versions are immutable; edits save as a draft new version.
  const saveDraft = (quiet = false): WorkflowDef | undefined => {
    if (!work) return
    const st = getState()
    const existing = draftOf(st, key)
    const maxV = Math.max(0, ...versionsOf(st, key).map((v) => v.version))
    const saved: WorkflowDef = { ...clone(work), status: 'draft', id: existing?.id ?? (work.status === 'draft' ? work.id : uid('wfd')), version: existing?.version ?? (work.status === 'draft' ? work.version : maxV + 1) }
    mutate((d) => {
      const i = d.workflowDefs.findIndex((x) => x.id === saved.id)
      if (i >= 0) d.workflowDefs[i] = saved
      else d.workflowDefs.push(saved)
    }, { entity: 'workflow-def', entityId: key, action: 'save-draft', summary: `Saved draft ${saved.name} v${saved.version}` })
    setViewId(saved.id)
    setDirty(false)
    if (!quiet) toast(`Draft v${saved.version} saved`)
    return saved
  }
  const discardDraft = () => {
    const dr = draftOf(getState(), key)
    if (dr) mutate((d) => { d.workflowDefs = d.workflowDefs.filter((x) => x.id !== dr.id) }, { entity: 'workflow-def', entityId: key, action: 'discard-draft', summary: `Discarded draft ${dr.name} v${dr.version}` })
    setViewId(undefined)
    if (!dr && baseDef) { setWork(clone(baseDef)); setDirty(false) }
    toast(dr ? `Draft v${dr.version} discarded` : 'Changes discarded', 'info')
  }

  if (!baseDef || !work) return <Empty title="Process not found" action={<a className="text-link text-[13px] font-semibold" href="#workflows">Back to the process catalog</a>}>No process with key “{key}”.</Empty>

  const isDraftView = work.status === 'draft' || dirty
  const nextVersion = storedDraft?.version ?? (work.status === 'draft' ? work.version : Math.max(...versions.map((v) => v.version)) + 1)
  const running = s.workflows.filter((w) => w.defKey === key && w.status === 'running')
  const download = async (kind: 'sop' | 'json') => {
    const r = kind === 'sop' ? await saveFile(`${work.key}-sop-v${work.version}.html`, sopHtml(getState(), work), 'text/html') : await saveFile(`${work.key}-v${work.version}.json`, JSON.stringify(work, null, 2), 'application/json')
    toast(r === 'saved' ? (kind === 'sop' ? 'SOP downloaded' : 'Definition downloaded') : r === 'declined' ? 'Download cancelled' : 'Downloads are not available here', r === 'saved' ? 'good' : 'info')
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow={<span><a href="#workflows" className="hover:text-ink">Workflows</a> / <Mono>{key}</Mono></span>}
        title={work.name || 'Untitled process'}
        subtitle={work.description || 'Describe what this process controls.'}
        actions={<>
          <Button size="sm" icon={<Icon name="doc" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} onClick={() => download('sop')}>Download SOP</Button>
          <Button size="sm" icon={<Icon name="download" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />} onClick={() => download('json')}>JSON</Button>
          {editable && !narrow && <>
            {(storedDraft || dirty) && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={discardDraft}>Discard draft</Button>}
            <Button size="sm" disabled={!dirty} onClick={() => saveDraft()}>Save draft</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant={isDraftView ? 'marker' : 'secondary'} disabled={!isDraftView} onClick={() => setPublishOpen(true)}>Publish v{nextVersion}</Button>
          </>}
        </>}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[12px] text-muted">
          <Badge tone="ink">{recordTypeLabel(work.recordType)}</Badge>
          <span>Owner <b className="text-ink">{s.roles.find((r) => r.id === work.ownerRole)?.name}</b></span>
          <span>·</span>
          {published ? <span>Published <b className="text-ink">v{published.version}</b> effective {fmtDate(published.effective)}</span> : <span>Not yet published</span>}
          {storedDraft && <Badge tone="info">Draft v{storedDraft.version} saved</Badge>}
          {dirty && <Badge tone="marker">Unsaved changes</Badge>}
          <span>·</span><span>{running.length} running instance{running.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
          {versions.length > 1 && (
            <label className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1.5">Version
              <Select aria-label="Version" className="h-7 w-auto py-0.5 text-[12px]" value={baseDef.id} onChange={(e) => setViewId(e.target.value)} options={versions.map((v) => ({ value: v.id, label: `v${v.version} · ${v.status}` }))} />
            </label>
          )}
        </div>
      </PageHeader>

      {!editable && <Callout tone="info" title={`Viewing v${baseDef.version} (${baseDef.status})`}>{baseDef.status === 'retired' ? 'Retired versions are read-only. Instances started on this version still finish on it.' : `Draft v${storedDraft?.version} holds the pending edits; published v${baseDef.version} is read-only.`} <button className="font-semibold text-link" onClick={() => setViewId(undefined)}>{storedDraft ? 'Open the draft' : 'Open the current version'}</button></Callout>}
      {editable && baseDef.status === 'published' && dirty && <Callout tone="marker" title={`Editing creates draft v${nextVersion}`}>v{baseDef.version} stays in force until you publish. The {running.length} request{running.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} in flight keep routing on v{baseDef.version}.</Callout>}

      <Tabs<Mode> value={mode} onChange={setMode} tabs={[
        ...(narrow ? [] : [{ id: 'design' as Mode, label: 'Design' }]),
        { id: 'test', label: 'Test routing' },
        { id: 'sop', label: 'Documentation (SOP)' },
        { id: 'versions', label: 'Versions & instances', count: running.length || undefined },
      ]} />
      {narrow && <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">The visual designer needs a larger screen. On a phone you can read the procedure, test routing and follow instances.</p>}

      {mode === 'design' && !narrow && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_340px]">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="flex min-w-0 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface">
              {/* palette */}
              {!readOnly && (
                <div className="flex w-[148px] shrink-0 flex-col gap-0.5 border-r border-line p-2">
                  <div className="eyebrow px-1 pb-1">Add step</div>
                  {NODE_TYPES.filter((t) => t.type !== 'start').map((t) => (
                    <button key={t.type} title={t.hint + (selNode ? ` — inserted after “${selNode.label}”` : '')} onClick={() => addNode(t.type)} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded px-1.5 py-1 text-left text-[12.5px] font-medium hover:bg-sunken">
                      <PaletteGlyph type={t.type} />{t.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                  <p className="mt-2 px-1 text-[11px] leading-snug text-faint">{selNode ? <>New steps go after <b className="text-muted">{selNode.label}</b> and are wired in.</> : 'Select a step first to insert after it.'}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-line px-2 py-1.5">
                  {!readOnly && <Button size="sm" variant={connect ? 'primary' : 'secondary'} onClick={() => setConnect(!connect)} title="Click a step, then another, to connect them">{connect ? 'Connecting — click two steps' : 'Connect'}</Button>}
                  {!readOnly && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={!sel} onClick={deleteSel}>Delete</Button>}
                  {!readOnly && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={!undo.current.length} onClick={doUndo} title="Undo (Ctrl+Z)">Undo</Button>}
                  {!readOnly && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" disabled={!redo.current.length} onClick={doRedo} title="Redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z)">Redo</Button>}
                  <span className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] text-muted">
                    <button className="rounded px-1.5 hover:bg-sunken" aria-label="Zoom out" onClick={() => setZoom((z) => Math.max(0.5, +(z - 0.1).toFixed(1)))}>−</button>
                    <button className="w-11 rounded tabular-nums hover:bg-sunken" onClick={() => setZoom(1)} title="Actual size">{Math.round(zoom * 100)}%</button>
                    <button className="rounded px-1.5 hover:bg-sunken" onClick={fit} title="Fit to width">Fit</button>
                    <button className="rounded px-1.5 hover:bg-sunken" aria-label="Zoom in" onClick={() => setZoom((z) => Math.min(1.6, +(z + 0.1).toFixed(1)))}>+</button>
                  </span>
                  <span className={cx('rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11.5px] font-semibold', errors.length ? 'bg-bad/10 text-bad' : 'bg-good/10 text-good')}>{errors.length ? `${errors.length} issue${errors.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} to fix` : 'Ready to publish'}</span>
                </div>
                <div ref={viewport} className="max-h-[600px] min-h-[420px] overflow-auto bg-ground/40">
                  <Canvas s={s} def={work} selected={sel} onSelect={(x) => { setSel(x) }} onMoveNode={moveNode} onMoveEnd={() => { moving.current = false }} onConnect={(a, b) => { connectNodes(a, b); setConnect(false) }} readOnly={readOnly} issues={issueNodes} connectMode={connect} zoom={zoom} active={liveAt} />
                </div>
                <Legend />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Panel pad={false} className="self-start">
            <Tabs<SideTab> className="px-2" value={side} onChange={setSide} tabs={[
              { id: 'selection', label: 'Properties' }, { id: 'process', label: 'Process' }, { id: 'fields', label: 'Form', count: work.fields.length }, { id: 'checks', label: 'Checks', count: errors.length || undefined },
            ]} />
            <div className="max-h-[640px] overflow-y-auto p-3">
              {side === 'selection' && (selNode ? <NodeProps s={s} def={work} n={selNode} onPatch={patchNode} onDelete={deleteSel} readOnly={readOnly} preview={preview} />
                : selEdge ? <EdgeProps s={s} def={work} e={selEdge} onPatch={patchEdge} onDelete={deleteSel} readOnly={readOnly} preview={preview} />
                : <p className="text-[13px] text-muted">Select a step or a connection on the canvas to edit it. Drag steps to move them; drag the blue handle on a selected step to another step to connect them.</p>)}
              {side === 'process' && <ProcessSettings s={s} def={work} readOnly={readOnly} onChange={(p) => change((d) => Object.assign(d, p))} />}
              {side === 'fields' && <FieldsEditor fields={work.fields} readOnly={readOnly} onChange={(f) => change((d) => { d.fields = f })} usedKeys={new Set([...work.edges.map((e) => e.condition?.field ?? ''), ...work.nodes.map((n) => (n.assignee?.kind === 'doa' ? n.assignee.field : ''))])} />}
              {side === 'checks' && <Checklist checks={checks} onPick={(c: Check) => { const nid = c.nodeIds?.[0]; if (nid) setSel({ kind: 'node', id: nid }); else if (c.edgeIds?.[0]) setSel({ kind: 'edge', id: c.edgeIds[0] }) }} />}
            </div>
            {side !== 'checks' && side !== 'selection' && <div className="border-t border-line px-3 py-2 text-[11.5px] text-faint">Test values for previews: <button className="font-semibold text-link" onClick={() => setMode('test')}>edit in Test routing</button></div>}
          </Panel>
        </div>
      )}

      {mode === 'test' && <TestMode s={s} def={work} preview={preview} setPreview={setPreview} />}
      {mode === 'sop' && <SopView s={s} def={work} onDownload={() => download('sop')} />}
      {mode === 'versions' && <VersionsPanel s={s} defKey={key} current={work} onOpen={(vid) => { setViewId(vid); setMode(narrow ? 'sop' : 'design') }} />}

      <PublishModal open={publishOpen} onClose={() => setPublishOpen(false)} s={s} work={work} published={published} checks={checks} nextVersion={nextVersion} running={running.length}
        onPublish={(effective, summary) => {
          const saved = saveDraft(true)
          if (!saved) return
          mutate((d) => {
            for (const x of d.workflowDefs) if (x.key === key && x.status === 'published') x.status = 'retired'
            const x = d.workflowDefs.find((y) => y.id === saved.id)!
            x.status = 'published'
            x.effective = effective
          }, { entity: 'workflow-def', entityId: key, action: 'publish', summary: `Published ${saved.name} v${saved.version}: ${summary}` })
          setViewId(undefined)
          setPublishOpen(false)
          toast(`${saved.name} v${saved.version} published — new requests route on it`)
        }} />
    </div>
  )
}

function PaletteGlyph({ type }: { type: WfNodeType }) {
  const c = tok(TYPE_COLOR[type])
  return (
    <svg width={18} height={14} viewBox="0 0 18 14" aria-hidden className="shrink-0">
      {type === 'condition' ? <polygon points="9,1 17,7 9,13 1,7" fill="none" stroke={c} strokeWidth={1.6} />
        : type === 'parallel-split' || type === 'parallel-join' ? <rect x={7} y={1} width={4} height={12} fill={c} />
        : type === 'end' ? <circle cx={9} cy={7} r={5.5} fill={c} />
        : type === 'notify' || type === 'system' ? <rect x={1} y={3} width={16} height={8} rx={4} fill="none" stroke={c} strokeWidth={1.6} strokeDasharray={type === 'system' ? '2 1.5' : undefined} />
        : <><rect x={1} y={2} width={16} height={10} rx={2} fill="none" stroke={tok('line')} strokeWidth={1.4} /><rect x={1} y={2} width={3} height={10} rx={1} fill={c} /></>}
    </svg>
  )
}

function Legend() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 border-t border-line px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted">
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><svg width="22" height="6"><line x1="0" y1="3" x2="22" y2="3" stroke={tok('faint')} strokeWidth="1.6" /></svg>Forward path</span>
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><svg width="22" height="6"><line x1="0" y1="3" x2="22" y2="3" stroke={tok('warn')} strokeWidth="1.6" strokeDasharray="5 3" /></svg>Return for revision</span>
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"><svg width="22" height="6"><line x1="0" y1="3" x2="22" y2="3" stroke={tok('bad')} strokeWidth="1.6" strokeDasharray="5 3" /></svg>Reject</span>
      <span>Drag to move · select a step and drag its <b className="text-link">+</b> handle to connect · Delete removes · Ctrl+Z undoes</span>
    </div>
  )
}

function NodeProps({ s, def, n, onPatch, onDelete, readOnly, preview }: { s: AppState; def: WorkflowDef; n: WfNode; onPatch: (p: Partial<WfNode>) => void; onDelete: () => void; readOnly: boolean; preview: Preview }) {
  const human = isHuman(n.type)
  const inbound = def.edges.filter((e) => e.to === n.id).length, outbound = def.edges.filter((e) => e.from === n.id).length
  return (
    <fieldset disabled={readOnly} className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><PaletteGlyph type={n.type} /><span className="eyebrow">{nodeTypeLabel(n.type)}</span><Mono className="ml-auto text-faint">{n.id}</Mono></div>
      <Field label="Step name"><Input id="wf-node-label" value={n.label} onChange={(e) => onPatch({ label: e.target.value })} /></Field>
      {human && (
        <Field label="Step type"><Select value={n.type} onChange={(e) => onPatch({ type: e.target.value as WfNodeType })} options={[{ value: 'form', label: 'Form — fill in and submit' }, { value: 'review', label: 'Review — approve forward or return' }, { value: 'approval', label: 'Approval — e-signed decision' }]} /></Field>
      )}
      {(human || n.type === 'notify') && <AssigneeEditor s={s} value={n.assignee} fields={def.fields} preview={preview} onChange={(a) => onPatch({ assignee: a })} />}
      {human && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <Field label="SLA (days)"><Input type="number" min={0} value={n.slaDays ?? ''} onChange={(e) => onPatch({ slaDays: e.target.value ? Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value)) : undefined })} /></Field>
          {n.type !== 'form' && <Field label="When several people" hint={n.rule === 'all' ? 'Every assignee must approve' : 'First to act decides'}><Select value={n.rule ?? 'any'} onChange={(e) => onPatch({ rule: e.target.value as 'any' | 'all' })} options={[{ value: 'any', label: 'Any one' }, { value: 'all', label: 'All must act' }]} /></Field>}
        </div>
      )}
      {n.type === 'system' && (
        <Field label="System action" hint={SYSTEM_ACTIONS.find((a) => a.id === n.systemAction)?.does}><Select value={n.systemAction ?? 'none'} onChange={(e) => onPatch({ systemAction: e.target.value as WfNode['systemAction'] })} options={SYSTEM_ACTIONS.map((a) => ({ value: a.id, label: a.label }))} /></Field>
      )}
      {n.type !== 'parallel-split' && n.type !== 'parallel-join' && <Field label="Instructions" hint="Shown to the assignee in My work, and in the SOP step table."><TextArea value={n.description ?? ''} onChange={(e) => onPatch({ description: e.target.value || undefined })} className="min-h-[60px]" /></Field>}
      <Field label="Swimlane override" hint="Leave blank to use the assignee as the lane."><Input value={n.lane ?? ''} onChange={(e) => onPatch({ lane: e.target.value || undefined })} placeholder="e.g. Field operations" /></Field>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-line pt-2 text-[12px] text-muted">
        <span>{inbound} in · {outbound} out</span>
        {!readOnly && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={onDelete}>Delete step</Button>}
      </div>
    </fieldset>
  )
}

function EdgeProps({ s, def, e, onPatch, onDelete, readOnly, preview }: { s: AppState; def: WorkflowDef; e: WfEdge; onPatch: (p: Partial<WfEdge>) => void; onDelete: () => void; readOnly: boolean; preview: Preview }) {
  const a = def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.from), b = def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.to)
  const fromHuman = a && isHuman(a.type) && a.type !== 'form'
  return (
    <fieldset disabled={readOnly} className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
      <div className="eyebrow">Connection</div>
      <div className="rounded border border-line bg-sunken/60 px-2.5 py-2 text-[13px]"><b>{a?.label}</b> <span className="text-faint">→</span> <b>{b?.label}</b></div>
      {fromHuman && (
        <Field label="Followed when the assignee chooses" hint="Approve moves forward; Return sends back for revision; Reject ends the process.">
          <Select id="wf-edge-outcome" value={e.outcome ?? 'approve'} onChange={(ev) => onPatch({ outcome: ev.target.value as WfEdge['outcome'], label: ev.target.value === 'return' ? (e.label || 'Return') : ev.target.value === 'reject' ? (e.label || 'Reject') : e.label === 'Return' || e.label === 'Reject' ? undefined : e.label })} options={[{ value: 'approve', label: 'Approve / submit' }, { value: 'return', label: 'Return for revision' }, { value: 'reject', label: 'Reject' }]} />
        </Field>
      )}
      {a?.type === 'condition' && <ConditionEditor s={s} def={def} edge={e} preview={preview} onChange={(c) => onPatch({ condition: c })} />}
      <Field label="Label on the diagram"><Input value={e.label ?? ''} onChange={(ev) => onPatch({ label: ev.target.value || undefined })} placeholder={a?.type === 'condition' ? 'Yes / No / Over $5M' : 'Optional'} /></Field>
      {!readOnly && <div className="flex justify-end border-t border-line pt-2"><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-bad" onClick={onDelete}>Delete connection</Button></div>}
    </fieldset>
  )
}

function PublishModal({ open, onClose, s, work, published, checks, nextVersion, running, onPublish }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; s: AppState; work: WorkflowDef; published?: WorkflowDef; checks: Check[]; nextVersion: number; running: number; onPublish: (effective: string, summary: string) => void }) {
  const [effective, setEffective] = useState(s.settings.asOf)
  const auto = useMemo(() => diffDefs(s, published, work), [s, published, work])
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState(auto)
  useEffect(() => { if (open) { setSummary(auto); setEffective(s.settings.asOf) } }, [open]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  const errs = blockingErrors(checks)
  return (
    <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title={`Publish ${work.name} v${nextVersion}`}
      footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" disabled={!!errs.length || !summary.trim()} onClick={() => onPublish(effective, summary.trim())}>Publish v{nextVersion}</Button></>}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <Checklist checks={checks} />
        {errs.length > 0 && <Callout tone="bad">Fix the {errs.length} item{errs.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} above before publishing.</Callout>}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Field label="Effective date"><Input type="date" value={effective} onChange={(e) => setEffective(e.target.value)} /></Field>
          <div className="text-[12px] text-muted sm:pt-5">{published ? <>v{published.version} will be retired. {running ? `${running} in-flight request${running > 1 ? 's' : ''} keep routing on v${published.version}.` : 'No requests are in flight.'}</> : 'This is the first published version.'}</div>
        </div>
        <Field label="What changed (revision history)"><TextArea value={summary} onChange={(e) => setSummary(e.target.value)} /></Field>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/workflows/editors.tsx =====
// Property editors used by the designer: assignee, condition, form fields, process settings, validation checklist.
import type { AppState, Assignee, Condition, ConditionOp, FormField, RoleId, TeamPosition, WfEdge, WorkflowDef } from '@/core/types'
import { resolveAssignees } from '@/core/engine/workflow'
import { cx, describeCondition, evalCondition } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Checkbox, Field, Input, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { PROJECT_PATHS, RECORD_TYPES, TEAM_POSITIONS, conditionValueText, parseConditionValue, previewInstance, type Check } from './lib'

export interface Preview { projectId?: string; requesterId: string; data: Record<string, unknown> }

const KINDS: { value: Assignee['kind']; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'team-position', label: 'Position on the project team' },
  { value: 'role', label: 'Anyone holding a role' },
  { value: 'doa', label: 'Approver by dollar authority (DOA)' },
  { value: 'person', label: 'A named person' },
  { value: 'requester', label: 'The requester' },
  { value: 'manager-of-requester', label: "The requester's manager" },
]

export function AssigneeEditor({ s, value, onChange, fields, preview }: { s: AppState; value?: Assignee; onChange: (a: Assignee | undefined) => void; fields: FormField[]; preview: Preview }) {
  const kind = value?.kind ?? ''
  const moneyFields = fields.filter((f) => f.type === 'money' || f.type === 'number')
  const setKind = (k: string) => {
    switch (k) {
      case 'role': return onChange({ kind: 'role', roleId: 'pmo' })
      case 'team-position': return onChange({ kind: 'team-position', position: 'pm' })
      case 'person': return onChange({ kind: 'person', personId: s.people.find((p) => !p.company)?.id ?? s.people[0].id })
      case 'doa': return onChange({ kind: 'doa', field: moneyFields[0]?.key ?? 'amount' })
      case 'requester': return onChange({ kind: 'requester' })
      case 'manager-of-requester': return onChange({ kind: 'manager-of-requester' })
      default: return onChange(undefined)
    }
  }
  const project = s.projects.find((p) => p.id === preview.projectId)
  const resolved = value ? resolveAssignees(s, previewInstance({ id: 'p', key: 'p', version: 0 } as WorkflowDef, preview.projectId, preview.requesterId, preview.data), value) : []
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Field label="Assigned to">
        <Select id="wf-assignee-kind" value={kind} onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value)} options={[{ value: '', label: '— Not assigned —' }, ...KINDS]} />
      </Field>
      {value?.kind === 'role' && (
        <Field label="Role"><Select value={value.roleId} onChange={(e) => onChange({ kind: 'role', roleId: e.target.value as RoleId })} options={s.roles.map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: `${r.name} (${s.people.filter((p) => p.roles.includes(r.id)).length})` }))} /></Field>
      )}
      {value?.kind === 'team-position' && (
        <Field label="Team position" hint="Resolved from each project's team roster.">
          <Select value={value.position} onChange={(e) => onChange({ kind: 'team-position', position: e.target.value as TeamPosition })} options={TEAM_POSITIONS.map((t) => ({ value: t.id, label: t.label }))} />
        </Field>
      )}
      {value?.kind === 'person' && (
        <Field label="Person"><Select value={value.personId} onChange={(e) => onChange({ kind: 'person', personId: e.target.value })} options={s.people.map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: `${p.name} · ${p.title}` }))} /></Field>
      )}
      {value?.kind === 'doa' && (
        <Field label="Amount field" hint="The DOA matrix picks the approver whose limit first covers this amount.">
          <Select value={value.field} onChange={(e) => onChange({ kind: 'doa', field: e.target.value })} options={moneyFields.length ? moneyFields.map((f) => ({ value: f.key, label: `${f.label} (${f.key})` })) : [{ value: value.field, label: `${value.field} — add a money field` }]} />
        </Field>
      )}
      {value && (
        <div className="rounded border border-line bg-sunken/60 px-2.5 py-2 text-[12px]">
          <div className="text-faint">Resolves to on {project ? <b className="font-mono text-ink">{project.code}</b> : 'no project'} with the test values</div>
          <div className="mt-0.5 font-semibold">{resolved.length ? resolved.map((id) => s.people.find((p) => p.id === id)?.name).join(', ') : <span className="text-bad">Nobody — this step would be skipped</span>}</div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

const OPS: { value: ConditionOp; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'gt', label: 'greater than' }, { value: 'gte', label: 'at least' }, { value: 'lt', label: 'less than' }, { value: 'lte', label: 'at most' },
  { value: 'eq', label: 'equals' }, { value: 'ne', label: 'does not equal' }, { value: 'in', label: 'is one of' }, { value: 'truthy', label: 'is yes / set' }, { value: 'falsy', label: 'is no / empty' },
]

export function ConditionEditor({ s, edge, def, onChange, preview }: { s: AppState; edge: WfEdge; def: WorkflowDef; onChange: (c: Condition | undefined) => void; preview: Preview }) {
  const c = edge.condition
  const fieldOpts = [
    ...def.fields.map((f) => ({ value: f.key, label: `Form · ${f.label}` })),
    ...PROJECT_PATHS.map((p) => ({ value: p.path, label: p.label })),
  ]
  if (c && !fieldOpts.some((o) => o.value === c.field)) fieldOpts.unshift({ value: c.field, label: c.field })
  const formField = c && def.fields.find((f) => f.key === c.field)
  const ctx = { ...preview.data, project: s.projects.find((p) => p.id === preview.projectId) }
  const others = def.edges.filter((e) => e.from === edge.from && e.id !== edge.id)
  const hasOtherDefault = others.some((e) => !e.condition)
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <div className="flex gap-1">
        <button className={cx('flex-1 rounded border px-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-semibold', !c ? 'border-ink bg-ink text-surface' : 'border-line text-muted hover:text-ink')} onClick={() => onChange(undefined)}>Default path</button>
        <button className={cx('flex-1 rounded border px-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-semibold', c ? 'border-ink bg-ink text-surface' : 'border-line text-muted hover:text-ink')} onClick={() => onChange(c ?? { field: def.fields.find((f) => f.type === 'money' || f.type === 'number')?.key ?? fieldOpts[0]?.value ?? 'amount', op: 'gt', value: 0 })}>Rule</button>
      </div>
      {!c && <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">Taken when no rule on the other paths matches.{hasOtherDefault && <span className="text-bad"> Another path from this decision is already the default — a decision needs exactly one.</span>}</p>}
      {c && (
        <>
          <Field label="When"><Select id="wf-cond-field" value={c.field} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...c, field: e.target.value })} options={fieldOpts} /></Field>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <Field label="Operator"><Select value={c.op} onChange={(e) => { const op = e.target.value as ConditionOp; onChange({ ...c, op, value: op === 'truthy' || op === 'falsy' ? undefined : parseConditionValue(conditionValueText(c), op) }) }} options={OPS} /></Field>
            {c.op !== 'truthy' && c.op !== 'falsy' && (
              <Field label={c.op === 'in' ? 'Values (comma separated)' : 'Value'}>
                {formField?.type === 'select' && c.op !== 'in' ? (
                  <Select value={conditionValueText(c)} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...c, value: parseConditionValue(e.target.value, c.op) })} options={(formField.options ?? []).filter(Boolean)} />
                ) : (
                  <Input value={conditionValueText(c)} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...c, value: parseConditionValue(e.target.value, c.op) })} />
                )}
              </Field>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="rounded border border-line bg-sunken/60 px-2.5 py-2 text-[12px]">
            <div className="font-mono text-[11.5px]">{describeCondition(c)}</div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-faint">With the test values: {evalCondition(c, ctx) ? <Badge tone="good">true — takes this path</Badge> : <Badge>false</Badge>}</div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export function FieldsEditor({ fields, onChange, readOnly, usedKeys }: { fields: FormField[]; onChange: (f: FormField[]) => void; readOnly?: boolean; usedKeys: Set<string> }) {
  const set = (i: number, patch: Partial<FormField>) => onChange(fields.map((f, j) => (j === i ? { ...f, ...patch } : f)))
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      {fields.length === 0 && <p className="text-[12px] text-muted">No form fields. Add the values requesters enter — routing rules and dollar authority read them.</p>}
      {fields.map((f, i) => (
        <div key={i} className="rounded border border-line p-2">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_110px] gap-1.5">
            <Input aria-label="Field label" value={f.label} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => set(i, { label: e.target.value })} className="h-7 py-0.5" />
            <Select aria-label="Field type" value={f.type} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => set(i, { type: e.target.value as FormField['type'] })} className="h-7 py-0.5" options={['text', 'textarea', 'money', 'number', 'date', 'select', 'boolean']} />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Input aria-label="Field key" value={f.key} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => set(i, { key: e.target.value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g, '') })} className="h-7 w-[130px] py-0.5 font-mono text-[12px]" />
            <Checkbox checked={!!f.required} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(v) => set(i, { required: v })} label={<span className="text-[12px]">Required</span>} />
            {usedKeys.has(f.key) && <Badge tone="info" title="Used by a routing rule or dollar-authority step">routes</Badge>}
            {!readOnly && <button className="ml-auto text-[12px] font-semibold text-bad hover:underline" onClick={() => onChange(fields.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}>Remove</button>}
          </div>
          {f.type === 'select' && <Input aria-label="Options" className="mt-1.5 h-7 py-0.5 text-[12px]" placeholder="Options, comma separated" disabled={readOnly} value={(f.options ?? []).join(', ')} onChange={(e) => set(i, { options: e.target.value.split(',').map((x) => x.trim()) })} />}
        </div>
      ))}
      {!readOnly && <Button size="sm" onClick={() => onChange([...fields, { key: `field${fields.length + 1}`, label: 'New field', type: 'text' }])}>Add field</Button>}
    </div>
  )
}

export function ProcessSettings({ s, def, onChange, readOnly }: { s: AppState; def: WorkflowDef; onChange: (p: Partial<WorkflowDef>) => void; readOnly?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
      <Field label="Process name"><Input id="wf-name" value={def.name} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => onChange({ name: e.target.value })} /></Field>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <Field label="Record type"><Select value={def.recordType} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => onChange({ recordType: e.target.value as WorkflowDef['recordType'] })} options={RECORD_TYPES.map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: r.label }))} /></Field>
        <Field label="Process owner"><Select value={def.ownerRole} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ownerRole: e.target.value as RoleId })} options={s.roles.map((r) => ({ value: r.id, label: r.name }))} /></Field>
      </div>
      <Field label="Description" hint="Shown in the catalog and the SOP scope."><TextArea value={def.description} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => onChange({ description: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[60px]" /></Field>
      <Field label="Purpose" hint="Why the control exists — the first section of the SOP."><TextArea value={def.purpose} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => onChange({ purpose: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[60px]" /></Field>
    </div>
  )
}

export function Checklist({ checks, onPick }: { checks: Check[]; onPick?: (c: Check) => void }) {
  return (
    <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      {checks.map((c) => (
        <li key={c.id}>
          <button disabled={c.ok || !onPick} onClick={() => onPick?.(c)} className={cx('flex w-full items-start gap-2 rounded px-1.5 py-1 text-left text-[12.5px]', !c.ok && onPick && 'hover:bg-sunken')}>
            <span className={cx('mt-0.5 flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-surface', c.ok ? 'bg-good' : c.level === 'error' ? 'bg-bad' : 'bg-warn')}>{c.ok ? '✓' : c.level === 'error' ? '✕' : '!'}</span>
            <span className="min-w-0"><span className={cx(c.ok ? 'text-muted' : 'font-semibold')}>{c.label}</span>{!c.ok && c.detail && <span className="block text-[11.5px] text-muted">{c.detail}</span>}</span>
          </button>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/workflows/hooks.ts =====
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

/** True when the viewport is narrower than `px` (phones / small tablets). */
export function useNarrow(px = 768): boolean {
  const q = `(max-width: ${px - 1}px)`
  const get = () => (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia(q).matches : false)
  const [v, setV] = useState(get)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!window.matchMedia) return
    const m = window.matchMedia(q)
    const f = () => setV(m.matches)
    f()
    m.addEventListener?.('change', f)
    return () => m.removeEventListener?.('change', f)
  }, [q])
  return v
}
