export function describeAssignee(s: Pick<AppState, 'roles' | 'people'>, a: Assignee | undefined, fields: FormField[] = []): string {
  if (!a) return 'Unassigned'
  switch (a.kind) {
    case 'role': return s.roles.find((r) => r.id === a.roleId)?.name ?? a.roleId
    case 'person': return s.people.find((p) => p.id === a.personId)?.name ?? 'Named person'
    case 'team-position': return `Project's ${teamLabel(a.position)}`
    case 'requester': return 'Requester'
    case 'manager-of-requester': return "Requester's manager"
    case 'doa': return `Dollar authority on ${fields.find((f) => f.key === a.field)?.label ?? a.field}`
  }
}

/** Swimlane label with sensible placement for non-human nodes. */
export function laneFor(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef, n: WfNode): string {
  if (n.lane) return n.lane
  if (n.assignee) return laneOf(s, n)
  if (n.type === 'start') {
    const first = def.edges.find((e) => e.from === n.id)
    const t = first && def.nodes.find((x) => x.id === first.to)
    if (t?.assignee) return laneOf(s, t)
  }
  if (n.type === 'condition' || n.type === 'parallel-split' || n.type === 'parallel-join') {
    const into = def.edges.find((e) => e.to === n.id && !e.outcome?.match(/return|reject/))
    const p = into && def.nodes.find((x) => x.id === into.from)
    if (p && p.id !== n.id) return laneFor(s, def, p)
  }
  return 'System'
}

export function lanesOf(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  for (const n of def.nodes.slice().sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x || a.y - b.y)) {
    const l = laneFor(s, def, n)
    if (l !== 'System' && !out.includes(l)) out.push(l)
  }
  if (def.nodes.some((n) => laneFor(s, def, n) === 'System')) out.push('System')
  return out
}

export function edgeOutcomeLabel(e: WfEdge): string {
  if (e.condition) return e.label || describeCondition(e.condition)
  if (e.label) return e.label
  switch (e.outcome) {
    case 'approve': return 'Approve'
    case 'return': return 'Return'
    case 'reject': return 'Reject'
    default: return ''
  }
}

export function outcomePaths(def: WorkflowDef, n: WfNode): string {
  const name = (id: string) => def.nodes.find((x) => x.id === id)?.label ?? '?'
  const out = def.edges.filter((e) => e.from === n.id)
  if (n.type === 'end') return 'Process completes; the requester is notified of the outcome.'
  if (!out.length) return '—'
  if (n.type === 'condition') {
    const conds = out.filter((e) => e.condition).map((e) => `If ${describeCondition(e.condition)} → ${name(e.to)}`)
    const def0 = out.find((e) => !e.condition)
    return [...conds, def0 ? `Otherwise → ${name(def0.to)}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join('; ')
  }
  if (n.type === 'parallel-split') return `In parallel → ${out.map((e) => name(e.to)).join(' + ')}`
  const parts = out.map((e) => `${e.outcome === 'return' ? 'Return' : e.outcome === 'reject' ? 'Reject' : n.type === 'form' ? 'Submit' : isHuman(n.type) ? 'Approve' : 'Then'} → ${name(e.to)}`)
  if (n.type === 'approval' && !out.some((e) => e.outcome === 'reject')) parts.push('Reject → process ends as rejected')
  if (isHuman(n.type) && n.type !== 'form' && !out.some((e) => e.outcome === 'return')) parts.push('Return → process ends as returned')
  return parts.join('; ')
}

export function stepDuty(def: WorkflowDef, n: WfNode): string {
  if (n.description) return n.description
  const rec = recordTypeLabel(def.recordType).toLowerCase()
  switch (n.type) {
    case 'start': return `A ${rec} is submitted into the process.`
    case 'form': return `Completes the ${def.fields.length ? def.fields.map((f) => f.label.toLowerCase()).join(', ') : 'request'} and submits.`
    case 'review': return `Reviews the ${rec} and either approves it forward or returns it with comments.`
    case 'approval': return `Decides on the ${rec} and e-signs: approve, return for revision, or reject.`
    case 'condition': return `Routes automatically: ${outcomePaths(def, n)}.`
    case 'parallel-split': return 'Starts the following steps at the same time.'
    case 'parallel-join': return 'Waits until every parallel branch is complete.'
    case 'notify': return 'Sends a notification and continues without waiting.'
    case 'system': return SYSTEM_ACTIONS.find((a) => a.id === n.systemAction)?.does ?? 'Crosswalk performs an automatic action.'
    case 'end': return 'The outcome is applied to the record and the requester is notified.'
  }
}

/** Nodes in reading order (breadth-first from start, forward edges only, then by x). */
export function orderedNodes(def: WorkflowDef): WfNode[] {
  const start = def.nodes.find((n) => n.type === 'start')
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  const out: WfNode[] = []
  if (start) {
    const q = [start.id]
    while (q.length) {
      const id = q.shift()!
      if (seen.has(id)) continue
      seen.add(id)
      const n = def.nodes.find((x) => x.id === id)
      if (!n) continue
      out.push(n)
      def.edges.filter((e) => e.from === id && e.outcome !== 'return' && e.outcome !== 'reject').map((e) => def.nodes.find((x) => x.id === e.to)).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => a!.x - b!.x || a!.y - b!.y).forEach((t) => q.push(t!.id))
    }
  }
  const rest = def.nodes.filter((n) => !seen.has(n.id)).sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x)
  const all = [...out, ...rest]
  // keep end nodes last
  return [...all.filter((n) => n.type !== 'end'), ...all.filter((n) => n.type === 'end')]
}

// ───────────────────────────── Validation (WF-08 publish checklist)
export interface Check { id: string; ok: boolean; level: 'error' | 'warn'; label: string; detail?: string; nodeIds?: string[]; edgeIds?: string[] }

export function reachable(def: WorkflowDef, fromId: string, dir: 'fwd' | 'back' = 'fwd'): Set<string> {
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  const q = [fromId]
  while (q.length) {
    const id = q.pop()!
    if (seen.has(id)) continue
    seen.add(id)
    for (const e of def.edges) {
      if (dir === 'fwd' && e.from === id) q.push(e.to)
      if (dir === 'back' && e.to === id) q.push(e.from)
    }
  }
  return seen
}

export function validate(def: WorkflowDef): Check[] {
  const out: Check[] = []
  const starts = def.nodes.filter((n) => n.type === 'start')
  const ends = def.nodes.filter((n) => n.type === 'end')
  out.push({ id: 'start', ok: starts.length === 1, level: 'error', label: 'Exactly one start', detail: starts.length === 0 ? 'Add a Start node.' : starts.length > 1 ? `${starts.length} start nodes — keep one.` : undefined, nodeIds: starts.length > 1 ? starts.map((n) => n.id) : undefined })
  out.push({ id: 'end', ok: ends.length >= 1, level: 'error', label: 'At least one end', detail: ends.length ? undefined : 'Add an End node so the process can complete.' })
  const ids = new Set(def.nodes.map((n) => n.id))
  const dangling = def.edges.filter((e) => !ids.has(e.from) || !ids.has(e.to))
  out.push({ id: 'edges', ok: !dangling.length, level: 'error', label: 'Every connection has both ends', detail: dangling.length ? `${dangling.length} broken connection(s).` : undefined, edgeIds: dangling.map((e) => e.id) })
  if (starts[0]) {
    const r = reachable(def, starts[0].id)
    const unreachable = def.nodes.filter((n) => !r.has(n.id))
    out.push({ id: 'reach', ok: !unreachable.length, level: 'error', label: 'Every step is reachable from start', detail: unreachable.length ? `Not reachable: ${unreachable.map((n) => n.label).join(', ')}` : undefined, nodeIds: unreachable.map((n) => n.id) })
    const deadEnds = def.nodes.filter((n) => n.type !== 'end' && r.has(n.id) && !ends.some((e) => reachable(def, n.id).has(e.id)))
    out.push({ id: 'finish', ok: !deadEnds.length, level: 'error', label: 'Every step can reach an end', detail: deadEnds.length ? `Dead ends: ${deadEnds.map((n) => n.label).join(', ')}` : undefined, nodeIds: deadEnds.map((n) => n.id) })
  }
  const noAssignee = def.nodes.filter((n) => isHuman(n.type) && !n.assignee)
  out.push({ id: 'assignee', ok: !noAssignee.length, level: 'error', label: 'Forms, reviews and approvals have assignees', detail: noAssignee.length ? `Missing: ${noAssignee.map((n) => n.label).join(', ')}` : undefined, nodeIds: noAssignee.map((n) => n.id) })
  const badDoa = def.nodes.filter((n) => n.assignee?.kind === 'doa' && !def.fields.some((f) => f.key === (n.assignee as { field: string }).field && (f.type === 'money' || f.type === 'number')))
  out.push({ id: 'doa', ok: !badDoa.length, level: 'error', label: 'Dollar-authority steps read a money field', detail: badDoa.length ? `Add the amount field or pick another: ${badDoa.map((n) => n.label).join(', ')}` : undefined, nodeIds: badDoa.map((n) => n.id) })
  const conds = def.nodes.filter((n) => n.type === 'condition')
  const badCond = conds.filter((n) => { const o = def.edges.filter((e) => e.from === n.id); return o.length < 2 || o.filter((e) => !e.condition).length !== 1 })
  out.push({ id: 'cond', ok: !badCond.length, level: 'error', label: 'Decisions have a rule and exactly one default path', detail: badCond.length ? `Fix: ${badCond.map((n) => n.label).join(', ')}` : undefined, nodeIds: badCond.map((n) => n.id) })
  const noForward = def.nodes.filter((n) => n.type !== 'end' && !def.edges.some((e) => e.from === n.id && e.outcome !== 'return' && e.outcome !== 'reject'))
  out.push({ id: 'forward', ok: !noForward.length, level: 'error', label: 'Every step has a way forward', detail: noForward.length ? `No forward path: ${noForward.map((n) => n.label).join(', ')}` : undefined, nodeIds: noForward.map((n) => n.id) })
  const badSplit = def.nodes.filter((n) => (n.type === 'parallel-split' && def.edges.filter((e) => e.from === n.id).length < 2) || (n.type === 'parallel-join' && def.edges.filter((e) => e.to === n.id).length < 2))
  out.push({ id: 'parallel', ok: !badSplit.length, level: 'error', label: 'Parallel splits and joins have two or more branches', detail: badSplit.length ? `Fix: ${badSplit.map((n) => n.label).join(', ')}` : undefined, nodeIds: badSplit.map((n) => n.id) })
  const noSla = def.nodes.filter((n) => isHuman(n.type) && !n.slaDays)
  out.push({ id: 'sla', ok: !noSla.length, level: 'warn', label: 'Human steps have an SLA', detail: noSla.length ? `No SLA: ${noSla.map((n) => n.label).join(', ')}` : undefined, nodeIds: noSla.map((n) => n.id) })
  const approvals = def.nodes.filter((n) => n.type === 'approval')
  out.push({ id: 'approval', ok: approvals.length > 0, level: 'warn', label: 'At least one e-signed approval', detail: approvals.length ? undefined : 'Without an approval step nobody signs the outcome.' })
  out.push({ id: 'purpose', ok: !!def.purpose.trim() && !!def.name.trim(), level: 'warn', label: 'Name and purpose filled in (used in the SOP)' })
  return out
}
export const blockingErrors = (c: Check[]) => c.filter((x) => !x.ok && x.level === 'error')

export const slugify = (t: string) => t.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 40)

// ───────────────────────────── Test mode trace (WF-09)
export interface TraceStep { node: WfNode; kind: 'human' | 'auto'; via?: string; people: Person[]; delegatedFrom: { from: Person; to: Person }[]; note?: string }

/** Walk the route a request would take, resolving real people (with DOA tiers and out-of-office delegation). */
export function trace(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef, data: Record<string, unknown>, projectId?: string, startedById?: string): TraceStep[] {
  const fake: WorkflowInstance = { id: 'sim', defId: def.id, defKey: def.key, defVersion: def.version, title: 'Simulation', recordType: def.recordType, recordId: 'sim', projectId, status: 'running', active: [], startedAt: '', startedById: startedById ?? s.currentUserId, data, history: [] }
  const noOoo: AppState = { ...s, people: s.people.map((p) => ({ ...p, outOfOffice: undefined })) }
  const project = projectId ? s.projects.find((p) => p.id === projectId) : undefined
  const ctx = { ...data, project }
  const out: TraceStep[] = []
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  const person = (id: string) => s.people.find((p) => p.id === id)
  const walk = (id: string, via: string | undefined, depth: number) => {
    if (depth > 60) return
    const n = def.nodes.find((x) => x.id === id)
    if (!n || seen.has(id)) return
    seen.add(id)
    const edges = def.edges.filter((e) => e.from === id)
    if (isHuman(n.type) || n.type === 'notify') {
      const ids = resolveAssignees(s, fake, n.assignee)
      const raw = resolveAssignees(noOoo, fake, n.assignee)
      const delegatedFrom = raw.filter((r) => !ids.includes(r)).map((r) => { const p = person(r)!; const to = person(p.outOfOffice?.delegateId ?? '')!; return { from: p, to } }).filter((x) => x.from && x.to)
      let note: string | undefined
      if (n.assignee?.kind === 'doa') {
        const field = (n.assignee as { field: string }).field
        const amt = Math.abs(Number(data[field] ?? 0))
        const role = doaRoleFor(s, fake, amt)
        const m = doaMatrixFor(s, projectId)
        const row = m?.rows.slice().sort((a, b) => a.upTo - b.upTo).find((r) => amt <= r.upTo)
        note = `${money(amt)} falls in the “${row?.label ?? role}” tier${row && row.upTo < 1e12 ? ` (up to ${money(row.upTo)})` : ''} of ${m?.name ?? 'the DOA matrix'} v${m?.version ?? '?'} → ${s.roles.find((r) => r.id === role)?.name ?? role}`
      }
      if (!ids.length) note = (note ? note + '. ' : '') + 'No one resolves — the engine would skip this step. Pick a project or fix the assignee.'
      out.push({ node: n, kind: 'human', via, people: ids.map(person).filter(Boolean) as Person[], delegatedFrom, note: note ?? (n.rule === 'all' && ids.length > 1 ? 'All must approve' : ids.length > 1 ? 'Any one may act' : undefined) })
    } else out.push({ node: n, kind: 'auto', via, people: [], delegatedFrom: [] })
    if (n.type === 'condition') {
      const hit = edges.find((e) => e.condition && evalCondition(e.condition, ctx)) ?? edges.find((e) => !e.condition)
      if (hit) { out[out.length - 1].note = `${hit.condition ? describeCondition(hit.condition) + ' → true' : 'No rule matched → default path'}: ${hit.label || 'continue'}`; walk(hit.to, hit.label, depth + 1) }
      else out[out.length - 1].note = 'No path matches and there is no default.'
    } else if (n.type === 'parallel-split') edges.forEach((e) => walk(e.to, 'parallel', depth + 1))
    else if (n.type === 'parallel-join') {
      const e = edges[0]
      if (e) { seen.delete(n.id); if (def.edges.filter((x) => x.to === n.id).every((x) => seen.has(x.from))) { seen.add(n.id); walk(e.to, undefined, depth + 1) } else { out.pop() } }
    } else {
      const e = edges.find((e) => !e.outcome || e.outcome === 'approve' || e.outcome === 'default')
      if (e) walk(e.to, e.label, depth + 1)
    }
  }
  const st = def.nodes.find((n) => n.type === 'start')
  if (st) walk(st.id, undefined, 0)
  return out
}

export function doaMatrixFor(s: AppState, projectId?: string): DoaMatrix | undefined {
  const p = projectId ? s.projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId) : undefined
  const prog = p ? s.programs.find((x) => x.id === p.programId) : undefined
  return s.doaMatrices.find((m) => m.id === prog?.doaMatrixId) ?? s.doaMatrices[0]
}

// ───────────────────────────── Analytics (WF-12)
const H = 36e5
export function nowMs(s: AppState): number { return Math.max(Date.now(), Date.parse(s.settings.asOf + 'T23:59:59Z')) }
export function fmtDur(hours: number | undefined): string {
  if (hours == null || !isFinite(hours)) return '—'
  if (hours < 1) return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(hours * 60))} min`
  if (hours < 48) return `${hours.toFixed(hours < 10 ? 1 : 0)} h`
  return `${(hours / 24).toFixed(hours < 240 ? 1 : 0)} d`
}

export interface StepStat { nodeId: string; label: string; type: WfNodeType; n: number; avgH: number; maxH: number; slaDays?: number; breaches: number; runningNow: number; returns: number; oldestRunningH: number }
export interface ProcessStat {
  key: string; name: string; total: number; completed: number; running: number; approved: number; rejected: number; returnedOut: number
  avgCycleH?: number; medianCycleH?: number; p90CycleH?: number; returnRate: number; slaBreaches: number; overdueNow: number
  steps: StepStat[]; bottleneck?: StepStat; cycles: number[]
}

const ACTIONS = new Set(['approve', 'reject', 'return', 'submit'])

/** Per-step elapsed hours for one instance: each actor decision measured from when its step was entered. */
export function stepDurations(def: WorkflowDef | undefined, inst: WorkflowInstance): { nodeId: string; hours: number; action: string }[] {
  const hist = inst.history.slice().sort((a, b) => a.at.localeCompare(b.at))
  const out: { nodeId: string; hours: number; action: string }[] = []
  const preds = (id: string, depth = 0): string[] => {
    if (!def || depth > 6) return []
    const direct = def.edges.filter((e) => e.to === id).map((e) => e.from)
    return direct.flatMap((p) => { const n = def.nodes.find((x) => x.id === p); return n && (n.type === 'parallel-split' || n.type === 'parallel-join') ? [p, ...preds(p, depth + 1)] : [p] })
  }
  const acted = new Set<string>()
  hist.forEach((h, i) => {
    if (!ACTIONS.has(h.action)) return
    const key = h.nodeId + '|' + h.actorId
    if (acted.has(key) && h.action === 'approve') return
    acted.add(key)
    const p = new Set(preds(h.nodeId))
    let enter: string | undefined
    for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const e = hist[j]
      if (p.has(e.nodeId) && (ACTIONS.has(e.action) || e.action === 'system' || e.action === 'start')) { enter = e.at; break }
    }
    enter ??= hist[i - 1]?.at ?? inst.startedAt
    out.push({ nodeId: h.nodeId, hours: Math.max(0, (Date.parse(h.at) - Date.parse(enter)) / H), action: h.action })
  })
  return out
}

function quantile(xs: number[], q: number) { if (!xs.length) return undefined; const a = xs.slice().sort((x, y) => x - y); return a[Math.min(a.length - 1, Math.floor(q * (a.length - 1) + 0.5))] }

export function processStats(s: AppState, key: string): ProcessStat {
  const versions = versionsOf(s, key)
  const latest = versions.find((d) => d.status === 'published') ?? versions[0]
  const insts = s.workflows.filter((w) => w.defKey === key)
  const done = insts.filter((w) => w.status !== 'running' && w.completedAt)
  const cycles = done.map((w) => (Date.parse(w.completedAt!) - Date.parse(w.startedAt)) / H)
  const now = nowMs(s)
  const steps = new Map<string, StepStat>()
  const stat = (def: WorkflowDef | undefined, nodeId: string) => {
    let x = steps.get(nodeId)
    if (!x) {
      const n = latest?.nodes.find((y) => y.id === nodeId) ?? def?.nodes.find((y) => y.id === nodeId)
      x = { nodeId, label: n?.label ?? nodeId, type: n?.type ?? 'review', n: 0, avgH: 0, maxH: 0, slaDays: n?.slaDays, breaches: 0, runningNow: 0, returns: 0, oldestRunningH: 0 }
      steps.set(nodeId, x)
    }
    return x
  }
  let slaBreaches = 0
  for (const w of insts) {
    const def = s.workflowDefs.find((d) => d.id === w.defId)
    for (const d of stepDurations(def, w)) {
      const node = def?.nodes.find((n) => n.id === d.nodeId)
      if (!node || !isHuman(node.type)) continue
      const x = stat(def, d.nodeId)
      x.avgH = (x.avgH * x.n + d.hours) / (x.n + 1)
      x.n++
      x.maxH = Math.max(x.maxH, d.hours)
      if (d.action === 'return') x.returns++
      if (node.slaDays && d.hours > node.slaDays * 24) { x.breaches++; slaBreaches++ }
    }
    for (const a of w.status === 'running' ? w.active : []) {
      const x = stat(def, a.nodeId)
      x.runningNow++
      x.oldestRunningH = Math.max(x.oldestRunningH, (now - Date.parse(a.since)) / H)
    }
  }
  const overdueNow = insts.filter((w) => w.status === 'running').reduce((a, w) => a + w.active.filter((x) => x.due && x.due < s.settings.asOf).length, 0)
  const order = latest ? orderedNodes(latest).map((n) => n.id) : []
  const list = [...steps.values()].sort((a, b) => (order.indexOf(a.nodeId) + 1 || 99) - (order.indexOf(b.nodeId) + 1 || 99))
  const bottleneck = list.filter((x) => x.n).sort((a, b) => b.avgH - a.avgH)[0]
  return {
    key, name: latest?.name ?? key, total: insts.length, completed: done.length, running: insts.length - done.length,
    approved: done.filter((w) => w.status === 'approved').length, rejected: done.filter((w) => w.status === 'rejected').length, returnedOut: done.filter((w) => w.status === 'returned').length,
    avgCycleH: cycles.length ? cycles.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / cycles.length : undefined, medianCycleH: quantile(cycles, 0.5), p90CycleH: quantile(cycles, 0.9),
    returnRate: insts.length ? insts.filter((w) => w.history.some((h) => h.action === 'return')).length / insts.length : 0,
    slaBreaches, overdueNow, steps: list, bottleneck, cycles,
  }
}

export function monthlyVolume(s: AppState, months = 12): { labels: string[]; started: number[]; completed: number[] } {
  const end = s.settings.asOf.slice(0, 7)
  const keys: string[] = []
  let [y, m] = end.split('-').map(Number)
  for (let i = 0; i < months; i++) { keys.unshift(`${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`); m--; if (!m) { m = 12; y-- } }
  return {
    labels: keys,
    started: keys.map((k) => s.workflows.filter((w) => w.startedAt.slice(0, 7) === k).length),
    completed: keys.map((k) => s.workflows.filter((w) => w.completedAt?.slice(0, 7) === k).length),
  }
}

// ───────────────────────────── Inbox helpers
export function taskAmount(t: Task): number | undefined {
  const v = t.inst.data.amount
  return typeof v === 'number' ? v : undefined
}
/** Low-risk items eligible for bulk approval: routine reviews and small-dollar decisions, never gates, estimates or exceptions. */
export function isLowRisk(t: Task): boolean {
  if (t.node.type === 'form') return false
  if (['gate', 'estimate', 'waiver', 'budget', 'contract', 'closeout'].includes(t.inst.recordType)) return false
  const amt = taskAmount(t)
  if (amt != null && Math.abs(amt) > 250_000) return false
  return t.node.type === 'review' || ['deliverable', 'variance', 'contingency', 'change', 'initiation', 'safety-plan'].includes(t.inst.recordType)
}

/** A short, deterministic e-signature fingerprint (the password itself is never stored). */
export function signatureHash(parts: string[]): string {
  let h1 = 0x811c9dc5, h2 = 0x01000193
  for (const ch of parts.join('|')) { h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ ch.charCodeAt(0), 16777619) >>> 0; h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ ch.charCodeAt(0), 2246822519) >>> 0 }
  return (h1.toString(16).padStart(8, '0') + h2.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')).slice(0, 16)
}

export function isOutOfOffice(p: Person, asOf: string) { const o = p.outOfOffice; return !!o && asOf >= o.from && asOf <= o.to }

// ───────────────────────────── Condition helpers
export function parseConditionValue(raw: string, op: Condition['op']): unknown {
  if (op === 'truthy' || op === 'falsy') return undefined
  if (op === 'in') return raw.split(',').map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((x) => (x !== '' && !isNaN(Number(x)) ? Number(x) : x))
  if (raw === 'true') return true
  if (raw === 'false') return false
  return raw !== '' && !isNaN(Number(raw)) ? Number(raw) : raw
}
export const conditionValueText = (c?: Condition) => (c?.value == null ? '' : Array.isArray(c.value) ? c.value.join(', ') : String(c.value))

// ───────────────────────────── Version diff (feeds the publish note and revision history)
export function diffDefs(s: Pick<AppState, 'roles' | 'people'>, a: WorkflowDef | undefined, b: WorkflowDef): string {
  if (!a) return 'Initial release.'
  const out: string[] = []
  const an = new Map(a.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n])), bn = new Map(b.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]))
  const added = b.nodes.filter((n) => !an.has(n.id)), removed = a.nodes.filter((n) => !bn.has(n.id))
  if (added.length) out.push(`Added ${added.map((n) => `“${n.label}”`).join(', ')}`)
  if (removed.length) out.push(`Removed ${removed.map((n) => `“${n.label}”`).join(', ')}`)
  for (const n of b.nodes) {
    const o = an.get(n.id)
    if (!o) continue
    const ch: string[] = []
    if (o.label !== n.label) ch.push(`renamed from “${o.label}”`)
    if (JSON.stringify(o.assignee) !== JSON.stringify(n.assignee)) ch.push(`assignee ${describeAssignee(s, o.assignee, a.fields)} → ${describeAssignee(s, n.assignee, b.fields)}`)
    if ((o.slaDays ?? 0) !== (n.slaDays ?? 0)) ch.push(`SLA ${o.slaDays ?? 0}→${n.slaDays ?? 0} days`)
    if ((o.rule ?? 'any') !== (n.rule ?? 'any')) ch.push(`rule ${o.rule ?? 'any'}→${n.rule ?? 'any'}`)
    if (o.type !== n.type) ch.push(`type ${o.type}→${n.type}`)
    if (ch.length) out.push(`“${n.label}”: ${ch.join(', ')}`)
  }
  const ek = (e: WfEdge) => `${e.from}>${e.to}:${e.outcome ?? ''}:${JSON.stringify(e.condition ?? null)}`
  const ae = new Set(a.edges.map(ek)), be = new Set(b.edges.map(ek))
  const eAdd = b.edges.filter((e) => !ae.has(ek(e))).length, eDel = a.edges.filter((e) => !be.has(ek(e))).length
  if (eAdd || eDel) out.push(`Routing: ${eAdd} path(s) added, ${eDel} removed`)
  const fa = new Set(a.fields.map((f) => f.key)), fb = new Set(b.fields.map((f) => f.key))
  const fAdd = b.fields.filter((f) => !fa.has(f.key)), fDel = a.fields.filter((f) => !fb.has(f.key))
  if (fAdd.length) out.push(`New field(s): ${fAdd.map((f) => f.label).join(', ')}`)
  if (fDel.length) out.push(`Removed field(s): ${fDel.map((f) => f.label).join(', ')}`)
  if (a.name !== b.name) out.push(`Renamed to “${b.name}”`)
  if (a.purpose !== b.purpose || a.description !== b.description) out.push('Updated description/purpose')
  return out.length ? out.join('; ') + '.' : 'No functional changes.'
}

export function defaultValues(def: WorkflowDef): Record<string, unknown> {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {}
  for (const f of def.fields) {
    out[f.key] = f.type === 'money' ? 420_000 : f.type === 'number' ? 0 : f.type === 'boolean' ? false : f.type === 'select' ? (f.options ?? []).find(Boolean) ?? '' : f.type === 'date' ? '' : ''
  }
  return out
}

export function previewInstance(def: WorkflowDef, projectId: string | undefined, startedById: string, data: Record<string, unknown>): WorkflowInstance {
  return { id: 'preview', defId: def.id, defKey: def.key, defVersion: def.version, title: 'Preview', recordType: def.recordType, recordId: 'preview', projectId, status: 'running', active: [], startedAt: '', startedById, data, history: [] }
}

export function defaultTestProject(s: AppState): string | undefined {
  return (s.projects.find((p) => p.status === 'active' && p.team.projectControls && p.team.sponsor && p.team.constructionManager && p.stageIndex >= 2) ?? s.projects[0])?.id
}

export function relTime(fromIso: string, nowMsV: number): string {
  const h = (nowMsV - Date.parse(fromIso)) / 36e5
  if (!isFinite(h)) return '—'
  if (h < 1) return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(h * 60))} min ago`
  if (h < 24) return `${Math.round(h)} h ago`
  const d = Math.round(h / 24)
  return d === 1 ? 'yesterday' : `${d} days ago`
}

/** Open-step load by person across every running instance (who is holding work). */
export function tasksForAll(s: AppState): { person: Person; count: number; overdue: number }[] {
  const m = new Map<string, { count: number; overdue: number }>()
  for (const w of s.workflows) {
    if (w.status !== 'running') continue
    for (const a of w.active) for (const id of a.assigneeIds) {
      if (a.actedIds.includes(id)) continue
      const x = m.get(id) ?? { count: 0, overdue: 0 }
      x.count++
      if (a.due && a.due < s.settings.asOf) x.overdue++
      m.set(id, x)
    }
  }
  return [...m.entries()].map(([id, v]) => ({ person: s.people.find((p) => p.id === id)!, ...v })).filter((x) => x.person).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count || b.overdue - a.overdue)
}

// Auto-generated standard operating procedure (WF-11): swimlane diagram, step table, RACI, DOA table, revision history.
// The same generator draws the diagram in-app (theme tokens) and in the downloadable SOP (fixed print colors).
import type { AppState, WfEdge, WfNode, WorkflowDef } from '@/core/types'
import { htmlDoc } from '@/core/download'
import { fmtDate, fmtDateTime, money } from '@/core/util'
import { describeAssignee, edgeOutcomeLabel, isHuman, laneFor, lanesOf, nodeTypeLabel, orderedNodes, outcomePaths, recordTypeLabel, stepDuty, versionsOf, doaMatrixFor, SYSTEM_ACTIONS } from './lib'

export type Palette = Record<'ink' | 'muted' | 'faint' | 'line' | 'surface' | 'sunken' | 'good' | 'warn' | 'bad' | 'info' | 'link' | 'marker', string>
export const TOKEN_PALETTE: Palette = Object.fromEntries(['ink', 'muted', 'faint', 'line', 'surface', 'sunken', 'good', 'warn', 'bad', 'info', 'link', 'marker'].map((k) => [k, `rgb(var(--${k}))`])) as Palette
export const PRINT_PALETTE: Palette = { ink: '#141b24', muted: '#4f5a69', faint: '#7e8896', line: '#d6dce3', surface: '#ffffff', sunken: '#eef1f4', good: '#1b8048', warn: '#b86e00', bad: '#c02828', info: '#2c6ab2', link: '#145caa', marker: '#f0b000' }

const esc = (t: string) => t.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;')

function wrapText(t: string, max: number, lines = 2): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  let cur = ''
  for (const w of t.split(/\s+/)) {
    if ((cur + ' ' + w).trim().length > max && cur) { out.push(cur); cur = w } else cur = (cur + ' ' + w).trim()
  }
  if (cur) out.push(cur)
  if (out.length > lines) { const k = out.slice(0, lines); k[lines - 1] = k[lines - 1].slice(0, max - 1) + '…'; return k }
  return out
}

export interface SwimlaneLayout { lanes: string[]; cols: number; pos: Record<string, { col: number; lane: number; x: number; y: number }>; width: number; height: number }

const LANE_H = 92, HEAD_W = 132, COL_W = 158, TOP = 8

export function swimlaneLayout(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef): SwimlaneLayout {
  const lanes = lanesOf(s, def)
  const sorted = def.nodes.slice().sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x || a.y - b.y)
  // cluster x positions into columns
  const colOf: Record<string, number> = {}
  let col = -1, lastX = -Infinity
  for (const n of sorted) { if (n.x - lastX > 45) { col++; lastX = n.x } colOf[n.id] = col }
  // avoid two nodes in the same cell: push later ones right
  const taken = new Set<string>()
  const pos: SwimlaneLayout['pos'] = {}
  let shift = 0
  const colShift: Record<number, number> = {}
  for (const n of sorted) {
    const lane = Math.max(0, lanes.indexOf(laneFor(s, def, n)))
    let c = colOf[n.id] + (colShift[colOf[n.id]] ?? shift)
    while (taken.has(`${c}:${lane}`)) { c++; shift++; colShift[colOf[n.id]] = shift }
    taken.add(`${c}:${lane}`)
    pos[n.id] = { col: c, lane, x: HEAD_W + c * COL_W + COL_W / 2, y: TOP + lane * LANE_H + LANE_H / 2 }
  }
  const cols = Math.max(1, ...Object.values(pos).map((p) => p.col + 1))
  return { lanes, cols, pos, width: HEAD_W + cols * COL_W + 20, height: TOP + lanes.length * LANE_H + 40 }
}

const BOX = { w: 128, h: 50 }
function half(n: WfNode) {
  if (n.type === 'start' || n.type === 'end') return { w: 15, h: 15 }
  if (n.type === 'condition') return { w: 30, h: 30 }
  if (n.type === 'parallel-split' || n.type === 'parallel-join') return { w: 5, h: 30 }
  return { w: BOX.w / 2, h: BOX.h / 2 }
}

function edgePath(L: SwimlaneLayout, def: WorkflowDef, e: WfEdge): { d: string; mx: number; my: number; back: boolean } | null {
  const S = def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.from), T = def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.to)
  if (!S || !T) return null
  const a = L.pos[S.id], b = L.pos[T.id]
  const hs = half(S), ht = half(T)
  const back = e.outcome === 'return' || e.outcome === 'reject' || b.col < a.col
  if (back) {
    const yb = Math.max(a.y, b.y) + LANE_H / 2 - 6
    const x0 = a.x - 10, y0 = a.y + hs.h, x1 = b.x + 10, y1 = b.y + ht.h
    return { d: `M${x0} ${y0} C${x0} ${yb} ${x1} ${yb} ${x1} ${y1}`, mx: (x0 + x1) / 2, my: yb - 6, back: true }
  }
  if (b.col === a.col) {
    const down = b.y > a.y
    const x0 = a.x, y0 = a.y + (down ? hs.h : -hs.h), x1 = b.x, y1 = b.y + (down ? -ht.h : ht.h)
    return { d: `M${x0} ${y0} L${x1} ${y1}`, mx: x0, my: (y0 + y1) / 2, back: false }
  }
  const x0 = a.x + hs.w, y0 = a.y, x1 = b.x - ht.w, y1 = b.y
  const c = Math.max(30, (x1 - x0) * 0.5)
  // labels from decisions sit near the diamond so they never hide behind a later box
  const f = S.type === 'condition' ? 0.18 : 0.5
  const bez = (p0: number, p1: number, p2: number, p3: number) => (1 - f) ** 3 * p0 + 3 * (1 - f) ** 2 * f * p1 + 3 * (1 - f) * f * f * p2 + f ** 3 * p3
  return { d: `M${x0} ${y0} C${x0 + c} ${y0} ${x1 - c} ${y1} ${x1} ${y1}`, mx: bez(x0, x0 + c, x1 - c, x1), my: bez(y0, y0, y1, y1), back: false }
}

/** Swimlane diagram as an SVG string (lanes from laneOf, nodes ordered by x). */
export function swimlaneSvg(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef, P: Palette, opts: { idPrefix?: string } = {}): string {
  const L = swimlaneLayout(s, def)
  const id = opts.idPrefix ?? 'sl'
  const parts: string[] = []
  parts.push(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${L.width} ${L.height}" width="${L.width}" height="${L.height}" font-family="Public Sans, system-ui, sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Swimlane diagram: ${esc(def.name)}">`)
  parts.push(`<defs>${(['faint', 'warn', 'bad'] as const).map((c) => `<marker id="${id}-a-${c}" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill="${P[c]}"/></marker>`).join('')}</defs>`)
  L.lanes.forEach((lane, i) => {
    const y = TOP + i * LANE_H
    parts.push(`<rect x="0" y="${y}" width="${L.width - 10}" height="${LANE_H}" fill="${i % 2 ? P.surface : P.sunken}" stroke="${P.line}"/>`)
    parts.push(`<rect x="0" y="${y}" width="${HEAD_W - 8}" height="${LANE_H}" fill="${P.sunken}" stroke="${P.line}"/>`)
    wrapText(lane, 16, 3).forEach((l, j, arr) => parts.push(`<text x="10" y="${y + LANE_H / 2 - (arr.length - 1) * 7 + j * 14 + 4}" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" fill="${P.ink}">${esc(l)}</text>`))
  })
  for (const e of def.edges) {
    const g = edgePath(L, def, e)
    if (!g) continue
    const c = e.outcome === 'return' ? 'warn' : e.outcome === 'reject' ? 'bad' : 'faint'
    parts.push(`<path d="${g.d}" fill="none" stroke="${P[c]}" stroke-width="1.5" ${g.back ? 'stroke-dasharray="5 4"' : ''} marker-end="url(#${id}-a-${c})"/>`)
    const label = edgeOutcomeLabel(e)
    if (label && (e.condition || g.back || e.label)) {
      const t = label.length > 24 ? label.slice(0, 23) + '…' : label
      parts.push(`<rect x="${g.mx - t.length * 2.9 - 5}" y="${g.my - 8}" width="${t.length * 5.8 + 10}" height="15" rx="7" fill="${P.surface}" stroke="${P[c === 'faint' ? 'line' : c]}"/><text x="${g.mx}" y="${g.my + 3}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.5" font-weight="600" fill="${P[c === 'faint' ? 'muted' : c]}">${esc(t)}</text>`)
    }
  }
  const order = orderedNodes(def)
  for (const n of def.nodes) {
    const p = L.pos[n.id]
    const num = order.filter((x) => isHuman(x.type) || x.type === 'system' || x.type === 'notify').indexOf(n) + 1
    if (n.type === 'start' || n.type === 'end') {
      parts.push(`<circle cx="${p.x}" cy="${p.y}" r="15" fill="${n.type === 'start' ? P.surface : P.ink}" stroke="${n.type === 'start' ? P.good : P.ink}" stroke-width="2.5"/>`)
      parts.push(`<text x="${p.x}" y="${p.y + 30}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="${P.muted}">${esc(n.label)}</text>`)
    } else if (n.type === 'condition') {
      parts.push(`<polygon points="${p.x},${p.y - 30} ${p.x + 30},${p.y} ${p.x},${p.y + 30} ${p.x - 30},${p.y}" fill="${P.surface}" stroke="${P.warn}" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="${p.x}" y="${p.y + 5}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="${P.warn}">?</text>`)
      wrapText(n.label, 22).forEach((l, j) => parts.push(`<text x="${p.x}" y="${p.y + 42 + j * 11}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.5" font-weight="600" fill="${P.ink}">${esc(l)}</text>`))
    } else if (n.type === 'parallel-split' || n.type === 'parallel-join') {
      parts.push(`<rect x="${p.x - 5}" y="${p.y - 30}" width="10" height="60" rx="2" fill="${P.ink}"/>`)
    } else {
      const sys = n.type === 'system' || n.type === 'notify'
      const color = n.type === 'approval' ? P.marker : n.type === 'form' ? P.link : n.type === 'review' ? P.info : P.faint
      parts.push(`<rect x="${p.x - BOX.w / 2}" y="${p.y - BOX.h / 2}" width="${BOX.w}" height="${BOX.h}" rx="${sys ? 25 : 5}" fill="${P.surface}" stroke="${n.type === 'approval' ? P.warn : P.line}" stroke-width="${n.type === 'approval' ? 1.6 : 1.2}" ${sys ? 'stroke-dasharray="4 3"' : ''}/>`)
      if (!sys) parts.push(`<rect x="${p.x - BOX.w / 2}" y="${p.y - BOX.h / 2}" width="4" height="${BOX.h}" rx="2" fill="${color}"/>`)
      parts.push(`<text x="${p.x - BOX.w / 2 + (sys ? 14 : 10)}" y="${p.y - BOX.h / 2 + 12}" font-size="8" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.5" fill="${P.faint}">${num ? num + ' · ' : ''}${esc(nodeTypeLabel(n.type).toUpperCase())}${n.slaDays ? ' · ' + n.slaDays + 'D' : ''}</text>`)
      wrapText(n.label, 21).forEach((l, j) => parts.push(`<text x="${p.x - BOX.w / 2 + (sys ? 14 : 10)}" y="${p.y - BOX.h / 2 + 26 + j * 12}" font-size="10.5" font-weight="600" fill="${P.ink}">${esc(l)}</text>`))
    }
  }
  parts.push('</svg>')
  return parts.join('')
}

// ───────────────────────────── Tables
export interface StepRow { num: number; node: WfNode; who: string; sla: string; duty: string; outcomes: string }
export function stepRows(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef): StepRow[] {
  let i = 0
  return orderedNodes(def).filter((n) => n.type !== 'parallel-join').map((n) => ({
    num: n.type === 'start' || n.type === 'end' ? 0 : ++i,
    node: n,
    who: isHuman(n.type) || n.type === 'notify' ? `${describeAssignee(s, n.assignee, def.fields)}${n.rule === 'all' ? ' (all must act)' : n.rule === 'any' ? ' (any one)' : ''}` : n.type === 'start' ? 'Requester' : 'Mainline (automatic)',
    sla: n.slaDays ? `${n.slaDays} business day${n.slaDays > 1 ? 's' : ''}` : '—',
    duty: stepDuty(def, n),
    outcomes: outcomePaths(def, n),
  }))
}

export type RaciCode = 'R' | 'A' | 'C' | 'I' | 'A/R'
export function raci(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef): { cols: string[]; rows: { label: string; cells: Record<string, RaciCode | ''> }[] } {
  const lanes = lanesOf(s, def).filter((l) => l !== 'System')
  const owner = s.roles.find((r) => r.id === def.ownerRole)?.name ?? def.ownerRole
  const cols = [...lanes]
  if (!cols.includes(owner)) cols.push(owner)
  if (!cols.includes('Requester')) cols.push('Requester')
  const rows = orderedNodes(def).filter((n) => isHuman(n.type) || n.type === 'system' || n.type === 'notify').map((n) => {
    const cells: Record<string, RaciCode | ''> = Object.fromEntries(cols.map((c) => [c, ''])) as Record<string, RaciCode | ''>
    const lane = laneFor(s, def, n)
    if (n.type === 'approval') cells[lane] = 'A/R'
    else if (n.type === 'notify') cells[lane] = 'I'
    else if (lane !== 'System') cells[lane] = 'R'
    if (n.type !== 'approval' && !cells[owner]) cells[owner] = 'A'
    if (n.type === 'approval') {
      for (const e of def.edges.filter((x) => x.to === n.id)) {
        const p = def.nodes.find((x) => x.id === e.from)
        if (p && p.type === 'review') { const l = laneFor(s, def, p); if (!cells[l]) cells[l] = 'C' }
      }
      if (!cells.Requester) cells.Requester = 'I'
    }
    if (n.type === 'system' && !cells.Requester) cells.Requester = 'I'
    return { label: n.label, cells }
  })
  return { cols, rows }
}

export interface Revision { version: number; status: string; effective: string; summary: string; at?: string; by?: string }
export function revisions(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef): Revision[] {
  const vs = versionsOf(s, def.key)
  const log = s.audit.filter((a) => a.entity === 'workflow-def' && a.entityId === def.key)
  return vs.map((v) => {
    const hit = log.filter((a) => a.summary.includes(`v${v.version}`) && a.action === 'publish').pop()
    return { version: v.version, status: v.status, effective: v.effective, summary: hit?.summary.replace(/^Published [^:]+: ?/, '') || (v.version === vs[vs.length - 1].version ? (v.version === 1 ? 'Initial release.' : 'Current release migrated into Crosswalk; earlier versions archived in the legacy procedure library.') : 'Revision.'), at: hit?.at, by: hit?.actorId }
  })
}

export function rolesInvolved(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef): { lane: string; duties: string[] }[] {
  return lanesOf(s, def).map((lane) => ({ lane, duties: orderedNodes(def).filter((n) => laneFor(s, def, n) === lane && n.type !== 'start' && n.type !== 'end' && n.type !== 'parallel-split' && n.type !== 'parallel-join').map((n) => n.label) })).filter((x) => x.duties.length)
}

// ───────────────────────────── Downloadable SOP
export function sopBody(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef, narrative?: string, idPrefix = 'sop'): string {
  const owner = s.roles.find((r) => r.id === def.ownerRole)?.name ?? def.ownerRole
  const steps = stepRows(s, def)
  const R = raci(s, def)
  const m = doaMatrixFor(s)
  const usesDoa = def.nodes.some((n) => n.assignee?.kind === 'doa')
  const revs = revisions(s, def)
  const name = (id?: string) => s.people.find((p) => p.id === id)?.name ?? (id === 'system' ? 'System' : '—')
  const conditionEdges = def.edges.filter((e) => e.condition)
  const sys = def.nodes.filter((n) => n.type === 'system')
  const body = `
  <div class="meta">${esc(s.settings.orgName)} · Standard operating procedure · Generated by Crosswalk ${esc(fmtDate(s.settings.asOf))}</div>
  <h1>${esc(def.name)}</h1>
  <div class="meta">Process key <code>${esc(def.key)}</code> · Version ${def.version} (${esc(def.status)}) · Effective ${esc(fmtDate(def.effective))} · Process owner: ${esc(owner)}</div>
  <h2>1. Purpose</h2><p>${esc(def.purpose || '—')}</p>
  ${narrative ? `<h3>Narrative</h3>${narrative.split(/\n{2,}/).map((p) => `<p>${esc(p).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p>`).join('')}` : ''}
  <h2>2. Scope</h2>
  <p>${esc(def.description || '')}</p>
  <table><tbody>
    <tr><th>Applies to</th><td>Every ${esc(recordTypeLabel(def.recordType).toLowerCase())} record routed in Crosswalk under process key <code>${esc(def.key)}</code>.</td></tr>
    <tr><th>Trigger</th><td>The process starts when a ${esc(recordTypeLabel(def.recordType).toLowerCase())} is submitted for approval. In-flight requests finish on the version they started on.</td></tr>
    <tr><th>Records</th><td>Every action is time-stamped in the workflow history and the audit log; approvals are e-signed after password re-authentication.</td></tr>
  </tbody></table>
  <h2>3. Roles and responsibilities</h2>
  <table><thead><tr><th>Role / lane</th><th>Responsible for</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${rolesInvolved(s, def).map((r) => `<tr><td><b>${esc(r.lane)}</b></td><td>${esc(r.duties.join('; '))}</td></tr>`).join('')}
  </tbody></table>
  <h2>4. Process map</h2>
  <div style="overflow-x:auto">${swimlaneSvg(s, def, PRINT_PALETTE, { idPrefix })}</div>
  <p class="meta">Solid arrows: forward path. Dashed amber arrows: return for revision. Diamonds: automatic routing rules. Black bars: parallel split / join.</p>
  <h2>5. Procedure</h2>
  <table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Step</th><th>Who</th><th>SLA</th><th>What they do</th><th>Outcome paths</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${steps.map((r) => `<tr><td class="num">${r.num || ''}</td><td><b>${esc(r.node.label)}</b><br><span class="tag">${esc(nodeTypeLabel(r.node.type))}</span></td><td>${esc(r.who)}</td><td>${esc(r.sla)}</td><td>${esc(r.duty)}</td><td>${esc(r.outcomes)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
  </tbody></table>
  ${conditionEdges.length ? `<h3>Routing rules</h3><table><thead><tr><th>At</th><th>Rule</th><th>Goes to</th></tr></thead><tbody>${conditionEdges.map((e) => `<tr><td>${esc(def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.from)?.label ?? '')}</td><td>${esc(edgeOutcomeLabel(e))} (${esc(e.condition!.field)} ${esc(e.condition!.op)} ${esc(String(e.condition!.value ?? ''))})</td><td>${esc(def.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.to)?.label ?? '')}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>` : ''}
  ${sys.length ? `<h3>Automatic actions</h3><ul>${sys.map((n) => `<li><b>${esc(n.label)}</b> — ${esc(SYSTEM_ACTIONS.find((a) => a.id === n.systemAction)?.does ?? '')}</li>`).join('')}</ul>` : ''}
  <h2>6. RACI matrix</h2>
  <table><thead><tr><th>Step</th>${R.cols.map((c) => `<th>${esc(c)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>
  ${R.rows.map((r) => `<tr><td>${esc(r.label)}</td>${R.cols.map((c) => `<td style="text-align:center;font-weight:700">${r.cells[c] ?? ''}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}
  </tbody></table>
  <p class="meta">R responsible · A accountable · C consulted · I informed</p>
  <h2>7. Form fields</h2>
  <table><thead><tr><th>Field</th><th>Key</th><th>Type</th><th>Required</th><th>Options</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${def.fields.map((f) => `<tr><td>${esc(f.label)}</td><td><code>${esc(f.key)}</code></td><td>${esc(f.type)}</td><td>${f.required ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</td><td>${esc((f.options ?? []).filter(Boolean).join(', '))}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="5">No form fields.</td></tr>'}
  </tbody></table>
  <h2>8. Approval authority</h2>
  ${usesDoa && m ? `<p>Steps marked “dollar authority” route to the approver whose limit first covers the amount, from <b>${esc(m.name)}</b> v${m.version}, effective ${esc(fmtDate(m.effective))}. Out-of-office approvers are replaced by their named delegate for the dates set.</p>
  <table><thead><tr><th>Amount up to</th><th>Approver</th><th>Role</th><th>People holding the role</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${m.rows.slice().sort((a, b) => a.upTo - b.upTo).map((r, i, arr) => `<tr><td class="num">${r.upTo >= 1e12 ? `Above ${money(arr[i - 1]?.upTo ?? 0, 'full')}` : money(r.upTo, 'full')}</td><td>${esc(r.label)}</td><td>${esc(s.roles.find((x) => x.id === r.roleId)?.name ?? r.roleId)}</td><td>${esc(s.people.filter((p) => p.roles.includes(r.roleId) && !p.company).map((p) => p.name).join(', '))}</td></tr>`).join('')}
  </tbody></table>` : '<p>This process does not route by dollar amount; approvers are named by role or project team position in the procedure above.</p>'}
  <h2>9. Revision history</h2>
  <table><thead><tr><th>Version</th><th>Status</th><th>Effective</th><th>Change</th><th>Published</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${revs.map((r) => `<tr><td>v${r.version}</td><td>${esc(r.status)}</td><td>${esc(fmtDate(r.effective))}</td><td>${esc(r.summary)}</td><td>${r.at ? esc(fmtDateTime(r.at) + ' · ' + name(r.by)) : '—'}</td></tr>`).join('')}
  </tbody></table>
  <p class="meta">This SOP is generated from the live process definition, so the document and the system cannot drift apart.</p>`
  return body
}

export const sopHtml = (s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef, narrative?: string) => htmlDoc(`${def.name} — SOP v${def.version}`, sopBody(s, def, narrative))

/** Every published process in one printable manual with a table of contents. */
export function manualHtml(s: AppState, defs: WorkflowDef[]): string {
  const toc = `<div class="meta">${esc(s.settings.orgName)} · Generated by Crosswalk ${esc(fmtDate(s.settings.asOf))}</div><h1>Capital delivery process manual</h1>
  <p>${defs.length} published business processes with defined approvers, routing rules and approval authority. Each section is generated from the live process definition.</p>
  <table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Process</th><th>Key</th><th>Version</th><th>Effective</th><th>Owner</th></tr></thead><tbody>${defs.map((d, i) => `<tr><td class="num">${i + 1}</td><td>${esc(d.name)}</td><td><code>${esc(d.key)}</code></td><td>v${d.version}</td><td>${esc(fmtDate(d.effective))}</td><td>${esc(s.roles.find((r) => r.id === d.ownerRole)?.name ?? d.ownerRole)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`
  return htmlDoc('Capital delivery process manual', toc + defs.map((d, i) => `<div style="page-break-before:always;margin-top:56px;border-top:3px solid #141b24;padding-top:8px">${sopBody(s, d, undefined, 'm' + i)}</div>`).join(''))
}

/** Plain-text brief of the process, for the AI narrative prompt. */
export function processBrief(s: AppState, def: WorkflowDef): string {
  const steps = stepRows(s, def)
  return [
    `Process: ${def.name} (key ${def.key}, version ${def.version}, record type ${recordTypeLabel(def.recordType)})`,
    `Owner: ${s.roles.find((r) => r.id === def.ownerRole)?.name ?? def.ownerRole}`,
    `Description: ${def.description}`,
    `Purpose: ${def.purpose}`,
    `Form fields: ${def.fields.map((f) => `${f.label} (${f.type})`).join(', ') || 'none'}`,
    'Steps:',
    ...steps.map((r) => `- ${r.num ? r.num + '. ' : ''}${r.node.label} [${nodeTypeLabel(r.node.type)}] — who: ${r.who}; SLA: ${r.sla}; does: ${r.duty}; outcomes: ${r.outcomes}`),
  ].join('\n')
}

===== FILE: src/views/workflows/SopView.tsx =====
// In-app SOP (WF-11): the same content as the downloadable document, rendered with theme tokens.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, WorkflowDef } from '@/core/types'
import { ask, aiMessage, useAiAvailable } from '@/core/ai'
import { saveFile } from '@/core/download'
import { fmtDate, fmtDateTime, money } from '@/core/util'
import { AiTag, Badge, Button, Callout, KV, Panel, Section } from '@/ui/kit'
import { toast } from '@/ui/toast'
import { doaMatrixFor, nodeTypeLabel, recordTypeLabel } from './lib'
import { TOKEN_PALETTE, processBrief, raci, revisions, rolesInvolved, sopHtml, stepRows, swimlaneSvg } from './sop'

export function SopView({ s, def, onDownload }: { s: AppState; def: WorkflowDef; onDownload: () => void }) {
  const steps = useMemo(() => stepRows(s, def), [s, def])
  const R = useMemo(() => raci(s, def), [s, def])
  const svg = useMemo(() => swimlaneSvg(s, def, TOKEN_PALETTE, { idPrefix: 'app' }), [s, def])
  const revs = useMemo(() => revisions(s, def), [s, def])
  const m = doaMatrixFor(s)
  const usesDoa = def.nodes.some((n) => n.assignee?.kind === 'doa')
  const owner = s.roles.find((r) => r.id === def.ownerRole)?.name ?? def.ownerRole
  const aiOk = useAiAvailable()
  const [narr, setNarr] = useState('')
  const [accepted, setAccepted] = useState(false)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const draft = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setAccepted(false); setNarr('')
    try {
      const prompt = `You write standard operating procedures for a gas utility's capital project delivery organization (${s.settings.orgName}, fictional demo).
Write a plain-language narrative for the SOP of the process below, for project managers and approvers. 3 short paragraphs, no headings, no bullet lists, no markdown:
1) why the control exists and what it protects (tie to regulatory reasonableness review where relevant);
2) how a request moves through the steps, naming who acts and the SLAs, including how returns and any routing rules work;
3) what good looks like for approvers (what to check before e-signing) and what happens to the record on completion.
Use only the facts below. Do not invent steps, people or dollar limits.

${processBrief(s, def)}
${usesDoa && m ? `Dollar authority (${m.name} v${m.version}): ${m.rows.slice().sort((a, b) => a.upTo - b.upTo).map((r) => `${r.upTo >= 1e12 ? 'above' : 'up to ' + money(r.upTo)} → ${r.label}`).join('; ')}` : ''}`
      const t = await ask(prompt, { onText: setNarr })
      setNarr(t.trim())
    } catch (e) { toast(aiMessage(e), 'bad') } finally { setBusy(false) }
  }
  const downloadWithNarrative = async () => {
    const r = await saveFile(`${def.key}-sop-v${def.version}.html`, sopHtml(s, def, accepted ? narr : undefined), 'text/html')
    toast(r === 'saved' ? 'SOP downloaded' : r === 'declined' ? 'Download cancelled' : 'Downloads are not available here', r === 'saved' ? 'good' : 'info')
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Panel title="Standard operating procedure" subtitle="Generated from the live definition — what you edit in the designer is what this document says."
        actions={<>
          {aiOk && <Button size="sm" disabled={busy} onClick={draft}>{busy ? 'Thinking…' : narr ? 'Redraft narrative' : '✦ Draft SOP narrative'}</Button>}
          <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={accepted && narr ? downloadWithNarrative : onDownload}>Download SOP (HTML)</Button>
        </>}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
          <KV cols={4} items={[['Process', <span key="n"><b>{def.name}</b> <span className="font-mono text-[11.5px] text-faint">{def.key}</span></span>], ['Version', <span key="v">v{def.version} <Badge tone={def.status === 'published' ? 'good' : def.status === 'draft' ? 'info' : 'neutral'}>{def.status}</Badge></span>], ['Effective', fmtDate(def.effective)], ['Process owner', owner]]} />
          <Section title="1 · Purpose"><p className="max-w-3xl text-[13.5px]">{def.purpose || <span className="text-muted">No purpose written yet — add it in the designer's Process tab.</span>}</p></Section>
          {narr && (
            <div className="rounded-md border border-info/40 bg-info/5 p-3">
              <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-2">{!accepted && <AiTag />}<span className="text-[12px] font-semibold">{accepted ? 'Narrative accepted — included in the download' : 'Review before accepting'}</span>
                {!busy && !accepted && <span className="ml-auto flex gap-1"><Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => { setAccepted(true); toast('Narrative accepted') }}>Accept</Button><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setNarr('')}>Discard</Button></span>}
              </div>
              {narr.split(/\n{2,}/).map((p, i) => <p key={i} className="mb-2 max-w-3xl text-[13.5px] last:mb-0">{p}</p>)}
            </div>
          )}
          <Section title="2 · Scope">
            <p className="max-w-3xl text-[13.5px]">{def.description}</p>
            <p className="max-w-3xl text-[13px] text-muted">Applies to every {recordTypeLabel(def.recordType).toLowerCase()} routed under <span className="font-mono">{def.key}</span>. Requests finish on the version they started on. Every action is time-stamped; approvals are e-signed after password re-authentication.</p>
          </Section>
          <Section title="3 · Roles">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
              {rolesInvolved(s, def).map((r) => <div key={r.lane} className="rounded border border-line px-3 py-2"><div className="text-[13px] font-semibold">{r.lane}</div><div className="text-[12px] text-muted">{r.duties.join(' · ')}</div></div>)}
            </div>
          </Section>
          <Section title="4 · Swimlane process map">
            <div className="scroll-x rounded border border-line bg-surface p-2" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: svg }} />
          </Section>
          <Section title="5 · Procedure">
            <div className="scroll-x">
              <table className="tbl">
                <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Step</th><th>Who</th><th>SLA</th><th>What they do</th><th>Outcome paths</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>
                  {steps.map((r) => (
                    <tr key={r.node.id}>
                      <td className="num text-faint">{r.num || ''}</td>
                      <td className="min-w-[160px]"><b>{r.node.label}</b><div><Badge tone={r.node.type === 'approval' ? 'marker' : 'neutral'}>{nodeTypeLabel(r.node.type)}</Badge></div></td>
                      <td className="min-w-[140px]">{r.who}</td>
                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap">{r.sla}</td>
                      <td className="min-w-[220px] text-muted">{r.duty}</td>
                      <td className="min-w-[220px] text-[12px]">{r.outcomes}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Section>
          <Section title="6 · RACI matrix">
            <div className="scroll-x">
              <table className="tbl">
                <thead><tr><th>Step</th>{R.cols.map((c) => <th key={c} className="text-center">{c}</th>)}</tr></thead>
                <tbody>{R.rows.map((r) => <tr key={r.label}><td>{r.label}</td>{R.cols.map((c) => <td key={c} className="text-center font-mono font-bold">{r.cells[c] ? <span className={r.cells[c]!.includes('A') ? 'text-ink' : 'text-muted'}>{r.cells[c]}</span> : ''}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">R responsible · A accountable · C consulted · I informed</p>
          </Section>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 xl:grid-cols-2">
            <Section title="7 · Form fields">
              <div className="scroll-x"><table className="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Field</th><th>Key</th><th>Type</th><th>Required</th></tr></thead><tbody>{def.fields.map((f) => <tr key={f.key}><td>{f.label}{f.options?.filter(Boolean).length ? <div className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">{f.options.filter(Boolean).join(', ')}</div> : null}</td><td className="font-mono text-[12px]">{f.key}</td><td>{f.type}</td><td>{f.required ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div>
            </Section>
            <Section title="8 · Approval authority">
              {usesDoa && m ? (
                <>
                  <p className="text-[12.5px] text-muted">Dollar-authority steps route to the first tier that covers the amount — {m.name} v{m.version}, effective {fmtDate(m.effective)}.</p>
                  <div className="scroll-x"><table className="tbl"><thead><tr><th className="num">Up to</th><th>Approver</th><th>Holders</th></tr></thead><tbody>{m.rows.slice().sort((a, b) => a.upTo - b.upTo).map((r, i, arr) => <tr key={i}><td className="num">{r.upTo >= 1e12 ? `> ${money(arr[i - 1]?.upTo ?? 0)}` : money(r.upTo)}</td><td>{r.label}</td><td className="text-[12px] text-muted">{s.people.filter((p) => p.roles.includes(r.roleId) && !p.company).map((p) => p.name).join(', ')}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div>
                </>
              ) : <Callout>This process does not route by dollar amount; approvers are named by role or team position.</Callout>}
            </Section>
          </div>
          <Section title="9 · Revision history">
            <div className="scroll-x"><table className="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Version</th><th>Status</th><th>Effective</th><th>Change</th><th>Published</th></tr></thead><tbody>{revs.map((r) => <tr key={r.version}><td className="font-semibold">v{r.version}</td><td><Badge tone={r.status === 'published' ? 'good' : r.status === 'draft' ? 'info' : 'neutral'}>{r.status}</Badge></td><td className="whitespace-nowrap">{fmtDate(r.effective)}</td><td className="text-muted">{r.summary}</td><td className="whitespace-nowrap text-[12px]">{r.at ? `${fmtDateTime(r.at)} · ${s.people.find((p) => p.id === r.by)?.name ?? ''}` : '—'}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div>
          </Section>
        </div>
      </Panel>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: src/views/workflows/TestMode.tsx =====
// Test routing (WF-09): enter sample form values and a project; see who the request would reach, step by step.
import { useMemo } from 'react'
import type { AppState, WorkflowDef } from '@/core/types'
import { cx, money } from '@/core/util'
import { Avatar, Badge, Button, Callout, Checkbox, Field, Input, MoneyInput, Panel, Select, TextArea } from '@/ui/kit'
import { ProjectSelect, PersonSelect } from '../shared/pickers'
import { Canvas } from './canvas'
import { defaultValues, doaMatrixFor, isOutOfOffice, nodeTypeLabel, trace } from './lib'
import type { Preview } from './editors'

export function TestMode({ s, def, preview, setPreview }: { s: AppState; def: WorkflowDef; preview: Preview; setPreview: (p: Preview | ((p: Preview) => Preview)) => void }) {
  const steps = useMemo(() => trace(s, def, preview.data, preview.projectId, preview.requesterId), [s, def, preview])
  const onPath = useMemo(() => new Set(steps.map((x) => x.node.id)), [steps])
  const project = s.projects.find((p) => p.id === preview.projectId)
  const setVal = (k: string, v: unknown) => setPreview((p) => ({ ...p, data: { ...p.data, [k]: v } }))
  const m = doaMatrixFor(s, preview.projectId)
  const ooo = s.people.filter((p) => isOutOfOffice(p, s.settings.asOf))
  const humanCount = steps.filter((x) => x.kind === 'human' && x.node.type !== 'notify').length
  const slaTotal = steps.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.node.slaDays ?? 0), 0)
  const skipped = steps.filter((x) => x.kind === 'human' && !x.people.length)
  const amountField = def.fields.find((f) => f.type === 'money')
  const scenarios = amountField ? [100_000, 1_200_000, 12_000_000, 75_000_000] : []
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[340px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
      <Panel title="Sample request" subtitle="Nothing is saved — this is a dry run against live people, teams and authority.">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Field label="Project"><ProjectSelect id="wf-test-project" value={preview.projectId} onChange={(id) => setPreview((p) => ({ ...p, projectId: id }))} /></Field>
          <Field label="Requested by"><PersonSelect id="wf-test-requester" value={preview.requesterId} onChange={(id) => setPreview((p) => ({ ...p, requesterId: id }))} /></Field>
          {def.fields.map((f) => (
            <Field key={f.key} label={<>{f.label} <span className="font-mono text-[10.5px] font-normal text-faint">{f.key}</span></>}>
              {f.type === 'money' ? <MoneyInput value={Number(preview.data[f.key] ?? 0)} onChange={(v) => setVal(f.key, v)} />
                : f.type === 'number' ? <Input type="number" value={String(preview.data[f.key] ?? 0)} onChange={(e) => setVal(f.key, Number(e.target.value))} />
                : f.type === 'boolean' ? <Checkbox checked={!!preview.data[f.key]} onChange={(v) => setVal(f.key, v)} label="Yes" />
                : f.type === 'select' ? <Select value={String(preview.data[f.key] ?? '')} onChange={(e) => setVal(f.key, e.target.value)} options={(f.options ?? []).length ? (f.options ?? []).map((o) => ({ value: o, label: o || '—' })) : [{ value: '', label: '—' }]} />
                : f.type === 'date' ? <Input type="date" value={String(preview.data[f.key] ?? '')} onChange={(e) => setVal(f.key, e.target.value)} />
                : f.type === 'textarea' ? <TextArea className="min-h-[52px]" value={String(preview.data[f.key] ?? '')} onChange={(e) => setVal(f.key, e.target.value)} />
                : <Input value={String(preview.data[f.key] ?? '')} onChange={(e) => setVal(f.key, e.target.value)} />}
            </Field>
          ))}
          {scenarios.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <div className="mb-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-muted">Try an amount</div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">{scenarios.map((a) => <Button key={a} size="sm" variant={preview.data[amountField!.key] === a ? 'primary' : 'secondary'} onClick={() => setVal(amountField!.key, a)}>{money(a)}</Button>)}</div>
            </div>
          )}
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setPreview((p) => ({ ...p, data: defaultValues(def) }))}>Reset values</Button>
          {ooo.length > 0 && <Callout tone="info" title="Delegations in force">{ooo.map((p) => <div key={p.id}>{p.name} → {s.people.find((x) => x.id === p.outOfOffice!.delegateId)?.name} until {p.outOfOffice!.to}</div>)}</Callout>}
        </div>
      </Panel>
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
          <MiniStat label="People steps" value={String(humanCount)} />
          <MiniStat label="SLA on this path" value={`${slaTotal} days`} />
          <MiniStat label="Approver tier" value={(() => { const st = steps.find((x) => x.node.assignee?.kind === 'doa'); if (!st || !m) return '—'; const amt = Math.abs(Number(preview.data[(st.node.assignee as { field: string }).field] ?? 0)); return m.rows.slice().sort((a, b) => a.upTo - b.upTo).find((r) => amt <= r.upTo)?.label ?? '—' })()} />
          <MiniStat label="Skipped (no one)" value={String(skipped.length)} tone={skipped.length ? 'bad' : undefined} />
        </div>
        <Panel title="Route" subtitle={`${def.name} v${def.version}${project ? ` on ${project.code} ${project.name}` : ''}`} pad={false}>
          <ol className="divide-y divide-line">
            {steps.map((st, i) => (
              <li key={st.node.id + i} className={cx('flex gap-3 px-4 py-2.5', st.kind === 'auto' && 'bg-sunken/40')}>
                <span className={cx('mt-0.5 flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold', st.kind === 'human' ? (st.people.length ? 'bg-ink text-surface' : 'bg-bad text-white') : 'border border-line text-faint')}>{i + 1}</span>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <b className="text-[13px]">{st.node.label}</b>
                    <Badge tone={st.node.type === 'approval' ? 'marker' : st.kind === 'auto' ? 'neutral' : 'info'}>{nodeTypeLabel(st.node.type)}</Badge>
                    {st.via && st.via !== 'parallel' && <span className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">via “{st.via}”</span>}
                    {st.via === 'parallel' && <Badge>parallel branch</Badge>}
                    {st.node.slaDays ? <span className="ml-auto text-[12px] text-muted">{st.node.slaDays}-day SLA</span> : null}
                  </div>
                  {st.people.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
                      {st.people.map((p) => <span key={p.id} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12.5px]"><Avatar name={p.name} size={18} /><b>{p.name}</b><span className="text-muted">{p.title}</span></span>)}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {st.delegatedFrom.map((d) => <div key={d.from.id} className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-info">Delegated: {d.from.name} is out of office until {d.from.outOfOffice?.to}; {d.to.name} acts instead.</div>)}
                  {st.note && <div className={cx('mt-0.5 text-[12px]', st.kind === 'human' && !st.people.length ? 'text-bad' : 'text-muted')}>{st.note}</div>}
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        </Panel>
        <Panel title="Path on the diagram" pad={false}>
          <div className="max-h-[380px] overflow-auto"><Canvas s={s} def={def} readOnly highlight={onPath} zoom={0.8} /></div>
        </Panel>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function MiniStat({ label, value, tone }: { label: string; value: string; tone?: 'bad' }) {
  return <div className="min-w-0 rounded-md border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2"><div className="eyebrow truncate">{label}</div><div className={cx('mt-0.5 truncate font-display text-[18px] font-bold tabular-nums', tone === 'bad' && 'text-bad')}>{value}</div></div>
}

===== FILE: src/views/workflows/Versions.tsx =====
// Version history and live instances of one process; select an instance to see where it sits on its own version's diagram.
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { AppState, WorkflowDef } from '@/core/types'
import { personName } from '@/core/store'
import { projectHref } from '@/core/router'
import { fmtDate, fmtDateTime } from '@/core/util'
import { Badge, Button, Empty, Panel, SegButtons, StatusBadge, Table } from '@/ui/kit'
import { WorkflowStatus } from '../shared/WorkflowStatus'
import { Canvas } from './canvas'
import { fmtDur, nowMs, versionsOf } from './lib'
import { revisions } from './sop'

export function VersionsPanel({ s, defKey, current, onOpen }: { s: AppState; defKey: string; current: WorkflowDef; onOpen: (id: string) => void }) {
  const versions = versionsOf(s, defKey)
  const revs = revisions(s, current)
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'running' | 'done' | 'all'>('running')
  const insts = useMemo(() => s.workflows.filter((w) => w.defKey === defKey && (filter === 'all' || (filter === 'running' ? w.status === 'running' : w.status !== 'running'))).sort((a, b) => b.startedAt.localeCompare(a.startedAt)), [s.workflows, defKey, filter])
  const [pick, setPick] = useState<string | undefined>()
  const sel = s.workflows.find((w) => w.id === pick) ?? insts[0]
  const selDef = sel && s.workflowDefs.find((d) => d.id === sel.defId)
  const now = nowMs(s)
  const proj = (id?: string) => s.projects.find((p) => p.id === id)
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <Panel title="Versions" subtitle="Published versions are immutable. Publishing retires the previous version; requests already in flight finish on the version they started on." pad={false}>
        <Table rowKey={(v) => v.id} rows={versions} columns={[
          { key: 'v', header: 'Version', render: (v) => <b>v{v.version}</b>, sort: (v) => v.version },
          { key: 'st', header: 'Status', render: (v) => <Badge tone={v.status === 'published' ? 'good' : v.status === 'draft' ? 'info' : 'neutral'}>{v.status}</Badge> },
          { key: 'eff', header: 'Effective', render: (v) => fmtDate(v.effective) },
          { key: 'steps', header: 'Steps', num: true, render: (v) => v.nodes.length },
          { key: 'inst', header: 'Instances', num: true, render: (v) => s.workflows.filter((w) => w.defId === v.id).length },
          { key: 'run', header: 'Running', num: true, render: (v) => { const n = s.workflows.filter((w) => w.defId === v.id && w.status === 'running').length; return n ? <Badge tone="marker">{n}</Badge> : '0' } },
          { key: 'chg', header: 'Change', render: (v) => <span className="text-[12px] text-muted">{revs.find((r) => r.version === v.version)?.summary}</span> },
          { key: 'open', header: '', render: (v) => <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => onOpen(v.id)}>Open</Button> },
        ]} />
      </Panel>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
        <Panel title="Instances" actions={<SegButtons value={filter} onChange={(f) => { setFilter(f); setPick(undefined) }} options={[{ id: 'running', label: 'Running' }, { id: 'done', label: 'Completed' }, { id: 'all', label: 'All' }]} />} pad={false}>
          <Table rowKey={(w) => w.id} rows={insts} maxHeight={520} onRowClick={(w) => setPick(w.id)} empty={<div className="p-4"><Empty title="Nothing here">No {filter === 'running' ? 'running' : filter === 'done' ? 'completed' : ''} instances of this process.</Empty></div>} columns={[
            { key: 't', header: 'Request', render: (w) => <div className={w.id === sel?.id ? 'font-semibold text-link' : ''}><div className="max-w-[300px] truncate">{w.title}</div><div className="text-[11.5px] text-faint">{proj(w.projectId)?.code ?? 'Portfolio'} · v{w.defVersion} · by {personName(s, w.startedById)}</div></div> },
            { key: 'at', header: 'Where', render: (w) => w.status === 'running' ? <span className="text-[12px]">{w.active.map((a) => s.workflowDefs.find((d) => d.id === w.defId)?.nodes.find((n) => n.id === a.nodeId)?.label).join(', ')}</span> : <StatusBadge status={w.status} /> },
            { key: 'age', header: 'Age', num: true, sort: (w) => w.startedAt, render: (w) => fmtDur(((w.completedAt ? Date.parse(w.completedAt) : now) - Date.parse(w.startedAt)) / 36e5) },
          ]} />
        </Panel>
        {sel && selDef ? (
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3">
            <Panel title={sel.title} subtitle={<>Started {fmtDateTime(sel.startedAt)} on v{sel.defVersion}{sel.projectId && <> · <a className="text-link" href={projectHref(sel.projectId, 'activity')}>{proj(sel.projectId)?.code}</a></>}</>} pad={false}>
              <div className="max-h-[320px] overflow-auto"><Canvas s={s} def={selDef} readOnly zoom={0.72} active={new Set(sel.active.map((a) => a.nodeId))} done={new Set(sel.history.filter((h) => h.action === 'approve' || h.action === 'submit').map((h) => h.nodeId))} /></div>
            </Panel>
            <WorkflowStatus instanceId={sel.id} />
          </div>
        ) : <Empty title="Select an instance">Pick a request to see where it sits.</Empty>}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

===== FILE: .github/workflows/deploy.yml =====
# Test, then deploy the demo as one Neon Function (page + API) next to its Neon Postgres database.
# Every push to main: typecheck, tests, license check, build, then `neon deploy`. Migrations run on the
# function's first API request (plain SQL from migrations/, applied once each).
#
# Repository secrets (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions):
#   NEON_API_KEY      Neon → Account settings → API keys
#   NEON_PROJECT_ID   the Neon project id (e.g. cold-term-78724510)
#   EDIT_PASSCODE     the passcode people type to edit the shared demo
# Until those are set, the workflow only runs the checks.
name: Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: node scripts/embed-page.mjs   # the function bundles the built page, so typecheck after it
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run licenses
  deploy:
    needs: check
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      NEON_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEON_API_KEY }}
      NEON_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.NEON_PROJECT_ID }}
      EDIT_PASSCODE: ${{ secrets.EDIT_PASSCODE }}
    steps:
      - name: Secrets present?
        id: ready
        run: |
          if [ -n "$NEON_API_KEY" ] && [ -n "$NEON_PROJECT_ID" ] && [ -n "$EDIT_PASSCODE" ]; then
            echo "ok=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "::notice::Deploy skipped: add NEON_API_KEY, NEON_PROJECT_ID and EDIT_PASSCODE as repository secrets."
          fi
      - if: steps.ready.outputs.ok == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - if: steps.ready.outputs.ok == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - if: steps.ready.outputs.ok == 'true'
        run: npm ci && npm run build && node scripts/embed-page.mjs
      - name: Deploy to Neon
        if: steps.ready.outputs.ok == 'true'
        run: npx --yes neon@8.17.1 deploy --project-id "$NEON_PROJECT_ID" --no-env-pull --yes

===== FILE: migrations/001_shared_state.sql =====
-- Shared state for the hosted demo (AGENT_RULES §5: plain SQL migrations, Postgres only).
--
-- A "generation" is one run of the shared dataset. It starts from a full snapshot (seq 0) and grows by an
-- ordered log of changes (immer patches). "Reset demo data" starts a new generation; nothing is ever
-- updated or deleted (rule 21: append-only), so every past edit stays on record.

create table if not exists generations (
  id             bigserial primary key,
  schema_version integer     not null,
  started_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  started_by     text        not null,
  reason         text        not null default ''
);

create table if not exists changes (
  generation_id bigint      not null references generations (id),
  seq           integer     not null check (seq > 0),
  at            timestamptz not null default now(),
  actor         text        not null,
  summary       text        not null default '',
  patches       text        not null, -- JSON array of immer patches, stored as text and passed through untouched
  primary key (generation_id, seq)    -- two writers racing for the same seq: the second gets a conflict
);

create table if not exists snapshots (
  generation_id bigint      not null references generations (id),
  seq           integer     not null check (seq >= 0),
  at            timestamptz not null default now(),
  state_gz      text        not null, -- base64 of the gzipped JSON state after change `seq`
  primary key (generation_id, seq)
);

create index if not exists generations_schema_idx on generations (schema_version, id desc);

-- Append-only: refuse every UPDATE and DELETE (and TRUNCATE) on the three tables.
create or replace function crosswalk_append_only() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$
begin
  raise exception 'crosswalk: % is append-only; % is not allowed', tg_table_name, tg_op;
end $$;

drop trigger if exists generations_append_only on generations;
create trigger generations_append_only before update or delete on generations for each row execute function crosswalk_append_only();
drop trigger if exists generations_no_truncate on generations;
create trigger generations_no_truncate before truncate on generations for each statement execute function crosswalk_append_only();

drop trigger if exists changes_append_only on changes;
create trigger changes_append_only before update or delete on changes for each row execute function crosswalk_append_only();
drop trigger if exists changes_no_truncate on changes;
create trigger changes_no_truncate before truncate on changes for each statement execute function crosswalk_append_only();

drop trigger if exists snapshots_append_only on snapshots;
create trigger snapshots_append_only before update or delete on snapshots for each row execute function crosswalk_append_only();
drop trigger if exists snapshots_no_truncate on snapshots;
create trigger snapshots_no_truncate before truncate on snapshots for each statement execute function crosswalk_append_only();
